before: I think it earns that kind of a laugh because everybody has a piece of that mother. (Laughter) EH: And the sitcom Jewish mother is born, right there.
after: NL: Yeah. EH: Tell us what happened when you were nine years old.
ru: Отец также серьёзно повлиял на вашу жизнь, в основном своим отсутствием.

quote: It's the absence of susceptibility factors and risk factors for these disorders.
before: And this ability to experience stress and be resilient and bounce back and not develop depression or PTSD is known as stress resilience, and it varies between people. And we have always thought of it as just sort of this passive property.
after: But what if it were active? Maybe we could enhance it, sort of akin to putting on armor.
ru: Это отсутствие факторов восприимчивости и факторов риска для данных расстройств.

quote: We cannot make decisions in the absence of all of the information.
before: The infectious diseases Cochrane Group, which are based in Italy, has been trying to get the full data in a usable form out of the drug companies, so they can make a full decision about whether this drug is effective or not, and they've not been able to get that information. This is undoubtedly the single biggest ethical problem facing medicine today.
after: So it's a little bit difficult from there to spin in some kind of positive conclusion. But I would say this: I think that sunlight is the best disinfectant.
ru: Мы не можем принимать решения при отсутствии полной информации.

quote: The discovery comes after an extensive search by mountain rescue teams, following Todd's unexpected absence.
after: According to GMP, the chief Constable had been on a walking trip, which was not uncommon, however when he failed to return the alarm was raised.

quote: But, you know, I met a group of lads that blagged a caravan for free, it was an absolute wreck.
before: I've always been a bike fanatic but my parents have always been against it and by the time I got to 15, I think I wore my parents down that much. They were a bit concerned about me getting a road bike so they got me a trials bike and the minute I was 17, I took my test and got a road bike, so it backfired a bit on my parents.
after: Dragged it all over the country, it was falling apart and we got to race meetings, had a few beers at a barbecue, raced all day. It was just great to experience that side of it.
ru: Однажды я познакомился с ребятами, они раздобыли где-то старый трейлер, полную развалюху,

before: Daddy's here. Amanda!
after: Come on, baby. Hang in there.
ru: Чтобы жить без греха, необходимо полное прощение.

quote: It could be the biggest finding of my career, or an absolute disaster.
before: Colleagues you've invited with the promise of a great breakthrough today. A man whose life hangs in the balance.
after: You're just nervous. I am.
ru: Это может стать самым большим достиженим в моей карьере или обернуться полным крахом.

quote: Anything other than absolute contrition would be sheer folly.
before: Should we explain that starvation and poverty are also relative? Let me be clear?
after: So my task is to grovel? Play the game by bending the rules?
ru: Всё помимо полного раскаяния будет безрассудством.

quote: One is total chaos. The other is absolute order.
before: Within seconds, as if the panels have noticed the presence of the viewer, they appear to panic and sort of get into a strict symmetry. (Laughter) So this is the sketch of the two states.
after: And we were interested in seeing how little change it takes to move from one state to the other state. This also reminded us of two very different pictorial traditions.
ru: Одно — полный хаос. Другое — полный порядок.

quote: This year, unfortunately the lakebed's turned into an absolute cracked dry bed.
before: A few years later, there's no snow left at all. And all the trees have turned brown.
after: And I fear, if we do nothing for our planet, in 20 years, it's going to look like this. (Laughter) Mr. Vice President, I wish I knew how to quit you.
ru: К сожалению, в этом году дно озера полностью высохло и потрескалось.

quote: The first half of the 20th century was an absolute disaster in human affairs, a cataclysm.
after: We had the First World War, the Great Depression, the Second World War and the rise of the communist nations. And each one of these forces split the world, tore the world apart, divided the world.
ru: Первая половина двадцатого века была полной катастрофой в истории человечества катаклизмом.

quote: As his country's 37-year-old Ngwenyama (king), Mswati is the last absolute monarch in sub-Saharan Africa.
I am absolutely positive I think I sent them.

before: You would think he'd be less interested in talking after your last... conversation. I agree.
after: What does he want? Our assistance.
ru: Так что, раз он пошёл на контакт, это потому что он считает совершенно необходимым.

quote: But in Prague, my colleagues are all absolutely useless.
before: I'd imagine the mathematics must be very complex. If I was back in Zurich, I'd have my friend Grossmann to help me.
after: When Pierre was alive, we had the luxury of always being there to help each other. I once had that with my wife.
ru: Но в Праге все мои коллеги совершенно бесполезны.

quote: That is absolutely irrelevant considering the horrific suffering of women as mothers.
before: Say there were 50 girls or women who did this somewhere. That's nothing.
after: The deeper you research and read testimonies... I cross-reference them with the Nazi records and many other resources.
ru: Это совершенно несопоставимо, учитывая ужасающие страдания женщин как матерей.

quote: Absolutely, exquisitely minute, and yet we've discovered pretty much the full set.
before: You know, they're a step in size from the entire observable universe. So, 100 billion galaxies, 13.7 billion light years away — a step in size from that to Monterey, actually, is about the same as from Monterey to these things.
after: So, one of my most illustrious forebears at Manchester University, Ernest Rutherford, discoverer of the atomic nucleus, once said, " All science is either physics or stamp collecting. " Now, I don't think he meant to insult the rest of science, although he was from New Zealand, so it's possible.
ru: Абсолютно, совершенно мелкие, но мы открыли почти полный комплект.

quote: Year after year after year, absolutely incredible.
before: And perhaps most remarkably, at the beginning of the 21st century, really for the first time in modern history, growth extended to almost all parts of the world. So China, I've already mentioned, beginning around 1978, around the time of the death of Mao, growth — ten percent a year.
after: Never before in human history have so many people been raised out of such great poverty as happened in China. China is the world's greatest anti-poverty program over the last three decades.
ru: Год за годом. Совершенно невероятно.

quote: But it absolutely is, especially if it's being used for growth.
before: I'm going to just focus on two. First, it makes us think that overhead is a negative, that it is somehow not part of the cause.
after: Now, this idea that overhead is somehow an enemy of the cause creates this second, much larger problem, which is, it forces organizations to go without the overhead things they really need to grow, in the interest of keeping overhead low. So we've all been taught that charities should spend as little as possible on overhead things like fundraising under the theory that, well, the less money you spend on fundraising, the more money there is available for the cause.
ru: Но ведь это совершенно не так, особенно если их направлять на рост организации.

quote: "This is simply too important to not get absolutely right," said Hayden.
You know, I always thought your interests were a bit more abstract.

after: Well, adversity brings out previously unknown qualities, I guess. You're still interested in genetics?
ru: Знаешь, я всегда думал, что твои интересы более отвлеченные.

before: The death of Scottish artist Alan Davie was announced on Sunday.

after: Whoa! I spanked Valentina when she was little.
ru: Проблема в том, что шлепки в последствии могут перерасти в жестокое обращение!

quote: Did you know she's developed something of a substance abuse problem since you've been gone?
before: What's her name? Thea?
after: I guess the strain of losing two family members must have been too much for her to bear. One day, someone may just find her in the back of a car, dead with a needle in her arm.
ru: Ты знал, что у неё развилась некая форма злоупотребления запрещёнными веществами с тех пор, как ты исчез?

quote: I mean,drug abuse,unsafe sex.I drink vodka like it's water.
before: Sean,I've lived my life like I've had some kind of death wish. You know?
after: If I could fit into a tailored gucci suit without working out,I'd never step inside a gym. And now?
ru: Ну там злоупотребление наркотиками, небезопасный секс. Я пил водку, как будто это была вода.

quote: A blatant abuse of position and waste of resources.

after: But maybe you should start again. The other story sounds far more interesting.
ru: Вопиющее злоупотребление служебным положением и нерациональное использование ресурсов.

quote: We started something called the Speech Project; curbing abuse, expanding freedom.
before: And I want to say a word about revenge porn. Part of what came out of this tweet was my getting connected with allies and other activists who are fighting for a safe and free internet.
after: And that website provides a critical forum, because there is no global, legal thing to help us figure this out. But we do provide on that website a standardized list of definitions, because it's hard to attack a behavior in the right way if we're not all sharing a definition of what that behavior is.
ru: Мы создали сайт Speech Project, помогающий ограничить злоупотребления и дать больше свободы.

quote: Some might be calling up because they're reporting abuse.
before: Some people might be calling up for a friendly chat, maybe some information about local services. Some might be calling because they're suicidal.
after: And some quite simply, as I was, may have simply just given up on life. I guess it's a really simple idea, setting up a helpline.
ru: Кто-то звонит, чтобы рассказать о жестоком обращении.

quote: Others were more concerned about alcohol’s potential for abuse.
before: Almost every region of the globe had its own fermented drinks. As alcohol consumption became part of everyday life, some authorities latched onto effects they perceived as positive — Greek physicians considered wine to be good for health, and poets testified to its creative qualities.
after: Greek philosophers promoted temperance. Early Jewish and Christian writers in Europe integrated wine into rituals but considered excessive intoxication a sin.
ru: Других же больше волновало злоупотребление алкоголем.

quote: Michael Jackson continues to deny 10 counts of abuse and false imprisonment.
I-can-bag-anyone-in-this- bar-because-I-have-a-sexy- accent has reverted to online dating?

after: It's a whole city of people saying most words wrong. It's just a stupidity in a massive region.
ru: Люди называют это "Бостонским акцентом".

before: Have your tickets ready, please. All we have to do is act like we belong.
after: No accent. [mimics Southern accent] Well, I do declare that is mighty disappointing.
ru: У меня хотя бы есть очаровательный южный акцент?

quote: Number one, I don't have an Indian accent, I have a Pakistani accent, OK?
before: (Video) Comment: Couldn't follow because of the Indian accent. SS: OK, OK, OK, two things.
after: And number two, I clearly have a Pakistani accent. (Laughter) But comments like that kept coming in, so I figured I should just ignore them and start working on the second part of the video.
ru: Первая: у меня нет индийского акцента, у меня пакистанский акцент.

quote: They think we say "sorry" too much in our funny accents.
before: Their stories matter because they contain tools the rest of us can use, and not just for those particular problems, but for many others, too. When most people think about my homeland, Canada, today, if they think about Canada at all, they think cold, they think boring, they think polite.
after: And that's all true. (Laughter) Sorry.
ru: Думают, мы слишком часто извиняемся, говорим со смешным акцентом.

quote: There are about five or six accents in this country as I speak.

after: Someone says, " How so? How could this happen? "
ru: Сейчас в нашей стране 5 или 6 разных акцентов.

before: Zoe Saldaña, the actress behind warrior princess Neytiri in Avatar, picked up the Na'vi language faster than her fellow cast members.
after: Saldaña remarked that the most difficult part about acting in the film was speaking in English with the accent of the Na'vi people. Cameron touted the rich nature of the Na'vi language in publicity for his film.

quote: It was socially acceptable in a way that we couldn't imagine today, thankfully.
before: We put out of consideration people who can talk like that, especially these days, especially after the Holocaust. Anti-Semitism back then, of course, wasn't associated with the Holocaust.
after: But Wagner was by no means alone. Anti-Semitism was widespread in 19th-century Germany, even amongst political liberals like Wagner.
ru: Он был социально приемлемым, чего мы не можем себе представить сегодня, к счастью.

quote: For hundreds of years, having multiple partners was quite acceptable.
before: That's interesting. Not really, Booth.
after: Oh, no, no, no. Iris is a dog.
ru: На протяжении сотен лет, наличие нескольких половых партнеров было вполне приемлемо.

quote: But what's dirty to you might be quite acceptable to somebody else.
before: Dirty's dirty. That's what dirty is.
after: - Quite normal, in fact. - This wasn't normal.
ru: Но то, что грязно для вас, может быть вполне приемлемо для других.

quote: But in the end, he was within the box of acceptable behavior.
before: All right now, he walked a fine line. Okay?
after: But in my mind, when you allow that behavior to progress, you end up with a My Lai. You think I should have taken harsher action.
ru: Но в конце, он вышел за рамки приемлемого поведения.

quote: Those people are always the threat to the status quo, to what is considered acceptable.
before: All of us are put in boxes by our family, by our religion, by our society, our moment in history, even our own bodies. Some people have the courage to break free, not to accept the limitations imposed by the color of their skin or by the beliefs of those that surround them.
after: In my case, for the last nine years, some of my neighbors, some of my friends, colleagues, even my agent, did not know about my history. I think, in mystery, this is called the reveal.
ru: Эти люди всегда представляют опасность для устоев общества, для того, что считается приемлемым.

quote: And also, make it socially acceptable that we change our minds, or probably even reward that?
before: Couldn't we just give people more incentives to engage in conversations, rather than just broadcasting opinions all the time? Or reward people for reading and responding to views that they disagree with?
after: What if we have a matrix that says how many people changed their minds, and that becomes part of our social media experience? If I could track how many people are changing their minds, I'd probably write more thoughtfully, trying to do that, rather than appealing to the people who already agree with me and " liking " because I just confirmed their biases.
ru: Сделать социально приемлемым изменение своих взглядов а может, даже поощрять это изменение?

quote: And the only acceptable answer is -- (Audience: Yes.) -- yes.
before: But you can create your own feedback loop. Anybody can create their feedback loop by asking these simple questions: Can I have my results?
after: What does this mean? Help me understand what the data is.

quote: While this is legal, it is not morally acceptable.

ru: Только у членов группы 38 был доступ к этой ячейке хранилища.

after: And why, in the process of getting that better education, did I have to endure the trauma of erasing what made me, me — a black girl from the Bronx, raised by an Antiguan mother? So when I think about our current education reform initiatives, I can't help asking: What are our students of color learning about themselves?
ru: Почему мне пришлось уехать из Бронкса, чтобы получить доступ к более качественному образованию?

quote: When I knew what they needed the most was access to clean drinking water.
before: We had to sit in a separate, ladies-only room, not even aware what was happening in the council. Men told me that, " You women, elected women members, should buy sewing machines for women. "
after: So I did everything I could do to prioritize the real challenges these women faced. I set up five hand pumps in the two dried up wells in my locality.
ru: В то время как я знала, что больше всего им нужен доступ к чистой питьевой воде.

quote: We didn't have access to education and health.
before: In Congo, the official language is French. But in Uganda, it is English.
after: We were exposed to harassment, exploitation, intimidation and discrimination. Humanitarian organizations mostly focused on the formal settlement in rural areas, and there was nothing in place for us.
ru: У нас не было доступа к системе здравоохранения и образования.

quote: The access was gained through the Board of Studies website.

ru: Возможно, снизится количество аварий, что позитивно для общественного здоровья.

quote: In countless accidents, the driver says, "I didn't see it coming."

ru: После бесчисленных аварий водители обычно говорят «Я не заметил, откуда он взялся!»

before: You gotta explain this. He's got no I.D., fingerprints aren't in the system, and nothing showed up in missing persons.
after: Like the crime dog? Well, it's better than buster or spot.
ru: Вместо настоящего имени, будем звать его МакГрафф.

quote: But next time, can we play the actual game?
before: Well, luckily, Glappy was sleeping, so Matchie goes straight to Candy Castle where he becomes King Candy, who can turn everyone into sweets with a wave of his royal gum ball staff. Cool story, dad.
after: First chance I get, I'll talk to the warden about finding some of those missing game pieces, okay? Gotta go, kids.
ru: А мы можем в следующий раз сыграть по-настоящему?

quote: Here you see a sample of this actual attack code.
before: And if you have heard that the dropper of Stuxnet is complex and high-tech, let me tell you this: the payload is rocket science. It's way above everything that we have ever seen before.
after: We are talking about — around about 15,000 lines of code. Looks pretty much like old-style assembly language.
ru: Здесь вы видите кусочек настоящего атакующего кода.

quote: Those are actual pictures of actual apartments renting for that amount as advertised on the Internet.
before: Some of them look like places I lived in as a graduate student. And as you get to the very bottom, you're faced with the unfortunate reality that if you don't save anything for retirement, you won't be able to afford any housing at all.
after: The last thing I'll show you, the last behavioral time machine, is something that I created with Hal Hershfield, who was introduced to me by my coauthor on a previous project, Bill Sharpe. And what it is is an exploration into virtual reality.
ru: Это фотографии настоящих квартир, которые можно снять за эту сумму, судя по рекламе в Интернете.

quote: Can these tissue-design principles be used in an actual human being?
before: Artificial electrodes are then placed on each AMI muscle, and small computers within the bionic limb decode those signals to control powerful motors on the bionic limb. When the bionic limb moves, the AMI muscles move back and forth, sending signals through the nerve to the brain, enabling a person wearing the prosthesis to experience natural sensations of positions and movements of the prosthesis.
after: A few years ago, my good friend Jim Ewing — of 34 years — reached out to me for help. Jim was in an a terrible climbing accident.
ru: Можно ли использовать эти принципы разработки тканей на настоящем человеке?

quote: The group's website, however, provides the actual credits for all the people involved.
before: The group designed it, but claims it was "knitted by dozens of grannies out of pink wool."

quote: Well, ahem, actually there's something everyone should know.
before: And you and Alex have amazing chemistry. Is it because you're together in real life?
after: The thing is I'm just excited about how many hot single women are gonna love this movie. Jump.
ru: Ну... Вообще-то, есть кое-что, что все должны знать... Мы не вместе.

quote: A country built on trust, where a vote actually means something!
before: I'm trying to give America its country back! The country they deserve!
after: By killing a man? If I'm already going to hell, why not?
ru: Страну, построенную на доверии, где голоса на самом деле чего-то стоят!

quote: No, actually, it's not, but I'm so glad I called you.
before: Not yet, but they have frozen our accounts. Everything okay?
after: I really missed you this summer. Blair's dating Catherine's stepson,
ru: Вообще-то, нет. Но я очень рад, что позвонил тебе.

quote: Actually, I should go and do some serious writing.
before: I can't decide if I should get drunk or pissed or go home. Me neither.
after: My girlfriend ditched me yesterday. - Or did you ditch her?
ru: Вообще-то, я должен написать кое-что серьезное.

quote: Below the skin's surface, the roots that give rise to our hair actually remain alive.
before: People going through chemotherapy treatment temporarily experience this. But while balding may look permanent, scientific investigation has revealed the opposite.
after: Using this knowledge, scientists have developed drugs that shorten the resting phase, and force follicles into anagen. Other drugs combat male pattern baldness by blocking the conversion of testosterone to DHT so that it doesn't affect those sensitive follicles.
ru: Под кожей головы корни, из которых растут волосы, на самом деле остаются живыми.

quote: You can compile it to molecules, send it to a synthesizer, and it actually works.
before: So, you start with something in the computer. You get a high-level description of the computer program, a high-level description of the origami.
after: And it turns out that a company has made a nice program that's much better than my code, which was kind of ugly, and will allow us to do this in a nice, visual, computer-aided design way. So, now you can say, all right, why isn't DNA origami the end of the story?
ru: Можно скомпилировать его в молекулы, послать всё на синтезатор, и это всё на самом деле функционирует.

quote: The stories can be anything, and some of them are actually true.
before: It is the story factory, one of the very best in the world. We bring stories to the public.
after: But they all have one thing in common: They all need to look like something. They all need a face.
ru: Истории могут быть о чём угодно, и некоторые из них на самом деле правдивы.

quote: As far as I know, Batuta's case actually turned up to be their last word.
before: I haven't heard about Hipolit.
after: As far as I know those people have made careers and they now have more serious things to care about.

quote: In addition to being the person who brings me my fax confirmations.
before: I have a very special connection to secretary's day in the form of that 115-pound moonbeam over there named Erin hannon. To a lot of you she may just be the person who brings you your fax confirmations, but to me, she is my girlfriend...
after: So I wrote a [English accent] Little ditty that I would like to play for all of you right now. It's a little tune called secretary of love.
ru: В добавление к тому, что она та, кто приносит мне подтверждения факсов.

quote: By the looks of it, a recent addition to the hospital directory.
before: - No news on Mrs. Kane yet, but that Dr. Harris you were onto didn't disappear after all. What?
after: I'm sending you a picture right now. Here.
ru: Судя по внешности, она недавно добавлена в каталог больницы.

quote: The addition of the venom will make the ripper virus even more lethal to vampires.
before: A good day. I've managed to extract the werewolf venom from Nadia Petrova's blood.
after: He was just using her as a case study in his project to wipe out vampires off the face of the earth. Why are you telling me this?
ru: Добавление яда сделает вирус потрошителя ещё более смертоносным для вампиров.

quote: In addition to the crimes he would have committed 40 years ago?
before: With all that activity, Mr. Laszlo, you gave yourself a nice alibi. Are you accusing him of being anti-Communist?
after: Why wasn't he charged earlier? The witness reports were locked away in the United Nations until last year.
ru: В добавление к преступлениям, которые он мог совершить 40 лет назад?

quote: Since it's organic, I'm really keen to try and minimize the addition of any chemicals.
before: So the color in this jacket is coming purely from green tea. I guess it also looks a little bit like human skin, which intrigues me.
after: I can make it change color without using dye by a process of iron oxidation. Using fruit and vegetable staining, create organic patterning.
ru: Так как материал органический, мне очень хочется минимизировать добавления какой-либо химии.

quote: In addition to SABMiller, Heineken and InBev had been interested in the Colombian company.
before: During recent months, Ricardo Obregón, president of Grupo Empresarial Bavaria, denied the persistent rumors of a possible sale.
after: Obregón will have to inform the head of the Colombian stock market of the acquisition.

quote: Use this additional look to enhance the current collection.
before: One look you will design and create over the next two days. I knew that the bomb was gonna drop.
after: I'm giving you 30 minutes to sketch, then we're going to Mood where you'll have a budget of $300. All right, I'll be back in 30 minutes, everyone.
ru: Используйте дополнительный наряд, чтобы усилить вашу коллекцию.

quote: Did it work? Why don't you ask the seven additional episodes CBS ordered?
before: to get Jericho back on the air. Did it work?
after: You idiots have been so annoying that folks hate turkeys more than ever. Business is a-boomin'!
ru: Почему бы тебе не спросить 7 дополнительных эпизодов заказанных CBS?

quote: Additional security is what we take to conferences in Geneva.
before: - Us? You, me, some additional security.
after: This is a war zone. What do you want?
ru: "Дополнительную охрану" — мы берём на конференцию в Женеву.

quote: A team of Deltas is providing an additional layer of security.
before: I-I don't understand. What does he have to do with this?
after: Wait a minute. Are those the reinforcements you were talking about?
ru: Отряд Дельта обеспечивает дополнительный уровень безопасности.

quote: But there are some additional benefits as well.
before: And the great part about this is it's just like Hotmail. It's cloud based, and it doesn't require any training, programming, consultants.
after: Now we knew when we built this system, the whole point of it, just like with the PalmPilots, was that you'd be able to collect the data and immediately upload the data and get your data set. But what we found, of course, since it's already on a computer, we can deliver instant maps and analysis and graphing.
ru: Есть также некие дополнительные преимущества.

quote: That means additional resources in this area could have a truly transformative impact.
before: Yet this is hugely neglected. There are 3,000 times more animals in factory farms than there are stray pets, but yet, factory farming gets one fiftieth of the philanthropic funding.
after: Now the third area is the one that I want to focus on the most, and that's the category of existential risks: events like a nuclear war or a global pandemic that could permanently derail civilization or even lead to the extinction of the human race. Let me explain why I think this is such a big priority in terms of this framework.
ru: Дополнительные средства в этой области могут совершить настоящий переворот.

quote: Recently, Flickr has added an additional function called tagging.
before: And the answer is: I got them from Flickr. Flickr is a photo-sharing service that allows people to take photos, upload them, share them over the Web and so forth.
after: Tagging was pioneered by Delicious and Joshua Schachter. Delicious is a social bookmarking service.
ru: Недавно на Flickr появилась дополнительная функция тегирования.

quote: In an additional eight states, all write-in votes are considered valid.
before: In his write-in campaign, Perry plans to be certified as a write-in candidate in nine states plus the District of Columbia.
after: According to Perry's calculations, this potentially provides him access to 114 electoral votes.

quote: You know, for such a handsome guy, you've got more than an adequate sense of humor.
before: It's so quiet and quaint. I hope it's not too quiet, if you catch my drift.
after: Sounds like somebody's finally gonna... Resuscitate a drowning victim?
ru: Знаешь, из многих красавчиков, у тебя адекватное чувство юмора.

quote: We're getting concerned that Lily hasn't developed an adequate sense of empathy.
before: Hey! Don't get blood in my eggs.
after: Insofar as she doesn't have any at all. Okay, that's good.
ru: Нас начинает беспокоить, что у Лили не развито адекватного чувства сопереживания.

quote: Listen. Ninel Nikolayevna is not capable, but still mentally adequate.
before: So, nothing can be done? Unfortunately, nothing.
after: How do you know? I've worked in this family for three years.
ru: Нина Николаевна хоть недееспособна, но психически адекватна.

quote: You are more than adequate for my needs.
before: One small bag for starting a new life does not seem very adequate, Mr Joseph. Well, I have you, Mrs Joseph.
after: It's a big trust I give you. Promise me, that when you get to England you will not forget me and leave me here?
ru: Этого более, чем достаточно.

quote: We have to provide adequate resources to young people.
before: Let's help them be proud of who they are, because our education system welcomes their families, their cultures, their communities and the skill set they've learned to survive. And of course the third strategy being the most important: resources.
after: Grit alone isn't going to cut it. You can sit there and tell me all you want, " Hey man, pick yourself up by the bootstraps. "
ru: Мы должны обеспечить молодёжь адекватными ресурсами.

quote: Another tremendous challenge for Ebola survivors is obtaining adequate health care.
before: But some male survivors have lost their spouses out of fear they will be infected with Ebola. That's how families are torn apart.
after: In theory, Liberia's public health services are free of charge. In practice, our health system lacks the funding and capacity to expand care to all at the point of need.
ru: Ещё одной большой проблемой для переболевших Эболой является получение адекватного медицинского обслуживания.

quote: So, we are not being charged with the adequate response to what is happening.
before: Where we have now come to live in a world where the most extreme forms of violence, the most horrific poverty, genocide, mass rapes, the destruction of the Earth, is completely out of control. And because we have suppressed our girl cells and suppressed our girl-ship, we do not feel what is going on.
after: I want to talk a little bit about the Democratic Republic of Congo. For me, it was the turning point of my life.
ru: Поэтому мы не чувствуем внутреннего призыва, чтобы адекватно ответить на происходящее.

quote: There is much concern its withdrawal will leave many without adequate aid.
before: The WFP has been feeding approximately six million of the poorest and most needy in the reclusive communist state.

quote: We call that an adjustment.
before: 10 minutes later than you did, and we would have been gone. I was supposed to spill my coffee?
after: See, sometimes, when people spill their coffee or their lnternet goes out or they misplaced their keys, they think it's chance. And sometimes it is. Sometimes it's us nudging people back on plan.
ru: Мы называем это корректировкой.

quote: I just need to make a few adjustments to the core.
before: Please tell Mr. Thawne I'm working as fast as I can. I've powered up the reactor.
after: Did you already turn it on? I-I had specific instructions from Mr. Thawne to do so.
ru: Мне просто нужно сделать кое-какие корректировки с ядром.

quote: Thus completes the penultimate adjustment to my weather control device!
before: - Top of the morning, everybody. - Excellent!
after: Victory is... Release me at once!
ru: Итак, предпоследняя корректировка погодного устройства завершена.

quote: Julian. hey, I made the adjustment you suggested in the garden scene.
before: Someone's out to get you, blair. it's just not me. Vanessa.
after: Uh, yeah, yeah. um, good show, sabrina. So how does it feel to play may welland?
ru: Джулиан, эй, я поставила приспособление, которое вы предложили для сцены в саду.

quote: Creative agility is about being able to test and refine that portfolio of ideas through quick pursuit, reflection and adjustment.
before: They also learn how to advocate for their point of view. They understand that innovation rarely happens unless you have both diversity and conflict.
after: It's about discovery-driven learning where you act, as opposed to plan, your way to the future. It's about design thinking where you have that interesting combination of the scientific method and the artistic process.
ru: Творческая деятельность — это способность проверять и улучшать портфолио идей посредством быстрого поиска, обдумывания и корректирования.

quote: The observation, reflection and adjustment is a learning zone.
before: Those are just some examples. Second, we can execute and perform as we're expected, but then reflect on what we could do better next time, like Beyoncé does, and we can observe and emulate experts.
after: And finally, we can lead and lower the stakes for others by sharing what we want to get better at, by asking questions about what we don't know, by soliciting feedback and by sharing our mistakes and what we've learned from them, so that others can feel safe to do the same. Real confidence is about modeling ongoing learning.
ru: Наблюдение, размышление и корректировка — это зона обучения.

quote: What would reasonable adjustments look like for me?
before: I discovered that under Australian law, cancer is considered a disability. So if you are unable to perform your usual work duties, your employer is obligated by the Disability Discrimination Act to make reasonable adjustments to your working arrangements, so that you can continue to work.
after: I knew the obvious impacts my diagnosis was going to have on work. Medical appointments would be scheduled during business hours, and I knew that I would need time off to recover from surgical procedures.
ru: Что в моём случае означали бы разумные корректировки?

quote: Chad called a great strategy, made some great adjustments for the short runs.
before: Johnson commented, "It's just beyond words [...] We just kept our heads in the game.
after: Luck came our way and we were able to win the race and win the championship."

quote: To make an adult relationship work, you need more. Come on.
before: You think passion is enough? You don't?
after: You're talking about claudine and elliot Like they're some insubstantial fling.
ru: Для создания взрослых отношений нужно нечто большее.

quote: I'm gettin' rid of all my adult dress-up clothes.
before: Not so. Look at those boxes by the front door.
after: George isn't into role-playing, so I no longer need my crotchless firefighter outfit. Now it's your turn to get rid of some things that you haven't played with, like that lambo...
ru: Я избавляюсь от всех своих нарядов для взрослых.

quote: Oh, so now you wanna treat her like an adult?
before: Are we sure this is right? If she wants to volunteer, let her volunteer.
after: Hey, I'm not the one who gave her a vote in how things go around here. You can't have it both ways.
ru: Так теперь она для тебя взрослая?

quote: You can be his appropriate adult. Right that's me.
before: Anything on him? No file. he doesn't even have an address.
after: What? Take off that bloody stupid hood.
ru: Там может понадобиться представляющий взрослый.

quote: Adults can too, and we get there when we read.
before: It's what Coleridge called the willing suspension of disbelief or poetic faith, for those moments where a story, no matter how strange, has some semblance of the truth, and then you're able to believe it. It's not just kids who can get there.
after: It's why in two days, people will be descending on Dublin to take the walking tour of Bloomsday and see everything that happened in " Ulysses, " even though none of that happened. Or people go to London and they visit Baker Street to see Sherlock Holmes' apartment, even though 221B is just a number that was painted on a building that never actually had that address.
ru: Взрослые тоже, и у нас это получается, когда мы читаем.

quote: I have just shown you three different games for kids, adults and seniors.
before: Poor muscle tone and impaired balance are the number one cause of falls, so reversing these problems through targeted exercise will help keep older people like my grandmother safer and independent for longer. When my schedule ends, MIRA briefly shows me how I progressed throughout my session.
after: These can be used with orthopedic or neurologic patients, but we'll soon have options for children with autism, mental health or speech therapy. My physical therapist can go back to my profile and see the data gathered during my sessions.
ru: Только что я показал вам 3 различных игры для детей, взрослых и пожилых людей.

quote: I don't know if it'll affect the adults.
before: But these are really high-performance athletic animals. I don't know what this kind of stuff will do in their gills.
after: If it's not, it's certainly affecting their eggs and larvae, I would certainly think. But if you look at that graph that goes down and down and down, that's what we've done to this species through overfishing over many decades.
ru: Я не знаю, повлияет ли это на взрослых особей.

quote: Three children and one adult remain in intensive care.
before: One child and one woman died in the day care centre itself, with another child dying in hospital. All injured are reported to be in stable condition.
after: Five others also remain hospitalised, although several are expected to be discharged at some point during the weekend.

quote: Because of their inter-social dynamics, having a predisposition towards stealing gives one a genetic advantage.
before: In Thailand, in China, in Costa Rica, people get mugged by monkeys all the time. Monkeys are gatherers.
after: You were mugged by a monkey. Maybe he was just curious.
ru: Вследствие межсоциальных динамик, предрасположенность к воровству даёт генетическое преимущество.

quote: For centuries, benders have possessed an unnatural advantage over ordinary people.
before: I'm not, I'm trying to save us! It's time to take back our city. See?
after: But thankfully, modern technology has provided us with a way to even out the playing field. Now anyone can hold the power of a Chi-blocker in their hand.
ru: Веками маги использовали свое преимущество перед немагами.

quote: In particular, the young, who perhaps didn't enjoy the same kind of advantages.
before: My husband is murdered and you have the gall to come into my home with such filth? Gerry's life was dedicated to the service of those less fortunate than himself.
after: I have to say, I'm surprised you were so easily taken in. Dr Portmore?
ru: Особенно молодым, у которых не было никаких преимуществ.

quote: Does it hurt that you are the king and there are advantages for me in that?
before: - Free, schmee. Why would I want to be free when I can be here with my son?
after: No. But more important, I'm a mother.
ru: Тебе больно, что ты Король и я пользуюсь этими преимуществами?

quote: The invention of cooking, one and half million years ago, gave us a huge advantage.
before: There is a trade-off between body size and the number of neurons a primate, including us, can sustain. A 25 kg ape has to eat 8 hours a day to uphold a brain with 53 billion neurons.
after: Cooked food is rendered soft and predigested outside of the body. Our guts more easily absorb its energy.
ru: Изобретение кулинарии 1,5 миллиона лет назад дало нам огромное преимущество.

quote: And we actually did that and it gave us a competitive advantage for a while.
before: So, I started a company with Stan Winston, my good friend Stan Winston, who is the premier make-up and creature designer at that time, and it was called Digital Domain. And the concept of the company was that we would leapfrog past the analog processes of optical printers and so on, and we would go right to digital production.
after: But we found ourselves lagging in the mid' 90s in the creature and character design stuff that we had actually founded the company to do. So, I wrote this piece called " Avatar, " which was meant to absolutely push the envelope of visual effects, of CG effects, beyond, with realistic human emotive characters generated in CG, and the main characters would all be in CG, and the world would be in CG.
ru: И мы действительно сделали это, что дало нам конкурентное преимущество на некоторое время.

quote: Now don't get me wrong, writing has certain advantages.
before: That's how much of a latterly thing writing is. So first there's speech, and then writing comes along as a kind of artifice.
after: When you write, because it's a conscious process, because you can look backwards, you can do things with language that are much less likely if you're just talking. For example, imagine a passage from Edward Gibbon's " The Decline and Fall of the Roman Empire: " " The whole engagement lasted above twelve hours, till the graduate retreat of the Persians was changed into a disorderly flight, of which the shameful example was given by the principal leaders and the Surenas himself. "
ru: Не поймите меня неправильно, у письменности есть ряд преимуществ.

quote: Democratic strategists poised themselves to take advantage of Santorum's association with the neologism phenomenon.
after: Based on sources among Democratic operatives, Jack Cahill of American Thinker reports Democratic tactics in Missouri involve actually galvanizing support for Santorum ahead of that state's Republican caucuses in order to eliminate the possibility of a Mitt Romney win. Cahill says they view Santorum as mostly a dirty joke's punchline.

quote: An adventure in the outback-- Man against nature.
before: Your--y-your what? My walkabout.
after: But they wouldn't let me go. And--and I sat there yelling at them, Shouting at them, That they couldn't tell me what I can't do.
ru: Приключения, дикая жизнь, человек против природы.

quote: Quite the awkward, little adventure, wouldn't you say?
before: Enjoy your kingdom. So thanks for the ride.
after: I'm sorry I tried to hurt you. I would never want that.
ru: Это было неловкое маленькое приключение, не правда ли?

quote: You taught me to be my best self, to look forward to tomorrow's adventures.
before: Yes. The moment that I met you, my life became extraordinary.
after: And when I was vulnerable, you were strong. I love you, Richard Castle.
ru: Ты научил меня быть лучше и с нетерпением ждать новых приключений.

quote: Your life, your Papacy, is an unforgettable adventure?
before: If I show it to you, then the adventure is over. Don't you see, Lenny?
after: You truly are my spiritual father, the best a priest could hope to have. Michael, what must I do to restore the Church's fate?
ru: Твоя жизнь, твое Папство - это незабываемое приключение?

quote: And actually this is where the adventure really started.
before: And we went through moments of fears because we had no idea how the little amount of gas we had in the balloon could allow us to travel 45,000 kilometers. But we were expected to have doubts; we're expected to have fears.
after: When we were flying over the Sahara and India it was nice holidays. We could land anytime and fly back home with an airplane.
ru: И вот с этого момента и началось настоящее приключение.

quote: Some of those adventures are wonderfully encouraging -- he's got to go to school.
before: And we're ready now to tell a story about his childhood and his life, and it goes on, and he has, you know, many adventures. Some of those adventures are a little bit dark or on the darker side.
after: The cool thing is that we're doing as well: as you interact with him, you're able to put things into his world; he recognizes objects. His mind is based in a cloud.
ru: Некоторые из этих приключений поразительно вдохновляющие -- он должен пойти в школу.

quote: I saw them and felt a sense of joy and adventure.
before: The workman was busy when the garden caught my attention. My eyes became glued to the patterns of embroidered roses blooming across my childhood landscape.
after: This excitement felt like a feeling to go forward into something I knew nothing about. My passion and connection to garden started at that exact moment.
ru: Я увидела их и ощутила радость и дух приключений.

quote: The Conception was owned by Truth Aquatics and chartered by Worldwide Diving Adventures.
after: Both companies have been in operation since the 1970s according to USA Today.

quote: I saw this advertisement for a limp corrector.
before: Yes, your ladyship. Yes?
after: Yes? What does it do, exactly?
ru: Я прочел вашу рекламу корректора хромоты.

quote: How's that advertisement getting on for the new maid?

ru: Внешностью он напоминал Махатму Ганди - вычтите набедренную повязку, добавьте ортопедические ботинки.

The monk confronted Xu Xian, telling him that because he consorted with a demon, he must remain at the monastery and cleanse his soul.

ru: Этого вполне достаточно для большинства природоохранных приложений.

But the computer has fundamentally changed the way we think about tools because computation is dynamic.
after: However, computers have the same static physical form for all of these different applications and the same static interface elements as well. And I believe that this is fundamentally a problem, because it doesn't really allow us to interact with our hands and capture the rich dexterity that we have in our bodies.
ru: Он может выполнять миллион различных процессов и обрабатывать миллион разных приложений.

after: What are we going to do about them? How can we save their lives?

quote: The Senate was to adjourn at 3.30pm, but this was extended to approximately 5.15-5.30pm.
before: The VSU legislation was earlier anticipated to be debated at the next session -- that is, next year -- but appeared on the notice paper today in case the Senate had time to discuss the bill, however, at approximately 1.40pm an urgency motion was moved on a number of bills, including the voluntary student unionism (VSU) legislation which entered the Senate yesterday. The urgency motion allots time on the second reading to extend to 4.30pm and remaining stages of the bill to 5.00pm.

quote: Ae Jeong, Yoon Pil Joo stays in the same area as we do.
before: Shut up! Keep quiet!
after: Shall we ask him along? Oppa, it's too late in the night.
ru: Э Чжон, Юн Пхиль Чжу живёт в нашем районе.

quote: Things that travel slower than light are condemned to live inside this area.
before: It can't happen. So, this line seems to restrict the movement of things.
after: This area is clearly important, and it's got a name. It's called the future light cone.
ru: То, что движется медленнее света, обречено оставаться в этой области.

quote: We'll secure the area, clean up, contain the situation.
before: He didn't escape. He was extracted.
after: Manage it without making any more noise. There were helicopters this time, for God's sake.
ru: Мы обезопасим район, приберемся, возьмем ситуацию под контроль.

quote: And every 10 years, an area the size of Britain disappears under a jungle of concrete.
before: This turtle is one of the countless species that have been unable to adapt to the change brought about by the urban environment. Only a small number of animals have managed to find ways of living alongside us.
after: But it doesn't have to be like this. Could it not be possible to build cities more in harmony with nature?
ru: И, каждые 10 лет, область размером с Британию исчезает в каменных джунглях городов.

quote: And that's twice that of adjacent areas in the same neighborhood.
before: We did the same thing in DUMBO, in Brooklyn, and this is one of our first projects that we did, and we took an underutilized, pretty dingy-looking parking lot and used some paint and planters to transform it over a weekend. And in the three years since we've implemented the project, retail sales have increased 172 percent.
after: We've moved very, very quickly with paint and temporary materials. Instead of waiting through years of planning studies and computer models to get something done, we've done it with paint and temporary materials.
ru: Это в два раза больше, чем в прилегающих районах.

quote: Normally, visual signals come in, into the eyeballs, go to the visual areas in the brain.
before: Now, what's really going on? So, to explain this curious disorder, we look at the structure and functions of the normal visual pathways in the brain.
after: There are, in fact, 30 areas in the back of your brain concerned with just vision, and after processing all that, the message goes to a small structure called the fusiform gyrus, where you perceive faces. There are neurons there that are sensitive to faces.
ru: В норме, зрительные сигналы поступают в глазные яблоки, и идут в зрительные области в мозге.

quote: But there's not much support for research in this area.
before: Now, you would think if somebody had a plausible idea about how to do that, everybody would be very excited about it, and there would be lots of research on how to do it. But in fact, a lot of people do understand how to do that.
after: And I think part of it is because there are some real misunderstandings about it. So I'm not going to try to convince you today that this is a good idea.
ru: Однако исследований в этой области практически нет.

quote: The Sirius Star is the largest ship captured by pirates in the area to date.
before: The oil tanker was carrying over 2 million barrels of oil at the time of her capture, and was on her way to the United States via Cape Town. Reuters claimed that news of the attack raised crude oil prices around the world.
after: This also sets a record for the farthest from the shore that pirates have struck.

quote: It's funny how one little argument can destroy an entire universe.
before: This shower has gotten completely out of hand. [chuckles] Yeah.
after: Yeah. Do you remember why we broke up?
ru: Забавно, как одна маленькая ссора может разрушить всю вселенную.

quote: Prajapati's arguments aren't going to melt it.
before: Hadn't he been worthy then brahmadeva wouldn't have sent me to him. This is the heart of a mother.
after: I know very well what's good or bad for my child. And there's no doubt that your decision regarding sati isn't well-meaning for her.
ru: Доводам Праджапати не растопить его.

quote: Your honor, our argument is simple and straightforward.
before: And it is love that turns us back to dust, saying, "Go back, oh, child of earth." It is love that sweeps us away like a dream.
after: My client provided emergency medical care to Christina Grunwald. Mr. Stearn met the young lady's father, learned of her desperate medical condition, had the resources at his disposal to save her life, and was moved to action.
ru: Ваша честь, наши доводы простые и очевидные.

quote: I did find the Secretary of State's argument quite persuasive, sir.
before: Will you not accept that when the laws that we now examine were first coined we did not face such modern perils as we do now from the likes of Joseph Hamer, that threaten our security as a nation? But Secretary of State, this idea that the looming threat almost upon us is surely old news?
after: But we must show a healthy caution. By us forcing through these laws that allow imprisonment without charge, will only bring us more trouble!
ru: Я действительно считаю доводы Гос.Секретаря очень убедительными, сэр.

quote: So why do arguments change people’s minds in some cases and backfire in others?
before: Researchers presented participants with a news article that showed no weapons of mass destruction had been found. Yet many participants not only continued to believe that WMDs had been found, but they even became more convinced of their original views.
after: Arguments are more convincing when they rest on a good knowledge of the audience, taking into account what the audience believes, who they trust, and what they value. Mathematical and logical arguments like the dinner party brainteaser work because even when people reach different conclusions, they’ re starting from the same set of shared beliefs.
ru: Так почему же в одних случаях нам удаётся изменить чьё-то мнение, а в других наши доводы производят обратный эффект?

quote: First of all, I'd like to give you an argument for why that list is complete.
before: They're categories of things, of course, but there's only seven of them. Cell loss, mutations in chromosomes, mutations in the mitochondria and so on.
after: Of course one can make a biological argument. One can say, " OK, what are we made of? "
ru: Приведу сначала довод, что этот список [должен быть] исчерпывающий.

quote: They're gray not because they're unsure, but because they believe that the moral dilemma faces two valid, opposing arguments.
before: However, there is another set of people who are very confident in answering somewhere in the middle. We think these high-confident grays are folks who understand that both arguments have merit.
after: And we discovered that the groups that include highly confident grays are much more likely to reach consensus. We do not know yet exactly why this is.
ru: Они серые не потому что не уверены, а потому что они думают, что моральная дилемма предлагает два обоснованных противоречащих довода.

quote: In court, Judge Richard Lowe, according to the Wall Street Journal, "seemed skeptical" about Falzone's arguments.
after: Lowe asked Falzone why the film's producers did not read the lyrics to the song or flash the lyrics on the screen. Lawyers also pointed out that Premise Media licensed all other music in the film except for Lennon's song.

quote: Well, thanks to Agent Bloom's magnificent arm, the beacon's tracker is working again.
before: He could've killed me if he wanted, but he didn't. Probably saw me coming.
after: We should get going though, before we lose the signal. Yeah.
ru: Что ж, благодаря великолепным рукам Агента Блума, маяк снова работает.

quote: They put up a physical barrier like an arm.
before: Duly noted. In 84% of perjury cases, the subjects display common physical behaviors, and in 70% of those cases, they actually try to hide themselves.
after: What are you working on specifically right now? I, um, I supervise a team of technicians in the satellite maintenance office.
ru: Они воздвигают физические барьеры, к примеру, руками.

quote: Who knew I would find redemption in this man's arms?
before: Yes, you did. You missed me proving to Lorna that I'm not afraid to take chances.
after: I'm really happy for you, Stuart. I just wish I hadn't fallen on my ass, so I could have helped you more.
ru: Кто знал, что я найду утешение в руках этого мужчины.

quote: Mary Jackson died in her son's arms after suffering a terrible illness.
before: As doctors, it's our job to relieve suffering. - Shouldn't you be... - What are your mother's name, Jackson?
after: Who am I talking to? It's A.L.I.E., right?
ru: Мэри Джексон умерла на руках своего сына после мучительных страданий от страшной болезни.

quote: He had a phantom arm, excruciatingly painful, and he couldn't move it.
before: He had his arm amputated 10 years ago. He had a brachial avulsion, so the nerves were cut and the arm was paralyzed, lying in a sling for a year, and then the arm was amputated.
after: It was a paralyzed phantom arm. So he came there, and I gave him a mirror like that, in a box, which I call a mirror box, right?
ru: У него была фантомная рука, мучительно болезненная, и он не мог ей шевелить.

quote: And they were moving and grinding and moving their arms up and down each other.
before: I once — this was years ago — I saw Ted Kennedy and Dan Quayle meet in the well of the Senate. And they were friends, and they hugged each other and they were laughing, and their faces were like this far apart.
after: And I was like, " Get a room. I don't want to see this. "
ru: Они двигались, тёрлись и водили руками друг по другу вверх и вниз.

quote: And she waved her arms, hoping they would see her, but the planes were soon gone.
before: But his heart soon stopped, and Doaa had to release the little boy into the water. Later that day, she looked up into the sky with hope, because she saw two planes crossing in the sky.
after: But that afternoon, as the sun was going down, she saw a boat, a merchant vessel. And she said, " Please, God, let them rescue me. "
ru: Она стала махать руками, надеясь, что её заметят, но самолёты вскоре исчезли из виду.

quote: Fred was then given a yellow for cruelly smashing Chivu in the face with his arm.
before: Doni then produced a few saves for Roma, kicking out Sylvan Wiltord's shot, and then diving to palm away a curling shot by Juninho. Both teams then made vain attempts for a penalty, but both Fred and Perrotta diving, but the referee made the right decisions and awarded only a yellow to Perrotta.
after: Fred was lucky to receive a red for his actions. Roma held on for the win, and the 5 time french champions bowed out of the Champions League.

quote: Please don't beat around the bush on my account.
before: Distract me. Okay, you should hire me.
after: You got a nice little practice here. The baby thing is covered, you got shrinks for the screwups, specialists who handle everything from heart attacks to hernias.
ru: - Пожалуйста, не ходи вокруг да около.

quote: It all started with Nixon's promise to build an alien-proof fence around the solar system.
before: Want to hear about how I got frozen? Not really.
after: Without cheap alien labo for menial jobs like harvesting crops, teaching math and curing disease, the economy collapsed. Starvation.
ru: Всё началось с обещания Никсона построить противоинопланетный забор вокруг Солнечной системы.

quote: The tree grew around the card in 18 years.
before: It was in the tree for 18 years. The card was in the tree.
after: I mean, that isn't magic. It's not magic. The point is, the trick was not to look closely.
ru: Дерево росло вокруг карты 18 лет.

quote: But based on these readings, Their biological age is somewhere around 80.
before: Yeah, well, here's the really puzzling thing. Common sense says they were around 40 when they died.
after: I want someone posted outside that facility At all times. Nobody comes in until after the thermal cleaning. Let's get the bodies ready for transport.
ru: Но судя по данным, биологический возраст - около 80-ти лет.

quote: They're the filters through which we see the world around us.
before: That's not what I'm saying. We all have our biases.
after: I'm not accusing anyone, bias is not an accusation. Rather, it's something that has to be identified, acknowledged and mitigated against.
ru: Это фильтры, через которые мы смотрим на мир вокруг нас.

quote: My goal is not to find technology to kill the new microscopic life around us.
before: Now, my dad is my biggest fan, so in that crushing moment where he wanted to kill my new little life form, I realized that actually I had failed him, both as a daughter and a scientist. In my years toiling away in labs and in people's backyards, investigating and cataloging the microscopic life around us, I'd never made clear my true mission to him.
after: My goal is to find new technology from this life, that will help save us. The diversity of life in our homes is more than a list of 100,000 new species.
ru: Я не стремлюсь найти технологию уничтожения микробов вокруг нас.

quote: We're standing around with watering cans, when what we really need is the fire brigade.
before: Africa is a continent in flames. And deep down, if we really accepted that Africans were equal to us, we would all do more to put the fire out.
after: You see, it's not as dramatic as the tsunami. It's crazy, really, when you think about it.
ru: Мы стоим вокруг этого пожара с лейками, но тут нужна пожарная бригада.

quote: Typical fees from customers were around £40 but some may have paid as low as £10.
after: Around half of each fee went to the Nejloveanus and half to the brothel. Police launched raids, rescuing the women after receiving a tip-off.

quote: She works at the new hotel, and she wouldn't appreciate our little arrangement.
before: What's her name? Carla.
after: No wonder it was so good. It was our last time.
ru: Она работает в новом отеле и вряд ли оценит нашу маленькую договоренность.

quote: What kind of arrangement do you suppose they have?
before: Funny thing about that massacre: not only did Dr. Bloom survive, she got rich. Lecter's living in the lab under her care.
after: Complicated arrangement. Couldn't be more complicated than your relationship with Hannibal.
ru: Какого рода договоренность между ними?

quote: I know he was unhappy with the arrangement you guys had with the big guy.
before: - He was in the pool hall... - Hey! He had words with Mr. O. a couple of days ago. I know my uncle was getting restless.
after: And I'm wondering, do you think Patton found out about that? - Why would you think that?
ru: Я знаю, что ему не нравились договоренности, что были у вас с боссом.

quote: You will forgive me for observing that the arrangement seems to have a flaw.
before: You do make the most refreshingly elliptical conversation, Miss Price. So Lizzy has gone to Hammersmith to see you, but you have come to Longbourn to see her.
after: - Oh, dear, are you quite well? - I do feel a bit... unusual.
ru: Вы простите меня за наблюдение, что в договоренности есть некоторый изьян.

quote: But now that marriage is a romantic arrangement, infidelity threatens our emotional security.
before: And never has infidelity exacted such a psychological toll. When marriage was an economic enterprise, infidelity threatened our economic security.
after: Ironically, we used to turn to adultery — that was the space where we sought pure love. But now that we seek love in marriage, adultery destroys it.
ru: Сейчас, когда брак — это романтическая договорённость, неверность угрожает нашей эмоциональной безопасности.

quote: This was an arrangement which was totally understandable from the corporation's point of view.
before: They did so not just in collaboration with national and local governments but also with a television company and with a major multinational soda company. In exchange for less than one million dollars, that corporation received the benefits of a months-long promotional campaign including a 12-hour telethon all using the company's logo and color scheme.
after: It enhances the reputation of the company and it creates brand loyalty for its products. But in my view, this is profoundly problematic for the intergovernmental agency, an agency that has a mission to promote sustainable living.
ru: Это была договорённость, абсолютно естественная с точки зрения самой корпорации.

quote: And what's shown there is one possible arrangement.
before: What you see on the left hand-side is the early schematics in my design, showing both a bird's-eye view and also one stacking variant. A stacking variant means that the entire product is consisted of different individual parts that have to work in unison.
after: So what exactly is this? So I had gone on to testing my sensors and as all scientists have stumbles along their work, I also had a couple of problems in my first generation of sensors.
ru: И то, что там показано, является одним из возможных расположений.

quote: No details about the cause of death or the funeral arrangements were immediately clear.
The Costa Gravan embassy in Los Angeles is preparing for your arrival.
before: We used to finish each other's sentences. I know, Generalissimo, I know.
after: Are you crazy? If I cannot trust my wife now, how am I supposed to trust my embassy? Uh, we can try to arrange a CIA safe house with some guards for the time being.
ru: Посольство Коста Грава в Лос-Анджелесе готово к Вашему прибытию С ума сошел?

quote: These orifices are to be purged before the arrival of her ladyship's guest, Mrs Schoonmaker.
before: Item three, appendix nine: unsightly hair in the nose and ears.
after: Good heavens. Erm, Beach.
ru: Данные отверстия должны быть очищены к приезду гостей ее светлости.

quote: I would pray hard for their swift arrival.
before: Your lack of compliance reflects poorly on me. Our papers are to come by road.
after: This is a Cistercian codex from the low countries. Very rare, almost forgotten.
ru: В таком случае, я бы начал истово молиться об их скорейшем прибытии.

quote: Since your arrival at the boarding school, that I sometimes weird things.
before: And I, in your opinion? Huh?
after: First, my parents. Then Cayetano.
ru: С тех пор как ты приехала в интернат, со мной происходят странные вещи.

quote: Monitors beeped, as did the elevator, noisily announcing its arrival.
before: While the elevated train rumbled overhead on its track, quite literally the room reverberated with each passing train car. The lights on the ward were fluorescent and too bright.
after: These families were experiencing some of the most excruciating moments of their lives, and I so wanted them to have a more peaceful place in which to say a last goodbye to their young daughters and sons. Surely, I thought, there must be a better spot than a hospital intensive care unit for children at the end of their lives.
ru: Пищали мониторы, пищали лифты, громко заявлявшие о своём прибытии.

quote: This is about the supposed arrival at the sum of all of our endeavors.
before: (Laughter) But she's on her way. This is the last piece.
after: In Santiago itself — it could be Santiago, it could be Mecca, it could be Varanasi, it could be Kyoto, it could be that threshold you've set for yourself, the disturbing approach to the consummation of all your goals. And one of the difficulties about walking into your life, about coming into this body, into this world fully, is you start to realize that you have manufactured three abiding illusions that the rest of humanity has shared with you since the beginning of time.
ru: Она о предполагаемом прибытии к цели всех наших начинаний.

quote: But upon arrival, he finds himself near the bottom of the pecking order.
before: This colossal competition is too dangerous for the tiny Egyptian vulture. With a wingspan of only 180 centimeters, this vulture migrated to Africa from his family nest in Portugal, using thermal updrafts to stay aloft for hours at a time.
after: Fortunately, what he lacks in size, he makes up for in intelligence. A short distance away, he spots an unguarded ostrich nest, full of immense, but impenetrable eggs.
ru: Однако по прибытии он оказался почти на нижней ступени иерархии.

quote: NASA is awaiting the arrival of very precious cargo from space.
He’s reckless, and even if he is arrogant and conceited and bad-tempered, he’s awfully generous.”
before: “But George isn’t saving.
ru: Он безрассудный, и пусть он высокомерный, самодовольный и вспыльчивый, зато ужасно щедрый.

quote: Yes, you want me on board even though I'm a selfish, arrogant neurosurgeon with a great ass.
before: Simon, I called you in here because, if I put him on blood thinners to dissolve a clot and he has a brain bleed... Yes.
after: And apparently, great hearing. This one is an odd duck.
ru: Да, тебе нужен я. Хотя я и эгоистичный высокомерный нейрохирург с классной задницей.

quote: Then you will tell him tonight that the King is arrogant, pigheaded and paranoid.
before: You're sure Thomas suspects nothing? I have him eating from my perfumed palm.
after: Shouldn't be too dificult. You will say that I am losing my grip on reality, rejecting all reasonable advice and you wish to leave Versailles for good.
ru: Хорошо, тогда сегодня вечером ты скажешь ему, что король - высокомерный, упрямый параноик.

quote: I think that's extremely arrogant on his part.
before: They actually do. I think there's also an amazing arrogance to the idea that he knows better than the framers of the Constitution in how the government should be designed and work for separation of powers and the fact that the executive and the legislative branch have to work together and they have checks and balances on each other, and then the judicial branch, which oversees the entire process.
after: CA: Can you give a specific example of how he put people's lives at risk? RL: Yeah, sure.
ru: Я считаю, что это крайне высокомерно с его стороны.
source_ru: Его самонадеянность в этом отношении не знает границ.

quote: I look at that now, I think, "What an arrogant jerk!"
before: You said, " I can say this with absolute certainty because I know how markets work. " Ray Dalio: I can say with absolute certainty that if you look at the liquidity base in the corporations and the world as a whole, that there's such reduced level of liquidity that you can't return to an era of stagflation. "
after: (Laughter) I was so arrogant, and I was so wrong. I mean, while the debt crisis happened, the stock market and the economy went up rather than going down, and I lost so much money for myself and for my clients that I had to shut down my operation pretty much, I had to let almost everybody go.
ru: Глядя на это сейчас, думаю: «Какой напыщенный зазнайка!»

quote: And I always say to the students and post-docs I lecture to, don't be arrogant, because arrogance kills curiosity.
before: And before I get to the next slide, I have to tell you that there are so many additional discoveries to be made. There is so much mystery we don't know.
after: Curiosity and passion. You need to always think, what else needs to be discovered?
ru: На лекциях я всегда говорю своим студентам и аспирантам: «Не будьте высокомерными, потому что высокомерие убивает любознательность».

quote: Judge Jackie Glass, however, described Simpson as arrogant and ignorant.
after: "Everything in this case was on tape and it was your own words that have brought you here because we heard it all and what came out on the tapes [gave] evidence in this case was overwhelming," she said. "That was a violent event, guns were brought, at least one gun was drawn, the potential for harm in that room was tremendous," she continued.
ru: Однако судья Джеки Гласс назвала Симпсона высокомерным и невежественным.

quote: You need to convince a customer to buy a 12-volume art encyclopedia.
before: May we film you? Yes.
after: We've hired an actor, who waits for you next door. It will help us to estimate your ability to improvise.
ru: Вам нужно убедить клиента купить 12-томную энциклопедию по искусству

quote: If there is any threat today, it is to the art of the theatre.
before: This time, with feeling. Now that my mother is gone... oh, my God, you're just deplorable.
after: Once again. Ahem! Now that my mother is gone, I am an orphan.
ru: Если сегодня и есть какая-то угроза, это угроза театральному искусству.

quote: You know, fencing is defined as the art of using the sword scientifically.
before: Well, I didn't know that rich people had their own Stormtroopers. It is popular across all classes.
after: It's been around since the 12th century. The only fencing I ever heard about when I was little involved stereos, two guys named Luigi, and a getaway car. Well, this kind won't get me arrested, but it will help my brain build new neural pathways.
ru: Фехтование - это искусство использования меча с научной точки зрения.

quote: Mm-hmm. Its culture, and the art of thawing meat.
before: Well, this has been a great night. I've learned so much about-about bowling,
after: Yeah, night's not over. You still haven't met the steamer.
ru: О его традициях, и об искусстве размораживать мясо.

quote: Art is not supposed to change the world, to change practical things, but to change perceptions.
before: (Applause) This image of three men wearing gas masks was taken in Chernobyl originally, and I pasted it in Southern Italy, where the mafia sometimes bury the garbage under the ground. In some ways, art can change the world.
after: Art can change the way we see the world. Art can create an analogy.
ru: Искусство не способно изменить мир в практическом смысле, но оно может изменить восприятие.

quote: Now, there are some skeptics that believe that art just belongs in an art museum.
before: Now, I've seen the Washington Monument in person thousands of times, well aware of the change in the color of marble a third of the way up, but I had never really looked at it out of context or truly as a work of art. And here, Georgia O'Keeffe's painting of this architectural icon made me realize that if we put our mind to it, it's possible to see everyday things in a wholly new and eye-opening perspective.
after: They believe that it has no practical use beyond its aesthetic value. I know who they are in every audience I teach.
ru: Есть скептики, полагающие, что место произведений искусства — в музее.

quote: And in the visual arts, the same thing happened.
before: This is a way in which modernism infiltrated this country and became perhaps the most popular, or promiscuous typeface, of the twentieth century. " Less is more, " right, these are the aphorisms of modernism.
after: Let's focus on the essentials, focus on the basic shapes, focus on geometry. So Futura actually holds this to its core.
ru: Это относится и к визуальным видам искусства.

quote: What is it that you’re saying now in your art?
When this is all over, I'm gonna write an article about it.
before: So am I. Congratulations. Thanks. Thanks, Rod.
after: After all, sex sells. Seriously.
ru: Когда все закончится, я напишу об этом статью.

quote: But I made some notes when Letitia first talked about doing an article.
before: He was bald and plump, with a moustache. Well, Mrs Opie didn't catch his name, and Mr Bell can't recall meeting him at all.

quote: I've written some articles on plants, but I do fine on the loader.
before: Haven't you been able to work on this here? No, not really.
after: What do you get for this? -A one year membership. One year? -Indeed.
ru: Но я написал пару статей о том, как удобрять гольф-поля в Исландии.

quote: Man, someone was just telling me about this crazy article.
before: - I don't like the energy here. Jeez.
after: - Yeah. - By someone, I mean the Internet.
ru: Чёрт, кто-то мне тут рассказывал об одной невероятной статье.

TR: So The Intercept is that new investigative journalism website, that's cofounded by Glenn Greenwald.
after: TA: The Intercept seemed to be the most logical place for this because my article is really leveraging the fact that a source had leaked to me transcripts of these private FBI conversations that a federal judge had sealed based on the government's claim that their release would irreparably damage the U.S. government's law enforcement strategy. So a place like The Intercept was set up to protect journalists and publish their work when they're dealing with very sensitive matters like this.
ru: Расскажите нам о своей статье и почему вы разместили её именно там.

quote: In the article they reminded me, his nickname was Dirty Waters.
before: Those of you who know football, Andre Waters was someone I grew up watching. Former Philadelphia Eagles strong safety, [44] years old, a Division II football coach when he decided to put a gun to his head.
after: He was known for leading with his head, so I thought I'm just going to look up did he ever talk about the concussions he had. And I found a quote from 1994 where Andre Waters said, " I stopped counting my concussions at 15.
ru: В статье мне напомнили, что его прозвали Грязный Уотерс.

after: For half the people, the article included a brain image, and for the other half, it was the same article but it didn't have a brain image. At the end — you see where this is going — people were asked whether they agreed with the conclusions of the article.

ru: Тем временем, Скарлет работает с художником над эскизом нападавшего на Бо.

before: No. I don't believe that.

ru: Почему ты передумала становится художником?

quote: Yeah, and thank you for being our artist in residence.
before: ♪ Forever young ♪ Thanks for being our roadie.
after: Of course. So, you went on stage tonight as Champagne Enema.
ru: И спасибо за то, что ты наша художница.

before: (Laughter) So it was going well. I was finding my way.
after: I was having some success and recognition and I moved into an apartment with more than four outlets. My mom and I would stay up very late talking about our latest ideas and inspiring each other.
ru: Я была активна и мотивирована, была окружена художниками, часто посещала различные мероприятия.

quote: As an artist, connection is very important to me.
after: Through my work I'm trying to articulate that humans are not separate from nature and that everything is interconnected. I first went to Antarctica almost 10 years ago, where I saw my first icebergs.
ru: Как художнику для меня очень важна взаимосвязь.

quote: And I'm happy to sign it for you with any name of any artist.
before: (Laughter) So I'm — yeah, actually I'm kind of finished at that moment. And for those who want to see more, I've got my book downstairs in the bookshop.
after: (Laughter) But before leaving I would like to show you, I'm working right now on another — in a related field with my tidying up art method. I'm working in a related field.
ru: И я буду счастлив подписаться в ней именем любого художника.

quote: A caricature artist was also present, selling custom drawn caricatures of attendees.
before: Comic collector Kevin Dutton was on hand, offering for sale his collection of 28,000 comic books. A broad array of 'geek-related' items were also available including: custom Lego mini figures, specialty knives, Pokémon merchandise, fantasy game merchandise and more.

before: Instead, I'm back in High School with you. If I punished anyone, it's myself.
after: I took the biggest risk here on all three of you. - Oh, come on.
ru: Это мое первое шоу в качестве художественного директора. театральной мастерской на Манхэттене.

before: - I'm still part of the show. - I just can't be here right now.

ru: Я художественный руководитель "Театральной Мастерской Манхэттана"?
