before: As a servant? I'm a mixologist.
after: And it is very honorable. I don't believe anyone in this hovel does anything important.
ru: Это художественная профессия изготовителей алкогольных напитков.

quote: Also, the latest artistic installation from Ludovic Klein.
before: Thank you for traveling with us and, as they used to say in the olden days, "Wagons roll." For your entertainment, we have the music channel playing retrovids of Earth classics.
after: Plus for the youngsters, a rare treat. The animation archives.
ru: А также последняя художественная инсталляция Людовика Клейна.

quote: When your expectations and your knowledge clash with my artistic intentions.
before: And the great lesson there was that the real magic doesn't happen on paper. It happens in the mind of the viewer.
after: Your interaction with an image, your ability to read, question, be bothered or bored or inspired by an image is as important as my artistic contribution. Because that's what turns an artistic statement really, into a creative dialogue.
ru: когда ваши ожидания и знания сталкиваются с моими художественными намерениями.

quote: No more familiar artistic references to the world around you.
before: Michelangelo was so committed to this project, that he succeeded in getting the job done in three and a half years, using a skeleton crew and spending most of the time, hours on end, reaching up above his head to paint the stories on the ceiling. So let's look at this ceiling and see storytelling gone global.
after: There's just space and structure and energy; a monumental painted framework which opens onto nine panels, more driven by sculptural form than painterly color. And we stand in the far end by the entrance, far from the altar and from the gated enclosure intended for the clergy and we peer into the distance, looking for a beginning.
ru: Больше нет знакомых художественных отсылок к окружающему нас миру.

quote: The Center for Political Beauty, an activist collective in Berlin, recently staged an extreme artistic intervention.
before: We were a weird-looking baby, a new kid on the block, a foreigner. And we will be ugly again when we don't belong.
after: With the permission of relatives, it exhumed the corpses of refugees who had drowned at Europe's borders, transported them all the way to Berlin, and then reburied them at the heart of the German capital. The idea was to allow them to reach their desired destination, if only after their death.
ru: Центр политической красоты, группа активистов в Берлине, недавно поставила экстремальный художественный эксперимент.

quote: Frequently people started reading for the more artistic stuff and then now want more of that.
before: RM. I guess only about 2% of the population is going to like the strip in the first place so I always expected that there are a lot of people who don’t like the strip and aren’t going to read it.
after: I don’t really know what to say to that other than that what I’m doing is what I feel like I have to contribute more of. I feel like there are a lot of people who are good at the kind of art they are doing and you know, have better messages there.

quote: As long as they don't kill us, they keep us safe and warm.
before: Start her on co-trimoxazole. We all need some secrets.
after: I'm... I'm gonna be okay?
ru: До тех пор, пока они нас не убивают, нам от них приятно и тепло.

quote: "As long as I carry it, every living thing I meet will love me dearly."
before: You seem to be enjoying it yourself. "The wonderful love magnet.
after: That would make your election easier, wouldn't it? Certainly cheaper.
ru: Пока он со мною, все на свете будут меня обожать."

quote: As long as I'm carrying this baby, I can't leave New Orleans.

after: If I do, they kill me. Well, knowing Klaus, he's planning a box for you the second you give birth to whatever's cooking in your tum.
ru: Пока я ношу этого ребенка я не могу покинуть Новый Орлеан.

quote: As long as you don't doubt yourself, everyone else will eventually fall in line.
before: You saved Charlotte from being Ultra's guinea pig. That's a win you should feel good about.
after: - (HIGH-PITCHED SCREECHING) - (FAINT SCREAMING) CARA:
ru: До тех пор, пока ты не сомневаешься в себе, все остальные рано или поздно тебе подчинятся.

quote: As long as we're around, DNA is around, and we'll find a way to sequence it.
before: How many of you even have a disk drive in your laptop, never mind a floppy drive? This will never be the case with DNA.
after: Archiving the world around us is part of human nature. This is the progress we've made in digital storage in 60 years, at a time when we were only beginning to understand DNA.
ru: Пока существуем мы, существует и ДНК, и мы найдём способ её секвенировать.

quote: So as long as activism is that simple, it's pretty easy to get away with.
before: Now there's a couple — there's a couple of lessons that you can take from this. And the first lesson, which I think is a worthwhile one, is that you cannot go wrong asking people to be active online, so long as activism just means retweeting a phrase.
after: The other thing you can take from this, by the way, is that there are a lot of Brazilians on Twitter. There's more than five million of them.
ru: До тех пор пока активность настолько проста, она довольно легко сходит с рук.

quote: And as long as you teach them that, you can teach them anything else you like.
before: So what I'm proposing is, just as we require reading, writing, arithmetic, American history, so we should have a curriculum on facts about all the religions of the world — about their history, about their creeds, about their texts, their music, their symbolisms, their prohibitions, their requirements. And this should be presented factually, straightforwardly, with no particular spin, to all of the children in the country.
after: That, I think, is maximal tolerance for religious freedom. As long as you inform your children about other religions, then you may — and as early as you like and whatever you like — teach them whatever creed you want them to learn.
ru: И пока вы учите их этому, вы можете учить их всему, чему пожелаете.

quote: Hey, Callie, call me as soon as you get this message.

ru: Привет, Кэлли. Перезвони мне, как только ты это получишь.

after: - Thank you. - Thanks.
ru: Как только я закончу, приду и поговорю с вами.

after: Paddy, this is Constable Collins. If you treat him nicely, he won't bite.
ru: Съездим обратно в Коллингвуд за его вещами, только сначала я переоденусь.

after: At this point, exactly 180 minutes have passed and the professor is at the halfway point of his journey with 90 kiloliters of fuel left. For the next 90 minutes, the professor and Orokana's planes fly towards each other, meeting at the three-quarter mark.
ru: Как только его самолёт касается земли, она взлетает, но теперь на восток.

before: Okay? That's all that's necessary.

ru: Теперь, как только я сниму затычку, польётся чистая питьевая вода.

after: And it felt to me like the sophisticated response to that was to be as extreme as possible. And despite this very shaky entry into the world of debate, I loved it.
ru: И когда тот же человек оспаривал мои идеи, было ужасно, я чувствовала себя униженной и пристыженной.

after: - Get back on your horse. - Really rather hungry...

after: And the hard truth is if they knew where we were, they would have bloody been here by now. So, no one's coming?
ru: Шутки в сторону, прошло три дня с крушения.

ru: Если не поддерживает, или мы не уверены, то отложим её в сторону.

after: He showed him, " You know, we don't have to do this wrong. It won't cost us any more to do it the right way. "
ru: Он отвел в сторону своего начальника, показал ему материалы по методу ограниченной каменной кладки.

quote: Mixon, who cannot order a harsher sentence but may reduce it or set it aside entirely.

So what's missing in that equation is figuring out what our boundaries would be.
after: The CEO of Netflix recently said, " our biggest competitors are Facebook, YouTube and sleep. " And so what we need to recognize is that the human architecture is limited and that we have certain boundaries or dimensions of our lives that we want to be honored and respected, and technology could help do that.

ru: Что ж, позволь тебя уведомить, что о некоторых сторонах моей жизни ты не знаешь ничего.

ru: Мне нравятся в тебе другие стороны, и я готов это обсудить.

ru: Давай сосредоточимся на позитивной стороне.

after: We are taking what we develop and learn in the large and applying it in the small to the classroom, to create a blended model of learning. But before I go into that, let me tell you a story.
ru: Сегодня я хочу обсудить другой аспект, другую сторону MOOC, рассмотреть иную перспективу.

before: It gives the viewer and the reader a chance to relive the excitement he or she had when they were young. They're really reading fairy tales for grown-ups when they read or when they see superhero stories today, and that's why I love them so.
after: By that, I mean: OK, we assume your superhero might be extra-strong, or might be able to fly or run as fast as a comet, but unless you care about the superhero's personal life, you're just reading a shallow story. Just because a person has a superpower doesn't mean he might not have the same personal problems that you or I might have.
ru: Человеческая сторона супергероев была для меня, возможно, самой важной частью.

after: And around the fortress is this vast field of taboo against premarital sex, against condoms, against abortion, against homosexuality, you name it. Faiza was living proof of this.
ru: Это общественная цитадель, неприступная крепость, которая не поддастся нападению, не примет компромисса.

quote: Chuck pushed the kid's face into the snow and the school cops charged him with aggravated assault.
before: He had just turned 18. That winter, a kid in the schoolyard called Chuck's mom a crack whore.
after: The other kid was fine the next day, I think it was his pride that was injured more than anything. But anyway, since Chuck was 18, this agg. assault case sent him to adult county jail on State Road in northeast Philadelphia, where he sat, unable to pay the bail — he couldn't afford it — while the trial dates dragged on and on and on through almost his entire senior year.
ru: Ударом в челюсть Чак повалил того в снег и получил обвинение в нападении при отягчающих обстоятельствах.

quote: Would a young and inexperienced Apple have survived the legal assault from a much larger and more mature company like Xerox?

after: Now, this idea that everything is a remix might sound like common sense until you're the one getting remixed. For example...

ru: Теперь, завтра вечером все будут присутствовать для сбора средств.

quote: There are schools that need to track attendance.
before: The demand for this, the need for data to run better programs just within health — not to mention all of the other fields in developing countries — is enormous. There are millions and millions and millions of programs, millions of clinics that need to track drugs, millions of vaccine programs.
after: There are all these different things for us to get the data that we need to do. And I realized if I kept up the way that I was doing, I was basically hardly going to make any impact by the end of my career.
ru: Школам необходимо отслеживать посещаемость.

quote: At the beginning, every important step took place under the attendance of the Russians.
before: For instance, the central jail for political prisoners, which was established by the Russians, was taken over by the Stasi and used until the end of Communism. You see it here.
after: But the Germans are known to be very effective, so the Stasi grew very quickly, and already in 1953, it had more employees than the Gestapo had, the secret police of Nazi Germany. The number doubled in each decade.
ru: В начале каждый важный шаг осуществлялся в присутствии русских.

quote: Perhaps we can increase school attendance in schools.
before: And if we are smart about connecting the dots that are right in front of our noses, we can do far more than give a family a box of superhero-shaped vegetable-enriched macaroni noodles and a gallon of barbecue sauce to feed themselves. Instead, we can give them back their dignity.
after: We can improve the health outcomes for millions. And, most importantly, we can reduce food waste in our landfills, creating a better environment for all of us.
ru: Возможно, мы можем повысить уровень посещаемости в школах.

quote: Prince Charles and Jacques Chirac will be in attendance.
before: It has been confirmed that King Fahd bin Abdul Aziz of Saudi Arabia has died. There will be no coffin or state funeral for Fahd and he will be buried without a headstone as is customary in Wahhabism, the kingdom's strict version of Islam.

quote: And take all of the attention away from the Ms. Cassie July?
before: The other day, she told me I wasn't sexy enough. Maybe you shouldn't wear a bra to your next class.
after: She'd flip. I can't stand her.
ru: И отнять все внимание от мисс Кесси Джулай?

quote: You gave her a lot of personal attention, make her feel special.
before: She joined the gym a year ago. Hey, what she did with her body took a lot of work and a lot of time.
after: I mean, yeah. That's a big part of my job. - Really?
ru: Вы уделяли ей много личного внимания, заставили почувствовать себя особенной.

quote: I did get caught up in all of the attention.
before: - Yes? I just want to say I'm sorry about last night.
after: I was just mainly frustrated 'cause I feel like moms do everything and no one ever notices and then Dads do one little thing - and people go crazy. - Mm. But you know what I realized last night?
ru: Всё внимание было направлено на меня.

quote: That keeps the attention of your dog while you're taking its picture.
before: What you got there? It's a camera attachment.
after: - Oh. - Schmidt came up with a great title for it. It's called "Perfect Pet Pic."
ru: Оно отвлекает внимание собаки, пока ты её фотографируешь.

quote: But once my attention turns over to a hairy leg, that lighting setup will change completely.
before: And the way I work is that I essentially split the insect up into multiple sections, and I treat each one of those sections like a small still life. So for example, if I was photographing the eye of the insect, which is normally quite smooth and dome-shaped, then I'd use a light source that is large and soft and diffuse, so I don't get any harsh hot spots on that surface.
after: And so I make that one tiny section look as beautiful as I possibly can, and I work my way across the insect until I have about 20 or 25 different sections. The issue with photography at high magnification is that there is inherently a very shallow depth of field.
ru: Но когда я переключаю внимание на покрытую волосками ногу, расположение света полностью меняется.

quote: On some trials, we'll ask them to pay attention to the face.
before: You should see a face and a scene overlaid on each other. And what we do is we ask our participants as they're viewing a series of these types of overlaid images, to do something with their attention.
after: And to make sure they're doing that, we ask them to tell us, by pressing a button, if the face appeared to be male or female. On other trials, we ask them to tell what the scene was — was it indoor or outdoor?
ru: Во время одних опытов мы просим их обращать внимание на лицо.

quote: Pay careful attention the next time you read the financial news.
before: Metaphor matters because it's around us every day, all the time. Metaphor matters because it creates expectations.
after: Agent metaphors describe price movements as the deliberate action of a living thing, as in, " The NASDAQ climbed higher. " Object metaphors describe price movements as non-living things, as in, " The Dow fell like a brick. "
ru: Когда в другой раз будете читать финансовые новости, обратите особое внимание.

quote: Ronan first came to Syco/Sony's attention when he entered this year's competition.
before: In a statement, Syco - a British entertainment company which Cowell is the chief executive officer of - responded by claiming that "[t]here is no truth in this story whatsoever.
after: Syco/Sony Music will not hesitate to take whatever legal action is appropriate to prevent further publication of these unfounded allegations." The Metropolitan Police Service have also reported that "[a]n allegation of malicious communications was made to Kensington and Chelsea police on Thursday 2 June" and that "[t]he allegation is being considered."

quote: I get back-talk and bad attitudes, just like I got from Amanda.
before: I give you food, shelter, clothing, and career training. And what do I get?
after: Let's not forget what it took to clean that mess up. No!
ru: Я получаю дерзость и плохое отношение, прямо как от Аманды.

quote: What sucks is this whole attitude you got going on here.
before: I love you, all right? But you want to know what sucks right now?
after: Now, I know you're upset about your mom and all that, but that is no reason to dump on me. I think that I'm entitled to dump a lot of it on you.
ru: Твое отношение ко всему, что здесь происходит, вот что отстой.

quote: You know, there was a time when that attitude would have thrilled me.
before: How do we proceed? I'll tell you when you need to know.
after: But I got too much at stake now. This?
ru: Знаешь, было время, когда такое отношение возбудило бы меня.

quote: Look, the attitude was cute for a while, but you gotta shape up.
before: Greta, could I see you? Thank you.
after: Now I'm gonna put Donna on that table, so just take it easy, okay? - Hey.
ru: Послушай, такое отношение выглядит мило какое-то время но тебе надо измениться.

quote: We can change national attitudes to women and national attitudes to HIV.
before: If we can change the way households believe and think, we can change the way communities believe and think. And if we can change enough communities, we can change national attitudes.
after: The hardest barrier really is around stigma reduction. We have the medicines, we have the tests, but how do you reduce the stigma?
ru: Мы можем изменить отношение к женщинам и отношение к ВИЧ-инфекции.

quote: Now religions have a much saner attitude to art.
before: But if we're serious people, we don't admit to that. But that feeling of puzzlement is structural to contemporary art.
after: They have no trouble telling us what art is about. Art is about two things in all the major faiths.
ru: Религии же занимают гораздо более разумную позицию в отношении искусства.

quote: I think that in art, an artist's attitude is the most important element.
before: Unsafe food can harm people's health, and a deluge of magazines can confuse people's minds. (Laughter) The next pieces of work show how I made myself invisible in magazines of different languages, in different countries and at different times.
after: If an artwork is to touch someone, it must be the result of not only technique, but also the artist's thinking and struggle in life. And the repeated struggles in life create artwork, no matter in what form.
ru: Я считаю, что в искусстве отношение артиста является важнейшим элементом.

quote: The attitude of the players was brilliant and we couldn't ask for any more.
before: After the match, Belgian coach Roberto Martínez said, "It was a close game and it was very tight and it was going to be decided by that bit of luck in front of goal.
after: We have to understand one team wins and the other loses, and we did what we could."

quote: Uh, as your attorney, I would definitely advise you to do that.
before: I don't know. What are you thinking about doing?
after: Uh, four more. Yeah.
ru: Как твой адвокат, я рекомендую вам именно так и поступить.

quote: I'm here to see you as his attorney.
before: Yes. What about it?
after: What? Professor AHN?
ru: Я здесь для того, чтобы встретиться с вами как его адвокат.

quote: Grant is the go-to criminal attorney at our firm.
before: Why? Same reason he was carrying my gun.
after: He represents numerous clients with uh, proclivities to violence. Did Mr. Abbott have any concerns about any of these clients in particular?
ru: Грант - компетентный уголовный адвокат нашей фирмы.

quote: McCall is going to come out here any minute and probably talk attorneys.
before: To be honest, I'm not entirely convinced that's why we're here. What do you mean?
after: Say you've agreed to allow mine to represent you. Why should I trust your attorney?
ru: МакКол в любую минуту придёт сюда и начнёт говорить об адвокатах.

quote: So the appropriate adult really should be an attorney or perhaps a trained child advocate.
before: You can just look at the case of the Central Park Five: five teenagers who falsely confessed to a brutal gang rape in 1989, with their parents by their sides. And it took over a decade to clear their names.
after: Overturning Dassey's conviction, the judge pointed out that there's no federal law requiring that the police even inform a juvenile's parent that the juvenile is being questioned or honor that juvenile's request to have a parent in the room. So if you think about all of this together for a second: as a country, we've decided that juveniles cannot be trusted with things like voting, buying cigarettes, attending an R-rated movie or driving, but they can make the judgment call to waive their Miranda rights, rights that we know from research, most teens don't understand or appreciate.
ru: Подходящим взрослым должен быть адвокат или подготовленный адвокат по защите детей.

quote: And Chester Carlson, the inventor, was a patent attorney.
before: And nobody knows just why this was so, but one story can reflect something of it. It was the origin of the Xerox copier, which celebrated its 50th anniversary last year.
after: He really was not intending to work in patent research, but he couldn't really find an alternative technical job. So this was the best job he could get.
ru: Честер Карлсон, изобретатель, был патентным поверенным.

quote: And his first hire was a legal services attorney to represent the patients.
before: But over the course of these nine months, I grew frustrated with feeling like we were intervening too far downstream in the lives of our clients — that by the time they came to us, they were already in crisis. And at the end of my freshman year of college, I read an article about the work that Dr. Barry Zuckerman was doing as Chair of Pediatrics at Boston Medical Center.
after: So I called Barry, and with his blessing, in October 1995 walked into the waiting room of the pediatrics clinic at Boston Medical Center. I'll never forget, the TVs played this endless reel of cartoons.
ru: Первым делом он нанял адвоката для представления пациентов.

quote: Jennifer Keller, an attorney from Orange County, California, assisted the arrangement for the Hausers to return.
You said this attraction thing could pull things apart on a quantum level.
before: Something's not right. Maybe my nicotine nanobots are malfunctioning.
after: What would it do to a person? Well, it would do the same thing.
ru: Ты сказал, что это притяжение может разрывать вещи на квантовом уровне.

quote: Gravity -- the attraction of a body to another body.
before: Anthony, what's he saying? What is the most pervasive force in the universe?
after: It's what makes the planets go around the suns. It's what makes the stars.
ru: Гравитация - это притяжение одного тела к другому.

quote: It's really one of our biggest attractions.
before: Because everybody who comes here, that's the first thing they wanna see. It's, "Where did Mary Tyler Moore throw her hat up in the air?"
after: Are you sure you don't want me to stop? - Definitely, no.
ru: Это одна из наших достопримечательностей.

quote: The law of attraction was not going my way.
before: Meet you in the shower! Babe?
after: Bow was seriously not feeling me right now. Oh, Lord.
ru: Закон притяжения работал не на меня.

quote: This is due to the attraction and the repulsion of the individual particles inside the liquid.
before: Excellent. So what you can see now is that the ferrofluid has formed spikes.
after: Now this looks already quite interesting, but let me now add some watercolors to it. Those are just standard watercolors that you would paint with.
ru: Это связано с притяжением и отталкиванием каждой частицы в жидкости.

quote: So clusters of galaxies will tend to form, because of all this gravitational attraction.
before: There are really two mysteries out there as to what makes up most of the universe, and they have very different effects. Dark matter, because it gravitationally attracts, it tends to encourage the growth of structure, OK.
after: Dark energy, on the other hand, is putting more and more space between the galaxies, makes it, the gravitational attraction between them decrease, and so it impedes the growth of structure. So by looking at things like clusters of galaxies, and how they — their number density, how many there are as a function of time — we can learn about how dark matter and dark energy compete against each other in structure forming.
ru: В результате, создаются условия для формирования скоплений галактик, всё это благодаря гравитационному притяжению.

before: The biggest tourist attraction in China is the Great Wall. The Great Wall is the only thing that can be seen from the moon.

ru: Крупная достопримечательность Дании – Русалочка.

after: Oh, my God, you're totally gross. No, I'm not gross!
ru: ГЛЕН - это акроним огромной организации, состоящей из привлекательных половозрелых мужчин?

after: If she were a civilian, would I notice her? I might well do.
ru: Босс - действительно очень привлекательная женщина.

after: I'm sure she is most appreciative of his support. Your Majesty, I wondered if I might have a word.
ru: И судя по всему, есть женщины, считающие его привлекательным.

quote: I prefer things which are a little more transparently attractive.
before: Shades of palest dove grey. Grey can be deceptively attractive, don't you think so, Miss Lane?
after: But, Miss Ellison, dove grey is certainly elegant. I am a little mature for white.
ru: Я предпочитаю более явно привлекательные вещи.

quote: A woman can drop out of the work force and still be an attractive partner.
before: And as many women hold that view as men do. We know that lots of women still judge the attractiveness of a man based in large part on how successful he is in his career.
after: For a man, that's a risky proposition. So as parents and partners, we should be socializing our sons and our husbands to be whatever they want to be, either caregivers or breadwinners.
ru: Женщина может перестать работать и всё равно представлять собой привлекательную партию.

quote: But estrogen and testosterone play important roles in shaping features that we find attractive.
before: The third factor that contributes to facial attractiveness is the effect of hormones. And here, I need to apologize for confining my comments to heterosexual norms.
after: Estrogen produces features that signal fertility. Men typically find women attractive who have elements of both youth and maturity.
ru: Эстроген и тестостерон играют важную роль в формировании нашего представления о привлекательности.

quote: I tried to figure out -- maybe solar's become attractive.
before: So what about making energy? Maybe we could make energy.
after: It's been 25 years since I was doing this, let me go back and look at what's been happening with solar cells. And the price had gone down from 10 dollars a watt to about four or five dollars a watt, but it stabilized.
ru: Я подумал, может ли солнечная энегрия быть привлекательной.

quote: Goh said he thought the design is "very attractive."
before: The front of commemorative note has scenes from both Brunei and Singapore, while the reverse bears Singapore's coat of arms and the face of Hassanal Bolkiah, Sultan of Brunei.

before: I had an act once. Slick as anything in vaudeville. ♪ ♪I'd surround myself with the prettiest girls I could find.
after: And they loved me for it. I was the biggest thing to come out of Baltimore since Wallis Simpson.
ru: И тогда я позволила зрителям смотреть на кого-то кроме меня

before: But I don't want to see the audience as the jury. I don't want to have disdain for them.
after: - Louis. - Donna, I'm sorry.
ru: Я сам зритель и хочу их любить.

quote: Well, the audience is going to think I'm a child molester.
before: - You wrote "boy". Well, all right, man, boy, it's a metaphor.
after: I've changed my mind. I'm playing the nightman.
ru: Зрители подумают, что я растлительница малолетних.

quote: Still a one-Woman show in search of an audience.
before: And you, as well, dear boy. Tell me, how is Martha?
after: She says you owe her an evening at le cirque. And to what do I owe the pleasure?
ru: По-прежнему - театр одной актрисы в поисках зрителей.

quote: This kept audiences guessing, increasing their fascination with his surreal worlds and enigmatic characters.
before: This was a key feature of his trademark uneven tempo and black humor, which became popular throughout the Theatre of the Absurd. He also cultivated a mysterious persona, and refused to confirm or deny any speculations about the meaning of his work.
after: The lack of any clear meaning makes Godot endlessly open to interpretation. Critics have offered countless readings of the play, resulting in a cycle of ambiguity and speculation that mirrors the plot of the drama itself.
ru: Такое пребывание в неведении вкупе с таинственными героями и сюрреалистическими мирами писателя всё больше очаровывало зрителей.

quote: Suddenly the artistic director can move between different stage and audience configurations.
before: We created what we like to call superfly. (Laughter) Now, superfly, the concept is you take all the freedoms you normally associate with the flytower, and you smear them across flytower and auditorium.
after: And because that flytower has the ability to pick up all the pristine elements, suddenly the rest of the environment can be provisional. And you can drill, cut, nail, screw paint and replace, with a minimum of cost.
ru: И вдруг художественный директор может переключаться между различными конфигурациями сцены и зрительного зала.

quote: Okay, one, two, three.Audience: Can you read this?
before: Right? So, I'm going to count to you, so we don't all do it together.
after: BL: Amazing. What about this one?
ru: Итак, раз, два, три. Зрители: «Можете это прочитать?»

before: Bill Gates - founder of Microsoft and the richest man in the world (owning $46.5 billion) - appeared on the London stage to discuss the challenges facing the world, before introducing Dido.

before: This... And the photo album. So who is she?
after: Do you think she could be your mother? Your real mother?
ru: Твоя тетя хотела, чтобы у неё были твои фотографии.

quote: Aunt Else says state school isn't that bad.
before: Right, mum. That's the right way round.
after: Of course it's not the Collège Français. I shan't miss the Monsieurs and Mademoiselles.
ru: Тетя Эльза, говорит, что государственная школа не так уж и плоха.

quote: Are you saying, sir, that the mad aunt shot the Ravenscrofts?
before: And we have reason to believe that one and and possibly two children died at her hands. And the general, having the feelings of guilt so terrible, pays for her to have treatment at the Willoughby Institute.
after: Non, monsieur. That is not my solution.
ru: Сэр, Вы хотите сказать, что безумная тетя стреляла в Рейвенскрофтов?

before: - Are you a witch? Yes.
after: - It also belongs to my son. - Did you ask their permission to be here?
ru: Это не ваша кровать, в ней спит моя тетя Сюзанна.

quote: This is Aunt Zip from Sodom, North Carolina.
after: She was 105 years old when I took this picture. She was always saying things that made me stop and think, like, " Time may be a great healer, but it ain't no beauty specialist. "
ru: Это тётя Зип из Содом, Северная Каролина.

quote: Spiderman is raised by his aunt and uncle.
before: Superman's parents die on Krypton before the age of one. Bruce Wayne, who becomes Batman, loses his parents at the age of six in Gotham City.
after: And all of them, just like the prophets who get their message from God through Gabriel, get their message from above. Peter Parker is in a library in Manhattan when the spider descends from above and gives him his message through a bite.
ru: Человека-Паука вырастили его тетя и дядя.

quote: I have an aunt who is a wonderful storyteller.
before: And they themselves had not known they cared. And as they wrote and debated, rather than seeing the films as artifacts, they began to see themselves.
after: In a moment she can invoke images of running barefoot on Table Mountain and playing cops and robbers. Quite recently she told me that in 1948, two of her sisters and my father traveled on a boat to Israel without my grandparents.
ru: Моя тётя — прекрасная рассказчица.

quote: Not my immediate family but my aunts and cousins from both of my parents' sides.
before: And I was looking for immigration even before that because most of my family lives outside of Iran.
after: So we were looking for immigration from early on, but I wanted to see if I could grow as a chess player within chess in Iranian Chess Federation but, when I was sure that it was not a good fit, is when I started to look for another federation and decided not to play for Iran anymore. And the last time I officially played for Iran in an official tournament was 2015.

quote: By the authority of Christ, and by His power alone, I cast you out!
before: "Holy Cross, be my light, let not the dragon be my guide." Be gone, demon!
after: I cast you out! I cast you out! I cast you out!
ru: Во имя Иисуса, силой и властью Его я изгоняю тебя!

quote: Mary is convinced the authorities will be hunting us down.
before: The others are here? No.
after: You should leave immediately. Without them?
ru: Мария уверена, что власти будут охотиться за нами.

before: Let me be your eyes and ears, my Lord. You can see yourself out.
after: Indeed he does. Very well, Father.
ru: Я подчиняюсь более высокому органу власти, чем вы, инспектор.

before: Shoot him? That man stole a year of my life.
after: Proper authorities(? ) What have they ever done for me?
ru: Тогда тебе нужно адресовать эти свидетельские показания властям.

quote: But the difference between this and that is, there's no central authority trying to control this.
before: OK? And, yes, there are things like Grameen Bank and micro-lending.
after: This is just street-up innovation. So, it turns out the street is a never-ending source of inspiration for us.
ru: Но различие между этим и нашим случаем заключается в том, что нет центральной власти, которая пытается это контролировать.

quote: I think it was a poor translation, probably, but people relied on authorities like that.
before: And immediately, he got into trouble with the local clergy who said, you can't make a vacuum. Ah, uh — (Laughter) Aristotle said that nature abhors one.
after: And you know, Boyle says, well, shit. I make them all the time.
ru: Я думаю, что это, скорее всего, результат плохого перевода, но люди полагались на такие авторитеты.

quote: It empowered authorities, and, as a result, marginalized citizens.
before: But if you look, if you have that perspective, then you can see what happened in the last 60 years. Aid actually did the opposite.
after: The authorities did not have the reason to make economic growth happen so that they could tax people and make more money for to run their business. Because they were getting it from abroad.
ru: Она дала силу представителям власти, что привело к маргинализации населения.

quote: Authorities made the arrest peacefully and later confirmed that the area was safe.
before: Authorities eventually found Adams, described as a heavyset, middle-aged white man with a bald head and beard, wearing a red shirt and shorts, and took him into custody on a boat later that day.

before: Hey coconut! If I continue to be with you.. ...I'll need to pop a few pills of Disprin everyday!
after: You know what you actually are. You're a British Born Confused Desi..
ru: Думаешь, если ты родилась в Англии, то автоматически стала англичанкой?

after: And we now have workstations at every bed, which are fully integrated with the new charting system. And the beds are now numbered differently, so just pay attention.
ru: Они автоматически обновляют данные пациентов, их анализы и прочее.

after: I built your exhaust system, pal, spare me the lecture. Stephen's right.
ru: - Простите, мои спусковые механизмы срабатывают автоматически, каждые шесть минут.

ru: Даже это краткое обсуждение выявляет то, на что многие экономисты не обратили внимания.

ru: Хулиганы существовали с тех пор, как пещерный человек изобрел кружкИ.

quote: Schools have a duty of care to protect kids, and maybe that should mean excluding bullies.
before: Not your day either, is it? We need to remember bullying hurts everyone, not just the target, but the bully as well.
after: Yeah, believe me, if it was that easy to get rid of them... This is serious.
ru: Школа должна заботиться о детях, защищать их, может, стоит исключать задир.

quote: Magic is not something you use to simply fight off bullies.
before: Please! I will work for you, do anything you want.
after: - That's not what... - Then what is it?
ru: Магия не для того, чтобы давать отпор задирам.

quote: But the worst part, the part that really hurt the most, was what these bullies would say to these kids.
before: And we all know a little bit of difference is all you really need for a bully to make you their next target. So these terrible, terrible people online, they would destroy everything that they tried to make, they would steal all their stuff, and they would kill them over and over again, making the game virtually unplayable.
after: They'd call them rejects and defects and retards. And they would tell these kids, some as young as six years old, that society doesn't want them, and their own parents never wanted a broken child, so they should just kill themselves.
ru: Но что хуже всего, обиднее всего было то, что эти задиры говорили таким детям.

quote: The newspaper Times of India ran the headline "Big(ot) Brother bullies Shilpa".
before: Chancellor Gordon Brown, currently on tour in India, told reporters in Bangalore: "I want to reassure people that what British people are proud of is our reputation for tolerance and fairness." Others believe this reflects a racist tendency in British our Western society in general.
after: "What is happening in Big Brother is just holding the mirror to the western society. This is the real, discriminating face of the West.", was the reaction of Bollywood film director Mahesh Bhatt.

quote: Monty's room is clean except for a bunch of heart medication.
before: No, he probably just went home. Nobody's here, Myks.
after: The guy's hanging on by a thread. You know, his assistant, Rose, never told us
ru: В комнате Монти только куча сердечных препаратов.

quote: It's 4 days of campus tours, classroom visits, and a bunch of father-daughter bonding time.
before: No. No. He thinks I'm here for a Prospective Student Week.
after: How are you doing? Really.
ru: Будут экскурсии по студгородку, посещение классов и куча времени для болтовни любящих папы и дочки.

quote: What, just show up with a bunch of balloons and peanut brittle?
before: Angela's gonna make the best deal she can and get us out in one piece. If the chief justice won't take calls, maybe we need to send someone.
after: - It's time to get Ashland off the bench. - There's a thing called the Constitution.
ru: Чтобы этот кто-нибудь стоял там со связкой воздушных шариков и коробкой орешков?

quote: Let's just say that if something's flying over your head, a whole bunch of flying cars going all over the place, that is not an anxiety-reducing situation.
before: Obviously, I do rockets, so I like things that fly. This is not some inherent bias against flying things, but there is a challenge with flying cars in that they'll be quite noisy, the wind force generated will be very high.
after: (Laughter) You don't think to yourself, " Well, I feel better about today. " You're thinking, " Did they service their hubcap, or is it going to come off and guillotine me? "
ru: Скажем так, когда что-то летает над головой, целая куча летающих автомобилей повсюду, это очень действует на нервы.

quote: It has a zillion individually controlled lights and a whole bunch of cameras.
before: They're a research lab that's associated with the University of Southern California. They have a device there, it's called the " light stage. "
after: And with that, we can reconstruct my face under a myriad of lighting conditions. We even captured the blood flow and how my face changes when I make expressions.
ru: В нём есть множество индивидуально контролируемых источников света и целая куча камер.

quote: Here, we have a whole bunch of disparate images.
before: And that's all well and good. Let's do something a little more difficult.
after: We can fly around them. So navigation is a fundamental issue.
ru: Здесь у нас есть целая куча различных изображений.

quote: The initial userbase was mostly a bunch of hobbyist programmers from that Finnish IRC channel.
after: Everyone liked messing around in the quirky little multiplayer sandbox that it was.

quote: Also, you're free from the burden of your earthly body.
before: They say it's the greatest feeling ever. Like the second when the fudge on your Sunday is still hot or when you're the first one to break in a new boob job.
after: It is a burden. Greetings, class!
ru: А еще ты свободен от бремени своего земного тела.

quote: My burdens can't compare to that of Salem itself.
before: Just now, he suffered a fit of sorts. If you don't mind me saying so, ma'am, it's a burden you've took on... a burden and load, carried out without cry or complaint.
after: How do you find the spirits on the square? Low, ma'am.
ru: Моё бремя не может сравниться с тем, что несёт Салем.

quote: You are too tiny to carry this enormous burden.
before: I have to choose. Everyone always says it's so great being a twin but they wouldn't say that if they had to be your twin.
after: Your mom is here. Love you more.
ru: Ты слишком маленькая, чтобы справиться в одиночку с этим бременем.

quote: A change of leadership in Washington will not lift this burden.
before: No doubt, there will be differences in the future. But the burdens of global citizenship continue to bind us together.
after: In this new century, Americans and Europeans alike will be required to do more, not less. Partnership and cooperation among nations is not a choice, it is the only way.
ru: Изменение руководства в Вашингтоне не снимет это бремя.

quote: And that communication, that connectivity around the world, that globalization now raises a burden.
before: And when you plot those friendship links by their latitude and longitude, it literally draws a map of the world. Our modern world is communicating with itself and with each other more than it has at any time in its past.
after: Because these different languages impose a barrier, as we've just seen, to the transfer of goods and ideas and technologies and wisdom. And they impose a barrier to cooperation.
ru: И это общение, эти связи по всему миру, эта глобализация становится бременем.

quote: But that puts some kind of burden on me.
before: A film tells a story. I often wonder when I make a film — I'm thinking of making a film of the Buddha — and I often wonder: If Buddha had all the elements that are given to a director — if he had music, if he had visuals, if he had a video camera — would we get Buddhism better?
after: I have to tell a story in a much more elaborate way, but I have the potential. It's called subtext.
ru: Но это накладывает на меня определенный груз.

quote: And the economic burden of asthma exceeds that of HIV and tuberculosis combined.
before: One death every 20 seconds. People spend over 90 percent of their lives indoors.
after: Now these statistics had a huge impact on me, but what really sparked my interest in my research was watching both my dad and my brother suffer from chronic allergies year-round. It confused me; why did these allergy symptoms persist well past the pollen season?
ru: И экономическое бремя астмы превышает ВИЧ и туберкулёз, вместе взятые.

quote: He said he needed time to prepare himself for the heavy burden of state.
before: However, Sarkozy last week explained the reasons for taking what was supposed to an unpublicized retreat.

quote: There's a lot of burnout.
before: Don't be a grade-ist, Louise. It's a young person's job.
after: Button? (Screams) Get that thing away from me.
ru: Там очень много выгорания.

quote: And, I mean, that's why there's so much burnout.
before: Sometimes being the first doctor that people has seen, in the past twenty-seven years. You're on here 24/7 which means that I'm on-call all the time.
after: Helping to stop the suffering of people is tremendously rewarding although it also fucks you up a bit. We have a 40-acre farm, so it's felt pretty comfortable for me, because I grew up with my grandparent's dairy and worked on it actually up until... till my first and second year of medical school.
ru: И, я думаю, это быстро приводит к эмоциональному выгоранию.

quote: We're ready to assume control any time after third stage burnout.
before: They're in the terminal position. Our scanners are locked on.
after: Good. I can't see anyone now.
ru: Мы готовы взять на себя контроль в любой момент, но только после третьей стадии выгорания.

quote: So to pull out of my own burnout, I decided to turn my activism into what I call today "play-tivism."
before: Play. From this very stage, psychiatrist and play researcher Dr. Stuart Brown said that nothing lights up the brain like play, and that the opposite of play is not work, it's depression.
after: (Laughter) When we play, others want to join. Today, my playground is filled with artists, techies and scientists.
ru: Чтобы выйти из моего собственного выгорания, я решила направить свою активность в «игративность».

quote: Following burnout of the fourth stage of the carrier rocket, the payloads were released.
before: An Indian Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle (PSLV) has successfully launched ten satellites. The 44-metre long rocket lifted off from the second launch pad at the Satish Dhawan Space Centre at 03:53:51 GMT (09:24 local time), and reached a polar, Sun-synchronous low Earth orbit a little over seven minutes later.
after: The PSLV flew in the CA, or Core Alone, configuration, with no solid rocket boosters around the first stage.

quote: Yeah, does that mean you're allowed in the bus lane?
before: Are you allowed in the bus lane? Yeah, I'm disabled.
after: Well, it bloody well should do! So what's up with this car, anyway?
ru: Значит ли это, что тебе можно ехать по полосе для автобусов?

quote: Friendly enough to smile at a bus conductor on her way home from work, yes?
before: Miss Stewart's an attractive young girl, isn't she, Mr Palmer? I have no doubt she's a friendly girl too.
after: My Lord, this is irrelevant. Choose your words carefully, Mr Walker.
ru: Достаточно доброжелательна, чтобы улыбаться кондуктору автобуса по дороге с работы домой, не так ли?

quote: But I don't like to take the bus after dark.
before: - hit the road. - Oh, I can find a better price.
after: Elliot, Josh is alone in his office. It's a perfect time to ask for a raise.
ru: Но я не люблю ездить в автобусах ночью.

quote: You don't want to throw your dead friend under the bus.
before: It-it wouldn't have made a difference. Taylor, I get it.
after: But you know in your heart that Ken's affair had nothing to do with this crash. Right?
ru: Вы не хотите швырять своего мертвого друга под автобус.

quote: As everybody knows, you can walk across town faster than you can take the bus.
before: Quite radical. We've also brought this approach to our buses, and New York City has the largest bus fleet in North America, the slowest bus speeds.
after: And so we focused on the most congested areas of New York City, built out six bus rapid transit lines, 57 miles of new speedy bus lanes. You pay at a kiosk before you get on the bus.
ru: Не секрет, что дойти пешком быстрее, чем доехать на автобусе.

quote: Paul grew up literally in a bus in a swamp in Florida.
before: And we began to ask some pretty fundamental questions. For people who have the great privilege of studying medicine and anthropology — I had come from parents who were refugees.
after: He liked to call himself " white trash. " And so we had this opportunity and we said, what is it that we need to do?
ru: Пол же вырос буквально в автобусе на болоте во Флориде.

quote: Hell, weren’t you sitting on that bus, too?
before: Most days the classroom feels like an antechamber. You are deemed expert on all things Morrison, King, Malcolm, Rosa.
after: You are every- body’ s best friend until you are not. Hip-hop lyricologist.
ru: Чёрт, ведь ты, наверно, сидел в том же автобусе?

quote: Multiple people are reported dead after an early Friday bus crash near Phoenix, Arizona.
after: The Arizona Department of Public Safety stated that there were "multiple fatalities and serious injuries" in the incident.

quote: You know, I have no business messing in Jeremy's head.
before: I'd say its attached itself to all of you pretty tight, yeah. Bonnie's right.
after: I just didn't know what else to do. He's in danger here.
ru: Знаешь, не мое дело лезть в голову Джереми.

quote: When a business fails, it dies, and a new, better one takes its place.
before: The free market is a jungle. It's beautiful and brutal and should be left alone.
after: Just let business be business and government be government. Here you go.
ru: Когда бизнес не удаётся, он умирает и новый, лучший занимает его место.

quote: I mean, not my business anymore, but how's that look?
before: I got to say... I was kind of surprised you'd let that happen.
after: He bombs with you guys, then gets a big hit across the street? People get fired for that.
ru: Конечно, это больше не мое дело, но как это выглядит?

quote: My past is none of your goddamn business, and it's not actively trying to kill us.
before: - What is that supposed to mean? - Well, no one's digging into your past.
after: - Clock is ticking. - So if we need more answers, going back to Midland Circle is the only play.
ru: Моё прошлое не твоего ума дело, оно не пытается нас убить.

quote: Well there, I think the answer is very clear: They're in business.
before: So if it's fundamentally a resource problem, where are the resources in society? How are those resources really created, the resources we're going to need to deal with all these societal challenges?
after: All wealth is actually created by business. Business creates wealth when it meets needs at a profit.
ru: Я думаю, ответ здесь совершенно очевиден: Они находятся в бизнесе.

quote: It means being aware of the impact, of the consequences of the failure of that business.
before: And in the case of social and green enterprises, the death of this business can have a negative impact on the ecosystems or communities they were trying to serve. But what does it mean to fail mindfully?
after: Being aware of the lessons learned. And being aware of the responsibility to share those learnings with the world.
ru: Это значит отдавать себе отчёт о влиянии и последствиях провала этого бизнеса.

quote: Data philanthropy makes good business sense, and it also can help revolutionize the humanitarian world.
before: We want to make a difference, and so through data philanthropy, companies can actually help engage and retain their decision scientists. And that's a big deal for a profession that's in high demand.
after: If we coordinated the planning and logistics across all of the major facets of a humanitarian operation, we could feed, clothe and shelter hundreds of thousands more people, and companies need to step up and play the role that I know they can in bringing about this revolution. You've probably heard of the saying " food for thought. "
ru: Информационная благотворительность выгодна для бизнеса, она может помочь полностью изменить работу гуманитарных организаций.

quote: Australian business tycoon Alan Bond died today after complications from open heart surgery.
after: He was 77.

quote: Yeah, just one of the hospital busy bees.
before: Oh, I didn't catch-- Oh, I'm Betty.
after: I also work with Doc Masters. Oh. He's my doctor.
ru: Да, одна из вечно занятых больничных пчелок.

quote: I don't know. I was a little busy trying not to bleed to death.
before: Was it a meet-up? Was it a deadline for something?
after: You have to make it all about you. Well, that's a clue.
ru: Не знаю, я был слегка занят, пытаясь не истечь кровью.

quote: We're so busy, we have to schedule sex.
before: The good news is, we can work through this. It's not a big problem.
after: Also not a big problem. It feels like we've lost the passion.
ru: Мы так заняты, что нам приходится планировать секс заранее.

quote: Its siblings are already busy exploring the area.
before: Her baby's first glimpse of the urban world, from a terrifying 30 feet up. This is the last of her litter to be brought down.
after: And they have much to learn. This one has fallen into a back alley and is trapped.
ru: Его братья и сестры уже очень заняты исследованием нового места.

quote: I'm an emergency-room doctor, and "crazy busy" is a phrase you will never hear me use.
before: Raise your hand, and be honest, if you've used the phrase " crazy busy " to describe your day, your week, your month.
after: And after today, I hope you'll stop using it, too. Here's why you cannot afford to use " crazy " to describe your busy.
ru: Я врач отделения скорой помощи, и вы никогда не услышите от меня словосочетание «безумно занята».

quote: Photos like this: construction going on along a busy road.
before: I felt like anyone could do that. So I wanted to create something different, something where the process starts when you press the trigger.
after: But it has an unexpected twist. And despite that, it retains a level of realism.
ru: Взгляните на эту фотографию: ремонт оживлённой дороги.

quote: Here's what happens: We're all busy. Everyone's busy. A woman's busy.
before: (Cheers) Message number three: Don't leave before you leave. I think there's a really deep irony to the fact that actions women are taking — and I see this all the time — with the objective of staying in the workforce actually lead to their eventually leaving.
after: And she starts thinking about having a child, and from the moment she starts thinking about having a child, she starts thinking about making room for that child. " How am I going to fit this into everything else I'm doing? "
ru: Вот как это происходит: мы все, в том числе и женщины, заняты делом.

quote: The bomb exploded at a busy road in the Kashkal area.
before: Police reports say that a car bomb containing nearly 50kg of explosives, has detonated in the Pakistani city of Peshawar on Saturday, killing at least 11 people and injuring at least 30 others.
after: According to police, a school bus was passing at the time of the detonation which resulted in many of the deaths being children.

quote: They hit the button on the floor below us.
before: You can cut them off on 25. _ what are we doing?
after: The guys who were trying to kill you or the guys who were trying to kill me? Open the fire safety panel.
ru: Они нажали кнопку этажом ниже.

quote: When you're happy with those, you press this button.
before: The interface is pretty simple. You put your horizontal "X" coordinate here, vertical "Y" coordinate here.
after: Got it. Leonard, you'll never guess who I just found online-
ru: Выбираешь - и нажимаешь на эту кнопку.

quote: It's a big red button with "go" on it.
before: - Geoff announces V Day at 9pm. It's a starting pistol.
after: If Philip made an adjustment to Janus, we must know today. Let us operate.
ru: Большая красная кнопка с надписью "начать".

quote: Well, that's why you have your reset button.
before: You gotta pretend you're the guy and you don't wanna die. Yeah, that sounds cool, but it's not gonna work every time.
after: Yeah, we didn't have those growing' up. Most violent game I've ever seen.
ru: Вот зачем нужна кнопка перезагрузки.

quote: You push a button, it takes off, flies and lands, all by itself.
before: It takes off and lands vertically, but flies forward like a regular airplane. It's fully self-piloted.
after: The prototype that you see here is designed to carry a single passenger and luggage. And it can go about 20 miles in 15 minutes.
ru: Вы нажимаете на кнопку, он взлетает, летит и приземляется самостоятельно.

quote: But that is more than simply good ergonomics, putting the buttons in the right place.
before: What makes life easier, more enjoyable? What makes technology useful and usable?
after: It's often about understanding culture and context before we even know where to start to have ideas. So when a team was working on a new vision screening program in India, they wanted to understand what the aspirations and motivations were of these school children to understand how they might play a role in screening their parents.
ru: Но это больше, чем просто хорошая эргономика, размещение кнопок в правильном месте.

quote: The rubber band through the buttonhole, around the button and back?
before: I remembered when I was pregnant and unwilling to stop wearing my own favorite pants, even though I was busting out of them, that rubber-band trick. You moms remember what I'm talking about?
after: Instant stretch. So I removed the zipper so he could pull it up and down on his own.
ru: Резиночка в петлю, вокруг пуговицы и опять в петлю.

quote: It works similarly to the Facebook "Like" button.
before: On Monday, Google added the "+1" button to its search results.
after: Today, Google began planning to add it to text ads, globally known as "AdSense".

quote: Then get someone else to make the grab, or tell your buyer to back off.
before: You can't walk away. I already have a buyer.
after: So I'm out a ton of money because you made a stupid mistake and got spotted? You know, thanks for nothing, Caffrey!
ru: Тогда найми для ограбления кого-нибудь другого или скажи своему покупателю, чтоб отвалил.

quote: So either go and get Pegasus back or find another buyer.
before: You say this is what you're good at. It better be, because everyone that I thought was in my corner just walked out, and you are all that I have now.
after: You say you trust me. Then trust me when I say you can do this, because you have to. They say that negotiation is an art form.
ru: Так что верни этих покупателей из Пегаса, или найди других.

quote: She said she had another buyer lined up.
before: She said it was a pittance. Turned us down flat.
after: This evening, we toast a miracle. Fraulein Elsa's Cabinet of Curiosities will belong to you,
ru: Говорит, есть другой покупатель.

quote: Apparently, it's not the kind of work buyers want to see on their walls.
before: And that's his girl. Hey, Brooks, how's the art hangin'?
after: All right, you boys ready to see how the other half lives? 50 times one. And I hope you didn't give all your singles to that vet.
ru: Вероятно, это – не тот стиль, который покупатели хотят видеть у себя на стене

quote: There's a little plaque on the end that, you know, each buyer gets their name engraved on it.
before: (Laughter) This was another one I could not get a loaner of. Tom Cruise supposedly owns this bed.
after: (Laughter) To try this one, the maker of it let me and my wife spend the night in the Manhattan showroom. Lights glaring in off the street, and we had to hire a security guard and all these things.
ru: Знаете, на изголовье есть табличка имя каждого покупателя на ней выгравировано.

quote: He is the main buyer of U.S. Treasury bonds.
before: (Laughter) Here's some advice from one of the largest investors in the United States. This guy runs the China Investment Corporation.
after: And he gave an interview in December. Here's his first bit of advice.
ru: Он крупнейший покупатель американских казначейских облигаций

quote: And we went in, pretending to be buyers.
before: We went about getting evidence of what was going on. And this is footage from a hidden camera in a button.
after: And we found this right in this very state, in Karnataka. And the bear cubs were being harvested from across the country and being sold and traded.
ru: Мы выдавали себя за покупателей.

quote: Every show organizer always hopes their (international) show can keep good images for international buyers.
before: With their idea, they successfully transformed a simple electronic show to a grand combination with multiple industries' show. As you talked about the pavilion at TAITRONICS, this was a great chance for TAITRA to reposition and restart.
after: Hope TWTC Nangang can bring a bright future and have a good start, and TAITRA can complete solutions for TWTC Nangang to keep TWTC Exhibition Hall in a steady position.

quote: Yeah, and I wasn't stealing, by the way!
before: Hitting, pushing a woman! Arsehole!
after: Those drinks were dead! Clear off, love.
ru: Да, кстати, я ничего не крала!

quote: By the way, a friend of mine comes here from time to time. Daniel Lorca.
before: - Thanks. - Thanks.
after: Lorca'? He hasn't visited recently, has he?
ru: Кстати, один мой друг приходит сюда время от времени.

quote: Oh, by the way, did you ever find out what IT stands for?
before: Well, if you change your mind, you know where I am. Thank you.
after: Piss off, June. Who wants tea?
ru: А кстати, вы случайно не выяснили, что такое "ИТ"?

quote: By the way, Denise, that shining beacon of hope found me.
before: Uh, what's that? Holy fuck!
after: And I'm damn grateful he did. We want a union!
ru: - Кстати, Дэнис, этот светящий маяк надежды нашел меня сам.

quote: By the way, the Netherlands is an interesting story.
before: The Netherlands is on the left, and Belgium is on the right. And finally, depending on your particular version of European similarity, you can think about the U.K. and France as either similar culturally or not, but it turns out that with organ donation, they are very different.
after: You see, the Netherlands is kind of the biggest of the small group. It turns out that they got to 28 percent after mailing every household in the country a letter, begging people to join this organ donation program.
ru: Кстати, Нидерланды представляют собой интересный пример.

quote: This is a scientific diagram, by the way.
before: " Is there a sense of wonder? " and " Does it invoke curiosity? "
after: I don't have time to explain it, but it has to do with DNA and RNA. So I have a particular imaginative approach to visual work.
ru: Кстати, это – научная диаграмма.

quote: And by the way, these were trials where their deals were made.
before: So in this case, if you look carefully, most of the arrows flow from right to left. That is, it looks as if the uninformed brain activity is happening first, and then it's followed by activity in the informed brain.
after: This is from the first two seconds. We haven't finished analyzing this data, so we're still peeking in, but the hope is that we can say something in the first couple of seconds about whether they'll make a deal or not, which could be very useful in thinking about avoiding litigation and ugly divorces and things like that.
ru: Кстати, это исследование, где сделки были заключены.

quote: I love that you're so calm, but you're adventurous.
before: Would you take L.S.D. With me? What?
after: And honestly, I need to take it again to really appreciate here and I don't wanna do it alone. And I think if you were there, then it'd be okay.
ru: Мне нравится, что ты такая спокойная, но ведь ты любишь приключения.

quote: The point is, your mom is so calm that it makes me more anxious.
before: - The three who? - ‭Never mind.
after: Listen, the only reason Mom's so chill is because you got to be the crazy one. You're actually doing her a favor.
