ru: - Это место немного походит на пещеру и выглядит, как естественный шатёр.

quote: We should go live in a cave with no electricity until you're about 35 years old.
before: That'll make everybody jealous. Yeah, you know what we should do?
after: - Daddy. - What?
ru: Мы должны переехать жить в пещеру без электричества пока тебе не исполнится 35. Вот что надо сделать.

quote: The cave runs deep, with many twists and turns.
before: BENDU: Somewhere safe. All right, I'll go, but I'm going alone.
after: How can you be sure where it is now? I hear something.
ru: Пещера глубокая, там много туннелей.

quote: Around this half of the country, most of your caves are made of limestone.
before: Okay, a few of you. When you think of a cave, most of you think of a tunnel going through solid rock, and in fact, that's how most caves are.
after: Back where I'm from, most of our caves are made of lava rock, because we have a lot of volcanoes out there. But the caves I want to share with you today are made completely of ice, specifically glacier ice that's formed in the side of the tallest mountain in the state of Oregon, called Mount Hood.
ru: В окрестностях этой половины страны, большинство пещер состоит из известняка.

quote: However, there were legends about the existence of a cave in the mountain.
before: You have to imagine that indigenous people have never been there. It was impossible for them to reach this area.
after: So when we started the exploration, we had to explore with a great respect, both because of the religious beliefs of the indigenous people, but also because it was really a sacred place, because no human had entered there before. So we had to use special protocols to not contaminate the environment with our presence, and we tried also to share with the community, with the indigenous community, our discoveries.
ru: Однако ходили легенды о существовании пещеры в этой горе.

quote: This is one of the richest caves that we have found on the planet, anywhere.
before: These extreme physical and chemical parameters make the biology that grows in these places very special. Because contrary to what you might think, this is not devoid of life.
after: It's bursting with life. The extremes on Earth are interesting in their own right, but one of the reasons that we're interested in them is because they represent, really, the average conditions that we may expect on other planets.
ru: Это одна из богатейших пещер, которую мы находили где либо ещё на планете.

quote: The cave has been closed off to the public so researchers can examine it further.
Which one do I use to kill brain cells?
before: Vagisil, Vagisil Maximum Strength, Vagisil Wash, Vagisil Medicated Wipes. Gee wiz! There's vagi-everythings.
after: Buy me one of each of them. - I'm buying? - I'm totally poor.
ru: Какой выбрать, чтобы разрушить клетки мозга?

quote: You see how those cells are stuck together?
before: Ooh, "laced" doesn't do it justice. Take a look at this.
after: That's not laced. It's molecular bonding.
ru: Видишь, как эти клетки приклеились вместе?

quote: The grate between our cells Was like an intercom of sorts.
before: Hello, stefan. How you doing?
after: A lot of conversations, I bet. He liked to keep the dialogue going.
ru: Решетка между нашими клетками, была как телефонная связь.

quote: And they're gonna use him to roll up the rest of the cell.
before: I understand you have some information on the gateway bombing. The Occupation arrested the man who loaded the bomb onto the truck.
after: The people responsible for that action used to be affiliated with us, but they splintered off when we discovered that we had a difference of, um... philosophy. But they know who you are.
ru: И они воспользуются им, чтобы накрыть всю ячейку.

quote: Like embryonic stem cells, they, too, can become any kind of cell in the body.
before: A third kind of stem cells is called induced pluripotent stem cells. These are regular skin, fat, liver, or other cells that scientists have changed to behave like embryonic stem cells.
after: While scientists and doctors hope to use all of these kinds of stem cells to create new tissue to heal your body, they can also use stem cells to help understand how the body works. Scientists can watch stem cells develop into tissue to understand the mechnanisms that the body uses to create new tissue in a controlled and regulated way.
ru: эмбриональных стволовых клеток. Подобно эмбриональным, они таким же образом могут

quote: These memory cells immediately deploy the exact weapons needed.
before: Dendritic cells, or macrophages, capture the virus and display pieces of it. Memory cells generated by the HIV vaccine are activated when they learn HIV is present from the front-line troops.
after: Memory B cells turn into plasma cells, which produce wave after wave of the specific antibodies that latch onto HIV to prevent it from infecting cells, while squadrons of killer T cells seek out and destroy cells that are already HIV infected. The virus is defeated.
ru: Эти клетки памяти немедленно мобилизуют конкретное необходимое оружие.

quote: So you could fit 10 human cells across the diameter of a human hair.
before: It's about a tenth of a millimeter. And as we go smaller again, about ten times smaller than that, is a cell.
after: So when we would look at cells, this is how I really got involved in biology and science is by looking at living cells in the microscope. When I first saw living cells in a microscope, I was absolutely enthralled and amazed at what they looked like.
ru: Получается диаметр человеческого волоска это десять человеческих клеток.

quote: These reproductive cells were not merely more plentiful in ABVD patients.
after: They also appeared immature, "new" in the words of lead researcher Evelyn Telfer. This challenges the conventional belief that girls are born with all the ova they will ever have and the numbers can only go down as the cells are either used up by the reproductive cycle or succumb to damage or natural aging.

quote: After all these centuries, it is finally time.
before: Then I would tell you there's one more thing that you should know. The full moon is tomorrow, brother.
after: I have been to see the witches. They believe they may have found a way to spare the doppelganger.
ru: После всех этих столетий наконец пришло время.

quote: He left me cursed to wander through the centuries alone and weak.
before: Shakespeare broke my staff. He drowned my book.
after: You still have to play by the rules of your story. A story writ when magic was dying, almost gone.
ru: Он обрек меня скитаться сквозь века одинокого и слабого.

quote: To keep living century after century, she carries with her the first body she inhabited.
before: The countess has our son on board. But for all her power and knowledge, she does not know you even exist.
after: Find it, destroy it, and the bitch can be run through with a dull blade. That, I can do.
ru: Чтобы сохранять свою жизнь столетие за столетием, она сохраняет своё первое тело.

quote: Have you sold any late 19th century revolvers recently, Mr. Childan?
before: Of course. Certainly.
after: Uh, no, sir. It is not an area of specialization for me.
ru: Вы продавали недавно револьверы 19-го века... М-р Чилдан?

quote: Centuries ago, our ancestors would burn cats alive as a form of popular entertainment.
before: In particular, can it explain a momentous historical development that I spoke about five years ago here at TED? Namely, we seem to be getting more humane.
after: Knights waged constant war on each other by trying to kill as many of each other's peasants as possible. Governments executed people for frivolous reasons, like stealing a cabbage or criticizing the royal garden.
ru: Столетия назад сжигание кошек живьём было популярным развлечением у наших предков.

quote: In the 17th century, Robert Boyle came up with an idea for a self-watering pot.
before: With a low center of mass, the wheel just swings back and forth like a pendulum, then stops. What about a different approach?
after: He theorized that capillary action, the attraction between liquids and surfaces that pulls water through thin tubes, might keep the water cycling around the bowl. But if the capillary action is strong enough to overcome gravity and draw the water up, it would also prevent it from falling back into the bowl.
ru: В XVII веке Роберт Бойль предложил идею самонаполняющегося сосуда.

quote: And he thinks that civilization has only a 50 percent chance of surviving this century.
before: All it takes is for a supernova to go off a few light-years away, and we'll all be dead! Martin Rees has recently written a book about our vulnerability to all sorts of things, from astrophysics, to scientific experiments gone wrong, and most importantly, to terrorism with weapons of mass destruction.
after: I think he's going to talk about that later in the conference. Now, I don't think that probability is the right category to discuss this issue in, but I do agree with him about this: we can survive and we can fail to survive.
ru: И он думает, что человеческая цивилизация имеет только 50% шансов выжить в этом веке.

quote: The six vaults containing the treasure have been undisturbed for over a century.
before: The Hindu temple was built in the 16th century by the kings of the then Kingdom of Travancore to serve as a royal chapel for the rulers of Travancore.
after: Assessment of the treasure began on June 27 after a lawyer concerned about the security of the treasure petitioned India's Supreme Court, which then appointed a seven-member panel of experts to inventory the treasure. The panel does not have the power to determine to whom the treasure will belong.

quote: The only thing I need to move is the senator swearing-in ceremony, so we're good.
before: - You can clear that. - CLIFF: Absolutely, ma'am.
after: What? The senator swearing-in ceremony.
ru: Единственное, что нужно перенести, это церемонию присяги сенаторов, так что всё в порядке.

quote: Isn't my offering up my house for the ceremony enough, Lloyd?
before: I really need an answer, Ari. Time is running out.
after: No, even though that is so amazingly generous, this is so much more important to me. I need more information.
ru: Моё предложение своего дома для церемонии не достаточно, Ллойд?

quote: She was helping me look for Lucy before the ceremony started.
before: No, she wasn't. What do you mean she wasn't?
after: Lucy was playing down at the beach in the morning. It would make sense that savi would have gone there.
ru: Она помогала мне искать Люси, пока церемония не началась.

quote: Yeah, and the ceremony has to take place during daylight.
before: Whatever we do, we cannot let the ceremony happen. If Amaru regains her true form, the doorway will open, and it will welcome her.
after: And conveniently, the church has a skylight. Which means they're going to protect the fuck out of it.
ru: Церемония должна проходить при свете дня.

quote: So the funeral ceremony itself embodies this relational perspective on death.
before: And here you can see these wooden effigies of the ancestors, so these are people who have already been buried, already had a funeral ceremony. These are called tau tau.
after: It ritualizes the impact of death on families and communities. And it's also a moment of self-awareness.
ru: Погребальная церемония переключает родственные отношения на смерть.

quote: Dr. Bodnar came to the ceremony and she explained that she grew up in Ukraine.
before: One to save your life, one to save the life of some lucky bystander. (Laughter) Why would someone do this, you might wonder.
after: She was one of the doctors who treated victims of the Chernobyl power plant meltdown. And they later discovered that a lot of the worst medical problems came from the particles people breathed in.
ru: Доктор Боднар пришла на церемонию и объяснила, что выросла на Украине.

quote: The ceremony begins with a mock battle between the midwives and the other physicians.
before: On top are two temples: the north, where rituals honor the rain god in the summer, and the south one is where rituals honor the war god in the winter. On the equinox, the sun rises between the two sides.
after: Xoquauhtli’ s team battles heartily, throwing nochtles, marigolds, and balls made of reed and moss. They joke, call their rivals names, and laugh.
ru: Церемония начинается с потешной битвы между повитухами и другими врачами.

quote: The award was presented to him at a ceremony in New York City.
before: University of Florida quarterback Tim Tebow became the first underclassman in NCAA history to obtain the coveted Heisman Trophy Saturday night.
after: He received 1,957 points and 462 first-place votes.

quote: Yet there are others who reasonably wish to observe certain protocol.
before: I was hoping you could stand by my side as I present blue energy, technology that could offer answers to some of your world's most pressing concerns. Many here are very excited to see the gifts you have to present.
after: You understand, of course. May I ask what camp you're in, Mr. Chima?
ru: Но есть и другие, которые в силу известных причин желают, чтобы был соблюден определенный протокол.

quote: Do you want to agree that certain things between us never happened?
before: As much as I hate to do this, I have to ask you a direct question.
after: No. I wouldn't take back anything.
ru: Ты хочешь согласиться с тем, что определенные вещи между нами никогда не случались?

quote: As you know, working at the CIA gives me certain privileges too.
before: I almost forgot. You'll need this.
after: And they include summoning a federal prisoner whenever I damn well please. Fair enough.
ru: Как вам известно, работа в ЦРУ тоже даёт мне определённые преимущества.

quote: You even garnered some respect in certain circles.
before: Yeah well, we had our reasons. As cut-throat mercenaries you filled a niche, you had a role to play.
after: You can't afford to have people think you've gone soft. We could send you back to your ship without your tongue.
ru: Даже заслужили уважение в определённых кругах.

quote: It confuses the difficulty of being certain with the impossibility of truth.
before: That can seem like a bracing bit of realpolitik to people, or liberating, because it allows each of us to discover or make our own truth. But actually, I think it's a bit of self-serving rationalization disguised as philosophy.
after: Look — of course it's difficult to be certain about anything; we might all be living in " The Matrix. " You might have a brain chip in your head feeding you all the wrong information.
ru: Она выдаёт сложность достижения высокой степени уверенности за невозможность истины.

quote: And, like all grasses, at a certain point it puts out seeds.
before: But what's wheat? Wheat is a grass that grows in the field.
after: And we harvest those seeds, and those are the wheat kernels. Now, in order to harvest it — I mean, what's harvesting?
ru: Как все травы, в определённый момент она даёт зёрна.

quote: And government has certain benefits it can uniquely bestow on these markets.
before: So it's on a par with the water supply or the road network. And it's a series of markets for low-level trade that can be fulfilled by a person or a small company.
after: It's about public spending going through these markets to buy public services at the local level. It's about interfacing these markets direct into the highest official channels in the land.
ru: И от этого правительство имеет определённую прибыль, оно может уникальным образом награждать такие рынки.

quote: Many continue to exclude certain groups from participation in public life.
before: In his speech, Mr Annan praised the progress in development across the continent since 1997 saying,"Despite elections, many Governments continue to suppress opposition parties and a free press.
after: Many continue to practise or tolerate large scale corruption," in his last address to the AU.

quote: I don't know, Mom, but I'm certainly not telling you.
before: What college? Are you talking about Dartmouth?
after: I am tired of running away from my future. It's about time that I start running towards it, no matter how far from here it is!
ru: Я не знаю, мама, но, конечно же, тебе я ничего не скажу.

quote: It certainly is a very fascinating case you've chosen to investigate.
before: Oh, yes, of course. He kept insisting this was the kind of material you were looking for for your yearbook.
after: But if we're to consider it there are one or two mistakes which will have to be dealt with. Of course.
ru: Ты, конечно, несомненно выбрала очень интересный случай.

quote: Martha can certainly use those in a wrongful death suit.
before: You don't have a practice anymore or a wife or a kid, I'm betting. So what else can you lose?
after: State revoke your license, yet? I always tell my patients,
ru: Марта, безусловно, может использовать эти в противоправных костюме смерти.

quote: It certainly is a pleasure to see so many new faces here this month.
before: I don't think you know how. Welcome.
after: But Mayor Norris assures me that there will be enough ambrosia and tipsy cake for everyone. Now, our guest tonight is a gentleman who despite what you might have heard, is one of us.
ru: Это конечно удовольствие видеть столько новых лиц.

quote: Now, "Superstorm" is certainly an extreme example, but it's also not an unusual one.
before: And he responded by saying, " Well, when you say it like that, it sounds ridiculous. " And I'm embarrassed to admit that I had the guy send me the script, and I read 30 pages before I was sure that it was as bad as I thought it was.
after: And unfortunately, most scripts aren't as easy to dismiss as that one. For example, a comedy about a high school senior, who, when faced with an unplanned pregnancy, makes an unusual decision regarding her unborn child.
ru: Конечно, этот «Супер шторм» — радикальный пример, но далеко не первый.

quote: They're happier than middle-aged people, and younger people, certainly.
before: Aging brings some rather remarkable improvements — increased knowledge, expertise — and emotional aspects of life improve. That's right, older people are happy.
after: (Laughter) Study after study is coming to the same conclusion. The CDC recently conducted a survey where they asked respondents simply to tell them whether they experienced significant psychological distress in the previous week.
ru: Они счастливее людей среднего возраста и уж конечно счастливее молодёжи.

quote: We most certainly do talk to terrorists, no question about it.
after: We are at war with a new form of terrorism. It's sort of the good old, traditional form of terrorism, but it's sort of been packaged for the 21st century.
ru: Безусловно, мы говорим с террористами, никаких сомнений в этом нет.

quote: This certainly isn't the first time a fictional band has had a television series.
after: The Archies, Josie and the Pussycats, The Banana Splits, and Alvin and the Chipmunks are all notable examples.

quote: I did not start this chain of events.
before: I hope you boys are ready to become men. Mama's bringing moonshine.
after: Nor did I have the balls to stop it. I have always wanted to go on one of Mike's guy trips, if only to observe, you know?
ru: Не я начал цепь этих событий.

quote: And thus began the chain of mistakes that has led us both here.
before: A group of people who saw Robert Baratheon for the disaster he was. We tried to do what was best for the realm by supporting a Targaryen restoration.
after: Things have gotten worse, not better. Westeros needs to be saved from itself.
ru: А потом последовала цепь ошибок, которая и привела нас обоих сюда.

quote: Yeah, if you like the taste of bicycle chain.
before: Polyurea grease. Ooh. Sounds delicious.
after: That's what they use to lubricate them. So the victim was hit by a bicycle?
ru: Да, если тебе на вкус нравится велосипедная цепь.

quote: No, Dinesh, that chain is insane. And not in the membrane.
before: - All right, I'm in. - Well, you're insane.
after: Sorry, Cypress Halal. Okay, Jared, settle down.
ru: - Нет, Динеш, это ты псих, сам себя на цепь посадил.

quote: I like to call it "The Chain of Hope."
before: How do you implement something across 15,000 schools and 100,000 teachers? The department used to have a process which is very interesting.
after: They would write a letter from the headquarters and send it to the next level, which was the district offices. They would hope that in each of these district offices, an officer would get the letter, would open it, read it and then forward it to the next level, which was the block offices.
ru: Я называю её «Цепь надежды».

quote: So basically you have a chain of elements.
before: So the last project I'll show is called Biased Chains, and it's probably the most exciting example that we have right now of passive self-assembly systems. So it takes the reconfigurability and programmability and makes it a completely passive system.
after: Each element is completely identical, and they're biased. So each chain, or each element, wants to turn right or left.
ru: В основе мы имеем цепь элементов.

quote: What are we allowing to break the chain and how do we repair it?
before: My interactions with colleagues and my own experiences make me feel like this is a universal struggle across all grade levels. So what are we missing?
after: In my career, I've experienced the death by suicide of two students and one amazing teacher who loved his kids; countless students experiencing homelessness; and kids entering and exiting the justice system. When these events happen, protocol is to say, " If you need someone to talk to, then... "
ru: Как мы можем разорвать эту цепь и собрать её заново?

quote: Two British footwear chains have entered administration, a form of company liquidation in the United Kingdom.
after: Both Barratts and PriceLess are owned by parent company Stylo. Stylo has not entered administration itself but shares have been suspended.

quote: Never been threatened with a chair leg before!
before: We're back in reception. We surrender!
after: No, I tell a lie. Did you just say, "It's OK, we're nice"? OK, I need everyone to shut up now!
ru: - Мне раньше не угрожали ножкой стула! Нет, вру.

quote: Move his chair so he can see the flowers.
before: Here. His toenails need clipping.
after: He misses the garden. I saw a bunion on his right foot.
ru: Подвинь его стул, чтобы ему цветы было видно.

quote: This door here, it's a fire exit, but students keep it propped open with a chair.
before: Now, you found that Mr. grant's card key had logged him in at 7:49 P.M., but the murder didn't happen until 9:15. How do you explain this?
after: This is how Mr. grant could have had access to the crime scene while bypassing the card key system. And did you check out Mr. grant's alibi?
ru: - Вот эта дверь тут - это пожарный выход, но студенты подпирают ее стулом.

quote: My dog has taken over my favorite chair.
before: And you ask, "is everything okay?" Yeah, I hear you.
after: It's like, how did it all slip away? Gentlemen.
ru: Моя собака теперь занимает мой любимый стул.

quote: "Do you like the color of the lawn chairs?"
before: It was about those lawn chairs. " What did you think about the lawn chairs? "
after: So if you've got a big, controversial project, think about lawn chairs. (Laughter) This is the final design for Times Square, and it will create a level surface, sidewalk to sidewalk, beautiful pavers that have studs in them to reflect the light from the billboards, creating a great new energy on the street, and we think it's going to really create a great place, a new crossroads of the world that is worthy of its name.
ru: «Вам нравится цвет раскладных стульев?»

quote: I went back to the left, and so slid the chair, blocking my path of travel.
before: I just figured I'd made a mistake, and went back to the right, and so slid the chair in perfect synchronicity. Now I was getting a little anxious.
after: Now, I was officially freaking out. So I yelled, " Who the hell's out there?
ru: Я снова взял левее, и опять этот скрежет стула, мешающий мне пройти.

quote: We had my first saw blade launcher and we had a flamethrower chair.
before: That's my youngest cousin. This is a segment called, " Dangerous Toys You Won't See at Christmas. "
after: My career basically peaked here. And in the back are foam-core cutouts of the people who couldn't make it to the show.
ru: Тогда были представлены моя первая пусковая пила и стул-огнемёт.

quote: Cambodia, an ally of China, is the current chair of ASEAN.
before: China has previously stated it wishes to solve the disputes bilaterally instead of multilaterally. It comes after the failure of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) to produce a consensus on how to solve the disputes during a summit this month.

quote: Mr. Chairman suspects that Murase and I are plotting something.
before: Katô! Katô, I'm talking to you!
after: Murase isn't Sanno-kai Family. You want me to fire shots at Murase's office?
ru: Председатель считает, что мы с Мурасэ что-то замышляем.

quote: Chairman Jang and Chairman Kang, did you two do something that we're not aware of?
before: I've given orders to clean it up. It won't be good if the police knows about my relationship with Kang Tae Ho.
after: What do you mean? Tae Ho died.
ru: Председатель Чан и Председатель Кан, вас связывало что-то, о чём мы не знали?

quote: He still acts as if he owes Chairman Hwang his life.
before: Let me ask you just one thing. Why didn't you tell your brother that Jo Pilyeon and Hwang Taeseop... were responsible for your father's death?
after: I can keep the burden of revenge all to myself. Gangmo has always been full of dreams.
ru: Он ведь считает, что обязан председателю Хвану жизнью.

quote: The Chairman of the Workers Party is on line two. And Kyle is on line three.
before: We have to be tough here. Mr. President, the Grand Duke of Luxembourg is on line one.
after: Oh, geez. What does Kyle want? This is the president.
ru: Председатель рабочей партии на второй, и Кайл на третьей линии.

quote: There's a woman in Atlanta, Debbie Dooley, who's the Chairman of the Atlanta Tea Party.
before: Now, in one of the presentations yesterday, the jitney thing, there is an effort to use regulations to slow this down. And I just don't think it's going to work.
after: They enlisted her in this effort to put a tax on solar panels and regulations. And she had just put solar panels on her roof and she didn't understand the request.
ru: В Атланте живёт женщина по имени Дебби Дули, она председатель «Движения чаепития» Атланты.

quote: He became the chairman of the National AIDS Committee and increased the budget fifty-fold.
before: He asked me in because he liked my wife a lot. So I said, " Okay. "
after: Every ministry, even judges, had to be involved in AIDS education — everyone — and we said the public, institutions, religious institutions, schools — everyone was involved. And here, every media person had to be trained for HIV.
ru: Он стал председателем национального комитета по СПИДу и увеличил бюджет в пятьдесят раз.

quote: This was given to me by the chairman of Shiseido.
before: From everything from a weird hotel lobby, to Saran wrap placed over your window, to this moment where I had my road in front of my house paved dark black, and this white moth was sitting there dying in the sun. And so, this whole thing has struck me as exciting to be here, because life is finite.
after: He's an expert in aging. This horizontal axis is how old you are — twelve years old, twenty-four years old, seventy-four, ninety-six years old — and this is some medical data.
ru: Эти данные мне были предоставлены председателем Shiseido.

ru: Эти кандзи составляют имя Идзанами, богини творения и смерти в синтоизме.

quote: I believe in humanity 'cause aren't we all God's miraculous creation?
before: And to be honest, even that one has been a little iffy for me sometimes. W- what about miracles and, like, water into wine, raising of the dead, that sort of thing?
after: I mean, look at yourself. Your skills are the difference between life and death every day.
ru: Я верю в гуманизм, в конечном счете, мы все Божьи создания.

quote: We are blessed, every day, to witness the grandeur of his creation.
before: And... it struck me. We are all graced by the King's favour.
after: We truly live every day in Paradise. But imagine... to live under the sun and not feel its warmth. To know the breathless beauty of this world, but not be able to look upon it ever again.
ru: Все мы имеем удовольствие день ото дня быть причастными к величию его творения.

quote: And as one of my creations, I do believe I have let you live long enough.
before: Oh, wow, you actually say "Whedonverse" in real life. That's right!
after: Time to die, werewolf! Wow!
ru: И, как одно из моих творений, ты и так достаточно прожил.

quote: So, all of that is in the creation of content, of relevance, basic human expression.
before: And again, here, you see Barbie.com, but also, very quickly, Adiosbarbie.com, the body image for every size. A contested cultural object, which you won't find anywhere soon on Overture, which is the classic market-based mechanism: whoever pays the most is highest on the list.
after: But remember, the computers were also physical. Just physical materials — our PCs — we share them together.
ru: Поэтому, все дело в создании контента, определении значимости, реализации природы человека.

quote: While creation sometimes seems a bit un-graspable, or even pointless, creativity is always meaningful.
before: And I can — in 15 minutes, I think I can touch only a very rather janitorial branch of creation, which I call " creativity. " Creativity is how we cope with creation.
after: See, for instance, in this picture. You know, creation is what put that dog in that picture, and creativity is what makes us see a chicken on his hindquarters.
ru: В то время как творение представляется немного недосягаемым или даже бессмысленным, творчество всегда имеет смысл.

quote: Barriers of energy separate them from their quest’s second goal: the Node of Creation.
before: Ethic and Hedge are on the ground floor of a massive tower.
after: To reach it, Ethic must use three energy streams to climb the tower. As soon as she steps forward a timer will begin counting down from 60 seconds.
ru: Энергетические барьеры отделяют их от следующей цели — Модуля творения.

quote: What is your opinion on the creation of a North American Union?
She and I are Keeping our creative lives separate right now.
before: Ah. Yeah, I-I wouldn't know.
after: Uh, you might wanna discuss this one, Since it involves her going to Haiti for three months.
ru: Мы... сейчас стараемся держать нашу творческую жизнь отдельно друг от друга.

quote: Cory dragged me into the office for another creative meeting.
before: Hey, honey. [Sighs] Sorry I'm late.
after: I am starving. Hey, you okay?
ru: Кори затащил меня в офис для очередной творческой встречи.

quote: Say you're never gonna let the kids do anything creative ever again.
before: You're gonna go to his office. You're gonna say that you were wrong.
after: From now on, your classroom is full-on North Korea: Math! Math! Math!
ru: Скажешь, что больше никогда не позволишь детям делать ничего творческого.

quote: Let's get a little, I don't know, creative here.
before: Do not touch the feet! OK.
after: What if we all work together to get the popcorn? Fine.
ru: Давайте подойдем к вопросу более творчески.

quote: Yes, love does require a creative, concrete and ingenious attitude.
before: In order to do good, we need memory, we need courage and we need creativity. And I know that TED gathers many creative minds.
after: Good intentions and conventional formulas, so often used to appease our conscience, are not enough. Let us help each other, all together, to remember that the other is not a statistic or a number.
ru: Да, любовь нуждается в творческих, конкретных, нестандартных решениях.

quote: I think this kind of creative thinking, these kinds of connections -- it's the new economy.
before: (Laughter) Yeah, really, that's a weird call you're going to get. But it's fascinating that this is not just a sort of one-off, nice-to-have special.
after: The World Economic Forum, the think tank in Geneva, did an interview with a lot of smart people all around the world, asking, " What are the top 10 skills you and I need to become successful? " And what is interesting, what you see here: it's not about money or being really good in C + +, although these are great skills to have, I have to admit.
ru: Я думаю, такое творческое мышление, подобные связи — новый тип экономики.

quote: And I think sometimes the simplest objects can make the most creative uses.
before: It crosses cultures. And I think it lasted because people need to move.
ru: И иногда самым простым вещам находится самое творческое применение.

quote: This recording has been released under the Creative Commons 2.5 License.
before: Wikinews is a free service and it is funded by your generous donations. Click on the donate link on our homepage to learn how you can contribute.

quote: You dipped your pens into the inkwell of daring and creativity.
before: I have to hand it to you boys. Most men draw plans of relative pencil-sketched simplicity. But you two?
after: Only one problem. You stole the wrong keys.
ru: Но вы двое? полную дерзости и изобретательности.

quote: I hope you're putting some of that creativity into your vows.
before: "Foreign national dies in U.S. custody"... That's not a headline anyone wants to see, right?
after: Agent Moretti, Dr. Pierce. I'm Vice-Consul Rashid Prasad.
ru: Надеюсь, при написании свадебной клятвы ты проявишь такую же изобретательность.

quote: But now everyone is united, everyone's creativity and thought dedicated to eradicating famine, disease, climate change.
before: Winn, can you hear me? Your inventions have drowned out sense and turned it into nonsense.
after: You're harvesting the brain power of everyone in the city to solve the world's problems? National City is a giant think tank?
ru: Но сейчас все объединены, творчество каждого и мысль посвящены искоренению голода, болезней и изменению климата.

quote: Yeah, and my opinion is your teacher doesn't understand the difference between emotional problems and creativity.
before: Uh... This is nothing, Mr. Hobson. We were just having a difference of opinion.
after: Shut up, Karl. Excuse me. Did you just tell him to shut up? You know, this is typical "Susan" behavior.
ru: Да, и по моему мнению ваш учитель не понимает разницы между эмоциональными проблемами и творчеством. Заткнись, Карл.

quote: It's good for your ideas. It's good for your creativity.
before: (Laughter) And sometimes we need — (Applause) Sometimes we need excuses to do nothing. We need to be reminded by these patron goddesses of idle fellows that slowing down and being in the present, not thinking about what you've got to do and what you should have done, but just being here, letting your imagination lift from the everyday concerns down here and just being in the present, it's good for you, and it's good for the way you feel.
after: It's good for your soul. So keep looking up, marvel at the ephemeral beauty, and always remember to live life with your head in the clouds.
ru: помогает разобраться в своих идеях, это хорошо для творчества.

quote: I mean, can you have rules about creativity?
before: Edicts like, " Defer judgment, " or " Go for quantity. " And somehow that seems wrong.
after: Well, it sort of turns out that we need rules to help us break the old rules and norms that otherwise we might bring to the creative process. And we’ ve certainly learnt that over time, you get much better brainstorming, much more creative outcomes when everybody does play by the rules.
ru: Я имею ввиду, разве можно устанавливать правила для творчества?

quote: The definition of creativity that a lot of people go with is "appropriate novelty."
before: But is it creative? So people came up with as many ideas as they could, and we had to decide: Is this creative or not?
after: For something to be appropriate, it has to be realistic, so unfortunately, you can't use a key as an eyeball. Boo!
ru: Для большинства людей основная суть изобретательности — её применимость.

quote: Back to my childhood observation — the numbers do count in creativity and productivity.
The old legends do speak of such creatures.
before: I think that someone has raised Lancelot from the dead. By someone, I presume you mean Morgana?
after: They call them "shades". Poor, tormented souls summoned from their rest by the necromancer's art.
ru: В легендах говорилось о таких существах.

quote: I love all God's creatures, even certain Jews.
before: This whole religious thing is just an act because you hate the fact that I'm hanging out with the mailman. I don't hate mailmen.
after: What would your God-fearing Christian friends, Jenna and Drew, think about you fraternizing with a Satanist?
ru: Я люблю всех Божьих созданий, даже некоторых евреев.

quote: A creature of secrets that she never reveals.
before: - What? - The Sphinx.
after: Rather like Granny Violet. What time will you get there, on Friday?
ru: Загадочное существо, которое никогда не раскрывает своих тайн.

quote: No creature exploits the greening of a desert more quickly or more dramatically than a locust.
before: The deserts of Peru are amongst the driest in the world, but just add a little water and plants that have lain dormant for months will burst into life. And when a desert suddenly turns green, even the most seemingly desolate can become a land of opportunity.
after: Madagascar's arid south-west has received its highest rainfall in years. Now, an army is on the march, attracted by the smell of newly sprouting grass.
ru: Ни одно создание не использует озеленение пустыни быстрее и драматичнее, чем саранча.

quote: These are two creatures that were created in order to save endangered species.
before: So with antithrombin in that goat — that goat has been genetically modified so that the molecules of its milk actually include the molecule of antithrombin that GTC Genetics wants to create. And then in addition, transgenic pigs, knockout pigs, from the National Institute of Animal Science in South Korea, are pigs that they are going to use, in fact, to try to create all kinds of drugs and other industrial types of chemicals that they want the blood and the milk of these animals to produce for them, instead of producing them in an industrial way.
after: The guar is an endangered Southeast Asian ungulate. A somatic cell, a body cell, was taken from its body, gestated in the ovum of a cow, and then that cow gave birth to a guar.
ru: Это - два существа, которые были созданы для того, чтобы спасти вымирающие виды.

quote: It was this wild place full of color and life, home to these alien-looking, fantastical creatures.
before: As a kid, I used to dream about the ocean.
after: I pictured big sharks ruling the food chain and saw graceful sea turtles dancing across coral reefs. As a marine biologist turned photographer, I've spent most of my career looking for places as magical as those I used to dream about when I was little.
ru: Он был для меня диким местом, полным красок и жизни, домом для фантастических созданий, напоминающих пришельцев.

quote: Like humans, octopuses are some of the most intelligent creatures on earth.
before: This idea of leaving but bringing and then becoming more is at one of the hearts of Afrofuturism, or you can simply call it a different type of science fiction. I can best explain the difference between classic science fiction and Afrofuturism if I used the octopus analogy.
after: However, octopus intelligence evolved from a different evolutionary line, separate from that of human beings, so the foundation is different. The same can be said about the foundations of various forms of science fiction.
ru: Как и люди, осьминоги — одни из самых умных существ на земле.

quote: Whitton claims the creature was walking "parallel" to them as they hauled out the corpse.
before: The single photo shown at the conference portrays a blurred black figure in the distance.
after: Another photo on Whitton's website www.searchingforbigfoot.com shows what is allegedly the corpse, decapitated and stuffed into a freezer.

quote: Five crew, six deceased in transfer cases en route from Kandahar to Dover Air Force Base.
before: Anything? Plane was a Marine C-130.
after: Went down in a field just short of their destination. Any survivors?
ru: Пять членов экипажа, шесть тел в полевых гробах на пути из Кандагара на базу ВВС в Дувре.

quote: This is Five, another member of our crew.
before: Hey. I brought someone to meet you.
after: Hello. Hey.
ru: Это Пятая, ещё один член нашего экипажа.

quote: Captain Brooke activates that device, taking the base and all her crew members with her.
before: The nuclear device at the heart of the Central Dome. Today, on the 21st November 2059,
after: No-one ever knows why. But you were saving Earth.
ru: Капитан Брук активирует это устройство, принимая базу и все ее члены экипажа вместе с ней.

quote: Think about family, think about children, think about the crew.
before: Start to land! Volodya, third one will hit you.
after: Captain... captain, let's land. They can shoot us down, Captain.
ru: Подумай о семье, подумай о детях. Подумай про экипаж.

quote: On the next table was a Chinese guy, and in the crew room, it was entirely Filipinos.
before: They're at sea for months at a time, and even when they're on board, they don't have access to what a five-year-old would take for granted, the Internet. And another thing that surprised me when I got on board Kendal was who I was sitting next to — Not the queen; I can't imagine why they put me underneath her portrait — But around that dining table in the officer's saloon, I was sitting next to a Burmese guy, I was opposite a Romanian, a Moldavian, an Indian.
after: So that was a normal working ship. Now how is that possible?
ru: За другим столом сидел китаец, а в кабине экипажа почти все были филиппинцами.

quote: This I know well because I was one of the five crew members on board.
before: And these boats were exciting to sail. This was a training sail off the French coast.
after: Five seconds is all it took from everything being fine to our world going black as the windows were thrust underwater, and that five seconds goes quickly. Just see how far below those guys the sea is.
ru: Мне он хорошо знаком, так как я была одним из пяти членов экипажа.

quote: I was there, too, with a film crew.
before: What she did is very simple to explain and describe, but very hard to do. She took 72 minutes of activity, getting ready for a night out on the town, and stretched it over three days and performed it on a traffic island in slow motion in New York City.
after: We filmed the whole thing, and then we reversed the process, speeding it up to 72 minutes again, so it looks like she's moving normally and the whole world is flying by. At a certain point, I figured out that what I was doing was making portraits.
ru: Я тоже был там со съёмочной группой.

quote: When questioned about the object by crew members, the teen tried to explain the ritual.
after: However, the plane's captain still thought it best to land in Philadelphia as a precaution. Once it landed, the plane was searched, passengers were questioned, and the tefillin was examined by the bomb squad and proven to be harmless.

quote: I wasn't aware that it was a crime.
before: Information that's available in any ladies' hairdresser. Mind you, I think they're talking about people who aren't already married to somebody else, like Mr Mitchell here.
after: No. Just cheating.
ru: Я не знал, что сейчас это преступление.

quote: A pan of custard is hardly a nutritional crime.
before: It's not like you, Trix. Cheering yourself up with something hot and fattening.
after: Besides, I'm going to pour it over this sliced banana, so vitamin C will be involved. I'd be prepared to overlook the fact he had a wife.
ru: Заварной крем вряд ли можно считать преступлением против диеты.

quote: If you committed a crime, you should be punished for it.
before: - Arrest him! - Yes, sir.
after: Isn't that right, loser? It won't be too long before you get punished.
ru: Надо нести наказания за свои преступления.

quote: But that's the difference between a fake crime scene and a real one.
before: You did your best to scrub everything down. Burned what you couldn't wash away.
after: Evidence always sticks around. We didn't have to invite your union delegate for this conversation.
ru: Но в этом и разница между постановочным местом преступления и реальным.

quote: Police around the world are starting to use remote sensing and big data to anticipate crime.
before: But as we've heard so many times, these new technologies are dual-edged, right? Take the case of law enforcement.
after: Some cops are able to predict criminal violence before it even happens. The future crime scenario, it's here today, and we've got to be careful.
ru: Полиция начинает использовать дистанционное зондирование и большие данные, чтобы предупреждать преступления.

quote: And these are skeletons by now, most of these crimes happened 32 years ago.
before: And that DNA is what we're going to compare to the DNA that comes from the skeletons. While we're doing that, though, we're looking for the bodies.
after: When we find the grave, we take out the dirt and eventually clean the body, document it, and exhume it. We literally bring the skeleton out of the ground.
ru: Сейчас от них остались только скелеты, ведь большинство таких преступлений совершено 32 года назад.

quote: Because crime is a product of a distorted mind.
before: Let me show you the next slide. I took the same concept of mindfulness, because, why did I bring meditation into the Indian prison?
after: It was distortion of mind which needed to be addressed to control. Not by preaching, not by telling, not by reading, but by addressing your mind.
ru: Потому что преступление - продукт извращенного сознания.

quote: Both he and the county's Police and Crime Commissioner Stephen Mold, urged the immunity be waived.
before: Despite the assurances, she and her husband Jonathan Socoolas left the country, police revealed on Saturday. Northamptonshire's chief constable Nick Adderley wrote to the US Embassy in London asking to waive her diplomatic immunity.
after: The embassy declined the request and said the Socoolas family left per advice from the United States Department of State.

quote: In order to become the best inspector, he has to think like the best criminal.
before: What can I do? - My son needs training.
after: And that's you. When I'm done, he'll be a super cop.
ru: Для того, чтобы стать лучшим инспектором, он должен научиться думать, как лучший преступник.

quote: One that points to every criminal in town but you.
before: BISHOP: Great spot to commit murder.
after: We've got Hyland. A stoner who says Long asked for directions to the school?
ru: Это может указать на каждого преступника в городе, кроме вас.

quote: That Restorative Justice programme, where the criminal and the victim meet face to face. Oh, that.
before: No. His prison record said that you met him in March last year.
after: How did it go? We just...sat in the car park.
ru: В рамках программы Реституционное Правосудие, когда преступник и жертва, встречаются лицом к лицу.

quote: The rolling meeting is a popular security measure among high-end criminals.
before: Are you through here? I have one more thing to do.
after: It's hard for law enforcement to bug, and it's a lot easier to detect any surveillance. Do it in an armored car with an armed team, it's not just a secure place, it's a fortress on wheels. I love these SUVs. They're roomy.
ru: встреча в машине популярная мера безопасности среди профессиональных преступников.

quote: Thankfully, criminals underestimate the power of fingerprints, too.
before: And even this evening, have you paid any attention to sit without touching anything? Well, you're not alone.
after: And I'm not just talking about the twisted parting of lines that make our fingerprint unique. I'm talking about an entire world of information hiding in a small, often invisible thing.
ru: К счастью, преступники тоже недооценивают силу отпечатков пальцев.

quote: Or to predict who the next criminal would be?
before: What if, on top of that, we found the data scientists and paid the data scientists to predict where the next crime would occur? Minority neighborhood.
after: A minority. The data scientists would brag about how great and how accurate their model would be, and they'd be right.
ru: Или же за прогнозирование следующего преступника?

quote: Now, criminals who weren't capable of reaching us before can reach us.
before: They will switch from one country to another, from one jurisdiction to another — moving around the world, using the fact that we don't have the capability to globally police operations like this. So the Internet is as if someone would have given free plane tickets to all the online criminals of the world.
after: So how do you actually go around finding online criminals? How do you actually track them down?
ru: Теперь преступники, которые не могли добраться до нас раньше, могут сделать это сейчас.

quote: The note referred to these two criminals as "brothers".
before: The note 'criticized' the placards used in Hrant Dink's funeral. It also asked Dink's assassin Ogün Samast and Yasin Hayal, who admitted to incite the assassin, to be freed.

quote: I know how desperate things look, but there's a guerilla team in Pour-De-Lys, right now, with a critical mission.
before: You thought the four of you would take down this HQ? We owed it to our men.
after: If we can get there, four good men like you... you could make the difference. If you want to help, we have to move fast.
ru: Я знаю, в каком отчаянном мы положении, но в данный момент в Пор-де-Лис находится партизанская команда, с важнейшей миссией.

quote: There's a guerilla team in Pour-De-Lys right now with a critical mission.
before: It's a carpet of just... bodies. My God.
after: If we can get to them four good men like you, - you could make the difference.
ru: В данный момент в Пор-де-Лис находится партизанская команда с важнейшей миссией.

quote: The critical skill when alternating rounds of chess and boxing is not a mastery of either.
before: Admittedly, it's not as popular here as it is in other countries. And this is supposed to help me be a C.I. how?
after: It is the ability to quickly shift one's mental state. Adrenaline clouds higher cognitive function and, conversely, deep concentration slows reflexes.
ru: Важнейшее умение при чередовании раундов шахмат и бокса — не мастерство в каждом из видов.

quote: Our mission on the pakistani border is critical to our safety here at home and I have a responsibility to my platoon.
before: Major harris, my client would like to avoid any unnecessary delay. He wants to plead out?
after: So, yes, I'm ready to plead guilty to fraternization. Fraternization?
ru: Наша миссия на пакистанской границе имеет решающее значение для безопасности нашей страны, и я несу ответственность за мой взвод.

quote: In the process, tardigrades could even help us answer a critical question: could life survive on planets much less hospitable than our own?
before: If we can understand how they, and other creatures, stabilize their sensitive biological molecules, perhaps we could apply this knowledge to help us stabilize vaccines, or to develop stress-tolerant crops that can cope with Earth's changing climate. And by studying how tardigrades survive prolonged exposure to the vacuum of outer space, scientists can generate clues about the environmental limits of life and how to safeguard astronauts.
ru: В процессе тихоходки могут даже помочь ответить на важнейший вопрос: может ли жизнь существовать на планетах, менее пригодных для этого, чем наша?

quote: Finding cancer early, closer its genesis, is one of the critical factors to improving treatment options, reducing its emotional impact and minimizing financial burdens.
before: It's emotionally draining and, for many, financially destructive. But a cancer diagnosis doesn't have to be a death sentence.
after: Most importantly, finding cancer early — which is one of the primary aims of my research — greatly enhances your odds of survival. If we just look at the case of breast cancer for example, we find that those who are diagnosed and treated at stage one have a five-year survival rate of nearly 100 percent — odds that decrease to just 22 percent if treated at stage four.
ru: Раннее обнаружение рака, вскоре после его зарождения, — один из важнейших факторов улучшения возможностей лечения, снижения эмоциональной нагрузки и уменьшения финансового бремени.

quote: And connection is a critical part of being human.
before: And we need to reconsider what it means to save time. Culture and rituals around the world build in slowness, because slowness helps us reinforce our shared values and connect.
after: We need to master speed, and that means thinking carefully about the trade-offs of any given technology. Will it help you reclaim time that you can use to express your humanity?
ru: А сопричастность — важнейшая часть того, что значит быть человеком.

quote: The Greek Orthodox Church, a Christian denomination, is extremely critical of worshippers of the ancient deities.
They want to return home and gather the harvest before the crops turn.
before: The cold won't beat them. Our spies report growing discontent among the northern lords.
after: And I'm sure if those same spies snuck into our own encampments, they would report growing discontent amongst the southern lords. This is war; no one's content.
ru: Они хотят вернуться домой и собрать урожай зерна.

quote: When my dad got sick, Mr. Kripke helped us get the crop in the silo.
before: Used to hire me to paint his fence every summer. Paid me $10 just for a day's work.
after: Well, he sounds like a lovely man. I don't like to eavesdrop, but I heard your conversation with the colonel.
ru: Когда заболел отец, мистер Крипке помог нам собрать урожай.

quote: When House Tyrell stops sending our crops to the capital, everyone here will starve.
before: The gods' laws must be applied to all equally. If it's equality you want, so be it.
after: And I'll make sure the hungry know who's to blame. Have you ever sowed the field, Lady Olenna?
ru: Когда дом Тиреллов перестанет посылать в столицу урожай, здесь все начнут голодать.

quote: We plant more crops, we gain security, we grow stronger.
before: No? I've been reading Pilcher's plans.
after: As our numbers grow, we can start new settlements out beyond the fence. It's what he always wanted.
ru: Засеять урожай, собрать охрану, стать сильнее.

quote: More than one third of the world's crop production is dependent on bee pollination.
before: This is our life with bees, and this is our life without bees. Bees are the most important pollinators of our fruits and vegetables and flowers and crops like alfalfa hay that feed our farm animals.
after: But the ironic thing is that bees are not out there pollinating our food intentionally. They're out there because they need to eat.
