after: And it shouldn't be happening. It seems as though a very, very large region of the universe around us, about a billion light years across, is moving at a phenomenal speed in the cosmos.
ru: Это таинственное явление известно как темный поток.

quote: You've chosen the dark side and allowed it to feed your anger and desire for power.
before: How so? You have done what is forbidden.
after: By bringing the chosen one here, you've shown me my potential. You've only yourself to blame.
ru: Ты избрал тёмную сторону, и позволил ей кормиться твоим гневом и жаждой власти.

quote: No. I can't part with him now, not when I know he's The Dark One's son.
before: They've killed for less. The sooner we give them what they want, the sooner they leave us alone.
after: Can't be chance that brought him here. Providence must be at work.
ru: Нет, я не могу лишиться его сейчас, когда узнал, что он сын Темного.

quote: You won't make me go back to that dark place, where dead people go?
before: - Mommy? - Yes?
after: - It was lonely there. - No, darling.
ru: Ты ведь не сделаешь так, что мне придется вернуться в то темное место, в которое попадают мертвые?

quote: But there were witnesses, survivors in the dark.
before: Extinction can come slowly, but sometimes it arrives fast. An asteroid hits, and the world went down in flames.
after: When the skies cleared, a new world was born. A world fit for mammals.
ru: Но были очевидцы, выжившие в темноте.

quote: Whispered in the dark, this question begins a tale of conspiracy, deception and moral ambiguity.
before: " Who’ s there? "
after: And in a play where everyone has something to hide, its answer is far from simple. Written by William Shakespeare between 1599 and 1601, " Hamlet " depicts its titular character haunted by the past, but immobilized by the future.
ru: С этого произнесённого шёпотом в темноте вопроса начинается история заговора, обмана и морального выбора.

quote: They have eyes, they can distinguish between light and dark, but they mostly work by smell.
before: And once they belong to the ants that work outside, they never go back down. Now ants — most ants, including these, don't see very well.
after: So just to reinforce that what you might have thought about ant queens isn't true — you know, even if the queen did have the intelligence to send chemical messages through this whole network of chambers to tell the ants outside what to do, there is no way that such messages could make it in time to see the shifts in the allocation of workers that we actually see outside the nest. So that's one way that we know the queen isn't directing the behavior of the colony.
ru: У них есть глаза, они могут различать темноту и свет, но в основном они работают, ориентируясь на запах.

quote: Computer simulations showed that these voids contained dark matter.
before: One such phenomenon is the universal structure of galaxies. Galaxies tend to clump themselves together, with voids in between.
after: It had been theorized that this occurred because there was an extra force in dark matter clumping it together. Kesden mentions that these structures may be caused by other forces that affect only regular matter, like electricity and magnetism, but not dark matter.

quote: This shrouded the planet in a cloak of darkness that lasted for months, cutting off sunlight.
before: The initial impact triggered wild fires, massive earthquakes and tsunamis. But most devastating was the debris blasted high into the atmosphere.
after: The Earth was thrown into almost permanent night. Animals that survived the blast were now faced with their greatest ordeal, as a devastating chain of events was set in motion.
ru: Они накрыли планету покрывалом темноты, которая продолжалась месяцами, перекрыв солнечный свет.

quote: The best defense is to even the playing field by taking away the darkness.
before: You ready? Yeah.
after: In the army, that means M224 illumination mortars, but if you're short on heavy artillery, a flaming quart of scotch will work, too. They're running.
ru: Лучшая защита - сравнять условия избавившись от темноты.

quote: Now that mirror is cracked, and the only reflection you see is one of darkness.
before: Well, no wonder you feel so lost. Debra became a mirror, reflecting a positive image of yourself that you used to balance out with the notion of yourself as a monster.
after: You make it sound like that part of me isn't real. You are no monster.
ru: А теперь зеркало разбилось, и единственное отражение, которое ты видишь - это темнота.

quote: It's not a lit-up streetlight hazy darkness like most nights.
before: - Just let her go. Hey, truck driver.
after: It is a black crisp night and my eyes are like headlights. I've become nothing, finally
ru: Это не туманная темнота улиц, освещенных фонарями.

quote: They have helped me over the years to come out of the darkness.
before: No easy answer. I was received with a lot of support that I got from my relatives, from colleagues, from friends, from people I didn't know.
after: Not everyone was treated with the same attention. How many of my colleagues, after a traumatic incident, took their own life?
ru: Они помогали мне годами, вызволяя меня из темноты.

quote: In a way that reminds us, as we listen, that we're not alone in darkness.
before: They speak to a very real part of being human that can often be hidden in fear and shame and pushed deep down where it lingers and rots. But I think in listening to these songs — really listening — can allow us to refeel these hard emotions, but in a cathartic and healing way.
after: There's a Japanese phrase known as " mono no aware, " which roughly translates as " the bittersweet poignancy of things, " or the pathos or " ahness " of things. It's a valuable awareness of impermanence, both a kind of gentle, transient sadness as things pass by in life, but also a deeper, softly lingering sadness about the impermanence of all reality.
ru: Понять, пока слушаем, что мы не одиноки в этой темноте.

quote: It is a battle in the darkness against the darkness.
before: Understanding the universe is battle. It is unrelenting, it is time-varying, and it is one we are all in together.
after: Which is why Orion has weapons. In any case, if you're going to engage in this battle, you need to know the battlefield.
ru: Это сражение в темноте и против темноты.

quote: Leader of the PSDB, Arthur Virgílio Neto, said that the government lives in darkness.
before: The testimony of Jefferson is at the center of discussions in Brazil. According to the PMDB leader, Senator Ney Suassuna, the denunciations are "nitroglycerine which are thrown into the arteries of the Republic every minute".
after: Senator Peter Simon (PMDB-RS) appealed to President Lula to do an ethical turn-around, and respect the imperatives of morality and seriousness in government. According to Simon: "Today society is still saying that president Lula is a man of good.

quote: I was naively hoping for a second chance to have a date.
before: Asphalt, hydrocarbons of the paraffin were brought all the way from Damascus, Syria. I had no idea this would be a chemistry class.
after: Well... I think that... Hello!
ru: А я-то наивно полагала, что у нас второе свидание.

quote: You can't even go on a date without checking your relationship agreement.
before: Not even married and the honeymoon's over. Whatever.
after: If you've got a problem basing a relationship on a contract, I'd like to tell you about 13 plucky colonies that entered a "relationship agreement" called the U.S. Constitution.
ru: Ты даже не можешь пойти на свидание без того, чтобы не свериться с договором об отношениях.

quote: Okay. Well, how many actual dates have you taken any of these girls on?
before: Holding hands, milkshakes with two straws, that kind of thing? Come on, you make it sound like I'm some sort of player.
after: I date! In... in fact,
ru: Тогда сколько реальных свиданий было у тебя с этими девчонками?

quote: I was supposed to have a date last night.
before: I'm not here to feel better. Please.
after: I got all dressed up. I'm sorry.
ru: У меня вчера свидание намечалось.

quote: I had 19 dates and each date lasted three minutes.
before: So my idea was to have Stacey here go speed dating in Las Vegas on Valentine's Day. (Laughter) (Applause) (Music) SB: We ended up at what was advertised as the world's largest speed dating event.
after: Participants were given a list of ice- breaker questions to get the ball rolling, things like, " If you could be any kind of animal, what would you be? " That sort of thing.
ru: У меня было 19 свиданий, и каждое длилось три минуты.

quote: This is why we have these four-minute dates.
before: One more example of this. People believe that when we deal with physical attraction, we see somebody, and we know immediately whether we like them or not, if we're attracted or not.
after: So I decided to do this experiment with people. I'll show you images here, no real people, but the experiment was with people.
ru: На этом принципы основаны всем известные 4-х минутные свидания.

quote: For me, today, on this date, it's like a second bar mitzvah experience.
before: And this is what I'll tell you about. 13 years — for some of you, you can empathize with that number.
after: (Laughter) So this dream is really enabled by the convergence of two known technologies. One is the focused ultrasound, and the other one is the vision-enabled magnetic resonance imaging.
ru: Для меня сегодня эта дата как второе испытание бара-мицвы.

quote: They also introduced "instant view" and "jump to date" features.
before: On Tuesday instant messaging application Telegram announced publishing service Telegraph.

quote: And I'm very angry with Tyler for defiling my daughter on the page.
before: - You do? And you're a very beautiful woman.
after: But as much as I'd like to stick it to Tyler and bang out his mom... Sorry for being so charming. I don't want to hurt my daughter. That's cool, Hank.
ru: А я очень зол на Тайлера за то, что он растлил мою дочь на страницах своего сценария.

quote: A locker key was cut five weeks ago by Lucy Thomson, Elias's daughter.
before: Good! Who is it?
after: Why do you want to search my room? We've got a witness who says it was you that copied the key that opened the locker on Rue Cassini.
ru: Пять недель назад ключ от ячейки делала Люси Томсон, дочь Элиаса.

quote: He dragged you down and he dragged your daughter down too.
before: - He's a friend. - Juan, he's not a friend.
after: If Roper wasn't in your life, I think she'd still be alive today. Sorry.
ru: Он затянул вас, и он затянул вашу дочь тоже.

quote: If I wanted to make sure my wife and daughter aren't here, where would I go?
before: We're running out of medicine. The mist is in the entire east wing.
after: I'm home! Already done?
ru: Если бы я хотел убедиться, что моя жена и дочь не будут здесь, куда бы я пошел?

quote: Jenn, my daughter, and my son-in-law came down from New York.
before: My family, my kids had all grown up. We were officially empty nesters, and we decided, let's go on a family vacation.
after: My youngest, Andrew, he came down from his home in Charlestown where he was working in Boston, and my son Pete, who had played at Boston College, baseball, had played baseball professionally in Europe, and had now come home and was selling group insurance, he also joined us. And one night, I found myself having a beer with Pete, and Pete was looking at me and he just said, " You know, Mom, I don't know, selling group insurance is just not my passion. "
ru: Джен, моя дочь, и мой зять приехали из Нью-Йорка.

quote: Sudha, a daily-wage earner, realizes that her one-year-old daughter is suffering from uncontrollable dysentery.
before: When we delved deeper, we realized that lack of accountability is at the core of it. Picture this.
after: So she decides to take the day off. That's a loss of about 350 rupees or five dollars.
ru: Судха, наёмная работница, узнаёт, что её годовалая дочь больна дизентерией в острой форме.

quote: I have a two-year-old daughter who's the best thing ever.
before: It's wavy. It sounds good, but I'll bet you know in your gut that it's not the whole truth, and I'll tell you why.
after: And I'm just going to come out and say it: My daughter is not a wave. And you might say, " Surely, Rueben, if you took even just the slightest step back, the cycles of hunger and eating, waking and sleeping, laughing and crying would emerge as pattern. "
ru: У меня есть двухлетняя дочь, самое лучшее создание на земле.

quote: He is survived by two daughters and four grandchildren.
before: Moore had previously suffered from skin cancer on his head, and broke his hip in 2018. He said his hospital treatment inspired him to fundraise for the NHS, describing the staff who treated him as "marvellous".

quote: He said that Nick clocked out early the day that Vivien died, at 5:00.
before: Hey. So I just spoke to, uh, Nick Johnston's Foreman.
after: But his wife said he didn't get home till at least 7:00. Well, that would've been plenty of time for him to get to Vivien's office, murder her, write the letter, all before the mail was picked up.
ru: Он сказал, что Ник ушел со смены пораньше, в день смерти Вивьен, в 5 часов.

quote: Even though you've been lying to me every day of my entire life.
before: Well, I only have your word for that. Yes.
after: Let the judge know we're ready. Are you okay?
ru: Даже хотя вы врали мне каждый день моей жизни.

quote: He vanished the day I became your father.
before: Given to all manner of drinking and mischief. Whatever happened to that fearsome ne'er-do-well?
after: I am what I am because of you, and I wouldn't have it any other way. I know, Daddy.
ru: Он исчез в тот же день, когда ты появилась на свет.

quote: Girl, now how am I gonna be pregnant wearing this outfit two shifts a day?
before: Oh, are you pregnant? No!
after: The management training program. I took the test.
ru: Девушка, как по твоему я могу забеременеть одевая эту униформу, две смены в день?

quote: It was their second day, and Bassem was getting very weak.
before: A refugee's stay is supposed to be temporary. Back to Doaa and Bassem in the water.
after: And now it was Doaa's turn to say to Bassem, " My love, please hold on to hope, to our future. We will make it. "
ru: Второй день после атаки. Бассем сильно ослаб.

quote: That day, Americans tanks started arriving in Baghdad.
before: It was April 8, 2003. I was in Baghdad, covering the war in Iraq.
after: We were just a few journalists in the Palestine Hotel, and, as happens in war, the fighting began to approach outside our windows. Baghdad was covered in black smoke and oil.
ru: В тот день американские танки вошли в Багдад.

quote: We could change it and make it Seattle-Florida, that day, in real time.
before: So, it's fairly easy — If you say I'm going to be really good at one specific route, that's one thing, but it should be able to go, really be very good, certainly once you enter a highway, to go anywhere on the highway system in a given country. So it's not sort of limited to LA to New York.
after: So you were going from LA to New York. Now go from LA to Toronto.
ru: Мы можем его поменять, например, Сиэтл — Флорида, в тот же день, в режиме реального времени.

quote: The order lasts 28 days, and Nowak is anticipated to be back in court later.
before: Following the private court appearance, Sheriff Peter Hammond sent Nowak to the Murray Royal, a mental hospital, for assessment.

quote: There's a reason the dead didn't come back to life and start raiding our cupboards.
before: He's not going for it. Maybe 'cause a canned ham don't kick and scream when you try to eat it.
after: We need live bait. Have I mentioned that I really like your new haircut?
ru: Он прав. Ведь мертвецы почему-то восстали не для того, чтобы шарить по нашим кухням.

quote: It is quite a feat to kill that which is already dead.
before: My services are not for sale. And the word you are looking for is "Destroy."
after: But you don't understand. My mother was murdered.
ru: А убить того, кто уже мертв, довольно сложно.

quote: I've been dead inside ever since I found out that vamper killed my parents.
before: Try it. Boy, you think I'm afraid of dying?
after: So you gonna tell me where Warlow is or we both die. Either way works for me.
ru: Я мертв уже с тех пор, как узнал, что этот Варлоу убил мою семью.

quote: A.C. is so dead, it should be embalmed.
before: Nobody got into this deal to build another Atlantic city, Ben. Please don't talk to me about Atlantic City.
after: That is the past. This, right here... this is the future, and the flamingo is only the start, the first seed of what will be a mighty forest.
ru: Тот город настолько мертв, что его пора бальзамировать.

quote: See her dancing, summoning the dead, resurrecting new life.
before: Feel her spinning, spanning several lifetimes. Hear her speaking, sparking alarm.
after: Heaven hears her knocking on the door, safely transporting the ones who call for her assistance. Wild women, they open portals to new worlds, new speech, new dreams.
ru: Смотрите, как она танцует, вызывая мёртвых, воскрешая новую жизнь.

quote: Nine years later, 12 of them were dead and 30 had become disabled.
before: The problem is that this can cause real harm. In the 1950s, a psychiatrist named Eliot Slater studied a cohort of 85 patients who had been diagnosed with hysteria.
after: Many had undiagnosed conditions like multiple sclerosis, epilepsy, brain tumors. In 1980, hysteria was officially renamed " conversion disorder. "
ru: Через девять лет 12 из них были мертвы, а 30 стали инвалидами.

quote: They're no longer being taught to babies, which means, effectively, unless something changes, they're already dead.
before: Every language is an old-growth forest of the mind, a watershed, a thought, an ecosystem of spiritual possibilities. And of those 6,000 languages, as we sit here today in Monterey, fully half are no longer being whispered into the ears of children.
after: What could be more lonely than to be enveloped in silence, to be the last of your people to speak your language, to have no way to pass on the wisdom of the ancestors or anticipate the promise of the children? And yet, that dreadful fate is indeed the plight of somebody somewhere on Earth roughly every two weeks, because every two weeks, some elder dies and carries with him into the grave the last syllables of an ancient tongue.
ru: На этих языках больше не обучают детей, а это означает, что, если ничего не изменится, то они уже мертвы.

quote: A gunman shot Burundi environment minister Emmanuel Niyonkuru dead early on Sunday, local time (UTC+2).
The city's on edge as the deadline approaches for Mayor Kane...
before: I work all day. Where am I supposed to put my children?
after: They got here this morning before I did. What do you think he's doing about all this?
ru: Город на грани, поскольку приближается крайний срок для мера Кейна...

quote: And tomorrow's my deadline for telling them yes or no, so you gotta tell me tonight.
before: Sweetheart, I don't mean to pressure you, but the Caesars people have offered me a roulette pit of my own in Atlantic City. That's a big break.
after: Will you come with me? That's not what you mean when you say, "come with me."
ru: А завтра крайний срок, нужно дать ответ: да или нет. А сегодня жду ответа от тебя.

quote: Make the arrival of the Chinese your deadline.
before: I can't very well kill my brother while our guest are here. Then do it before.
after: Otherwise, this will go on forever. And how will the plan go away?
ru: Пусть прибытие китайцев станет твоим крайним сроком.

quote: I assume you've heard of deadlines?
before: Now! Now!
after: I've got Lockett warming up in the bullpen if you're not up to it. Excuse me.
ru: Думаю, ты слышала про крайние сроки?

quote: So to get work done, you've got to set a deadline, right?
before: With brainstorming we make you happy, we play games, and we say, " No criticism, " and you get all these weird, neat ideas. But in fact, if that's how you always were you'd never get any work done because you'd be working along and say, " Oh, I got a new way of doing it. "
after: You've got be anxious. The brain works differently if you're happy.
ru: Так что, чтобы завершить что-нибудь вам обязательно нужен крайний срок, да?

quote: So I had a very short deadline for a competition.
before: So I bought a month's worth of classes. (Laughter) And proceeded to look at — I wanted to set competition so I'd have a deadline — Parkinson's Law, the perceived complexity of a task will expand to fill the time you allot it.
after: I got a female instructor first, to teach me the female role, the follow, because I wanted to understand the sensitivities and abilities that the follow needed to develop, so I wouldn't have a repeat of college. And then I took an inventory of the characteristics, along with her, of the of the capabilities and elements of different dancers who'd won championships.
ru: Так что я поставил очень короткий крайний срок,

quote: That's sort of the deadline that the environmental models have shown us that we have to meet.
before: CA: So, in your mind, timescale and likelihood of actually taking something like this live? BG: Well, we need — for one of these high-scale, electro-generation things that's very cheap, we have 20 years to invent and then 20 years to deploy.
after: And TerraPower — if things go well, which is wishing for a lot — could easily meet that. And there are, fortunately now, dozens of companies — we need it to be hundreds — who, likewise, if their science goes well, if the funding for their pilot plants goes well, that they can compete for this.
ru: Это – крайние сроки, которые нам диктуют разработанные модели изменения окружающей среды

quote: The initial deadline for the peace talks was Sunday at midnight, but was extended thrice.
before: Rebel negotiators faced intense pressure to accept the amended deal, as diplomats from the United States, Britain, Canada and the European Union struggled to find common ground.
after: The peace plan was prepared by mediators from the African Union and was amended after the rebel groups did not agree at an early draft. International negotiators, including U.S. Deputy Secretary of State Robert Zoellick, Nigerian President Olusegun Obasanjo and British International Development Secretary Hilary Benn, said the deal was the best hope for peace in Darfur.

quote: The kind you might use to transport a deadly pathogen.
before: It's got round corners. Could very easily be a briefcase.
after: Conrad, we need to get in that house ASAP. No.
ru: То, что могли использовать для транспортировки смертельного патогена.

quote: His actions are leading us to a deadly showdown.
before: So you want to put down Coulson and Skye? I want to avoid it.
after: Help me find him, and we'll stop it. Don't worry.
ru: Это его действия ведут нас к смертельному столкновению.

quote: She also said trepidation is a deadly quality.
before: There's no "we" here. You heard what Rorish said.
after: I'm already on her bad side. There's nothing in this for me.
ru: А еще она сказала, что трепет - смертельное качество.

quote: Breaking in, stealing a deadly virus, and using it to kill aliens in this very bar.
before: - Yes. When Henshaw was at the Fortress of Solitude...
after: He discovered your cousin keeps a Phantom Zone projector among his Kryptonian artifacts. A projector?
ru: Когда он вломился, украл смертельный вирус и использовал его, чтобы убить пришельцев в этом баре.

quote: Whoever gets the level exactly to 0 on their turn will win this deadly duel.
before: Control over water drainage alternates between you and NIM, and neither can skip a turn. Each of you can lower the water level by exactly 1, 3, or 4 stories at a time.
after: Note that neither of you can lower the water below 0; if the water level is at 2, then the only move is to lower the water level 1 story. You know that NIM has already computed all possible outcomes of the contest, and will play in a way that maximizes its chance of success.
ru: Тот, кто достигнет нулевого этажа в свой ход, победит в смертельной дуэли.

quote: But it's not just that mosquitos are annoying, they're also deadly.
before: Turns out we don't really like that too much. In fact, humans hate mosquitos so much that we spend billions of dollars worldwide to keep them away from us — from citronella candles to bug sprays to heavy-duty agricultural pesticides.
after: Mosquitos can transmit everything from malaria to yellow fever to West Nile virus to dengue. Over a million people worldwide die every year from mosquito-borne diseases, and that's just people.
ru: Но речь идёт не только о навязчивости комаров, но и об их смертельной опасности.

quote: This illustrates to me the deadly danger of fake news.
before: I am furious when I think about what the parents have told me, that if these were daughters of the rich and the powerful, they would have been found much earlier. And I am furious that the hoax narrative, I firmly believe, caused a delay; it was part of the reason for the delay in their return.
after: So what can we do about it? There are some very smart people, smart engineers at Google and Facebook, who are trying to use technology to stop the spread of fake news.
ru: Это иллюстрирует смертельную опасность фальшивых новостей.

quote: It is one of three deadly European airshow crashes in four days.
after: On Thursday two planes carrying parachutists collided and crashed in West Slovakia. At least seven were killed.

quote: So much for our deal with the Ursini.
before: Theoretically, yes. We've been tricked.
after: We just got a message from the seed ship. What does it say? "Target the command vessel."
ru: Вот вам и сделочка с Урсини. Пришло сообщение с установщика.

quote: Do you remember when you told us about one of your first gun deals, the Yakuza?
before: Oh. The same way that you almost did.
after: It was my first deal. The bullet that you used to shoot the Oni.
ru: Помнишь, когда ты рассказал нам о своей первой сделке с оружием, Якудзу?

quote: The way we remember it is, we had a deal, Eric.
before: You gave me tits, you're taking them out. Chocolate, boys?
after: Fuck the deal. You hustled me, motherfucker.
ru: Как мы помним это, Мы заключили сделку, Эрик.

quote: The deal you make is to sell the shares you buy on the same day.
before: ...and we've been there... Sorry, I have a dental appointment, okay?
after: And you'll earn money? - Enough to paint, anyway.
ru: Сделка состоит в том, что ты продаешь акции в тот же день, когда ты их купил.

quote: A company flies in, does a deal with a minister.
before: And the first step in that is selling the rights to resource extraction. You know how rights to resource extraction are being sold at the moment, how they've been sold over the last 40 years?
after: And that's great for the company, and it's quite often great for the minister — (Laughter) — and it's not great for their country. There's a very simple institutional technology which can transform that, and it's called verified auctions.
ru: Компания прилетает на самолёте, делает сделку с министром.

quote: And I thought that was the best deal in town, so I accepted it immediately.
before: And he thought I did very well — and I did, too — in the arts: this was my passion. And he said " If you go to MIT, " to which I had been given early admission, " I will pay for every year you're at MIT, in graduate or undergraduate — as much as you want — I will pay for an equal number of years for you to live in Paris. "
after: And I decided that if I was good in art, and I was good in mathematics, I'd study architecture, which was the blending of the two. I went and told my headmaster that, at prep school.
ru: Посчитав, что это выгодная сделка, я сразу же согласился.

quote: If you're wired to make deals, you make deals.
before: If you're wired to be an anthropologist, you'll be an anthropologist. If you're wired to be an undersea explorer, you'll be an undersea explorer.
after: If you're wired to paint, you paint. Did you know that God smiles when you be you?
ru: Если ты создан для того, чтобы заключать сделки, ты заключаешь сделки.

quote: They keep making a big deal about playing against Israel.
before: Yeah.
after: But the funny thing is that that tournament was in 2017 but in 2015, we both played against Israel in another tournament and nobody seemed to care, in the old tournament. I don't understand why they make it such a big deal.

quote: Dated a heroin smuggler To expose dealers targeting young kids.
before: She wanted to live her stories. Took a job at an after-hours sm club To expose sex traffickers.
after: Almost got hooked herself when she had to shoot up. Magazine got a lotta good copy for jane risking her life.
ru: Встречалась с торговцем наркотиков, чтобы разоблачить дилеров, продаваших наркотики детям.

quote: And what would an arms dealer look like?
before: He didn't look like an arms dealer. Really?
after: Connor's talking with a counselor right now. Obviously we can't charge him with anything... he's 11 years old... but he really needs to understand the seriousness of his actions.
ru: И как должен выглядеть торговец оружием?

quote: Compile a list of antique dealers with a permit to sell firearms.
before: Inconclusive. The man and boy who described the bespectacled gunman in the crowd believe this resembles the weapon they saw.
after: Frank, I'm glad I caught you. I'm kind of late for work.
ru: Составьте список торговцев антиквариатом... Которым разрешено продавать оружие.

quote: It's an international arms dealer who calls himself The Scorpion.
before: Who's behind all this? Who's trying to kill you?
after: The Agency's been after him for years. And your friends here were about to sell him these.
ru: Международный торговец оружием, называющий себя Скорпионом.

quote: There's no drug dealer phone and there's no journalist laptop.
before: Like Gamma and Hacking Team, the FBI also has the capability to remotely activate webcams, microphones, steal documents, get web browsing information, the works. There's sort of a big problem with governments going into hacking, and that's that terrorists, pedophiles, drug dealers, journalists and human rights activists all use the same kinds of computers.
after: We all use the same technology, and what that means then is that for governments to have the capability to hack into the computers of the real bad guys, they also have to have the capability to hack into our devices too. So governments around the world have been embracing this technology.
ru: Не существует модели телефона торговца наркотиками, как и не существует ноутбука журналиста.

quote: Scrap dealers recover copper, aluminum, steel, glass, plastic and printed circuit boards.
before: We know what they do, but not how they work or what's inside. In Agbogbloshie, people make it their business to know exactly what's inside.
after: It's called " urban mining. " It's now more efficient for us to mine materials from our waste.
ru: Торговцы вторсырьём добывают медь, алюминий, сталь, стекло, пластик, а также печатные платы.

quote: There's a World Bank, arms dealers and a United Nations.
before: I choose the Prime Minister based on my relationship with them. I offer them the job, they can turn it down, and then they choose their own cabinet.
after: There's also a weather goddess who controls a random stock market and random weather. (Laughter) That's not all.
ru: У нас есть Всемирный Банк, торговцы оружием и ООН.

quote: Newton stated that a drug dealer committed the killings.
before: According to the police, the motive for the murders was collection of $100,000 in life insurance.
after: Prosecutors say that gunpowder residue was found on Newton's skirt. Ballistics tests also backed up police claims that the pistol in question was the murder weapon.

quote: Rosalie, my dear, we're so happy to have you here with us.
before: Rhubarb pie! Your mother made it.
after: - We really missed you. - I'm happy too.
ru: Розали, дорогая, мы так рады, что ты сегодня с нами.

quote: I swore an oath to the care and nurturing of a dear friend.
before: You should just get out of here, baby. This ain't your problem.
after: Boop. Where did you come from?
ru: Я дала клятву, что буду заботиться о дорогом друге.

quote: You clearly no longer possess the power to arouse, dear Piers.
before: I am sure it does. It appears I am as limp as a wet palm frond.
after: How can you rally the king when you cannot even excite a simple, dirt-born rod? Bind the little French bitch.
ru: Ты утратил свою способность возбуждать, милый Пирс.

quote: What it's like to lose someone dear to you.
before: Takuma won't die and leave me behind. Don't make light of his life!
after: If you're going to be devastated then... It pains me to watch you. Let go of me.
ru: принцесса. каково это - потерять дорогого человека? оставив тебя одну?

quote: Sleep, actually, is something very dear to my heart, because my sleep is a disaster.
before: So what else can we sense about people using wireless signals? Sleep.
after: (Laughter) So one thing is when you start working on some physiological signal and you discover that yours sucks. (Laughter) So you can see why we can capture sleep, because the person walks and the device sees him as he walks to bed, when he stops tossing around in bed, when he steps out of bed, and that measure of sleep is what people call actigraphy.
ru: Сон — то, что дорого моему сердцу, поскольку я очень плохо сплю.

quote: She sings this song. It's called "Dear Heart."
before: In this scene, she sits at home. The phone is ringing, her friends are calling, but she doesn't know how to talk to them.
after: (Guitar) When I was dreaming, I took my body to beautiful places I'd never been. I saw Gibraltar, and stars of Kentucky burned in the moonlight, making me smile.
ru: И она начинает петь песню. Она называется «Дорогой друг».

quote: A good example of that light and color is a show I designed called "Dear Evan Hansen."
before: It's important to remember that, because when we design the world for you, the therapy is important. It tells you that emotion is going to become light and color.
after: (Cheers) " Dear Evan Hansen " exists — oh my God — " Dear Evan Hansen " exists in a world of almost all light and color. So I chose a color: inky-black darkness.
ru: Хороший пример света и цвета — мюзикл, над которым я работал, — «Дорогой Эван Хэнсен». (Звуки восторга)

quote: A 23-year-old Tokoroa man has been arrested for the murder of a school teacher, Lois Dear.
after: Dear's body was found on July 16 (Sunday) in her classroom at Strathmore Primary School, one day before term three of the New Zealand primary school year was to start.

quote: Did you say I act like my job is life and death?
before: Well, I-I tried to talk about it this morning, but I'm busy now. Uh-huh. I'm sorry.
after: Well, excuse me, my, my job is just death. Yeah, that's right.
ru: Ты сказала, что я отношусь к работе, как будто это вопрос жизни и смерти?

quote: Illness, old age, and death will be things of the past.
before: The Ultimate Serum. All forms of life will be invulnerable.
after: Mere memories. A more admirable goal than creating invincible soldiers, isn't it, Grandad?
ru: Болезни, старение, смерть окажутся в прошлом.

quote: It is a house of death for Maurice.
before: Lindy, you said this was a house of death for Maurice. Is it still?
after: Not his death. There's someone here.
ru: Это дом смерти для Мориса.

quote: You, me, an evil scheme, a little death.
before: Your cruelty is as sweet as this coffee I'm dumping this sugar into. Oh, Georgina, I missed this.
after: La petite Mort. You know I love it when you speak Spanish.
ru: Ты, я, кошмарный заговор, немного смерти.

quote: It had to do with death and disease and lots of other things.
before: Being someone who had had a very difficult childhood, a very difficult adolescence — it had to do with not quite poverty, but close. It had to do with being brought up in a family where no one spoke English, no one could read or write English.
after: I was a little prone to depression. So, as things got worse, as we really began to hate each other, I became progressively depressed over a period of a couple of years trying to save this marriage, which was inevitably not to be saved.
ru: Я видел смерть, болезни и кучу всего такого.

quote: Heart disease is the leading cause of death worldwide.
before: As we speak, there are 117 or so clinical trials researching the use of stem cells for liver diseases. What lies ahead?
after: 1.1 million Americans suffer heart attacks yearly. 4.8 million suffer cardiac failure.
ru: Заболевания сердца – главная причина смертности во всём мире.

quote: And I was on death row at that time.
before: That was then. But when Alexander came in, he was a young 20-year-old boy.
after: And we took him under our wing. It was an honest trust issue.
ru: А я в то время находился в камере смертников.

quote: The death toll was yesterday finalised at 71.
before: Four foreign men have today gone before a court in Hungary on suspicion of people smuggling. Their detention relates to Thursday's discovery of a lorry full of corpses in Austria.

quote: Well, my issues about debt division, are they included here?
before: If you're both amenable, we'll use this as a basis for preparing a formal settlement. Signed.
after: And the, uh, London condo? Page six.
ru: А мои документы по разделению долговых обязательств включены сюда?

quote: Richard, it pains me to admit it, but I am in your debt.
before: No, I've had enough of that. == sync, corrected by elderman == @elder_man
after: Yes. Deeply. But if you'd like to start paying rent...
ru: Ричард, мне больно это признавать, но я у тебя в долгу.

quote: I may as well owe the American national debt, or a handful of magical beans.
before: Well, I think that he just wants to talk about it. I can't talk about 600 grand.
after: Look, it's a lovely party. There is a lot of love in the room.
ru: От меня с тем же успехом можно потребовать национальный долг Америки или пригорошню волшебных бобов.

quote: More than once he's paid his debts off to his bookies by working as an enforcer.
before: He never went pro. Drug problem. Turned to gambling. Unfortunately, he wasn't very good at it.
after: Breaking fingers? Crushing skulls with a baseball bat.
ru: Не слишком удачно. Он не раз выплачивал долги букмекерам натурой, так сказать.

quote: Debt is the tangible manifestation of not forgiving.
before: We have to let go of our past in order to be free. Letting go of the past happens through surrender, faith and forgiveness.
after: If you have debt, you've not completely forgiven your past, so it's our work to forgive ourselves and others so that we can live freely. Otherwise, our history will continue to repeat.
ru: Долги — это наглядное проявление неготовности прощать.

quote: Refinance the debt, then use the savings to create marine protected areas.
before: For example, if you refinance your house to take advantage of a better interest rate, maybe you use the savings to insulate your attic. That's what Blue Bonds for Conservation do for entire coastal countries.
after: Of course, sovereign debt restructuring is more complicated than that, but you get the basic idea. If investors put in 40 million dollars now, it can unlock as much as 1.6 billion for ocean conservation.
ru: Рефинансировать долг и использовать сбережения для создания охраняемых зон.

quote: Now, you can see Africa's total debt there and the U.K. budget deficit for reference.
before: So massive, in fact, that it can contain all the other military budgets in the world inside itself. Gobble, gobble, gobble, gobble, gobble.
after: So that might well chime with your view that America is a sort of warmongering military machine, out to overpower the world with its huge industrial-military complex. But is it true that America has the biggest military budget?
ru: А теперь посмотрите на долг Африки вот здесь и сравните его с дефицитом бюджета Великобритании и Северной Ирландии.

quote: The deal is expected to cover debts of Whole Foods Market.
before: Whole Foods Market started in 1978, and employs about 87000 people in its roughly 460 stores across the US, UK and Canada.

quote: That he takes inches off a waist, and a decade off a jawline.
before: Sit on the chaise. People say Mr Beaton does a bit afterwards.
after: Do you suppose that's true? I know it's true.
ru: Что он убирает дюймы с талии, и десятилетия с подбородка.

quote: You're chastising yourself for failing to make a futile gesture a decade ago.
before: "Wise"? Does that matter?
after: Anyway, your feelings are trivial 'cause we have a murderer to catch. The bite mark, timeless expression of the frustration of impotence.
ru: Конечно, важно. Ты коришь себя за то, что не совершила бесполезный поступок десятилетие назад.

quote: For decades, terrorists have been fighting us, getting knocked down, rebuilding, then coming back at us.
before: It's logical. It's brilliant.
after: But if a U.S. nuke hits a Russian city-- they're gonna sit back and watch us destroy each other. There's only one way to fix this.
ru: На протяжении десятилетий, террористы пытались уничтожить нас, но безрезультатно.

quote: Although it didn't change much throughout the whole decade.
before: Whatever you need, I'm here. And then these are from the early '70s, so he probably wouldn't have arrived here yet.
after: This is one of the bedrooms. He, um... He would have stayed in a room just like this.
ru: Хотя он не сильно изменится на протяжении всего десятилетия.

quote: He pushed his pain agenda for decades, before it finally took hold in the mid-'70s.
before: He recast the very purpose of medicine. The goal wasn't to make patients better; it was to make patients feel better.
after: Hundreds of pain clinics sprung up all over the world. But as they did — a tragic twist.
ru: Он продвигал программу боли десятилетиями, пока она не окрепла в середине 70-х годов.

quote: The decades ahead will see dramatic advances in disease prevention, general health, the quality of life.
before: Find out what they are. You'll find your own way to discover, to learn, to teach.
after: All of humanity depends on the knowledge and practice of the medicine and the science behind it you will master. You have chosen a calling that will come in steps to give you satisfaction, at its conclusion, of a life well lived.
ru: В ближайшие десятилетия мы значительно продвинемся в вопросах профилактики заболеваний, общего здоровья, уровня жизни.

quote: Worldwide incomes have grown at a faster rate in the past decade than ever in history.
before: And that's just the United States. The global news is even better.
after: If anything, all these numbers actually understate our progress, because the new machine age is more about knowledge creation than just physical production. It's mind not matter, brain not brawn, ideas not things.
ru: Доходы по всему миру росли быстрее за последнее десятилетие, чем когда-либо в истории.

quote: The cost of education has increased far faster than inflation over the past several decades.
before: Higher education has been protected from price competition for many decades. The more government subsidizes education, the higher the price charged for that education with the result that the students and their parents end up paying as much as before.
after: From what I've seen and read, most university professors are grossly underworked. They need to spend more time teaching; there needs to be more innovation in teaching to keep the cost down (like online education, but certainly not limited to that).

quote: It just seems like an iffy decision at best.
before: -No, I don't mean that. I just mean with my mom in the other room dying.
after: -Honestly, I think she wanted this to happen. -Oh man.
ru: Мне просто кажется, что это не лучшее решение.

quote: Captain, I believe you have made the right decision.
before: All right. Let's go get this son of a bitch. Kirk out.
after: If I can be of assistance, I would be happy to accompany you on the away team. You?
ru: Капитан, я полагаю, вы приняли верное решение.

quote: Yeah, let's waste time discussing a decision I've already taken.
before: Man-bag and disruptor. Still reckon you'd be better off with the robot.
after: Tatty- bye. Boss on the move.
ru: Да, давай подискутируем на тему решения, которое я уже принял.

quote: You have a problem with my decision, you can take it up with him.
before: Number 10 Downing Street, London, SW1.
after: Mr. Menzies! Mr. Menzies!
ru: У вас есть проблемы с моим решением, Вы можете взять его с собой.

quote: I thought, maybe there's some earthly basis for moral decisions.
before: As an altar boy, I breathed in a lot of incense, and I learned to say phrases in Latin, but I also had time to think about whether my mother's top-down morality applied to everybody. I saw that people who were religious and non-religious were equally obsessed with morality.
after: But I wanted to go further than to say our brains make us moral. I want to know if there's a chemistry of morality.
ru: Я подумал, что может есть какая-то мирская основа для нравственных решений.

quote: I made a lot of mistakes and dumb decisions, of course.
before: (Laughter) And then I went home that night, and I had an even larger emotional meltdown, which I'll say more about in a minute. And this was all actually quite shocking to me, because prior to this moment, I had prided myself on having absolutely no regrets.
after: I do that hourly. But I had always felt like, look, you know, I made the best choice I could make given who I was then, given the information I had on hand.
ru: Я сделала много ошибок и приняла много глупых решений, конечно же.

quote: Now these decisions vary in the number of choices that they offer per decision.
before: Here's a German car manufacturer that gives you the opportunity to completely custom make your car. You've got to make 60 different decisions, completely make up your car.
after: Car colors, exterior car colors — I've got 56 choices. Engines, gearshift — four choices.
ru: Каждое из этих решений имеет разное количество вариантов выбора.

quote: Judge Duch Kimsan said he will announce his decision in the near future.
before: The trial took place behind closed doors and lasted a day. Lines was tried on charges of procuring an underage child for sex.

quote: Hey, Karsten's connections run deep, and none of the individual charges is a home run.
before: Seriously? I gave you assault, tax fraud, bribery...
after: 5 to 10 will be a win. 18 years' worth of testimony, and all you can pin him on is 5 to 10?
ru: Эй, связи Карстена имеют глубокие корни, и никакие личные обвинения не гарантируют полный успех.

quote: And I spoke to the bands that used to record at deep rock sound.
before: Where do we stand with our mysterious song? Well, we're not much closer than when we started, but we do have a partial name and former employment.
after: They remembered him and thought he was a great guy, but nobody knows what happened to him. And the cowbell guy said...
ru: Я говорил с группами, что записывают глубокий рок.

quote: Deep gash at the base of the skull. Two broken teeth. May I?
before: There you go. Get me the caretaker now.
after: "On absence without longing "On naked solitude On the steps of death
ru: Глубокая рана под волосами в затылочной части, 2 зуба сломаны.

quote: Gonna pick you up, and I want you to take a big, deep breath, okay?
before: Okay. Sorry.
after: - Biggest breath you can. - All right. And then hold it.
ru: Я возьму тебя и хочу, чтобы ты сделала глубокий вдох, хорошо?

quote: So let's think big and let's think deep.
before: And instead of getting taken to the natural history museum or an aquarium, you get taken out to the ocean, to an underwater Noah's Ark, which you can access through a dry-glass viewing tunnel, where you can see all the wildlife of the land be colonized by the wildlife of the ocean. Clearly, it would blow your mind.
after: Who knows where our imagination and willpower can lead us? I hope that by bringing our art into the ocean, that not only do we take advantage of amazing creativity and visual impact of the setting, but that we are also giving something back, and by encouraging new environments to thrive, and in some way opening up a new — or maybe it's a really old way of seeing the seas: as delicate, precious places, worthy of our protection.
ru: Так будем же думать масштабно и глубоко.

quote: In thinking about biofluorescence, I wanted to know, how deep does it go?
before: And here in the Solomon Islands, there's only a few thousand breeding females of this species left, and this is one of the hotspots for them. So it shows us how much we need to really protect these animals while they're still here, and understand them.
after: Does this go all the way to the bottom of the ocean? So we started using submarines, and we equipped them with special blue lights on the front here.
ru: Размышляя о биофлуоресценции, я хотел знать, как глубоко она проникает?

quote: And I've been fueled by a deep scientific curiosity, and a passion to change these statistics.
before: And this is exactly what I've been doing. For the past three years, I've been developing technologies that could ultimately aid clinicians with rapid, early-stage cancer diagnostics.
after: Last year however, this fight became much more personal when my wife was diagnosed with breast cancer. It was an experience that added a strong and unexpected emotional dimension to these efforts.
ru: Мною движет глубокая научная любознательность и страстное желание изменить эту статистику.

quote: People needed to walk in around one meter deep water or evacuate in trucks.
before: Some shops and the train services in the adjacent Chiang Mai city closed.
after: Authorities closed several major roads and contacted residents downstream advising to either evacuate or prepare to imminent floodings.

quote: You couldn't help but deeply connect with your partner.
before: My mom would send me to sleepaway camp, you know. The stakes were high, it was fun, but so intense.
after: That's how a lot of camp love affairs started. I guess you're right.
ru: Ты не сможешь не почувствовать глубокую связь со своим напарником.

quote: But, our friends in Florida will feel deeply disrespected.
before: In the next two weeks, or.. Not only will the Sheikh feel something.
after: So, will I. Rosalyn, you need to come with me, alright.
ru: Но наши друзья во Флориде будут чувствовать себя глубоко униженными.

quote: Breathe in and out, deeply from the abdomen.
before: Yeah, I got it. One, two, three.
after: You can do this, you can do this. We each brought an object that holds Lilly's energy.
ru: Сделайте вдох, и глубоко из брюшной полости.

quote: And I am sorry deeply if I let you think for a second that I don't.
before: Because deep down... and I think... I hope you know this... I am your guy. I have your back forever, always.
after: Bring me back, sir. Let me serve at the pleasure of the president, as it is my honor to do so.
ru: И я глубоко сожалею, если вы хоть на секунду в этом усомнились.

quote: And many of us here are deeply involved in that.
before: This is a unique, new organizational form that we've seen grown up. Enormous innovation, enormous energy, enormous talent now has been mobilized through this structure to try to deal with all of these challenges.
after: I'm a business school professor, but I've actually founded, I think, now, four nonprofits. Whenever I got interested and became aware of a societal problem, that was what I did, form a nonprofit.
ru: И многие из нас здесь глубоко задействованы в этом.

quote: We launched Ebola Deeply. We did our best.
before: We need to live up to our own ideals, and we need to recognize when what we're doing could potentially harm society, where we lose track of journalism as a public service. I watched us cover the Ebola crisis.
after: But what we saw was a public that was flooded with hysterical and sensational coverage, sometimes inaccurate, sometimes completely wrong. Public health experts tell me that that actually cost us in human lives, because by sparking more panic and by sometimes getting the facts wrong, we made it harder for people to resolve what was actually happening on the ground.
ru: Мы запустили сайт «Глубоко об Эболе».

quote: And in fact, this idea of generations has become deeply embedded in United States culture.
before: And these stereotypes about each generation have, in a lot of ways, created this self-fulfilling prophecy, that people begin to act as if they're part of that generation because we've said out loud that generation is real. I'm not so sure that it is.
after: When we talk generations, people know exactly what we're talking about. In fact, people have a lot of thoughts and feelings about each of these generations.
ru: На самом деле, эта идея поколений глубоко укоренилась в культуре Соединённых Штатов.

quote: The Prime Minister said he is "deeply saddened" by the news.
before: Cameron also called McLetchie "one of Scottish politics' most formidable intellects and finest debaters. All he did was carried out with dedication and conviction, and his passing leaves a gap in the lives of all who knew him."

quote: So I admit defeat, and then he reaches out to start a conversation.
before: He wants to turn me. He wants to make me his disciple.
after: Well, that's all supposition. - He's not gonna--
ru: Так что я признаю своё поражение, и тогда он связывается со мной, чтобы начать диалог.

quote: They'll chalk it up as a colossal defeat.
before: Mr. President, if we give in now, the public won't credit you with a victory. Not even a hollow one.
after: Well, that's on you, Frank. You let this situation devolve to where it is.
ru: Это будет записано как разгромное поражение.

quote: All right, fair enough. I admit defeat. You guys have the biggest icicles.
before: Yakutsk? Mm-hmm.
after: (plays "The Battle Hymn of the Republic" off-key) It's left over from my Presidents' Day party.
ru: Хорошо, достаточно справедливо. я признаю поражение у вас, ребята, есть огромные сосульки

quote: Eight crushing defeats all in a row. Seven.
before: The honour of the town. Weld have won against Stafford in a long time.
