after: We decided on the ones with the-- oops-- silver vase. And I don't know how else you describe them, but we like those, so... (LOUD THUD)
ru: Просто хотел уточнить о доставке цветов.

quote: Making a delivery one night, I got arrested.
before: Sometimes, Jay would put his probationers to work too. Unpaid minions.
after: Didn't snitch. Got sent back to juvie for the third time.
ru: Ж: Однажды ночью, меня арестовали, когда я доставляла товар.

quote: I don't know what I shall do about today's delivery.
before: It's unheard of to do upstairs work in the morning. I'm in a bit of a fix, Laura. Mrs Macey won't be able to take her letters out.
after: Perhaps, if you thought I could manage it, - might I have a try, ma'am?
ru: Я не знаю, что делать с сегодняшней доставкой.

quote: And in fact, you can just look at pizza delivery drivers.
before: That gives you an idea of where they have people. Sometimes, when people visit a data center, they'll take a cell-cam photo and post it, and they aren't supposed to, but you can learn things about their hardware that way.
after: Turns out, they know where all the Google data centers are, at least the ones that have people in them. But I came up with my estimate, which I felt pretty good about, that was about 10 exabytes of data across all of Google's operations, and then another maybe five exabytes or so of offline storage in tape drives, which it turns out Google is about the world's largest consumer of.
ru: А ещё можно просто поговорить с курьерами по доставке пиццы.

quote: I chose Sub-Saharan Africa because this is a huge delivery territory.
before: Let me show you how possible this is. This is a map of Sub-Saharan Africa, with a map of the United States for scale.
after: It's very challenging. But we analyzed every 50-mile by 50-mile block on the continent, and we found that half of farmers live in just these shaded regions.
ru: Я выбрал Южно-Африканский регион, так как это огромная территория доставки.

quote: They run the world's only automated delivery system operating at national scale.
before: Even more importantly, 100 percent of the teams we hire at these distribution centers are local. So here's our Rwandan team, which is a group of extraordinary engineers and operators.
after: They have been able to master something that the largest technology companies in the world have not yet been able to figure out. So they are total heroes.
ru: Они управляют единственной в мире автоматической системой доставки, работающей в масштабах целой страны.

quote: Bush went on to describe the methods used in the delivery of the aid.
after: "A U.S. C-17 aircraft with humanitarian supplies is on its way. And in the days ahead we will use U.S. aircraft, as well as naval forces, to deliver humanitarian and medical supplies."

quote: All your online reviews say how in demand you are.
before: Hey. Thanks for coming out so fast, man.
after: Yeah, it's a good thing you got me between jobs. Your main support beam is near-about busted all the way through.
ru: Все твои онлайн отзывы говорят о том, что на тебя большой спрос.

quote: With all your constant demands and trendy needs.
before: Okay. You're the one who pushed me into this, you know that?
after: I did not tell you to go on Jeff's computer and make a deal with an arms dealer! Well, you didn't tell me not to.
ru: Своими вечными требованиями и гонкой за модой!

quote: They have 10 days to meet our humble demands.
before: The Danish government refuses to cooperate. They do not care about this woman.
after: Each day we will demonstrate our dedication to a free Afghanistan by taking a finger from this woman. 10 days, 10 fingers!
ru: Мы даем им десять дней на выполнение наших требований.

quote: None of the witnesses recall any orders or demands from these robbers?
before: Why? - It's per a federal wiretap law, lest we overhear an account number not party to investigative...
after: No, they don't recall anything. It's kind of like they have short-term memory loss or something.
ru: Кто-нибудь из свидетелей может повторить приказы или требования этих грабителей?

quote: He expects to hire 30 more people in the next year, as his demand rapidly rises.
before: In Luo's first year back home, he was able to employ 15 villagers. And he sold about 60,000 units of fermented bean curd.
after: There are 60 million left-behind children scattered across China's rural landscape. And they grow up with at least one parent far away from home, as a migrant worker.
ru: Он планирует нанять ещё 30 людей в следующем году, так как спрос вырос.

quote: Well, modern agriculture simply cannot sustainably scale to meet that demand.
before: In addition, we will need many more resources and raw materials to make consumer goods and industrial goods. So how will we scale to meet that demand?
after: There are a number of reasons why. One of them is that modern agriculture is one of the largest emitters of greenhouse gases.
ru: Современное сельское хозяйство не способно расшириться, чтобы удовлетворить спрос.

quote: That reduced population means reduced demand for electricity, food, travel, buildings and all other resources.
before: Now, a solution that often does not get talked enough about, family planning. By providing men and women the right to choose when, how and if to raise a family through reproductive health clinics and education, access to contraception and freedom devoid of persecution can reduce the estimated global population by 2050.
after: All the energy and emissions that are used to produce that higher demand is reduced by providing the basic human right to choose when, how and if to raise a family. But family planning cannot happen without equal quality of education to girls currently being denied access.
ru: Сокращение населения означает снижение спроса на электричество, еду, путешествия, здания и все другие ресурсы.

quote: The demand for Japanese automobiles was hit particularly hard, plunging by 69%.
after: Demand for electronic goods also dropped substantially.

quote: Dad was demanding but it wasn't the Gulag!
before: Whereas Karine made me over. After 20 years of merciless criticism. Oh, come on!
after: Sure, you did everything right. Just like him. You had his unconditional approval.
ru: Папа был требовательным, но мы же не в ГУЛАГе росли.

quote: I think the challenges are getting even more demanding.
before: Thankyou. Goodluck,everybody.
after: And this is where your talent, your innovation and your creativity really have a chance to shine, and embrace the technology. Oh, my God, Jerell!
ru: Задания становятся всё более требовательными.

quote: We're finally recovering from the famine three years ago, yet the shogunate is so demanding.
before: This story takes place in 1735, within the Inaba-han, a tozama han.
after: And now this... So many headaches.
ru: Мы только начали восстанавливаться после великого голода, 3 года назад, Но правительство так требовательно.

quote: I'm glad you want to walk this demanding path.
before: No. Behind that lies the deep desire for innovation.
after: That's what we get. There are countless of unemployed male rabbis in Eastern Europe.
ru: Я рада, что вы решили идти этим трудным путем.

quote: I've been back every year since that first visit in 2011, and the fieldwork has been exhilarating, demanding and at times dangerous.
before: Then, to my tremendous relief — I was freaking out, to be honest with you — a smile began to snake across his face, and he just laughed. (Laughter) I had received the shaman's blessing to study the river, on the condition that after I take the water samples and analyze them in my lab, wherever I was in the world, that I pour the waters back into the ground so that, as the shaman said, the waters could find their way back home.
after: One story was even featured in National Geographic Magazine. I was trapped on a small rock about the size of a sheet of paper in sandals and board shorts, in between an 80 degree C river and a hot spring that, well, looked like this, close to boiling.
ru: Я возвращался каждый год, начиная с первого визита в 2011 году, работа в тех местах была опьяняющей, требовательной и иногда опасной.

quote: First of all: we have to become demanding consumers and citizens.
before: And we have to understand another thing too, which is: he who writes, has to write in order to be understood. How do we get there?
after: Think it this way: next time someone gives you a document that you just simply don't understand, don't be shy, don't keep quiet, pretending that you are understanding everything. No!
ru: В первую очередь мы должны стать требовательными клиентами и гражданами.

quote: Bolivia is still demanding maritime access, something Chile refuses to give.
before: The reason behind Bolivia's rejection of the Chilean candidate is the ongoing dispute between Chile and Bolivia that began with the War of the Pacific in 1879 and resulted in Bolivia losing it's maritime border (and thus maritime access) at Atacama.
after: Bolivia thus believes that Mr Insulza would be incapable of finding a solution to what Bolivia feels is it's legitimate demand for maritime access were he to become the OAS Secretary General. While Bolivia believes that the OAS is the right multilateral forum to address this issue Chile claims that it is an issue between Bolivia and Chile, and should not concern other nations, a viewpoint that Mr Insulza has himself expressed.

quote: With the department of justice, we'll be lucky if that's all that happens.
before: Yeah. You think we'll lose the case?
after: Come on, we were set up. They know that.
ru: Имея дело с министерством юстиции, отделаться только этим- большая удача.

quote: My work with the Department has compromised me.
before: I haven't had my tea. That's why I wanted to see you, Mr Crumb.
after: I've got very little humanity left to lose now. I want you to recruit me.
ru: Моя служба в отделе дискредитировала меня.

quote: She's working for an ME department down south.
before: There's something I have to do first. Lee Thompkins' number.
after: I promised Bruce Wayne I'd solve his parents' murder. I have to do that first.
ru: Она работает в медицинском отделении на юге.

quote: To this you can add residency at the Department of Infectious Diseases.
before: Nice to see you all. This is a six-week course with classes Monday, Wednesday and Friday.
after: We'll end with a written exam in August which you have to pass to be posted. It will primarily be on a river hospital on the Amazon in north Bolivia. That's us this fall.
ru: Вы можете пройти медицинскую практику в инфекционном отделении.

quote: Now we come to a powerful political institution, little-known to Westerners: the Party's Organization Department.
before: Compare that with the ruling elites in both developed and developing countries, I think you'll find the Party being near the top in upward mobility. The question then is, how could that be possible in a system run by one party?
after: The department functions like a giant human resource engine that would be the envy of even some of the most successful corporations. It operates a rotating pyramid made up of three components: civil service, state-owned enterprises, and social organizations like a university or a community program.
ru: Рассмотрим влиятельный политический институт, малознакомый Западу — Партийный Организационный Отдел.

quote: We can't have a department that runs after people and looks after people.
before: (Laughter) And so, the question we were asking was, how can we be taking care of people? People are the only thing we have.
after: So as we started finding that this worked, and we'd say, we're looking for — and this is, I think, the main thing I was looking for in the terminal days and in the company, which is, how do you set up for wisdom? We've come from an age of revolution, industrial revolution, an age of information, an age of knowledge, but we're not any closer to the age of wisdom.
ru: Нас не устраивает просто отдел, который занимается людьми, заботится о них.

quote: He should have fired his geology department, but he didn't.
before: He viewed talent differently. He wondered, who are their peers?
after: You know, some of the best submissions didn't come from geologists. They came from computer scientists, engineers.
ru: Ему следовало уволить свой геологический отдел, но он этого не сделал.

quote: In addition one Roberts' children was video-taped vandalizing and removing athletic department equipment from ORU property.
after: The items, which were beneficial to the Roberts family was not recovered and though Richard was confronted he took no action.

quote: People are worshiping them instead of God, growing dependent on them.
before: They're dangerous. Dangerous?
after: This is my opportunity to speak my mind from my pulpit. It's more than an opportunity.
ru: Люди поклоняются им вместо Бога, становятся зависимыми от них.

quote: Blinding the victims leaves them helpless, lost, totally dependent.
before: Or it could be about shame. Perhaps the unsub is disfigured himself.
after: It may be a manifestation of how he sees himself in this world. It is a form of enucleation, just without the scalpel.
ru: Ослепляя жертв, он оставляет их беззащитными, потерянными, полностью зависимыми.

quote: My daughter is a prostitute and we're dependent on her.
before: - It stinks here. ... do something with your life.
after: It's not nice. The dog's shitting - Udo!
ru: Моя дочь - проститутка. И мы от нее зависим.

quote: I didn't get divorced to become dependent on another man.
before: Why can't we live together? I want to make it on my own.
after: I'll stay with my mother until I get on my feet. What the hell is this?
ru: Я не развелась, чтобы не попадать в зависимость от другого мужчины.

quote: But we're still dependent on natural, raw materials.
before: Obviously there's fantastic opportunities with recycled materials, and we can and will go zero waste. And there's opportunities in a circular economy.
after: Let's take cotton. Cotton's brilliant.
ru: Но мы по-прежнему зависим от природного сырья.

quote: We are more dependent on it now than ever.
before: Shipping brings us 90 percent of world trade. Shipping has quadrupled in size since 1970.
after: And yet, for such an enormous industry — there are a 100,000 working vessels on the sea — it's become pretty much invisible. Now that sounds absurd in Singapore to say that, because here shipping is so present that you stuck a ship on top of a hotel.
ru: Мы больше зависим от него сейчас, чем раньше.

quote: We were totally dependent during those years on this amazing acronym, which is MAD.
before: And basically, we lived for all those years, and some might argue that we still do, in a situation of being on the brink, literally, of an apocalyptic, planetary calamity. It's incredible that we actually lived through all that.
after: It stands for mutually assured destruction. So it meant if you attacked us, we would attack you virtually simultaneously, and the end result would be a destruction of your country and mine.
ru: В течение тех лет мы были полностью зависимы от потрясающей аббревиатуры MAD [англ.

quote: Employment and educational opportunities are dependent on a system of male guardianship.
before: Women rights are strictly defined by Islamic Sharia law in Saudi Arabia.
after: For example, a female under the age of 45 must gain the approval of a male before traveling.

quote: Tell me. At what point did he realize the depth of your indifference towards him?
before: Peeta. He's a lovely boy.
after: I'm not indifferent. Don't lie!
ru: Скажите, когда он осознал всю глубину вашего безразличия?

quote: But the depth of the imprint tells a different story.
before: Well, maybe not. I made this from the boot prints that we found in the snow. It does show the same wear patterns as Micah Canet's boots.
after: Micah weighs approximately 175lbs. The person wearing these boots weighs at most 120.
ru: Глубина отпечатка говорит об обратном.

quote: Happens when divers ascend too quickly from a great depth.
before: Looks like he's got the bends too. It's Cutis marmorata.
after: So what happened first? The blunt force trauma or he came up too fast?
ru: Возникает, когда водолазы слишком быстро поднимаются с глубины.

quote: Her father will rest at the regular depth.
before: That way, the grave-robbers can't dig down to their meat before the sun comes up. My wife has no business with the grave-diggers.
after: Dear God. There walks a dead man.
ru: Её отец будет похоронен на обычной глубине.

quote: We see those at all depths and even at the greatest depths.
before: You can actually see through his head. And here he is, flapping with his ears and very gracefully going up.
after: They go from a couple of inches to a couple of feet. They come right up to the submarine — they'll put their eyes right up to the window and peek inside the sub.
ru: И всё это мы можем наблюдать на больших и очень больших глубинах.

quote: This is at about 60 feet or 18 meters, depth.
before: This is a Brain Coral living in Tobago that's around 2,000 years old. And I had to overcome my fear of deep water to find this one.
after: And you'll see, there's some damage to the surface of the coral. That was actually caused by a school of parrot fish that had started eating it, though luckily, they lost interest before killing it.
ru: Глубина здесь около 60 футов, или 18 метров.

quote: And the land, to depths of tens of meters, is also warming.
before: These floats reveal that the upper half of the ocean is gaining heat at a substantial rate. The deep ocean is also gaining heat at a smaller rate, and energy is going into the net melting of ice all around the planet.
after: The total energy imbalance now is about six-tenths of a watt per square meter. That may not sound like much, but when added up over the whole world, it's enormous.
ru: Суша также прогревается в глубину на десятки метров.

quote: It reached 4.3 grades, and had a depth of 32.4 kilometers.
before: Almost ten minutes before this earthquake, at 11:39:08 (14:39 UTC), another March 11 earthquake aftershock was felt between the O'Higgins and Bíobío regions.
after: The epicentre was located 16 kilometers at the southeast of Pichilemu. It lasted about 15 seconds.

quote: And in your experience, is a young, black male an unusual description for a rape suspect?
before: That was the description of the suspect we were looking for. I see.
after: There are all kinds of suspects. But isn't it true that in New York, black males between the ages of 14 and 35 constitute less than 5% of the general population, yet commit 50% of the rapes?
ru: А как вам подсказывает опыт, молодой черный мужчина - это необычное описание для подозреваемого в изнасиловании?

quote: I saw someone who matched the description of an Interpol notice you have up.
before: (Fusco) This is Detective Lionel Fusco with the NYPD down here at the Eighth Precinct. I was in the village running down a lead on some stolen property for a larceny case.
after: Chinese woman, late 20s, early 30s. You hunting down a thief or something?
ru: Я видел кое-кого, кто подходит по описание в извещении Интерпола, которое у вас.

quote: If the maintenance man wakes up, make sure you get a description of his attacker.
before: Petra, it's Dan. Eric's on his way over.
after: Are you okay? Yes, I'm fine.
ru: Если механик очнётся, постарайся получить описание нападавшего.

quote: That's a rather perfect description of most people's lives.
before: So... surgeon... sober companion... detective. I-I know it sounds meandering when I describe it, but I promise you it all felt very organic while it was actually happening.
after: I find your story inspiring, actually. Wow. I think my mother would say "flighty," but... thanks.
ru: Это довольно подходящее описание большинства жизней.

quote: This is called the EyeWriter, and you can see the description.
before: A lot of our friends thought we were absolutely stupid to do that and that we were going to come back and all the pictures on the wall would be removed and graf on the walls. But for over two weeks, we programmed, we went to the Venice boardwalk, my kids got involved, my dog got involved, and we created this.
after: This is a cheap pair of sunglasses that we bought at the Venice Beach boardwalk, some copper wire and some stuff from Home Depot and Radio Shack. We took a PS3 camera, hacked it open, mounted it to an LED light, and now there's a device that is free — you build this yourself, we publish the code for free, you download the software for free.
ru: Устройство называется EyeWriter, вы видите описание.

quote: Now, would any of those descriptions scream comic-book editor?
before: By my skin color? By my hair?
after: Maybe my t-shirt, actually; I think that might have given it away. But no, probably not.
ru: Будут ли эти описания кричать о том, что я редактор комиксов?

quote: Our members defy the binary description of how we so often describe our young.
before: What we could not have foreseen was the measurable improvements in behavior, confidence and academic achievement. Once-reluctant students now race to school, talk to their teachers, fight, not on the playground, but to choose next week's film — young people who have found self-definition, ambition and an appetite for education and social engagement from the stories they have witnessed.
after: They are neither feral nor myopically self-absorbed. They are, like other young people, negotiating a world with infinite choice, but little culture of how to find meaningful experience.
ru: Наш коллектив не придаёт значения двойному описанию, которым все обычно характеризуют молодых людей.

quote: Police are looking for the suspects based on some vague descriptions.
The woman in the desert, she was crying.
before: Maybe I haven't had as much practice as you. Take care, Rina.
after: She said her husband was held prisoner here. There's something not right about this place.
ru: Та женщина в пустыне - она плакала.

quote: Can anything survive the North African desert when the sun is at its fiercest?
before: In this immense, ever-shifting landscape, it's easy to see how a lost traveller could succumb to what's been called the Sahara's only endemic disease - madness.
after: It's approaching midday. A fringe-toed lizard is hungry.
ru: Может ли что-либо выжить в североафриканской пустыне, когда солнце палит в полную силу?

quote: Listen George, when I was 22 with two broken legs, I crossed the Afghan desert.
before: He gave me some morphine. Come on.
after: So compared to that, a kidney missing, it's nothing. Come on.
ru: Слушай, Джордж, в 22 года я пересёк афганскую пустыню, хотя у меня были сломаны ноги.

quote: Why wouldn't the Sonora desert make a perfectly good promised land?
before: They'll come, they'll settle, and I'll win the prize. I really don't understand your objections, professor Goldfarb.
after: Go away. We could call it Nuevo Jerusalem.
ru: Почему пустыня штата Сонора не может стать отличной плодородной землей?

quote: I mean, I've got a mouth as dry as the Kalahari Desert.
before: I'm yanking them in from the back. I'm doing double knots.
after: I've got a white-knuckle grip on the door. You know what I'm talking about?
ru: Кажется, мой рот пересох, как пустыня Калахари.

quote: They were literally turning pollution into abundance for a desert people.
before: So they're all shitting each other's ponds, quite literally. And what this project was doing was taking the effluent of these, and turning them into all of this food.
after: They had created an industrial ecosystem, of a sense. I was there because I was actually modeling the mangrove portion for a carbon credit program, under the U.N.
ru: Они буквально превратили отходы в богатство для людей пустыни.

quote: Some are already deserts; others are being seriously degraded by the sand.
before: Let me try and explain why. Dry areas cover more than one third of the Earth's land surfaces.
after: Just south of the Sahara we find the Sahel. The name means " edge of the desert. "
ru: Одна часть – уже пустыня, другая – значительно разъедается песком.

quote: Imagine coming back from a camping trip in the desert.
after: Then a few months later you notice in your photos from the trip that you camped inside a giant impact crater so big that no one documented it before. Could it happen?

quote: Hello? Thought we were supposed to be seeing our greatest desires, here.
before: You, do you see the truth? I see that I have been ripped off.
after: Not just... Unless... Unless...
ru: Я думал, тут должны показывать самые главные желания.

quote: Yet, I've indulged his desire to review the minutiae of their relationship.
before: If outside parties are removing them from his life, then he's not developing that capacity. He needs to cut her off, that's blatantly obvious.
after: You know, I know you hate this word, but you've already been nice. You heard him out.
ru: Тем не менее, я потакал его желанию пересмотреть мельчайшие детали их отношений.

quote: This version has no desire to see her children dead.
before: Where's the girl that I fell in love with, the girl that I found irresistible? I can't say that I recognize this version.
after: If you have a problem with that, we have a problem. Lily...
ru: Эта версия не имеет никакого желания видеть своих детей мертвыми

quote: "How much he would awaken this desire in me, a desire that had always been there."
before: Come on. - Okay.
after: Whoa! Whoa, Robert.
ru: "Он смог так сильно пробудить это желание во мне, желание, которое всегда во мне таилось."

quote: I'm here today because saving the oceans is more than an ecological desire.
before: You may be wondering why a marine biologist from Oceana would come here today to talk to you about world hunger.
after: It's more than a thing we're doing because we want to create jobs for fishermen or preserve fishermen's jobs. It's more than an economic pursuit.
ru: Сегодня я здесь потому, что спасение океанов есть больше, нежели экологическое желание.

quote: The other is the desire to do something exciting.
before: CA: Elon, it almost seems, listening to you and looking at the different things you've done, that you've got this unique double motivation on everything that I find so interesting. One is this desire to work for humanity's long-term good.
after: And often it feels like you feel like you need the one to drive the other. With Tesla, you want to have sustainable energy, so you made these super sexy, exciting cars to do it.
ru: Во-вторых, желание создавать что-то удивительное.

quote: It should resonate with deep needs and desires.
before: Without a restoration story that can tell us where we need to go, nothing is going to change, but with such a restoration story, almost everything can change. The story we need to tell is a story which will appeal to as wide a range of people as possible, crossing political fault lines.
after: It should be simple and intelligible, and it should be grounded in reality. Now, I admit that all of this sounds like a bit of a tall order.
ru: Она должна отвечать глубоким потребностям и желаниям.

quote: On Thursday, Silva expressed his desire to leave Hull City.
before: Sliva managed Hull City for the last eighteen Premier League games last season, winning six of them, but could not save the club from relegation. Watford finished 17th in the Premier League table, one place above the relegation zone.
after: Along with the Portuguese, other Hull City staff including Assistant Head Coach Joao Pedro Sousa, First Team Coach Goncalo Pedro and Goalkeeping Coach Hugo Oliveira left the club.

quote: Three days a week stuck behind a desk. No.
before: I shouldn't have done what I did, all right? It was a mistake. But all this modified assessment crap is just a waste of time.
after: I need to be back with the regiment. That's not going to happen, Sam, until I've cleared you.
ru: Три дня в неделю за письменным столом.

quote: Improperly secured desks, futon frames and even a refrigerator were found on provincial highways.
before: Students heading to college residences posed another problem.

quote: Look at any religion and you'll see disputes and arguments going all the way down.
before: They're messy. They're impure.
after: Any criticism of religion in any form has to therefore be part of the expansive sense of humanity we should aspire to. I respect your right to have and to express your religion or your culture or your opinion, but I don't necessarily have to respect the content.

before: Ooh! Didn't have to.

ru: Джордж сказал: "Мы не будем на расстоянии вечно"

quote: Radiant intensity is the inverse square of distance.
before: Four seconds longer, and it would have become self-sustaining. So now let's assume fast criticality sustained for two to three minutes.
after: Factoring in the lack of concrete walls that mitigate exposure... you and your staff would most likely be... well, dead. I say "most likely" because, Colonel, we don't actually know, but we could.
ru: Интенсивность излучения падает как квадрат расстояния.

quote: I'd keep my distance if I were you.

ru: Советую держаться на расстоянии.

quote: But it pleases me to admire him from a distance.

after: To think of his infinite superiority to all the rest of the world. With gratitude, wonder and respect. Oh, Harriet, I am not surprised that his service to you was enough to melt your heart.
ru: Мне просто нравится восхищаться им на расстоянии.

quote: It was just the right distance from its star to contain huge oceans of liquid water.
before: Now, where do you find such Goldilocks conditions? Well, planets are great, and our early Earth was almost perfect.
after: And deep beneath those oceans, at cracks in the Earth's crust, you've got heat seeping up from inside the Earth, and you've got a great diversity of elements. So at those deep oceanic vents, fantastic chemistry began to happen, and atoms combined in all sorts of exotic combinations.
ru: Она была на нужном расстоянии от своей звезды, чтобы содержать огромные океаны.

quote: Third, the planet needs to be at the right distance from its star.
before: For example, our moon has no atmosphere, and so if you spill some water on the moon, it will either boil away as vapor, or freeze solid to make ice. Without the pressure of an atmosphere, liquid water can't survive.
after: Too close, and the surface temperature will exceed the boiling point of water, and oceans will turn to vapor. Too far, and the surface temperature will fall below the freezing point of water, causing the oceans to turn to ice.
ru: В-третьих, планета должна находиться на определённом расстоянии от звезды.

quote: Some astronomers focus their time and energy on finding planets at these distances from their stars.
before: So we look for planets that orbit at just the right distance from their stars. At this distance, shown in blue on this diagram for stars of different temperatures, planets could be warm enough for water to flow on their surfaces as lakes and oceans where life might reside.
after: What I do picks up where their job ends. I model the possible climates of exoplanets.
ru: Некоторые астрономы вкладывают своё время и энергию в поиск исключительно таких планет на этих расстояниях от их звёзд.

after: Unlike most of today's micronations, Molossia allows visitors and has its own economy. It also has its own time zone and holidays as well as a few tourist attractions.

ru: Однажды Джереми заметил изменения освещенности одной далекой звезды.

quote: I was first to wake up in the distant future.

ru: Я должна была проснуться в далёком будущем.

quote: I did a bit of stargazing in my dim and distant youth.

after: Shall we? Orion is Betelgeuse, Bellatrix, Saiph and Rigel at the bottom right.
ru: Я наблюдал за звездами в своей далекой юности.

quote: Let me end it with words from politicians who were similarly distant.
before: And then we're off to the races, because I don't believe for a second that we have forgotten how to solve tough challenges or that we have become too apathetic or hard-hearted to even try. I started my talk with quotes from wordsmiths who were separated by an ocean and a century.
after: Winston Churchill came to my home of MIT in 1949, and he said, " If we are to bring the broad masses of the people in every land to the table of abundance, it can only be by the tireless improvement of all of our means of technical production. " Abraham Lincoln realized there was one other ingredient.
ru: Позвольте мне закончить словами политиков, которые также были далеко.

quote: Additionally, these sort of Edenic places are often distant from where people live.
before: Because children don't want to hike through a beautiful landscape for five hours and then look at a beautiful view. That's maybe what we want to do as adults, but what kids want to do is hunker down in one spot and just tinker with it, just work with it, just pick it up, build a house, build a fort, do something like that.
after: And they're expensive to get to. They're hard to visit.
ru: К тому же эти райские уголки часто находятся далеко от населённых пунктов.

quote: Pollution, global warming, these things -- the consequences are distant in time and space.
before: This is absolutely crucial, and virtuality is dazzling at delivering this. If you look at some of the most intractable problems in the world today that we've been hearing amazing things about, it's very, very hard for people to learn if they cannot link consequences to actions.
after: It's very hard to learn, to feel a lesson. But if you can model things for people, if you can give things to people that they can manipulate and play with and where the feedback comes, then they can learn a lesson, they can see, they can move on, they can understand.
ru: Последствия загрязнений, глобального потепления и многого другого очень далеки во времени.

quote: Alonso is on a distant 7th in the provisional standings.
before: In the Drivers's standings, Lewis Hamilton retains his lead losing two points to Felipe Massa and is five points ahead of him. Robert Kubica came much closer to Lewis, now only 12 points behind.
after: Earlier Alonso said that he "remained realistic as it will be difficult to race the Ferraris and McLarens, but we will give our maximum to score as many points as possible because the fight for fourth in the Championship remains very close." Ferrari is now seven points ahead of McLaren and fourteen over BMW Sauber in the Constructors' Championship.

quote: I notice a distinct lack of crazy people screaming.

ru: Я нашла особый недостаток кричащих людей.

quote: And acromegaly has a very distinct set of side effects associated with it, principally having to do with vision.
before: There's even speculation that Abraham Lincoln had acromegaly. Anyone who's unusually tall, that's the first explanation we come up with.
after: The pituitary tumor, as it grows, often starts to compress the visual nerves in your brain, with the result that people with acromegaly have either double vision or they are profoundly nearsighted. So when people have started to speculate about what might have been wrong with Goliath, they've said, " Wait a minute, he looks and sounds an awful lot like someone who has acromegaly. "
ru: И у акромегалии очень отчётливый набор побочных эффектов, сопряжённых с ней, главным образом связанных со зрением.

quote: When you see a color, each cone sends its own distinct signal to your brain.
before: The cones, however, are a different story. There three kinds of cone cells that roughly correspond to the colors red, green, and blue.
after: For example, suppose that yellow light, that is real yellow light, with a yellow frequency, is shining on your eye. You don't have a cone specifically for detecting yellow, but yellow is kind of close to green and also kind of close to red, so both the red and green cones get activated, and each sends a signal to your brain saying so.
ru: Когда вы видите какой-то цвет, каждая колбочка отправляет в мозг свой особый сигнал.

quote: I have had the distinct pleasure of living inside two biospheres.

after: In a now famous experiment, she asked H.M. to trace a third star in the narrow space between the outlines of two concentric ones while he could only see his paper and pencil through a mirror. Like anyone else performing such an awkward task for the first time, he did horribly.
ru: Но это было не единственное отличие, которое обнаружила Милнер.

ru: Во многих языках местоимение второго лица отражает данные различия через формы обращения на «ты» и «вы».

ru: Давайте помнить часто забываемые интернет-пользователями отличия между критикой и оскорблениями.

ru: Вам должно быть назначено время встречи с окружным прокурором.

after: But now in direct opposition to its own patent office, the US government files a brief that states that is has reconsidered this issue in light of the district court's opinion, and has concluded that isolated DNA is not patent eligible. This was a really big deal, totally unexpected.
ru: Так, правительство представило в районный суд документ в защиту Myriad.

after: But he watched physicists and chemists become the purveyors of weapons of mass destruction in the early 20th century. He once said that science in his generation had become like a razor blade in the hands of a three-year-old.
ru: Эйнштейн глубоко верил что наука должна превосходить национальные и этнические разделения.

quote: In an ant colony, there are dramatic divisions of labor.
before: Certain groups have taken genetic sex determination in completely other directions. Ants, for example, have one of the most interesting systems for determining sex, and because of it, if you are a male ant, you do not have a father.
after: There are soldiers that defend the colony, there are workers that collect food, clean the nest and care for the young, and there's a queen and a small group of male reproductives. Now, the queen will mate and then store sperm from the males.
ru: В муравьиной колонии строжайшее разделение труда.

quote: And so both sides raise each other's standards of living through the sexual division of labor.
before: And the man knows that he doesn't have to do any digging to get roots. All he has to do is make sure that when he kills a warthog it's big enough to share some.
after: When did this happen? We don't know, but it's possible that Neanderthals didn't do this.
ru: Таким образом, обе стороны повышают уровень жизни друг друга за счёт полового разделения труда.

After a stalemate in the overtime period, Patrik Elias (the only shooter to score) would win the game for Devils in a hard fought game.

ru: Как символ, не нашего неудачного брака, а нашего замечательного развода.

ru: Чарльз, 50% браков заканчмваются разводом.

quote: Family violence, domestic violence, and divorce have torn apart families.
before: I came from a southern Ohio steel town, and it's a town that's really struggling in a lot of ways, ways that are indicative of the broader struggles of America's working class. Heroin has moved in, killing a lot of people, people I know.
after: And there's a very unique sense of pessimism that's moved in. Think about rising mortality rates in these communities and recognize that for a lot of these folks, the problems that they're seeing are actually causing rising death rates in their own communities, so there's a very real sense of struggle.
ru: Жестокость, бытовое насилие и разводы разбивают семьи.

quote: They're terrified of the social, legal, emotional, economic consequences of divorce.
before: And I stumbled, then, on a statistic that really came home to me. It was a very interesting academic article in which I found that 67 percent of singles in America today who are living long-term with somebody, have not yet married because they are terrified of divorce.
after: So I came to realize that I don't think this is recklessness; I think it's caution. Today's singles want to know every single thing about a partner before they wed.

quote: It took me four drafts to get it right.

before: Nature provides a first draft, which experience then revises. ' Built-in' doesn't mean unmalleable; it means organized in advance of experience. "

We found five best matches, which we call the five foundations of morality.
ru: Отлично, так что насчёт черновика нравственности?

quote: And they don't even have to do anything spectacular or dramatic.

after: But usually, they do do something spectacular or dramatic — (Laughter) to break your heart. And then they live with you as spies and saboteurs for years, watching your every psychological move, and spotting your every weakness.
ru: И ведь им для этого не нужно делать ничего особенно впечатляющего.

quote: And my antibody regulates my proteins for that dramatic change.
before: We were able to track them, and we could really see — for example, my immune system, just to give you a little hint there. My immune system changed dramatically over 24 hours there.

ru: Мои антитела отрегулирвали мои белки при такой резкой перемене.

quote: This tends to be a really dramatic effect on the ground.
before: We tend to think, when we think of places being lit up, of very extreme examples — Times Square, the Vegas Strip. But really what that picture shows you is that it's not just these extreme examples, it's anywhere that uses outdoor lighting.

ru: Они оказались настолько опасными, что их медицинское применение было резко уменьшено.

quote: We don't have to get strokes and we can dramatically reduce the risk of cancer.

quote: There's an opportunity to scale this up, dramatically.

after: And fast. TNC has identified 20 more nations where such a plan should be possible.

quote: But the population has changed dramatically since I was first here.

ru: Но размеры популяции пингвинов изменились, и значительно, с тех пор как я впервые здесь побывала.

ru: У него был величественный подбородок и мечта.

quote: I never told you because I thought it was a dream.

ru: Я никогда не говорила тебе, так как думала, что это был сон.

before: He had a huge ambition. But it wasn't simply for office or power or celebrity or fame — what it was for was to accomplish something worthy enough in life so that he could make the world a little better place for his having lived in it.
after: He somehow had to escape that hard-scrabble farm from which he was born. No schooling was possible for him, except a few weeks here, a few weeks there.
ru: Ещё в детстве у Линкольна были большие мечты.

quote: In my dreams I fantasize of wreaking vengeance on you guys.
before: It's not enough your software crashed my Mac, and it constantly hangs and bombs — it erased my ROMs! Now the Mac makes the sounds of silence.
after: Say your motorcycle crashes. Blood comes gushing from your gashes.
ru: Я закрываю глаза и мечтаю о страшной и сладкой мести.

Now, that's been the promise of the self-driving car, the autonomous vehicle, and it's been the dream since at least 1939, when General Motors showcased this idea at their Futurama booth at the World's Fair.
after: Now, two weeks ago, that dream took a step forward, when the state of Nevada granted Google's self-driving car the very first license for an autonomous vehicle, clearly establishing that it's legal for them to test it on the roads in Nevada. Now, California's considering similar legislation, and this would make sure that the autonomous car is not one of those things that has to stay in Vegas.
ru: И эта мечта почему-то всегда оказывалась где-то на 20 лет впереди.

after: And he looked at me and he said, " You mean like when they drill into people's brains? " And I said, " Excuse me? "
ru: Тот момент, когда дрель только-только просверливает стену насквозь и сверло проваливается в неё.

before: And my question to everybody else is, is this what we want: to let them get away with it, and to sit back and play with our phones, as this darkness falls? The history of the South Wales Valleys is of a fight for rights.

quote: Now, I do not blame the Hallowiches for accepting a take-it-or-leave-it settlement and starting their lives elsewhere.
before: And it turned out the Hallowiches had made a secret settlement with the gas operators, and it was a take-it-or-leave-it settlement. The gas company said, you can have a six-figure sum to move elsewhere and start your lives again, but in return you must promise not to speak of your experience with our company, not to speak of your experience with fracking, not to speak about the health consequences that might have been revealed by a medical examination.
after: And one can understand why the company would wish to silence a squeaky wheel. What I want to point the finger at is the legal and regulatory system, a system in which there are networks of agreements just like this one which serve to silence people and seal off data points from public health experts and epidemiologists, a system in which regulators will even refrain from issuing a violation notice in the event of pollution if the landowner and the gas company agree to settle.
ru: И я не виню семью Хэллоуич за принятие бескомпромиссного решения и переезд в другое место.

quote: Or will some of the metallic objects launched from the Earth spawn new oases, a post-human life elsewhere?
before: Will some spasm foreclose Earth's future? Or will the biosphere stabilize?
after: The science done by the young Einstein will continue as long as our civilization, but for civilization to survive, we'll need the wisdom of the old Einstein — humane, global and farseeing. And whatever happens in this uniquely crucial century will resonate into the remote future and perhaps far beyond the Earth, far beyond the Earth as depicted here.
ru: Или же некоторые объекты, запущенные с Земли, откроют для нас новые неизведанные островки, пост-человеческую жизнь в других местах?

quote: How is it that we can actually take this type of activity elsewhere?
before: We have the technology that's shown us where it is. What we need to think about perhaps for Mission Blue is increasing the biologging capacity.
after: And then finally — to basically get the message home — maybe use live links from animals such as blue whales and white sharks. Make killer apps, if you will.
ru: Каким же образом мы можем сделать подобную работу в других местах?

quote: About two dozen donor countries from Europe and elsewhere have been asked to help.
after: The money will go to support 63 U.N. and non-governmental organizations who intend to deliver food aid, protection, shelter, water and sanitation and disease outbreak prevention. The largest amount of the appeal - ten million dollars - is intended to be allocated to food aid.

quote: I am embarrassed to admit that I agreed with him, which did make him laugh.
before: It is my one weakness. He predicted I would be the first postmistress in five counties.
after: And this, Sydney... this is my mother. Oh, Thomas, she looks so tired sitting there.
ru: Мне неловко признать, но я тогда с ним согласилась, и этим его рассмешила.

quote: I know you're embarrassed, and I know that you're hurt, okay, and that's totally normal.
before: I know you don't want to talk about it. Well, can you just please listen?
after: But I just want to tell you that I... I am so incredibly proud of you.
ru: Я знаю, что тебе неловко, и я знаю, что тебе больно, и это совершенно объяснимо.

quote: But my point is that you have absolutely no reason to be embarrassed.
before: Doesn't that violate the health code? No, at the sub shop we were only making out.
after: Really? Do you think I overreacted?
ru: Но я считаю, что у тебя нету абсолютно никаких оснований быть смущенной.

quote: I am truly sorry if I've embarrassed you.
before: I believe there is a connection between your family and mine. I even think it possible that the House of Clennam might be responsible for the misfortunes that have befallen your family, and I should like to do something to help, if I can.
after: Will you accept my apology? I was sorry to hear you were locked in last night, Mr Clennam.
ru: Мне действительно жаль, если я поставил вас в неловкое положение.

quote: I said, "No way, ma, you have embarrassed me my entire life."
before: Well, I stood up to her. This is — you know, you'd think by now I'm — and still holding?
after: Of course, her comeback is, " When have I embarrassed you? " (Spanish) And she's still talking while she puts the car in park, hits the emergency brake, opens the door, and with a spryness astounding in a woman her age, she jumps out of the car, knocks out the phone books, and then she walks around — she's carrying her cheap Kmart purse with her — around the front of the car.
ru: Я говорю: «Ни за что, мам! Всю жизнь ты ставишь меня в неловкое положение!»

quote: Later I also felt a little embarrassed, and he too felt bad.
before: (Laughter) Though to be honest, I regret leaving such a super hit film over its title. So I left the film.
after: So we decided to let bygones be bygones and work on some other film. Hence, the film " Kal Ho Naa Ho. "
ru: Потом мне стало немного стыдно, и ему тоже было неловко.

quote: If you have any videos of yourself, three or four years ago, you probably feel embarrassed because you don't recognize yourself.
before: And this, I think, is very, very significant, particularly at this stage of life you're at. You'll be aware of the fact how much of you changed over recent years.
after: So I want to get that message over, that what we need to do is think about ourselves as things that we can shape, and channel and change. This is the Buddha, again: " Well-makers lead the water, fletchers bend the arrow, carpenters bend a log of wood, wise people fashion themselves. "
ru: Если у вас есть видео с вашим участием, сделанные 3-4 года назад, возможно, вам неловко их пересматривать — вы себя просто не узнаёте.

quote: I am embarrassed and I am pissed off.
before: "Bush is really the evil one here and it is more than just him. We are the Nazis in this game and I don't like it.
after: I mean to say something. I think a lot of people in this country agree with me...we'll see what happens to me if I get my head cut off next week -- it is always unknown or bushy-haired strangers who commit suicide right afterwards with no witnesses," the writer said.

quote: I mean, what if you need something in the middle of the night, or what if there's an emergency?
before: But I don't want you to move in with me. What if something goes wrong?
after: Fine. Look at us.
ru: То есть, что если тебе что-нибудь понадобиться в середине ночи, или случиться какая-нибудь чрезвычайная ситуация?

quote: He was brought on duty here at an emergency.
before: Captain Adrian's been promoted. Since last night?
after: What's this about? You should know I've been ordered to place you under arrest.
ru: Он временно исполнял обязанности на время чрезвычайной ситуации.

quote: Well, I guess we have different definitions of "emergency," then.
before: The more I talk to people, the less I imagine plummeting to my death in a fiery spiral of screaming and crying. Pretty dark for someone who just said "jinkies."
after: You know, I'm just gonna say it-- 911 dispatchers have a little bit of attitude. Well, you requested a S.W.A.T. Team.
ru: Ну, я полагаю, что тогда у нас разное понятие "чрезвычайной ситуации".

quote: The town charter says that in an emergency, I run the show.
before: I'm calling the shots. I think that sash is cutting off the air to your brain.
after: Well, we'll just see about that. Let's go to town hall.
ru: устав города говорит что в чрезвычайных ситуациях все руководство - на мне.

quote: They agree that a drastic emergency is upon us, that it is human-caused.
before: And so she really struck a chord in me. And then, learning that just about 100 percent of climate scientists agree.
after: But they said we can do something about it. We have the time, the technology, the tools.
ru: Они согласны с тем, что мы стоим перед лицом чрезвычайной ситуации, которая вызвана людьми.

quote: She designed Priority Displays that would interrupt astronaut’s regularly scheduled tasks to warn them of emergencies.
before: Her team assigned every task a unique priority to ensure that each job occurred in the correct order and at the right time — regardless of any surprises. After this breakthrough, Margaret realized her software could help the astronauts work in an asynchronous environment as well.
after: The astronaut could then communicate with Mission Control to determine the best path forward. This marked the first time flight software communicated directly — and asynchronously — with a pilot.
ru: Она разработала так называемые приоритетные индикации для прерывания запланированных космонавтами задач, чтобы предупреждать их о чрезвычайных ситуациях.

quote: This may be enough under normal circumstances, but during emergencies, this limited cache is stretched thin.
before: And events like the COVID-19 pandemic have shown that they’ re even more essential than we thought. Because current models are bulky, expensive, and require extensive training to operate, most hospitals only have a few in supply.
after: The world urgently needs more low-cost and portable ventilators, as well as a faster means of producing and distributing this life-saving technology.
ru: В обычных обстоятельствах этого бывает достаточно, но в чрезвычайных ситуациях скудного запаса ИВЛ хватит не всем.

quote: Allen will replace the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) director Michael D.
before: The U.S. Secretary of Homeland Security, Michael Chertoff, announced from Baton Rouge, Louisiana on Friday that Coast Guard Vice Admiral Thad W.
after: Brown as the Principal Federal Official (PFO) for the recovery effort; however, Mr. Brown will continue as the Director of FEMA.

quote: I was already maxed out on that emotion.
before: Don't worry about it. I couldn't worry.
after: What does that look like to you? Boobs.
ru: Я уже была измотана этим чувством.

quote: Sometimes people can be very shy about their emotions.
before: Did she reciprocate your feelings? She didn't seem to.
after: Well, in case she didn't get it the first time I told her again that I was in love with her and I wanted to marry her. Thinking it might swing things. Did it? Yeah.
ru: Порой люди стесняются проявлять свои чувства.

quote: There are no two stronger human emotions than fear and love.
before: Will you please just go? I really... I can't look at you.
after: In many ways, they're not so different. Both can make you do crazy things... tell your own brother you're in love with him, put your own life at risk to hunt down the man who took away your beloved...
ru: Не бывает чувств сильнее, чем страх и любовь.

quote: I think I'm in touch with that emotion.
before: You OK there, tiger? Did you ever have one of those days where you feel like a tired, old whore whose uterus is about to fall out?
after: Really? I was just being dramatic.
ru: Думаю, это чувство, мне знакомо.

quote: Here's what it feels like for me: I am instantly an internal storm of contrasting emotions.
before: Not even that. Have you ever been called something you are not?
after: I break out into a sweat that is a combination of rage and humiliation, I feel like the entire store is staring at me, and I simultaneously feel invisible. I want to explode in a tirade of fury, and I want to crawl under a rock.
ru: В этот момент я чувствую себя так: во мне бушует море самых разных противоречивых эмоций.

quote: Nonetheless, they may eventually be able to accurately read our emotions and respond to them.
before: And what becomes of our rights if authorities think they can identify the people likely to commit crimes before they even make a conscious decision to act? Robots currently have a long way to go in distinguishing emotional nuances, like irony, and scales of emotions, just how happy or sad someone is.
after: Whether they can empathize with our fear of unwanted intrusion, however, that's another story.
ru: Тем не менее рано или поздно они научатся точно идентифицировать наши чувства и реагировать на них.

quote: There's an intensity of affection and emotion, a rush.
before: Abusive relationships don't start out abusive. They start out exciting and exhilarating.
after: It feels really good. You feel so lucky, like you've hit the jackpot.
ru: Сила притяжения и чувств велика, почти кайф.

quote: Prince Charles stirred emotions by reading extracts from a serviceman's diary.
after: The diary entry, by Company Quartermaster Sergeant Benjamin Leane, was addressed to his wife and was written hours before the first Gallipoli landing.

quote: And she was always pretty, shall we say, emotional.
before: I used to come here with my first wife, back when Molly's folks were running the place. Long before you came on the scene.
after: She got away with it cos she was a looker. Let's face it, she'd have to be nuts to go for a guy like you.
ru: И она всегда была довольно, так сказать, эмоциональной.

quote: We all have physical, emotional needs that can only be met by interaction with another person.
before: I nearly made the same mistake as you last night. You did?
after: Trick is to ask someone appropriate to meet them. Why can't you marry your daddy?
ru: - У всех нас есть физические и эмоциональные потребности, которые можно удовлетворить только с помощью другого человека.

quote: It's designed to identify emotional and psychological stability.
before: There's a test later today. It's an important part of the evaluation process.
after: I'll do my best. I'd rather not leave it to chance.
ru: Он определит вашу эмоциональную и психологическую устойчивость.

quote: Are you able to have sex with men are to develop an emotional attachment?
before: You can? Excuse me?
after: Sheldon, I really do not want talk to you about this. Is conversation makes you uncomfortable?
ru: Ты можешь заниматься сексом с людьми, не развивая эмоциональную привязанность к ним?

quote: I want to talk about emotions and the need to boost our emotional intelligence.
before: We feel attached to the people, the culture, the land, the food. And yet at the same time, we feel increasingly frustrated by its politics and politicians, sometimes to the point of despair or hurt or anger.
after: I think it's a pity that mainstream political theory pays very little attention to emotions. Oftentimes, analysts and experts are so busy with data and metrics that they seem to forget those things in life that are difficult to measure and perhaps impossible to cluster under statistical models.
ru: Я хочу поговорить об эмоциях и необходимости эмоционального развития.

quote: Kismet has an underlying, three-dimensional emotional space, a vector space, of where it is emotionally.
before: (Laughter) But it's still going to pay attention if something more significant comes into its field of view — such as Cynthia Breazeal, the builder of this robot, from the right. It sees her, pays attention to her.
after: And at different places in that space, it expresses — can we have the volume on here? Can you hear that now, out there?
ru: У Кисмет имеется основное, трёхмерное эмоциональное пространство, векторное пространство эмоциональности.

quote: So his perception of your emotional states is very important for machines to effectively become empathetic.
before: Oh, it's so sad. Okay, so you smile, frowning.
after: Machines are becoming devastatingly capable of things like killing. Right?
ru: И его восприятие вашего эмоционального состояния очень важно для того, чтобы машины действительно стали сопереживающими.

quote: "Is there no one else?" asked an emotional Reyes.
after: "Is there anyone else signing this for truth?"

quote: I'd say my coaching style is centered around fundamentals, with an emphasis on fun.
before: Aaaa, bam! Boom!
after: Hey, watch this. Go get it!
ru: Я бы сказал, что мой метод тренировки сосредоточен вокруг основ, но акцент сделан на веселье.

quote: I'm a criminal profiler, with an emphasis on acts of historical imitation.
before: But I was only half the team. What did you say you did again?
after: Let's be in touch. Ichabod, please hurry.
ru: Я составляю портреты приступников с акцентом на историческую имитацию.

quote: The brain is a bioelectrical device, emphasis on "electrical."
before: - Is that so, Dr. I've-never-studied- neuroscience-unlike-Cameron?
after: Even after death, the wiring, the synapses... they're all still in there... For a while anyways.
ru: Мозг - это биоэлектрическое управление, Акцент на "электрическое".

quote: We varied our emphasis on her military record, her stellar pilot rating, nothing's changed the outcome.
before: I have some ideas that could balance her military edge. Worth a shot.
after: Mr. Foreman, have you reached a verdict? We have, Your Honor.
ru: Мы делали акцент и на ее военном прошлом, и на ее достижениях как пилота. В итоге ничего не изменилось.

quote: We make suggestions to the author through the editor to improve the emphasis of a sentence or point out unintentional repetitions and supply compelling alternatives.
before: There is a related role called query proofreading, or page-OK'ing. Whereas copyediting is mechanical, query proofreading is interpretive.
after: Our purpose is to make the author look good. Note that we give our proofs not directly to the author, but to the editor.
ru: Через редакторов мы предлагаем авторам внести правки в текст, чтобы правильно расставить акценты в предложении, или указываем на неумышленные повторы, убеждаем рассмотреть варианты.

quote: That kind of tells you a little bit of an idea of the emphasis that my parents placed on education.
before: (Laughter) And, as you can imagine, if you can picture this: I was born in a very small village in Mexico, in, unfortunately, very poor surroundings, and my parents did not have a college education. But I was fortunate to be able to have one, and so were my four sisters.
after: My parents were fanatics about learning, and I'll come back to that a little bit later. But one of the things that exposed me early to learning, and a tremendous curiosity that was instilled in me as a child, was through a technology which is on the screen — is a Victrola.
ru: Это поможет вам лучше понять, почему мои родители уделяли особое внимание образованию.

quote: Our emphasis on solutions is quite intentional.
before: Alex Steffen and I founded Worldchanging in late 2003, and since then we and our growing global team of contributors have documented the ever-expanding variety of solutions that are out there, right now and on the near horizon. In a little over two years, we've written up about 4,000 items — replicable models, technological tools, emerging ideas — all providing a path to a future that's more sustainable, more equitable and more desirable.
after: There are tons of places to go, online and off, if what you want to find is the latest bit of news about just how quickly our hell-bound handbasket is moving. We want to offer people an idea of what they can do about it.
ru: Акцент, который мы делаем именно на решениях, вовсе не случаен.

quote: He was pursuing a graduate degree in sociology, with an emphasis in peace and social justice.
before: NIU president John Peters released some details about the shooter during a press conference following the shooting. Kazmierczak had been a student at NIU but transferred to the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign for the current academic year.
after: Kazmierczak won a Dean's Award for a project in 2006, and was active in the student government while at NIU. Officials at a press conference also indicated that Kazmierczak was taking medication for an unspecified condition, and discontinued use of that medication approximately two weeks prior to the shooting.

quote: We ran backgrounds on the employees and owners of the four jewelry stores.
before: Maybe not. Looks like he did business with at least four jewelry stores near Rodeo Drive on a regular basis.
after: None seem to have any relevance... Except for one.
ru: Мы проверили всех работников и владельцев четырех ювелирных магазинов.

quote: And I won't force my employees to speak up against the police.
before: I guess we'll just see what a jury has to say. The Callaghan wedding was attended by a-an ocean of cops.
after: Well, in that case, I'd like all your hotel security footage from the wedding, and that includes inside the banquet hall and the parking area. We have never shared our security footage.
ru: И я не смогу заставить своих сотрудников пойти против полиции.

quote: I found a discrepancy in the employee access logs.
before: We're missing something. Max, you got a minute?
after: The server automatically stores backup files to a secondary disk, but last week's files were corrupted. Did you restore it?
ru: Я нашла несоответствие в журналах доступа сотрудников.

quote: Like to have an office full of employees like her.
before: We had a standing appointment. Three years she never stood me up once.
after: I'm sure you would. I'd like you to write down what she looks like.
ru: Хотел бы я иметь полный офис таких сотрудников как она.

quote: My partner and I, Thom, we had to let all our employees go.
before: So they took their money and their projects to others who would serve them better. Well, it didn't take long for business to drop like a rock.
after: It was down to just the two of us, and we were about to go under. And that was great.
ru: Мой партнёр Томас и я распустили всех работников.

quote: By this point, I was definitely not going to be an employee.
before: I would collect for the papers — he could just deliver them. Because then I realized I could make money.
after: (Laughter) My dad owned an automotive and industrial repair shop. He had all these old automotive parts lying around.
ru: В этот момент я точно не собирался быть наемным работником.

quote: You offer 50 funds -- 10 percent fewer employees participate than if you only offer five.
before: A colleague of mine got access to investment records from Vanguard, the gigantic mutual fund company, of about a million employees and about 2,000 different workplaces. What she found is that for every 10 mutual funds the employer offered, rate of participation went down two percent.
after: Why? Because with 50 funds to choose from, it's so damn hard to decide which fund to choose, that you'll just put it off till tomorrow, and then tomorrow and then tomorrow and tomorrow, and, of course, tomorrow never comes.
ru: Если вы предложите 50 фондов, то будут участвовать на 10% меньше работников, чем в случае, если вы предложите только пять.

quote: Casino inspectors, who are state employees, are no longer working.
before: All 12 casinos in Atlantic City locked their doors for the first time in the 28-year history of legalized gambling in New Jersey.
after: While the casino floor is shut down, many casinos have remained open for hotel, restaurant, and entertainment business.

quote: Put in a call to his current employer.
before: Taught high school history, coached football for a few years. Guess that didn't work out 'cause he started working construction after that.
after: Said Granger was fired last week. The reason why?
ru: Мы позвонили его текущему работодателю.

quote: Yes, the difficulty is the employer threatened to fire them, so we felt obligated.
before: - They're inspired by this case that isn't a case. We thought you were giving it up.
after: - You broke it, you own it? - Unfortunately.
ru: Да, трудность в том, что работодатель угрожал уволить их, и я почувствовала себя обязанной.

quote: But last night, this great Australian entrepreneur, employer of thousands, suffered a personal tragedy.
before: What's with that shit about his dad? As you know, usually at this time, we're privileged to have the company of the wonderful Tikki Wendon to discuss the world of business and finance with us.
after: Her offices were broken into, robbed and vandalised. I even read an unconfirmed report on the net that said Tikki herself was threatened at knifepoint.
ru: Но прошлым вечером эта выдающаяся австралийская предпринимательница, работодательница для тысяч людей, пережила личную трагедию.

quote: Well remember, Sofia, it only takes one employer to say yes.
before: - That's fantastic. - ...and got rejections from.
after: Well, one employer did say yes. - Yay!
ru: Помни, София, что какой-нибудь работодатель скажет тебе "да".

quote: Before this, most employers were not interested in engaging with relaunchers at all.
before: This testing out period removes the perceived risk that some managers attach to hiring relaunchers, and they are attracting excellent candidates who are turning into great hires. Think about how far we have come.
after: But now, not only are programs being developed specifically with relaunchers in mind, but you can't even apply for these programs unless you have a gap on your résumé. This is the mark of real change, of true institutional shift, because if we can solve this problem for relaunchers, we can solve it for other career transitioners too.
ru: Раньше большинство работодателей вовсе не были заинтересованы в задействовании второзаходников,

quote: Employers made prejudiced hiring decisions based on reductive decoding charts.
before: Researchers gave the test to Nazi war criminals, hoping to unlock the psychological roots of mass murder. Anthropologists showed the images to remote communities as a sort of universal personality test.
after: As the test left clinics and entered popular culture its reputation among medical professionals plummeted, and the blots began to fall out of clinical use. Today, the test is still controversial, and many people assume it has been disproven.
ru: Работодатели выносили предвзятые решения, основываясь на таблицах с интерпретацией.

quote: So as a result, my employer is going to be less productive.
before: Well, let's think about it this way. I can be the most skilled person in the world, but if everyone else at my firm lacks skills, my employer is going to find it more difficult to introduce new technology, new production techniques.
after: They will not be able to afford to pay me as good wages. Even if everyone at my firm has good skills, if the workers at the suppliers to my firm do not have good skills, my firm is going to be less competitive competing in national and international markets.
ru: В результате мой работодатель станет менее производителен.

quote: The security workers are in a contract dispute with their employer, Stallion Security Consortium Pty (Ltd).
after: Workers claim they were promised as much as seven times as much pay for a shift than what they are currently receiving.

quote: Your father's employment record, including the results of his last appraisal.
before: That is your record of academic achievement. Plus a couple of other things.
after: It's not, as you can see, glowing. How did you get this?
ru: Данные о занятости твоего отца, включая последнюю оценку его капиталов.

quote: The terms of my employment would not allow me to do that.
before: You don't have to run, Dave. You can walk.
after: This here LeMat's mighty heavy. Puts me at a disadvantage.
ru: Условия моей занятости не позволит мне сделать это.

quote: The employment agency sent me for the assistant position.
before: - No, neither do I. My name's Hilliard.
after: That position has been filled. No, it isn't.
ru: Служба занятости прислала меня на вакансию помощника.

quote: Throughout the evening, I'll speak with each of you about your employment prospects.
before: Oh, no, I apologize. I didn't realize that we had to be allowed to speak. You will be, individually.
after: Now, in the meantime, I hope you'll take any free time that you have to familiarize yourself with our employee handbook. That sound?
ru: В течение этого вечера я поговорю с каждым из вас о ваших перспективах занятости.

quote: Others, around homelessness in London, around youth and employment and education elsewhere in the country.
before: Investors have put in 3.1 million pounds. That program started last month.
after: There are now 13 social impact bonds in Britain, and amazing levels of interest in this idea all over the world. So David Cameron's put 20 million pounds into a social outcomes fund to support this idea.
ru: Подобные программы работают с бездомными в Лондоне, молодёжью, занятостью, образованием в других частях страны.

quote: I just love how equally we divide our responsibilities.

ru: Задумайтесь: материальное обеспечение и домашняя забота одинаково важны для полноценной жизни человека.

before: Norway has invested to build a society with opportunity and economic mobility. Saudi Arabia has raised living standards while frustrating many other human strivings.

ru: Две страны, обе богатые, не одинаково благополучны.

Now, the exact amount of how you map from a certain increase of CO2 to what temperature will be, and where the positive feedbacks are — there's some uncertainty there, but not very much.
