ru: Это фотография, которую каждый может увидеть.

quote: Everyone younger than you and me reads "Rolling Stone."
before: That is a music magazine. "News of the Week" competes with "Time Magazine."
after: Yeah, well, youth is wasted on the young. - It's not that bad.
ru: Все, кто моложе нас с тобой, читают "Rolling Stone".

quote: No one could. Because everyone in this room loves you and wants to give you everything.
before: You can't say no. That's the problem. I couldn't.
after: I don't want everything. I just want this baby.
ru: Никто не мог, потому что все в этой комнате любят тебя, и хотят дать тебе все.

quote: In fact, everyone here must be part of the solution.
before: The power to do that is with all of us. Everyone here can be part of the solution.
after: Most people in this room own companies via their superannuation funds, their banks and their insurers. And it is time for us to ask them: Are they investing our money in companies that make products that kill seven million people every year?
ru: Каждый из нас должен быть частью решения.

quote: This city we just saw is different in everyone.
before: Deeper in the depths of our gut city, the syntrophs eke out a living off the fermenters' trash. At each step of this process, energy is released, and that energy is absorbed by the cells of the digestive tract.
after: Every person has a unique and diverse community of gut microbes that can process food in different ways. One person's gut microbes may be capable of releasing only a fraction of the calories that another person's gut microbes can extract.
ru: Эти города разные в каждом из нас.

quote: And then you connect that with your feeling that everyone has that motherly possibility.
before: And you begin to get very sentimental; you cultivate sentimentality intensely. You will even weep, perhaps, with gratitude and kindness.
after: Every being, even the most mean looking ones, can be motherly. And then, third, you step from there to what is called " a feeling of gratitude. "
ru: И тогда вы почувствуете связь этого состояния с вашими чувствами о том, что каждый обладает этими материнскими потенциальными возможностями.

quote: Under communism, "everyone worked for the collective farm," Daariimaa said.
after: None of her children has a steady job these days.

quote: I'm taking you for everything you have, mister.
before: You think we're gonna have a nice divorce if we ever get divorced? No fucking way.
after: I'm taking your balls and I'm thumbtacking them to the wall. You're gonna get nothing out of it.
ru: Я буду с тобой судиться за все, что у тебя только есть, мистер.

quote: I need to make sure that I have tried everything.
before: I am not convinced. I know what he has done and what he has become... but I need one last chance to break through to him.
after: All right. But whatever you plan on doing, do it quickly...
ru: Я должен быть уверен, что сделал все, что мог.

quote: He's everything the Prophet said the First Risen would be and so much more.
before: - I am. He spoke of his redemption from the earth clear and true, others bore witness. And there's something incredibly special about him, Julian.
after: I'm proud of you, Simon. You found him.
ru: В нём есть всё, о чём предупреждал Пророк, и даже больше.

quote: Fearlessness that comes from knowing that everything is gonna be okay.
before: What do you think it took to face the Monkeys head on? Fearlessness, right?
after: Old me is proof that I live to fight another day. What about everybody else?
ru: А бесстрашен тот, кто знает, что всё кончится хорошо.

quote: I'm looking for one key piece, but it just blends in with everything else.
before: You've got your contacts list, your email, and probably 500 apps you've never used in your entire life, and behind all of this is the software, the code, that controls your phone, and somewhere, buried inside of that code, is a tiny piece that controls your battery, and that's what I'm really after, but all of this, just a bunch of ones and zeros, and it's all just mixed together. In cyber, we call this finding a needle in a stack of needles, because everything pretty much looks alike.
after: So let's step back from this theoretical situation of making a terrorist's phone explode, and look at something that actually happened to me. Pretty much no matter what I do, my job always starts with sitting down with a whole bunch of binary information, and I'm always looking for one key piece to do something specific.
ru: Я ищу одну ключевую часть, но она смешана со всем остальным.

quote: Empowering them will change everything -- more than technology and design and entertainment.
before: For every dollar given to a women's program, 20 dollars are given to men's programs. Women are 51 percent of humankind.
after: I can promise you that women working together — linked, informed and educated — can bring peace and prosperity to this forsaken planet. In any war today, most of the casualties are civilians, mainly women and children.
ru: И если предоставить им права, то это изменит всё - больше чем просто технологию, дизайн и развлечения.

quote: And I don't think people understand that that could change everything.
before: Workers are even sent home if their brains show less-than-stellar concentration on their jobs, or emotional agitation. It's not going to happen tomorrow, but we're headed to a world of brain transparency.
after: Everything from our definitions of data privacy to our laws, to our ideas about freedom. In fact, in my lab at Duke University, we recently conducted a nationwide study in the United States to see if people appreciated the sensitivity of their brain information.
ru: И мне кажется, что люди не понимают, что это может всё поменять.

quote: "They were taking everything they could carry, his personal belongings, the furniture, everything," Induta said.
before: Induta also said that the president was "taken down by bullets fired by these soldiers," and that afterwards they looted his home.

quote: I've looked everywhere, even after the police left.
before: - What are you saying? - I'd also really love to find this missing gun.
after: Well, we know that Favelloni had about a minute between shooting everyone here and stumbling out that door without the gun. So it's less than a minute from here. Somewhere.
ru: Я искал везде, и после того как уехала полиция.

quote: It seemed that male supremacy and male chauvinism was everywhere.
before: It's a free household slave for each man. It will take a major social revolution for women to be truly liberated. We began to reinterpret the whole world.
after: And it was. What's your general feeling about the National Organization of Women's complaints? To become a member of the Press Club, you have to be 21 years of age and be a male.
ru: что мужское превосходство и шовинизм были везде.

quote: You must get this everywhere you go, you're going to get it everywhere.
before: What's...what's Chewbacca like? - AS HARRISON FORD: - "Laugh it up, fuzzball!"
after: I've gotten used to it, you know. It'll take a couple of minutes for the navi computer to calculate the coordinates.
ru: Тебя преследует это повсюду, везде, куда бы ты не пошла.

quote: It's based out of India, but they fly everywhere.
before: Ajira. It's an airline.
after: Great. Maybe they got a flight out of here to Vegas tonight.
ru: Она находится в Индии, но летает везде.

quote: Everywhere there has been constant extraction of mineral, killing animals, the logging timbers and so on.
before: And fortunately, I saved his life. And that was the language of the war.
after: And what of important things — I think all of you here have a cell phone. That mineral has killed a lot: five millions of Congolese have gone because of this Colombo-Tantalite — they call it Coltan — that they use it to make cell phones and it has been in that area, all over in Congo.
ru: Везде непрерывно добывались полезные ископаемые, убивались животные, вырубались леса... и так далее.

quote: Then, people said monarchy dominated everywhere because it was rooted in human nature.
before: History was over and society would inevitably have to take second place to economy. But I've been struck with a parallel in how people often talk about capitalism today and how they talked about the monarchy 200 years ago, just after the French Revolution and the restoration of the monarchy in France.
after: We were naturally deferential. We needed hierarchy.
ru: Тогда люди говорили, что монархия преобладает везде, потому что она коренится в человеческой природе.

quote: You go in along the shore, you can find it everywhere.
before: And one of the really most incredible things, I think, is that there's nobody out there trying to collect it at the site where it is densest. Parts of the ocean there look just absolutely apocalyptic.
after: It's really messy. If you go to the places where it's just arriving, like the eastern part of the Gulf, in Alabama, there's still people using the beach while there are people cleaning up the beach.
ru: Идя вдоль берега, это можно увидеть везде.

quote: "Bodies were strewn all over the place, and there was blood everywhere," he said.
I strongly believe that careful examination of the prince's remains will provide vital evidence.
before: Are you doing an autopsy on a doll? Yes, but hear me out.
after: You have one minute of my attention. Use it wisely.
ru: Я действительно верю, что тщательное изучение останков принца обеспечит нас необходимыми доказательствами.

quote: And we have evidence that Victoria had sex with someone the day she died.
before: No, we didn't. I'm married.
after: - You have evidence? - Yeah, a little semen.
ru: У нас имеются доказательства, что Виктория занималась сексом в день смерти.

quote: I present the evidence found in the accused's dwelling.
before: The peace endures. I present the accused, Ellic Lemasniel, forjudgment for the murder of Dolan the 36th.
after: Found? Oh, come on.
ru: Представляю доказательства, найденные в жилище обвиняемого.

quote: Father Eugene even violated the seal of the confessional to provide evidence.
before: - He said that he and Father Eugene went to Tucker a year ago. That they had information that Vice was running some of their students.
after: - He claims that? - They also named Russo and Jefferson.
ru: Отец Юджин даже нарушил тайну исповеди, чтобы предоставить доказательства.

quote: We have had clear evidence of the great impact of this program.
before: And that is the end product. Because it has to go high, and there is some space available, two or three rooms are made under the water tower, which are used by the village for different committee meetings.
after: Before we started, there were, as usual, more than 80 percent of people suffering from waterborne diseases. But after this, we have empirical evidence that 82 percent, on average, among all these villages — 1,200 villages have completed it — waterborne diseases have come down 82 percent.
ru: Мы получили убедительные доказательства большого влияния этой программы.

quote: It teaches them to accept authority, revelation and faith, instead of always insisting on evidence.
before: In my view, not only is science corrosive to religion; religion is corrosive to science. It teaches people to be satisfied with trivial, supernatural non-explanations, and blinds them to the wonderful, real explanations that we have within our grasp.
after: There's Douglas Adams, magnificent picture from his book, " Last Chance to See. " Now, there's a typical scientific journal, The Quarterly Review of Biology.
ru: Религия учит людей принимать власть, откровения и судьбу, вместо того чтобы всё время настаивать на доказательствах.

quote: There's ample evidence that gender- and ethnically diverse companies are more effective.
before: We're seeing young founders of companies in their early 20s scale them up to global giants by the time they get to 30, and yet, we expect these young digital leaders to somehow miraculously embody the relationship wisdoms we older workers have had decades to learn. It's hard to microwave your emotional intelligence.
after: But what about age? This is a very important question, because for the first time ever, we have five generations in the workplace at the same time, unintentionally.
ru: Есть множество доказательств, что компании с сотрудниками разного пола и этноса работают более эффективно.

quote: Additional charges of solicitation, conspiracy, tampering with physical evidence and other charges are pending.
before: Radel, Arrant and Waterman have been charged with murder in the first degree. Due to the severity of the charges, Waterman has been waived into adult court.
after: Arrant and Waterman will be arraigned in the District Court in Craig this morning.

quote: They know, but they also believe you're pure evil.
before: You're more powerful than I am. Do they really not know how strong you are?
after: Hmm. And what do you think? I believe I was sleepwalking before I met you, and you woke me up.
ru: Они знают, но они также считают тебя чистым злом.

quote: I didn't know then that Revere was a soldier in the supernatural war against evil.
before: Betsy? You shouldn't be here.
after: Shortly after his visit, Betsy's niece made a full recovery. So Revere had a cure, or he might've killed the thing.
ru: Я не знал, что Ревир был солдатом в сверхъестественной войне со злом.

quote: I believe the Caliphate is evil and our enemy.
before: As such, he has no constitutional or moral authority to take our country to war. I want to be very clear.
after: If I'm elected your president, I will immediately withdraw our troops from a war we should not be fighting. That I do not believe we can win.
ru: Я верю, что халифат — зло, это наш враг.

quote: Sure, sit out the war between good and evil.
before: We've had this conversation. I haven't changed my mind.
after: After all, you've got a good thing going being applauded by mindless twits. Really?
ru: Конечно, стой в стороне, пока идет война добра со злом.

quote: In every past version, the main character has been an evil queen.
before: (Laughter) Vuja de is when you look at something you've seen many times before and all of a sudden see it with fresh eyes. It's a screenwriter who looks at a movie script that can't get the green light for more than half a century.
after: But Jennifer Lee starts to question whether that makes sense. She rewrites the first act, reinvents the villain as a tortured hero and Frozen becomes the most successful animated movie ever.
ru: В каждой из последних версий главным героем была злодейка-королева.

quote: The good was my church and its members, and the evil was everyone else.
before: The end of my antigay picketing career and life as I knew it, came 20 years later, triggered in part by strangers on Twitter who showed me the power of engaging the other. In my home, life was framed as an epic spiritual battle between good and evil.
after: My church's antics were such that we were constantly at odds with the world, and that reinforced our otherness on a daily basis. " Make a difference between the unclean and the clean, " the verse says, and so we did.
ru: Добро — моя церковь и её прихожане, зло — все остальные.

quote: The problem with evil is that in real life, evil doesn't necessarily look ugly.
before: They're cruel even to their own supporters. When I see these movies, I never understand — why would anybody be tempted to follow a disgusting creep like Voldemort?
after: It can look very beautiful. This is something that Christianity knew very well, which is why in Christian art, as [opposed to] Hollywood, Satan is usually depicted as a gorgeous hunk.
ru: Но проблема со злом в том, что в реальной жизни зло вовсе не обязательно омерзительно.

quote: I think sharing is good and stopping people from sharing is evil.
before: It's a smear term to insult people who share. I will not smear sharing.
after: Now I when they say protected, what they really mean is restricting. And I think that's bad.

quote: My son has the exact same color eyes.
before: is that your daughter, Mr. Kuttner? She's beautiful.
after: Mind your business, Stross. He doesn't wanna talk about it, Nolan.
ru: У моего сына глаза точно такого же цвета.

quote: Can you honestly say that you wouldn't have done the exact same thing?
before: He offered to help me... money, a job. Put yourself in the same position.
after: Oh, well, my judgment's not in question here, nor my future. And we both know it would be a simple pleasure to annihilate you.
ru: Можете ли вы честно сказать, что не поступили бы точно также?

quote: Andy, we had this exact same conversation when you wanted to get rid of Nellie.
before: You understand why, right? No.
after: You can't just get rid of people over grudges. Nellie was a professional grudge.
ru: Энди, у нас уже был точно такой же разговор, когда ты собирался уволить Нелли.

quote: If you could get me her exact weight, I could guarantee a semi-precise T.O. pain-free D.
before: Maybe...120. Why?
after: A.S.A.P. Best I can do for now.
ru: Если скажете мне точный вес, я смогу гарантировать быструю и безболезненную "С".

quote: These figures couldn't be exact, but we knew those materials were finite.
before: It was also materials. In 2008, I picked up a scientific study looking at how many years we have of valuable materials to extract from the ground: copper, 61; tin, zinc, 40; silver, 29.
after: We only have them once. And yet, our speed that we've used these materials has increased rapidly, exponentially.
ru: Это были не точные значения, но известно, что данные материалы ограничены.

quote: In quantum mechanics, the exact position and exact speed of an object have no meaning.
before: The real origin is much deeper and more amazing. The Uncertainty Principle exists because everything in the universe behaves like both a particle and a wave at the same time.
after: To understand this, we need to think about what it means to behave like a particle or a wave. Particles, by definition, exist in a single place at any instant in time.
ru: В квантовой механике точное место и точная скорость объекта не имеют смысла.

quote: You now know the exact intentions that led to the creation of this work.
before: And where you see stars in a romantic sky, your friend interprets global warming-inducing pollutants. To settle the debate, you turn to the internet, where you read that the painting is a replica of the artist's first-grade art project: Red was her favorite color and the silver dots are fairies.
after: Are you wrong to have enjoyed it as something the artist didn’ t intend? Do you enjoy it less now that you know the truth?
ru: Сейчас вам известен точный замысел автора, повлекший создание этой работы.

quote: No. We don't even have an exact measurement of the age.
before: Not much. [laugh] Unfortunately, not much.
after: Because it can be between like one and five million years old. So it's not very accurate.

quote: What exactly do those boys think they're gonna do?
before: Yeah, well, you just be careful. That was Jo. 30 more dead on the west coast.
after: It's the boys. If anybody can pull this out of their ass, it's those two.
ru: Что именно эти ребята намереваются сделать?

quote: Which is exactly what we're trying to avoid.
before: Russell, that compound is on a hair trigger. Sending in the military is just gonna push them over the edge.
after: What we're trying to avoid is another U.S. government official getting killed. JSOC's already done an assessment on sending a team in.
ru: А именно этого мы и пытаемся избежать.

quote: What exactly would she want with Alchemy's followers?
before: 16 Hawthorne Avenue and 1104 Truman Place. She's trying to find the acolytes, I was trying to say.
after: She must think that he can take her to Alchemy. She wants him to take her powers away.
ru: Что именно она хочет от приспешников Алхимии?

quote: The woman. Where exactly did she take you?
before: Dashiell, look at me. This is important.
after: I'm sorry. I don't know what you're referring to.
ru: Куда именно тебя отвезла та женщина?

quote: At the start you have exactly 3 tanks’ worth of fuel.
before: But where? There’ s an interesting pattern that can help.
after: At 8 parsecs you need exactly 1. Is there a point, which we can call point X, where you could have exactly 2?
ru: Вначале у тебя есть в точности 3 комплекта с канистрами топлива.

quote: Every bit of food was exactly what it was for its nutritional value.
before: (Laughter) I had to drop 50 pounds in three months. So, everything that I put into my body, I considered as medicine.
after: I ate really small controlled portions throughout the day. And I started to really adapt my body.
ru: Каждый кусочек пищи представлял для меня в точности то, что составляло его питательную ценность.

quote: Problem number two was, I couldn't exactly control the sensitivity of my sensors.
before: First of all, I couldn't figure out how to get a nanoparticle ink into a printcheck cartridge without spilling it all over my carpet. That was problem number one.
after: I couldn't scale them up or down, I couldn't really do anything of that sort. So I wanted something to solve it.
ru: Проблема номер два — я не могла точно контролировать чувствительность моих сенсоров.

quote: Officials say that a full investigation will be launched to determine exactly what caused the blast.
before: The explosion occurred at 10:50 a.m. [EST] at the Flat Top Little General Store, and fire officials say that the cause may have been from a nearby propane tank that was leaking. The gas station was completely wiped out.

quote: After you passed your board exams, I made you that dinner.
before: You did not. What do you mean, I did not?
after: You came home, off shift, late... (sighs) threw some noodles on, and asked me if I wanted to get married. - No ring.
ru: После того как ты сдала экзамены, я приготовил тебе ужин.

quote: If you passed your exams, you'd be in a better place to help him.
before: In fact, it was really rather interesting. I just wish Mr Mason was settled.
after: Maybe, but first, I've got to make them listen. Her Ladyship was there and she tried to calm the new owner down, so she must be sympathetic.
ru: Сдашь экзамены - может и придумаешь, как ему помочь.

quote: Now, I believe someone has a final exam to attend.
before: After due consideration, I have elected not to retire. Yeah! Oh, thank god!
after: Set a course for Morty's high school. Perhaps I'm biased, but if that story never happened, then I wouldn't still be the family butler.
ru: Я думаю, кому-то надо сдать итоговый экзамен.

quote: That story about the philosophy exam and the chair?
before: What are we? Savages? I thought you were gonna keep him as a souvenir or something.
after: What does that actually mean? It's not supposed to mean anything.
ru: Что это за басня про экзамен по философии и стул?

quote: They need to be able to take their countries' licensing exams.
before: Now we need to do our part to support the 23,000 and counting, All of us — foundations, residency directors, press, entrepreneurs, policymakers, people — need to step up. We need to do much more globally to give these new doctors the opportunity to prove their mettle.
after: They need jobs in the public health sector or in nonprofit health centers to put their training and commitment to work. They need the chance to be the doctors their patients need.
ru: Им нужно суметь пройти экзамены на сертификаты в своих странах.

quote: When we're taking final exams, sitting in traffic or pondering pollution, we internalize stress.
before: Special chemicals called stress hormones run through your body, giving you more oxygen and power to run away from danger or to face it and fight for your life, hence the term " fight or flight. " But when you don't fight, or take flight, you face the plight.
after: It all begins in the brain. The hypothalamus, the master controller of your hormones, releases something called corticotropin-releasing hormone.
ru: Когда мы сдаём экзамены, стоим в пробке или думаем о загрязнении окружающей среды, мы подвергаем себя стрессу.

quote: Why did I take the entrance exam as its benchmark?
before: It is now writing a 600-word essay on maritime trade in the 17th century. How does that sound?
after: Because I thought we had to study the performance of AI in comparison to humans, especially on the skills and expertise which are believed to be acquired only by humans and only through education. To enter Todai, the University of Tokyo, you have to pass two different types of exams.
ru: Почему я взяла вступительный экзамен в качестве ориентира?

quote: Electronic gadgets are banned from the exam centres.
before: foreign=suppress cameras have been installed at the locations where the exam question papers are printed, and metal detectors have been installed in over 2000 exam centres. According to various reports, around 700 thousand students are due to take the exams, whose results are expected to be declared a month later from July 22.

quote: We try to set a good example for our children.
before: Why are you guys so uptight? Because, Phil...
after: That is the difference between you and us. Not the only difference, I hope.
ru: Мы пытаемся показать хороший пример для наших детей.

quote: Another example: After close observation, I notice we all scratch our ass.
before: I wanted to buy some cheese. Come along. How vulgar!
after: As far as I know, we never mentioned it to anyone, least of all a doctor. We'd rather die of a disease than of shame!
ru: Другой пример: после месяцев наблюдений я констатирую, что вся семья чешет зад.

quote: So take, for example, those tracks that lead right to your back door.
before: Most of my job was figuring out whether the things people said lined up with the truth. Lucky for me, it's a skill that never goes out of style.
after: Tracks? Fresh ones.
ru: К примеру, возьмем те следы, которые ведут прямо к Вашей задней двери.

quote: Even in your example, you're all by yourself.
before: No one understands that better than I do. Hey, look at that.
after: When there was a lice epidemic at my school, everybody got it except me. I tried to fool everyone by sprinkling sugar in my hair, but I just got attacked by bees.
ru: Даже в твоём примере ты одна одинёшенька.

quote: Bertie County is kind of a prime example in the demise of rural America.
before: The entire county is home to just 20,000 people, and they're very sparsely distributed. So there's only 27 people per square mile, which comes down to about 10 people per square kilometer.
after: We've seen this story all over the country and even in places beyond the American borders. We know the symptoms.
ru: Округ Берти - это своего рода показательный пример вымирания сельской Америки.

quote: And the reason is that -- take Africa for example.
before: And, sadly, we don't know. And worst of all, we will never know.
after: Africans have already got a lot of aid. These are the blue bars.
ru: И причина в том — возьмём для примера Африку —

quote: And in fact, he used the cassowary as an example.
before: In 1975, a light went on in somebody's head. Dr. Peter Dodson at the University of Pennsylvania actually realized that dinosaurs grew kind of like birds do, which is different than the way reptiles grow.
after: And it's kind of cool — if you look at the cassowary, or any of the birds that have crests on their heads, they grow to about 80 percent adult size before the crest starts to grow. Now think about that.
ru: Фактически, он использовал в качестве примера казуара.

quote: The coin is believed to be one of 20 or fewer examples available commercially.
after: Two are in the Smithsonian Museum.

quote: There's some excellent fishing, upstream, under the waterfall.
before: And yet I've never heard of you. Our camp is set up over here.
after: I will go. And I also, for everybody knows...

after: Fourteen years ago, we all took the King's shilling. We all signed up together.
ru: Вы заметили, как мало мужчин живёт в этой деревне?

quote: In the world of humanitarian aid, there are very few decision scientists.
before: Decision scientists are people like me. They take the data, they clean it up, transform it and put it into a useful algorithm that's the best choice to address the business need at hand.
after: Most of them work for companies. So that's the second thing that companies need to do.
ru: В сфере гуманитарной помощи очень мало таких специалистов.

quote: On the few radio stations still operating in the country, I mostly heard pop music.
before: As I reported on these massacres, I bought and ate little sweets, seeking the familiar comfort of their taste. Central Africans ate these sweets to ease their hunger, leaving a trail of thousands of plastic wrappers as they fled.
after: As the war mounted, we received less information about the massacres. It became easier to feel a sense of normalcy.
ru: На немногих радиостанциях, всё ещё работавших в стране, я чаще всего слышал поп-музыку.

quote: There are just way too few eye care professionals.
before: They're quite plentiful. The problem is, there aren't enough eye care professionals in the world to use the model of the delivery of corrective eyewear that we have in the developed world.
after: So this little slide here shows you an optometrist and the little blue person represents about 10,000 people and that's the ratio in the U.K. This is the ratio of optometrists to people in sub-Saharan Africa.
ru: Этих специалистов просто слишком мало.

quote: A few dozen anti-abortion-rights counter-protesters also came to Washington D.C. that day.
after: One, 24-year-old Anna Lulis of Virginia, held a sign reading "women's rights begin in the womb." Police kept the two groups from approaching each other, but there were some clashes.

quote: To be a successful field agent, one must give up many things.
before: Because of me, Jae Hee's mom died. I.. It was in retaliation for my rounding up the international drug cartels.
after: The more capable, the more to give up. For a field agent, to have both success and ordinary happiness is an impossibility.
ru: Полевой агент вынужден от многого отказаться.

quote: Don Shula was just as important to that record as the players on the field.
before: The only NFL team to win the Super Bowl after a perfect season was the '72-- '72 Dolphins.
after: Thank you. You're welcome.
ru: Тренер Дон Шула был так же важен для того достижения, как и сами игроки на поле.

quote: If I don't have something by then, I will turn Charming into a killing field.
before: They'll dig in. You have until noon tomorrow.
after: UNSER: I spent the night in a bathtub, bound and gagged.
ru: Если до тех пор ничего не выяснишь, я превращу Чарминг в чёртово поле боя.

quote: B.B.L.'s a liter in the field and only one P.I.V. We need access here!
before: Okay. Now imagine you have a cat...
after: A teeny, tiny cat... OLIVIA: What have we got?
ru: B.B.L. 'S литра в области и только один P.I.V нам нужен доступ

quote: Turns out, they're essential in many fields of math and science.
before: In other words, an equilateral triangle is not symmetric with respect to rotations of 90 degrees around its center. But why do mathematicians and scientists care about symmetries?
after: Let's take a close look at one example: symmetry in biology. You might have noticed that there's a very familiar kind of symmetry we haven't mentioned yet: the symmetry of the right and left sides of the human body.
ru: Оказывается, она необходима во многих областях математики и естественных наук.

quote: My mom grabbed us by the shoulders. She marched us out in the field.
before: We were standing on the edge of thousands of acres of cotton. There were about a hundred black folks out there picking.
after: She went up to the foreman; she said, " I've got these two little boys never worked a day in their lives. " Of course, we were just eight and 10.
ru: Мама схватила нас за плечи и выпроводила в поле.

quote: In fact, the fish were still plentiful, the fields for grazing were still vast.
before: Even if we mess up some part of the environment, we were not fundamentally changing the functions of the earth system. The global commons had still enough capacity to take the punches we gave them.
after: Our mistake was to assume that the capacity of the earth for self-repair had no limits. It does have limits.
ru: Более того, рыбы пока было в избытке, полей, пригодных для выпаса скота, всё ещё было достаточно.

quote: The West Indies made errors in the field, dropping catches and bowling 23 wides.
before: South African captain Graeme Smith picked up a hand injury facing the first ball of the innings, but managed to score 28 runs before being caught by Chris Gayle in the sixth over, leaving the hosts on 88-2. Three overs later Abraham de Villiers was caught behind for sixteen runs.
after: Justin Kemp scored 46 runs off 22 balls and Herschelle Gibbs, despite needing a runner, scored 90 not out to win the match for South Africa with fourteen balls remaining.

quote: "Here follow the facts and figures proving fraud, embezzlement and murder."
before: "And Crispin Horsefry, clubbed to death by Reacher Gilt." Turn it off!
after: "The full record of the clandestine dealings of Reacher Gilt." My Lord, they're lying.
ru: "Ниже приводятся факты и цифры, доказывающие мошенничество, растрату и убийство."

quote: I want the figures checked.
before: Ladies and gentlemen, I've been keeping the totals as we've gone along. The total of those opposed comes to exactly... Fourteen thousand, one hundred and sixty-five shares... certainly not enough to win out over our total of... one million, six hundred thousand.
after: I demand a re-count. Miss Partridge, you're...
ru: Я хочу сверить цифры.

quote: So this figure prompted a lot of hand-wringing in Whitehall.
before: Now, Level 1 numeracy skills — that's low-end GCSE score. It's the ability to deal with fractions, percentages and decimals.
after: Policies were changed, investments were made, and then they ran the survey again in 2011. So can you guess what happened to this number?
ru: Эта цифра вызвала большой ажиотаж в Уайтхолле.

quote: Now, 20 percent, well, that's a fairly huge figure, you might think, but you've still got 80 percent left of the problem, right?
before: You would be wrong. One or two euros was enough to make 20 percent of cars disappear from rush hours.
after: Because you still have 80 percent of the traffic. Now, that's also wrong, because traffic happens to be a nonlinear phenomenon, meaning that once you reach above a certain capacity threshold then congestion starts to increase really, really rapidly.
ru: Можно подумать, что 20% — да, достаточно большая цифра, но всё равно остаётся 80% проблемы.

quote: A number of public figures including Wolfgang Schuessel, the Austrian Chancellor, have publicly denounced the posters.
before: The posters depict Britain's Queen Elizabeth, having sexual intercourse with US president George W. Bush, and French President Jacques Chirac.

quote: After a lifetime in the daddy waiting room, it looks like the doctor is finally in.
before: Serena. Paging Serena Van Der Woodsen.
after: William, what's going on? I was just about to ask you that, Lily.
ru: После целой жизни в комнате ожидания папочки, кажется, доктор наконец появился.

quote: This is our chance to finally have the life we were supposed to have.
before: Meaning? The three of us finally under the same roof.
after: Angelo, this is what it would've been... dirty dishes, cockroaches and sullen teens. This is real life.
ru: Это наш шанс в конце концов жить так, как мы и должны были.

quote: We finally have a second chance at a life together.
before: I was waiting for you in our cabin. But since no one can confirm that, I didn't want to risk telling that to the police.
after: I don't want anything getting in the way of that. Neither do I.
ru: Наконец-таки у нас появился второй шанс.

quote: You know, I'm so glad you finally agreed to go out with me, Jenna.
before: Hey, let's go grab some good beer even though we brought the bad beer. And these two barbecue scumbags formed a lifelong friendship until their deaths at the ripe old age of 52 in separate ATV accidents.
after: Me, too. I'm having a really nice time.
ru: Знаешь, я так рад, что ты наконец согласилась. пойти на свидание, Дженна.

quote: Finally, as a machine, I could exchange energy with the world via haptics.
before: Secondly, as a machine, I could place digital information, or output information, into reality. Holograms are examples of a machine interacting with an environment from an output perspective.
after: Now, imagine being able to feel the temperature of a virtual object, or better yet, imagine pushing a hologram and having it push you back with equal force. With this perspective, we are able to collapse reality into a simple matrix.
ru: Наконец, будь я машиной, я бы мог обмениваться энергией с миром с помощью тактильной обратной связи.

quote: With this narrow escape, the Argonauts finally had Colchis in their sights.
before: But Phineas’ advice rang in their heads. The Argonauts released a single dove and sped through in its wake to emerge unscathed.
after: Yet while Jason rested and celebrated with his crew, he could feel his time among them was drawing to a close. As the fleece gleamed in his mind, he knew he would have to retrieve it alone.
ru: Чудом избежав неприятностей и в этот раз, аргонавты наконец-то увидели Колхиду.

quote: And finally, free. Free is really, really interesting.
before: This is a tipping point — if Malcolm's here, forgive me — and it's going to change the economics, and the speed, and the players in the industry. It's going to look a little bit like that.
after: Free is something that comes with digital, because the reproduction costs are essentially free. It comes with IP, because it's such an efficient protocol.
ru: И, наконец, бесплатность. Это очень, очень интересное явление.

quote: Then Africa, Asia, the Americas, the Caribbean and finally Oceania entered the stadium.
before: In a change from the traditional format, the teams did not enter in alphabetical order; instead, they entered in order of regions of the Commonwealth, starting with the European nations.

quote: He's fine, he has a room of his own and everything.
before: And your little brother, where is he? In Brittany, with a foster family.
after: I went to see him last year, but he didn't recognise me. Thanks.
ru: Он в порядке, у него своя комната и всё, что нужно.

quote: I'm sure they're fine, but they can't distribute like Schiller can.
before: Well, the coxon burnouts can't guarantee the security we have. They know what they're doing.
after: Schiller? So you're working with Schiller now?
ru: Уверена, что с ними порядок, но они не смогут продать столько же как Шиллер.

quote: I'm taking medication and most days I'm fine.
before: No, I'm not dying. I mean, we're all-- we're all dying, but, no, it's under control.
after: Other days-- You pile-drive a Zenith.
ru: Я принимаю лекарства, и большинство дней я в порядке.

quote: Admission of guilt, five years' probation, and a 60 million dollar fine.
before: Don't be a son of a bitch. We're ready to settle.
after: A very nice offer. It's funny. Something about a settlement doesn't sit right with me.
ru: Признание вины, пять лет условно и штраф в шестьдесят миллионов.

quote: And then he said, "But I'm sure she's fine."
before: A few weeks later, I talked to the Gawker journalist. I emailed him and asked him how it felt, and he said, " It felt delicious. "
after: But she wasn't fine, because while she slept, Twitter took control of her life and dismantled it piece by piece. First there were the philanthropists: [If @ JustineSacco's unfortunate words... bother you, join me in supporting @ CARE's work in Africa.]
ru: И добавил: «Уверен, у неё всё в порядке».

quote: So, they said, "Fine, the permanent nature of adoption is for you."
before: Would you like a job, or would you like a family? " And we said, " No, we definitely want a family. "
after: So we said, " Great, that's the first sort of simple thing there's to decide. So, what do we do next? "
ru: «Хорошо, усыновление на постоянной основе вам подходит», — сказали нам.

quote: After I paid the fine and bribe, my family was released in one month.
before: But I had to spend almost all my money to bribe the border guards in Laos. But even after we got past the border, my family was arrested and jailed for illegal border crossing.
after: But soon after, my family was arrested and jailed again, in the capital of Laos. This was one of the lowest points in my life.
ru: Я заплатила штраф и новую взятку и мою семью выпустили через месяц,

quote: Microsoft CEO Steve Ballmer stated that the company had news that the fine was pending.
after: "We knew it was pending," Ballmer told interviewers. "We didn't know it was this week, but we knew it was coming at some point."

quote: They cut off my Dad's finger for trying to grab a gun.
before: I'm the one they want. Which is exactly why you cannot open the door, okay?
after: - They will kill you for what you did. - What I did was kill Hurst.
ru: Они отрезали палец моему папе за то, что он пытался отобрать оружие.

quote: I have an itch on my trigger finger.
before: That he wants to start a war. It's about time.
after: (Martine): Tannhauser wishes to speak with you. Good morning, Herr Tannhauser!
ru: У меня спусковой палец чешется.

quote: If she puts on lipstick after her cat's death, Then push a finger into her mouth!
before: Torture her. Humiliate her, just to see.
after: And Leon, always the gentleman! It's Tolo.
ru: Если она накрасилась после смерти ее кота, тогда засунь палец ей в рот!

quote: A tiny finger tracing a line in the infinite.
before: You are the last person I should have confided in about this. I liked that idea. That even if we're not real, we represent a dynamic.
after: A shape. And then we're gone.
ru: Крошечный палец, который проводит по линии в бесконечности.

quote: Finger, finger, finger, finger, finger, finger, finger, finger.
before: Little, ring, middle, index. And then open.
after: A little bit faster. Finger, finger, finger, finger, finger, finger, finger, finger.
ru: Теперь откройте. Палец, палец, палец, палец, палец, палец, палец, палец.

quote: Prick a finger, you get some blood -- about 50 microliters.
before: (Laughter) And so an issue here is to, in some cases, figure out how to deal with matters that seem uninteresting, like compliance. Now, take a look at what a typical test looks like.
after: That's about all you're going to get, because you can't use the usual sort of systems. You can't manipulate it very well; I'll show something about that in a moment.
ru: После укола в палец, получаем кровь, примерно 50 микролитров.

quote: As you can see, I use my finger to interact with my digital body.
before: Our digital body is one-to-one life size, so this is exactly the way students will see the real anatomy. I'm going to do some demonstrations.
after: I'm going to do some cuts. I can cut any way I want to, so I cut right here.
ru: Как вы можете видеть, я использую палец для взаимодействия с цифровым телом.

quote: Tests were done on the finger to determine this.
before: Initially, county health officials said Ayala was fine and the finger had been cooked, which would have killed any bacteriae in the finger. However, on March 27, officials admitted they were not so sure anymore.
after: Dr. Martin Fenstersheib, Santa Clara County's health officer, said that even if the finger was still raw when Ayala bit into it, the risk was low that she would have become infected with anything. However, he advised that Ayala should undergo a series of precautionary follow-up tests.

quote: The fire crew had to cut him out.
before: Come on, Saul. Shit.
after: They think he was... There was a vodka bottle on the seat next to him.
ru: Пожарникам пришлось его вырезать.

quote: I've broken windows, I've set more fires than I can count.
before: Wasn't so bad. I've done bad things, too, ok?
after: Is that supposed to make me feel better? I'm saying I learned how to control it.
ru: Разбивала окна, устроила столько пожаров, что и не счесть.

quote: They opened fire before they even got to the house.
before: They had papers, some bullshit. They didn't come to arrest me.
after: Christine told me what you did. Yeah, you told me to protect her, right?
ru: Открыли огонь прежде чем вошли в дом.

quote: I'll look into the fire at the fishing lodge.
before: Only change the 'a' in praying to an 'e' - because she preys upon... - Thank you, George. I think we should focus on the husbands.
after: Sir, I'm quite intrigued by this falling piano. First thing tomorrow, then.
ru: Я поищу информацию о пожаре в рыбацком домике.

quote: Both families hate each other, and this is just adding fuel to the fire.
before: Okay, heartless hinds. We know that once again, it's not a good thing.
after: But just how bad is this stinger? A heartless hind is a coward, and calling someone that in front of his own men, and the rival family, means there's going to be a fight.
ru: Оба клана ненавидят друг друга, и эти слова подливают масла в огонь.

quote: We need to put the right kind of fire back into the system again.
before: So what do we do? We need to restore the power of the patchwork.
after: It's how we can resize the severity of many of our future fires. And the silver lining is that we have tools and we have know-how to do this.
ru: Нам нужно восстановить правильный режим пожаров.

quote: Al is a fire hydrant in the city of Boston.
before: But really what they're doing is they're showing what's possible with technology today. So meet Al.
after: Here it kind of looks like he's looking for a date, but what he's really looking for is for someone to shovel him out when he gets snowed in, because he knows he's not very good at fighting fires when he's covered in four feet of snow. Now how did he come to be looking for help in this very unique manner?
ru: Ал — пожарный гидрант в Бостоне.

quote: Quito Fire Chief Jaime Benalcazar informed local radio that the emergency exits were padlocked shut.
before: While rescuers continue to search for any remaining bodies, police are investigating the disaster. One line of enquiry concerns whether adequate safety precautions were taken.
after: Preliminary investigations show that a roman candle lit by a band member triggered the disaster. The Factory had not been authorised to hold the event.

quote: Then I realized that firefighter saw something when he braved those flames to rescue you.
before: And who would light a fire on such a warm morning? The hard part was to figure out what would drive you to kill the man who saved your life?
after: Got an unconscious man in here. Something that would send you to jail for life when he caught the news reports of the robbery and pieced together what he saw inside that burning house.
ru: Потом я понял, что пожарный увидел что-то, когда рассекал в огне, спасая вас.

quote: Remember, Dad, you said firefighters sleep all the time, right?
before: FDNY. Ah! Good. Good.
after: I said firefighters sleep upstairs in the firehouse when they're not putting out fires. I'll bet your dad likes donuts.
ru: Помнишь папа, ты говорил, что пожарные спят круглосуточно, так?

quote: My dad was a firefighter, and now I am too.
before: So I figured I'd teach myself so if he ever came back, I could show him that I didn't need him. I know the feeling, bud.
after: But I did it without his help. Is it hard?
ru: Мой отец был пожарным, и теперь я тоже пожарный.

quote: I'm just not gonna go pissing on a firefighter who's proven himself.
before: You're looking the other way and letting him skate. I'm not blind, Casey.
after: Did you even check his story? No, I didn't check his story.
ru: Я просто не собираюсь слушать пожарного, который пытается проявить себя.

quote: So that's first responders and firefighters, refugees, prisoners and prison guards, soldiers, you name it.
before: We tried Prozac as well, and that had no effect. So if this were to translate into humans, we might be able to protect people who are predictably at risk against stress-induced disorders like depression and PTSD.
after: And to give you a sense of the scale of these diseases, in 2010, the global burden of disease was estimated at 2.5 trillion dollars, and since they are chronic, that cost is compounding and is therefore expected to rise up to six trillion dollars in just the next 15 years. As I mentioned before, repurposing can be challenging because of our prior biases.
ru: Это работники экстренных служб, пожарные, беженцы, заключённые и их охранники, солдаты и так далее.

quote: He wants to know what it feels like to be a firefighter.
before: And so sometimes these analogous experiences, analogous role-play, can also be quite valuable. So when a kid dresses up as a firefighter, you know, he’ s beginning to try on that identity.
after: We’ re doing the same thing as designers. We’ re trying on these experiences.
ru: Он хочет знать, каково это - быть пожарным.

quote: Or a surgeon or firefighter missing any time.
before: And when this mind-wandering happens, it can be problematic. Now I don't think there will be any dire consequences with you all sitting here today, but imagine a military leader missing four minutes of a military briefing, or a judge missing four minutes of testimony.
after: The consequences in those cases could be dire. So we might ask why do we do this?
ru: Или хирург, или пожарный отвлекутся от дела.

quote: Firefighters said they believe the fire started in an area containing deep fat fryers.
before: No one was injured in the blaze, which destroyed the pier.
after: Smoke could be seen as far away as ten miles.

quote: But right now, I'm firmly planted in stage three, bargaining.
before: Next will be stage four, depression. And then stage five, acceptance.
after: Dear God, if you stop Cece's breast reduction, Okay. - I'll circumcise Coach.
ru: но сейчас, я твёрдо намерен остаться в стадии три - торги.

quote: I firmly believe in a woman's right to her own body.
before: Okay. Here's the thing.
after: - We're the ones who have to carry the baby, take care of it, turn our entire lives upside down. And I feel strongly that children should be brought into this world only when they're wanted and are able to be provided for.
ru: Я твердо верю, что женщина имеет право на своё собственное тело.

quote: Margaret holds the key, I firmly believe that.
before: Wouldn't you agree? Yes, that's why I told you to do it.
after: Still an animal... of course, but there is something exquisite about her. Now what precisely are we looking for?
ru: МАргарет - ключ. Я твёрдо в это верю.

quote: Because I firmly believed that it would be cute.
before: Marcia, that was not my intention at all. Why else would you marry penguins?
after: And it was. Are you married?
ru: Я твёрдо верила, что это будет мило.

quote: And I firmly believe that our job in those times is to disrupt what is happening.
before: But people like me, the professional troublemakers, should not be the only ones who are committed to being these dominoes who are always falling out of planes or being the first one to take this hit. People are so afraid of these acute consequences, not realizing that there are many times when we walk in rooms and we are some of the most powerful people in those rooms — we might be the second-most powerful, third-most powerful.
after: And then if we're not the most powerful, if two more of us band together, it makes us powerful. It's like cosigning the woman in the meeting, you know, the woman who can't seem to get her word out, or just making sure that other person who can't make a point is being heard.
ru: И я твёрдо убеждена, что в такие моменты мы должны нарушать то, что происходит.

quote: So, as an aside, I firmly believe in the field of trying to identify cancer early.
before: This is the state-of-the-art and how we do it. You know, I know very well, as a cancer doctor, I can't treat advanced cancer.
after: It is the only way you can start to fight cancer, is by catching it early. We can prevent most cancers.
ru: Поэтому в противоположность этому я твердо верю в попытку обнаружения рака на ранней стадии.

quote: And I firmly believe that that's the message that we have to carry forward.
before: She founded the hospice movement. And she said, " You matter because you are, and you matter to the last moment of your life. "
after: Thank you. (Applause)
ru: И я твёрдо верю, что именно с такой идеей мы должны идти вперёд.

quote: We firmly believe more people were involved in Tony's death.
before: Head Detective Inspector, Mike Arnerich, said "tonight's arrest was excellent news, police were still seeking more people in connection with the death.
after: We've still got a lot of investigative work to do to identify and find these people."

quote: I got on the first plane to Luxembourg to investigate.
before: Read me in, Annie. Megan Carr was reported dead with a flash drive found in her possession.
after: Hey, Midge? Yes?
ru: Я первым же самолетом вылетела в Люксембург.

quote: If your troops had taken this hill on the first day, we would have been finished.
before: I don't know what you chaps were belly-aching about. This is a veritable Garden of Eden.
after: How close did we get? There.
ru: Займи ваши войска этот холм в первый день, нам бы настал конец.

quote: But first, you might need to catch Dr. Banner.
before: I'm already there. You'll catch on.
after: News or footage. Keyword, "Hulk."
ru: Но сначала попробуй поймать д-ра Бэннера.

quote: You'll need to when you lead your first army into battle.
before: You'll remember the rest in due time. But you'd better get comfortable casting Doubt.
after: Lead armies? Me?
ru: Тебе это понадобится, когда ты поведёшь в бой свою первую армию.

quote: The first patient to ever be treated with an antibiotic was a policeman in Oxford.
after: On his day off from work, he was scratched by a rose thorn while working in the garden. That small scratch became infected.
ru: Самым первым пациентом, которого лечили антибиотиками, был полицейский из Оксфорда.

quote: He had accidentally been the first person to tune in to them.
before: It was a solar wind interacting with our ionosphere that he was listening to — a phenomena which we can see at the extreme northern and southern latitudes of our planet as the aurora. So whilst inventing the technology that would usher in the telecommunications revolution, Watson had discovered that the star at the center of our solar system emitted powerful radio waves.

before: Here's what I think is going on. I think that we tend to look a lot at the infrastructure of globalization.
