ru: Мы смотрим на структуру, которая делает возможной жизнь в соединённом мире.

quote: We just give a framework, and hope for the best.
before: There's so much to do! It's great that so many are doing this stuff, and that people can choose the things that interest them. this is the thing about LV (as with Wikipedia etc) ... we can't control our volunteers, nor do we want to.

quote: Frankly, my Lady, this rather narrows the field.
before: There is a new law enacted. It requires that any lady the King may marry must, on pain of death, disclose any charge of sexual misconduct that might be brought against her.
after: The ladies at court are-how to say- not exactly known for their virtue. I still think the King will want to remarry.
ru: Откровенно говоря, миледи, ...это значительно сужает поле.

quote: Frankly, it would be faster to tell you what you don't have.
before: Vicodin, Percocet, whatever's handy. You have liver damage, esophageal varices, immune system dysfunction, likely renal failure.
after: Maybe the online medical school you graduated from didn't cover this before they emailed you your diploma. I'm going to try to make this simple.
ru: Откровенно говоря, быстрее было бы перечислить то, чего у вас нет.

quote: Quite frankly, I could give a damn whoever it is.
before: Give him that. Superintendent Haas has yet to make a decision.
after: Just remember one thing, it's all about the students. It's not about you two.
ru: Откровенно говоря, мне плевать, кто меня заменит.

quote: Why run for Vice President when frankly, I'd rather flip patties at Gettysburger.
before: There's no need for it, Liv. I'm sitting here practicing my speech, and all I can think is "Why?"
after: You'd be the second most powerful person on the planet. And completely miserable.
ru: Зачем мне бороться за пост вице-президента, если откровенно говоря, я бы хотел жарить котлеты в Геттисбургере.

quote: Fortunately, scientific advances and, frankly, economic realities make that option less viable every day.
before: Maybe it's easier to see in other zip codes because we don't want to look at it. We'd rather be sick.
after: The science is clear: Early adversity dramatically affects health across a lifetime. Today, we are beginning to understand how to interrupt the progression from early adversity to disease and early death, and 30 years from now, the child who has a high ACE score and whose behavioral symptoms go unrecognized, whose asthma management is not connected, and who goes on to develop high blood pressure and early heart disease or cancer will be just as anomalous as a six-month mortality from HIV / AIDS.
ru: К счастью, продвижение науки и, откровенно говоря, экономические реалии делают такой выбор с каждым днём всё менее жизнеспособным.

quote: And I think, quite frankly, that's where I started.
before: And thinking that, can an individual actually do something, or come up with something, that may actually get some traction out there and make a difference? Inspired by nature — that's the theme here.
after: I became very interested in the landscape as a Canadian. We have this Great North.
ru: Откровенно говоря, я начал как раз с этого.

quote: Well, quite frankly, because the real newspaper is depressing.
before: (Applause) " Why?, " you might ask. " Why make a fake newspaper? "
after: We ostensibly live in a democracy where we should have some say in what happens in the world. But the truth is, we never see the stories we want to see in the newspaper.
ru: Откровенно говоря, затем, что реальные газеты депрессивны.

quote: So it will have some effect, but we, frankly, wouldn't have expected it to be enormous.
after: Yeah, it's what Ms Truss has to say, but, yeah, frankly it's sort of, it's not, in any standard usage of the word, it would not be 'enormous'.

quote: We are in the circle of Fraud which one commits upon those who trust in him.
before: My thanks, Geryon. This way, Dante.
after: You must travel these ten malebolge alone. And quickly
ru: Мы находимся в круге Мошенничества которые совершали те кто верит в Него.

quote: It can't be fraud if she signed off on any potential conflict of interest.
before: It's standard for us. Good, we're protected.
after: Why don't I find it in discovery? Because you're blind.
ru: Это не может быть мошенничество, если она подписала отказ от любых конфликтов интересов.

quote: She was doing time for cheque fraud, for God's sake.
before: She said you killed her partner. Them sending that poison into the prisons, making my poor Helena overdose.
after: Didn't deserve that. Well, if someone killed my woman, I'd do the same.
ru: Она, чёрт возьми, отбывала срок за мошенничество.

quote: Anyway if it all goes tits up, it'll be six month in Strangeways for fraud.
before: Yeah, but we don't do Christmas. Stan does.
after: Sorry. Nine.
ru: В любом случае, если всё провалится, то это шесть месяцев в тюрьме Стренжвэйс за мошенничество.

quote: And they largely succeeded, which is how the fraud became endemic.
before: Second thing we need to do is completely reform modern executive and professional compensation, which is what they use to suborn the appraisers. Remember, they were pressuring the appraisers through the compensation system, trying to produce what we call a Gresham's dynamic, in which bad ethics drives good ethics out of the marketplace.
after: And the third thing that we need to do is deal with what we call the three D's: deregulation, desupervision, and the de facto decriminalization. Because we can make all three of these changes, and if we do so, we can dramatically reduce how often we have a crisis and how severe those crises are.
ru: Они невероятно в этом преуспели, потому и мошенничество стало обычным делом.

quote: One out of seven large, public corporations commit fraud every year.
before: I'm pretty sure there are at least seven companies you've interacted with today. Let me tell you a stunning statistic.
after: This is a US academic study that looks at US companies — I have no reason to believe that it's different in Europe. This is a study that looks at both detected and undetected fraud using statistical methods.
ru: Одна из семи крупных государственных корпораций каждый год совершает мошенничество.

quote: It's since been deployed in Mexico to track electoral fraud.
before: And that, that maneuver called " crisis mapping, " was kicked off in Kenya in January of 2008. And enough people looked at it and found it valuable enough that the programmers who created Ushahidi decided they were going to make it open source and turn it into a platform.
after: It's been deployed in Washington D.C. to track snow cleanup. And it's been used most famously in Haiti in the aftermath of the earthquake.
ru: Затем программу стали использовать в Мексике, чтобы отслеживать мошенничество на выборах.

quote: Otto Perez Molina, the main opposition candidate, called the divorce electoral fraud.
before: A petition was taken to the court by a group of students, claiming the divorce is a "farce" that would bypass the constitution.
after: As first lady Torres has played a big role in politics during the presidency.

quote: Says he'll hunt down any man who's working the Free Trade.
before: What do you want? There's a new magistrate in Launceston, sent down...
after: You don't think I know about it? Yeah, well, you should do something about it.
ru: Говорит, что выследит любого, кто работает в свободной торговле.

quote: She's finally free of the clutches of Penelope dreadful, rightfully owns her family fortune.
before: - And the world weeps. - But not Louise.
after: Which, given the size of this party and the guest list, she's already spent. Speaking of...
ru: Она наконец свободна от цепких лапок Пенелопы, и законно владеет семейным состоянием.

quote: Hey, people ask us for free medical advice all the time.
before: Are those our taxes? Hey, Chief, stop harassing my patient.
after: It's not harassment unless I don't want to help her. I just had fetal surgery and I've been stuck on bed rest for weeks.
ru: Люди постоянно просят нас о бесплатном медицинском обследовании.

quote: One free barium enema, and my mother won't care she's not Jewish.
before: You brought a girl to the Mars Rover control room? Yeah,I picked her up in the bar. She's a doctor.
after: Wait a minute. So the eye patch and the insults worked? No,there were three other guys with eye patches.
ru: Она врач. Одна бесплатная бариевая клизма, и моей маме уже всё равно, что она не еврейка.

quote: And we expect to do so for free.
before: Right? Buildings like these are intended to enrich their owners and tenants, but not necessarily the lives of the rest of us, those of us who navigate the spaces between the buildings.
after: Shiny towers are an invasive species and they are choking our cities and killing off public space. We tend to think of a facade as being like makeup, a decorative layer applied at the end to a building that's effectively complete.
ru: И мы ожидаем, что это будет бесплатно.

quote: It's about whether it's actually possible to have a free and fair election ever again.
before: And it's bigger than any of us. And it is not about left or right or " Leave " or " Remain " or Trump or not.
after: Because as it stands, I don't think it is. And so my question to you is, is this what you want?
ru: Вопрос в том, возможно ли теперь свободное и честное голосование в принципе.

quote: We have a choice. We've been blessed, or cursed, with free will.
before: We just want to try and create that awareness because, sure, changing a light bulb isn't going to change the world, but that attitude, that awareness that leads you to change the light bulb or take your reusable coffee mug, that is what could change the world. I really believe that we stand at a very important point in history.
after: We can choose a greener future, and we can get there if we all pull together to take it one stroke at a time. Thank you.
ru: У нас есть выбор. Свободная воля -- наше благословение и проклятие.

quote: Presentation of the book "Japan for free" (6).jpg|Pinchuk.
after: Presentation of the book "Japan for free" (7).jpg|Pinchuk autographing a copy donated to the library. Presentation of the book "Japan for free" (8).jpg|The author and attendees.

quote: Men like Fisher Bloom, they love their freedom above all else.
before: Trouble, that's what. Breezing into town, expecting a welcome.
after: They have no thought for others. But he is a young man and he is free to choose the life he chooses.
ru: Люди вроде Фишера Блума любят свою свободу больше всего остального.

quote: The woman wanderer goes forth to seek the land of freedom.
before: - Dont talk back. - Maud-
after: How am I to get there?  Reason answers:
ru: 'Женщина-скиталица идёт вперед в поисках свободной земли.

quote: To fight against anything or anyone that robs us of our freedoms.
before: Before he died, he inspired me to think that things could change here. That it was important to rise up and speak out against the regime.
after: I guess I just wanted to thank you for making me believe again. Mum...
ru: Бороться со всем и всеми, кто лишает нас свободы.

quote: Should you feel ill, do not hesitate to visit your local Freedom Medical Center.
before: Be sure to get plenty of sleep... Why are you following me?
after: I wanted to give you these. Your Freedom Card is up to date...
ru: Если вам нездоровится, незамедлительно посетите ваш местный медицинский центр Свободы.

quote: So privacy, in a way, is both the means and the price to pay for freedom.
before: They achieve autonomy. The price to pay, however, is leaving the garden.
after: Again, marketers tell us that big data and social media are not just a paradise of profit for them, but a Garden of Eden for the rest of us. We get free content.
ru: Так и тайна частной жизни, в некотором роде и возможность и цена, которую нужно платить за свободу.

quote: That's what technology is bringing us: choices, possibilities, freedoms.
before: Those are all basically the same thing. And those are the things that technology brings us.
after: That's what it's about. It's this expansion of room to make differences.
ru: Вот что технология приносит нам: варианты выбора, возможности, свободы.

quote: We have curtailed their opportunities and their freedoms.
before: NDB: By telling girls that no deed can be kept secret, that their bodies will reveal them no matter what, we have endowed them with fear. Girls are afraid of ruining themselves, either through sport, play, tampon use or a sexual activity.
after: It's time we put an end to the virginity fraud. It's time we break the myths about the hymen once and for all.
ru: Тем самым мы ограничиваем их возможности и их свободу.

quote: This was followed by chants of "Libertad", the Spanish word for freedom.
before: "We want freedom for everyone," said Betancourt while speaking to a crowd of thousands in Paris, France.

quote: Glen, how's it feel to finally be able to move freely between buildings?
before: I was bird-watching. I wasn't lurking. And for my opponent to suggest that I'm some kind of Peeping Tom is, frankly, outrageous.
after: Can we review your concept on the plan we discussed? The, eh, plutonium transport.
ru: Глен, как тебе ощущение свободы передвижения между зданиями?

quote: We need a human soldier who can move freely in the daylight.
before: - Justine, you can't do this. - Mayor, I just did.
after: You have proven yourself capable. I'm listening.
ru: Нам нужен человеческий солдат, способный свободно передвигаться при свете дня.

quote: You may speak freely in front of him as he barely understands a word.
before: For God's sake, give her some lines, she's perfectly capable of starving us! Good afternoon, I'm Sherlock Holmes. This is my friend and colleague, Dr Watson.
after: Holmes! However, before you do, allow me to make some trifling observations.
ru: Вы можете говорить при нем свободно, он все равно не поймет.

quote: He can speak more freely about his past than with someone else.
before: Yes, I remember. I still believe it's a good thing.
after: What about his present? I will assume that you aren't here for a consultation.
ru: Здесь он может свободно говорить о своём прошлом.

quote: If something is freely spinning, as one number gets bigger, the other gets smaller.
before: This is called the conservation of angular momentum. Mathematically, angular momentum is a product of two numbers, one that gives the spin rate and one that gives the distance of the mass from the axis.
after: Arms closer, spin faster. Arms farther, spin slower.
ru: Если объект вращается свободно, то по мере того, как одно число становится больше, другое становится меньше.

quote: It comes with its own wine cellar that you can draw freely from.
before: It was designed by the architect I.M. Pei. It comes with its own Rolls Royce and driver.
after: When I took the tour, it actually included some Opus One, I was glad to see. 30,000 dollars for a night in a hotel.
ru: В нем есть винный погреб, откуда можно свободно брать вино.

quote: And when I place the superconducting disk on top of this rail, it moves freely.
before: Now, I can extend this circular magnet, and make whatever track I want. For example, I can make a large circular rail here.
after: (Applause) And again, that's not all. I can adjust its position like this, and rotate, and it freely moves in this new position.
ru: И когда я помещаю суперпроводник над этим рельсом, он свободно движется.

quote: Only freely available open source software was used to create the movie.
before: The project was first announced one year ago and was jointly produced by the Blender Foundation and the Netherlands Media Art Institute. The film tells the story of Emo and Proog, two men trapped inside a surreal machine world.
after: Most of the work was done using Blender, a 3D modelling and rendering tool. The Blender Foundation is selling an extended edition on DVD, which includes subtitles in 34 languages, a Making Of documentary, commentary tracks, and all files used to create the movie.

quote: There would be a pattern to the jump intervals, however frequent they are.
before: - I never agreed to that. I don't think it's because of pulsar damage.
after: There's also the changes in the ship's course once we drop out of FTL. It also seems too coincidental that every time this happens, we can't seem to get a hold of Rush.
ru: В интервалах прыжков была бы закономерность, какими бы частыми они не были.

quote: This is Mr. Bell, frequent beneficiary of said consultations.
before: Sherlock Holmes. Consulting detective.
after: How can I help you? You ever wonder why you have such blue eyes, Sean?
ru: Это мистер Бэлл, частый получатель моих услуг консультанта.

quote: She also mentioned her husband's a frequent user of ride-share.
before: She's being pretty insistent. You'll probably get a lot more like her coming in here.
after: JJ, Lewis, check it out. He's gonna chop off his head!
ru: Она также сказала, что ее муж часто вызывал машину с помощью приложения.

quote: See, Bbal Ddae was saying President Baek made frequent trips to Seoul.
before: We said we'd advance into Seoul then he betrayed us. He must have made a deal with President Kang.
after: Then we can't even fight in the club? Keep calm, think it through calmly, Nam Je Il, there must be a way out.
ru: Помните, Баль Дэ говорил, что президент Пэк часто ездил в Сеул.

quote: That's me and my sister, Esther, who's a frequent TEDster.
before: (Laughter) So, this ship was basically the size of the Marriott Hotel, a little taller and a little bigger. And one of the people who worked on it at the beginning was my father, Freeman, there in the middle.
after: I didn't like nuclear bomb-propelled spaceships. I mean, I thought it was a great idea, but I started building kayaks.
ru: Это мы с моей сестрой, Эстер, которая является частой слушательницей TED.

quote: We have no chance of competing against machines on frequent, high-volume tasks.
before: An ophthalmologist might see 50,000 eyes. A machine can read millions of essays or see millions of eyes within minutes.
after: But there are things we can do that machines can't do. Where machines have made very little progress is in tackling novel situations.
ru: В соревнованиях с машинами у нас нет шансов, если залог победы — частота повторения и объём.

quote: We see "better" is the most frequent feeling, followed by "bad."
before: Mounds visualizes the entire dataset as large, gelatinous blobs which kind of jiggle. And if I hold down my cursor, they do a little dance.
after: And then if I go over here, the list begins to scroll, and there are actually thousands of feelings that have been collected. You can see the little pink cursor moving along, representing our position.
ru: Мы видим "лучше" намного более частое чувство чем "плохо".

quote: It has been a frequent target for separatist attacks over the past few years.
before: Sungai Kolok is a town on Thailand's border with Malaysia.

quote: In nature, it happens frequently that female fish changes sex to male after maturity and breeding to increase their number.
before: Sorry, but... the big ones are female, and the small are male. Sex change?
after: The male clownfish number's little. Kengo-san!
ru: Гермафродизм в природе нередок. После полового созревания и размножения самка меняет свой пол для увеличения популяции.

quote: Those who oppose him frequently end up dead.
before: He's a man of mystery without biography. Well, that's hardly unusual for an American.
after: Those that oppose you frequently end up dead. It's coincidence. Nothing more.
ru: Его конкуренты зачастую оказываются в могиле.

quote: The love impulse in man frequently reveals itself in terms of conflict.
before: - You're angry, aren't you? - Yes, I am.
after: - Excuse me. The what impulse?
ru: Любовный импульс в человеке зачастую обнаруживается в конфликтных ситуациях.

quote: So it runs frequently, the entire hospital, just on a generator.
before: And finally, I think you can see that infrastructure is not very strong. This hospital is connected to a very weak power grid, one that goes down frequently.
after: And you can imagine, the generator breaks down or runs out of fuel. And the World Bank sees this and estimates that a hospital in this setting in a low-income country can expect up to 18 power outages per month.
ru: Поэтому целый госпиталь зачастую обеспечивается энергией только за счёт генератора.

quote: When I speak to businesspeople, I frequently make them very upset when I contradict them and say that no, your employees are not your most valuable asset.
before: And how you can channel this into an organization that harnesses this great power of wanting to make the world a better place. And in the end, come out a little on the better.
after: Your most valuable asset is the thousands of people who want to work for you for free. And you don't let them.
ru: Когда я общаюсь с бизнесменами, я зачастую очень расстраиваю их, когда я противоречу им и говорю: «Нет, ваши сотрудники — не самый ценный ваш актив.

quote: Frequently, grandparents are raising their grandchildren because parents, due to alcoholism, domestic violence and general apathy, cannot raise them.
before: The school dropout rate is up to 70 percent. Teacher turnover is eight times higher than the US national average.
after: Fifty percent of the population over the age of 40 suffers from diabetes. The life expectancy for men is between 46 and 48 years old — roughly the same as in Afghanistan and Somalia.
ru: Зачастую прародители растят внуков потому что родители из-за алкоголизма, домашнего насилия и общей апатии, не могут растить их сами.

quote: Cholera is frequently spread by contaminated, untreated water.
after: The spread of the disease was expedited by the collapse of Zimbabwe's health and sanitation systems; state media reported that most of Harare has been left without water after the city ran out of chemicals for its treatment plant. A resident of Mabvuku, a suburb located east of Harare, told APTV that electricity is not available most of the time, so water is consumed without being boiled first.

quote: You know, I needed a little fresh air.
before: No one did. I was locked upfor 12 years.
after: Do you have any idea how stupid that sounds? We need to be careful.
ru: Знаешь, мне был нужен свежий воздух.

quote: Do you prefer fresh limes, sir, or cordial?
before: - A gimlet, um... - Well, obviously he can't.
after: Fresh, of course. Very good.
ru: Вы предпочитаете свежие лаймы, сэр, или ликёр?

quote: I thought rather than have our audience in the study, we could get some fresh air.
before: To a very significant degree, yes. Oh, well, you can tell me all about it in the car.
after: You must be longing for a walk after your journey. Do you have any outdoor shoes?
ru: Я подумала, что вместо аудиенции в кабинете мы можем подышать свежим воздухом.

quote: And I'm not seeing any fresh tar on the street or on his shoes.
before: Almost certainly happened before he hit the ground. Dead men don't bruise.
after: What if it came from our killer's foot? Which he got when he was kicked in front of the bus.
ru: И я не вижу никакой свежей смоли на улице или на его ботинках.

quote: The fresh air clears his mind and help him think better.
before: One of the best known of Zeno's problems is called the dichotomy paradox, which means, " the paradox of cutting in two " in ancient Greek. It goes something like this: After a long day of sitting around, thinking, Zeno decides to walk from his house to the park.
after: In order to get to the park, he first has to get half way to the park. This portion of his journey takes some finite amount of time.
ru: Свежий воздух очищает его разум и помогает сосредоточиться.

quote: His music never ceases to sound fresh and surprising to me.
before: I didn't hear the boundaries. I still start every day practicing playing Bach.
after: But as I was moving away from the traditional classical repertoire and trying to find new ways of musical expression, I realized that with today's technological resources, there's no reason to limit what can be produced at one time from a single string instrument. The power and coherency that comes from one person hearing, perceiving and playing all the voices makes a very different experience.
ru: Его музыка никогда не прекращала звучать для меня свежо и удивительно.

quote: He said, "If I keep tossing myself off I get fresh sperm being made."
before: Sperm that sit around in the body for a week or more start to develop abnormalities that make them less effective at head-banging their way into the egg. British sexologist Roy Levin has speculated that this is perhaps why men evolved to be such enthusiastic and frequent masturbators.
after: Which I thought was an interesting idea, theory. So now you have an evolutionary excuse.
ru: Он решил: «Если я то и дело буду рукоблудить, то будет вырабатываться свежая сперма».

quote: And so those scars were still like, really fresh.
before: "I was in an extremely competitive [singing musical theatre] program in high school. I had started working at Funimation when I was 19, so I was just barely in college.
after: I had a lot of competition and people would find what your perceived weakness was, or what your actual weakness was in the program, and they would take advantage of it. And so I had people trying to make me feel like I couldn't sing my way out of a paper bag, and then I would get so nervous when I would sing that I couldn't support my notes, and so it would just prove them right."

quote: The one branded on your friend Maggie Chen?
before: You don't know God. This God?
after: Maggie helped make you. Then she saw the light and came to our side.
ru: Отпечаток которого был на коже твоей подруги Мэгги Чен?

quote: Excuse me, ma'am, could I have a moment with your friend?
before: Bigass hail Mary. How many more drinks do we need to get out here?
after: - What is this? - Let's just say it's the most important meeting you're gonna have all day.
ru: Простите, мэм, могу я поговорить с вашим другом?

quote: She'll be your best friend when she's 25.
before: [ sighs ] I just wanted to be her best friend, you know? She's a teenager.
after: Till then, 12 years of her thinking you're evil. - Really?
ru: Она будет твоей подругой, когда ей исполнится 25.

quote: You know what your problem is, my friend?
before: No, come on. The killer could have painted on the correct wall here, But he didn't because he didn't know better because he isn't red john. It's interesting.
after: You enjoy your work a little too much. You're a ghoul.
ru: Знаешь в чем твоя проблема, друг мой?

quote: And that same year, another friend of mine filled out the application and he got in.
before: You know that Neil and Buzz thing from back in' 69? And he handed me an application, and I looked at it, and I didn't fill it out.
after: And I said to myself, " If NASA's letting knuckleheads like that be astronauts, " (Laughter) " maybe I can be one, too. " So the next selection, I filled out the application, and I got in.
ru: Но в этом же году мой другой друг заполнил анкету, и его приняли.

after: The first thing is that we have seen this ongoing process of exponential acceleration. I know you all know about Moore's law, but in fact, it's more broad-based than that; it extends in many cases, for example, to software, it extends to communications, bandwidth and so forth.
ru: Я бы выделил три основополагающих пункта.

quote: None of these are captured in GDP statistics, but they are all fundamental to a healthy and a happy society.
before: In policy terms, this journey for Scotland started back in 2007, when we published what we call our National Performance Framework, looking at the range of indicators that we measure ourselves against. after: (Applause) And that broader approach is at the heart of our economic strategy, where we give equal importance to tackling inequality as we do to economic competitiveness. It drives our commitment to fair work, making sure that work is fulfilling and well-paid.
ru: Ни один из этих факторов не учитывается в статистике ВВП, хотя все они являются основополагающими для здорового и счастливого общества.

quote: It is the basic, most fundamental food that we've had in the last ten thousand years.
before: We add in raisins and oil and milk and all kinds of things to make bread, from a simple food into kind of a support for calories. And today, bread now is associated with obesity, which is very strange.
after: Wheat is the most important crop — the first crop we domesticated and the most important crop we still grow today. But this is now this strange concoction of high calories.
ru: Поскольку это основная, основополагающая пища человечества за последние десять тысяч лет.

quote: How fundamental has that government support been towards this?
before: In the lead up to this there was a lot of coverage of how much money the government gave you for stuff like the recovery centre inside here.

quote: If there was ever a real funeral.

after: You should come. Hey, buddy.
ru: Если бы похороны были настоящими.

quote: Wagons-lits, dining car, and you'll be at Groby with a day to spare before the funeral.

ru: Спальные вагоны, вагон-ресторан, и вы будете в Гроби за день до похорон.

quote: We needed a culprit before the funeral.

after: Pepper was sacrificed so that the people of Gotham would see swift justice done, so they can feel safe and secure. - And that matters so much to you?
ru: Нам надо было найти виновного до похорон.

quote: (Ruzek) That's Evan serving as a pallbearer for the funeral of an eight-year-old girl, his niece.

before: Auburn in Cambridge, Massachusetts were lushly landscaped gardens filled with sculpted stones and ornate tombs. Once a luxury reserved for the rich and powerful, individually marked graves became available to the middle and working classes.
after: By the late 19th century, as more public parks and botanical gardens appeared, cemeteries began to lose visitors. Today, many old cemeteries are lonely places.
ru: Люди приходили на кладбища не только на похороны, но и в определённые годовщины, по праздникам или даже на прогулки.

quote: He had only weeks to live and had, in fact, already paid for his funeral.

after: The cells were infused, and within days, he had high fevers. He developed multiple organ failures, was transferred to the ICU and was comatose.
ru: Ему оставалось жить пару недель. Он уже даже оплатил свои похороны.

before: Roy warns that the tragic consequences of their relationship “would lurk forever in ordinary things,” like “coat hangers,” “the tar on roads,” and “the absence of words.” Roy’ s writing makes constant use of these ordinary things, bringing lush detail to even the most tragic moments.
after: As the family mourns, lilies curl and crisp in the hot church. A baby bat crawls up a funeral sari.
ru: Книга начинается с описания похорон утонувшей кузины двойняшек Софи, наполовину британки.

quote: A private family service was held after the state funeral.
You can't throw away years of your life just because, well, you think it's funny.
before: I think you should take a bottle of tequila, I think you should walk out the door, and I don't think you need to ever come back. But my job is my life.
after: My hair smells of cheese. Monterey Jack.
ru: Нельзя выбросить годы жизни но помойку потому что... Ну что тут смешного?

quote: I swear he's gonna walk into that courtroom in a funny hat.
before: You're right. But the judge is way too into it.
after: See? He sounds... whimsical.
ru: Бьюсь об заклад, он придет в суд в смешной шляпе.

ru: Смешно, Шмидти, но мою концентрацию не сломить

ru: У вас странная манера начинать разговор с незнакомыми людьми.

ru: Нет такой вещи — смешно само по себе.

before: And behind that are some more modern galaxies. You see the whole big picture?
after: And then there's a part of the universe we can't see because it's so dense and so hot, light can't escape. It's like you can't see to the center of the Sun; you have to use other techniques to know what's going on inside the Sun.
ru: Начало времени смешное - оно находится снаружи, так ведь?

quote: But funny story, actually, of being put into a dog kennel.
before: (Applause) In my time there, I saw Natives being chased on horseback by police officers shooting at them, history playing out in front of my eyes. I myself was put into a dog kennel when I was arrested.
after: So we're in this big wire kennel with all these people, and the police officers are there and we're there, and we start howling like dogs. You're going to treat us like dogs?
ru: Смешная была история с собачим питомником.

This is just one of many perfect examples that showed what kind of humble person Ben was.

ru: Зовите кого-то на помощь, если вздумаете переставлять мебель.

after: - You gonna give it away or...? - Oh, I was gonna leave it for my sister.
ru: Так что ты будешь делать со своей старой мебелью?

after: It all went on my card, didn't it? I'm sorry.
ru: ¬ смысле, за... мебель, за картины, за одежду.

before: A car on a stick. (Laughter) If you put it next to contemporary architecture, it feels totally natural to me.

ru: То, что Себастьян прекрасный хозяин, не значит, что он может собрать мебель из IKEA.

ru: При нынешнем проценте смертности мы не сможем отбросить их еще дальше.

after: A minute ago he gained practically unlimited access to all materials... Ok, If we have to.

after: A drug cartel in Veracruz, for example. He's left fibers at two separate crime scenes.

after: It overreacts, makes things up as it goes along and is actually designed for somebody else's benefit. I'm sorry to break it to you, but I don't think this one is a winner.
ru: Кроме того, вы говорите, что этот продукт автономный,

after: In my experience, in fact, the light footprint was extremely helpful. And these troops that we brought in — it's a great picture of David Beckham there on the sub-machine gun — made the situation worse, not better.
ru: Более того, это просто не правда, то, что не получилось в Афганистане, так это минимальное вмешательство.

after: Let's go back a little. In the 1960s and 1970s, the Vietnam War was basically shown in America's living rooms day in, day out.
ru: Кроме того, эти образы навсегда уничтожили якобы высокие моральные устои оккупационных сил.

before: Sandy hit the northeast coast on the final week of campaigning, causing damages largely in New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut. The destruction and lack of electricity in certain areas raised questions of how the election could take place on November 6 amid such chaos.

ru: Вокруг будущего туман, потому что твой выбор еще не сделан

after: Right now, I think we left him back in Florence. You know, I understand... ..why they don't trust me.

ru: Мисс Додд не разделяет моего оптимистического взгляда на будущее.

ru: И если бы он выжил, будущее транспорта уже, скорее всего, наступило бы сейчас.

after: Our participants could see more clearly, they could focus more quickly and they thought it was an easier and better focusing experience than their current correction. To put it simply, when it comes to vision, autofocals don't compromise like static corrections in use today do.
ru: Увиденное сразу убедило нас, что будущее ― за самофокусированием.

But I want to tell you the story of PISA, OECD's test to measure the knowledge and skills of 15-year-olds around the world, and it's really a story of how international comparisons have globalized the field of education that we usually treat as an affair of domestic policy.
ru: Полная открытость в сфере школьного образования — дело далёкого будущего.

quote: Now if that is the future, why don't we progress towards this TODAY.

ru: Но даже без финансирования моих разработок мне удалось покорить новые высоты.

quote: You need to adjust the height of it, and you just do it by shrugging.
before: Let's do the long way around. (Robot buzzes) (Laughter) And then you have a little hand.
after: (Laughter) (Applause) It has a little hand. (Hand thwacks) (Laughter) (Applause) I just bumped my mic off, but I think we're all good.
ru: Высоту можно отрегулировать — надо просто пожать плечами.

quote: In the capital of American Samoa, Pago Pago, the tsunami measured 1.57 meters in height.
after: The superintendent of the National Park of American Samoa Mike Reynolds reported four waves as high as six meters. People who experienced the quake said it was long, lasting from 90 seconds to three minutes.

quote: Christ, we don't even know if that helicopter made it out of South African airspace.
before: There's still no lead on Knox. They slapped a "D" Notice on everything-- covered up any evidence that Coldfall Ridge was ever a nuclear storage facility.
after: It's possible the Israelis have got a track on Knox. We could get Scott to intercept.
ru: Мы даже не знаем, покинул ли тот вертолет воздушное пространство ЮАР.

quote: Four years with Helicopter Sea Combat Squadron 24.
before: Uh-huh. Lieutenant Commander Oliver Happ.
after: Otherwise known as the Ghostrunners. Exemplary service record, including two commendations for acts of bravery in Afghanistan.
ru: Четыре года служит в 24 морской боевой вертолетной эскадрилье.

quote: And the door of the helicopter was open.
before: I... We were allowed to go over central London about 500 feet.
after: And Tom Hooper, who directed it, was sitting behind the camera. And we were up, banking right, and I was leaning out the window, and a certain point, he said, "I'm afraid we have to cut, we have to change..."
ru: И дверь вертолета была открыта.

quote: Next sound they hear is the helos, the helicopters.
before: And then there was silence. The team thinks, "That's it. Frank's dead, and we're next."
after: They get to the landing zone, you know what they see? Frank Castle, standing there, grinning.
ru: Потом они услышали вертушки,вертолёты.

quote: Helicopter stunts are always fun, hanging out of them, whatever.
before: And that's Centre Point in London. We brought Oxford Street and Tottenham Court Road to a standstill.
after: And aerial stunts. No aerial stunt would be the same without skydiving.
ru: Трюки с вертолётами — это всегда весело, висеть на них и всё такое.

quote: I went to the place where his helicopter was about to land.
before: And, you know, just like how every cartoonist knows Bush here, and if you had to meet Bush, it would be the funnest thing because his face was a cartoonist's delight. I had to meet my Prime Minister.
after: I saw layers of security. I caricatured my way through three layers by just impressing the guards, but I got stuck.
ru: Я пришёл туда, куда должен был приземлиться его вертолёт.

quote: That was filmed from a helicopter using a gyro-stabilized camera.
before: KB: I love that shot. I always get goosebumps every time I see it.
after: And it's a wonderful bit of gear, because it's like having a flying tripod, crane and dolly all rolled into one. But technology alone isn't enough.
ru: Он был снят с вертолёта гиростабилизированной камерой.

quote: On Tuesday a helicopter was shot down, killing seven civilians.
before: The latest crash is the fifth in the space of a week.
after: Yesterday a NATO-chartered helicopter crashed at Kandahar Airfield, killing sixteen, and another helicopter landed heavily elsewhere, injuring several people. Only Tuesday's accident involved hostile fire.

quote: Would it be helpful to you if I told you about my dreams?
before: Instead, I get the same question I hear from the lady who slices my bologna at Ralph's. I'm sorry, I'll start again.
after: Um, I don't know, maybe. I recently had a dream that I was a giant.
ru: Может, тебе будет полезно, если я расскажу тебе о своих снах?

quote: Agent Van Pelt said you were really helpful.
before: How you doing? Good.
after: What can I do for you? Well, it's quite a setup you have here.
ru: Агент Ван Пелт говорила, вы были полезны.

quote: And you'll appear concerned and helpful and lead her nowhere.
before: She'll call with instructions. Then you'll meet.
after: The CCTV cameras in the garage went dark just before the abduction. - Probably disabled.
ru: Ты будешь заинтересованной, полезной и приведёшь её в никуда.

quote: It would be very helpful for me to have context.
before: Just about Liberty. The climate here, the challenges.
after: Sure. Anything you need.
ru: Для меня будет полезно узнать контекст.

quote: Now, this ignorance, however, is not very helpful on the level of the social.
before: They'd rather prefer denying the illness, which is why it's not so wise to inform them if they don't ask. Surprisingly, research shows that sometimes people who deny their illness live longer than those who are rationally choosing the best treatment.
after: When we are ignorant about where we are heading, a lot of social damage can be caused. Now, on top of facing ignorance, we are also facing today some kind of an obviousness.
ru: Это незнание всё же не так услужливо на социальном уровне.

quote: But scientists still aren't sure exactly how or why the tears themselves are helpful.
before: When someone is either too sad or too happy, it feels like a loss of control, which can be dangerous. So, emotional tears are sent in to stabilize the mood as quickly as possible, along with other physical reactions, such as an increased heart rate and slower breathing.
after: They may be a social mechanism to elicit sympathy or show submission. But some studies have also found that emotional tears contain higher levels of stress hormones, such as ACTH and enkephalin, an endorphin and natural pain killer.
ru: Но учёные до сих пор не уверены, как или почему эти слёзы полезны сами по себе.

quote: In my experience, in fact, the light footprint was extremely helpful.
before: If the Al-Qaeda base was to be established near Ghazni, we would hit them very hard, and it would be very, very difficult for the Taliban to protect them. Furthermore, it's simply not true that what went wrong in Afghanistan is the light footprint.
after: And these troops that we brought in — it's a great picture of David Beckham there on the sub-machine gun — made the situation worse, not better. When I walked across Afghanistan in the winter of 2001-2002, what I saw was scenes like this.
ru: По моему опыту, фактически, минимальное вмешательство было чрезвычайно полезным.

quote: "Obviously it’s not helpful to whoever our Democratic nominee is," she said.
before: Democrat Hillary Clinton seemed more concerned about Nader's bid.
after: "I remember when he did this before, it didn't turn out too well for anyone, especially our country." She said Nader "prevented Al Gore from being the 'greenest' president we could have had", and she hoped his bid will be "just a passing fancy that people won't take too seriously."

quote: Hence, your services will no longer be required.
before: - It's quite alright, Archbishop. Mr Logue, you must know that I found a replacement English specialist with impeccable credentials.
after: - l'm sorry? - Your Majesty's function is to consult and be advised.
ru: Следовательно, в ваших услугах больше нет необходимости.

quote: Your PPA activist file has followed you here from Oran, hence these measures.
before: I detest violence. Glad to hear it.
after: - What's going on? - I don't know.
ru: Ваше досье следовало сюда за вами из Орана, поэтому мы приняли меры.

quote: Hence we have decided to send you on a six-month course to teach you precision marksmanship.
before: According to a report dated June 20 from Mr Kovalchuk, a shooting instructor at Osovi Yahimova's firing range, he witnessed your excellent results. You have talent.
after: Congratulations. And my studies?
ru: Поэтому мы решили послать вас на шесть месяцев курс , Чтобы научить вас точность стрельбы.

quote: I don't want to stand out, hence the camouflage paint.
before: Round here, water. Essential. Subtle stuff too.
after: But perhaps most importantly, the whole of my bug-out campervan has been armour-plated. I really have thought of everything!
ru: Я не хочу выделяться, поэтому окраска - камуфляж.

quote: And, hence, the eight times more common incidence of synesthesia among poets, artists and novelists.
before: Instantly, you've found the links. Now, if you assume that this greater cross wiring and concepts are also in different parts of the brain, then it's going to create a greater propensity towards metaphorical thinking and creativity in people with synesthesia.
after: OK, it's a very phrenological view of synesthesia. The last demonstration — can I take one minute?
ru: И, следовательно, в 8 раз большая частота синестезии среди поэтов, художников и писателей.

quote: And hence, the enormous role that a marine protected area can play.
before: For example, the anecdote that some present, as Captain so-and-so observed lots of fish in this area cannot be used or is usually not utilized by fishery scientists, because it's not " scientific. " So you have a situation where people don't know the past, even though we live in literate societies, because they don't trust the sources of the past.
after: Because with marine protected areas, we actually recreate the past. We recreate the past that people cannot conceive because the baseline has shifted and is extremely low.
ru: Поэтому, огромна роль, которую может играть морской заповедник.

quote: It manifests in each individual differently, hence why Remi is so different from Sam.
before: But what lifted my heart and strengthened my soul was that even though this was the case, although they were not seen as ordinary, this could only mean one thing: that they were extraordinary — autistic and extraordinary. Now, for you who may be less familiar with the term " autism, " it's a complex brain disorder that affects social communication, learning and sometimes physical skills.
after: And across the world, every 20 minutes, one new person is diagnosed with autism, and although it's one of the fastest-growing developmental disorders in the world, there is no known cause or cure. And I cannot remember the first moment I encountered autism, but I cannot recall a day without it.
ru: В каждом человеке он проявляется по-разному, именно поэтому Реми так отличается от Сэма.

quote: This makes importing genome maps from other groups unfeasible, and hence justifies the study.
before: Among other results, the five year-long work found that, while sharing the 99.9% of the genome common to all humans, in the remaining portion the Mexican population has significant genetic variation from the world's other known genetic subgroups.

quote: He kidnapped a girl in Chicago, and we tracked him here.
before: - Am I? Susie, why do you think I'm here?
after: No. Nadia.
ru: Он похитил девушку в Чикаго, и мы отследили его здесь.

quote: Look, I need to be here as long as it takes.
before: I mean, not if you're still here. Not if Sammy's still here.
after: Okay, I do, too, then. That's the thing, you don't.
ru: (ЖЕН) Слушай, мне нужно быть здесь столько, сколько будет необходимо.

quote: So I wonder, do you really think you're here to question me?
before: The corners in the floors have been painted in such a way as to warp perspective, and this water-- it's clean, but a benign, bitter flavorant has been added to provoke paranoia. You're every bit as perceptive as they say.
after: Force of habit, interrogating murderers. You know what they say.
ru: Поэтому я удивляюсь Вы действительно думаете, что вы здесь, чтобы задавать мне вопросы?

quote: We're here to get the money back for the American people.
before: This is crazy what they're doing with our money. If I could get them to actually give the money back-- l'd be in favor of that.
after: I understand, sir, but you can't come in. - Can you just take the bag?
ru: Мы здесь, чтобы получить назад деньги для американского народа.

quote: It's an honor to be here. Thanks very much.
before: This piece, actually, will be on display down in the Sierra Simulcast Lounge in the breaks between now and the end of the show. So I'd love to talk to you all, and invite you to come down and take a closer look.
after: (Applause)
ru: Для меня честь быть здесь, большое спасибо.

quote: And I see that a few of them did make it here to the conference.
before: But I feel a bit like a fish out of water. But I am very proud of my students.
after: So you will get the extra credit I promised you. But, while I know that I may not look like the typical TED-izen, as you would say, I do like to make the point that we in global society, we are never as different as the appearances may suggest.
ru: И я вижу, что некоторые из них пришли сюда, на конференцию.

quote: The epidemic in the friends group has shifted to the left, over here.
before: Exactly what we predicted happened. So the random group is in the red line.
after: And the difference in the two is 16 days. By monitoring the friends group, we could get 16 days advance warning of an impending epidemic in this human population.
ru: А эпидемия в группе друзей изображена слева, вот здесь.

quote: But I didn't think much of them because we hear so many gunshots around here.
before: There were a lot of them," Teresa Webster told the Detroit News. "They woke me up.
after: There was a stabbing here about a month ago. And three days ago, I found a body in a car in the parking lot.

quote: I hereby tender my resignation as office dog.
before: Three inches? Stacey, have we sent Ryan the CNVN311 addendum yet?
after: Well, it'll be a pretty big blow to the company. Don't forget to schedule an exit interview with the snow globe.
ru: Настоящим, я снимаю с себя обязанности офисного пса.

quote: I hereby declare elections to be held on Tuesday 11 June.
before: I'm proud of that. So, now I'll leave it to the Danish people to tell us who's the best prime minister.
after: 'Midway on the journey of life, I suddenly found myself in a dark forest...' -Dante, "The Divine Comedy" (1308-1321 AD) TWO AND A HALF YEARS LATER The only thing we shouldn't do in this crisis, is to act like the two tourists who encounter a leopard.
ru: Настоящим я подаю заявление на участие в парламентских выборах во вторник, 11 июня.

quote: The sergeant of arms is hereby instructed to compel the attendance of absent senators.
before: - Nay! - The ayes have it, and the motion is agreed to.
after: It feels good to be back in Congress. The Democrats have now empowered the Capitol Police to arrest absent members if necessary.
ru: В настоящий момент офицеру конгресса поручается обеспечить принудительную явку отсутствующих сенаторов.

quote: It read in its entirety, "I hereby resign "the Office of President of the United States.
before: At 11:35 this morning, a letter was delivered to the Office of the Secretary of State in Washington. This is a replica of it.
after: Sincerely, Richard Nixon." There was more... Hey.
ru: "В нём написано: "Настоящим заявляю, что подаю в отставку с поста Президента США,

quote: "We hereby confirm we have lodged notice of appeal," McLaren's CEO Martin Whitmarsh, told the BBC.
That's what you get for being a hero.
before: It's gonna hurt like a son of a bitch, but you're gonna be okay. -Thanks. -I can't thank you enough.
after: -I need the car. -I know.
ru: Героям приходится нелегко.

quote: Either way, you come out the hero trying to save him.
before: - Okay. You put me in a terrible position when you showed up with that check, because, you see, I'd either be the bitch who needed a million dollars to save her brother or I'd be the bitch who a million dollars wasn't enough for.
after: But here's the thing... none of this matters without me, right? So it turns out I'm the hero.
ru: В любом случае, ты оказалась героиней, которая пыталась спасти его.

quote: So this is what our new national hero looks like?
before: Hello. Hello.
after: Well, let's fight first. It's nice that you're modest, - but we want a world champion.
ru: Значит так выглядит наш новый национальный герой.

quote: Or you can give me what I want, and be the hero.
before: A trail from here to California with you as the head of the Mike Sandoval clean-up committee. Your whole career, up in smoke.
after: I'll see what I can do. AUSA Valdes.
ru: Или ты можешь дать мне что я прошу, и стать героем.

quote: Now I know what you're thinking, but I'm no hero.
before: (Laughter) I swear. So, not exactly what I was hoping for, but off I went — up the stairs, down the hall, past the' real' firefighters, who were pretty much done putting out the fire at this point, into the master bedroom to get a pair of shoes.
after: (Laughter) I carried my payload back downstairs where I met my nemesis and the precious dog by the front door. We took our treasures outside to the homeowner, where, not surprisingly, his received much more attention than did mine.
ru: Я знаю, о чём вы сейчас думаете, но я не герой.

quote: Our hero, on the other hand, one landing at a bad angle and he's down.
before: The tendons would also be at risk of tearing. Tall buildings stay standing because they have steel frames and do not run and jump around in the jungle.
after: Assuming his bodily function is the same as any mammal's, his heart would need to pump a large amount of blood throughout his body to provide enough oxygen for him to move 5,400 pounds of body weight around. This would take tremendous energy, which he would need to provide by consuming 27 times 3,000 calories of food every day.
ru: Что же касается нашего героя, один неудачный прыжок — и ему конец.

quote: She has been my hero since day one.
before: TM: But a fully complex human being whose femininity wasn't for me to rein in, control or critique. It's her brilliance, the way she leads with compassion, and how she never loses sight of her empathy.
after: (Applause) KKM: Our relationship has always been about setting each other free. One of the first questions I asked him was what dreams he had left to accomplish, and how would I help him get there.
ru: Она была моим героем с самого первого дня.

quote: Following the near disaster, many people hailed Sullenberger as a hero.
after: Over the past year, he has been involved in writing a book, giving speeches, and appearing before Congress. During his testimony before Congress, he spoke about the importance of pilot safety.

quote: This could be a very high profile case.
before: Okay, you got primary. Just remember, a reporter is dead.
after: I want everything done by the book, okay? Yes sir.
ru: Это могло быть дело высокого профиля.

quote: Your pockets are empty and I'm still sitting high and dry!
before: Ha! You suckers!
after: Boo! Yeah, boo!
ru: Ваши карманы пусты, а я все еще сух и высоко сижу!

quote: Tensions between your nation and South Korea are at an all-time high.
before: Indeed, Dave. Camera three.
after: It's fair to say that you're on the brink of armed conflict. So, what I want to know is:
ru: Напряжённость в отношениях между вашей нацией и Южной Кореей во все времена была высокой.

quote: He was attacked and wounded, and is also suffering from high levels of contamination.
before: They are seeking medical treatment at a secure facility as tests have since confirmed they are suffering from high levels of contamination. Furthermore, acting on his own initiative and without the Minister's knowledge my colleague, and my good friend, Jonas Flack, overreached his security clearance and entered into the Quarantine Zone to pursue reports of vandalism and looting.
after: Hello, Jennifer. Who are you?
ru: На него напали и ранили. И он также страдает от высокого уровня заражения.

quote: And we have really high standards for consent in a lot of other areas.
before: Before anyone can distribute your private information, they should have to get your permission. This idea of affirmative consent comes from anti-rape activists who tell us that we need consent for every sexual act.
after: Think about having surgery. Your doctor has to make sure that you are meaningfully and knowingly consenting to that medical procedure.
ru: У нас имеются довольно высокие стандарты согласия во многих других областях.

quote: It was a “high stakes” test, and you passed with flying colors.
before: And indeed, when that precious beam of sunlight enters the hall, it bounces between the walls and strikes the Southeast corner, spot on. The vampires, sensing the intrusion, burst from their coffins and turn to dust in the light.
ru: Это был тест с «высокими ставками», и вы справились с ним блестяще.

quote: Our 27 percent obesity rate is high even for this country, and diabetes comes with it.
before: These land-use decisions created the hostile conditions that lead to problems like obesity, diabetes and asthma. Why would someone leave their home to go for a brisk walk in a toxic neighborhood?
after: One out of four South Bronx children has asthma. Our asthma hospitalization rate is seven times higher than the national average.
ru: Наш уровень заболеваемости ожирением, 27%, высок даже для этой страны, а с ним приходит и диабет.

quote: Mr Brown will probably have to face country-wide protests on high fuel prices.
after: The protesters from the Fuel Lobby give the government three days to meet them to discuss lowering the fuel tax, then they threat refinery demonstrations and motorway go-slows.

quote: Oh, I highly doubt we have to worry about appearing perfect.
before: - Hey. Studies show that you're judged to be more likeable if you begin by admitting your faults rather than waiting. We'd be better off making up things to admit to than appearing to be perfect.
after: Yeah. Was that Beth? Huh?
ru: О, я очень сомневаюсь, что мы должны беспокоиться о том что мы идеальны.

quote: That frog was filled to the gills with formaldehyde, a highly toxic poison.
before: Easiest money I ever... Son, by rights, I should be playing banjo at your funeral.
after: Here's your money, Dad. What?
ru: Это лягушка была заполнена по жабры формальдегидом, высокотоксичным ядом.

quote: You know, you come highly recommended from a friend, but Maybe he was wrong.
before: You seem Young. Well you're not exactly what I was expecting either.
after: Look, I gotta ask. Are you affiliated with a law enforcement agency?
ru: Ты знаешь, о тебе очень хорошо отзывался друг, но, возможно, он был не прав.

quote: Mr Sorsby, I know you to be a highly successful businessman.
before: Six years, until the work is complete. Six years shall ye sow the land and gather in its yield.
after: A chain of Drapers' stores. And two cotton mills in Bradford.
ru: Мистер Сорсби, я знаю вас как очень успешного бизнесмена.

quote: Our mushroom strains were in the highly active range.
before: Dr. Earl Kern, who's a smallpox expert of the U.S. Defense Department, states that any compounds that have a selectivity index of two or more are active. 10 or greater are considered to be very active.
after: There's a vetted press release that you can read — it's vetted by DOD — if you Google " Stamets " and " smallpox. " Or you can go to NPR.org and listen to a live interview.
ru: Наши штаммы грибов показали крайне высокий уровень активности.

quote: Well statistically, the majority of those who join extremist organizations are highly educated.
before: Is it just about grievances? Is it just about a lack of education?
after: Statistically, they are educated, on average, above the education levels of Western society. Anecdotally, we can demonstrate that if poverty was the only factor, well Bin Laden is from one of the richest families in Saudi Arabia.
ru: Ну, по статистике, большинство тех, кто вступает в экстремистские организации, очень хорошо образованы.

quote: But how speed feels, and whether we like it, is highly subjective.
before: Right? Miles per hour, gigabytes per second.
after: So we can document that the pace at which we are adopting new technologies is increasing. For example, it took 85 years from the introduction of the telephone to when the majority of Americans had phones at home.
ru: Но как ощущается скорость, нравится ли она нам, остаётся очень субъективным.

quote: If you haven't seen Carl Sagan's Pale Blue Dot, I highly recommend it—available on YouTube.
Sliding down this hill, there's a lot of things that could have ruptured the tank.
before: Two things make a car go boom-- ruptured gas tank and a spark. Rough terrain.
after: Yeah, and metal dragging over the rocks, could have caused a spark. If it was anywhere near the tank.
ru: Скатываясь с этого холма, много чего могло повредить бензобак.

quote: The other vehicle must have rammed him down that hill.
before: Is that why you think his death was suspicious? His car was stationary when it was hit.
after: And, plus, I think he was working on a story, maybe about Storne Gas. If he was, wouldn't he have mentioned that to you?
ru: Должно быть, другой автомобиль столкнул его вниз с этого холма.

quote: Climb that hill, first guy to do that.
before: It's a strange feeling. Step outside the Rover, first guy to be there.
after: 4 and a half billion years, nobody here. And now, me.
ru: Залез на холм, - первый покоривший его.

quote: But I will build a beacon on the hill.
before: Our men here shall disband. There are fields to work.
after: You will escape and light the fire. Lord, you know that escape will be near impossible.
ru: Но мы устроим на холме сигнальный маяк.

quote: And I watched young Elvis begin to psych herself up for the hill.
before: And I watched as the matriarch drank, and then she turned in that beautiful slow motion of elephants, looks like the arm in motion, and she began to make her way up the steep bank. The rest of the herd turned and began to follow.
after: She got visibly — ears came forward, she had a full go of it and halfway up, her legs gave way, and she fell backwards. She attempted it a second time, and again, halfway up, she fell backwards.
ru: А я наблюдал, как молодая Элвис начинает готовиться к подъёму на холм.

quote: Because this is not about the steep hill in front of her.
before: Finally, when your girl is, let's say, on her bike on the top of the steep hill that she insists she's too scared to go down, guide her to access her bravery. Ultimately, maybe that hill really is too steep, but she'll come to that conclusion through courage, not fear.
after: This is about the life ahead of her and that she has the tools to handle and assess all the dangers that we cannot protect her from, all the challenges that we won't be there to guide her through, everything that our girls here and around the world face in their future. So by the way, the world record for crawling today — (Laughter) is 35.18 miles, and I would really love to see a girl go break that.
ru: Потому что дело не в крутом холме, который находится перед ней.

quote: Very high-density living on the side of a hill.
before: And again, the rebuilding of the city — to me, it was sad to see that they didn't really grab a lot of, I guess, what we know here, in terms of urban planning. There were no parks; there were no green spaces.
after: And here they had a chance to rebuild cities from the bottom up, but somehow were not connecting with them. Here is a sign that, translated, says, " Obey the birth control law.
