after: "Participation in a hunger strike will not help the cause of the individuals concerned," the Minister said. "I have personally written to all six to advise them that I will not be considering any cases while protest activity continues."

quote: You missed all the fun, but I think there's some food if you're still hungry.
before: - Tom. - Raylan.
after: No, thanks. This is Winona.
ru: Ты пропустил все веселье, но я думаю там есть немного еды, если ты все ещё голоден.

quote: I was with UNICEF, hanging out foods for the hungry kids of Africa.
before: Characters they invented. What have you been doing all these years?
after: And you? Taking care of my son.
ru: Я сотрудничал с ЮНИСЕФ, добывал еду для голодающих детей Африки.

quote: Three hundred more are strolling around the hallways, hungry and bored, looking for some action.
before: Ready to pluck your feathers and rip off your balls? There are 20 women guarding the hostages.
after: What exactly... were you thinking you'd do? You think I'm here to rescue the hostages?
ru: Ещё три тысячи прохаживаются по коридорам, голодные и скучающие, жаждущие зрелища.

quote: Well uh, you don't sound fine. You sound agitated. Hungry.
before: It's been really good. You guys doing okay with no money or accommodations? We've been fine! God!
after: Miserable. Anyway the reason I'm here is that I caught wind that "Thunderhorse" is doing a health benefit. You realize tonight is your uh, Chefs from around the World
ru: Но звучит как то не уверенно, вы... взволнованны, голодны, депрессивны,

quote: Now I eat whenever I'm hungry, and I've lost 10 pounds.
before: Three and a half years ago, I made one of the best decisions of my life. As my New Year's resolution, I gave up dieting, stopped worrying about my weight, and learned to eat mindfully.
after: This was me at age 13, when I started my first diet. I look at that picture now, and I think, you did not need a diet, you needed a fashion consult.
ru: Сейчас я ем всякий раз, когда чувствую голод, и я похудела на 4,5 килограмма.

quote: And when you're hungry, food becomes more attractive, and so forth.
before: You throw everything else away. You become a monomaniac — all you care about is not stepping out on that platform.
after: So I see emotions as highly evolved subsets of your capability. Emotion is not something added to thought.
ru: В состоянии голода становится приоритетной еда, ну и так далее.

quote: Saving the lives of billions, eradicating disease, feeding the hungry, teaching kids to read?
before: Some intellectuals have responded with fury to my book " Enlightenment Now, " saying first how dare he claim that intellectuals hate progress, and second, how dare he claim that there has been progress. (Laughter) With others, the idea of progress just leaves them cold.
after: Boring. At the same time, the most common response I have received from readers is gratitude, gratitude for changing their view of the world from a numb and helpless fatalism to something more constructive, even heroic.
ru: Спасение жизней миллиардов людей, избавление от болезней, пропитание голодающим, обучение детей грамоте?

quote: You could tell the Rangers were hungry to score goals, due to having 5 days off.
after: A goal scored by Sean Avery just ten seconds into the game could tell you that. In fact, three more goals would be scored by the Rangers by the time the first period ended; Ryan Callahan at 4:29, Brandon Dubinsky at 9:05, and Brendan Shanahan at 12:25.

quote: She always said that was the best way to catch a husband in a lie.
before: Bruce Caplan and the Sheikh's deaths won't stick in court without hard evidence, and you made s'mores of all the financial records. Not before I carefully read each film with Cece's jewler's loupe.
after: I know she was referring to low-grade diamonds, but still... I'll send you everything I can remember.
ru: Она всегда говорила, что это лучший способ уличить мужа во лжи.

quote: He and my late husband were close friends.
before: - Yes. - Okay.
after: He recruited Natalie to work with him. Senator, when was the last time you heard from Natalie?
ru: Они с моим покойным мужем были друзьями.

quote: I need to be a better husband, a better father!
before: I feel like you hate me, Randy! I don't hate you! I love you!
after: We all need to be better to each other! OK, maybe I need to stop being so angry!
ru: И хочу быть хорошим мужем и отцом!

quote: I'm Alan, and this is my husband, Elliot.
before: Come in, angel. Bat Mitzvah-aged angel.
after: Please tell me those two are my foster parents, and these are my funny, gay uncles. (whispering) She has go to back!
ru: Я Алан, а это мой муж Эллиот.

quote: The people who sent hate mails are workers, husbands, wives, parents like you and me.
before: I always bring food because when we eat together, it is easier to find what we have in common and make peace together. Along the way, I have learned some valuable lessons.
after: I'm not saying that their behavior is acceptable, but I have learned to distance myself from the hateful views without distancing myself from the person who's expressing those views. And I have discovered that the people I visit are just as afraid of people they don't know as I was afraid of them before I started inviting myself for coffee.
ru: Люди, присылавшие мне письма с оскорблениями, были рабочими, мужьями, жёнами, родителями, как мы с вами.

quote: Then Indra disappeared. (Clap! Clap!) And the woman's husband, the Brahmin, appeared.
before: The woman paid him no heed. So, Indra, attracted, threw her onto the floor, and proceeded to rape her.
after: He realized at once what had happened. So, he petitioned the higher gods so that he may have justice.
ru: Потом Индра исчез. (Хлоп! Хлоп!) А появился муж женщины, Брахмин.

quote: I myself have a husband and a father and two sons whom I dearly love.
before: The 200,000-year period in which men have been top dog is truly coming to an end, believe it or not, and that's why I talk about the " end of men. " Now all you men out there, this is not the moment where you tune out or throw some tomatoes, because the point is that this is happening to all of us.
after: And this is why I like to talk about this, because if we don't acknowledge it, then the transition will be pretty painful. But if we do take account of it, then I think it will go much more smoothly.
ru: У меня у самой есть муж, отец, и двое сыновей, которых я очень люблю.

quote: She, in front of the police station, shouted talaq thrice to divorce her husband.
before: 25-year-old Muslim woman Amreen Begum had filed a police complaint in Meerut against her husband for domestic violence.
after: She said, "I have divorced him. If a man can divorce his wife that way, why can't a woman?

quote: Aha. Well, that would fit my hypothesis on you.
before: I, uh... I kind of have that effect on people.
after: Mm-hmm? Would you mind if I ask you some incredibly personal questions?
ru: Ага, это соответствует моей гипотезе о тебе.

quote: My hypothesis is that the killer used a knife with a unique engraving on the handle.
before: Actually, Commander, I really think you need to see this in person. Sorry to drag you back in here, but I noticed something disturbing while performing the autopsy.
after: When he rested it on the victim's skin, it left a latent blood impression. Looks like some sort of symbol.
ru: Моя гипотеза, что убийца использовал нож с уникальной гравировкой на рукоятке.

quote: My core hypothesis that monsters are fake will be vindicated.
before: And I'll prove it. I'll re-create the baron's supposed life-imbuing experiment from his own notes. When the ice is melted and the experiment fails, the hoax will be revealed.
after: I don't totally understand your goal. But, Velma, you yourself told us how many of your ancestors were driven crazy... by this monster obsession.
ru: Моя гипотеза, что монстры - фальшивка, будет доказана.

quote: Would you care to expand on that hypothesis?
before: People change, mate. Or maybe they don't, as Marquez posits.
after: Um, yes. Yeah. Watch me expand. The author, old Gabriella Garcia Marquezeria.
ru: Вам бы не хотелось развить эту гипотезу?

quote: So there's good evidence for the whole restoration hypothesis.
before: It's gone in and out of fashion. It's fashionable at the moment because what's been shown is that within the brain, a whole raft of genes have been shown to be turned on only during sleep, and those genes are associated with restoration and metabolic pathways.
after: What about energy conservation? Again, perhaps intuitive.
ru: и каналами метаболического обмена. Так что есть хорошие доказательства этой гипотезы.

quote: Let's see where this hypothesis is going to lead us.
before: In 2015, the LHC will almost double the energy of the colliding protons, and these more powerful collisions will allow us to explore further the particle world, and we will certainly learn much more. But for the moment, since we have found no evidence for new phenomena, let us suppose that the particles that we know today, including the Higgs boson, are the only elementary particles in nature, even at energies much larger than what we have explored so far.
after: We will find a surprising and intriguing result about our universe, and to explain my point, let me first tell you what the Higgs is about, and to do so, we have to go back to one tenth of a billionth of a second after the Big Bang. And according to the Higgs theory, at that instant, a dramatic event took place in the universe.
ru: Давайте посмотрим, куда приведёт нас эта гипотеза.

quote: We have, for the first time ever, support for the habitat hypothesis.
before: Anybody can do this. Urban areas have the most habitat, best habitat, as you can see here: over 200 different plants.
after: We also now know how we can work with cities. The City of Boston has eight times better habitat than its nearby suburbs.
ru: Мы впервые получили поддержку гипотезы среды обитания.

quote: What conditions did you test your hypothesis under?
Okay, Tasha, how about we get you a shaved ice, yes?
before: I know the whole periodic chart. I love science!
after: What flavor would you like? - But I was...
ru: Как насчёт того, чтобы мы принесли тебе замороженный лёд?

quote: As a child, it was my job to put ice in father's drink.
before: Peter, i know we've had our fair share of ups-and-downs since i started dating Lauren, but... I could be your beer-pong partner. [Laughs mockingly] I actually have amazing aim.
after: And if i got too close, he would SWAT at me. Okay, Oliver, these stories are getting so-- okay, you know, it's not about making it.
ru: Когда я был ребенком, моей задачей было бросать лед в напитки отца.

quote: Whatever the Ice Queen is giving you, my people will offer you more.
before: Lot of people out there right now looking for no one. You're obviously not loyal to the Ice Nation, so why are you taking me there?
after: Doubt that, not for someone who abandoned them. You don't know anything about me.
ru: Что-бы Ледяная Королева не предлагала тебе, мои люди дадут тебе больше.

quote: The title of the book will be "heat and ice."
before: Done. Vasily!
after: Ice is the code name for the new russian super spy Who is nikki heat's new nemesis. Enemy from the east.
ru: Название книги будет "Жара и Лед".

quote: Ice absorbs longer, redder wavelengths of light, and reflects shorter, bluer light.
before: So I'd like future telescopes to follow up on this planet to look for signs of life. Ice on a planet's surface is also important for climate.
after: That's why the iceberg in this photo looks so blue. The redder light from the sun is absorbed on its way through the ice.
ru: Лёд поглощает длинноволновой красный свет и отражает коротковолновой синий свет.

quote: We just had a number of cameras out on the Greenland Ice Sheet.
before: There is a custom made computer that tells the camera when to fire. And these cameras are positioned on rocks on the sides of the glaciers, and they look in on the glacier from permanent, bedrock positions, and they watch the evolution of the landscape.
after: We actually drilled holes into the ice, way deep down below the thawing level, and had some cameras out there for the past month and a half or so. Actually, there's still a camera out there right now.
ru: Только недавно мы установили несколько камер на ледовом щите Гренландии.

quote: That's the Ross Sea Ice Shelf on the right there.
before: This is a crazy thing, this big drill rig wrapped in a blanket to keep everybody warm, drilling at temperatures of minus 40. And we drilled in the Ross Sea.
after: So, this huge floating ice shelf the size of Alaska comes from West Antarctica. Now, West Antarctica is the part of the continent where the ice is grounded on sea floor as much as 2,000 meters deep.
ru: Здесь справа ледяной щит моря Росса.

quote: We were expecting to find ice within two to six inches of the surface.
before: "It's the consensus of all of us that we have found ice.
after: The thrusters have excavated two to six inches and, sure enough, we see something that looks like ice. It's not impossible that it's something else, but our leading interpretation is ice," said top Phoenix investigator at the University of Arizona in Tucson Peter Smith.

quote: And I had the idea that maybe the missing camper van was up in the forest.
before: For what reason? They knew each other...
after: That's where I was going yesterday. To look for it.
ru: И у меня возникла идея, что пропавший минивэн может быть где-то в лесу.

quote: Chloe, I don't think that's a good idea.
before: I'll run comm for you. I'll get you satellites, schematics.
after: Jack, I know you don't trust me. Adrian lied to me.
ru: Хлоя, не думаю, что это хорошая идея.

quote: So this idea that "fat is fate," that's nonsense, is it?
before: Brilliant. Text the details to my cell... mobile.
after: I am certain that the Deputy Prime Minister would like to move on now to the matters at hand. Oh, I...
ru: Значит, идея о том, что "жир - это судьба" - полная чушь, не так ли?

quote: The idea was that the teacher was going to counsel Mr. Maxwell.
before: A conversation ensued among the three of them. Now, if you care to rest, the president and the teacher appear to be meditating.
after: We brought him in at your request, Madam Secretary. What happened after that is not up to us.
ru: Идея была в том, чтобы учитель сходил к мистеру Максвеллу.

quote: That is a marvelously enticing idea, but it's kind of fraught.
before: I think there are a lot of reasons, but I first want to address the one that you're probably most likely to have heard of, because actually it's more dangerous than you might think. And that is the idea that a language channels your thoughts, that the vocabulary and the grammar of different languages gives everybody a different kind of acid trip, so to speak.
after: So it's not that it's untrue completely. So for example, in French and Spanish the word for table is, for some reason, marked as feminine.
ru: Это удивительно заманчивая идея, но она проблематична.

quote: And as innovative ideas go, this one is both easy and free.
before: All of our conferences could have, at their centerpiece, a debate over the biggest, most controversial ideas in the field. Each of our weekly team meetings could devote 10 minutes to a debate about a proposal to change the way in which that team works.
after: You could start tomorrow. (Laughter) And once we're inside this shared reality, debate also requires that we separate ideas from the identity of the person discussing them.
ru: Как и все новые идеи, эта идея проста и не требует денег.

quote: The idea I want to leave you with is it's all right to appeal to incentives.
before: But I don't know yet how this develops over a lifetime. That will be the subject of future research.
after: I'm an economist; I certainly believe in the fact that incentives work. But do think about selecting the right people rather than having people and then putting incentives in place.
ru: Но сегодня я хотел бы донести до вас одну мысль: вознаграждение как средство мотивации — это нормально.

quote: See, the idea is: each according to their choice.
before: Yeah, it is okay.
after: The people who have chosen [to work here] have gotten. I personally don't believe in this too much of gender-bias.

quote: She would make the ideal bait, wouldn't she?
before: Hobbs spent a lot of time here. Spent a lot of time with his daughter here.
after: Hobbs killed alone. Ah.
ru: Она бы идеальный приманку, бы не так ли?

quote: I'll have all this looking like the ideal home by then.
before: Banged it on the handle of the wardrobe. According to your notes, you're down for a home delivery, Molly.
after: Oh, hello, lovely! This is my little Lorraine.
ru: К тому времени в квартире будет идеальный порядок.

quote: It's the ideal opportunity to learn alongside him.
before: You've got lots of experience. You'll be running the store one day, won't you?
after: Gosh, if it was me - It doesn't matter!
ru: Это же идеальная возможность узнать всё изнутри.

quote: I admit it's not ideal, but these guys have terrorist street cred and Peruvian drug money.
before: We weren't, but some of our old friends from the shining path were. So we're in business with murderers.
after: How much? Enough to get in on the bidding.
ru: Признаю, это не идеальный вариант, но у этих парней опыт терроризма и наркоденьги из Перу.

quote: Now, what are the ideal conditions for chemistry?
before: So, chemistry is dominated by the electromagnetic force. That operates over smaller scales than gravity, which explains why you and I are smaller than stars or planets.
after: What are the Goldilocks conditions? Well, first, you need energy, but not too much.
ru: Теперь, каковы идеальные условия для химии?

quote: So those two are ideal and complementary areas from which flow is easy to go into.
before: It's not very challenging any more. And if you want to enter flow from control, you have to increase the challenges.
after: The other combinations of challenge and skill become progressively less optimal. Relaxation is fine — you still feel OK.
ru: Таким образом, эти две зоны являются тесно связанными с зоной потока и идеальны для того, чтобы легко «войти в поток».

quote: As a result, networks are ideal representations of complex systems.
before: And all of this also means that you can forget about the individual parts of the system, how complex they are. So if it's a cell or a termite or a bird, you just focus on the rules of interaction.
after: The nodes in the network are the system's components, and the links are given by the interactions. So what equations are for physics, complex networks are for the study of complex systems.
ru: В результате идеальной моделью сложных систем являются сети.

quote: The Ideal Explosives industries sustained an explosion at about 6:30 p.m. local time.
after: The Rajasthan Explosives Private Limited next door soon followed.

quote: That's where Brent got his stories and his identity.
before: So not only did Brent Dundas and Brian Young know each other. It's reasonable to believe they were friends.
after: All right, well, our friend the bartender here said we ought to talk to one of his waitresses, Star. Apparently, she had a lot of face time with the victim.
ru: Вот, откуда Брент взял его байки и его личность.

quote: Until that happens, I'm putting a gag order on Buddy's true identity.
before: If we find that gold, I'm pretty sure the killer won't be far behind. And if we're able to crack this case, we'll get to rub it in the face of every agency in the Western hemisphere.
after: Less people know about this, less of a circus it becomes around here. I'm working with the penitentiary to try to get a video call set up with Clarkson.
ru: Ну, а до тех пор, СМИ не должны знать о подлинной личности Бадди.

quote: The thing my whole identity is organized around.
before: And why do I return to it over and over? It's my cornerstone, isn't it?
after: Yes, Bernard. We gave all of the hosts a backstory.
ru: Дело вся моя личность организована вокруг.

quote: For years I was afraid of real change, of revealing my true identity through pro-alien action.
before: You really turned this place around. I can't take the credit.
after: Your daughters helped me with it. They demanded we all be better.
ru: Многие годы я боялся перемен, боялся, что через про-инопланетные действия проявится моя настоящая личность.

quote: Enrollment in a school means recognition of her identity and her name.
before: Yes, I must mention it. It may be taken for granted in Canada, in America, in many developed countries, but in poor countries, in patriarchal societies, in tribal societies, it's a big event for the life of girl.
after: Admission in a school means that she has entered the world of dreams and aspirations where she can explore her potentials for her future life. I have five sisters, and none of them could go to school, and you will be astonished, two weeks before, when I was filling out the Canadian visa form, and I was filling out the family part of the form, I could not recall the surnames of some of my sisters.
ru: Допуск в школу означает признание её как личности.

quote: But above all, it's the guide by which each of us builds our identity, our personality.
before: But we can all avoid being recruited using the resources we have — our principles, unity, faith. Yes, fear is part of the human condition, as well as being necessary for survival.
after: It's true, I was 41 years old the first time I felt fear, and feeling fear was not my decision. But it was my decision what to do with that fear.
ru: Но прежде всего это чувство, вокруг которого мы выстраиваем свою личность, свою индивидуальность.

quote: Don't you feel one step closer already, like it's already becoming part of your identity?
before: Imagine their congratulations, and their high image of you. Doesn't it feel good to say it out loud?
after: Well, bad news: you should have kept your mouth shut, because that good feeling now will make you less likely to do it. The repeated psychology tests have proven that telling someone your goal makes it less likely to happen.
ru: Разве вы не чувствуете, как сделали ещё один шаг — как будто ваши будущие достижения уже становится частью вашей личности?

quote: The identities of the dead are currently not known.
I mean, any idiot could see that you need to be supervised, am I right?
before: - I don't need to be supervised. - Clearly you do.
after: - Are you saying I'm "any idiot"? - What is your involvement?
ru: Любой идиот видит, что за тобой нужно присматривать.

quote: That I'd be an idiot to believe anything she says.
before: She pulled me into her car, asked me to help take you down. What did you tell her?
after: She's persistent. Got to give her that.
ru: Что я буду идиотом, если поверю её словам.

quote: No, I think they're idiots because you hired them instead of me.
before: - Because harm is necessary for racism to be... harmful. But you think they're idiots because they're big white guys?
after: Can I see your laptop? Why?
ru: Нет, я считаю их идиотами, потому что вы наняли их, а не меня.

quote: Our idiot brother committed a felony buying houses.
before: - That's fraud. - I know, I know.
after: B-but... Patrick doesn't even know anything about real estate. Why would he...
ru: Наш брат-идиот совершил преступление, покупая дома.

quote: Have you ever stared at your phone smiling like an idiot while texting with someone?
before: Have you ever misplaced your TED badge and then immediately started imagining what a three-day Vancouver vacation might look like? Have you ever marveled at how someone you thought was so ordinary could suddenly become so beautiful?
after: Have you ever subsequently texted that person the phrase " I'm staring at the phone smiling like an idiot "? Have you ever been tempted to, and then gave in to the temptation, of looking through someone else's phone?
ru: Вы когда-нибудь пялились на свой телефон, улыбаясь как идиот во время переписки?

quote: Are you thinking that maybe I'm an idiot in diamond shoes?
before: I play and I play until I begin to wonder why we ever stop playing in the first place. You can do it too, say yes every time your child asks you to play.
after: You're right, but you can still do this. You have time.
ru: Может, вы думаете, что я идиотка в дорогущих туфлях?

quote: I thought that only idiots were happy, to be honest.
before: (Laughter) But I want to talk a little bit about happiness, and the relationship to this whole vagina journey, because it has been an extraordinary journey that began eight years ago. I think before I did the " Vagina Monologues, " I didn't really believe in happiness.
after: I remember when I started practicing Buddhism 14 years ago, and I was told that the end of this practice was to be happy, I said, " How could you be happy and live in this world of suffering and live in this world of pain? " I mistook happiness for a lot of other things, like numbness or decadence or selfishness.
ru: Если честно, то я думала, что счастливы только идиоты.

quote: And someone tried to make idiots of them.
before: But later something turned me on. I thought there was a group of idealistic people who want to make humanity happier with their meticulous work.

quote: As my grandfather used to say, ignorance is the devil's whoopee cushion.
before: Well, we don't really know why. Please, no apologies.
after: You know what? I bet my grandfather gave your grandfather wedgies in high school. Whoa!
ru: Как любил говорить мой дед, невежество - ещё один повод для веселья дьявола.

quote: Because it is clear that ignorance is no match for a curious mind.
before: I don't understand why people fear an educated woman. Well, maybe I do.
after: And hatred and oppression are no match for the human heart. Compassion and love will guide us, and freedom will be our reward.
ru: Потому что,это означает что невежество не сравнится с пытливым умом.

quote: You serve a cruel lord who seeks only ignorance and His own glory.
before: Do you know how many my Power is responsible for? 10, and most of those ordered by your God.
after: Satan is the one who brings death and ignorance and darkness. He... he turns away from the light, the love.
ru: Ты служишь жестокому хозяину, которому нужно только невежество и Его собственное величие.

quote: Couldn't? Is that professional. Discretion or just pure ignorance?
before: Then, where is she? I couldn't say.
after: Discretion, frau bauer. Generally... Discretion is for strangers or unwelcomed guests.
ru: Это профессиональная осмотрительность или всего лишь чистое невежество?

quote: Now, this ignorance, however, is not very helpful on the level of the social.
before: They'd rather prefer denying the illness, which is why it's not so wise to inform them if they don't ask. Surprisingly, research shows that sometimes people who deny their illness live longer than those who are rationally choosing the best treatment.
after: When we are ignorant about where we are heading, a lot of social damage can be caused. Now, on top of facing ignorance, we are also facing today some kind of an obviousness.
ru: Это незнание всё же не так услужливо на социальном уровне.

quote: We as Africans often respond to mental health with distance, ignorance, guilt, fear and anger.
before: In all of Africa, 90 percent of our people lack access to treatment. As a result, we suffer in solitude, silenced by stigma.
after: In a study conducted by Arboleda-Flórez, directly asking, " What is the cause of mental illness? " 34 percent of Nigerian respondents cited drug misuse; 19 percent said divine wrath and the will of God — (Laughter) 12 percent, witchcraft and spiritual possession.
ru: Мы, африканцы, часто относимся к психическому здоровью с отчуждением, невежеством, чувством вины, опаской и гневом.

quote: But medical ignorance of the female body continues.
before: They have the birth control pill, they have sexting and Tinder and vajazzling. " (Laughter) Things must be better now.
after: How many of you recognize this? It's the full structure of the clitoris.
ru: Но медицинское невежество в отношении женского тела существует до сих пор.

quote: I’m reminded of that wonderful teachers’ union bumper sticker: ‘if you think education’s expensive, try ignorance’.
before: Whatever the true figure, it is undeniably expensive; but it gives our musicians a chance to be on national radio. We figure it’s worth it.
after: If you think creating the world’s first radio station playing 100% new music is expensive …. try being inaudible.

quote: Remember the love and patience I showed when you were ill.
before: You mustn't say that. I have some kind of illness.
after: - That's what I need from you now. You have it always. Oh, please don't go.
ru: Вспомни, как терпелив и добр я был к тебе, когда ты была больна.

quote: You know, back in Wales, where I'm from, there was a boy who was ill.
before: What is there then? You mean exorcism?
after: The parish decided upon the rite of exorcism. They did not seek approval from Rome.
ru: Знаете, в Уэльсе, откуда я родом, был больной мальчик.

quote: He said that his wife was ill and he needed to tend her.
before: How long did the accused stay with you after you entered the house? About five minutes.
after: When did you see him again? - So there was nothing to prevent him leaving the house as soon as you were settled and returning to the beach to attack the exciseman?
ru: Он сказал, что его жена больна, и ему нужно ухаживать за ней.

quote: Once we knew you were ill, I was tasked to you by Director Fury.
before: -Hi. -I'm a S.H.I.E.L.D. shadow.
after: I suggest you apologise. You've been very busy.
ru: Как только мы узнали, что вы больны, меня к вам направил Директор Фьюри.

quote: We don't know the needs of the elderly, the mentally ill.
before: We don't know — and this is really amazing to me — we don't know how many children were born — or how many children there are — in Bolivia or Botswana or Bhutan. We don't know how many kids died last week in any of those countries.
after: For all of these different critically important problems or critically important areas that we want to solve problems in, we basically know nothing at all. And part of the reason why we don't know anything at all is that the information technology systems that we use in global health to find the data to solve these problems is what you see here.
ru: Мы не знаем ничего о нуждах пожилых или психически больных людей.

quote: Sophie pretends to be ill so she doesn't have to go to school.
before: They call her names. Somebody's mum has heard that Sophie's dad is in prison.
after: And her teacher can't understand why she's so far behind with her schoolwork. After what seems a long, long time to Sophie, a letter arrives.
ru: Софи притворялась больной, чтобы не идти в школу.

quote: The other pictures are of my very ill grandmother.
before: Matty shared with me an emotional email he received from the mother in that picture. " That's me, my husband and son.
after: Thank you for making your site. These pictures mean more to me than you know.
ru: На других снимках — моя больная бабушка.

quote: The terminally ill man will begin that appeal next year.
before: Today, Megrahi's legal campaign for freedom continues. The Scottish Criminal Cases Review Commission granted him a second appeal, saying there may have been a miscarriage of justice.
after: Wikinews wrote to Mr Megrahi in prison but he did not respond.

quote: This was a huge win for the federal prosecutor in our ongoing war against illegal weapons.
before: And your client is a gun runner, a killer, and a liar. I don't know if he has any imagination whatsoever.
after: I'm flying back to Washington to brief the president on what an excellent job the U.S. Marshals Service did here today. Uh, give me a second?
ru: Это огромная победа для федерального обвинителя в нашей не прекращающейся борьбе против незаконной торговли оружием.

quote: This party is so decadent and in the private rooms, frankly, illegal.
before: You're just in time to hear K.C. tell me how I've destroyed my bad boy business plan once and for all. I warned you, but it turns out I was wrong.
after: The big romantic gesture showed the hedonist has a heart. So Blair's the perfect balance?
ru: Эта вечеринка является настолько декадентской и в отдельных комнатах, откровенно говоря, незаконной.

quote: And I will perform a surprise and illegal wire walk.
before: I intend to rig my wire in secret on the most spectacular stage in the world. And then, without warning, I will appear.
after: If it works, it will be the artistic coup of the century. Wow.
ru: Это будет сюрприз и незаконный проход по канату.

quote: I told you that's illegal, and I cannot go to jail right now.
before: You've been here for three days. Well, it would've been a lot less time if someone had stopped me from creating a fake Instagram account.
after: I am one stamp away on my frozen yogurt punch card from scoring a freebie, so... (groans) What could she possibly see in Josh Chan? I-I have literally no idea what he has to offer to someone like this.
ru: Я говорила, что это незаконно, а я не могу сейчас сесть в тюрьму.

quote: And so, coast guards could use that and go and find those illegal fishing vessels.
before: But we frequently find ships that are not doing that. The pictures don't lie.
after: And soon we'll add not just ships and planes but all the other objects, and we can output data feeds of those locations of all these objects over time that can be integrated digitally from people's work flows. In time, we could get more sophisticated browsers that people pull in from different sources.
ru: Береговая охрана может использовать их и находить незаконные рыболовные суда.

quote: Those urban voids quickly became illegal parking or trash yards.
before: Unfortunately, because of the pollution of the river, it has been covered little by little by concrete slabs since 1952. This process of erasure was coupled with the destruction of many houses along the river banks to be able to make machineries enter the narrow pedestrian network of the medina.
after: Actually, the state of the river before entering the medina is pretty healthy. Then pollution takes its toll, mainly due to untreated sewage and chemical dumping from crafts such as tanning.
ru: Эти расчищенные пространства быстро стали местом незаконных парковок и мусорных свалок.

quote: Some of them were illegal whale meat, by the way.
before: In fact, what we did a few years ago was learn how to smuggle a molecular biology lab into Tokyo and use it to genetically test the DNA out of whale meat samples and identify what they really were. And some of those whale meat samples were whale meat.
after: That's another story. But some of them were not whale meat at all.
ru: Некоторые - незаконно добытым китовым мясом, кстати.

quote: China's mines, many of them illegal, are considered the world's most dangerous.
after: More than 6,000 miners died in accidents in China last year, according to previously released government figures. Other independent estimates put the real figure at around 20,000.

quote: Is Mary's illness the reason you made me?
before: I see you. Your face, your body, your clothes.
after: Yes. If you're alive, she has a second chance.
ru: Является болезнь Мэри причиной, из за которой вы сделали меня?

quote: I always tell my patients they should come once a year, because illnesses can arise.
before: If you talk, your eye moves and I can't see. Hold on a second.
after: And your test says that you've developed glaucoma. I'm going to go blind?
ru: Я всегда говорю своим пациентам, что они должны обследоваться раз в год. Потому что могут возникнуть разные болезни.

quote: Brightborn has identified genes that eliminate dozens of childhood illnesses.
before: You're allowing emotions to cloud your judgment. Think like a scientist.
after: These are human beings that you're tinkering with. Trial and error without consent.
ru: В Брайтборн идентифицировали гены, уничтожающие множество младенческих болезней.

quote: There is no illness like this in Lima, is there, doctor?
before: And her mother transmitted her fear through her breast milk. The "milk of sorrow", as we call anyone born that way, without a soul... because it hid underground out of fear.
after: Did you know your niece had a potato in her vagina? No, I didn't know about that.
ru: Болезни типа этой не существуют здесь, доктор.

quote: Everyone recognized that she was struggling heroically with a biological illness.
before: Every time she went to the doctor, they measured specific molecules that gave them information about how she was doing and what to do next. New medical options became available every few years.
after: This spring, she received an innovative new medical treatment in a clinical trial. It dramatically knocked back her cancer.
ru: Все признают, что она героически сражалась со своей болезнью.

quote: The true illness in our society today is our unwillingness to confront failure.
before: But, see, it's not working, because the self-help industry today has a higher recidivism rate because it's more focused on teaching you how to accept being a failure and lower your acceptance level than it is about pushing you to be perfect. See, these doctors, therapists and self-help gurus are all focused on a symptom and not the illness.
after: See, we're more comfortable resting on our efforts than we are with focusing on our results. Like at Dublin Jerome High School in Ohio, where they name 30 percent of a graduating class valedictorian.
ru: Истинная же болезнь общества заключается в нашем нежелании противостоять неудачам.

quote: I had that condition, to a certain extent, from my own childhood illness.
before: It is there within every human being. But the conditions for compassion to be activated, to be aroused, are particular conditions.
after: Eve Ensler, whom you'll hear later, has had that condition activated amazingly in her through the various waters of suffering that she has been through. And what is fascinating is that compassion has enemies, and those enemies are things like pity, moral outrage, fear.
ru: Я столкнулась с этими услвиями, в известной степени, благодаря моей детской болезни.

quote: Both groups were found to show equal progress in healing off the illness.
before: The group examined 2,037 children between 3 to 59 months in seven areas in Pakistan. About half of them were given antibiotics and sent home while the other ones got intravenous antibiotics in the hospital.

quote: It helped that our murderer showed a distinct lack of imagination in her modus operandi.
before: Good teamwork, Hugh. How on earth did you manage that?
after: Thank you. It was galling, wasn't it, Eva?
ru: Помогло то, что наша убийца показала явный недостаток воображения в своём методе убийства.

quote: Mr. Castle, you really do have an overactive imagination.
before: Now, that must have been a bitter pill to swallow, knowing that Lars used all of your hard-earned research to find something you never could. And now he was gonna get all the fame and fortune that you never would.
after: You could no more prove that story you just spun than you could prove that genies come out of lamps and grant three wishes. Actually, that's not true.
ru: Мистер Касл, у вас и правда буйное воображение.

quote: I had a -- very vivid imagination, I used to make things up.
before: That's what she said... to most of my complaints. She used to call me "the fabricator".
after: Once, I told her that I saw my sister kissing the, uh, gardener behind the house. She went ballistic.
ru: У меня было очень живое воображение. Я часто выдумывала что-нибудь.

quote: And he is not a figment of my imagination.
before: I missed her so much that my subconscious took every opportunity to bring her back. Charlie, or whatever he chooses to call himself, is not a dream.
after: I know how compelling seeing this man must be. I lost him once, Will.
ru: И не домысел моего воображения.

quote: Then there's the thing of mystery in terms of imagination -- the withholding of information.
before: (Laughter) It's huge! Anyway — So there's this thing with mystery boxes that I started feeling compelled.
after: You know, doing that intentionally is much more engaging. Whether it's like the shark in " Jaws " — if Spielberg's mechanical shark, Bruce, had worked, it would not be remotely as scary; you would have seen it too much.
ru: Это понимание загадки в плоскости воображения - сдерживание информации.

quote: But for my generation of people, software is the interface to our imagination and our world.
before: In the seventies, it was punk music that drove the whole generation. In the eighties, it was probably money.
after: And that means that we need a radically, radically more diverse set of people to build those products, to not see computers as mechanical and lonely and boring and magic, to see them as things that they can tinker and turn around and twist, and so forth. My personal journey into the world of programming and technology started at the tender age of 14.
ru: Но для моего поколения программное обеспечение — интерфейс для нашего воображения и нашего мира.

quote: But well before my imagination was my vocation, my imagination saved my life.
before: My name is Jarrett Krosoczka, and I write and illustrate books for children for a living. So I use my imagination as my full-time job.
after: When I was a kid, I loved to draw, and the most talented artist I knew was my mother, but my mother was addicted to heroin. And when your parent is a drug addict, it's kind of like Charlie Brown trying to kick the football, because as much as you want to love on that person, as much as you want to receive love from that person, every time you open your heart, you end up on your back.
ru: Но задолго до того, как оно стало моим призванием, воображение спасло мне жизнь.

quote: "The whole thing is something that captures your imagination," he told reporters.
after: "This is our first glimpse into the earliest history of the Earth. The miraculous thing about the crystal is that we've been able to make such wide-ranging inferences about the early Earth."

quote: It's a bridge card that links to the immediate future.
before: The rest you know. The rest is the present.
after: The wheel of fortune. Upside down.
ru: Эта карта - связующее звено, которое ведет к ближайшему будущему.

quote: All those in favour of an immediate withdrawal of labour raise your hand.
before: OK. OK, let's go straight to the vote.
after: Oh, I see. I suppose you all think the sun shines out of Lipwig's backside.
ru: Те, кто за начало немедленной забастовки, поднимите руку.

quote: I do have an immediate favor to ask of you.
before: Yeah. Good.
after: - And that is? - Help me capture the Iron Fist, and you and your sister will be safe.
ru: И я хочу попросить тебя о немедленной услуге.

quote: Look, I'm requesting an immediate stand down and transfer back to DC.
before: She handed me orders last night to come here to a warehouse in South Dakota. The order code was solid, and Lattimer's here too.
after: Myka. Myka, I can't do that, okay? This order trumps me.
ru: Послушайте, я прошу немедленно это остановить и вернуть меня обратно.

quote: Confessing brings an immediate reward to the suspect, right?
before: LM: " No matter what you did, we can work through that. " Hints of leniency like you just saw with Brendan are especially powerful among adolescents, in part because they evaluate reward and risk differently than adults do.
after: Now the stressful, unpleasant interrogation is over. So confessing may seem like the best option to most teens, who are less focused on that long-term risk of conviction and punishment down the road as a result of that confession.
ru: Признание даёт немедленное вознаграждение для подозреваемого, да?

quote: Kenya's creative industry is dynamic, cosmopolitan, forward-looking, and without a doubt, a true manufacturing industry of the immediate future.
before: For these ideas to come to life, jobs will be created, and Kenyan ideas will be exported. But more importantly, Kenyans may finally consider themselves worthy of the love that we reserve for others.
after: But its true power lies in its ability to help heal the psyche of Kenya, so we can finally build a nation for real. Thank you.
ru: Творческая индустрия Кении динамична, многонациональна, дальновидна и, несомненно, является настоящей производственной отраслью ближайшего будущего.

quote: Immediate dismissal to bus drivers in New York, if seen with a mobile phone in a hand.
before: But there are many institutions that are actually blocking this access. And every day, every single day, I read news that makes me cringe, like a $15 fine to kids in Texas, for using, every time they take out their mobile phone in school.
after: Companies blocking access to IM or to Facebook. Behind issues of security and safety, which have always been the arguments for social control, in fact what is going on is that these institutions are trying to decide who, in fact, has a right to self determine their attention, to decide, whether they should, or not, be isolated.
ru: Или о немедленном увольнении водителя автобуса в Нью-Йорке, если он замечен с мобильным телефоном в руке.

quote: He was 82, but doctors still say that his death was "unexpected and immediate."
before: Merv Griffin, creator of game shows such as Wheel of Fortune and Jeopardy!, died of prostate cancer on Sunday.

quote: Sir, count dooku commands you to contact him immediately.
before: Say? Um, we think they might have gone to the...
after: Inform count dooku that I am unreachable. Send all units to the airfield.
ru: Сэр, граф Дуку приказывает вам немедленно с ним связаться.

quote: I need you to take me to your commanding officer immediately.
before: There's no need to fire, boys. I'm unarmed.
after: There's an extremely powerful sentient computer that intends to destroy the planet. That's the bad news.
ru: Мне нужно, чтобы вы отвели меня к своему командиру немедленно.

quote: All customers and employees must exit the building immediately.
before: Hello? Hello?
after: Do not stop to retrieve personal belongings. [Electricity thuds]
ru: [Сообщение в записи]: Все клиенты и сотрудники должны немедленно покинуть здание.

quote: Setting up for our press conference, which will take place immediately after yours.
before: What--Ron? What are you doing here?
after: Are you crazy? You can't do that.
ru: Готовимся к нашей пресс-конференции, которая будет происходить сразу же после твоей.

quote: As soon as I can't find anybody else to air out, I leave the scene immediately.
before: It will cost you 20 billion dollars. " (Laughter) But here's the deal.
after: That's called the Powell Doctrine. Way downstream we have the International Criminal Court.
ru: Как только не на ком будет выпустить пар, я уйду со сцены немедленно.

quote: And then our team will immediately spring into action.
before: This actually used to be a cornfield nine months ago, and with the Rwandan government, we leveled it and built this center in a couple weeks. So when a patient is having an emergency, a doctor or a nurse at that hospital can send us a WhatsApp, telling us what they need.
after: We pull the blood from our stock, which is delivered from the National Center for Blood Transfusion; we scan the blood into our system so the Ministry of Health knows where the blood is going; and then we'll basically pack it into a Zip, which is what we call these little autonomous airplanes that run on batteries. And then once that Zip is ready to go, we accelerate it from zero to 100 kilometers an hour in about half of a second.
ru: Наша команда немедленно принимается за дело.

quote: It snows so heavily there, the installation was almost immediately buried.
before: WAIS Divide itself though, is a circle of tents in the snow. In blizzard winds, the crew sling ropes between the tents so that people can feel their way safely to the nearest ice house and to the nearest outhouse.
after: Indeed, the researchers picked this site because ice and snow accumulates here 10 times faster than anywhere else in Antarctica. They have to dig themselves out every day.
ru: Там такой сильный снегопад, что сооружения почти немедленно заметает.

quote: Immediately after the murder, concern was raised that budget cuts may have played a factor.
after: Colin Moses, chairman of the Prison Officers' Association, was quoted as saying "...staff there [Grendon] are concerned about the kind of people who are now being put into Grendon. They are taking a much more unsuitable kind of prisoner."

quote: Przybylo supposedly threatened to have the plaintiff's mother, a Polish immigrant, deported if he resisted.
before: Przybylo and the rectory of Five Holy Martyrs, and continued for more than a year. Rev.

quote: Mandy would've understood the impact of air quality on someone with respiratory illness.
before: So I spoke with admissions at the hospital, and they said that numbers for severe asthma patients are up for that neighborhood. Well, as a weather girl and someone with asthma,
after: The note said, "If any of this gets out, I'll kill you." What if Mandy found out what or who was responsible for the styrene in the air?
ru: Мэнди могла понять влияние качества воздуха на человека с дыхательным заболеванием.

quote: We would react to these incursions and minimize their impact.
before: The only way to prevent these abuses was to put in place a safety net that was built around an idea. A common desire to protect history.
after: One man made the sacrifice to journey back 1000 years to establish an order. A temple of a sort.
ru: Мы бы реагировали на вторжения и минимизировали бы воздействие.

quote: On impact, the atmospheric adaptation must have tried to compensate.
before: We're at the bottom of the ocean, in case you missed that bit. These pods are built to be compatible with all S.H.I.E.L.D. aircraft, submarines, spacecraft.
after: We slowly sank as it increased the density of the outer walls. I measured the rate the water rose on the glass.
ru: Что до влияния, атмосферная адаптация должны была компенсировать это.

quote: The wholesale extinctions, the impact on the environment.
before: Granted. Let's forget about the animals for a moment...
after: Let's just consider the human toll... The thorough corruption of local authorities, political assassinations, the massacres of entire villages and wildlife compounds...
ru: Масштабное вымирание, воздействие на окружающую среду.

quote: And the impact of increased mobility is only part of the potential here.
before: Transportation services like this are the fundamental driver of logistics, trade, social services, access to education, health care and employment. The transportation grid to physical economies is akin to the internet to virtual economies.
after: Since the late 1700s, the Industrial Revolution has catapulted the development of economies around the world into thriving societies. Today, manufacturing is still the engine of economic growth and stability, even as new technologies have inevitably transformed the way we live.
ru: И влияние увеличенной мобильности — это только часть потенциала.

quote: We found absolutely no correlation, no impact whatsoever, between these two variables.
before: [Does] a man's opinion of the role of religion in politics shape their view of women's rights? The answer is no.
after: What drives men's support for women's employment is men's employment, their level of education as well as a high score on their country's U.N. Human Development Index. What this means is that human development, not secularization, is what's key to women's empowerment in the transforming Middle East.
ru: Мы абсолютно не нашли ни связи, ни какого-либо воздействия между этими двумя факторами.

quote: So very small changes can have a big impact.
before: Difference human / Neanderthal is sperm and testis, smell and skin. And those are the specific genes that differ from one to the other.
after: And as you're thinking about this, we're continuing to mutate. So about 10,000 years ago by the Black Sea, we had one mutation in one gene which led to blue eyes.
ru: Итак, очень маленькие изменения могут иметь большое влияние.

quote: And that is before considering the impact of streaming on growing bandwidth and energy requirements.
before: There are many occasions when a download is preferable to a stream, and MusicDNA files have the advantage of customised, at your fingertips, rich media available on- and offline.

quote: Since its implementation, returns here at Martin/Charles have been up over 30%.
before: Or it could be where this whole thing started. Our new high-frequency program employs computerized algorithms that operate at a speed unmatched by traditional trading methods.
after: Now, as you can see, our one-, three- and five-year growth projections in HFT are quite impressive. What about the ten-year projection?
ru: С начала ее внедрения доходы "Мартин/Чарльз" увеличились более, чем на 30%.

quote: Method of implementation, fire and acid, acid and fire.
before: We will raze to the ground and sterilise an area of forest some 50 miles radius. Objective, the creation of a cordon sanitaire around the dome.
after: This is insane. There is no danger.
ru: Способ выполнения: огонь и кислота. Кислота и огонь.

quote: Program Sisko-1-9-7 ready for implementation on your command.
before: Computer, what's the status of program Sisko-1-9-7? All necessary modifications have been completed.
after: Ops to Captain Sisko. Sir, we're receiving a message from the Cardassian border.
ru: Программа Сиско-1-9-7 готова к выполнению по вашей команде.

quote: Bilderberg issues executive decisions and prime directives to its sub-directorates for implementation.
before: What the Trilateral Commission intends, is to create a worldwide economic power superior to the political governments of the nation-states involved. As managers and creators of the system, they will rule the future.
after: The Trilateral Commission takes the Bilderberg Group agenda and executes it through regional roundtable groups throughout Europe, Asia and the Americas. The Council on Foreign Relations serves as the managing roundtable group in the United States sector.
ru: Билдерберг издает приказы и основные инструкции его суб-директорату для выполнения.

quote: So seven years later, we've developed so that we've got advocacy, instigation and implementation.
before: The fact that nobody told us we couldn't do it, we did it. And so there's something to be said about naïveté.
after: We advocate for good design, not only through student workshops and lectures and public forums, op-eds; we have a book on humanitarian work; but also disaster mitigation and dealing with public policy. We can talk about FEMA, but that's another talk.
ru: За семь лет развития мы создали себе систему пропаганды, стимулирования и внедрения.

quote: Institutional design requires a keen focus on issues, innovative thinking and flexible and well-funded implementation.
before: It needs to help them reach an equitable compromise, and it needs to ensure that a broad coalition of local, regional and international supporters help them implement their agreement. Third, institutional design.
after: Conflict parties need to move away from maximum demands and towards a compromise that recognizes each other's needs. And they need to think about the substance of their agreement much more than about the labels they want to attach to them.
ru: Институциональный дизайн требует пристального внимания к вопросам, инновационного мышления а также гибкости и хорошего финансирования при внедрении.

quote: Because in the mean time, the German Constitutional Court ruled that the implementation of this E.U. directive into German law was unconstitutional.
