before: And here is the best example, the Contras in Nicaragua, created by the CIA, legally funded by the U.S. Congress, illegally funded by the Reagan administration via covert operation, for example, the Iran-Contra Affair. Then comes the late 1970s, early' 80s, and some groups successfully carry out the privatization of terrorism.
after: Now, again we see a mix of legal and illegal activities. So, Arafat used to get a percentage of the smuggling of hashish from Bekáa Valley, which is the valley between Lebanon and Syria.
ru: Итак, они получили независимость от спонсора и стали сами себя финансировать.

quote: Abkhazia has been fighting to break away and gain independence from Georgia.
after: So far only Russia, Venezuela, Nicaragua, and another tiny island state, Nauru, have announced the recognition of Abkhazia.

quote: We just finished making a charming independent movie.
before: - Shut up. And if the tape does get out?
after: For it to work, we need to take it to a major film festival. We need people focusing on your great film, Julian, not a sex tape.
ru: Мы только что закончили снимать замечательный независимый фильм.

quote: If you're so independent, why didn't you get the right bus home?
before: I was trying to be independent, Dad. Well, how did that work out for you?
after: I've no money left. You spent the whole lot, the whole 20 quid. On what?
ru: Если ты такая независимая, почему не поехала домой на автобусе?

quote: He says that you're quite the independent thinker.
before: Vigorously. Jack Thompson thinks very highly of you.
after: I'm sure he meant that as an insult. perhaps.
ru: Он говорит, что вы достаточно независимая личность.

quote: Well, as of this morning, I'm officially an independent.
before: Garrett's testimony did not make me any friends. Not in your party, no.
after: I think the GOP can find me a place on judiciary. - Okay, Alex.
ru: На данный момент а я официально независимый.

quote: He had a website, La Blogothèque, dedicated to independent music.
before: And actually, why do we record? Well, it is with such simple questions in mind that I started to make films 10 years ago, first with a friend, Christophe Abric.
after: We were crazy about music. We wanted to represent music in a different way, to film the music we love, the musicians we admired, as much as possible, far from the music industry and far from the cliches attached to it.
ru: У него был веб-сайт, La Blogothèque, посвящённый независимой музыке.

quote: Independent analysis from anonymous employees on their surveys.
before: And you can say, " Well how do you know they're happy? " Well we did win, every year that we entered, one of the rankings for best employer for small business.
after: It does, and it can, work in Bulgaria. There's nothing holding us back, except our own mentality about play.
ru: В независимом анализе анонимных сотрудников, по их опросам.

quote: Each of those is an independent life-support system, keeping us alive in its own way.
before: So when it comes to reasons for studying physics, for example, here is the best reason I can think of: I think that each of us has three life-support systems. We've got our own body, we've got a planet and we've got our civilization.
after: And they all run on the fundamental physical laws that you can learn in the kitchen with eggs and teacups and lemonade, and everything else you can play with. This is the reason, for example, why something like climate change is such a serious problem, because It's two of these life-support systems, our planet and our civilization, kind of butting up against each other; they're in conflict, and we need to negotiate that boundary.
ru: Каждая из них независима и по-своему поддерживает в нас жизнь.

quote: Channel 4 has no production facilities itself; all television programmes are commissioned from independent companies.
before: The crew were freelancers filming a new comedy show for Channel 4.

quote: There's no indication she knows she's being followed.
before: Do we have even a guess as to where she could be headed? No, I'm afraid not.
after: So whatever's going on, she should lead us right to it. Sophia is here.
ru: Нет никаких признаков того, что она знает что за ней следят.

quote: Every indication told me that the spine was transected, which would have been incurable.
before: There is only one possible explanation. It starts with my own mistake.
after: But when Sir John Coates came to see Matthew, he agreed with you. Well, he didn't.
ru: Все признаки указывали на то, что позвоночник сломан, а это вылечить невозможно.

quote: All current indications of his presence are that there are no current indications of his presence.
before: Where's the big burrito himself? Where's God in all of this?
after: What? Caught the fun bus out of town?
ru: Все признаки его присутствия говорят о том, что он полностью отсутствует.

quote: There are no indications of a traditional tiger throat bite or strangle hold.
before: Common house cat will devour you before you're cold. The victim's hyoid and spinal cord are still intact.
after: The tiger was not the cause of death. I agree.
ru: Нет никаких признаков на обычные приемы тигра убивать жертву: укус в горло или удушение

quote: Pretty good indication it's not Clint Eastwood in the picture.
before: Second, Google looks at the picture file, the name of the file as such uploaded to the website. Again, is it called " MichelleObama.jpeg "?
after: So, you've got those two and you get a search result like this — almost. Now, in 2009, Michelle Obama was the victim of a racist campaign, where people set out to insult her through her search results.
ru: Это ещё один верный признак, что на нём нет Клинта Иствуда.

quote: After all, there are no physical indications you have the virus.
before: The fear of how others perceive us when we're honest keeps us from doing many things in life, and this is the case for the HIV-positive population. To face social scrutiny and ridicule is the price that we pay for transparency, and why become a martyr when you can effectively pass as someone without HIV?
after: There's no sign that you wear. There is safety in assimilation, and there is safety in invisibility.
ru: Ведь не существует физических признаков вируса.

quote: But the indications of that on her body was that her intestine was outside her body.
before: Shaheen's background I don't even know. We found her in a railway track, raped by many, many men, I don't know many.
after: And when we took her to the hospital she needed 32 stitches to put back her intestine into her body. We still don't know who her parents are, who she is.
ru: но мы поняли это по признакам на её теле. Её кишечник торчал снаружи.

quote: There is no indication alcohol was a factor in the accident.
before: A criminal investigation has been launched. A blood sample has been taken from the truck driver, 76-year-old Donald Creed, who has been released from hospital after treatment.

quote: This could withstand a 9.0 quake or an industrial thermal lance.
before: TD-9000-- brand-new technology, can be used on any size vault. More than a dozen interlocking composite-steel bolts, reinforced receiving cups, ten-gear release mechanism.
after: Yes, but our witnesses said they got in with a glass of water. Th-They did what?
ru: Это может выдержать землетрясение в 9,0 баллов или да же промышленный газовый резак.

quote: This is Agent Knox, we got an old industrial building here.
before: Team, on me. This is Agent Weller, what have you got?
after: Looks vacant. My team's standing by to breach the doors on your say-so.
ru: Это агент Нокс, у нас тут старое промышленное здание.

quote: We made a proposal to the Minister of Industrial Development.
before: I had to travel to Russia just to meet the man and ended up with his brilliant daughter. My brilliance is like the Moon next to your sun.
after: Canada could lead the world in space exploration. Imagine a Canadian flag planted on the Moon.
ru: Мы сделали предложение министру промышленного развития.

quote: The world's worst industrial accident is being remembered in India today.
before: - And you're watching ^IBBC World.^I Our main headlines.
after: It's 20 years since deadly gas leaked from the Union Carbide chemical plant in the city of Bhopal. At least 18,000 deaths are attributed to the leak, and many local people say that contamination has never been properly cleared up.
ru: Худший промышленный инцидент, сегодня все еще помнят в Индии.

quote: Now we are experiencing another metamorphic change: the industrial Internet.
before: First, the Industrial Revolution brought us machines and factories, railways, electricity, air travel, and our lives have never been the same. Then the Internet revolution brought us computing power, data networks, unprecedented access to information and communication, and our lives have never been the same.
after: It brings together intelligent machines, advanced analytics, and the creativity of people at work. It's the marriage of minds and machines.
ru: Сейчас мы переживаем ещё одну метаморфозу: Интернет промышленного размаха.

quote: Palm oil is used to manufacture a wide range of consumer and industrial goods.
before: We made an oil that was similar to a citrus oil, which can be used for flavoring and for fragrances, but it also can be used as a biodegradable cleaner or even as a jet fuel. And we made an oil that's similar to palm oil.
after: We began working with manufacturers to scale up this technology, and we're currently working with them to bring some of these products to market. We believe this type of technology can indeed help us profitably recycle carbon dioxide into valuable products — something that's beneficial for the planet but also beneficial for business.
ru: Пальмовое масло используют в производстве широкого спектра потребительских и промышленных товаров.

quote: Industrial trawlers and draggers are scraping the sea floor like bulldozers, taking everything in their path.
before: All of these parts are part of our life support system. We kill using long lines, with baited hooks every few feet that may stretch for 50 miles or more.
after: Using Google Earth you can witness trawlers — in China, the North Sea, the Gulf of Mexico — shaking the foundation of our life support system, leaving plumes of death in their path. The next time you dine on sushi — or sashimi, or swordfish steak, or shrimp cocktail, whatever wildlife you happen to enjoy from the ocean — think of the real cost.
ru: Промышленные траулеры и драги выскабливают морское дно как бульдозеры, забирая все на своём пути.

quote: One of the oldest mines in Poland, it is centrally located in the industrial Silesia region.
before: The Halemba mine, located in Ruda Slaska, has produced coal for nearly 50 years, has been fraught with safety concerns and has a track record of serious accidents.

quote: And this laid the foundations for chemistry, physics and modern industry.
before: A new age where electricity ceased being a mere curiosity and started being genuinely useful. With constant flowing current electricity, new chemical elements could be isolated with ease.
after: Volta's pile changed everything. The pile made Volta an international celebrity, feted by the powerful and the rich.
ru: И это заложило основы химии, физики и современной промышленности.

quote: Our proprietary designs keep us at the forefront of the industry.
before: Looks that way. Any idea why China might be interested in Rylatech?
after: Maybe they want to steal our work. Or sabotage it.
ru: Благодаря нашим собственным разработкам мы были лидерами отрасли.

quote: You're the one that invited half the record industry.
before: Open bar per person we're looking at that. That's 400 people.
after: I know you're in the business, but our house band, Karisma, you're hearing them over the speakers. You won't do better anywhere.
ru: - Ты сам пригласил половину своей отрасли.

quote: What those in the tech industry might call an "incubator."
before: Who is that? He's a venture capitalist of sorts, for criminals.
after: And you really believe that if we find McGrath, he'll lead us to Kirk? Not us.
ru: В отрасли высоких технологий это называют "инкубатором".

quote: And beyond medicine, biofabrication can be a humane, sustainable and scalable new industry.
before: This is biofabrication, where cells themselves can be used to grow biological products like tissues and organs. Already in medicine, biofabrication techniques have been used to grow sophisticated body parts, like ears, windpipes, skin, blood vessels and bone, that have been successfully implanted into patients.
after: And we should begin by reimagining leather. I emphasize leather because it is so widely used.
ru: Кроме медицины биофабрикацию можно было бы использовать в качестве гуманной, устойчивой и масштабируемой новой отрасли.

quote: Now, this scarcity fueled widespread corruption in the industry.
before: In the late 1990s, fewer than five percent of people in sub-Saharan Africa had phones. In Nigeria, for example, the country had more than 110 million people but fewer than half a million phones in the whole nation.
after: I mean, public officials who worked for the state-owned phone companies demanded bribes from people who wanted phones. And because most people couldn't afford to pay the bribes, phones were only available to those who were wealthy.
ru: Такой дефицит способствовал распространению коррупции в отрасли.

quote: It could also be novel ways of organizing firms and industries.
before: Instead, innovation, if you remember, some of you may have read the famous economist Schumpeter, he said, " Innovation is novelty in how value is created and distributed. " It could be new products and services, but it could also be new ways of producing products.
after: Once you take this, there's no reason to restrict innovation, the beneficiaries of innovation, just to end users. When you take this broader conceptualization of innovation, what we found was, India is well represented in innovation, but the innovation that is being done in India is of a form we did not anticipate, and what we did was we called it " invisible innovation. "
ru: Это могут быть также новые способы организации фирм и отраслей промышленности.

quote: The industry publication stated the aircraft overran the runway and broke through a perimeter barrier.
before: The Aviation Herald reported the failed landing at Fath, which has a much shorter runway than Payam, was a mistake and the jet was supposed to land at Payam.
after: It cited the Air Force as stating Saha Airlines owned the plane, and claimed a reported sixteenth death.

quote: While they spend one billion won a year, they want just two things. Inequality and discrimination.
before: Do you know what social groups are created in the social economy's labor organizations based on division and income? It's class.
after: If they can't control and rule you, they'd rather have you completely discriminated against. That's their reason and common sense.
ru: Бросая на ветер миллиард вон, эти люди хотят лишь неравенства и дискриминации.

quote: I agree with you, such inequalities are shocking.
before: A whole family could have lived there. To think there's homeless in France...
after: What's that? That's the Jacuzzi.
ru: Вы правы, это неравенство режет глаз.

quote: Wealth inequality has led to a permanent state of social unrest.
before: The world as we know it is coming to an end. With or without these embryos, current society is unsustainable.
after: The economic models are broken. The present value of any business or society is its future success.
ru: Имущественное неравенство привело к беспрестанным массовым беспорядкам.

quote: And, as the inequality grows, naturally, more and more people are becoming desperate.
before: The World is being taken over by a hand-full of business powers who dominate the natural resources we need to live, while controlling the money we need to obtain these resources. The end result will be world monopoly based not on human life but financial and corporate power.
after: So the establishment was forced to come up with a new way to deal with anyone who challenges the system. So they gave birth to the 'Terrorist'.
ru: И, естественно, с ростом неравенства всё больше и больше людей впадают в отчаяние.

quote: I'm not. I'm not making a moral argument that economic inequality is wrong.
before: And it will be terrible when they come for everyone, but particularly for people like us plutocrats. I know I must sound like some liberal do-gooder.
after: What I am arguing is that rising economic inequality is stupid and ultimately self-defeating. Rising inequality doesn't just increase our risks from pitchforks, but it's also terrible for business too.
ru: Но я не такой. Я не привожу моральных аргументов в пользу того, что это экономическое неравенство — это неправильно.

quote: But this feeling of inequality would get even more complex.
before: But in the eyes and the minds of the other kids, I was not their equal. I couldn't speak English, and I was way behind in terms of reading and writing.
after: Every school holiday spent back in the village with my grandmother made me consciously aware of the inequalities this incredible opportunity had created within my own family. Suddenly, I had much more than the rest of my village.
ru: Но у школьного неравенства появилась новая сторона.

quote: And without government intervention, they generate an iterative cycle of both stratification and inequality.
before: What is glaringly missing from this narrative is the role of power and capital, and how that power and capital can be used to alter the rules and structure of transactions and markets in the first place. Power and capital become self-reinforcing.
after: The capital finance provided by baby trust is intended to deliver a more egalitarian and an authentic pathway to economic security, independent of the family financial position in which individuals are born. The program would complement the economic rights to old-age pensions and provide a more comprehensive social security program, designed to provide capital finance from cradle all the way through grave.
ru: Без правительственной инициативы они лишь создают порочный круг расслоения и неравенства в обществе.

quote: The war is with inequality, not with fellow socialists.
before: "I predict hundreds, maybe thousands, of ordinary, everyday workers will fight for equality and justice.
after: And Scotland is big enough for more than one socialist party, " said Sheridan.

quote: Change is inevitable and necessary, like the seasons, Mr. Palmer.
before: I suppose with changes in my personal life, I could always count on a stable work environment. And now, suddenly, things seem to be changing for you as well, and I...
after: I suggest you embrace it. I will.
ru: Изменения неизбежны и необходимы, как времена года, мистер Палмер.

quote: It's inevitable, so it's better you hear it from me.
before: I haven't been completely honest with you... about why I'm going away. I'm... well, I've been scared to tell you the truth, but I guess you're gonna find out anyway.
after: What are you talking about, Pop? I got Alzheimer's.
ru: Это неизбежно, так что, лучше услышать вам это от меня.

quote: But if it doesn't, we've delayed an inevitable operation.
before: What's TPA? It's a clot-busting medicine that could help.
after: That could cause a stroke or MI. Surgery is the best option here.
ru: Если нет, то мы запоздаем с неизбежным вмешательством.

quote: The blue hand marks a surrender to the inevitable.
before: Blue hands. They represent a portal, a gateway from one understanding to another.
after: Raynaud. Here we go.
ru: Синяя рука показывает, что человек покорился неизбежному.

quote: We thought that becoming senile was a normal and inevitable part of getting old.
before: Because here's what few people know but everyone should: Alzheimer's is a disease, and we can cure it. For most of the past 114 years, everyone, including scientists, mistakenly confused Alzheimer's with aging.
after: But we only have to look at a picture of a healthy aged brain compared to the brain of an Alzheimer's patient to see the real physical damage caused by this disease. As well as triggering severe loss of memory and mental abilities, the damage to the brain caused by Alzheimer's significantly reduces life expectancy and is always fatal.
ru: Мы думали, что старческий маразм — естественная и неизбежная часть старения.

quote: In our research, people accepted acceleration as inevitable, both the thrills and the lack of control.
before: Will a faster future make us more secure and productive? Or will it make us more vulnerable?
after: They fear that if they were to slow down, they might run the risk of becoming obsolete. They say they'd rather burn out than rust out.
ru: Согласно нашему исследованию, люди восприняли ускорение как неизбежность, включая волнение и потерю контроля.

quote: But it's inevitable that we will be two to three billion more.
before: And we will be just 10 billion in this world, if the poorest people get out of poverty, their children survive, they get access to family planning. That is needed.
after: So when you discuss and when you plan for the resources and the energy needed for the future, for human beings on this planet, you have to plan for 10 billion. Thank you very much.
ru: Неизбежно то, что нас станет на пару-тройку миллиардов больше.

quote: The United States said "this now looks inevitable."
before: European diplomats have said that they will hold an emergency IAEA meeting to consider referring Tehran to the UN for further action and or sanctions.

quote: There have been several convincing studies of identical twins, like yourself, who were separated as infants.
before: That's something I think you might be able to help us with. I don't see how.
after: As adults, they tend to be remarkably similar. Are you serious about this?
ru: Существует несколько убедительных исследований об идентичных близнецах, как вы, которые были разделены в младенчестве.

quote: Just like last night, an alarm of a crying infant will sound to awaken you.
before: Hello, ladies. Night number two of sleep deprivation.
after: It will not turn off until you've completed a simple logic test. When you hit complete at the end of the test, your alarm will end and you can go back to sleep.
ru: Также, как и прошлой ночью, будет включаться голос плачущего младенца, чтобы разбудить вас.

quote: This city, Mr Marlott, dragged kicking and screaming like a raucous infant towards a better future.
before: But not always of its own accord, eh? Sir?
after: One way or another. Do well by me, and... you'll be assured a part in it.
ru: Этот город, мистер Марлот, тянется, толкаясь и крича, как шумный младенец, к светлому будущему.

quote: Sociopathic traits are identifiable in very young children, infants even.
before: A sociopath, really? He's just a little boy; he's only ten.
after: Couldn't the picking up of the button just be a normal curiosity? Most children when confronted with such a horrific event would be repelled.
ru: Черты социопата можно опознать в раннем возрасте, даже у младенцев.

quote: In children, that figure is 50%, and in infants, 60%.
before: Monkey brains use 10%. An adult human brain, which accounts for only 2% of the body's mass, consumes 20% of daily glucose burned.
after: This is far more than expected for their relative brain sizes, which scale in proportion to body size. Human ones weigh 1.5 kilograms, elephant brains 5 kg, and whale brains 9 kg, yet on a per weight basis, humans pack in more neurons than any other species.
ru: Для детей это число 50%, а для младенцев — 60%,

quote: Infant mortality is falling and has been falling at an incredible rate.
before: You just shone less light up into the sky. There are a huge number of good news stories in the world.
after: A few years ago, the number of babies dying in their first year of life in the world fell by five percent in just one year. More children are going to school and learning to read and write and getting connected to the Internet and going on to go to university than ever before at an incredible rate, and the highest number of young people going to university in the world are women, not men.
ru: С поразительной скоростью падает младенческая смертность.

quote: Every single one of them: man, woman, child, infant, fetus.
before: And they told me this story all about this guy named Lehi, who lived in Jerusalem in 600 BC. Now, apparently in Jerusalem in 600 BC, everyone was completely bad and evil.
after: And God came to Lehi and said to him, " Put your family on a boat and I will lead you out of here. " And God did lead them.
ru: Все и каждый: мужчина ли, женшина, ребёнок, младенец или плод в утробе.

quote: Other passengers included Osama Warraich, who was a senior civil servant in Chitral, and two infants.
before: Jamshed ran a nationally successful fashion business. His wife joined him on the flight.

quote: Okay, the instrument of original infection would've been the cat's claws.
before: "Oh, boy," what? It says we need the instrument of original infection.
after: - Exactly. - Well, let's get the cat.
ru: хорошо, инструмент, от которого началось заражение были кошачьи когти.

quote: If she gets an infection from the I.V., then we're liable.
before: Shoot. Call the police.
after: And have maintenance come and clean up. It's a mess.
ru: Если у нее будет заражение после капельницы, на нас могут подать в суд.

quote: So you're-you're talking about those of us that show no signs of an alien infection.
before: "Tragically, most of the town expired "when the dome came down, leaving only a few survivors."
after: Correct. And as long as it remains dormant in you and the others, you will have your freedom.
ru: Вы...вы говорите о тех из нас, у кого не нашли следов инопланетного заражения.

quote: There's nothing in here about a meteor infection.
before: I'm just trying to help you, bette. I wish you hadn't made me do that.
after: Here. Let me take a look.
ru: Нет ни слова про заражение метеоритами.

quote: Infection rate stood at about two percent in my early days there.
before: Zimbabwe reported its first AIDS case in 1985, the year I arrived. I had taken care of a few patients with AIDS in the early 1980s, when I did my medical training at Harlem Hospital, but — we had no idea what lay in store for Africa.
after: These would soar to one out of every four adults by the time I left Harare 17 years later. By the mid-1990s, I'd told hundreds of people in the prime of life that they were HIV-positive.
ru: Риск заражения составлял всего 2% в первые дни после моего прибытия.

quote: But when they do, these cross-species infections, or viral host jumps, have the potential to produce deadly epidemics.
before: Some had pet the pigs, while others had merely been near their barns; but soon, 40 of these attendees would be diagnosed with swine flu. More often than not, sick animals don’ t infect humans.
after: So how can pathogens from one species infect another, and what makes host jumps so dangerous? Viruses are a type of organic parasite infecting nearly all forms of life.
ru: Но когда заражение происходит, то межвидовая инфекция, или межвидовая миграция вирусов, потенциально может вызвать смертоносные эпидемии.

quote: There is, however, ample evidence to show that incarcerating people increases their risk of HIV and other infections.
before: In Thailand people who use drugs, or are merely suspected of using drugs, are placed in detention centers, like the one you see here, where they are supposed to clean up. There is absolutely no evidence to show that throwing people into detention cures their drug dependence.
after: We know how to reduce HIV transmission and other risks in people who inject drugs. It's called harm reduction, and it involves, among other things, providing clean needles and syringes, offering opioid substitution therapy and other evidence-based treatments to reduce drug dependence.
ru: Есть, однако, достаточные доказательства того, что у заключённых повышается риск заражения ВИЧ и другими инфекциями.

quote: The insanitary conditions have already caused diarrhoea and respiratory infections.
before: In other parts of Pakistan the water has receded, but this leaves a layer of mud and slime and this covers very large areas. For those affected by the floods, disease is the biggest problem now.
after: Cholera and other water-borne diseases may appear if sanitary conditions for those displaced by the calamity are not established. Medical supplies are desperately needed for doctors to keep a pandemic or epidemic of a water-borne disease from infecting the victims of the flooding.

quote: Use your influence to anoint her the new "It Girl."
before: Well, you need to replace yourself. Find a new Serena.

" (Laughter) Every day, we allow our coworkers, who are otherwise very, very nice people, to steal from us.

before: You know, coyote in Central Park, a whale in the Gowanus Canal, elk in Westchester County. It's happening all over the Developed World, probably for loss of habitat, but also because our cities are a little bit more livable than they have been.

And that was when, before we did this in any developing countries — we're doing it, in fact, in three developing countries right now: Pakistan, Colombia and Senegal — we did it in some pretty rough areas of New York City.

And we badly need them to turn their energies and their power to big, what economists might call public goods problems, that are often beyond markets where investors can easily be found.
ru: Мой призыв к действию для новой власти — не быть островом.

When he walks outside his souk, walks into a pharmacy for heart medicine that can prevent the blood in his arteries from clotting, he confronts the fact that, despite a growing epidemic that currently accounts for 82 percent of all deaths in Egypt, it is the medicines that can address these conditions that counterfeiters, ever the evil geniuses they are, have decided to target.

quote: Every one of those links must hold for the mission to succeed.

ru: Задача каждого из этих звеньев — привести миссию к успеху.

after: I saw this diagram drawn by a French architect, and I thought, " Wow! What a beautiful fractal! "
ru: Это горы Мандара, рядом с нигерийской границей Камеруна, Мокулек.

quote: But in fact, the gulls are looking for food in the dump near the prison.
before: You can see the sky. Seagulls fly overhead, and you feel like you're next to the sea, that you're really close to the beach.
after: I went farther inside and I suddenly saw inmates moving across the corridors. Then it was as if I stepped back and thought that I could have very well been one of them.
ru: Но на самом деле, чайки ищут еду в мусорной куче рядом с тюрьмой.

quote: And the answer is, until we get near to zero, the temperature will continue to rise.
before: I asked the top scientists on this several times: Do we really have to get down to near zero? Can't we just cut it in half or a quarter?
after: And so that's a big challenge. It's very different than saying, " We're a twelve-foot-high truck trying to get under a ten-foot bridge, and we can just sort of squeeze under. "
ru: Ответ в том, что пока мы не дойдём до уровня, близкого к нулю, температура будет продолжать расти.

quote: The accident occurred at Kindel Air Field, which is located south of Berlin, near Eisenach.
after: The aircraft involved was a Zlin Z-37 Cmelak, a Czech built single-seater plane which had been used by authorities in former East Germany as a cropduster.

quote: Isn't there military nearby who can do that?
before: These forests are just crawling with members of the Chechen Separatist Movement, just looking to start another fight with the Russians. So you want us to find the plane and destroy it before anyone can get there?
after: Perhaps. There is, however, an additional twist that adds to the urgency and the national security implications of this mission.
ru: Разве нет поблизости военных, которые могут это сделать?

quote: Then he kills her, he kills himself and anyone else nearby.
before: Up until the moment he discovers that she'll never have him, yeah. Then what happens?
after: You sure we're safe to work in here? I've tripled my firewalls just to be sure.
ru: Потом он убьёт её, убьёт себя и убьёт всех поблизости.

quote: Well, then there must be a water source nearby.
before: Look... no root structure. Right.
after: Yeah, it would have to have a slow current, lots of rocks. The water would probably be more red than green.
ru: Хорошо, здесь поблизости должен быть источник воды.

quote: Okay okay, so no elevator, no coffee shop nearby.
before: All right, you know what's going to happen if we live near a coffee shop, right? We're going to end up spending five bucks a day on lattes that we could just make ourselves.
after: Is there anything else that you just can't tolerate? Yeah, your mattress.
ru: Ладно, значит никакого лифта и никакой кофейни поблизости.

quote: But what's particularly eerie is that there's no tell-tale mass of dead or dying bees nearby.
before: A typical crime scene has almost no adult bees left in the hive, except, perhaps, a lonely queen and a few other survivors. It's full of untouched food stores and a brood of unborn larvae, suggesting that the adults vacated without waiting for them to hatch.
after: Either they have forgotten their way back to the hive, or they have simply disappeared. These mysterious disappearances aren't new.
ru: Особенно странным кажется то, что поблизости нет множества мёртвых или погибающих пчёл.

quote: Such a large population needs to eat, and the nearby garden provides a veritable buffet.
before: Although each worker only lives for roughly 3 weeks, the queen’ s continuous egg-laying swells their ranks. In just one summer, the nest reaches the size of a basketball, supporting thousands of workers.
after: As the swarm descends, alarmed humans try to swat them. They even fight back with pesticides that purposefully poison wasps, and inadvertently impact a wide-range of local wildlife.
ru: Такая большая популяция нуждается в питании и соседний огород — настоящий шведский стол.

quote: They'd been told that these islands, and several others nearby, were populated by cannibals.
before: The men knew that the nearest islands they could reach were the Marquesas Islands, 1,200 miles away. But they'd heard some frightening rumors.
after: So the men pictured coming ashore only to be murdered and eaten for dinner. Another possible destination was Hawaii, but given the season, the captain was afraid they'd be struck by severe storms.
ru: как будто эти острова и соседние с ними были населены каннибалами.

quote: According to Oliver, a nearby Toronto resident also responded to the scam.
From the Prussians, from Frederick the Great, I have nearly nothing.
before: I would love to have it. Have you seen something here?
after: Let's go play soccer now. Let's wait a bit. Till Rosenbaum is gone.
ru: Прусская, времён Фридриха Великого, таких почти не осталось.

quote: You nearly got killed tonight, Barton, For sitting in a car.
before: You think Margaret and Vivian will stand by you... When this all comes out? It's not going to come out.
after: You can do your shirt up. - I can go again.
ru: Бартон, сегодня вечером ты почти был убит на сидении автомобиля.

quote: It was a lesson that took me nearly 30 years to unlearn.
before: Well, at least I still got my hot dogs. No!
after: Where could Barney be? Oh, relax. He always finds his way home.
ru: Прошло почти 30 лет, но тот урок меня так ничему и не научил.

quote: It looks like the bullets took nearly identical exit paths, judging from the spray.
before: Yeah, they are that close together. It's very impressive shooting.
after: And this was all topped off by a final shot to the head. She was mozambiqued.
ru: Судя по брызгам, пули прошли почти по одинаковой траектории.

quote: But the travel options are very limited; plane tickets cost nearly half of their monthly salary.
before: Over the 40-day travel period of Chinese New Year, three billion trips are taken, as families reunite and celebrate. Now, the most strenuous of these trips are taken by the country's 290 million migrant workers, for many of whom this is the one chance a year to go home and see parents and their left-behind children.
after: So most of them, they choose the train. Their average journey is 700 kilometers.
ru: Но возможности перемещения для них очень ограничены: билеты на самолёт стоят почти половину их месячной зарплаты.

quote: Now we can make nearly instantaneous, emotionally charged symbols out of something that's brand new.
before: It's never going to happen again, I think, because we are living on the verge of the greatest revolution in architecture since the invention of concrete, of steel, or of the elevator, and it's a media revolution. So my theory is that when you apply media to this pendulum, it starts swinging faster and faster, until it's at both extremes nearly simultaneously, and that effectively blurs the difference between innovation and symbol, between us, the architects, and you, the public.
after: Let me show you how this plays out in a project that my firm recently completed. We were hired to replace this building, which burned down.
ru: Мы научились почти мгновенно создавать эмоционально заряженные символы из чего-то совершенно нового.

quote: I saw Jason nearly every day, sometimes twice a day.
before: Jason started at DARPA on March 18th, 2010. He was with our transportation team.
after: And more so than most, he saw the highs and the lows, the celebrations and the disappointments. And on one particularly dark day for me, Jason sat down and he wrote an email.
ru: Я встречалась с ним почти каждый день, иногда по несколько раз.

quote: The death toll is the highest reported incident in Iraq for nearly one month.
before: Most of the dead were police recruits, yet civilians and other serving officers were also injured or killed. At least 57 people were injured in the attack.

quote: Guilt isn't necessarily a bad thing, I'll tell you that.
before: I mean, I'm still shocked you would do this, not to mention disappointed. Are you trying to make me feel guilty, or guiltier than I already feel?
after: Yeah, I hope you do feel guilty. Plenty guilty.
ru: Вина не обязательно плохая вещь, я уже говорил тебе это.

quote: Well, not necessarily a rational explanation, but there's an explanation.
before: It's not unusual. Nine times out of ten, there's a perfectly...
after: People turn up right as rain. They're often embarrassed there's been such a fuss!
ru: Ну, не обязательно рациональное, но все же объяснение.

quote: It doesn't necessarily mean he lied about this.
before: I'm saying there's a pattern. Okay, so he lied then.
after: But you built your whole intel chain on the guy. He's your key witness and not a reliable one.
ru: Это не обязательно означает, что он лгал сейчас.

quote: Though, in fairness, being a pirate is not necessarily a bad thing.
before: Maybe she feels the same way about pirates as you do about magic. I've worked to change.
after: Particularly a charming one like meself. I think your self-appreciation is blinding you to a simple fact... this isn't about you.
ru: И, справедливости ради, быть пиратом не обязательно означает быть плохим.

quote: (Video) MM: The global village is a world in which you don't necessarily have harmony.
before: If you substitute the word blogosphere, of the Internet today, it is very true that his understanding is probably very enlightening now. Let's listen in to him.
after: You have extreme concern with everybody else's business and much involvement in everybody else's life. It's a sort of Ann Landers' column writ large.
ru: (Видео) ММ: Глобальная деревня — это слово, в котором гармония не обязательна.

quote: And you don't necessarily have to have your own TV set.
before: Cynthia Schneider: These programs are reaching incredibly deeply into society. In Afghanistan, people go to extraordinary lengths to be able to watch this program.
after: People watch it all over the country also in public places. But it goes beyond watching, because also, part of this is campaigning.
ru: И совсем не обязательно для этого иметь собственный телевизор.

quote: I don't think this is necessarily an algorithmic process.
before: Basically, she's a deejay. She's a skilled human curator who knows what material is available to her, who's able to listen to the audience, and who's able to make a selection and push people forward in one fashion or another.
after: I think what's great about the internet is that it actually makes it much easier for deejays to reach a wider audience. I know Amira.
ru: Я не думаю что это обязательно алгоритмический процесс.

quote: "A political settlement is not necessarily going to be with the Tamil Tigers," added Kohona.
after: It will take into account the concerns of the Tamil people of Sri Lanka and the other minorities of Sri Lanka."

quote: So a little Wget magic is all that's necessary to download the entire Kirkland facebook.
before: Let the hacking begin. First up is Kirkland. They keep everything open and allow indexes in their Apache configuration.
after: Kids' stuff. Next is Eliot.
ru: Теперь Wget. Это всё что нужно, чтобы полностью скачать весь фотоальбом Кёркленда.

quote: What we do is necessary for the greater good.
before: One of my agents is dead, and your sister's going home. What kind of positive message is that?
after: There's nothing good about this. Excuse me for the interruption, sir.
ru: То, что мы делаем необходимо для более великих хороших дел.

quote: I promise you we won't keep you a moment longer than necessary, Mr Murran.
before: I wonder if we could have a quick word. I'm already late for a meeting.
after: I've been Sam Harper for 25 years. The Murrans are a bad bunch.
ru: - Обещаю, мы не задержим вас дольше, чем необходимо, мистер Марран.

quote: I want no more upheaval for the family than absolutely necessary.
before: The parents are staying with the next-door neighbours. I'm not sending CSIs in, unless something significant comes out of the post-mortem.
after: Pete, speak to the hospital. I want to know if there was something other than the child's injuries that made medical staff suspicious.
ru: Не будем беспокоить семью, если в этом нет необходимости.

quote: He told himself it was necessary to make them from scratch.
before: All the movements stopped at falsifying. But demand was ever-growing and it was difficult to tamper with existing documents.
after: He started a press. He started photoengraving.
ru: Он решил, что нужно их целиком делать самим.

quote: Yes, fear is part of the human condition, as well as being necessary for survival.
before: We all feel fear. But we can all avoid being recruited using the resources we have — our principles, unity, faith.
after: But above all, it's the guide by which each of us builds our identity, our personality. It's true, I was 41 years old the first time I felt fear, and feeling fear was not my decision.
ru: Разумеется, страх — это часть нашей жизни, и он необходим для выживания.

quote: A typical example being, "Sometimes it is necessary to tell lies."
before: I simply took those questions where I got 50 percent yeses and 50 percent noes — so I was able to get a collection of 16 such statements. These were areas where the children were clearly confused, because half said yes and half said no.
after: They don't have a way to determine which way to answer this question; perhaps none of us do. So I leave you with this third question.
ru: Вот пример такого вопроса: "Иногда необходимо соврать".

quote: This is necessary as a deterrent for such outrageous, uncivilised behaviour.
before: "It is time to stamp out these barbaric, feudal practices which are a slur on the nation.
after: All persons who are planning to perpetrate honour killings should know that gallows await them," Justice Katju said.

quote: And then the neck of the cocoon split.
before: A naturalist once came upon the cocoon of this rare creature, just as it was struggling to emerge in its new form. He watched as it writhed and labored terribly to shed its shell.
after: It seemed to gain no progress. Unable to witness such a thing of beauty suffer so... the man produced a blade and cut it free.
ru: А затем шея кокона разорвалась.

quote: I have to let you know, my neck is extraordinarily ticklish.
before: Come on, buddy. I got a song and everything.
after: You don't say. Don't you dare. Don't.
ru: Должен признаться, что моя шея безумно чувствительна к щекотке.

quote: Those things are practically impervious to blasters, but they have one weak point in their armor, the neck.
before: You won't be working much slower than you normally do. We're not gonna be able to hide in this storm forever.
after: One well-placed shot from the main gun should destroy it. That's all we might get, one shot.
ru: Эти штуки почти невосприимчивы к бластерам, но у них есть одно слабое место в корпусе - шея.

quote: I don't think my neck will ever recover.
before: OK, yeah, I guess we're done here. I can't believe we had to sit in the first row.
after: I kinda liked it. It felt like we were right there in the action.
ru: Я не думаю, что моя шея оправиться от этого когда-нибудь.

quote: And that long neck also serves as a super-efficient feeding mechanism.
before: Now, to grow so large, an animal like Dreadnoughtus would've had to have been a model of efficiency. That long neck and long tail help it radiate heat into the environment, passively controlling its temperature.
after: Dreadnoughtus could stand in one place and with that neck clear out a huge envelope of vegetation, taking in tens of thousands of calories while expending very few. And these animals evolved a bulldog-like wide-gait stance, giving them immense stability, because when you're 65 tons, when you're literally as big as a house, the penalty for falling over is death.
ru: А длинная шея — это суперэффективный механизм кормления.

quote: Then as the neck began to compress, the force of the blow caused it to whip back to the right.
before: His head did not move to the right. In fact, it rotated first to the left.
after: So this left-right motion was sort of a whiplash-type phenomenon, and we think that is probably what led to the brain injury. Now, this device is only limited in such that it can measure the skull motion, but what we really want to know is what's happening inside of the brain.
ru: Потом, как только шея начала сжиматься, сила удара заставила голову отскочить вправо.

quote: All the neck and the tail are cable, so it moves smoothly and organically.
before: They had to fit within the envelope. There was a tremendous amount of work to get all that working right.
after: And then, of course, you're not done yet. You have to get the look for the skin.
ru: Шея и хвост — это кабель, он движется плавно и органично.

quote: He went to the hospital that night, to get medication for "neck pain".
before: News networks quickly picked up footage of Tigger punching a guest at Walt Disney World. The Monaco family claims that the costume character hit their son in the face unprovoked.

quote: For God sakes, Carol, it's a necklace, not a heroin needle.
before: Listen, I want you to return everything that you bought and meet me back at my hotel. Uh, necklace?
after: We were just hanging out. And you bought her $1,000 worth of clothes.
ru: Ради Бога, Кэрол, это ожерелье, не игла с героином.

quote: Very small needle, very steady hand. Ah!
before: - He'll scream in pain. - Don't listen to her.
after: Now, when I pull back on the plunger, what do you think's gonna come out? Air.
ru: Очень тонкая игла, очень ловкие руки.

quote: The source of the discomfort you're feeling is an exquisitely tooled diamond needle, the titular Widow's Tear.
before: It's called... the Widow's Tear. No!
after: And as I turn the handle, the diamond... (Groans) ..slowly incises a circle of skin, from the back of the hand, one layer of epidermis at a time. Now, I want you to weigh your next answer very, very carefully.
ru: Неудобство доставляет изысканно сработанная алмазная игла, называемая Слезой вдовы.

quote: I always thought it would be needles and test tubes, but turns out that's really pricy.
before: Jeremy... my best friend since we were kids. We made one of those pacts... you know, if we both wound up single at 40, we'd make a baby.
after: Yeah, it's up there. Look this way.
ru: Я всегда думала, что обойдусь иглами и пробирками, но оказалось, что это дороговато.

quote: I mentioned epidurals. This is an epidural needle.
before: I call that a problem worth solving. So let's take a look at some of the devices that are used in these types of procedures.
after: It's used to puncture through the ligaments in the spine and deliver anesthesia during childbirth. Here's a set of bone marrow biopsy tools.
ru: Я упомянул эпидуральную анестезию. Это эпидуральная игла.

quote: This is why we can lift heavy objects without breaking our skin, but a tiny needle can make us bleed with just a little poke.
before: Well, pressure is force divided by area. The smaller the area, the bigger the pressure.
after: The pressure that will be exerted on her body can be calculated by force divided by the area on the top of your arms that comes in contact with her. It doesn't matter if your arms are strong enough to catch her body without breaking your bones.
ru: Именно поэтому мы можем поднимать тяжёлые предметы, не повреждая нашу кожу, но крошечная игла может вызвать кровоточение в результате маленького укола.

quote: Periodically, this drill, like a biopsy needle, plunges thousands of feet deep into the ice to extract a marrow of gases and isotopes for analysis.
before: It makes for an exotic and chilly commute. (Laughter) But under the surface is a hive of industrial activity centered around an eight-million-dollar drill assembly.
after: Ten times a day, they extract the 10-foot long cylinder of compressed ice crystals that contain the unsullied air and trace chemicals laid down by snow, season after season for thousands of years. It's really a time machine.
ru: Периодически эта установка, как игла для биопсии, вонзается на сотни метров глубоко в лёд, чтобы извлечь внутренние газы и изотопов для анализа.

quote: The potent and easily detected steroid is almost always injected with a needle.
before: Palmeiro responded to the suspension at a news conference that followed by saying he had no idea how traces of the steroid could be found in his urine, and that somehow he was an unwitting victim.

quote: Four people, four brownies, a ton of negative energy.
before: Good God! You know, I think this was fate.
after: I think we should all just have one. Not a chance.
ru: Нас четверо, пирожных тоже и тонна отрицательной энергии.

quote: Echo was negative, but he has severe abdominal pain.
before: You just did. What happened?
after: Ultrasound didn't suggest any intestinal blockages, but he's severely constipated. No spores, clostridium, or organic toxins in the kitchen samples.
ru: Эхограмма отрицательна, но у него сильная боль в животе.

quote: Use the negative prongs first or she'll short out.
before: About 25 minutes. Quickly.
after: Start with a trickle of DC and let it calibrate. No more. Pretty.
ru: Сперва используем отрицательные заряды, иначе её мозг закоротит.

quote: The baby's blood was AB negative, the same as yours.
before: That's why you had to hide the body, because of the scandal. She botched her own abortion -and you couldn't clean it up.
after: You must have thought it was a long shot that anybody would put two and two together, but you couldn't take the chance, could you? I'm going to give you 30 seconds to get out of this building.
ru: У ребенка была группа крови четвертая отрицательная, как и твоя.

quote: In study two, we incorporated the two values, a positive and a negative.
before: Study one explored how infants would engage with a novel toy if there were no values or instructions provided. So we simply showed infants how to activate the toy robot, but didn't assign any values, and we also didn't tell them that they could play with the remote, providing them with a really ambiguous situation.
after: And in the last study, we had two experimenters and one remote. One experimenter expressed a negative value towards pressing the remote, saying, " Yuck, the toy moved, " while the other experimenter expressed a positive value, saying, " Yay, the toy moved. "
ru: Второй группе детей мы показали два пульта и обе реакции — положительную и отрицательную.

quote: Africa has had a mixed affair with organized religion, with both positive and negative consequences.
before: And I said... " Yes he could, yes he could, but he sent us here as change agents, light of the world, salt of the earth, and we are failing. "
after: The Christian missionaries educated most of our political elite, like Senghor and Nkrumah, built many of our first hospitals and schools. Similarly, Islam has introduced commerce and mathematics across the continent.
ru: У Африки неоднозначные отношения с религией. С положительными и отрицательными последствиями.

quote: Those who are HIV-negative must know how to stay negative.
before: (Video) Female Narrator: There is hope, hope that one day we shall win this fight against HIV and AIDS. Each person must know their HIV status.
after: Those who are HIV-infected must know how to take care of themselves. HIV-positive pregnant women must get PMTCT services in order to have HIV-negative babies.
ru: ВИЧ-отрицательные должны знать, как оставаться отрицательными.

quote: Are there columnists where you receive consistently positive or consistently negative responses to?
before: thumb|250px|Columnist [[w:Herbert Kornfeld (character)|Herbert Kornfeld was murdered in an episode of white-on-white violence. "There was almost a Notorious B.I.G.-like upset [amongst readers]," according to Chet Clem.Image source: The Onion.]] DS: Are there certain columnists who are reader favorites?

quote: On a more serious note; an hour ago both presidents threatened to leave and end negotiations.
before: I'm very impressed by your work these past days. You deserve a big hand.
after: They didn't though. China stopped the ship with the helicopters and gave us 36 hours.
ru: А теперь к более серьезному: час назад оба президента угрожали уехать и закончить переговоры.

quote: I say either way, you'll use it in negotiations.
before: I get a strong possessive sense there. You're not going to say?
after: Call. So how do you know Gretchen?
ru: Что бы я не ответил, ты все равно используешь это в переговорах.

quote: I will get you replaced for sabotaging our negotiations, I swear!
before: - Yes, of course she is! - I'll go to the judge...
after: I am helping you! Of course she's lowballing me.
ru: Я добьюсь того, чтобы вас отстранили за саботаж наших переговоров, клянусь!

quote: The negotiations for your Agent Burke begin tomorrow.
before: So I did a test of my own. I give him back to you now to show you my good faith so you can show the others the truth.
after: We saw hostages, at least four. Not Agent Burke, but he's probably there.
ru: Переговоры о вашем агенте Бёрке начнутся завтра.

quote: So after a certain amount of negotiation, they agreed to it.
before: And I said, " The fact that you've never heard of it is an indication that it is news. " (Laughter) (Applause) " And you are a news magazine. "
after: But I think a lot of what they said was connected in some strange way to this distaste that people still have for the idea of treatment, the notion that somehow if we went out and treated a lot of people in indigent communities, that would be exploitative, because we would be changing them. There is this false moral imperative that seems to be all around us, that treatment of depression, the medications and so on, are an artifice, and that it's not natural.
ru: После переговоров они всё же согласились её напечатать.

quote: In negotiations, it comes in the form of alternatives.
before: What is power? Power comes in lots of forms.
after: So my brother had no alternatives; he lacked power. The company had lots of alternatives; they had power.
ru: В переговорах оно выражается в наличии альтернатив.

quote: This video would go on to kick-start negotiation talks with Boko Haram.
before: One of the mothers, when she watched the video, told me that if she could have reached into the laptop and pulled our her child from the laptop, she would have done so. For those of you who are parents, like myself, in the audience, you can only imagine the anguish that that mother felt.
after: And a Nigerian senator told me that because of this video they entered into those talks, because they had long presumed that the Chibok girls were dead. Twenty-one girls were freed in October last year.
ru: Это видео стало поводом начать переговоры с Боко Харамом.

quote: Hanefi mediated negotiations, reportedly, with the Taliban for the release of Mastrogiacomo.
before: Mastrogiacomo's interpreter, Adjmal Nashbandi, was later executed by the Taliban. The release of Mastrogiacomo was controversial and criticized at the time for the exchange of five Taliban prisoners in return.

quote: Neighbors knew everything that happens in the area.
before: And the father-abbot. And, of course, our father became much more bearable here than in the valley.
after: Life in this small community, seemed like a prison. Up here, it was the opposite - complete freedom.
ru: Соседи знали все, что происходит в округе.

quote: Neighbor had to come to help with birth.

ru: В недавно открывшемся ресторане действительно вкусно.

ru: Мы были в середине квеста, когда получили новости.

ru: Её не получится одурачить; она читает новости и знает:
