ru: Ты заметила что-нибудь странное в уборщике, который мыл пол в больнице?

quote: I guess I must be odd then because I was voting not guilty.
before: I said it just seems odd. Yeah, we sometimes see split votes veering one way or the other, but to have a complete turnaround leaning from not guilty to guilty in a matter of hours just seems odd.
after: Until you read the testimony of the alibi witness? Yes, I mean, it just didn't seem to hold up.
ru: Тогда я полагаю, я странный, потому, что я голосовал за невиновность.

quote: Credit cards, driver's license -- it's odd to leave these behind.
before: Mr. Powers! Nolan!
after: Everything about this is odd. What is a 40-year-old man doing alone watching cartoons, playing with stickers?
ru: Кредитки, водительские права ... странно их оставлять.

quote: Some people might think that's a bit odd.
before: Something they didn't hide well enough last time they were here. Randomly touching other people's houses.
after: - I was just... - You're Felix's brother, aren't you?
ru: Некоторые могут подумать, что это странно.

quote: It's a bit odd, because I'm an economist.
before: So what's Africa looking like today? This is how I look at Africa.
after: Each little box is about a billion dollars, and you see that I pay an awful lot of attention to Nigeria sitting there in the middle. South Africa is playing a role.
ru: Это немного странно, так как я экономист.

quote: And laughter can take us to some pretty odd places in terms of making noises.
before: (Audio: Laughing) This hasn't been edited; this is him. (Audio: Laughing) (Laughter) And finally we have — this is a human female laughing.
after: (Audio: Laughing) She actually says, " Oh my God, what is that? " in French. We're all kind of with her.
ru: Смех может довести нас до очень странных моментов в плане издавания звуков.

quote: And it's no wonder that as we head into the writers' strike, odd things happen.
before: PH: In my own company, Technorati, we see something like 67,000 blog posts an hour come in. That's about 2,700 fresh, connective links across about 112 million blogs that are out there.
after: You know, it reminds me of that old saw in Hollywood, that a producer is anyone who knows a writer. I now think a network boss is anyone who has a cable modem.
ru: Неудивительно, что накануне забастовки писателей происходят странные вещи.

quote: That would end any odd idea that the church should end in France.
before: And on that point they are very right. This is the fair part of the verdict.
after: Scientology is recognized everywhere in the world and France must step up to international standards. That is good for the church."

quote: Yeah, yeah, of course, just remind me how to, er?
before: That's miles away, isn't it? Well, do you want a drink or don't you?
after: A68 towards Wooler... ..follow the signs for Kielder then Howden. And the pub's called The Goose?
ru: Да-да, конечно, только напомните, где это.

quote: Of course, I don't yet have controlling interest.
before: British Imperial Coolant? The very same.
after: Which is where you come in. Gentlemen, is everything in order?
ru: Конечно у меня пока еще нет контрольного пакета акций.

quote: I left home early, of course because I wanted to catch the 7.22 bus.
before: Major-General Sandberg was supposed to talk on the orderly withdrawal. But when I got there, it was cancelled, of course.
after: It started raining, of course and I had no umbrella, of course so I decided to hurry home and get it, of course I thought it would be there but it wasn't, of course. On my way to the bus stop it started raining even more, and I got soaking wet, of course.
ru: Я пошел домой... раньше времени, конечно... потому что хотел успеть на автобус 7.22.

quote: Of course, now she can have her way with everything.
before: - No-one could get Reggie to do anything he didn't want. It drove Kitty mad.
after: But you can live wherever you want, though, can't you? You're not dependent on Kitty's charity.
ru: Конечно, теперь всё будет так, как захочет она.

quote: Of course, many, many cartoons must be rejected.
before: My job is to look at 1,000 cartoons a week. But The New Yorker only can take 16 or 17 cartoons, and we have 1,000 cartoons.
after: Now, we could fit more cartoons in the magazine if we removed the articles. (Laughter) But I feel that would be a huge loss, one I could live with, but still huge.
ru: Конечно, от многих карикатур приходится отказываться.

quote: Now, of course, in a mosh pit it's hard to specify a destination.
before: It's just part of your neighborly duty. And, in a way, that's exactly how packets move around the Internet, sometimes in as many as 25 or 30 hops, with the intervening entities that are passing the data around having no particular contractual or legal obligation to the original sender or to the receiver.
after: You need a lot of trust, but it's not like, " I'm trying to get to Pensacola, please. " So the Internet needs addressing and directions.
ru: Конечно, в слэме перед сценой трудно указать пункт назначения.

quote: Everybody benefits from that -- those employed, of course, because they get a job and dignity.
before: And you know what? It's good for everybody.
after: But also for the newcomers. They are 7,000 every year — people coming for the first time.
ru: Все выигрывают от такой политики. Те, кого нанимают, конечно, потому что они получают работу и самоуважение.

quote: We don't ban t-shirt slogans at TSU no matter what I find offensive.
before: It was sold by an alumni organization, so it was outside my purview. Is it true that members of Tau Omega were seen on campus wearing this t-shirt for months despite numerous complaints to your office?
after: Our students chose a progressive liberal arts university for a reason. How many sex crimes complaints has your office reported in the last three years?
ru: Мы не запрещаем футболки и лозунги на них независимо от того, что нам кажется оскорбительным.

quote: Yes, it's offensive that I have to be the smart one all the time!
before: That's not only offensive, but it's fucking stupid. It's offensive that I'm saying that you should be smart?
after: I'm allowed to be just as irresponsible as you. Well, that's how it works!
ru: Да. Оскорбительно, что я постоянно должна быть умной.

quote: I hope not, because that would be offensive.
before: So let's talk about the whole construction noise thing. Has anyone ever told you you look like a Jewish Kennedy?
after: I thought you were supposed to be some kind of big shark, and you were playing her. About the noise.
ru: Надеюсь, нет, потому что это было бы оскорбительно.

quote: There was nothing about the cake itself that was offensive to the baker?
before: It's because... you won't win. I mean, this was a plain wedding cake?
after: That's correct. It's the fact it would have been used in a ceremony she believes dishonored her religious creed.
ru: В самом торте не было ничего такого, что было для кондитера оскорбительно?

quote: I was in no way a pioneer, and would come to understand how offensive that is.
before: That I was some kind of pioneer. Well, I couldn't have been more wrong.
after: One of the first things I learned was to add my voice to the chorus, not overwrite what was already happening. (Voice breaking) Because the neighborhood hadn't died.
ru: Я ни в коем случае не был пионером, и позже я осознал, как оскорбительно было так считать.

quote: They decide what is too offensive or too provocative for you to see.
before: But we need to support these independent, critical and responsible voices in Africa, in Lebanon, in your local newspaper, in the Apple store. Today, tech companies are the world's largest editors.
after: So really, it's not about the freedom of cartoonists; it's about your freedoms. And for dictators all over the world, the good news is when cartoonists, journalists and activists shut up.
ru: Они решают, что является чересчур оскорбительным либо лишком провокационным для просмотра вами.

quote: They get called nasty names like "male-basher" and "man-hater," and the disgusting and offensive "feminazi", right?
before: These are the kind of questions that we need to be asking and the kind of work that we need to be doing, but if we're endlessly focused on what women are doing and thinking in relationships or elsewhere, we're not going to get to that piece. I understand that a lot of women who have been trying to speak out about these issues, today and yesterday and for years and years, often get shouted down for their efforts.
after: And you know what all this is about? It's called kill the messenger.
ru: Их обзывают фанатичными феминистками и мужненавистницами и отвратительным и оскорбительным словом «феминаци».

quote: The Northern Territory Police Association says Mr Brough's comments are offensive and ignorant.
after: "Mr Brough claims that our members turn a blind eye to crime in Aboriginal communities," association president Vince Kelly said. "That is the most ridiculous claim I have ever heard from a federal indigenous affairs minister."

quote: So listen, man, my living situation is officially screwed, but, um, not to worry.
before: - It's a good look for you. - Thanks.
after: I should be out of my room the next couple of days. What happened to financial aid?
ru: Так слушай чувак моя ситуация с жильём официально испортилась Но не переживай.

quote: But now his stupid, dum-dum-face girlfriend has officially barred him from being alone with me.
before: Okay? Sue me.
after: Yeah, I saw that coming. I don't know what to do.
ru: Но теперь его глупая девушка с дурацким лицом официально запретила ему оставаться со мной наедине.

quote: The Exes are officially in the big leagues.
before: - That soon? - Mm-hmm. - So start packing.
after: My name's Frankie. And I'm an alcoholic.
ru: "Бывшие" теперь официально в высшей лиге.

quote: Since then female genital mutilation is officially forbidden in many countries.
before: Waris Dirie was the first woman to bring the practice of female genitital mutilation to world public attention. In 1977 she was appointed by UN Secretary General Kofi Annan to be the ambassador in the fight against this terrible ritual.
after: Never the less six thousand girls are maimed daily. Out.
ru: С тех пор женское обрезание было официально запрещено во многих странах.

quote: It had the right to open preliminary investigations and to interrogate people officially.
before: It could stop people on the street and arrest them in its own prisons. Thirdly, the Stasi worked as a kind of public prosecutor.
after: Last but not least, the Stasi had its own armed forces. More than 11,000 soldiers were serving in its so-called Guards Regiment.
ru: У неё было право открывать предварительное расследование и официально допрашивать людей.

quote: Man: So you're the first human being to officially emulate a gecko.
before: (Laughter) Narrator: With a mattress below and attached to a safety rope, Lynn began her 60-foot ascent. Lynn made it to the top in a perfect pairing of Hollywood and science.
after: Lynn Verinsky: Ha! Wow.
ru: Мужчина: Вы первый человек, официально имитировавший геккона.

quote: As a multi-purpose passenger vehicle, it is now officially "designed for occasional off-road use."
before: So we did need a little bit of support from the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration. Now you may have seen in the news recently, they came through with us at the end of last month with a few special exemptions that will allow the Transition to be sold in the same category as SUVs and light trucks.
after: (Laughter) Now let's see it in action. You can see there the wings folded up just along the side of the plane.
ru: Как многофункциональное пассажирское транспортное средство, теперь оно официально «разработано для нерегулярного использования вне дорог».

quote: His death has officially been ruled as suicide.
before: Officials reported that 39-year-old Cerniglia had jumped off of the George Washington Bridge into the Hudson.
after: His body was retrieved from the river after reports of a man jumping off of the bridge.

quote: They didn't come down to their boat often but I had seen them earlier that day.
before: But I heard footsteps on the pontoon. (FOOTSTEPS) I thought it was the Lamberts returning at first.
after: But then I heard the footsteps going back again so I realised that it couldn't have been them. What about the explosion?
ru: Они не очень часто приходили к лодке но в тот день я их уже видел.

quote: My dominus often spoke of his distaste for the man.
before: Attius, a blacksmith by trade. I know of him.
after: Can we lay trust in the Roman? He stands Roman only by name.
ru: Мой господин часто отзывался о нём с неприязнью.

quote: I used to play at The Marsh House often.
before: I'm ready for it. It was a long time ago.
after: Marnie and I were very little. It's a bear!
ru: Я часто играла в Доме-на-Отмели.

quote: Though it's obvious we're not talking as often as we should be.
before: We both were. We practically live here.
after: There's security footage if you want to see it. We do.
ru: Хотя, видимо, разговариваем мы не так часто, как следовало бы.

quote: That's why people often confuse me with a GPS.
before: (Laughter) There are some other unusual things about me. You may have noticed that I don't have much inflection in my voice.
after: (Laughter) This can make basic communication a challenge, unless you need directions. (Laughter) Thank you.
ru: Поэтому люди часто путают меня с GPS.

quote: How often have you seen these kinds of inspirational memes in your Facebook feed?
before: So if you guys catch yourselves using these vague words, like " probably " or " sometimes, " try, instead, using numbers, because when we speak in numbers, we know what lands in the other person's brain. Now, the third thing I want to touch on today is intuition.
after: [Always trust your gut feeling and never second-guess.] They're nice, right?
ru: Как часто вы видите такие вдохновляющие мемы в ленте Facebook?

quote: And so often they told victims, "Just turn your computer off. Ignore it. It'll go away."
before: Law enforcers are not going to enforce laws they don't know about and proffer problems they don't understand. In my research on cyberstalking, I found that law enforcement lacked the training to understand the laws available to them and the problem of online abuse.
after: And we saw that in Rana Ayyub's case. She was told, " Come on, you're making such a big deal about this.
ru: Поэтому они часто говорят жертвам: «Просто выключите компьютер. Не обращайте внимания, и всё пройдёт».

quote: During his tenure at WWE he was often surrounded by both controversy and personal issues.
before: Hardy only left the WWE two weeks ago when he lost a “Loser leaves WWE” match against CM Punk.
after: He was released in 2003 with him saying it was a “mutual decision” He returned in 2006 but was suspended twice for violations to the WWE wellness program. He also had a stint in Total Nonstop Action Wrestling, where he was suspended and later released for missing shows.

quote: It's a compound containing neat's-foot, Stockholm tar, saligari, silicone and eucalyptus oil.
before: Really? After all this time, you expect me to know what this stuff says?
after: Those are all generic terms, and not at all scientific. Don't make me beg.
ru: Это состав, содержащий костяное масло, Стокгольмскую смолу, салигари, силикон и эвкалиптовое масло.

quote: We found his body under an oil drum.
before: I remember it well. And it's impossible to forget!
after: The drum was cut in half and the body was under it, like this... His head and feet were covered by sacks but one foot poked out like this.
ru: Мы нашли его труп под нефтяной бочкой.

quote: It's too much of a coincidence, what, to be an oil lamp she's left on?
before: He must have burnt that flat out. I don't care what the fire service says, it's just...
after: Come on, he was burning evidence and that is so different from... Well, that is someone who knows her.
ru: Слишком большое совпадение. Она оставила масляную лампу?

quote: Not to mention the oil, squirted between each layer.
before: Made-to-measure suits. The body goes here and the machine wraps it in 200 layers of bandages.
after: What kind of oil is it? No idea, but it worked a treat.
ru: Не говоря уже о масле, которым смазывался каждый слой.

quote: Imagine Van Gogh being born before the technologies of cheap oil paints.
before: And I think it's really important. Because if you can imagine Mozart before the technology of the piano was invented — what a loss to society there would be.
after: Imagine Hitchcock before the technologies of film. Somewhere, today, there are millions of young children being born whose technology of self-expression has not yet been invented.
ru: Представьте, что Ван Гог родился до технологий дешевых масляных красок.

quote: The world's most common fluids like water, oils and alcohols respond to force linearly.
before: Or a liquid? The answer is, it depends.
after: If you push on them twice as hard, they move twice as fast. Sir Isaac Newton, of apple fame, first proposed this relationship, and so those fluids are called Newtonian fluids.
ru: Самые распространённые жидкости, как вода, масло и алкоголь отвечают на воздействие линейно.

quote: So it actually hastens oil getting into the body easily and readily.
before: The solvents in them do that very efficiently. So they break down lipid membranes in our body, starting with cells of the skin, the cells of organs.
after: Oil contains hundreds of hydrocarbon compounds and other compounds that are toxic to every organ in the body. And so with the dispersants combined, you have this very synergistic combined toxicity.
ru: Поэтому этот процесс с лёгкостью ускоряет попадание нефти в наш организм.

quote: I have never traded or benefited from any oil deals with Iraq.
before: I've now had a chance to read the report which was compiled without this Senate committee asking me a single question about these absurd allegations. I repeat once more.

quote: The night Rolf died, I was in new Orleans, visiting an old friend.
before: So where were you the night your brother died? Whoa, whoa, whoa. This is not getting any better.
after: Does your old friend have a name? - Adam haupfman.
ru: Ночью, когда умер Рольф, я была в Новом Орлеане, в гостях у старого друга.

quote: So you pulled an old man out of the rubble?
before: I was nearby. I heard an explosion, came over to see what happened.
after: Tourniquet on an arm? Splint another man's leg.
ru: Так вы вытащили старика из под обломков?

quote: To sing in front of old people. Mm-hmm.
before: Get this. So he takes me to a nursing home...
after: So I'd be a star but in a comfortable environment, 'cause otherwise i would freak out. It was the whole works. He had the red carpet, he had the car, suit.
ru: Привез меня в дом престарелых, чтобы я спела старикам.

quote: The least you can do is set that old man's mind to rest.
before: Time to go home. Your people think you're dead.
after: He thinks I'm dead? He wasn't much wrong.
ru: Как минимум, ты должна успокоить своего старика.

quote: For that I won a big old plaque -- Man of the Year in Education.
before: And last year I put 88 percent of those kids in college and I've averaged over 80 percent for 15 years. We've made a fascinating discovery: there's nothing wrong with the kids that affection and sunshine and food and enthusiasm and Herbie's music can't cure.
after: I beat out all the Ph.D.'s because I figured that if you treat children like human beings, it increases the likelihood they're going to behave that way. And why we can't institute that policy in every school and in every city and every town remains a mystery to me.
ru: За это я получил большую старую табличку — Человек года в образовании.

quote: How do they treat their young and their old?
before: Where do the inhabitants live and work and go to school? What do they eat and how do they play?
after: What relationships do they have with the animals and plants of the world? And what do those animals and plants look like?
ru: Как они обращаются с детьми и стариками?

quote: We're still living with the old paradigm of age as an arch.
before: That's an entire second adult lifetime that's been added to our lifespan. And yet, for the most part, our culture has not come to terms with what this means.
after: That's the metaphor, the old metaphor. You're born, you peak at midlife and decline into decrepitude.
ru: Мы всё ещё живём согласно старой парадигме, где возраст рассматривается как дуга.

quote: He moved to Chicago when he was eight years old.
before: Terkel was born in New York City in 1912.
after: He was mostly known for his oral histories, but he was also host of his own radio show, an author of several books, and an activist.

quote: I got a messy situation going on on my end, too.
before: I'm getting a divorce. Yeah, I know how that goes.
after: Had to let my guy go. Had to cut him loose.
ru: У меня тут тоже неприятная ситуация.

quote: That's gonna be a problem on my end.
before: The remaining 12 will be arriving in your territories. We need a search of each one.
after: Colombian port officials are bought off by the cartels, and drugs are going in and out. They're not just gonna open the doors for the FBI.
ru: С моей стороны возникнут проблемы.

quote: Didn't quite go that well on my end.
before: And Sage is over the moon. Well, I'm happy to hear that.
after: First of all, Deacon told Maddie that he proposed. So, what?
ru: С моей стороны не все нормально.

quote: Now, who I choose to do business with on my end is not your problem.
before: You could charge twice the current rate for what I provide, and your customers would pay it. Hands down.
after: You won't see him. You won't interact with him.
ru: с кем я хочу делать бизнес с моей стороны - не ваша проблема.

quote: She believed he'd pushed his blocks under Milan's feet on purpose.
before: -When Milan died, Eugenia was somehow convinced it was little Peter who killed him,
after: After that she just stayed in the bedroom with Peter, watching over him. Day and night she just sat there watching him, holding his hand.
ru: Она была уверена, что он специально подложил под ноги Милана блоки конструктора.

quote: Why are they putting you in a coma on purpose?
before: Just want to get a sense of where we stand. If I have any questions, I'll ask you later.
after: Your... your brain seems fine. It's not like you think you're Napoléon.
ru: Зачем им специально погружать тебя в кому?

quote: I dropped the keys on purpose so she'll lead us here.
before: It was all just talk, but she... What the hell happened?
after: And what happened? You guys stopped for a smoothie?
ru: - Я бросил ключи нарочно, чтобы она привела нас сюда.

quote: You're gonna ask your own son to lose on purpose?
before: All we got to do is take those bets and get Chris to take a dive! Wait, hold on, Peter.
after: Damn, Quagmire! Your fridge gives you water from the door?
ru: Ты хочешь попросить своего собственного сына проиграть нарочно?

quote: So allow me to express that if I make you laugh, it's usually on purpose.
before: A muscle memory that overcomes even the most bitter of times, my memory is spotted with days of laughing until I cried, or crying until I laughed. Laughter and tears are both involuntary human reactions, testaments to our capacity for expression.
after: And if I make you cry, I'll still think you are beautiful. This is for my cousin Zeinab, bedridden on a random afternoon.
ru: Позвольте мне выразить себя: если я заставляю вас смеяться — это нарочно.

quote: Did I check it on purpose or just casually glance at the clock?
before: Was I hungry? Was I late?
after: And this is the key part — representing the details of my days and my personality through my data collection. Using data as a lens or a filter to discover and reveal, for example, my never-ending anxiety for being late, even though I'm absolutely always on time.
ru: Специально ли я смотрела на часы или просто взглянула мельком?

quote: It hurts more if you believe somebody is doing it to you on purpose.
before: The first shock hurts like hell. The second shock hurts just as much, and the third and the fourth and the fifth.
after: The most extreme example of this is that in some cases, pain under the right circumstances can transform into pleasure. Humans have this extraordinarily interesting property that will often seek out low-level doses of pain in controlled circumstances and take pleasure from it — as in the eating of hot chili peppers and roller coaster rides.
ru: Боль сильнее, если вы верите, что кто-то причиняет её специально.

quote: Once we get Barrett, we can go to the CIA, the FBI.
before: Just so we're sure here, you're not actually planning on turning this Barrett character over to Vaughn, right? No.
after: He's a pretty big card to play. You think it's enough to get Jesse back in?
ru: Как только мы получим Барретта, мы можем обратиться в ЦРУ, ФБР.

quote: And once he did that, how long do you think we'd keep breathing?
before: If general Monroe finds out that Jason went A.W.O.L., what would happen? He'd question our loyalty too.
after: Please. I'm doing this for you.
ru: И как только он сделает это, как ты думаешь, долго ли мы сможем продолжать дышать?

quote: I'll have you know, I once tossed a rabid bull off a cliff.
before: We'll be watching for your return. Now, are you sure you can hold me?
after: How is that even remotely relevant? I can hold you.
ru: Знаешь, однажды я скинул бешеного быка с обрыва.

quote: I told myself, once, once I had exposed Sixtus, relief would come.
before: Eventually even you won't be able to stop him. Would you have preferred I not?
after: And has it? I didn't do this for me.
ru: Я сказала себе, однажды, однажды, когда я разоблачу Сикста, облегчение придет.

quote: Well, the standard explanation was once summed up by the British Prime Minister, Margaret Thatcher.
before: The poor borrow more, save less, smoke more, exercise less, drink more and eat less healthfully. Why?
after: And she called poverty " a personality defect. " (Laughter) A lack of character, basically.
ru: Привычное объяснение было однажды высказано британским премьер-министром Маргарет Тэтчер.

quote: Colfax Avenue, here in Denver, Colorado, was once called the longest, wickedest street in America.
after: My office is there in the same place — it's a medical desert. There are government clinics and hospitals nearby, but they're not enough to handle the poor who live in the area.
ru: Улица Колфакс в Денвере, штат Колорадо, однажды была названа самой длинной неблагополучной улицей в Америке.

quote: But it has happened before once in history, right back at the dawn of science.
before: It's a difficult thing to do, however. We're talking about changing the culture of entire large parts of science.

after: We'll announce their engagement tonight at the St. Nicholas Feast. Well, what about the nobles?
ru: Этот брак хорошая возможность, реальный путь к миру.

quote: So, I just go down that path all the way?
before: And evil lurks around every corner. Gosh, you startled me.
after: A guy like you can go anywhere he wants. And any moment, Billy can strike.
ru: Значит, все время идти по тропинке?

quote: And that's been the path that we've been on in business.
before: Business should give more. Business should be more responsible.
after: But again, this path that we've been on is not getting us where we need to go. Now, I started out as a strategy professor, and I'm still a strategy professor.
ru: И это и есть тот путь, которому мы следуем в бизнесе.

quote: And the principle we all revolve around is what's called the "Neural Path of Least Resistance."
before: And I don't know about you, but living inside of Windows scares me. (Laughter) To isolate the single most intuitive interface out of infinity, we use neuroscience to drive our design guidelines, instead of letting a bunch of designers fight it out in the boardroom.
after: At every turn, we're connecting the iOS of the brain with our brain on, for the first time, our brain's terms. In other words, we're trying to create a zero learning-curve computer.
ru: Принцип, вокруг которого мы все вращаемся, называется «нейронный путь наименьшего сопротивления».

quote: The gravity of the matter is strong enough to bend the path of light.
before: And this map is showing us all the matter in this region of the sky, which is inferred by the light distorted from these 100 million galaxies. The light distorted from all of the matter that was between those galaxies and us.
after: And it gives us this image. So these kinds of maps can tell us about how much dark matter there is, they also tell us where it is and how it changes over time.
ru: Гравитация материи достаточно сильна, чтобы искривить путь света.

quote: We seek a path where all the constituent elements of our society can grow and prosper.
before: The SDP seeks the common good in Britain's national interest. We represent neither capital nor labour, not private industry nor the public sector, but only the welfare of the British people and residents of these islands.
after: We believe in a Social Market Economy where pro-public sector and pro-market policy can beneficially coexist within a balanced programme – provided each inhabits its correct domain, and neither is allowed to distort our country's economy in the service of ideology.

quote: Their patience shall be rewarded, for soon they will dip their spears in blood.
before: The army stands behind you, my lord. It appears.
after: We strike at midnight. I honoryou, my lord.
ru: Их терпение должно быть вознаграждено, ибо скоро они окрасят свои копья кровью.

quote: We ask for your continued patience and your help with this implementation.
before: A reminder... These are not a replacement for U.S. currency. We continue to work with the banks to ensure everyone has access to their money and their property, but until our productivity can keep up with demand, these cards will ensure citizens are granted equal access to available goods.
after: Dr. Rachel Scott's murder came as a shock to us all, but she died knowing that she brought life back to this great nation. And her sacrifice will not be forgotten.
ru: Мы просим проявить терпение и оказать помощь в реализации.

quote: And truthfully, Trend, I just don't have the time and the patience to teach you tolerance.
before: It's time for Omega Chi to work harder on the quality of guys we bring in Calvin Owens has more potential than you'll ever have.
after: I don't know who elected you, emperor of Omega Chi but you don't have the authority to kick me out, I'm not going anywhere. Actually you're about 3 months late on your dues which if your checked the house rules is due cause for exposure.
ru: И по правде говоря, Трен, у меня нету времени и терпения учить тебя манерам.

quote: I'm just asking for a little patience, all right?
before: I'm really trying here, Dexter. Dexter.
after: Not for me, but for Deb. Right now I need to focus on finding who did this.
ru: Я просто прошу немного терпения, хорошо?

quote: Not everybody has the patience of my wife, Chaz.
before: They aren't an improvement, but they're the best I can do. They give me a way to speak.
after: But online, everybody speaks at the same speed. This whole adventure has been a learning experience.
ru: Не у всех есть терпение как моей жены, Чез.

quote: All you need to find them is a little patience and a microscope.
before: And they're in diverse biomes including deserts, ice sheets, the sea, fresh water, rainforests, and the highest mountain peaks. But you can find tardigrades in the most ordinary places, too, like moss or lichen found in yards, parks, and forests.
after: Scientists are now to trying to find out whether tardigrades use the tun state, their anti-drying technique, to survive other stresses. If we can understand how they, and other creatures, stabilize their sensitive biological molecules, perhaps we could apply this knowledge to help us stabilize vaccines, or to develop stress-tolerant crops that can cope with Earth's changing climate.
ru: Для того чтобы их найти, требуется немного терпения и микроскоп.

quote: When I say mindful patience, I don't mean the ability to wait.
before: Alarmingly, one in every four diabetics in the world now comes from China. The stories around food are scary and somewhat overwhelming, and I told myself it's time to bring a mindful patience into the impatience.
after: I mean knowing how to act while waiting. And so, while I wait for the day when a sustainable food system becomes a reality in China, I launched one of China's first online farmers market to bring local, organically grown produce to families.
ru: Когда я говорю об осознанном терпении, я не имею в виду умение ждать.

quote: Battle-weary after six months of contacting his operator, Spadaro has lost all patience.
after: "Since June, I've spent hours writing emails, letters or calling Orange to ask for an explanation. I've been passed from call centre to call centre, from customer services to debt collection.

quote: He's been patient and organized up to now.
before: So, the victim was supposed to meet her husband for date night and he never showed up. So the unsub wanted both but only got one.
after: Why wouldn't he wait? Maybe one was enough?
ru: До сих пор он был терпелив и организован.

quote: I am a very patient man, Helena.
before: How did Maggie find the clones? How did she communicate with you?
after: So, I'ma just make me a grilled cheese sandwich while you think about it. Sorry I can't help you out of this.
ru: Я очень терпеливый человек, Хелена.

quote: I'm telling you, you need to be patient.
before: Hey, time to get up, buddy. We're going on a little field trip.
after: I'm afraid that's not one of my virtues. Amen to that.
ru: Говорю тебе, нужно быть терпеливым.

quote: And it seems like he's been pretty damn patient, if you ask me.
before: Yeah. But Kevin does.
after: I mean, when's the last time you guys even went out? Look, at some point, you just got to stop being afraid of who you are now and... and... trust that what's meant to be is meant to be.
ru: И кажется, будто он был чертовски терпелив, на мой взгляд.

quote: And my parents were very patient, but I had been doing intermittent sojourns to India on a mystical quest.
before: It all started back in 1977. I was a young man, and I had been dropping in and out of college.
after: And I remember the last time I came back from India — in my long white flowing robes and my big beard and my John Lennon glasses — and I said to my father, " Dad, I think I've just about found spiritual enlightenment. " He said, " Well there's one more thing you need to find. "
ru: Мои родители были очень терпеливыми, в то время когда я периодически посещал Индию, для моих эзотерических поисков.

quote: Patient capital works between, and tries to take the best of both.
before: They must navigate markets daily, making micro-decisions, dozens and dozens, to move their way through society, and yet if a single catastrophic health problem impacts their family, they could be put back into poverty, sometimes for generations. And so we need both the market and we need aid.
after: It's money that's invested in entrepreneurs who know their communities and are building solutions to healthcare, water, housing, alternative energy, thinking of low income people not as passive recipients of charity, but as individual customers, consumers, clients, people who want to make decisions in their own lives. Patient capital requires that we have incredible tolerance for risk, a long time horizon in terms of allowing those entrepreneurs time to experiment, to use the market as the best listening device that we have, and the expectation of below-market returns, but outsized social impact.
ru: «Терпеливый» капитал работает между ними и пытается взять лучшее от обеих систем.

quote: From this dataset you actually learn that retired European families are extremely patient with survey takers.
before: One way to imagine that is I gather large datasets from around the world. So for example, there is the Survey of Health, [Aging] and Retirement in Europe.
after: (Laughter) So imagine that you're a retired household in Belgium and someone comes to your front door. " Excuse me, would you mind if I peruse your stock portfolio?
ru: По нему вы видите, что европейские семьи пенсионного возраста чрезвычайно терпеливо относятся к тем, кто проводит опрос.

quote: Mohamed Abdi, a patient at the hospital, was a witness to the event.
after: "I was sitting in my wheelchair about 10 meters [30 feet] away from my friends when a mortar exploded and smoke and dust covered us all. I saw my friends on the ground, with blood scattered everywhere like slaughtered goats," he told the Associated Press news agency.

quote: I wanted the toile ones, with the blue-and-green pattern.
before: Why can't you ever do what I ask? They were 70% off, Ang.
after: It's a cup, Ang. It's a cup!
ru: Я хотела те прозрачные с сине-зелёным узором.

quote: And it's important to remember this, that... this is a pattern... that repeats itself throughout history.
before: How do they do that? Lower education... they limit culture... censor information... they censor any means of individual expression.
after: Okay. See you next week.
ru: И важно помнить, что.. это закономерность... которая повторяется на протяжении всей истории.

quote: Well, he's not adhering to any pattern now.
before: Almost there. One sec... One sec.
after: None whatsoever. All right, you two.
ru: Ну, теперь он не придерживается какой-либо закономерности.

quote: If Grams ever does get home, she won't be pleased to find out you've rubbed the pattern off her bowl.
before: To not hating each other. Cheers.
after: Joey, I appreciate whatever reasons you have for pretending you're fine but you don't have to do that with me. Do you miss me?
ru: Знаешь, если бабуля когда-то вернется домой, она не обрадуется тому, что ты стёрла узор на ее блюде.

quote: Behavioral researchers have identified consistent patterns that seem to guide this process of impression updating.
before: If so, you might choose to avoid him the next time you see him. That said, we can change our impressions in light of new information.
after: On one hand, learning very negative, highly immoral information about someone typically has a stronger impact than learning very positive, highly moral information. So, unfortunately for our new friend from the football game, his bad behavior at the game might outweigh his good behavior at the park.
ru: Бихевиористы обнаружили закономерности, управляющие процессом обновления впечатлений.

quote: So what do these patterns look like again?
before: So he sent a letter back to John saying, " It turns out you can generate these patterns using prime number theory. " And John went about and solved the sonar problem for the Navy.
after: Here's a pattern here. This is an 88-by-88-sized Costas array.
ru: Как же выглядят эти закономерности?

quote: It adds together the interference pattern from two raindrops that land near each other.
before: This is the " Double Raindrop. " Of all my sculptures, it's the most talkative.
after: Instead of expanding circles, they're expanding hexagons. All the sculptures move by mechanical means.
ru: Она соединяет вместе интерференционный узор двух капель, которые падают рядом друг с другом.

quote: The scientists suggested cross-pollination and changing farming patterns in Assam were likely the causes.
after: However, they still have to check other possible influences such as changing agro-climatic conditions.

quote: The goods are returned upon payment in person.
before: Pawn shop takes half a month interest even for a day. The principle 80,000 Won plus interest 1,600 Won.
after: Oh! Really, sir? Didn't know that.
ru: товар возвращается лично клиенту после полной оплаты кредита.

quote: So, when Liu gave me the drugs, I asked him about money, payments.
before: Something gnawing at me. What?
after: And Liu said-- and I quote-- "We'll talk finances later."
ru: Когда Лю отдал мне наркотики, я спросила его о деньгах, об оплате.

quote: Further commission payment can be made via mobile phone.
before: Due to the credit crisis brought on by Five/Nine, many private businesses cannot afford waste management services, which has sparked a cottage industry of roadside garbage burning at discounted rates. Due to the advance of Five/Nine, the Taxi and Limousine Commission asks that drivers now accept Ecoin.
after: Just download the Ecoin app from the Play Store or App Store, scan the QR code once you reach your destination, and the payment will be withdrawn from your Ecoin Wallet. You had me worried not answering my calls after all that went down.
ru: Оплата может быть произведена через мобильный телефон.

quote: My team uncovered a large payment to Tom Larsen from a bank account associated with Olivia.
before: The warrant I'm submitting to have Olivia Pope arrested. On what grounds?
after: It's all right there. I'm sure this isn't what it seems.
ru: Моя команда обнаружила огромный платеж Тому Ларсену с банковского счета Оливии Поуп.

quote: Now, the US spends over three billion a year on energy bill payment assistance.
before: We're connecting neighborhoods to community solar and spearheading community-led smart home research and installation programs to help families bring down their energy bills. We're even working directly with elected officials, advocating for more equitable pricing, because to see this vision of energy equity and resilience succeed, we have to work together sustainably.
after: And these programs do help millions of people, but they're only able to help a fraction of those in need. In fact, there is a 47-billion-dollar home-energy affordability gap, so assistance alone is not sustainable.
ru: США тратят более 3 млрд долларов в год на помощь в оплате электричества.

quote: It's a system that really ties together all the transportation assets into a single payment system.
before: Pedestrian zones and dedicated traffic lanes are going to be created, and all of this will cut down the average rush hour commute to get across town in New York from about an hour today at rush hour to about 20 minutes. Now if you look at Hong Kong, they have a very interesting system called Octopus there.
after: So parking garages, buses, trains, they all operate within the same system. Now shared car services are also springing up around the world, and these efforts, I think, are great.
ru: Это система связывает весь транспортный парк единой платежной системой.

quote: We accept payment for advertising, and we mark it as such.
before: The other thing I wanted to mention just briefly is that we have a tremendous ability and responsibility to provide people the right information, and we view ourselves like a newspaper or a magazine — that we should provide very objective information. And so in our search results, we never accept payment for our search results.
after: And that's unlike many of our competitors. And I think decisions we're able to make like that have a tremendous impact on the world, and it makes me really proud to be involved with Google.
ru: Нам платят только за рекламу, которую мы и продвигаем как рекламу.

quote: What were some of the items/services that required buying/payment?
before: You've said elsewhere that the production budget was about $800.

quote: Please, let me sit in peace with my uncle.
before: I've not betrayed you. I wish to be alone with my uncle.
after: It really is. It's wonderful.
ru: Прошу тебя, оставь меня в покое с моим дядей.

quote: War feeds our glory there is no place for peace.
before: And when he does pray doom does not fall upon your heads. Brave warriors!
after: Do you want them followed? We could kill them in their sleep... and feast on their flesh this very night.
ru: Война питает нашу славу. Там нет места для мира.

quote: Leave the devil in peace and let's concentrate on our task.
before: Shush, you're making my hairs stand on end. Sometimes I am not sure that we are not working for the devil himself.
after: Salvador told us that we would find everything necessary for the mission here and I don't see anything. Let's look in the rooms.
ru: Оставим дьявола в покое и сосредоточимся на наших делах.

quote: Men at war who were ordered to do appalling things and are now at peace.
before: Those are things I know nothing about but I do know about forgiveness and I've seen a lot of men who have confessed their sins admitted their guilt, and left their burdens behind them. Stronger men than you.
after: Well, I gotta hand it to you, Padre. You came here with your guns loaded this time.
ru: Людей, которым приказывали на войне делать ужасающие вещи которые теперь обрели покой.

quote: And then there's this beautiful statement: "We came in peace for all mankind."
before: This plaque is a beautiful object, and one that I want to talk to you a little bit about. First, you might notice that there's two globes, representing all of earth.
after: Now, at first, this is just nice poetic language, but it's also set in a typeface that's perfect for this moment. It seems industrial, it seems engineered.
ru: А ниже красивая фраза: «Мы пришли с миром от всего человечества».

quote: And donors are supposed to bring peace by building schools and roads.
before: This is a picture I took in 2005, walking on Fridays over the hills in Kabul, and for me it's a symbolic picture of an open future for a young generation. So, doctors prescribe medication.
after: Military collect weapons, and depression stays intact. Why?
ru: а благотворительные организации должны приносить мир: строить школы и прокладывать дороги.

quote: These are the ideals that a war-torn Libya needs desperately in order to achieve peace.
before: We need to start acting as agents of compassion and mercy. We need to develop a feminine discourse that not only honors but also implements mercy instead of revenge, collaboration instead of competition, inclusion instead of exclusion.
after: For peace has an alchemy, and this alchemy is about the intertwining, the alternation between the feminine and masculine perspectives. That's the real zipper.
ru: Это те идеалы, которые пострадавшая от войны Ливия срочно должна воплотить, чтобы достичь мира.

quote: The initial deadline for the peace talks was Sunday at midnight, but was extended thrice.
before: Rebel negotiators faced intense pressure to accept the amended deal, as diplomats from the United States, Britain, Canada and the European Union struggled to find common ground.
after: The peace plan was prepared by mediators from the African Union and was amended after the rebel groups did not agree at an early draft. International negotiators, including U.S. Deputy Secretary of State Robert Zoellick, Nigerian President Olusegun Obasanjo and British International Development Secretary Hilary Benn, said the deal was the best hope for peace in Darfur.

quote: And all we want on this small, small planet is peaceful coexistence.
before: Vampires are not the enemy. We-- we are God's creatures, just like you.
after: Speaking of coexistence, is there anyone special in your life? Let's just say that... yes, there is someone... and she makes me very happy.
ru: И всё, чего мы хотим на этой маленькой, маленькой планете, так это мирного сосуществования.

quote: I like my garden peaceful and quiet with big, beautiful, blooming buds.
before: Yeah, your numbers are amazing. But then I... I am the one left behind spending half my life making nice with all the people whose lives you've carved up and gutted.
after: Okay, skip, listen. Maybe my style points leave something to be desired, yeah, granted. I'll try to do better.
ru: Мне нравится свой сад умиротворённым и спокойным, с большими, прекрасными, цветущими бутонами.

quote: Peaceful worlds must choose sides or face the threat of invasion.
before: I do believe Miss Price just assaulted Mr Collins. A galaxy, divided by war.
after: Republican Separatist armies vie for the allegiance of neutral planets. Desparate to build a Republic supply base in the system of Toydaria, Jedi Master Yoda travels to secret negotiations on a remote neutral moon.
ru: Мирные планеты должны выбрать одну из сторон или столкнуться с угрозой вторжения.

quote: Go there and plant fruit trees and live a peaceful life, Eun Sung's Dad.
before: And you can use your own name. So I started looking for an avenue.
after: Don't make me and Eun Sung feel uneasy. When I get in touch with Eun Sung, I'll notify you.
ru: Поезжай туда, занимайся садоводством и живи спокойно, отец Ын Сон.

quote: It was a beautiful country, beautiful, peaceful country.
before: I live in a country that was a beautiful country. I just want to share this with you.
after: We were going everywhere. Women were getting education: lawyer, engineer, teacher, and we were going from house to house.
ru: Это была прекрасная страна, красивая, мирная страна.

quote: So you can imagine it's a very peaceful, quiet meal.
before: It's something that you can do in a very kind of personal way. So every once in a while, if I'm lucky, my wife and I like to go out to dinner, and we have three children under the age of seven.
after: (Laughter) So we sit down and literally all I want to do is just eat and chill, and my kids have a completely and totally different idea of what we're going to be doing. And so my first idea is my sandbag strategy, right?
ru: Представляете, какой это спокойный, тихий ужин.

quote: Those men wanted to create a peaceful, democratic Europe, a Europe that works for its people.
before: A world war had emerged from Europe. The human suffering was unbelievable and unprecedented.
after: And one of the many building blocks in that peace project was a common European market. Already back then, they saw how markets, when left to themselves, can sort of slip into being just the private property of big businesses and cartels, meeting the needs of some businesses and not the needs of customers.
ru: Эти люди хотели создать мирную, демократическую Европу, которая служит интересам её населения.

quote: "It had been peaceful up to that point."
before: "We were surprised by the approach. It was supposed to be a peaceful demonstration," one officer said.

quote: You're 33 films, you're 30, I think this is the peak of your career now.
before: He says, "Well they don't call me Bozo for nothing. " Anyway, obviously, you came here to see how fast you could driveour reasonably priced cararound our track. Absolutely.
after: I'm thinking of maybe Cameron's lap first of all. Yeah?
ru: У тебя 33 фильма, а тебе 30, я думаю это пик твоей карьеры.

quote: Now, when you get to Piston Peak Air Attack, you're gonna ask for Blade Ranger.
before: That's the morning rush. Highway's all clear, Duster.
after: Blade Ranger. You got it. Yeah.
ru: Сядешь на базе у Пика Поршня, скажешь, тебе нужен Рейнджер Винт.

quote: The celebrations of our victory at Calais will reach their peak.
before: Be off. Don your finest clothing.
after: Clean that. I was wrong.
ru: Празднование в честь нашей победы на Кале достигает своего пика.

quote: Once all these scamps sleep in their graves, you'll be at your peak.
before: It's moments away and so I am really delighted that you'll not only see her mom's grave but also her in the bloom of youth. I think you will like it.
after: And a hundred years from now none of us will be alive. Why are we going to Olomouc?
ru: Однажды все эти негодяи уснут в своих могилах, а вы будете на вершине.

quote: I am a white, able-bodied guy sitting nearly at the peak of privilege mountain.
before: Being trans means a daily onslaught of these misconceptions. And I have it pretty easy.
after: For non-binary people, for trans women, for trans people of color, it is so much harder. So I've given you a starter pack of trans knowledge that I hope will lead to more learning on your own.
ru: Я — белый трудоспособный парень, я на вершине социальной лестницы.

quote: And first, what surprised us was sleep was the biggest peak of the day.
before: Let's zoom in a little bit here. What you see is 24 hours from left to right, and here is two days of data.
after: Now, that sounds broken, right? You're calm when you're asleep, so what's going on here?
ru: И первое, что нас удивило, — это то, что наибольший пик активности за весь день пришёлся на сон.

quote: If we look closer, we see those peaks occur at the same month every year.
before: See this line, this is a landscape for violent video games. As you can see, there's a kind of odd, regular pattern in the data, twin peaks every year.
after: Why? Well, November, Christmas video games come out, and there may well be an upsurge in the concern about their content.
ru: Если мы внимательнее присмотримся к этим пикам, то увидим, что они происходят в одно и то же время каждый год.

quote: Peak winds associated with Andres are estimated at 60 mph, with gusts to 75 mph.
after: The cyclone is tracking towards the west-northwest at 5 mph. Barometric pressure at the storm's center has fallen to 995 mbar.

quote: Everyone needs a place to decompress with their peers.
before: I've heard of cop bars and sports bars and mafia bars. Never been to a postal bar.
after: Actually, uh, these are not my peers, but they are clearly yours, and I thought you might enjoy it here. Aren't you a charmer?
ru: Каждый нуждается в месте, где можно хорошо провести время со своими ровесниками.

quote: And it started to eke out in his discussion, little by little, to his cousin first, his peer, followed by all that trauma that winter.
before: That's why he confessed. 'Cause he couldn't live with it.
after: The loss of weight, the tearful sessions, sitting at a birthday party and he's in tears because he's by himself. It's not because he lost a girlfriend, it's because he couldn't live with it.
ru: И он стал искать выход этому в своих разговорах, понемногу, сначала с двоюродной сестрой, своей ровесницей, как следствие травмы, перенесенной той зимой.

quote: He needs social interaction with his peers.
before: D-- no, no, no, no, no, let's not be hasty. We shouldn't pull young upchuck out till he finishes the school year.
after: Isolation could wreak havoc on his underdeveloped mind. - Mm. - Hey, hey, buddy.
ru: Ему необходимы социальные контакты с ровесниками.

quote: Teachers and peers were underestimating her; she was teased at school.
before: But people used to say to her, " Why are you so miserable? " People were making misjudgments all the time on her mood.
after: So she chose to have facial surgery. After the facial surgery, she said, " My face now reflects my personality.

ru: Сокращение всемирной нищеты на 80% в тот период произошло в Китае.

quote: This is the critical period for sound development, but what's going on up there?

quote: Because presently, the politicians do not have permission to do what needs to be done.

quote: But anyway, the council granted these people permission, and they're now trying to build their cemetery.

ru: Теперь пора потребовать и этой интимной справедливости в их личной жизни.

ru: Я полагаю, с вашей точки зрения весьма прискорбно, что не один из них не сядет.
