ru: Прямо сейчас всё, что я могу тебе сказать: предыдущий владелец - женщина.

quote: Bringing up three children when you're the world's richest family seems like a social experiment without much prior art.
before: So they know the difference that an education can make in a huge, profound way. CA: I mean, this is another pic of your other two kids, Rory and Phoebe, along with Paul Farmer.
after: How have you managed it? What's been your approach?
ru: Трое детей, когда у тебя самая богатая семья в мире, звучит как социальный эксперимент без особой предварительной подготовки.

quote: Medicine may very well be the last high-stakes industry that does not practice prior to game time.
before: That's a problem. I think there's a better approach.
after: I want to describe to you a better approach through medical simulation. Well, the first thing we did is we went to other high-stakes industries that had been using this type of methodology for decades.
ru: Медицина, возможно, последняя отрасль с высокими ставками, в которой не используют предварительную тренировку.

quote: We discussed, in the prior film, some of the old things that we did, like stents and insulin pumps for the diabetic.
before: I'm going to discuss with you three of my inventions that can have an effect on 10 to a 100 million people, which we will hope to see happen.
after: And I'd like to talk very briefly about three new inventions that will change the lives of many people. At the present time, it takes an average of three hours after the first symptoms of a heart attack are recognized by the patient, before that patient arrives at an emergency room.
ru: Мы обсудили, в предыдущем фильме, некоторые из старых проектов, которые уже осуществлены, стенты и инсулиновые насосы для диабетиков.

quote: Prior to January 1, a global quota system helped regulate the trade.
after: With the quota system gone, fears have arisen that a flood of Chinese goods could undercut U.S. competitiveness in the market. China is able to market its goods cheaply due to an artificially weak yuan.

quote: Sounds like someone's targeting 15, so this case is top priority.
before: That's gonna be a long list. Half the people we bring in file bogus complaints.
after: So anything you guys need, you got it. (Bottle clunks) (Man) How could you not know anything?
ru: Похоже, кто-то открыл охоту на 15-й участок, так что у этого дела высший приоритет.

quote: Well, getting your family back is our top priority.
before: Why didn't you show them the text message? I was told if I involved the police that they'd... they'd be killed.
after: Well, then, go get them back. Please.
ru: Ну, возвращение вашей семьи наш приоритет.

quote: Locating Miranda Shaw is now our top priority.
before: I jumped on a plane the second I heard about you and that bomb. All right, I want everyone's attention, please!
after: We have to find her and stop her before that bomb goes off, wherever it is. And we will not fail.
ru: Поиск Миранды Шоу - теперь главный приоритет.

quote: Do you think we made our priorities about others?
before: And what if we hadn't? Do you think others at that time counted?
after: You guys all had your lives. You had people that you were going to hate for the simple reason that they existed.
ru: Вы думаете, мы поставили наши приоритеты выше других?

quote: A problem's higher priority, the bigger, the more easily solvable and the more neglected it is.
before: Of all the many problems that the world faces, which should we be focused on trying to solve first? Now, I'm going to give you a framework for thinking about this question, and the framework is very simple.
after: Bigger is better, because we've got more to gain if we do solve the problem. More easily solvable is better because I can solve the problem with less time or money.
ru: Приоритет проблемы тем больше, чем больше её величина, решаемость и степень запущенности.

quote: But while the telephone companies have built surveillance as a priority, Silicon Valley companies have not.
before: So what that means is that when you're talking to your spouse, your children, a colleague or your doctor on the telephone, someone could be listening. Now, that someone might be your own government; it could also be another government, a foreign intelligence service, or a hacker, or a criminal, or a stalker or any other party that breaks into the surveillance system, that hacks into the surveillance system of the telephone companies.
after: And increasingly, over the last couple years, Silicon Valley companies have built strong encryption technology into their communications products that makes surveillance extremely difficult. For example, many of you might have an iPhone, and if you use an iPhone to send a text message to other people who have an iPhone, those text messages cannot easily be wiretapped.
ru: Но в отличие от телефонных компаний, сделавших слежку приоритетной задачей, компании Силиконовой долины работают иначе.

quote: What this really does is that it makes us think about our priorities.
before: Basically for the amount of money that we spend, we can do X amount of good in treatment, and 10 times as much good in prevention. So again, what we focus on is prevention rather than treatment, at first rate.
after: I'd like to have you look at your priority list and say, did you get it right? Or did you get close to what we came up with here?
ru: Это заставляет нас по-настоящему задуматься о своих приоритетах.

quote: Priorities of the conference include economic growth, peace and democracy and climate change.
before: The United Nations (UNFPA) organization United Nations Population Fund emphasized the importance of women's health in Africa at the 4th Tokyo International Conference on African Development (TICAD IV).
after: The three-day conference which ended Friday included representatives from over 80 countries.

quote: Brian Green will die in prison. That's enough. Oh, really?
before: It's not our fault you didn't pay the ransom. He didn't mean that.
after: You never said, 'As far as I'm concerned, they're as guilty as each other, and that witch cheated justice'? Come with me.
ru: Брайан Грин умрет в тюрьме, и этого достаточно.

quote: God knows I was beating myself up every day in prison while I was there.
before: Look, I don't blame you for wanting to move on and start anew. Alright?
after: So, you know, you, Fuzz, moving... It's of no value going over this now. I've moved on.
ru: Лишь Бог знает, как я казнил себя каждый день в тюрьме, пока я там находился.

quote: He wanted to know if he could go to prison for lying on the stand.
before: - That's a killer, man. - What did you two talk about?
after: Nothing worse for an ex-cop than going to prison. - He didn't lie.
ru: Он хотел знать, сядет ли он в тюрьму за ложь в суде.

quote: Survival is about being patient. I learnt that in a Spanish prison.
before: Another few inches would do it. Save your strength.
after: Five years in gaol. That must have been tough.
ru: Испанская тюрьма научил меня тому, что терпение - залог выживания.

quote: If we rely on just prisons to reduce crime, I'm afraid we'll never get there.
before: Reducing recidivism may be our ultimate goal, but it's not our only goal. To be honest with you, preventing crime takes so much more from so many more people and institutions.
after: But prisons can do some things we never thought they could do. Prisons can be the source of innovation and sustainability, repopulating endangered species and environmental restoration.
ru: Если мы будем полагаться лишь на тюрьмы в сокращении преступности, боюсь, мы никогда к этому не придём.

quote: He assumed the regency himself and threw the boys in prison.
before: The rest of Edward IV's reign was peaceful, but upon his death in 1483, the bloodshed resumed. Though his twelve-year-old son was due to succeed him, Edward's younger brother Richard III declared his nephews illegitimate due to their father's secret marriage.
after: Though no one knows what ultimately became of them, after a while, the Princes disappeared and Richard's power seemed secure. But his downfall would come only two years later from across the narrow sea of the English Channel.
ru: Он сам объявил себя королем и отправил мальчиков в тюрьму.

quote: Now, unless you're a prison guard, the sentence "Some jobs are jails" is literally false.
before: Because we cannot ignore the metaphorical meaning of words either. One of the sentences was, " Some jobs are jails. "
after: Sadly, it's metaphorically true. And the metaphorical truth interferes with our ability to identify it as literally false.
ru: Если вы не тюремный надзиратель, то очевидно, что предложение «Иногда работа – тюрьма» неверно буквально.

quote: Mangione was present for the decision, in his prison uniform and shackles, according to The Guardian.
And they include summoning a federal prisoner whenever I damn well please.
before: You'll need this. As you know, working at the CIA gives me certain privileges too.
after: Fair enough. Guard, hold all my calls.
ru: А они заключаются в вызове на допрос заключенных федерального значения когда бы мне того не захотелось.

quote: We have the prisoners and are leaving HYDRA airspace.
before: Okay. Come on. We don't have much time. This is SHIELD 218.
after: Whew. Well done, Coulson. Agent Weaver, have our jets fire when ready.
ru: Пленники у нас и мы покидаем воздушной пространство ГИДРЫ.

quote: She's not a prisoner; she agreed to remain with us.
before: We've been trying to keep things friendly. How friendly can things be when you're holding her prisoner?
after: Because she doesn't want to go back to Libya. Okay, look.
ru: Она - не заключенная, она согласилась остаться с нами.

quote: The Twi'lek prisoners will make this difficult but not impossible.
before: But there's a complication. They've taken the locals hostage, and they're using them as shields.
after: I still have a good plan for taking out those guns. Getting the villagers out of harm's way is our first priority.
ru: Заключённые тви'леки осложняют дело, но не срывают.

quote: The children are virtual prisoners; they cannot leave, they cannot go home.
before: Step three: The Taliban want these children to hate the world that they currently live in. So they beat these children — I have seen it; they feed them twice a day dried bread and water; they rarely allow them to play games; they tell them that, for eight hours at a time, all they have to do is read the Koran.
after: Their parents are so poor, they have no resources to get them back. Step four: The older members of the Taliban, the fighters, start talking to the younger boys about the glories of martyrdom.
ru: Дети, фактически, – пленники. Покинуть школу нельзя, домой уйти они не могут.

quote: This is how a prisoner drew how they felt about the prison.
before: This was a magic box. This was a sensitive box.
after: If you see somebody in the blue — yeah, this guy — he was a prisoner, and he was a teacher. And you see, everybody's busy.
ru: Так заключённые изобразили, что они чувствуют и что происходит в тюрьме.

quote: He's a prisoner, just like Jonah inside the whale.
before: If a person stretched their arms wide, this person is saying, " It was this big. " The person inside the mouth, the person is trapped.
after: One tree is a tree. Two trees together, we have the woods.
ru: Он заключённый, как Иона внутри кита.

quote: Miller was then transferred to Iraq, where there was a prisoner abuse scandal at Abu Ghraib.
before: Gen. Geoffrey Miller, commander of the Guantánamo detention camp, is said to have made the decision to jail Mr Yee.
after: The extent of Miller's involvement in Mr Yee's treatment at Guatamano and Abu Ghraib is not known. The US administration has not elaborated on Mr Yee's claims.

quote: Let's talk about the real reason you don't like private school.
before: She's 10 and you're counting her out already? It's over?
after: What? It's about you.
ru: Давай обсудим реальную причину. Ты не любишь частные школы.

quote: Should I try and stall the Colombian men who just flew in on a private jet?
before: This is a really bad time. I'm sorry.
after: - Cartel? - That would be my guess if I cared.
ru: Мне попросить колумбийцев на частном самолете подождать?

quote: "Private lessons in mathematics and physics, "given most thoroughly by Albert Einstein.
before: And I will do the right thing for you and this child. I promise.
after: Trial lesson free." Sounds promising.
ru: "Частные уроки математики и физики, тщательно излагаемые Альбертом Эйнштейном.

quote: Donald Strachey, private investigator, and you've just made it.
before: I think there's been a mistake. There has been a mistake,
after: What is it? They're back.
ru: Дональд Стрейчи, частный следователь, и вы только что её совершили.

quote: Now, all this private ownership of course had a public cost.
before: And that phenomenon had gone global. In China by 2011, there were more car sales happening in China than in the US.
after: In the US, we spend 7 billion hours a year, wasted, sitting in traffic. 160 billion dollars in lost productivity, of course also sitting in traffic, and one-fifth of all of our carbon footprint is spewed out in the air by those cars that we're sitting in.
ru: Конечно, владение частными авто дорого обходится обществу.

quote: We think these problems are the domain of NGOs or governments, not private companies.
before: So why aren't there more start-ups that are tackling these global problems that are faced by billions of people in developing economies? The reason is that investors and entrepreneurs are totally blind to the opportunity.
after: That's what we have to change. You may have noticed I left something out of the video that I showed you.
ru: Многие считают, что этими проблемами должны заниматься правительства и НПО, а не частные компании.

quote: And you need a strong government to do that, because you cannot respect private property rights.
before: This is an Oxford-trained economist steeped in humanistic values, and yet he agrees with the high-pressure tactics of Shanghai. So let me call it the Shanghai model of economic growth, that emphasizes the following features for promoting economic development: infrastructures, airports, highways, bridges, things like that.
after: You cannot be constrained by the public's opinion. You need also state ownership, especially of land assets, in order to build and roll out infrastructures very quickly.
ru: Чтобы построить всё это, вам нужно сильное правительство, потому что вы не можете себе позволить уважать права частной собственности.

quote: Getty images will arrange a private photo shoot for the baby.
after: "We are honored that the Jolie-Pitt family has recognized our long-term commitment to these critical issues, as well as our ability to use the power of imagery to make a difference in the lives of many," said Jonathan Klein, Getty's CEO and cofounder.

quote: As you know, working at the CIA gives me certain privileges too.
before: I almost forgot. You'll need this.
after: And they include summoning a federal prisoner whenever I damn well please. Fair enough.
ru: Как вам известно, работа в ЦРУ тоже даёт мне определённые преимущества.

quote: It was a remarkable privilege and an amazing education.
before: I drove the trucks. And I operated the mechanical brooms and I plowed the snow.
after: Everyone asks about the smell. It's there, but it's not as prevalent as you think, and on days when it is really bad, you get used to it rather quickly.
ru: Это было особое преимущество и потрясающий опыт.

quote: I am the exception because of luck and privilege, not hard work.
before: They are full of people applying their savvy intelligence to stretch a minimum wage paycheck, or balance a job and a side hustle to make ends meet. They are full of people doing for themselves and for others, whether it's picking up medication for an elderly neighbor, or letting a sibling borrow some money to pay the phone bill, or just watching out for the neighborhood kids from the front stoop.
after: And I'm not being modest or self-deprecating — I am amazing. (Laughter) But most people work hard.
ru: Я стала исключением, благодаря удаче и преимуществу, а не упорной работе.

quote: What, in the year we said time's up, what did you do with your privilege?
before: When they came for victims in the night, did you sleep through it or were you roused? What was the cost of staying woke?
after: Did you sup on others' squalor? Did you look away or directly into the flame?
ru: В год, когда мы решили, что время вышло, — что ты сделала со своим преимуществом?

quote: In his speech, McGuinty told supporters "For this great privilege I am profoundly grateful."
after: He continued by stating that the party "deplore[s] negativity," and that no one should "mistake our civility as a weakness."

quote: You must be one of our grand prize winners.
before: We'll get this one. Welcome to Sunray Motors.
after: Yeah. Actually, I'm here to pick up the prize for my brother.
ru: Вы, должно быть, один из тех, кто выиграл наш главный приз.

quote: He won the Nobel Prize for Literature. Yes, he did.
before: Have another go. He won the Nobel Prize, didn't he?
after: He wrote so much. Our Prime Minister won the Nobel Prize for Literature, no question.
ru: Выиграл Нобелевскую премию по литературе.

quote: He's won countless awards, including this year's Swedish Literary Society's Grand Prize.
before: Type "yes." Yes. Yes!
after: He's quite simply a national treasure. Please welcome the incomparable Anton Bjornberg.
ru: Он является обладателем огромного количества наград, включая присужденную в этом году главную премию Ассоциации Шведских Литераторов.

quote: Maybe we can live on all the prize money she wins as a competitive eater.
before: Yes, you've made that perfectly clear. [coos]
after: So, how are they doing out there? [sighs] about like you'd expect, from archer.
ru: Что она выиграет в качестве профессиональной обжоры.

quote: Memory was the only prize I allowed myself.
before: I thought about how, if I was a writer, I was some kind of misfit writer. What I'm saying is, I flew back to Oregon without a book deal, without an agent, and with only a headful and heart-ful of memories of having sat so near the beautiful writers.
after: And yet, at home in the dark, back in my underwear, I could still hear their voices. They said, " Don't listen to anyone who tries to get you to shut up or change your story. "
ru: Воспоминания были единственной наградой, которую я себе позволила.

quote: His app wasn't reinstated until he won the Pulitzer Prize.
before: Fast-forward more than two decades: Apple launches the iPhone in China and censors the Dalai Lama out along with several other politically sensitive applications at the request of the Chinese government for its Chinese app store. The American political cartoonist Mark Fiore also had his satire application censored in the United States because some of Apple's staff were concerned it would be offensive to some groups.
after: The German magazine Stern, a news magazine, had its app censored because the Apple nannies deemed it to be a little bit too racy for their users, and despite the fact that this magazine is perfectly legal for sale on newsstands throughout Germany. And more controversially, recently, Apple censored a Palestinian protest app after the Israeli government voiced concerns that it might be used to organize violent attacks.
ru: Его приложение не было восстановлено до тех пор, пока он не выиграл Пулитцеровскую премию.

quote: And the app adds rewards, incentives, group prizes, user rating.
before: You can now deposit your recyclables in Vancouver or Berlin, and a family could withdraw building bricks or cell phone minutes in the slums of Manila. Or Lise — she could deposit recycling at a center in Port-au-Prince, and her mother could withdraw cooking fuel or cash across the city.
after: We've gamified recycling. We add fun and formality into an informal industry.
ru: Приложение предлагает награды, бонусы, групповые призы, рейтинги пользователей.

quote: A spokesman for the Institute said it would decide on the prize in two years.
before: Observers speculate that he will also refuse this prize. In 1997, he also refused an award by the European Congress of Mathematicians, because he deemed the judges unable to understand his work.
after: Richard Hamilton's "Ricci flow" equation could also earn him a part of the prize, since it formed the basis for Perelman's papers.

quote: So by the sheer law of probability, it must be his.
before: I slept with Louis a hundred times. He may be mild-mannered, but he's surprisingly virile.
after: Well, except the definition of "probability" is "strong likelihood" not, uh, "known fact"
ru: Таким образом, учитывая закон вероятности, Он должен быть от него.

quote: And unfortunately, balance of probabilities is one thing and beyond reasonable doubt is another.
before: On the balance of probabilities, I'd say you could be right. Oh, you...
after: All the defence has to do is create reasonable doubt that also fits the facts and we're shot. And what would that be?
ru: Но, к сожалению, баланс вероятностей - это одно, а вне всякого сомнения - совсем другое.

quote: This is the house, Mr. Kane, where the probabilities of criminal activity are determined.
before: Please. Come in.
after: There are always two members of the house. Cassandra is the dealer, and I am the pit boss.
ru: Это дом мистер Кейн, где определяются вероятности совершения преступлений.

quote: For years, your probability formula has decided the fate of others.
before: - Today is that day. - No!
after: The healthy have benefited while the potentially sick have been unjustly rejected. However, this formula does not take into account the human will to live.
ru: Годами твоя формула вероятности решала судьбы людей.

quote: It's just that the probability of encountering them compared to combat is astronomically lower.
before: You begin not trusting family or friends. Which is not to say there are no dangers in civilian life; there are.
after: So we never advise veterans to turn off caution completely. We do train them, however, to adjust caution according to where they are.
ru: Только вероятность с ними столкнуться, по сравнению с полем боя, во много крат ниже.

quote: You say, what's the probability of being caught?
before: Instead, what we saw is a lot of people who cheat a little bit. Now, in economic theory, cheating is a very simple cost-benefit analysis.
after: How much do I stand to gain from cheating? And how much punishment would I get if I get caught?
ru: надо прикинуть, вероятность быть пойманным,

quote: I mean, probability and statistics, it's the mathematics of games and gambling.
before: (Laughter) (Applause) Not only — thank you — not only that... but if it's taught properly, it can be a lot of fun.
after: It's analyzing trends. It's predicting the future.
ru: Я имею в виду, вероятность и статистика, это математика игр и азарта.

quote: There is a probability that his hands may have to be amputated.
before: The boy was delivered to the hospital by the airport staff and is said to be in a critical condition. His arms and legs were so severely frozen and swollen that the rescuers were not able to remove his coat and shoes.
after: However, according to the medical staff at the hospital, it is nothing short of a miracle that the boy survived the ordeal. The Boeing 737 has a cruising speed of 900 kilometres per hour and was flying constantly at an altitude of 10,000 metres for two hours.

quote: Killer probably got cut dragging the body through the woods.
before: Died between 9:00 and 11:00 P.M. Also found blood on his right sleeve, but no wounds on the Vic.
after: Combed his hair, washed his hands and face, laid his hands across his body, and built a shrine. Somebody spent a lot of time getting this just right.
ru: Убийца, вероятно, порезался, пока тащил тело через лес.

quote: That being said, we should probably donate blood or something this year.
before: Pulled from the freshest cadaver I could find. But the pickings were slim.
after: (roaring) He's gonna need these.
ru: Поэтому нам, наверное, кровь нужно сдать или еще чего.

quote: Mikael is probably jonesing for a restorative snack about now.
before: Let me think about that. No, but you should probably get going, Nik.
after: Be a shame for you to find... Cami, is it? ...
ru: Майкл наверняка нестерпимо жаждет полноценно перекусить прямо в эту минуту.

quote: I had my eye on it, but it's probably too rich for my blood.
before: Rachel Maddox. Oh, and thank you very much for getting me the tickets. Thanks for the signed first edition for the auction.
after: My boyfriend Paul Reynolds. He's a huge fan.
ru: Я положил на это глаз, но это вероятно слишком для меня.

quote: In fact, you're probably sick of hearing the term big data.
before: In this case, it allows us to see what America's favorite pie is: not apple. Now, you probably all have heard the term big data.
after: It is true that there is a lot of hype around the term, and that is very unfortunate, because big data is an extremely important tool by which society is going to advance. In the past, we used to look at small data and think about what it would mean to try to understand the world, and now we have a lot more of it, more than we ever could before.
ru: Вы, вероятно, уже устали слышать термин «большие данные».

quote: It's a few million dollars, it fills a room, many people have probably been in one.
before: We're excited about it. This is an MRI machine.
after: I've spent a lot of time in one. It has a focus of about a millimeter — kind of chunky, compared to what I just showed you.
ru: Стоит пару миллионов долларов, занимает комнату, многие уже наверняка были в таком аппарате.

quote: We can probably make it for 50 cents if we put our mind to it.
before: It performs about equivalently to a system that's on the order of 100,000 dollars. It costs 50 dollars.
after: Why doesn't somebody do it? The answer is: How do you make a profit in a capitalist system, doing that?
ru: Мы можем снизить, наверное, до 50 центов, если хорошенько подумаем.

quote: It will probably be just a month or two.
before: It depends how many volunteers participate, and how fast they look at the 'focus movies'.

quote: Unfortunately, a letter wouldn't solve Jane's current problem.
before: Love, Xo. _
after: - I just really want you and Rafael to bond, and I think dinner together will help. Hey!
ru: К сожалению, письмо не может решить текущие проблемы Джейн.

quote: Then give the Piron keys back to the Alec who isn't a problem.
before: I just took care of the situation in my own creative way. Fine.
after: I'd love to, but the board doesn't know what we know and it might be a hard sell to them with the whole time travel doubles thing, you know. Paradoxically speaking.
ru: Ну так отдай ключи от Пайрона тому Алеку, который не создаёт проблем.

quote: The only problem is Mr. Ross never actually went to Harvard.
before: What are you talking about? Your honor, this is Mr. Ross' Harvard diploma.
after: The only place he did graduate from was danbury federal prison where he spent time for impersonating a lawyer. All right, that is inadmissible and irrelevant.
ru: Проблема только в том, что мистер Росс никогда не ходил в Гарвард.

quote: We got bigger problems to worry about than TV okay?
before: Why not ? Why should I ?
after: You're thinking about this in a very narrow way The idea is that everybody is gonna have a house, a car, a television the American dream.
ru: У нас есть проблемы и поболее, чтобы беспокоиться о телевизоре.

quote: Now, cities have been dealing with this problem for decades.
before: We even have skyscrapers built for cars. That's the world we live in today.
after: It's called mass transit. And even in a city like New York City, one of the most densely populated in the world and one of the most sophisticated mass transit systems in the world, there are still 2.5 million cars that go over those bridges every day.
ru: Города сталкиваются с этой проблемой на протяжении десятков лет.

quote: They do not have more problems than other kids.
before: It was about how special and how deeply loved their child was. And research so far shows that these children are doing fine.
after: Yet, these parents also wanted to justify their decisions through the tales they tell. They hoped that their children would understand their reasons for making the family in this way.
ru: У них проблем не больше, чем у других детей.

quote: If we invest about 12 billion dollars, we could make a severe inroad into that problem.
before: Not just malnutrition in general, but there's a very cheap way of dealing with malnutrition, namely, the lack of micronutrients. Basically, about half of the world's population is lacking in iron, zinc, iodine and vitamin A.
after: That would be the second best investment that we could do. And the very best project would be to focus on HIV / AIDS.
ru: Достаточно вложить 12 миллиардов долларов, чтобы серьёзно уменьшить эту проблему.

quote: The Ming Pao news agency also reported mechanical problems.
before: Shipping was unaffected. The New Zealand Herald quoted Hong Kong's Cable TV as saying that the rotorcraft performed an emergency landing on water after experiencing mechanical problems.

quote: Businesses should balance profit with preserving natural resources.
before: There should be enforced regulations on catching only bigger fish. Catching the smaller fish before they've matured lowers the overall number.
after: Without fish, we can't do business. However, that doesn't mean they should catch all the fish to the brink of extinction.
ru: Бизнес должен соблюдать баланс между прибылью и сохранением природных ресурсов.

quote: You have corporations funding political campaigns, and working on a quarterly profit calendars.
before: Every generation in history has had their own big challenge to deal with, and this one is ours. It's money.
after: And it's impossible to take you eye of that. A lot of comments I get revolve around people feeling badly.
ru: У вас есть корпорации, финансирующие политические кампании, и погоня за квартальными прибылями.

quote: Do you think this'll appease them, me giving up my profits?
before: How am I looking? Little more worried.
after: They're still coming after your seat. As long as the three are divided, I'm fine.
ru: Как ты думаешь, они успокоятся, если я перестану получать прибыль?

quote: What I wish for is for fair profit.
before: And what they are is too high, my benighted friend. Lower your price if you wish to transport our mormon workmen West.
after: I have consulted and prayed... And here is what I will pay.
ru: Чего я хочу - это достойной прибыли.

quote: Well, one line of thinking is, let's take this profit and redeploy it into social problems.
before: That's what business does when it makes a profit. Now what does this all have to do with social problems?
after: Business should give more. Business should be more responsible.
ru: Одна из точек зрения такова — давайте возьмём эту прибыль и перенаправим в социальные проблемы.

quote: The profit motive is transforming health outcomes in this world.
before: And actually, they know how to transform science and facts into compelling messages. Just for a minute, imagine when they put all their forces behind a message as powerful as handwashing with soap.
after: But it's been happening for centuries: the Lifebuoy brand was launched in 1894 in Victorian England to actually combat cholera. Last week, I was in Ghana with the minister of health, because if you don't know, there's a cholera outbreak in Ghana at the moment.
ru: Прибыльные мотивы преобразуют показатели здоровья в этом мире.

quote: The answer is: How do you make a profit in a capitalist system, doing that?
before: We can probably make it for 50 cents if we put our mind to it. Why doesn't somebody do it?
after: Interesting problem. So, let me finish by saying that we've thought about this as a kind of engineering problem.
ru: Ответ: «А как с этого можно получить прибыль в капиталистической системе?»

quote: No company is going to make a profit serving every community in the nation.
before: One good example is the post office department, you know, the post office department. There's no for-profit business that's ever going to make profit serving every community in the nation, you know.
after: And yet at the same time, they're going out of their way to destroy the United States Postal Office that basically services every community in the nation. And so, we have to go back in and look at that, so it's good.

quote: DMT is one of the most profound and potent psychedelics known.
before: It was really exciting for me because I though this is the first study in a generation, and not only that. Despite the fact that DMT had been used safely in earlier studies and it was a natural component of the brain
after: So it wasn't just an initiation of clinical research it was a reinitiation of clinical research with an extremely potent drug. I was at a strong opinion that you could do this studies and Rick agreed so we had a number of discussions and at some point the discussion came up, you know
ru: ДМТ один из самых глубоких и сильных известных психоделиков.

quote: Living here has had a profound effect on all of us.
before: Sophia, we all appreciate the sacrifices that you and the others have made, locked up all those years. But...
after: Most of us have grown to like it. And the truth is...
ru: Жизнь здесь оказала глубокое влияние на всех нас

quote: Another moment in remand amongst hardened criminals could have a profound psychological impact on him.
before: Your Honour, I hate to see valuable time wasted where the witness has no recollection. My client is a loving family man whose children have missed him terribly.
after: I have another matter that is ready. I'll stand this down part-heard until the 12th.
ru: Каждый момент в заключении среди закоренелых преступников может нанести ему глубокую психологическую травму.

quote: He told me he felt the warmest love, the most profound admiration, and the deepest respect.
before: What? He came to me yesterday evening, before dinner.
after: Did he? Indeed?
ru: Сказал, что любит меня всем сердцем, искренне восхищается и глубоко уважает.

quote: In fact, if all the clouds went away, we would experience profound climate changes.
before: Now, there's no one right answer, no perfect way to do this, and different climate models make different choices. Now, it is unfortunate that computers struggle with clouds, because clouds are crucially important in regulating the temperature of the planet.
after: But without clouds, would it be warmer or colder? The answer is both.
ru: На самом деле, если все облака исчезнут, мы ощутим на себе глубочайшие изменения климата.

quote: Forms of organization can have a profound impact on human nature.
before: You're changing the microstructure of your brain as you go along. So in a broad sense, we don't need to think about technology as only little gadgets, like these things here, but even institutions and techniques, psychological methods and so forth.
after: Looking ahead, there is a range of technologies that are almost certain to be developed sooner or later. We are very ignorant about what the time scale for these things are, but they all are consistent with everything we know about physical laws, laws of chemistry, etc.
ru: Организации могут оказать глубокое воздействие на человеческую природу.

quote: But in five to ten years we're going to start see some very profound changes.
before: I mean we're essentially using technology to just jam evolution into fast-forward. It's not at all clear where it's going to take us.
after: The most immediate changes that we'll see are things like in medicine. There is going to be a big shift towards preventative medicine as we start to be able to identify all of the risk factors that we have as individuals.
ru: Но через 5-10 лет мы увидим некоторые очень глубокие изменения.

quote: The intellectual and collecting impact of the Scottish diaspora has been profound.
before: Closed for a little over three years, today's reopening of the museum is seen as the "centrepiece" of National Museums Scotland's fifteen-year plan to dramatically improve accessibility and better present their collections. Sir Andrew Grossard, chair of the Board of Trustees, said: "The reopening of the National Museum of Scotland, on time and within budget is a tremendous achievement [...] Our collections tell great stories about the world, how Scots saw that world, and the disproportionate impact they had upon it.
after: It is an inspiring story which has captured the imagination of our many supporters who have helped us achieve our aspirations and to whom we are profoundly grateful."

quote: Yes, we're, uh, we're doing a story on your husband's promotion.
before: Hi. Can I help you?
after: Wanted to ask you a few questions. I'm sorry.
ru: Да, мы, ну, мы сделаем историю о продвижении по службе Вашего мужа.

quote: I understand there are some questions about my opponent's hiring and promotion practices over at the state's attorney's office.
before: What if one day when this is all over, you want to come home again? I won't.
after: I don't intend to speak to that. But I do think diversity is a fair...
ru: Я слышала, что есть ряд вопросов к моему оппоненту по поводу практики подбора кадров и продвижения по службе в офисе прокурора штата.

quote: I got this promotion locked! Mmm-hmm.
before: Our bodies were intertwined, but our spirits were in constant opposition. Dynamic.
after: Yeah. Don't worry.
ru: - Мне гарантировано продвижение!

quote: I get a promotion, you get a raise.
before: Escaped from a cargo ship and attacked some people. So we get the exclusive footage on the recapture,
after: I don't want a raise, amy! I want to live!
ru: Я получу продвижение, тебе повысят зарплату.

quote: Sally was given the promotion of a lifetime, but it came with a price.
before: And when they do, you have to convert them into productive forms of thinking, like problem-solving. My patient Sally is a good example.
after: She was no longer able to pick up her daughter from school every day, and that broke her heart. So she came up with a plan.
ru: Салли повысили в должности, о чём она мечтала всю жизнь, но у этого повышения была своя цена.

quote: He performed in several different promotions including MidSouth Wrestling, World Championship Wrestling and World Wrestling Entertainment.
before: Williams, who originally trained up as an MMA fighter started his career in 1979.
after: He held the World Tag Team Championship with Terry Gordy in WCW.

quote: And prompt decision for his quick return to Sicilia.
before: Quintus. We must prove this fucking house in order.
after: Withered old fuck. Eat, brothers!
ru: И подтолкнуть его к быстрому возвращению на Сицилию.

quote: My Lord, a true man living in a time of great changes. Should make prompt decisions.
before: This is a world affair! Why he has to be the lord?
after: The first one reaching Xianyang will be the Lord Qin. Besides, it is King Huai'of Chu's order. It will be too late to regret when the opportunity passes.
ru: Мужчина, живущий в эпоху перемен, должен быстро принимать решения.

quote: Good of you to come so prompt, sir.
before: Never seen anything like it in all my puff! It'd make an 'orse sick, that would!
after: Not at all, Sergeant. I'm always happy to be of service to the police.
ru: Очень любезно с вашей стороны столь быстро прийти сюда, сэр.

quote: Evan, thank you for your thoughtful and prompt payment.
before: You have until 5 o'clock. Don't make me come find you.
after: It shall not be forgotten. I...
ru: Эван, спасибо за вдумчивую и быструю оплату.

quote: After the meeting Merkel said she expected a 'very prompt' withdrawal of Russian forces from Georgia.
before: During her meeting with Georgian President Mikheil Saakashvili, Merkel stated that Georgia's territorial integrity and its independence have to be respected.

quote: I don't have any proof, but I will.
before: Come on. I know you rigged that car;
after: I'm gonna do whatever it takes. I'm gonna be on you 24/7.
ru: У меня нет доказательств, но я знаю.

quote: There's no proof that Giggle Pig is a serious problem.
before: You have more of a fly-catching gape than usual. I've examined his proposal.
after: So, we're just supposed to wait until it turns into an epidemic? You're like the League of Nations in '36, just hoping the Abyssinian crisis resolves itself.
ru: Нет никаких доказательств того, что "свинка-хохотушка" - серьёзная проблема.

quote: What she did to Paul and Rachel, it's proof of that.
before: Our children are dead. Whatever she is, she isn't Camille.
after: I didn't do anything to the Koretskys. I just wanted to help them.
ru: То, что она сделала пол и Рейчел, это тому доказательство.

quote: Whatever's going down in Chester's Mill, here's proof that it ain't real.
before: We're outside the dome. We hope it takes us home, but what if it takes us to an alternate reality?
after: These places... these people... something is wrong here. What do you say, Red?
ru: Что бы ни происходило в Честерз-Милле, вот доказательство, что всё это неправда.

quote: Evidence prevents the elites from imposing their own view without proof.
before: And evidence stands up for the man on the street and against the elites. Because evidence forces you to prove it.
after: A second reason why experts are not trusted is that different experts say different things. For every expert who claimed that leaving the EU would be bad for Britain, another expert claimed it would be good.
ru: Доказательства препятствуют элите навязывать своё мнение без подтверждения.

quote: Here is another proof that the African is not capable of governing himself.
before: It was complete chaos. And my heart sank, because I thought, here we are again.
after: And not only that, I am documenting it — documenting my own cultural shortcomings. So when the echo of the gunshots had lingered, it was soon drowned by the chanting of the mob, and I didn't believe what I was hearing.
ru: И вот ещё одно доказательство того, что африканцы не способны управлять сами собой.

quote: This is a technique known as proof by contradiction.
before: If we make a wrong guess, we’ ll eventually reach a point where our conclusions contradict each other. That would allow us to confirm that our initial guess was wrong and work from there.
after: The trick is in being strategic about where we begin our guessing. Some assumptions might not lead to contradictions without making further assumptions.
ru: Этот способ называется доказательством от противного.

quote: Measurements of the ice thickness, as in the present study, give definite proof for ice melting.
before: There has been considerable uncertainty over the causes of ice loss in the Arctic. It has been debated that ice could have been piled up against the coast, thus reducing the sea ice extent.
after: "So this means melting; it doesn't mean that the ice has just been pushed up against the coastline," remark Seymour Laxon, co-author of the paper.

quote: I think after waiting ten years, I deserve a proper kiss.
before: Does anybody want to know what I think? Yes, of course.
after: You're calling me why? Well, I always call you after I hook up with a hot guy.
ru: По-моему, за 10 лет ожидания я заслужил настоящий поцелуй.

quote: If your son goes wild and you haven't taken the proper precautions, it's on your head.
before: Then you're at risk. That Freddie Preston stopped taking his medication and went completely rabid, almost murdered his own wife.
after: - Steve? - Huh? Are you all right?
ru: Если твой сын взбесится, а ты не примешь надлежащих мер, это будет на твоей совести.

quote: Villages in the Eastern Lands have failed to pay proper tribute.
before: Forgive me, Pharaoh... for disrupting your... pleasuring. You are forgiven, High Priest.
after: With your permission, I shall see that such payments are now obligatory, as they are in the cities. Make it so.
ru: Деревни Восточных земель не заплатили надлежащую дань.

quote: But we're not in St Petersburg proper, yet.
before: "Look at the size of that road he's on." Yes.
after: We're still on the outskirts. When we get near the middle, there's going to be a small alleyway, something built before cars were invented.
ru: Но мы еще не в настоящем Санкт-Петербурге.

quote: These were administered when proper drugs weren't available, or if someone imagined they were ill.
before: The answer lies in the placebo effect, an unexplained phenomenon wherein drugs, treatments, and therapies that aren't supposed to have an effect, and are often fake, miraculously make people feel better. Doctors have used the term placebo since the 1700s when they realized the power of fake drugs to improve people's symptoms.
after: In fact, the word placebo means " I shall please " in Latin, hinting at a history of placating troubled patients. Placebos had to mimic the real treatments in order to be convincing, so they took the form of sugar pills, water-filled injections, and even sham surgeries.
ru: Их давали пациентам, когда настоящие лекарства были недоступны или когда кто-то только воображал, будто он болен.

quote: This is when riders typically experience seat separation, and, without the proper precautions, ejection.
before: It can contribute to a rider’ s motion sickness by suspending the fluid in their inner ears which coordinates balance. But the bigger potential danger – and thrill – comes from what ride designers call airtime.
after: The numerous belts and harnesses of modern coasters have largely solved this issue, but the passenger’ s ever-changing position can make it difficult to determine what needs to be strapped down. Fortunately, modern ride designers are well aware of what your body, and the coaster, can handle.
ru: При этом теряется контакт с сиденьем, и без надлежащих мер безопасности пассажиры могут выпасть из вагончика.

quote: It puts you into a proper relationship with reality.
before: You do not know how to get from here to there. What does that do?
after: Why? Because you have to ask for help.
ru: Вы вступаете в настоящие отношения с реальностью.

quote: We want to make sure we are doing the correct thing – and the proper thing.
before: We are communicating with the City on this. You may recall that the City suggested this to us last time.
after: I am not sure whether I have a clear indication of that at this juncture," said Savarino.

quote: We need to do this properly so there's no question in court.
before: She showed you two photo arrays, each with a possible suspect and five other fill-in photos. If you recall, she showed you two arrays, but the suspects you identified were both in the same array.
after: Okay. Excellent.
ru: Нужно сделать всё как следует, чтобы в суде не было проблем.

quote: And if you don't feel yourself doing it properly, please, order a pizza.
before: Now, we mix in the eggs... the parmesan... the spaghett... and parsley. You see, it's all about timing and rhythm.
after: Sorry I'm late. Yeah.
ru: И если вы не готовы делать все правильно, пожалуйста, закажите пиццу.

quote: And you don't give us the tools to do our jobs properly.
before: And I know I'm just a teacher, but that ought to be worth something around here. In fact, that ought to be worth everything to you guys, but instead, you treat us like shit.
after: And I can't believe I'm saying this, but Strickland's right. The students are running all over the fucking school.
ru: И вы не даете нам инструменты для правильной работы.

quote: Mussolini said that fascism should properly be called corporatism, and that's what it is.
before: Is a private corporate takeover of the nation states, of the governments of the world. Then these private corporations bring in a tyrannical form of neofeudalism that they call corporatism, or fascism.
after: And they create the socialism to get control of the wealth and to control society. And then they pipe the profits to themselves, so they socialize the general public to get control of us, but it's private above us.
ru: Муссолини сказал, что фашизм правильно было бы называть корпоративизмом, и так оно и есть.

quote: Perhaps, that is why it took them almost six months to get her properly diagnosed.
before: Her lifestyle was almost free of risk. She never smoked a cigarette, she never drank alcohol, and she had been playing sports for almost half her life.
after: My story might be, unfortunately, familiar to most of you. One out of three people sitting in this audience will be diagnosed with some type of cancer, and one out of four will die because of it.
ru: Вероятно поэтому врачам понадобилось почти 6 месяцев, чтобы поставить правильный диагноз.

quote: I believe in the beauty of work when we do it properly and in humility.
before: (Laughter) It's one thing to have an idea for an enterprise, but as many people in this room will know, making it happen is a very difficult thing and it demands extraordinary energy, self-belief and determination, the courage to risk family and home, and a 24 / 7 commitment that borders on the obsessive. So it's just as well that I'm a workaholic.
after: Work is not just something I do when I'd rather be doing something else. We live our lives forward.
ru: Я верю в красоту работы, когда она делается правильно и смиренно.

quote: Not only that you can, but that you will when they are properly suggested to you.
before: And it makes a very bad microphone; I've tried it many times. (Laughter) The other assumption that you made — and this little lesson is to show you that you will make assumptions.
after: You believe I'm looking at you. Wrong.
ru: не только что вы можете, но будете — если их вам правильно внушают.

quote: At 22:22, Phoenix was confirmed to be properly aligned for entry into the Martian atmosphere.
before: According to the live broadcast on NASA TV, a systems check began in final preparation for landing at 22:20 GMT (7:20 p.m. eastern time) which was given the "all green".
after: At 22:30 Phoenix began to accelerate into the atmosphere, where it will hurtle towards the planet at nearly 11,000 miles an hour. At 22:41 the data stream was successfully sent to Earth, Phoenix successfully separated from its boosters and sent a UHF signal to NASA.

quote: Now it's in your best interest to vacate my property on your own accord.
before: I just don't have the money right now. You are behind on your payments, Mr. Perry.
after: Well, What about my Wife and little boy? This is our home.
ru: Теперь это в ваших интересах добровольно освободить мою собственность.

quote: Badge or no badge, you got no right trespassing and seizing our private property.
before: Everybody stay calm. I'm an officer of the Law.
after: - We know the law. - Gentlemen...
ru: Есть у тебя значок или нет, ты не имеешь права вторгаться и захватывать нашу собственность.

quote: I'm going to give you ten seconds to get off my property.
before: We expect full payment for the damages. Then your son is a liar.
after: After that, I call the cops. - Mom!
ru: Я даю тебе 10 секунд, чтобы ты убрался с моей собственности.

quote: Seeing as you know how things work, well, how property move from place to place.
before: That's what you want us to be, friends? I want your help, yes.
after: You know, I... I got this.
ru: Вижу, что вы знаете, как все устроено, как имущество перемещается с место на место.

quote: Was it working days and nights trying to protect lives and property?
before: Was it working in the sun? Was it working to provide food for a family or a community?
after: Was it working alone or working on a project that wasn't guaranteed to succeed, but that might improve human health or save a life? Was it working to build something, create something, make a work of art?
ru: Работа день и ночь в попытках уберечь жизни и имущество?

quote: "White Woman Calls Police On Black Real Estate Investor Inspecting His Own Property."
before: (Applause) And I need to pause the game to remind us of the structure. A subject takes an action against a target engaged in some activity.
after: " California Safeway Calls Cops On Black Woman Donating Food To The Homeless. " " Gold Club Twice Calls Cops On Black Women For Playing Too Slow. "
ru: «Белая женщина заявила на чернокожего домовладельца, осматривающего свою собственность».

quote: And far and away the biggest trigger for all sibling fights is property.
before: And Bobby Kennedy, who grew up to have 11 children of his own, had a household with a whopping 91 dyads. This overpopulation of relationships makes fights unavoidable.
after: Studies have found that over 95 percent of the fights among small children concern somebody touching, playing with, looking at the other person's stuff. (Laughter) This in its own way is healthy if it's very noisy, and the reason is that small children come into the world with absolutely no control.
ru: В подавляющем большинстве случаев братья и сёстры ссорятся из-за собственности.

quote: More than half of that is in housing, in real estate property.
before: So, my house is my asset. In Ireland, each man, woman and child is worth something like USD180 thousand each, something like that, alright?
after: So we rely on our property for our wealth. So when your parents die or when your parents want to send you to university, they can borrow against the value of their house and send you to university, to get a loan based on the value of their house.

quote: Those proportions would suggest your conclusion.
before: Does this suggest she was anorexic? Yes.
after: And has anorexia ever resulted in a seizure? Yes.
ru: Такие соотношения приводят к такому выводу.

quote: The sample contained a particular proportion of magnesium, bromide, bitumen, calcium and potassium.
before: As usual, I'm not following you. There was lotion on the shovel handle.
after: The high salt content would explain why my extraction failed. Only one vendor sells a version with the precise mineral proportions that I've identified, and they only offer it online.
ru: Образец содержит определенное соотношение магния, брома, битума, кальция и калия.

quote: Although, the proportion of translated books published in many other countries is a lot higher.
before: And after I'd worked out how to fit reading and blogging about, roughly, four books a week around working five days a week, I then had to face up to the fact that I might even not be able to get books in English from every country. Only around 4.5 percent of the literary works published each year in the UK are translations, and the figures are similar for much of the English-speaking world.
after: 4.5 percent is tiny enough to start with, but what that figure doesn't tell you is that many of those books will come from countries with strong publishing networks and lots of industry professionals primed to go out and sell those titles to English-language publishers. So, for example, although well over 100 books are translated from French and published in the UK each year, most of them will come from countries like France or Switzerland.
ru: Хотя доля опубликованных переведённых книг в других странах намного выше.

quote: To calculate the proportions for each genotype and phenotype, we can use a Punnett square too.
before: For example, besides being yellow or green, peas may be round or wrinkled. So we could have all these possible combinations: round yellow peas, round green peas, wrinkled yellow peas, wrinkled green peas.
after: Of course, this will make it a little more complex. And lots of things are more complicated than peas, like, say, people.
ru: Чтобы рассчитать соотношения каждого генотипа и фенотипа, также можно использовать решётку Пеннетта.

quote: Here in Germany, the proportion of people that use contraception is about 66 percent.
before: And as a result, birth control has almost completely and totally disappeared from the global health agenda. The victims of this paralysis are the people of sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia.
