ru: Мне нужно перенастроить мультифазовую гарнитуру на УВЧ-диапазон.

quote: But we can get to 64 using rectangles in the 14-18 range, leaving out 15.
before: With all that in mind, let’ s see what works. Starting with area 20 or more puts us over the limit too quickly.
after: Unfortunately, there’ s no way to make them fit. Using the 2x7 leaves a gap that can only be filled by a rectangle with a width of 1.
ru: Но мы можем получить 64, используя прямоугольники в диапазоне от 14 до 18, пропустив 15.

quote: The average temperature is minus 81 degrees, although there is quite a range of temperature.
before: The atmosphere on Mars is really thin — 100 times thinner than on Earth — and it's not breathable, it's 96 percent carbon dioxide. It's really cold there.
after: A day on Mars is about as long as a day on Earth, plus about 39 minutes. Seasons and years on Mars are twice as long as they are on Earth.
ru: Средняя температура — минус 27°C, хотя диапазон температур там довольно широк.

quote: So this is the sound of the O-H stretch, translated into the audible range.
before: These molecules, as you saw in the beginning, the building blocks had springs connecting them to each other. In fact, molecules are able to vibrate at a set of frequencies which are very specific for each molecule and for the bonds connecting them.
after: S-H, quite a different frequency. Now, this is kind of interesting, because it tells you that you should be looking for a particular fact, which is this: nothing in the world smells like rotten eggs except S-H, OK?
ru: Это звук участка O-H, переведённый на слышимый диапазон.

quote: The bands scheduled span a wide range of rock and metal genres.
after: Amongst the other acts already confirmed to appear are Judas Priest, Helloween, Soilwork, Ensiferum, At The Gates, Avantasia, Sodom, Dismember, Saturnus, Manticora and Sybreed.

quote: It's an independent offensive unit based on skill, with no ranks, and it has top priority.
before: You're some piece of work. So, you're telling me to be Public Security's errand boy?
after: I'll give you memories of being more than a dog trained to kill. These fake memories--can you really erase 'em?
ru: Это независимое подразделение быстрого реагирования, основанное на умениях, без званий и с максимальными полномочиями.

quote: Dunlavey, you are hereby promoted to the rank of E3 for bravery against enemy attack.
before: I need answers, not questions. Sir, I was afraid for the safety of my fellow soldier.
after: Effective today, you'll work in my office reporting directly to me. I... I don't understand, sir.
ru: Данлейви, вам присвоено звание рядового первого класса за храбрость в атаке на врага.

quote: Dolokhov has been reduced to the ranks and Monsieur Pierre has left Petersburg in disgrace.
before: Yes, but you mustn't take me as a model of behaviour. So, what happened with the young men?
after: Thank God my dear boy Boris has stayed away from Anatole and his drunken clique! Your son does you great credit, Anna Mikhailovna!
ru: Долохов был понижен в звании, а месье Пьер с позором покинул Петербург.

quote: Name, rank, serial number, and that's all she's gonna say.
before: How do you like my boots? jack, what is it, what is she saying?
after: How do you know? Cos I know who she is and why she's here.
ru: Имя, звание, серийный номер, и это всё, что она нам может сообщить.

quote: Your rank said something about your history and the respect you had earned.
before: Your uniform is maintained to the inch. How diligently you followed those rules spoke volumes about the kind of Marine you were.
after: In the civilian world there's no rank. Here you're just another body, and I felt like I constantly had to prove my worth all over again.
ru: Звание рассказывает кое-что о твоей истории и том уважении, что ты заслужил.

quote: What's interesting about social rank is that across all living beings, they will structure themselves by hierarchy.
before: Do we sense our social status, even at the moment of birth? So in this experiment, we took placentas of monkeys that had different social status.
after: Monkey number one is the boss; monkey number four is the peon. You put four monkeys in a cage, there will always be a boss and always be a peon.
ru: В теме социального положения интересен тот аспект, что все живые существа устанавливают иерархию.

quote: And in that time, I've served in every rank, from police officer to police chief.
before: I've been a police officer in an urban city for nearly 25 years. That's crazy, right?
after: A few years ago, I noticed something alarming. Starting in 2014, I started monitoring recruits as they cycled through police academies in the state of New Jersey, and I found that women were failing at rates between 65 and 80 percent, due to varying aspects of the physical fitness test.
ru: За это время я служила во всех возможных званиях от простого агента до начальника полиции.

quote: Mitts was posthumously promoted from his present rank, Chief Master Sgt.
before: Mitts was the oldest of five men on board the ill-fated helicopter. He was assigned to Iraq from September 2006 to September 2007 with Company C of the 1st Battalion, 108th Aviation Regiment, based in Topeka, Kansas.
after: Gonda Moncada announced.

quote: But I'd like to do a rapid strep test just to be sure.
before: My school is one great big petri dish. Well, it's probably a viral pharyngitis.
after: How long will that take? Just a few minutes.
ru: Проведём быстрый стрептококковый тест, чтобы удостовериться.

quote: To ask, if he could obtain a rapid citizenship, through an act of congress..
before: For representative, John O'Connel with the 9th district. Representative O'Connel was contacted by Carmine Polito.
after: For one, Sheikh Abdullah-- the investor. I'm excited to be here.
ru: Чтобы спросить , может ли он получить быстрое гражданство, через акт конгресса ..

quote: Our rapid response team with operative Walker on point is moments way.
before: But if we let business proceed, we may be abetting the attack. We risk hundreds of deaths that could be avoided.
after: Operative Walker has suggested we proceed with a discreet sweep and allow the trading floor to remain open. I strongly support this action.
ru: Наша группа быстрого реагирования находится на объекте вместе с агентом Уолкер.

quote: Parker's specialty is the redeployment Of rapid response groups.
before: No, they test ours. Hey, parker, how's it going?
after: I thought we had people at the pentagon who do that. We do.
ru: Паркер специализируется на передислокации групп быстрого реагирования.

quote: And the next thing we do -- we do what we call "rapid prototyping."
before: And so we have agreed that instead of collecting plastic bits, we are going to collect only the data. So we're going to get an image of the plastic with a robot — so robots, kids get very excited.
after: We are so rapid at prototyping that the lunch is still in the lunchbox when we're hacking it. (Laughter) And we hack table lamps and webcams, into plumbing fixtures and we assemble that into a floating robot that will be slowly moving through water and through the plastic that we have there — and this is the image that we get in the robot.
ru: Следующий этап мы называем «быстрым прототипированием».

quote: Rapid nuclear fission is not any better since it often results in many radioactive particles.
before: In order to utilize fusion in a short amount of time, the temperature of the area needs to be hotter than the Sun. Every innocent bystander will be burned to a crisp.
after: Our hero would become a walking, talking nuclear power plant, ultimately harming every person he tries to save. And do you really want the heat of the Sun or a radioactive nuclear plant inside of your body?
ru: Быстрое ядерное деление ничем не лучше, поскольку в его процессе образуются многочисленные радиоактивные частицы.

quote: So window farms have been evolving through a rapid versioning process similar to software.
before: Tony in Chicago has been taking on growing experiments, like lots of other window farmers, and he's been able to get his strawberries to fruit for nine months of the year in low-light conditions by simply changing out the organic nutrients. And window farmers in Finland have been customizing their window farms for the dark days of the Finnish winters by outfitting them with LED grow lights that they're now making open source and part of the project.
after: And with every open source project, the real benefit is the interplay between the specific concerns of people customizing their systems for their own particular concerns, and the universal concerns. So my core team and I are able to concentrate on the improvements that really benefit everyone.
ru: И так оконные фермы развиваются через быстрый контроль версий похожий на процесс с программным обеспечением.

quote: Unlike yesterday's attacks, one of which was also in Baghdad, today's attacks happened in rapid succession.
before: Four bombings in two days have left over 130 dead in Iraq, with at least as many injured. Al Jazeera reports that at least 60 were killed in the two explosions at a tomb in Baghdad today.

quote: They breathe rapidly, their little heart races, and they have to eat a huge amount.
before: As a result, they naturally lose heat at a very high rate. To help offset the cost of losing so much energy in the form of heat, the bats are forced to maintain a high rate of metabolism.
after: So, a bat's size clearly affects the speed at which it lives its life. Right across the natural world, the size you are has a profound effect on your metabolic rate - or your "speed of life".
ru: Они быстро дышат, их сердце бьется очень часто, и они вынуждены крайне много есть.

quote: Yeah, but the age gap is rapidly closing.
before: All those taut, masculine bodies parading through the house in low-hanging board shorts and tank tops. They're just boys.
after: I'm sure you can't help but to find yourself attracted to the ones that have moved into their man bodies. Oh, I can help it.
ru: Но разница в возрасте быстро сокращается

quote: By the late 60s, the idea of self exploration was spreading rapidly in America.
before: -They gave up being nuns? -They did, yeah, they became persons..
after: Encounter groups became the center of what was seen as a radical alternative culture based on the development of the self free of a corrupt capitalist culture. I just want to free them,.. to be ourselves..
ru: К концу 60-х идея познания себя быстро распространялась в Америке.

quote: The payment will have to be taken care of rapidly.
before: But your mother's condition didn't allow that. But, now... your mother has passed away.
after: This is all I have. But if I give it all to you, I...
ru: Оплата должна быть произведена как можно быстрее

quote: The human population is growing very rapidly and is growing exponentially.
before: So it's a very precious thing that we're using to dye our foods. Now the situation in the world is going to change for you and me, for everyone on this Earth.
after: Where, at the moment, we have something between six and seven billion people, it will grow to about nine billion in 2050. That means that we have a lot more mouths to feed, and this is something that worries more and more people.
ru: Население планеты очень быстро растёт, причём экспоненциально.

quote: And we have demonstrated that you can do this and crush populations very, very rapidly.
before: This is my colleague who runs this show at Ifakara. And he has demonstrated cleverly that you can actually get mosquitoes to come to the place where they normally come to get blood to pick up a dose of sterilants or insecticide, carry this back to their own breeding habitat and kill all their progeny.
after: This is beautiful. This is our mosquito city.
ru: А мы доказали, что, сделав это, можно очень быстро уничтожить популяцию комаров.

quote: We can actually build for you, very rapidly, a physical object.
before: It is actually a reality today that you can download products from the Web — product data, I should say, from the Web — perhaps tweak it and personalize it to your own preference or your own taste, and have that information sent to a desktop machine that will fabricate it for you on the spot.
after: And the reason we can do this is through an emerging technology called additive manufacturing, or 3D printing. This is a 3D printer.
ru: Мы можем очень быстро создать для вас физический объект.

quote: Rapidly, news sites even claimed that the photos were fake.
before: After this revelation, media newswires branded the original story a hoax. These hoax claims spread nearly as quickly as the original story.
after: The true story, however, is more complicated than that.

quote: It's very rare for sexual sadism to be an inherited trait.
before: A father-son partnership? Wait, an older Alpha with a younger submissive?
after: That's why we ruled it out. What if he created his partner and groomed him?
ru: Наследственные черты сексуального садизма - редкость.

quote: A rare book expert and a wine connoisseur.
before: Agent Gruetzner will be joining us. Hello.
after: Oh, California Zin. Well, there's no shame in having one specialty.
ru: Эксперт по редким книгам и ценитель вин.

quote: A rare opportunity awaits you now to announce yourself before the entire province.
before: Do you really not see the path that I've set you on? The whore is gone.
after: And what is that? Tomorrow I shall bring John Alden's case before the board.
ru: Теперь у тебя есть редкая возможность заявить о себе перед всей провинцией.

quote: You knew that he was the only decent source of rare pharma in Western Syria.
before: He sells drugs for ISIS. Have you even seen the...
after: People, regular people, children are going to die without his drugs. I know that.
ru: Ты знала, что он был единственным приличным источником редких фармацевтических препаратов в Западной Сирии.

quote: Now, this is relatively rare, so I had relatively little personal experience with this.
before: That sometimes shows up in the first decade of life, but it can be very confusing for parents, because it is quite normative for children to act in a cross-gender play and way, and, in fact, there are studies that show that even 80 percent of children who act in that fashion will not persist in wanting to be the opposite gender at the time when puberty begins. But, at the time that puberty begins — that means between about age 10 to 12 in girls, 12 to 14 in boys — with breast budding, or two to three times' increase in the gonads in the case of genetic males, by that particular point, the child who says they are in the absolute wrong body is almost certain to be transgender and is extremely unlikely to change those feelings, no matter how anybody tries reparative therapy or any other noxious things.
after: And my experience was more typical, only because I had an adolescent practice. And I saw someone age 24, genetically female, went through Harvard with three male roommates who knew the whole story, a registrar who always listed his name on course lists as a male name, and came to me after graduating, saying, " Help me.
ru: Это очень редкий случай, и у меня было очень мало личного опыта,

quote: And a beheading, which was a rare event in England at the time, attracted even more.
before: In London, as late as the early 19th century, there might be four or five thousand people to see a standard hanging. There could be 40,000 or 50,000 to see a famous criminal killed.
after: In May 1820, five men known as the Cato Street Conspirators were executed in London for plotting to assassinate members of the British government. They were hung and then decapitated.
ru: Обезглавливание, достаточно редкий вид казни в то время в Англии, привлекало еще больше зрителей.

quote: Because, obviously, an animal that is very abundant, before it gets extinct, it becomes rare.
before: We want to sustain things that are gone or things that are not the way they were. Now one should think this problem affected people certainly when in predatory societies, they killed animals and they didn't know they had done so after a few generations.
after: So you don't lose abundant animals. You always lose rare animals.
ru: Поскольку это очевидно, что когда животное в изобилии, прежде чем исчезнуть, оно становится редким.

quote: After a rare all-night session, the United States Senate voted today at 11 a.m.
after: EST on the motion to invoke cloture of the Levin/Reed Amendment (S.Amdt. 2087) which would begin a pullout of United States troops from Iraq, but only 52 votes were cast in favor of the amendment and 47 were cast against it, falling short of the 60 votes needed to overcome the Republican filibuster of the measure.

quote: That's something people in our business rarely get to do.
before: I just wanted to... try and... repair some of the damage. You know? 'Cause, I mean, let's face it.
after: So I decided to hand-deliver those checks because I wanted to personally hand someone hope. Some kind of joy?
ru: При нашей работе редко получается что-то изменить.

quote: Arranged marriages are rarely so-- so well arranged.
before: He seems like a nice boy. You're lucky.
after: Do you think Mother will like him? If she sees you're happy, I'm sure she will.
ru: В браках по соглашению редко... царит согласие.

quote: The only cases are miners, and they rarely pay.
before: He's come to the right place. Not if he cares to eat.
after: I wonder if healing is not its own reward? When you're living under a hedge and dining off thistles, perhaps you'll care to revisit that question, sir.
ru: Единственные случаи являются шахтеры, и они редко обращают.

quote: At the beginning, when I sinned only rarely, I lied only to save and appease myself.
before: I started to lie. Lies became my second, then my first, and finally my only essence.
after: Soon the lies became necessary to save those around me, my family; It seemed that I was doing the only thing I could for my loved ones:
ru: Сначала, когда грех был редким, я лгал только для своего спасения.

quote: I'm happy to say that when D got to fourth grade, he rarely got into trouble.
before: or " How can I help you? " instead of " Get out. " And this investment in our kids made huge differences, and we continue to see rises in our academic scores.
after: He became a leader in the school, and this behavior became contagious with other students. We saw and felt our school climate continue to improve, making it a happy and safe place not only for children but for adults, despite any outside influence.
ru: Я рада сообщить, что когда Д. перешёл в четвёртый класс, он редко попадал в неприятности.

quote: We rehearse our words, but we rarely rehearse our gestures.
before: Why do they do that? Well, we all do the same thing.
after: We say " yes, " we shake our heads " no. " We tell very convincing stories, we slightly shrug our shoulders.
ru: Мы репетируем свою речь, но редко репетируем жесты.

quote: But we rarely do that when we're having a bad day, and something horrible is happening.
before: It's not — we tend to take our cameras out when we're doing awesome things. Or we're, " Oh, yeah, this party, let me take a picture. "
after: And I found that it's actually been very, very important to record even just that one second of a really bad moment. It really helps you appreciate the good times.
ru: Но мы редко делаем подобное, когда у нас плохой день, и когда что-то ужасное происходит.

quote: He is rarely seen in public, and there is some speculation about his health.
before: The current president, Josefa Iloilo, is 88 years old and suffers from Parkinson's disease.

quote: Zoey must have stolen another device to RAT Aaron.
before: She's starting with Aaron, someone else will be next-- until she finds out who her bully is. I'm gonna have Nelson pick up his computer.
after: We're gonna find her. All right.
ru: Зои должна была украсть другой гаджет, чтобы "закинуть крысу" Аарону.

quote: Only to have him spring up like a rat from another hole with the Caliphate Army?
before: Really? Is that what you call it?
after: How did you not know about this until now? Admittedly, it was a failure of intelligence.
ru: И теперь он выскочил, словно крыса, из новой норы вместе с армией Калифата?

quote: All right, he found out that George was a rat.
before: Carl Nash. He's the one that ordered the hit.
after: What, you know him? Ex-homicide.
ru: И так, он узнал, что Джордж - крыса.

quote: Enjoy your next life as a gutter rat.
before: Pulling a gun on a federal agent? Talk about bad karma.
after: It's not what it looks like. This should be interesting.
ru: В следующей жизни будешь канализационной крысой.

quote: Let me summarize: The rat received a paralyzing lesion of the spinal cord.
before: So imagine the little 200-gram rat attached at the extremity of this 200-kilo robot, but the rat does not feel the robot. The robot is transparent, just like you would hold a young child during the first insecure steps.
after: The electrochemical neuroprosthesis enabled a highly functional state of the spinal locomotor networks. The robot provided the safe environment to allow the rat to attempt anything to engage the paralyzed legs.
ru: Давайте подведём итог. Крыса получила парализующее поражение спинного мозга.

quote: I had all kinds of rats, mice, hamsters, gerbils, squirrels.
before: As a child, I had two passions. One was a passion for rodents.
after: You name it, I bred it, and I sold them to pet shops. (Laughter) I also had a passion for Africa.
ru: У меня были все виды крыс, мышей, хомяков, песчанок, белок.

quote: Usually they eat larger snakes like rat snakes, or even cobras.
before: RW: Yes, this is actually the first time anyone of us knew about it, for one thing. As I said, it's just like a little snack for him, you know?
after: But this guy who we're following right now is in the deep jungle. Whereas other king cobras very often come into the human interface, you know, the plantations, to find big rat snakes and stuff.
ru: Обычно, они едят змей покрупнее, типа крысиной змеи или даже кобры.

quote: And, the fact that the rats would prefer the easy lever was also not so straightforward.
before: The articles were not giving as much information as we now have to write down. And so we had to guess some parameters over there.
after: So we thought "oh, they are gonna prefer the easy lever, and that's it." But at the end, you know, some rats, some animals develop a preference on the side; like they prefer their right lever, or the left lever, or others, they prefer the heavy lever.

quote: Inflation will force banks to raise interest rate.
before: It's enough to pay 2 meals. You should renew it.
after: I'm diabetic. How soon will... interest rate go up?
ru: Инфляция заставит банки повысить процентные ставки.

quote: So, at this rate, we should be there in six days?
before: It happened here? Yeah, it was an accident.
after: I'm going as fast as I can. You said we were taking a car.
ru: Ну что, таким темпом, дней за 6 доберемся?

quote: And even if they can afford a prime rate, they're automatically booted into a ghetto loan.
before: So white people get pointed in one direction where they get a decent percentage, and then, uh, black and brown people-- well, they get sent down the hall towards... Guess what-- they get a loan, too.
after: DOUG: Right. Then they immediately swap out that teaser rate for a sky-high rate.
ru: И если они в состоянии платить проценты по оптимальной ставке их автоматически отфутболивают на грабительские ставки.

quote: These electrodes will measure your blood pressure, breathing rate, and body temp.
before: Of course. I'm gonna ask you a series of questions.
after: Oh. So it's a glorified lie detector.
ru: Эти электроды будут измерять ваше давление, частоту дыхания и температуру тела.

quote: So instead, we target those areas where HIV rates are the highest.
before: That would do the job. But it's just not practical.
after: We know in certain countries in sub-Saharan Africa we can test and treat pregnant women where rates are highest. This precision approach to a public health problem has cut by nearly half HIV transmission from mothers to baby in the last five years.
ru: Следует сосредоточить усилия там, где уровень ВИЧ самый высокий.

quote: An economy’s relationship between supply and demand is reflected in its inflation rates and interest rates.
before: So it helps to start with the big picture: recessions occur when there is a negative disruption to the balance between supply and demand. There’ s a mismatch between how many goods people want to buy, how many products and services producers can offer, and the price of the goods and services sold, which prompts an economic decline.
after: Inflation happens when goods and services get more expensive. Put another way, the value of money decreases.
ru: Экономические отношения между предложением и спросом отражаются в показателях уровня инфляции и процентных ставок.

quote: So the recovery rate of all this stuff is going to be variable.
before: Now, in the Exxon Valdez spill, about 30 percent of the killer whales died in the first few months. Their numbers have never recovered.
after: It's going to take longer for some things. And some things, I think, will probably come back a little faster.
ru: Уровень восстановления численности будет разным.

quote: The use of VISA cards in Romania is currently growing at a fast rate.
after: VISA has 21 member banks in Romania which have issued a total of 2.8 million cards.

quote: I would rather have that than a Porsche car. Really?
before: Or Rab C Nesbitt. Beer and egg yolk stains are extra!
after: I would. Now, you know those air-fresheners you can get for cars, and they're always mountain dew and spring breeze?
ru: Я скорее выберу это, чем машину Porsche.

quote: I would rather share a life with you to the end than go on without you.
before: I don't age. I don't die. So if I were to marry you, then I would have to watch as you leave me behind.
after: If you still had the Grail... I do.
ru: Я скорее разделю свою жизнь с тобой до самого конца, чем проживу ее без тебя.

quote: Science,or rather the men who controlled science, don't appreciate it when their rules are challenged.
before: Tim, I've got to call back. I've gotta go.
after: Of course, we used to have religion and that told us that the earth was created 7,000 years ago, it was flat, and the sun revolved around us because God told it to. Now, we have science.
ru: Наука. Или скорее те, кто контролирует науку, не любят, когда их правила ставят под сомнение.

quote: Oh, the cheek's been rather skillfully removed, but I see signs of a struggle.
before: No, it isn't. Okay. So, our guy's into body mods, so is that what the cheek's about?
after: Hey, Janis, can you... Yeah.
ru: Щека была удалена довольно умело, но я вижу следы борьбы.

quote: I think it's rather easy to define if you're not trying to give a scientific definition.
before: You can't do this if you don't give a definition. People always say consciousness is very hard to define.
after: We're not ready for a scientific definition, but here's a common-sense definition. Consciousness consists of all those states of feeling or sentience or awareness.
ru: Я думаю, это довольно легко, если бросить попытки дать научное определение.

quote: Rather, it's supported by reasons created by us.
before: I am for chocolate donuts. (Laughter) This response in hard choices is a rational response, but it's not dictated by reasons given to us.
after: When we create reasons for ourselves to become this kind of person rather than that, we wholeheartedly become the people that we are. You might say that we become the authors of our own lives.

quote: The reason for this is the way we make decisions.

The people who we find are the highest-risk offenders, the people who we think have the highest likelihood of committing a new crime if they're released, we see nationally that 50 percent of those people are being released.
after: Judges have the best intentions when they make these decisions about risk, but they're making them subjectively. They're like the baseball scouts 20 years ago who were using their instinct and their experience to try to decide what risk someone poses.
ru: Причина этого в том, как мы принимаем решения.

quote: So there are lots of reasons for eating this way that go beyond just your health.

There are ecological reasons for eating lower on the food chain too, whether it's the deforestation in the Amazon or making more protein available to the four billion people who live on a dollar a day, not to mention whatever ethical concerns people have.
after: Now, we're about to publish the first study looking at the effects of this program on prostate cancer, in collaboration with Sloan Kettering and UCSF. We took 90 men who had biopsy-proven prostate cancer, who had elected, for reasons unrelated to the study, not to have surgery.
ru: Т.е. существует множество причин питаться правильно помимо нашего здоровья.

after: Reasonable. What about the definition of success?
ru: Разумно было бы проанализировать 21 год опыта приёма на работу в Fox News.

before: Caitlin Quattromani: The election of 2016 felt different. Political conversations with our family and friends uncovered a level of polarization that many of us had not previously experienced.

ru: Люди, которых мы привыкли считать разумными и мудрыми, стали похожи на незнакомцев.

after: Oh, as long as you're reasonably sure... Jordan, look at this map. There are 50 near misses in the anders nebula alone.

quote: Y-you did a reasonably good job of it?

CA: Edward Snowden, when, after his talk, was wandering the halls here in the bot, and I heard him say to a couple of people, they asked him about what he thought of the NSA overall, and he was very complimentary about the people who work with you, said that it's a really impassioned group of employees who are seeking to do the right thing, and that the problems have come from just some badly conceived policies.
after: He didn't come over like a crazy man. Would you accept that at least, even if you disagree with how he did it, that he has opened a debate that matters?

ru: В Бразилии достаточно эффективно ВВП конвертируется в благосостояние общества.

quote: This suggests that the probability of life appearing is reasonably high.

quote: Unlike a week earlier, those in attendance were reasonably well behaved.

after: In Boulder, Colorado, voters not too long ago approved a process to replace the private power company, literally the power company, the electric company Xcel, with a publicly owned utility that would forego profits and attend far more to climate change. Well, Xcel fought back, and Xcel has now put in play a ballot measure that would undermine or undo this municipalization.
ru: Я расскажу лишь две истории, взятые из недавних газетных заголовков.

quote: So in recent years, we have begun to learn about the happiness of the two selves.
before: The distinction between the happiness of the experiencing self and the satisfaction of the remembering self has been recognized in recent years, and there are now efforts to measure the two separately. The Gallup Organization has a world poll where more than half a million people have been asked questions about what they think of their life and about their experiences, and there have been other efforts along those lines.
after: And the main lesson I think that we have learned is they are really different. You can know how satisfied somebody is with their life, and that really doesn't teach you much about how happily they're living their life, and vice versa.
ru: Так, в последнее время мы начали изучать счастье через призму двух я.

quote: A recent class project had the task of addressing hearing loss in these elderly people.
before: The students are encouraged to engage with communities as they search for solutions to health-related problems. One of the communities that we work with is a group of elderly people in Cape Town.
after: The students, many of them being engineers, set out believing that they would design a better hearing aid. They spent time with the elderly, chatted to their healthcare providers and their caregivers.
ru: Задачей одного недавнего учебного проекта было решить проблему потери слуха у этих пожилых людей.

quote: Mr. Shinawatra's recent visit to the region was followed by further shootings.
after: In Narathiwat Province a 40 year old village worker was shot while helping a neighbour repair a fence. Friday saw the shooting of an assistant village head in Yala Province, and an elderly couple were shot in Pattani Province whilst returning from a local market.

ru: Недавно до меня дошли слухи о том, что случилось, когда я приехал к вам с Кемалем Памуком.

ru: Ты покупал недавно что-нибудь еще типа Окси- или Гидрокодона?

ru: А я недавно приобрела большую квартиру, забитую мебелью, скульптурами и антиквариатом.

quote: Torres's sister went to Argentina recently to look for him.
before: Or worse. He switched sides.
after: Few days later, somebody plants a bomb in her car. That's one hell of a coincidence.
ru: Сестра Торреса была в Аргентине недавно, чтобы разыскать его.

quote: I received a letter recently from a 13-year-old boy.
before: Before, effort and difficulty made them feel dumb, made them feel like giving up, but now, effort and difficulty, that's when their neurons are making new connections, stronger connections. That's when they're getting smarter.
after: He said, " Dear Professor Dweck, I appreciate that your writing is based on solid scientific research, and that's why I decided to put it into practice. I put more effort into my schoolwork, into my relationship with my family, and into my relationship with kids at school, and I experienced great improvement in all of those areas.
ru: Недавно я получила письмо от 13-летнего мальчика.

quote: And we stole recently a ship from the United States Navy.
before: Fortunately, we've been able to convince Congress. We begin to go on the Hill and lobby.
after: The Okeanos Explorer on its mission. Its mission is as good as you could get.
ru: И недавно мы украли корабль у Военно-морских сил США.

before: So what's missing in that equation is figuring out what our boundaries would be. You would want YouTube to know something about, say, falling asleep.
after: And so what we need to recognize is that the human architecture is limited and that we have certain boundaries or dimensions of our lives that we want to be honored and respected, and technology could help do that. (Applause) CA: I mean, could you make the case that part of the problem here is that we've got a naïve model of human nature?
ru: Недавно руководитель Netflix заявил, что «наши самые главные конкуренты — Facebook, YouTube и сон».

quote: Because the show is written six weeks in advance she appeared up until recently.

Of course there are more things than cats, so here's a computer algorithm telling us the picture contains a boy and a teddy bear; a dog, a person, and a small kite in the background; or a picture of very busy things like a man, a skateboard, railings, a lampost, and so on.
ru: Она позволила создать эффективную систему для получения новых многообещающих результатов в распознавании объектов.

after: Just a few years ago, an umbrella organization called the International Alliance of Carer Organizations, or IACO, was formed to bring together carer groups from all over the world, to provide strategic direction, facilitate information sharing, as well as actively advocate for carers on an international level. Private entities are also starting to recognize the situation of carers.
ru: И всё-таки произошло улучшение относительно признания их роли по всему миру.

after: And this allows us to temporally align all of the examples. And then we apply Kalman filtering, a technique from control theory, that allows us to statistically analyze all the noise and extract the desired trajectory that underlies them.

ru: Восхитительное выздоровление для женщины твоих лет.

after: And we have his book outside in the bookshop. The thing that amazed me is the painstaking detail with which he has written every hospital he has been to, every treatment he got, every near-miss he had, and how accidentally he stumbled upon innovations.
ru: Меня поразило то, насколько важную роль в его выздоровлении сыграла технология.

ru: Кейнс назвал это "парадоксом бережливости" -- рост сбережений замедляет восстановление.

after: If we looked at the world in 1800, you'd find that more than half of the world's people lived in Asia and they made more than half the world's product. Now fast forward to 1900: half the world's people — more than half — still live in Asia, but they're now making only a fifth of the world's product.
ru: В действительности это следовало бы называть восстановлением, или возвращением, Азии.

ru: Вы все еще планируете делать операцию по сокращению желудочков?

after: This seems counterintuitive, but turns out that as infant mortality is reduced, population sizes also decrease, because parents don't need to anticipate that their babies are going to die. after: I'm just waiting on the judge. We don't need much.
ru: Я отправила запрос на доступ к его данным.

quote: The senator made requests for classified intelligence 29 times last month.
before: Astrid must be there by now. If they've learned anything, I'm sure they'll call.
after: There's nothing here. Well, if he's like the other shape-shifters, he's gonna be careful.
ru: Сенатор запрашивал секретную информацию 29 раз за последний месяц.

quote: Should I call the ACC's office, sir, and put a request in.
before: That's a good idea, yes. Because the last person she had a drink with ended up with their neck snapped.
after: What for? Well, for an interview.
ru: Мне позвонить старшему следователю, сэр, сделать запрос?

quote: Events like these underscore the urgency of my request to Congress for a declaration of war.
before: The system that maintains our sewers has been tampered with. The perpetrators were targeting the government and their ultimate purpose, though foiled, was to disrupt all mid-Atlantic transportation networks.
after: Tonight, I can only suspect Congress will spend a dark night of the soul, after which they will reconsider their paralysis and choose to act. Capital East Telecom has informed me that it's repairing the network as fast as possible, but that it will take at least a couple more days to be fully restored.
ru: Такие события, как они подчеркивают актуальность моего запроса к Конгрессу для объявления войны.

quote: And so that's the request I have for everybody in this room.
before: The stories that we tell — what we push out — becomes who we are. People aren't simply projecting identity, they're creating it.
after: We are creating the technology that is going to create the new shared experience, which will create the new world. And so my request is, please, let's make technologies that make people more human, and not less.
ru: И у меня есть просьба ко всем сидящим в зале

quote: They come to us with a request for a loan.
before: That means that they have no sports; they have no latest news; circulation goes down. It's a kind of very nice, sophisticated way how to economically strangle a daily newspaper.
after: They want to — the only way for them to survive is to get a printing press. And we said, that's fine; let's meet; you'll bring us your business plan, which eventually they did.
ru: Они приходят к нам с просьбой о кредите.

quote: The simplest example of this is in the polite request.
before: You want to express the bribe, the command, the promise, the solicitation and so on, but you also have to negotiate and maintain the kind of relationship you have with the other person. The solution, I think, is that we use language at two levels: the literal form signals the safest relationship with the listener, whereas the implicated content — the reading between the lines that we count on the listener to perform — allows the listener to derive the interpretation which is most relevant in context, which possibly initiates a changed relationship.
after: If you express your request as a conditional — " if you could open the window, that would be great " — even though the content is an imperative, the fact that you're not using the imperative voice means that you're not acting as if you're in a relationship of dominance, where you could presuppose the compliance of the other person. On the other hand, you want the damn guacamole.
ru: Самый простой пример – вежливая просьба.

quote: This request is based on the U.S. Justice Department withdrawing charges against former Senator Ted Stevens.
before: The Republican Party of Alaska is requesting United States Senator Mark Begich, Democrat, to resign to pave way for a new election.

quote: Archer had never been more indifferent to the requirements of form; but his impulse to do Lawrence Lefferts a physical injury was only momentary.
after: The idea of bandying Ellen Olenska's name with him at such a time, and on whatsoever provocation, was unthinkable. He paid for his telegram, and the two young men went out together into the street.
ru: Арчер ещё никогда не был так равнодушен к требованиям приличий; но желание ударить Лоуренса Леффертса было лишь мимолётным.

quote: We never said anything about a residency requirement.
before: That's cheating. Eh, cheating is such an ugly word.
after: I think it's implied in the phrase "dorm triathlon." Oh.
ru: Мы ничего не говорили о требованиях к местожительству.

quote: Look, Mrs. St. Patrick, there may be a way to keep Tariq enrolled at this school, but the requirements will be severe.
before: Oh, I get it. The black kid gets expelled, but Michelle Batten and Jenny West don't, after they assaulted the girl on the lacrosse team with their sticks.
after: Oh, I wouldn't have expected it any other way. 'Riq, wait for me downstairs.
ru: - Послушайте, миссис Сэнт-Патрик, возможно, есть способ оставить Тарига в нашей школе, но требования будут очень жёсткие.

quote: Well, you've covered all the legal requirements, boss.
before: Then I'll keep you posted. Right now, we don't have anything but a tip, and we don't know much about what kind of information is allegedly being passed up.
after: The officer in question is assigned to your precinct. Kinda figured that.
ru: Ну, босс, все требования закона вы учли.
source_ru: Ну, босс, все законные требования вы прикрыли.

quote: But that's pretty much it for formal requirements.
before: So, the first thing that they tell you is that you need to have a certificate of burial before you can go ahead — you're not allowed to just murder people and put them under the patio. (Laughter) They also tell you that you need to keep a record of where the grave is.
after: Now, they do warn you that your neighbors might not like this, but, legally speaking, there's almost nothing that they can do about it. And just in case any of you still had that profit idea in your mind about how much those burial plots cost and how much money you might be able to make, they also warn that it might cause the value of your house to drop by 20 percent.
ru: Пожалуй, это всё, что касается формальных требований.

quote: The only two requirements were that they were studying at the university, and they spoke English.
before: And they're not necessarily, you know, great ways of looking at the entire world. So we actually invited 80 young people from all over the world to come and solve the same problem.
after: The majority of them were, first, from developing countries. They had all the same material but they could go vastly outside the scope of discussion, and they certainly did, to come up with their own lists.
ru: Было только два условия — чтобы они учились в университете и говорили по-английски.

quote: North American travelers will see a phased-in requirement to carry passports in the coming years.
after: In a multi-national initiative to restrict illegal immigration and travel, a passport layer of stricter identification will be introduced for travel throughout the continent by the year 2008. The US State Department announced the new American travel rules Monday.
ru: Для путешественников из Северной Америки в ближайшие годы поэтапно введут требование иметь при себе паспорт.

quote: I used to know that until I saw the research.
before: Um... the damage to your spinal cord's pretty severe. I think you know that.
after: Do you know how long the testing process takes for medical protocols like this? At least... 10 years... and- and that's before they even start human trials.
ru: Я знал это, пока я не увидел исследований.

quote: Alain encapsulated that research, and now he'll be sorely missed.
before: What sort of world is this? It's OK, I'll protect them.
after: Have you thought it over, Mr Vermillard? Shit!
ru: Ален занимался исследованиями. Нам его будет очень не хватать.

quote: The Patriot Act made my research at Thurn accessible to the government.
before: Men with guns always want to control the men with ideas. Is that why you left hithan tk Thurn-Tippett,
after: They rationalized that in a time of war, they needed access to anything that could help defeat terrorism. Defeat terrorism?
ru: По закону о борьбе с терроризмом правительство получило доступ к моим исследованиям.

quote: A guy like this, he wouldn't just stop registering his research because oliver let him go.
before: Schott is a pretty prolific inventor. He filed a lot of patents for s.t.a.r. Labs.
after: So maybe the patent office has a current address for him. If this guy's working for lex, we're dealing with a lot more than just some toy maker.
ru: И он явно не из тех, кто прекратил бы свои исследования только потому, что Оливер его уволил.

quote: My vision is to make genetic research more native, to indigenize genome sequencing technology.
before: Hawaii, for example, has the longest life expectancy on average of any state in the US, yet native Hawaiians like myself die a full decade before our non-native counterparts, because we have some of the highest rates of type 2 diabetes, obesity, and the number one and number two killers in the US: cardiovascular disease and cancer. So how do we ensure the populations of people that need genome sequencing the most are not the last to benefit?
after: Traditionally, genomes are sequenced in laboratories. Here's an image of your classic genome sequencer.
ru: Моя мечта — обратить геномные исследования во благо коренным народам и сделать технологии расшифровки генома доступными на местах.

quote: A headline certainly shouldn’t claim the results of this research are generally applicable.
before: So what’ s wrong with the headline: " Eating breakfast can help you lose weight " The people in the study started eating breakfast and lost weight — but we don’ t know that they lost weight because they started eating breakfast; perhaps having their weight tracked inspired them to change their eating habits in other ways. To rule out the possibility that some other factor caused weight loss, we would need to compare these participants to a group who didn’ t eat breakfast before the study and continued to skip it during the study.
after: And if the study itself made such a claim without a comparison group, then you should question its credibility. Now that you’ ve battle-tested your skills on these hypothetical studies and headlines, you can test them on real-world news.
ru: Заголовок этого исследования не должен заявлять, что его результаты являются общеприменимыми.

quote: In our research, people accepted acceleration as inevitable, both the thrills and the lack of control.
before: Will a faster future make us more secure and productive? Or will it make us more vulnerable?
after: They fear that if they were to slow down, they might run the risk of becoming obsolete. They say they'd rather burn out than rust out.
ru: Согласно нашему исследованию, люди восприняли ускорение как неизбежность, включая волнение и потерю контроля.

quote: "It's hard to believe they have done any research on this," he said.
after: "There is this naive belief you get sometimes in management that if a campaign is not working properly you simply open the spigot a bit more, but it doesn't work that way."

quote: He's a researcher at a government think tank.
before: - Blaine's definitely our killer. - But who is he?
after: Yeah, but what a researcher at a government think tank is doing involved in all this, we have no idea. Yeah, we may never know.
ru: Он исследователь в правительственном научном центре.

quote: The Brooklyn Museum is closed to the public on Tuesdays, but researchers are admitted.
before: "Behold the Great Red Dragon." And did you?
after: You knew that's when we'd both be going. A sophisticated intelligence can forecast many things.
ru: По вторникам Бруклинский музей закрыт для посещений всеми, кроме исследователей.

quote: Weeks passed and the team of researchers found nothing unusual.
before: In practice, that meant sitting alone in the dark and counting tiny, almost invisible, flashes on the phosphorescent screen. It was deeply tedious, but Rutherford insisted that they keep at it.
after: The alpha particles seemed to punch through the gold almost as though it wasn't there. Very occasionally, they would swerve slightly as they went through.
ru: Ќедели проходили но команда исследователей не находила ничего необычного.

quote: Researchers at the fragrance lab down there, when they're not dealing ecstasy.
before: Houston. This was over the weekend. Who are they?
after: Track it. West Coast Market Coordinator of the Floor Wax Division.
ru: Исследователи из лаборатории запахов, когда не продают экстази.

quote: Now, what is Roz Picard, an AI researcher, doing here telling you about SUDEP, right?
before: The vertical axis is the number of deaths times the remaining life span, so higher is much worse impact. SUDEP, however, unlike these others, is something that people right here could do something to push that down.
after: I'm not a neurologist. When I was working at the Media Lab on measurement of emotion, trying to make our machines more intelligent about our emotions, we started doing a lot of work measuring stress.
ru: Но почему я, Роз Пикар, исследователь ИИ, рассказываю вам про СВСЭП?

quote: And these were surfaced by researcher David Matsumoto in California.
before: And as I promised, we're now going to look at what the truth looks like. But I'm going to show you two videos, two mothers — one is lying, one is telling the truth.
after: And I think they're an excellent example of what the truth looks like. This mother, Diane Downs, shot her kids at close range, drove them to the hospital while they bled all over the car, claimed a scraggy-haired stranger did it.
ru: Эти ролики были отработаны исследователем Дэвидом Матсумото из Калифорнии.

quote: Well, that's what the researchers that I'm going to talk about today did.
before: The modern car is a sophisticated multi-computer device. And what happens if somebody wanted to attack this?
after: They basically stuck an attacker on the wired network and on the wireless network. Now, they have two areas they can attack.
ru: Вот как раз это и решила узнать группа исследователей, о которой я вам сейчас расскажу.

quote: The researcher published a key for adult males in the genus.
before: The species are also sexually dimorphic, making morphological association of females with males a challenge.

quote: That's strange, because our reserves are still at almost maximum current capacity from the last recharge.
before: Yeah, we've got several systems down. Looks like Destiny's activated some kind of power-saving mode.
after: Life support's fine. I should be able to work round it, Get the lights back on in a couple of minutes.
ru: Это странно, потому что наши запасы почти на максимуме с последней перезарядки.

quote: Where did you procure such massive quantities of reserves?
before: They're here! My God.
after: Is there a nearby citadel? A supermarket...
ru: Где вы добываете такое огромное количество запасов?

quote: We're all family here, but our cash reserves have been depleted.
before: - We all do. - And yet here we are, $300,000 short of dignified.
after: Surely Alicia knows that we were bruised by the loss of Chumhum. Yes, and because of the loss of Chumhum, client retention is even more critical.
ru: Мы все как семья, но наши запасы наличности истощены.

quote: Suppose this hand represents current reserves of dark matter and this hand represents consumer demand.
before: But you said... (MOM sighs) Allow me to explain.
after: Uh-huh. I just bet you'd like to know why I'm so angry about this dark matter shortage.
ru: Допустим, эта рука показывает текущий запас тёмной материи а эта рука показывает запросы потребителей.

quote: These were the people on the reserve who were responsible for its well-being.
before: Where he had learned to do that out in the bush I have no idea, but he could do it. He then moved across into what we called the habitat team.
after: He fixed roads, he mended wetlands, he did some anti-poaching. And then one day we were out together, and he came across the tracks of where a female leopard had walked.
ru: Эти люди несут ответственность за благополучие заповедника.

quote: We have reserves that can scale us up to large numbers.
before: The best lessons, I think, on how to get prepared are again, what we do for war. For soldiers, we have full-time, waiting to go.
after: NATO has a mobile unit that can deploy very rapidly. NATO does a lot of war games to check, are people well trained?
ru: У нас есть военные запаса, за счёт которых можно увеличить армию.

quote: And it has been named Okapi Faunal Reserve because of this beautiful creature.
before: So, the Okapi Faunal Reserve protects number — I think that is the largest number of elephants we have right now in protected areas in Congo. It has also chimpanzees.
after: That is a forest giraffe. I think you guys know it quite well.
ru: И заповедник получил название "Заповедник фауны Окапи" в честь этого красивого создания.

quote: Calls for an independent global reserve currency are not new.
after: In 1944, John Maynard Keynes proposed the "bancor", a unit like the SDR supported by a basket of commodities. Keynes' idea was rejected and the US dollar took the equivalent role under the Bretton Woods system.

quote: A warning was issued to residents to exercise extra caution.
before: I hate cream puffs. The knife wielding killer is still at large.
after: The Tsurukawa Award winner is Mr. Seitaro Tanaka. I first aspired to be a novelist when I was in the sixth grade.
ru: Жителям было объявлено предупреждение проявлять особую осторожность.

quote: There's a cop to every eight residents. Drawbridges.
before: Look, the problem is not the score, the problem is Palm Beach. Nobody does business there.
after: They could shut the island down like that. You're trapped.
ru: На каждых 8 жителей по дому, разводные мосты.

before: So, it'll look like an accident. It's essential to maintaining public order after the culling takes place.
after: The council has already issued a writ of consent giving the chancellor permission to carry out the population reduction. A sleep-inducing gas will be introduced into the air.
ru: Все жители раздела 17 будут в периоде сна.

quote: But I am a bona fide resident of Camden!
before: But I'm disabled! I don't always use a walking stick. That pulls the wool over people's eyes.
after: And I had rheumatic fever as a child, and mumps. I still think you'll have to move on. Go somewhere else.
ru: Но я настоящий житель Кэмдена!

quote: He began renting out motorbikes to local residents who couldn't normally afford them.
before: Aden saw an opportunity and seized it. He started a motorbike company.
after: He bought 10 bikes, with the help of family and friends, and his dream is to eventually expand to several hundred within the next three years. How is this story different?
ru: Он сдавал мотоциклы местным жителям, которые не могли купить их.

quote: So what's a resident to do to fit in?
before: Given the conservatism of these cops, there's no surprise that North Idaho has a strong gun culture. In fact, it is said, North Idaho has more gun dealers than gas stations.
after: I hit the gun club. When I rented a gun, the gentleman behind the counter was perfectly pleasant and kind, until I showed him my New York City driver's license.
ru: Итак, что делает местный житель, чтоб соответствовать окружению?

quote: So Father Samaan blessed the project, and his approval brought all the residents on board.
before: It was really important for me that the community felt connected to the words. And for me this quote was perfectly reflecting the spirit of the project.
after: Hundreds of liters of paint, a dozen blue manual lifts, several trips back and forth to Cairo, a strong and solid team from France, North Africa, Middle East and the US, and after a year of planning and logistics, there we are, my team and some members from the local community creating a piece that will spread over 50 buildings, some filling up the space of the calligraphy that I trace with colors. Here some blue, there some yellow, there some orange.
ru: Отец Самаан благословил этот проект, и его одобрение убедило всех жителей.

quote: Buildings have been evacuated and residents have been advised to stay inside to avoid fumes.
before: An explosion in an electricity substation in Chelmsford, Essex has killed one person.
after: The blast occurred at approximately 12:15 p.m. local time, near Anglia Ruskin University.

quote: For example, um, how did you solve the problem of plasmic resistance?
before: What? Of course.
after: Well, it's actually quite unexpected. What you have to do is linearize the structure to permit the addition of chimeric plasmids.
ru: Например, как Вы решили проблему сопротивления плазмы?

quote: However, there are still pockets of human resistance that threaten our peace.
before: What did you think? Did you think I'd just give up?
after: Your host was part of that resistance. You want me to locate her memories. Yes.
ru: Однако, остались очаги сопротивления, которые угрожают нашему миру.

quote: We would not be much of a resistance if we did not resist.
before: Then you cut off both heads and gut the body. Eric's death was necessary.
after: No. His reasons are personal.
ru: Мы бы не были сопротивлением, если бы не сопротивлялись.

quote: So I've created a hybrid compound with a resistance two times that of regular silicon.
before: Now, they ruined our nation- drugs, fornicating, a grown man singing about his feelings. It's time we win this war, expunge this school of all dope fiends.
after: Used as the basis material for electronics, it would provide increased protection against power surges, magnetic waves. This is an electromagnetic pulse generator.
ru: (Генри): Таким образом, я создал гибридный материал, с сопротивлением в два раза выше, чем у обычного кремния.

quote: But I wonder -- in those films, you have the resistance mounting.
before: (Applause) Helen Walters: James, thank you for coming and giving us that talk. So it's interesting: when you think about the films where the robotic overlords take over, it's all a bit more glamorous than what you're describing.
after: Is there a resistance mounting towards this stuff? Do you see any positive signs, green shoots of resistance?
ru: Но меня волнует вот что: в этих фильмах всегда есть какое-то сопротивление.

quote: And the principle we all revolve around is what's called the "Neural Path of Least Resistance."
before: And I don't know about you, but living inside of Windows scares me. (Laughter) To isolate the single most intuitive interface out of infinity, we use neuroscience to drive our design guidelines, instead of letting a bunch of designers fight it out in the boardroom.
after: At every turn, we're connecting the iOS of the brain with our brain on, for the first time, our brain's terms. In other words, we're trying to create a zero learning-curve computer.
ru: Принцип, вокруг которого мы все вращаемся, называется «нейронный путь наименьшего сопротивления».

quote: And finding alternatives to direct confrontation is at the core of nonviolent resistance.
before: Having had to navigate being in the less powerful position in multiple aspects of their lives, women are often more adept at how to surreptitiously pressure for change against large, powerful actors. The term " manipulative, " often charged against women in a derogatory way, reflects a reality in which women have often had to find ways other than direct confrontation to achieve their goals.
after: Now to the second potential misunderstanding. I've been talking a lot about my experiences in the Middle East, and some of you might be thinking now that the solution then is for us to educate Muslim and Arab societies to be more inclusive of their women.
ru: А умение найти альтернативы прямому столктновению и есть суть ненасильственного сопротивления.

quote: The year-long probe dubbed "Operation Resistance" began after information from the Brazilian Federal Police last December.
after: The tip-off supplied from the DPF via the Interpol, had contributed to identification of more than 200 suspects in 70 countries forming the global internet sex network. The Age reported that "six other Victorians arrested are a 40-year-old Bell Park man, 27-year-old Maldon man, Rodney Peter Smith, a 56-year-old Altona man, a 66-year-old Northcote man, a 32-year-old Lovely Banks man and a 47-year-old Windsor man."

after: This is a production of "Hamlet"? I... I don't think so.
ru: Да, я вижу это уважение по фотографии.

after: I have done what I have done to arrive at this point. I have done what I've done and I will live with it.
ru: При всём уважении, мадам, это не что-то такое, чего вы ранее не делали.

quote: All due respect, it's up to you folks to submit accurate paperwork.
before: Our folks are going to have to go back to square one on the new address. If we... we could d obin a provisional agreement today, to allow the... the branch to open be...
after: Maybe next time, double-check. Now, uh, the soonest we could revisit this matter... well, it... it looks like six weeks from Friday.
ru: Нет, нет. При всем уважении, вам надо было подать правильные документы.

before: Company 38, this is Captain Beckett of the 12th Precinct. Because of last night's tragic event, she will be joining us today as a special guest instructor.
after: Thank you, Sergeant. First of all, let me assure you that I have the best NYPD detectives looking into Officer Bardot's murder.

before: From sexuality and mental health to poverty and incarceration. Far beyond definition as single right or wrong decisions, our experiences can exist on a spectrum.
after: Thank you. (Applause)
ru: «За голос» сосредотачивает это обсуждение на человеческом опыте и делает поддержку и уважение доступными всем.

quote: And the respect of your team is more important than all the laurels in the world.
before: It's the most powerful thing you own. Imagination is a force that can actually manifest a reality.
after: I have young filmmakers come up to me and say, " Give me some advice for doing this. " And I say, " Don't put limitations on yourself.

quote: This is our new economy -- an economy based on the respect of our natural resources.
before: Nowhere else in the world has community-adopted conservation at this scale. (Applause) In 2008, conservancy generated 5.7 million dollars.
after: And we are able to use this money for many things: Very importantly, we put it in education. Secondly, we put it for infrastructure.

quote: Stab wounds to the back have pierced the right lung and the heart respectively.

I told his father I would keep him safe.

before: Under isolation. We heard.

ru: И когда в лаборатории будет достаточно безопасно, чтобы войти снова?
