ru: На вкус как песок с сахаром.

quote: Wendell, I know you don't live with your head in the sand.
before: I agree... It's time for the two of them to talk it out.
after: You're a good man. A good steward of the earth.
ru: Уэндел, я знаю, ты не из тех, кто прячет голову в песок.

quote: Why did you bring another type of sand?
before: I wish he were like everybody else. We'll find your husband's murderer, I promise you.
after: -What kind of sand? -You had a different type of sand.
ru: Зачем вы завезли новый песок?

quote: Absorbent material like sand would contain any seepage.
before: Any casings or slugs? Pattern's too wide for a bullet wound.
after: If Decker and his accomplice did bring Preeda out here, they did so to sever her carotid artery and then dispose of the body. Has a sample been sent off to the lab yet?
ru: Такой абсорбент, как песок, впитает любую жидкость.

quote: It brings sand and gravel to the river we need to use to build.
before: (Laughter) The rain in Burkina comes very fast, and after that, you have floods everywhere in the country. But for us, the rain is good.
after: We just wait for the rain to go. We take the sand, we mix it with clay, and we keep building.
ru: Они приносят песок и гравий в русло реки, которые нам нужны для строительства.

quote: No. They were given a task: move sand from this area to that area.
before: Right? Nobody was telling them go left, go right, or giving them a predescribed path.
after: And if they came across an obstacle, like a rock, they had to sort it out themselves. Or they came across another robot, they had to be able to make decisions.
ru: Нет. У них было лишь задание: перенести песок из одного места в другое.

quote: In a way, the static, stone mountain becomes a moving mountain of sand.
before: And as the sandstone weathers, new grains break free. Some of those grains may then accumulate on a massive scale, into a sand dune.
after: But, moving mountains can be dangerous. Let me try and explain why.
ru: В каком-то смысле, каменная гора становится подвижной песочной горой.

quote: It is estimated that the NOASC oil sands hold approximately 2.2 billion barrels of oil reserves.
before: NAOSC is an Alberta-based oil company founded in 2001. It manages 1,110 square kilometres of oil sands leases located in northern Alberta.
after: The company is planning to develop an extraction project and an upgrading facility. When the project is completed, NAOSC expects it to produce over 200,000 barrels of bitumen per day.

quote: Satellite imagery of the area has been blocked.
before: By whom? Don't know.
after: Get Henry on it. He's already in the lab.
ru: Спутниковое изображение местности было заблокировано

quote: This satellite is shared by NATO but operated by your N.S.A.
before: I'm not comfortable blindly doing your bidding. If you want me to do something, I need to know the reason.
after: I need it redirected. The N.S.A. refers to it internally as E-3175.
ru: Спутником владеет НАТО, но управляется он вашим АНБ.

quote: They're not getting away if I still got him on satellite.
before: I'm seriously pissed we're not getting paid for this. Well, at least we get to kill him.
after: Some genius. Thinks he can outrun the CIA.
ru: Они не уйдут, я слежу за ними через спутник.

quote: I've got a live satellite feed of the harbor.
before: This thing was made for open water, not navigating obstacles. Well, this just keeps getting better and better, doesn't it?
after: Still no sign of the sub. I need you to plot possible courses using everything we know about this sub's capabilities.
ru: У меня прямая трансляция гавани со спутника.

quote: We now know that you're at a fixed distance from the satellite.
before: So thanks to the atomic clock, we get a time reading accurate to within 1 billionth of a second, and a very precise measurement of the distance from that satellite. Let's ignore the fact that you're almost definitely on Earth.
after: In other words, you're somewhere on the surface of a sphere centered around the satellite. Measure your distance from a second satellite and you get another overlapping sphere.
ru: Известно, что вы находитесь на определённом расстоянии от спутника.

quote: Or maybe a satellite needs to have technology on board to help accelerate deorbit.
before: What if there actually were international laws with teeth that enforced end-of-life disposal of satellites instead of moving them out of the way as a temporary solution? Or maybe satellite manufacturers need to be charged a deposit to even launch a satellite into orbit, and that deposit would only be returned if the satellite was disposed of properly or if they cleaned up some quota of debris.
after: There are some encouraging signs. The UK's TechDemoSat-1, launched in 2014, for example, was designed for end-of-life disposal via a small drag sail.
ru: Или, возможно, у спутника должна быть встроена технология, помогающая ускорить вывод с орбиты.

quote: Well, we collect data from satellites, from airplanes, from ground vehicles, from people.
before: So when you think about this problem, what an enormous undertaking. Where do you begin?
after: This process is an engineering problem, a mechanical problem, a logistical problem, an operational problem. Here is an example of our aerial camera.
ru: Мы занимаемся сбором данных со спутников, с воздушных судов, с наземных средств передвижения, от людей.

quote: A Chinese Long March 3B carrier rocket has launched the Chinasat-9 satellite.
after: The rocket lifted off from pad 2 at the Xichang Satellite Launch Centre at 12:15 GMT this afternoon. Chinasat-9, also known as Zhongxing-9 and ZX-9, is a communications satellite, which will initially be used to relay coverage of the 2008 Olympic Games.

quote: Yeah, I'd say I told you so, but, you know, it wouldn't bring me much satisfaction.
before: Ah! Damn, it's overheating.
after: How deep? A few millimeters.
ru: Я бы сказал что "я же говорил", но это не доставило бы мне особого удовлетворения.

quote: With their satisfaction, our position in the opening games secured.
before: The risk outweighs concern. See to Petronius and his guests.
after: Snare any fish today in your little net? Reward, for victory in the arena.
ru: Их удовлетворение, обеспечит нашу позицию на открытие игр.

quote: The satisfactions and fulfillment of the delusion that brought Mr Hadfield before the King. Ah!
before: Then can we not say that the prisoner WAS in his true state when he committed the crime? Not if we accept the real motivation for the action.
after: Is it every frantic and idle humour of a man to be exempted from justice and the law? Are there not many circumstances that can displace a "good self"?
ru: Удовлетворение и выполнение навязчивой идеи привело м-ра Хэдфилда к Королю.

quote: Let's hope he got some satisfaction from being proved right.
before: What do you think? Dr. Paul Carruthers wrote an article for the Journal of Criminal Psychology in which he described Dr. Gideon as being a pathological narcissist who suffers from psychotic episodes.
after: I think this is about more than just getting the Chesapeake - Ripper's attention.
ru: Будем надеяться, он получил некоторое удовлетворение от того, что доказал свою правоту.

quote: Satisfaction with the direction of the country: 85 percent.
before: Today, it's the second largest economy in the world, an industrial powerhouse, and its people live in increasing prosperity. Pew Research polls Chinese public attitudes, and here are the numbers in recent years.
after: Those who think they're better off than five years ago: 70 percent. Those who expect the future to be better: a whopping 82 percent.
ru: Уровень удовлетворённых правительством страны — 85%.

quote: Young men were more likely to measure their satisfaction by their own orgasm.
before: In her work, McClelland found that young women were more likely than young men to use their partner's pleasure as a measure of their satisfaction. So they'd say things like, " If he's sexually satisfied, then I'm sexually satisfied. "
after: Young women also defined bad sex differently. In the largest ever survey ever conducted on American sexual behavior, they reported pain in their sexual encounters 30 percent of the time.
ru: Юноши скорее связывают степень удовлетворённости с собственным оргазмом.

quote: It turns out the pursuit of pleasure has almost no contribution to life satisfaction.
before: So we ask — and we've done this in 15 replications, involving thousands of people: To what extent does the pursuit of pleasure, the pursuit of positive emotion, the pleasant life, the pursuit of engagement, time stopping for you, and the pursuit of meaning contribute to life satisfaction? And our results surprised us; they were backward of what we thought.
after: The pursuit of meaning is the strongest. The pursuit of engagement is also very strong.
ru: Оказалось, стремление к удовольствию практически не влияет на удовлетворённость жизнью.

quote: "I even take some satisfaction on issues where I demonstrably failed."
In the marketplace of ideas, where... culture is king, and data moves faster than people, where scalable opportunities come from turnkey solutions...
before: How did she take it? Sh... She took it.
after: What are you trying to say, Schmidt? Is it over?
ru: На рынке идей, где... где главенствует культура а данные меняются быстрее, чем люди, где масштабируемые возможности приходят из готовых решений ...

quote: A better place through scalable, fault-tolerant distributed databases with asset transactions.
before: And we're making the world a better place through software defined data centers for cloud computing. A better place through canonical data models to communicate between endpoints.
after: And we are truly local mobile social. And we're completely So-Mo-Lo.
ru: Лучший мир с помощью масштабируемости, отказоустойчивой базы данных с операциями с активами.

quote: But without them, a scalable version would take years.
before: You might want to take off your shoes. I wasn't looking for investors at first.
after: And, as you know, with the drought, we don't have years. Super-easy to use.
ru: Но без них на масштабируемую версию потребовались бы годы.

quote: And beyond medicine, biofabrication can be a humane, sustainable and scalable new industry.
before: This is biofabrication, where cells themselves can be used to grow biological products like tissues and organs. Already in medicine, biofabrication techniques have been used to grow sophisticated body parts, like ears, windpipes, skin, blood vessels and bone, that have been successfully implanted into patients.
after: And we should begin by reimagining leather. I emphasize leather because it is so widely used.
ru: Кроме медицины биофабрикацию можно было бы использовать в качестве гуманной, устойчивой и масштабируемой новой отрасли.

quote: Why? Because that profit allows whatever solution we've created to be infinitely scalable.
before: That profit is that small difference between the price and the cost it takes to produce whatever solution business has created to whatever problem they're trying to solve. But that profit is the magic.
after: Because if we can make a profit, we can do it for 10, 100, a million, 100 million, a billion. The solution becomes self-sustaining.
ru: Почему? Потому что прибыль позволяет любому решению созданному нами быть бесконечно масштабируемым.

quote: However, the approach I built here is actually high-resolution, low-cost, and probably most importantly, very scalable.
before: Now, multi-touch sensing isn't completely new. People like Bill Buxton have been playing around with it in the' 80s.
after: So, the technology, you know, isn't the most exciting thing here right now, other than probably its newfound accessibility. What's really interesting here is what you can do with it and the kind of interfaces you can build on top of it.
ru: Однако я использую сенсор высокого разрешения, дешёвый и, что, наверное, важнее всего, легко масштабируемый.

quote: Florence Devouard also discussed the need for scalable sources of revenue for the foundation.
before: An estimation of the current total assets of the foundation was stated to be around $3.5 million.
after: These sources, she stressed, must be consistent with the foundation's non profit status, with the open/free content movement and with community wishes. Potential revenue sources include the continued sale of live datafeeds, a print on demand service, board games, puzzles and other merchandising.

quote: The same process happened for the first time On a much, much bigger scale.
before: The energy given off even from a star this small Would be devastating. Back in the early universe,
after: Gravity compressed the hydrogen gas clouds Over millions of years, Until, deep in the center, The first star burst into life Pouring its energy into the vast universe,
ru: тот же процесс случился впервые в гораздо большем масштабе.

quote: Blood loss on that scale, she almost certainly would have been dead.
before: No. Then she was moved.
after: So her attacker moved her from here, through into the front room. I know.
ru: Потеря крови в таком масштабе, она почти наверняка была мертва.

quote: They were weaponising anthrax, Ebola, smallpox, on a massive scale.
before: Biopreparat. It was huge.
after: The West panicked and created an organisation to combat the threat. It was known as The Network.
ru: Они превратили в оружие сибирскую язву, лихорадку Эбола, оспу и производили все это в огромных масштабах.

quote: Scale model of the world viewed from the inside.
before: His great globe in Leicester Square. And it was an enormous triumph.
after: Let's try something simpler. Where did the Arctic Highlanders get their cutlery from?
ru: Масштабная модель мира, рассматриваемая изнутри.

quote: To build something of this scale, only for that to sink on its maiden voyage?
before: It would have carried well over a thousand people on board, including 600 soldiers. And it housed 20 horses in separate stalls.
after: Well, let's just say that failure wouldn't have been a pleasant option for Archimedes. So he took on the problem: will it sink?
ru: Неужели строение таких масштабов могло не пережить своего первого плавания?

quote: We shrunk the dimensions of this technology from the micron scale to the true nanoscale.
before: We use a chip-based, continuous flow separation technique called deterministic lateral displacement. And we have done with it what the semiconductor industry has done so successfully for the past 50 years.
after: So how does it work? In a nutshell, a set of tiny pillars separated by nanoscopic gaps are arranged in such a way that the system divides the fluid into streamlines, with the larger cancer-related nanoparticles being separated through a process of redirection from the smaller, healthier ones, which can in contrast move around the pillars in a zigzag-type motion in the direction of fluid flow.
ru: Мы уменьшили масштаб этой технологии с микронного до истинного нанометрового.

quote: So what do we need if we want to do this at the human scale?
before: But I mean programmable materials that build themselves. And that's called self-assembly, which is a process by which disordered parts build an ordered structure through only local interaction.
after: We need a few simple ingredients. The first ingredient is materials and geometry, and that needs to be tightly coupled with the energy source.
ru: Как же перенести этот механизм в большой масштаб?

quote: Commissioner Lal says the scale of this ring is unprecedented.
after: He says four doctors, five nurses, twenty paramedics, three private hospitals, ten pathology clinics and five diagnostic centers were involved. "We suspect around 400 or 500 kidney transplants were done by these doctors over the last nine years," he said.

quote: The physician that examined you reported that 20% of your body is covered in scar tissue.
before: I don't need to show relevance, but since you asked, whatever happened to your client on that island turned him into a cold blooded killer. No!
after: The machine won't work unless you ask a question. Did that happen to you there?
ru: Врач который проверял тебя сказал, что 20% твоего тела покрыто шрамами.

quote: But if she dies for good, everyone with that scar on your chest does as well.
before: The Armory is a black hole of lies. As long as I have this scar, Rayna will hunt me.
after: I sacrificed everyone and everything for you. If there's even a fraction of you that cares about me, then you will not walk out that door.
ru: Но, если она умрёт, все те, у кого есть такой-же шрам на груди, также умрут.

quote: Nasty scar you got there on your neck.
before: Hey, young man, what's your name? Cruz.
after: Something you can tell us? Just what Sarge said.
ru: У вас на шее такой отвратительный шрам.

quote: Most common cause is a scar from your previous appendectomy.
before: You have something blocking your intestines. Something like what?
after: Or it could just be something you ate. We'll do some more studies, but often it'll resolve on its own.
ru: Чаще всего виноват шрам от перенесенной аппендоэктомии.

quote: She would trace her fingers along the numb keloid scars left by my top surgery.
before: It's this restrictive, binary thinking on gender that said that I didn't exist. But when we met, she loved me for exactly how I showed up.
after: Scars that run from the middle of my chest all the way out to my outer torso. She said that these were reminders of my strength and everything that I went through and nothing for me to be ashamed of.
ru: Она пробегала пальцами по старым шрамам, оставленным после моей операции.

quote: I'm crying on the inside. There are still scars.
before: I'm glad I'm past that. We're not going to go into that.
after: Anyway, but I guess my point is that all of these enterprises are engaging to me in their multiplicity, but as I've presented them to you today, they're actually solitary enterprises, and so pretty soon I want to commune with other people, and so I'm delighted that in fact I get to compose works for them. I get to write, sometimes for soloists and I get to work with one person, sometimes full orchestras, and I work with a lot of people, and this is probably the capacity, the role creatively for which I'm probably best known professionally.
ru: Я плачу внутри себя, и шрамы ещё не зажили.

quote: You can see their scars. You trust them.
before: It burnt my hand, whatever. " You believe them.
after: But whether it's victims, whether it's governments, NGOs, or even the Queen yesterday, in Northern Ireland, we have to interact and engage with those different layers of terrorism, and, in effect, we do have to have a little dance with the devil. This is my favorite part of my speech.
ru: Мы увидим их шрамы. И мы поверим им.

quote: And so those scars were still like, really fresh.
before: "I was in an extremely competitive [singing musical theatre] program in high school. I had started working at Funimation when I was 19, so I was just barely in college.
after: I had a lot of competition and people would find what your perceived weakness was, or what your actual weakness was in the program, and they would take advantage of it. And so I had people trying to make me feel like I couldn't sing my way out of a paper bag, and then I would get so nervous when I would sing that I couldn't support my notes, and so it would just prove them right."

quote: I really think this is a little too scary for Frank to be watching.
before: There's a scene coming up that might make you change your mind. Stosh?
after: You touch my sister again, I'll kill you. Oh, my God!
ru: Мне кажется, этот фильм слишком страшный для Фрэнка.

quote: It's scary to think it could have been someone in the school.
before: I had to clear that up. There's something I haven't really said out there to the other kids, but... no one knows where the girls purchased the drugs that they got for sure.
after: But the truth is, Rob, we all kind of gave the girls those drugs that day. Do you see, it's not just one person's fault, Rob. It's everyone's. In a way, it's mine.
ru: Страшно подумать, что они могли купить их у кого-то в школе.

quote: It's going to be a little scary, not being able to rely on the Omega Chis.
before: Now you're up by three. It just means you're making progress.
after: Ash, you're my president. And my best friend.
ru: Это немного страшно, не иметь возможности полагаться на Омега Кай.

quote: It would almost be scary If it wasn't wearing plaid. um, wait, wait.
before: Does this feel like a sitcom to anybody else? It feels like a reality show. good. so i can vote you off.
after: You guys didn't start without me, did you? hey.
ru: Было бы почти страшно, если бы они не носили шотландки.

quote: It is scary, and we hate it, and it needs to be done.
before: Your closet may be telling someone you love her for the first time, or telling someone that you're pregnant, or telling someone you have cancer, or any of the other hard conversations we have throughout our lives. All a closet is is a hard conversation, and although our topics may vary tremendously, the experience of being in and coming out of the closet is universal.
after: Several years ago, I was working at the South Side Walnut Cafe, a local diner in town, and during my time there I would go through phases of militant lesbian intensity: not shaving my armpits, quoting Ani DiFranco lyrics as gospel. And depending on the bagginess of my cargo shorts and how recently I had shaved my head, the question would often be sprung on me, usually by a little kid: " Um, are you a boy or are you a girl? "
ru: страшно, неприятно, но это необходимо сделать.

quote: Oh, wait a minute, actually it sounds really scary.
before: So, sounds great, right? Injecting semisynthetic organisms into people, dumping millions and millions of gallons of our bacteria into the ocean or out on your favorite beach?
after: This dinosaur is really scary. But here's the catch: our semisynthetic organisms in order to survive, need to be fed the chemical precursors of X and Y.
ru: Подождите-ка, на самом деле звучит страшновато.

quote: Yes, it was scary, but it was also fantastic.
before: And it's safe to say it wasn't glamorous. (Laughter) I took my breath in the wrong part of the wave, choked on river water and was unable to steer myself.
after: Waterfalls, slick canyons and a couple billion years of bedrock that seemed to change color throughout the day. The Grand Canyon is true wilderness and worthy of all of its accolades.
ru: Да, было страшно, и в то же время потрясающе.

quote: The cast of ghouls includes a human doll, several creepy clowns and other scary attractions.
after: Elaborate lighting and sound effects also heighten the sensory experience.

quote: Then I'll give you more time for the schedule.
before: You made this situation and this schedule, you punk! Fine.
after: I'm not doing it. I quit everything.
ru: Делай с этим графиком что хочешь.

quote: Yes, I'm afraid the bishop's schedule is rather tight.
before: Bishop Norman will present Mr. Thompson with the award. I'm noticing a private audience with the bishop has not been scheduled as I'd requested.
after: I see. Though, as you mentioned, it's a great honor for Mr. Thompson to receive the award for his selfless generosity to the diocese.
ru: Да, я боюсь расписание епископа сильно сжато.

quote: We would love to see the schedule so that we can plan accordingly.
before: We stick to the schedule. We completely understand.
after: It stays inside the diplomatic pouch. No one outside our team has access to it.
ru: Мы бы хотели взглянуть на ваш график, чтобы согласовать его с нашими планами.

quote: I thought you wouldn't be here, which is what it said on your schedule.
before: I was, uh, just leaving you a note about the, uh, "Observer" article. Oh. Great.
after: Right. Um, my meeting ended early.
ru: Я думала, тебя здесь не будет, так было в твоем расписании.

quote: Or should they both change their practices so they can have much more flexible schedules?
before: So how are they going to divide up breadwinning and caregiving responsibilities? Should one of them stop working or reduce hours to be home?
after: And what criteria should they use to make that decision? Is it who makes the most money or who is most committed to her career?
ru: Или, может быть, им обеим следует поменять вид деятельности, чтобы иметь более гибкий рабочий график?

quote: And they said, "Ha. There won't be a single moment in the schedule."
before: We went to this prestigious little school and they say they're going to study math 10 times a week and science eight times a week and reading five times a day and all this stuff. And we said, " Well what about play and recess? "
after: (Laughter) And we said, " He's five. " What a crime.
ru: А они говорят: "Ха! Ни минуты на это в нашем расписании".

quote: Or even, "When do I have 15 minutes to go over my schedule?"
before: Like, " Where in my schedule can I fit the tasks that are troubling me? " Or, " What can I move in my schedule to make room for this more urgent thing? "
after: All those are problems that can be solved. " I have so much work to do " is not.
ru: Или даже: «Когда я могу выделить 15 минут, чтобы пересмотреть своё расписание?»

quote: The first stage burn proceeded nominally, and separation occurred on schedule.
after: As the first stage fell away from the second, it was observed to have impacted on the engine bell of the second stage. About five minutes into the flight, the second stage began to roll out of control.

quote: Then why did this shop's owner loan from Scholar Lee?
before: Not very many. He charged a high interest, so people tried to find loans elsewhere.
after: He had to. Nobody else would lend him anything. Scholar Lee was here yesterday. He threatened to confiscate the shop.
ru: Тогда почему же владелец этой лавки взял ссуду у ученого Ли?

quote: No disrespect meant, but Josephine is an all-state athlete and National Merit scholar.
before: And I know you two loved that Bobby guy, but he was a barely functional alcoholic. Watch it.
after: Aidan is so fast he could pick your pocket before you could even blink. And Krissy, oh she's just a natural-born leader and hunter.
ru: При всем уважении, но Джозефина потрясащая спортсменка и национально-заслуженная ученица

quote: I must know which "scholars" have taken such leave of their reason.
before: The only thing as irrational as faith in God is faith in Man. The printer who made these said his last prayer and cut his own throat open in front of me.
after: A printer? By what name?
ru: Мне необходимо знать последователи, каких учений поступают так из-за своих убеждений.

quote: A minor scholar, but very good at labyrinths.
before: You use Hickman? De Chepe.
after: It was meant to be impenetrable. How did you break it?
ru: Несовершеннолетний ученый, но очень хорош в лабиринтах.

quote: Scholars have tried to explain: Why is it blue?
before: Again, Hubble is there. Let's get into the butterfly's wings.
after: Let's zoom in on it. What you see is that the architecture of the invisible humiliates the best architects in the world.
ru: Учёные пытались объяснить, почему они голубые.

quote: These are some remarkable trees of knowledge, or trees of science, by Spanish scholar Ramon Llull.
before: And this is only mapping 10 percent of a mammalian neocortex. We can also see this shift in the way we try to conceive of human knowledge.
after: And Llull was actually the precursor, the very first one who created the metaphor of science as a tree, a metaphor we use every single day, when we say, " Biology is a branch of science, " when we say, " Genetics is a branch of science. " But perhaps the most beautiful of all trees of knowledge, at least for me, was created for the French encyclopedia by Diderot and d'Alembert in 1751.
ru: Здесь вы видите древа знаний и науки, созданные испанским учёным Раймундом Луллием.

quote: She accrued a massive library, and was visited by many prominent scholars.

ru: Помнишь полки, которые Майк помог установить?

quote: We do know it had lecture halls, classrooms, and, of course, shelves.
before: He died before construction began, but his successor, Ptolemy I, executed Alexander’ s plans for a museum and library. Located in the royal district of the city, the Library of Alexandria may have been built with grand Hellenistic columns, native Egyptian influences, or a unique blend of the two — there are no surviving accounts of its architecture.
after: As soon as the building was complete, Ptolemy I began to fill it with primarily Greek and Egyptian scrolls. He invited scholars to live and study in Alexandria at his expense.
ru: Доподлинно известно, что там были аудитории, классы и, разумеется, полки.

quote: But modern industrial fishing, the kind that stocks our grocery shelves, looks more like warfare.
before: How did this happen? When some people think of fishing, they imagine relaxing in a boat and patiently reeling in the day's catch.
after: In fact, the technologies they employ were developed for war. Radar, sonar, helicopters, and spotter planes are all used to guide factory ships towards dwindling schools of fish.
ru: Но современный отлов рыбы, которая попадает на полки наших магазинов, больше походит на военные действия.

quote: Let's just break this shelf. Okay, that shelf broke.
before: More boring, but you still have that kind of colliding and bumping. And you can still do fun things like make shelves on your desktop.
after: I think beyond the icons, I think another really cool domain for this software — I think it applies to more than just icons and your desktop — but browsing photographs. I think you can really enrich the way we browse our photographs and bring it to that kind of shoebox of, you know, photos with your family on the kitchen table kind of thing.
ru: Давайте сломаем эту полку. Вот, полка сломалась.

quote: Also recently, a Canadian Arctic ice shelf broke away from Ellesmere Island.
before: Recently, the United States Department of Interior announced that they may add the polar bears to the list of threatened species.
after: Both issues are said to have been caused by global warming.

quote: Fidel, the forensic report on the oyster shell and the shot glass, if you would.
before: We took a wrong turn and never got back on track. By focusing on the gargle bottles, we looked away from what was really important.
after: Yeah, of course. Fingerprints.
ru: Фидель, будьте добры, отчёт криминалистов по устричной раковине и по стеклянной рюмке.

quote: The impossible challenge involved stringing a thread through a conch shell.
before: What would you like us to work on first, Uncle? Uncle?
after: The conch, as I'm certain you're well aware, is a veritable labyrinth of tiny twisting passageways. Completely impregnable I hear you say.
ru: Невыполнимым заданием было пропустить нить сквозь спиральную раковину.

quote: She needs to come out of her shell.
before: You should play hockey. She needs encouraging.
after: Janet, no! Come on.
ru: Ей надо вылезти из своей раковины.

quote: We used to love collecting shells as kids.
before: She left her phone here. These look like notes for her thesis.
after: We used to go to the beach after school. And then she moved to England?
ru: В детстве мы обожали собирать раковины.

quote: I brought along with me an abalone shell.
before: I thought I'd talk a little bit about how nature makes materials.
after: This abalone shell is a biocomposite material that's 98 percent by mass calcium carbonate and two percent by mass protein. Yet, it's 3,000 times tougher than its geological counterpart.
ru: Я принесла с собой раковину морского ушка.

quote: Plants and organisms that make shells, coral, think of it as a building block.
before: CO2 as a building block. Organisms don't think of CO2 as a poison.
after: There is now a cement manufacturing company starting in the United States called Calera. They've borrowed the recipe from the coral reef, and they're using CO2 as a building block in cement, in concrete.
ru: Растения и организмы, у которых есть раковина или панцирь, как кораллы, например, рассматривают его как стройматериал.

quote: You have fragments of other shells. You have olivine.
before: You have microshells there. You have things like coral.
after: You have bits of a volcano. There's a little bit of a volcano there.
ru: и осколки других раковин, и кристаллы хризолита,

quote: They say the busy Bakara market was also struck hard by mortar shells.
before: The witnesses said that insurgents shot mortars at the airport and airplane and African Union peacekeepers returned fire.
after: Witnesses saw the dead bodies of at least six civilians there. The president was not hurt in the attack.

quote: And then one day, A kindly old woman at the shelter gave me a tennis ball.
before: Displasia. No I didn't get that bad, but I was on death row.
after: That tennis ball. I could chew, without shame, and suddenly, I was lovable.
ru: И однажды, добрая старушка в приюте дала мне теннисный мячик.

quote: He'd look like maybe he'd go from shelter to shelter or something.
before: He was just... Um... I didn't know if he had a home, you know?
after: (Coffey) Detroit in the '70s was a hard place. Well, it's still a hard place.
ru: Он выглядел, как будто перебивается от приюта к приюту, типа того.

quote: How about fighting off perverts at a homeless shelter?
before: Yeah, and I could have used her help for the first 18 years of my life. You ever pee in the back of a minivan, take a bath in the sink at a diner?
after: That sounds horrible. I'm, uh... I'm sorry.
ru: Отбиваться от извращенцев в приюте для бездомных?

quote: He's headed to an animal shelter in Barstow.
before: So is treason. Are you guys really gonna send him to a black site?
after: When they hear the dogs barking after a few hours in the car, with a bag over their head, you'd be amazed how willing they are to talk. Yeah, but like he said, you know, desperate people are willing to do whatever you want 'em to.
ru: Его отправят в приют для животных в Барстоу.

quote: Only, we don't know that it's a homeless shelter.
before: I am six years old, and I don't cry when we leave home and we come to America, because I expect it to be a place filled with rare and wonderful things like bananas and chocolate and Bazooka bubble gum, Bazooka bubble gum with the little cartoon wrappers inside, Bazooka that we'd get once a year in Ukraine and we'd have to chew one piece for an entire week. So the first day we get to New York, my grandmother and I find a penny in the floor of the homeless shelter that my family's staying in.
after: We think that it's a hotel, a hotel with lots of rats. So we find this penny kind of fossilized in the floor, and we think that a very wealthy man must have left it there because regular people don't just lose money.
ru: Правда, мы не знаем, что это приют для бездомных.

quote: But I was so surprised to see the shelter, refugee camp organized by the U.N.
before: Two tribes, Hutu and Tutsi, fought each other. Over two million people became refugees.
after: They're so poor, and they are freezing with blankets during the rainy season, In the shelters built by the U.N., they were just providing a plastic sheet, and the refugees had to cut the trees, and just like this. But over two million people cut trees.
ru: Я был неприятно удивлён, увидев приют, лагерь беженцев, организованный ООН.

quote: We're trampling on this wonderful cosmos that shelters us and houses us.
before: And let's make it look down here, rather than to the far reaches of the universe. The universe is wonderful, but we have a practical reality, which is we live in an unknown cosmos, and we're ignorant about it.
after: Talk to any astrophysicist. The Earth is a statistical improbability.
ru: Мы пренебрегаем этим прекрасным миром, который приютил нас.

quote: Brussels is to grant 50 thousand euros as subsidies for the shelter.
before: First-ever Belgian refugee shelter "Refuge" for the victims of violence against the lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender (LGBT) community was announced this Friday by the initiators, one day prior to Brussels' LGBT Pride rally. The refugee shelter is to open in the Belgian capital Brussels in July.

quote: Tom and I will take on extra shifts at the cafe to cover the rent.
before: - Thank you, Tom. As you can see, Alex has the lion's share of the domestic tasks.
after: Why are you looking at each other like that? The cafe.
ru: А у нас с Томом дополнительные смены в кафе, чтобы оплачивать аренду.

quote: They, uh, meet in the mornings before the guards start their shifts.
before: Abbott's been having meetings on the roof. Seems him and Drexel have an even earlier exit plan scheduled for you.
after: Everyone knows to stay clear. Drexel's alone up there right now.
ru: Они, э-э, встречались утром... перед сменой охранников.

quote: The early shift was displeased that the supply closet is now padlocked.
before: She's not generally lacking for male companionship. I think we had a moment.
after: They'll get over it. This is where we're curing zombie-ism.
ru: Первая смена была недовольна, что подсобка теперь под замком.

quote: This could be our way back onto the day shift.
before: This is our chance. If C.J. can't find that evidence, he could be fired.
after: ♪ Come on and party tonight ♪ Wow! It's actually - a really catchy song.
ru: И мы сможем вернуться на дневную смену.

quote: But since then, a paradigm shift has taken place in the field of artificial intelligence.
before: You build up these expert systems, and they were kind of useful for some purposes, but they were very brittle, you couldn't scale them. Basically, you got out only what you put in.
after: Today, the action is really around machine learning. So rather than handcrafting knowledge representations and features, we create algorithms that learn, often from raw perceptual data.
ru: Но с тех пор в области искусственного интеллекта произошла смена парадигмы.

quote: We've seen perceptual shifts in the Mormon community that allow for talk of gender inequality.
before: Women are now allowed to pray in our church-wide meetings, and they never were before in the general conferences. As of last week, in a historic move, three women were invited down to three leadership boards that oversee the entire church.
after: We've opened up space, regardless of being despised, for more conservative women to step in and make real changes, and the words " women " and " the priesthood " can now be uttered in the same sentence. I never had that.
ru: Мы наблюдаем заметные сдвиги в общине мормонов, которые позволяют говорить о неравенстве полов.

quote: A momentous shift from rainy season to dry season is underway.
before: Lord Sun dawns on the day called 7-Monkey, his fingers slowly spreading a rosy sheen that mixes softly with smoke rising from Tenochtitlan’ s many hearth fires. The midwife, Xoquauhtli, has a difficult choice to make.
after: All summer, the gods have kept the people fed with corn, but the fertile summer months are disappearing. This day occurs during the festival that marks the shift between the summer season, when the gods feed the people, and the winter season, when the people feed the gods in return.
ru: Происходит важная смена сезонов — сезон дождей сменяется засухой.

quote: Earlier in the week, President Obama announced a major shift in U.S. nuclear policy.
after: He said for the first time that preventing nuclear proliferation and nuclear terrorism is at the top of the U.S. nuclear agenda. The threat of destruction by Russian warheads is now considered a secondary menace.

quote: I only took this refereeing job 'cause I was cold and needed a shirt!
before: What a rip! Shut your gobs!
after: I hate you fifth graders! I deem this victory Pyrrhic!
ru: Я взялся за работу судьи только потому, что мне было холодно и мне нужна была рубашка!

quote: Hey, did he tell you I saved the silk shirt?
before: Way to go, Priya. For once, he doesn't look like a mannequin in the boys' department.
after: No, he did not. He was gonna throw it in the washing machine with his Spiderman underwear.
ru: А он рассказывал тебе, что это я спасла шёлковую рубашку?

quote: I don't want to get schmutz on my shirt.
before: So, how may I thank you? Would you like some ice cream or ... Ooh! ... a cookie?
after: Can Warren just come over if he's not busy? Of course your brother can come over.
ru: Не хочу испачкать крошками свою рубашку.

quote: There wasn't much to choose from, so I just got you one of my shirts.
before: Hey, buddy. Just so you know, not nice to throw up on your mom.
after: Thanks. You know, you should really buy some clothes.
ru: Там не из чего было выбирать, поэтому принес тебе свою рубашку.

quote: It can image features as small as the button on a pedestrian’s shirt across the street.
before: That’ s a limited way of seeing, though, because the large beam-size can’ t visualize fine details. In contrast, a self-driving car’ s LIDAR system, which stands for Light Detection and Ranging, uses a narrow invisible infrared laser.
after: But how do we determine the shape, or depth, of these features? LIDAR fires a train of super-short laser pulses to give depth resolution.
ru: Он может различать такие мелкие детали, как пуговица на рубашке пешехода на другой стороне улицы.

quote: Put it on your shirt, it ruins the shirt.
before: It's made of paper. And paper, of course, wicks fluid, as you know, paper, cloth — drop wine on the tablecloth, and the wine wicks all over everything.
after: That's what a hydrophilic surface does. So in this device, the idea is that you drip the bottom end of it in a drop of, in this case, urine.
ru: Попади оно на рубашку — рубашка испорчена.

quote: So in preparation for this talk, I made myself a shirt.
before: And I realized that what I'd really like is that I can look at you as much as you're looking at me — just to even things out a little bit. So if I had way more eyeballs, then we'd all be really comfortable, right?
after: (Rattling) (Laughter) It's googly eyes. It took me 14 hours and 227 googly eyes to make this shirt.
ru: Поэтому готовясь к этому выступлению, я смастерила себе рубашку.
