Just minutes after this picture was taken the army moved in; 13 April 2009 File:8Rodeshirtsschietenterugengooienmolotovcocktails.jpg|Storming of the Din Daeng/Pracha Songkhro intersection by the Thai military; 13 April 2009 File:4Dindaengflatbewonersvallenderodenaan.jpg|After the liquid gas truck which the red shirts had threatened to blow up in the midst of the Din Daeng flats was removed the inhabitants of the flats swarmed on the street to attack the red shirts

quote: Sitting in front of your dress shop, watching the parade.
before: It's funny how things pan out. I've always known the kind of woman you really are.
after: Those little-girl-lost eyes. This beautiful, almost translucent skin.
ru: Ты сидела у входа в магазин одежды, смотрела парад.

quote: Why did you take her to the butcher shop?
before: Take her. She was so scared.
after: Because she cry. She keep crying.
ru: Зачем вы повезли её в мясной магазин?

quote: What if the cupcake shop is actually a mob front?
before: Wait a minute. Secret trips to Staten Island, all that cash...
after: Jimmy Whelan the baker is actually Jimmy Whelan the money launderer. Bobby S could've had a falling out with him, could've whacked him.
ru: Что если кондитерский магазин просто прикрытие?

quote: Bloke in Scarborough hung himself in his sporting goods shop.
before: 'l read it in The Daily Express.' 90% of small businesses go down the tubes, apparently, in the first year. I should stop you reading that paper.
after: Yeah, but people don't need sporting goods. They're always going to get old, aren't they?
ru: В Скарборо один повесился прямо в своем магазине спорттоваров.

quote: So I would thank the trucker who drove the coffee beans to the coffee shop.
before: It took me around the world. Because I discovered that my coffee would not be possible without hundreds of people I take for granted.
after: But he couldn't have done his job without the road. So I would thank the people who paved the road.
ru: Таким образом, я поблагодарил водителя, который отвозил кофейные бобы в магазин.

quote: Community was all about small, local shops and local services and walking, interacting with your neighbors.
before: The history, of course, of Chinese cities is robust. It's like any other place.
after: It may sound utopian, but it's not. It's actually what people really want.
ru: Жизнь сообщества раньше вращалась вокруг местных магазинчиков и служб, вокруг прогулок, на которых общались соседи.

quote: So, in the tidied-up version we have a sort of Keith Haring spare parts shop.
before: So, I mean, this picture has not even got a proper title. It's called " Untitled " and I think that's appropriate.
after: (Laughter) This is Keith Haring looked at statistically. One can see here quite clearly, you can see we have 25 pale green elements, of which one is in the form of a circle.
ru: Вот, в прибранной версии у нас получается что-то типа магазина запчастей Кита Харинга.

quote: Entertainment venues, theaters, and movie cinemas closed shop at sundown Wednesday.
after: Television stations and radio programming focused on memorial of the Holocaust. Memorial events end at sunset on Thursday, and will be followed one week later by the 60th anniversary of the declaration of independence of Israel in 1948, known as Yom Ha'atzmaut.

quote: I didn't think such beauty still exists. Not from beyond the shores of Costa Gravas, huh?
before: I'm going in. You're a doctor?
after: Well, it's nice to meet you. How do you know Devon exactly?
ru: Не знал, что такая красота ещё существует за пределами берегов Коста-Гравы, а?

quote: This lot go out there, dive, pick it up, bring it back on shore.
before: I think they were collecting the post. Ships go past from South America, crew dump the drugs overboard.
after: Dad! Dad!
ru: А эти приплывают туда, ныряют, поднимают и возвращаются на берег.

quote: We left these shores four months ago as members of the United States Navy.
before: We have no contact with home, and I have good reason to believe that the American government is no longer functioning. The country we all hoped we were coming back to no longer exists.
after: But now we are more than that. Now our duty is to the entire world.
ru: Мы покинули берег 4 месяца назад, как военнослужащие ВМФ США.

quote: We're gonna wash you up on a shore in Syria, outside of Tartus.
before: Your brothers and mine. You will act as a liberator.
after: Your bruises and the damage to your body will tell most of the story. You can invent the rest.
ru: Мы выбросим вас на берег Сирии, за пределами Тартуса.

quote: This forms the waves’ characteristic curls, or jets, as they break along the shore.
before: Above you is the wave’ s crest, where the water particles are undergoing their greatest acceleration. That forces them to move faster than the underlying wave, so they shoot ahead before falling under gravity’ s influence.
after: Sometimes, the curl might completely enclose part of the wave, forming a moving tube of water known as the barrel. Because of irregularities in the seafloor and the swell itself, few barrels last as long as the legendary 27-second ride off the coast of Namibia.
ru: Так формируются характерные для волн завитки, которые потом разбиваются о берег.

quote: In fact, they saw these people who landed at their shores as alien.
before: Let's go back to the mid-1800s, when the Chinese first came to America. Back then, Americans were not clamoring to eat Chinese food.
after: These people weren't eating dogs, they were eating cats. If they weren't eating cats, they were eating rats.
ru: На самом деле, народ, который приплыл к их берегам, казался им чуждым.

quote: You go in along the shore, you can find it everywhere.
before: And one of the really most incredible things, I think, is that there's nobody out there trying to collect it at the site where it is densest. Parts of the ocean there look just absolutely apocalyptic.
after: It's really messy. If you go to the places where it's just arriving, like the eastern part of the Gulf, in Alabama, there's still people using the beach while there are people cleaning up the beach.
ru: Идя вдоль берега, это можно увидеть везде.

quote: Services on the North Shore Line were cancelled, leaving commuters stranded in the city.
before: Sydney's transport systems fell into chaos on Friday after gale force winds caused damage to an overhead train line on the Sydney Harbour Bridge.

quote: Keep your responses short and to the point.
before: Your case is a two-demerit issue, and so we're gonna keep it friendly. And the more aggressive you come across, the more guilty you'll look.
after: - All right, cool. So you're saying
ru: Давай короткие ответы, только по делу.

quote: Even short jumps can knock you around a bit.
before: Yes, the thought has crossed my mind. Time travel can be disorienting.
after: Don't ever exceed the jump limit. It can be problematic.
ru: Даже короткие прыжки могут тебя немного оглушить.

quote: So I need to do something about it, because life is short.
before: And it just made me realize that life is short, and I don't want to just spend another night, you know, chitchatting about stupid stuff and eating store-bought tiramisu. - Again, we both buy... - Because the truth is, Francine, we've worked together for over a year now, and there's a thing here.
after: You only go around once. So what do you say, hmm?
ru: Так что мне нужно что-то с этим делать, потому что жизнь коротка.

quote: Yeah, according to my GPS, that's just a short 47-mile walk.
before: Hopefully to the next town. We can catch a bus from there.
after: Can you look up some good news on that thing, please? What about that?
ru: Согласно моему GPS, это короткая прогулка в 100 километров.

quote: Today, I want to tell you two short stories from our work.
before: And that often requires new technologies and ideas. And that is the mission that animates the scientists in my lab.
after: One fundamental obstacle we face in trying to turn the brain into a big-data problem is that our brains are composed of and built from billions of cells. And our cells are not generalists; they're specialists.
ru: Сегодня я расскажу вам две короткие истории из моей работы.

quote: Highly addictive -- the high was very short.
before: And it turned out there was this audience that didn't know it wanted crack cocaine, but when it came, it really did. And it was a perfect drug; you could buy the cocaine that went into it for a dollar, sell it for five dollars.
after: So for fifteen minutes, you get this great high, and then when you come down, all you want to do is get high again. It created a wonderful market.
ru: Очень быстрое привыкание — кайф очень короткий.

quote: Well, there are many reasons, and you heard some of them in the short talk today.
before: Why am I trying to sell you a half-built bridge? Am I that charming?
after: This understanding of chemistry actually can help us with our daily lives. But there is something more profound here, something deeper.
ru: Существует много причин, и вы слышали некоторые из них сегодня в короткой речи.

quote: The warnings were lifted a short time later.
before: According to the USGS numerous earthquakes ranging from magnitudes 5.1 to 6.1 have been reported off the western coast of Japan, prompting tsunami warnings to be issued.

quote: All over the country people are reporting a shortage of stuffing.
before: This doesn't make sense! It gets worse.
after: We don't think it's coincidence. You're telling me that somehow during a stuffing shortage, this pilgrim dropped down from space and got into a truck driven by Natalie Portman? !
ru: Со всей страны поступают сообщения о дефиците начинки для фаршировки

quote: Yeah, this town caters to tourists, so there's no shortage of lodging.
before: Almost none. They'd want a place to retreat to. All right, well, what if she offered them something other than or in addition to sex, like another hotel room?
after: So we may be looking for a woman who owns or works at a hotel. No I.D. on her yet.
ru: Это город для туристов, так что нехватки жилья нет.

quote: Shortages grounded airlines and it was too expensive for most to drive.
before: The high seas weren't safe anymore. Cargo no longer reached its destination.
after: Regulations strangled the production of coal, gas, oil and nuclear power. Power outages were frequent because no copper was available... to maintain the transmission lines.
ru: Дефицит приковал к земле самолеты, а водить автомобиль стало слишком дорого.

quote: The gulanite shortage has apparently forced the town to pull the plug on the stasis net.
before: Datak, Stahma. Exciting news from my spies outside of Defiance.
after: Cause for celebration, no? You'll overrun them easily.
ru: Нехватка гуланита, очевидно, заставила город отключить стат-сети.

quote: We are striving to create that world, a world without organ shortage.
before: Imagine a world where people with diabetes do not have to rely on insulin after every meal because we can provide them with good pancreatic cells that can produce insulin on their own. And imagine a world where patients with kidney failure do not have to face the burden of dialysis.
after: We finally have the tool to tackle the problem we could never tackle before, and Laika is just the beginning of our journey. We have to be very humble in front of nature, because there are more issues to be addressed, including immunology and things we couldn't even anticipate at this point.
ru: Мы жаждем создать такой мир, мир, где не существует проблемы нехватки трансплантатов.

quote: Even worse, we have a severe shortage of psychiatrists in Africa.
before: Globally, 75 percent of all mental illness cases can be found in low-income countries. Yet most African governments invest less than one percent of their health care budget in mental health.
after: Nigeria, for example, is estimated to have 200 — in a country of almost 200 million. In all of Africa, 90 percent of our people lack access to treatment.
ru: Что ещё хуже, в Африке у нас страшная нехватка психиатров.

quote: But we have a major shortage of organs.
before: Yet we're still dealing with a lot of the same challenges as many decades ago. Certainly many advances, many lives saved.
after: In the last decade the number of patients waiting for a transplant has doubled. While, at the same time, the actual number of transplants has remained almost entirely flat.
ru: Но мы испытываем огромный дефицит органов.

quote: WHO have previously warned that such travel restrictions increased the chance of food shortages.
before: The African Union also warned of the economic impact of the outbreak, urging a lifting of travel bans and border closures.
after: An agreement made yesterday is expected to lead to those restrictions imposed in the last few months being lifted.

quote: Get a shot of Tony with the guns.
before: You're as nervous as a cat when Johnny Kick-A-Cat walks into the room. Verlaat de vuurwapens op het dok En wij kunnen een Chimay bier drinken!
after: Um, eh... Closer.
ru: Сделаем снимок Тони на фоне пушек.

quote: I'd say your shot came from over there.
before: Not as fast as he used to. Okay, so assuming our guy was coming this way across the plaza-- he's about 5'7"-- the bullet enters from this angle at about 120 degrees.
after: Fourth floor, third window from the right. It was open before the shooting, now it's closed.
ru: Я бы сказала, выстрел произведен оттуда.

quote: A well-aimed shot from a weapon sounds like nothing else.
before: Me too. They say that you can tell most of the time by the sound.
after: It's like... Home-run ball coming off the bat. Boy, did I mess up in Kabul.
ru: Прицельный выстрел из оружия не похож ни на что.

quote: I'm talking about a shot across the bow.
before: You know what I'm talking about. I know you do. What if the smartest thing we could do right now would be to give them a show of force?
after: I wanna hear what you think. Caller number one, you're on the air.
ru: Я имею в виду предупредительный выстрел.

quote: Now you can also see a little bit how we did some of these shots.
before: I said, " It would have to show up free. " And so it showed up, we used it a little while, we cut it in half.
after: We would glue a piece of Pyrex or heat-resistant glass in front. We used a red, very high-temperature silicon to do that.
ru: Вот, здесь видно, как мы делали некоторые из этих снимков.

quote: And People magazine, I thought, got probably the best shot.
before: (Laughter) Having done a lot of magazines, I'm very curious how big magazines handle big stories, and I was very curious to see how Time and Newsweek would handle 9 / 11. And I was basically pretty disappointed to see that they had chosen to show the photo we'd already seen a million times, which was basically the moment of impact.
after: It's kind of horsey type, but the texture — the second plane not quite hitting: there was something more enticing, if that's the right — it's not the right word — but in this cover than Time or Newsweek. But when I got into this magazine, there's something kind of disturbing, and this continued.
ru: Журнал «People», я думал, получил, вероятно, лучший снимок.

quote: The West defeated the mighty Soviet Union without firing a shot.
before: The first event was the end of the Cold War. Yes, the end of the Cold War was a great victory.
after: Amazing. But you know, when you have a great victory like this, it also leads to arrogance and hubris.
ru: Запад победил могущественный Советский Союз без единого выстрела.

quote: During the 89th minute a shot was saved by Lehmann, the Arsenal goalkeeper.
before: At this point many reporters on the match said that Arsenal were unlikely to win. The fourth goal was scored in the 74th minute of the match.

quote: He's got a good head on his shoulders, that new friend of yours.
before: You come back any time. Khalil, don't forget what I told you, right?
after: He's very free with his advice. What he wants me to tell you is, I got arrested today.
ru: У твоего нового друга достойная голова на плечах.

quote: Jeez, what'd you do to your shoulder, huh?
before: - It's okay. - Okay...
after: Oh, my God. Oh, my shoulder's killing me.
ru: Боже, что ты со своим плечом сделал?

quote: I dislocated my shoulder, and that ended that.
before: You like wrestling? Oh, yeah, uh... I used to compete.
after: Huh, so that could've been you. I guess.
ru: Потом повредил плечо, и все закончилось.

quote: Because I didn't want to spend the rest of my life looking over my shoulder.
before: Why, Majid? Why?
after: You reached out to Dar Adal? I bet on a horse.
ru: Потому что я не хочу провести остаток своих дней озираясь через плечо.

quote: And suddenly I felt a hand on my shoulder.
before: I kept my emotions on hold. But then, when I took the first bite, I broke down in tears.
after: And it was the healing, motherly touch of an untouchable woman. And she told me, " Kailash, why are you crying?
ru: Внезапно я почувствовал руку на своём плече.

quote: You're really rubbing shoulders with the world's last great nomadic people.
before: So, you can't leave your normal metal tools out because you'll get a first-degree burn if you grab them sometimes. So, you are finding yourself also in an amazing cultural milieu.
after: These are the Tuareg nomads, and they're living their lives much as they have for centuries. Your job is to excavate things like this in the foreground, and make them enter the pages of history.
ru: Вы находитесь плечом к плечу с последним кочевым народом.

quote: So when you squish your shoulders, they pull on a bicycle cable.
before: It's not a lot different than the one you see on my patient. They work by harnessing shoulder power.
after: And that bicycle cable can open or close a hand or a hook or bend an elbow. And we still use them commonly, because they're very robust and relatively simple devices.
ru: Когда вы напрягаете плечи, натягивается велосипедный кабель.

quote: Doctors advised him to recuperate as he rests his shoulder.
before: Tyler suffered a broken shoulder and injuries to the head as the band played in front of a crowd in South Dakota. He was airlifted to hospital after the fall, and later travelled to Boston to see his own doctor.

quote: Jones, when you're finished up in here, the showers need cleaning.
before: It's all part of the job, Jones. Okay.
after: No, they don't. Excuse me?
ru: Джонс, когда закончишь здесь, нужно будет вымыть душевые.

quote: I set up three cameras in Nell's bedroom, one in the shower.
before: I could've named my price. I don't suppose you have any way of verifying this?
after: Pull 'em. You'll see I was there most of the night.
ru: Я установил три камеры в спальне, одну в душе.

quote: Wait, are you telling me I could lose my shower?
before: Tell her to stay clear of Brian's class. Their husbands are silent partners in the gym, and also, in their marriages.
after: And your juice bar jobs. Oh, right, that whole thing too.
ru: Погоди, хочешь сказать, я могу душа лишиться?

quote: Do you mind if I use your shower when Luke goes down for his nap?
before: Maybe I could stop having a birthday. Or you could just tolerate the fact that it's a 24-hour period where the people who love you can treat you extra special.
after: Sure. Knock yourself out.
ru: Не возражаете, если я приму душ, когда Люк уснет?

quote: Put it in the shower, or in the closet, but not in the foyer.
before: This light up here is the same light that occurs in every middle-class foyer in America. Don't put it in the foyer.
after: Then, somebody gave me a bidet, so it got a bidet. (Laughter) This little house here, those branches there are made out of Bois d'arc or Osage orange.
ru: повесьте её лучше в душе или в гардеробной, но не в прихожей.

quote: You know, you're not supposed to take long, warm showers.
before: Sustainability. And we thought, sustainability has grown into being this sort of neo-Protestant idea that it has to hurt in order to do good.
after: You're not supposed to fly on holidays because it's bad for the environment. Gradually, you get this idea that sustainable life is less fun than normal life.
ru: Вам это знакомо: долго стоять под теплым душем – нельзя.

quote: I looked through the shower screen and saw her standing on the other side.
before: (Laughter) (Applause) " It can't be done " was shown to be wrong. I was taking a shower in a hotel room in Sydney the moment she died, 600 miles away, in Melbourne.
after: I knew she had come to say goodbye. My mother phoned minutes later.
ru: Я увидела её через стекло душевой кабины, стоящую напротив меня.

quote: The only opportunity to wash was in a sink, there was no shower.
before: The 27 page indictment says that Fritzl "had equipped it [the cellar] with a double bed, a wash basin, a toilet, a TV, a video recorder, an oven and plastic crockery. In the cellar there was no daylight or fresh air.
after: There was also no hot water or heating." The indictment also stated that Fritzl's actions were "premeditated."

quote: Listen, Penny is pretty sick and she's not going to be able to go to Switzerland.
before: 'Cause I'm gonna be dead. Hey, Sheldon?
after: So if you're still interested, you're welcome to come. Great.
ru: Послушай, Пенни очень больна и не сможет полететь в Швейцарию.

quote: We'll call in sick anytime you have a problem.
before: Thanks for your support, guys. It means a lot.
after: Lily coming! Lily coming!
ru: Мы можем взять больничный в любое время, если у тебя проблемы.

quote: Hundreds of villagers have been killed, hundreds more are sick and the company does nothing.
before: - But now the pipeline is leaking. - Leaking?
after: Our lawyers are no match for your wealthy attorneys. The American embassy looks away.
ru: Погибли сотни поселенцев, ещё сотни больны, а компания бездействует.

quote: Steven Mullan was a certain sick and twisted individual.
before: Is that the guy... Yeah.
after: One night... Darling!
ru: Стивен Маллан был больным и изворотливым типом.

quote: Their children were hungry and sick, but they didn't ask for food or medicine.
before: " Do people know? " The question surprised me.
after: They asked me, " Do people know what is happening to us? " I felt helpless as I wrote down their question.
ru: Их дети были голодны и больны, но они не попросили еды или лекарств.

quote: We're seeing sick kids get sicker and sicker.
before: And that if we don't do that, the antithesis, although we've heard otherwise, is we're really going to become extinct, because we're feeding our children to death. That's my premise.
after: And the reason this is happening, by and large, is because of our food system and the way the government commodifies food, the way the government oversees our food, the way the USDA puts food on kids' plates that's unhealthy, and allows unhealthy food into schools. And by — tacitly, all of us send our kids, or grandchildren, or nieces, or nephews, to school and tell them to learn, you know, learn what's in those schools.
ru: Мы видим что наши больные дети болеют все больше.

quote: They're sick, and so they're less able to defend themselves from the mosquitoes.
before: Well, we could protect very high-value targets like clinics. Clinics are full of people that have malaria.
after: You really want to protect them. Of course, if you do that, you could also protect your backyard.
ru: Они больны, и не могут хорошо защитить себя от москитов.

quote: Lee was rushed to Cantonal Hospital in Geneva when he felt sick on Saturday.
after: He became sick while he was at an official meeting. Doctors then determined that he had a blood clot in his brain and operated on Lee immediately.

quote: I don't want to be on the other side with unfinished business.
before: I died last night. I'm a ghost, and I want the same thing you want.
after: I want my parents to see my off to college, I want to decorate my dorm room with my best friends.
ru: Я н хочу быть на той стороне с незаконченными делами.

quote: You simply need to determine which side of history you want to end up on.
before: Oh, no. I'm the Rubicon.
after: Who are you, Mr. Jasper? A subordinate who remained slavishly obedient to his master, or the presumptive leader of an organization that will be far more powerful than it has ever been?
ru: А тебе лишь нужно определиться, на чьей стороне ты хочешь оказаться.

quote: He's got mainstream political ambitions and is keen to show a softer side.
before: How are you doing? Dmitry says he's changed since his days in the Slavic Union.
after: On the march that you got organised, I heard people chanting. "Russia for Russians" and "Keep Russia white", were you aware of that sort of chant happening?
ru: У него появились амбиции большого политика и он стремится показать себя с более мягкой стороны.

quote: I just want to get his side of it.
before: You are. Hero cop shoots Romeo in back.
after: You do not go near that kid. Oh, yeah?
ru: Я просто хочу занять его сторону.

quote: You know, one minute Holmes is on the other side from Lestrade.
before: It's one of the few times we see Holmes moved in the mysteries, and I find it very moving, this little scene, but it's also mysterious, right? It seems to treat jealousy as a problem of geometry, not emotion.
after: The next minute they're on the same side. Suddenly, Lestrade is letting himself admire this mind that he's resented.
ru: В какой-то момент Холмс и Лестрейд находятся по разные стороны баррикад,

quote: On one side you have institutions and people with money.
before: There are other sources of income for artists, however. There are private foundations, grants and patrons who give money, except a vast majority of artists don't know about these opportunities.
after: On the other side you have artists seeking funding, but the artists don't know about the people with the money, and the people with the money don't necessarily know about the artists out there. This is why I am very excited to share " Grantpa, " an online platform that uses technology to match artists with grants and funding opportunities in a way that is easy, fast and less intimidating.
ru: С одной стороны есть учреждения и люди с деньгами.

quote: It pulls much stronger on one side than the other and the cloud is stripped apart.
before: And what does the big black hole do? It strips that gas cloud apart.
after: In fact, we anticipated that star formation shouldn't proceed in that environment. So, you shouldn't see young stars.
ru: Она тянет с одной стороны гораздо сильнее, чем с другой, и облако разрывается на полосы.

quote: Fierce fighting has broken out and dozens of casualties are reported on both sides.
before: Pakistani officials say the military has launched its much anticipated ground offensive against the Taliban and al-Qaeda in the South Waziristan tribal region.

quote: They've been hiding among us in plain sight.
before: We need to figure out the full extent of their capabilities. It's not gonna be easy.
after: God only knows how far we've been infiltrated. Sorry.
ru: Они скрываются среди нас будучи на виду

quote: Well, look, we can stay out of sight and still be ready to back you up.
before: Puente thinks you're American tourists with a bad rental car. If he sees your faces again, he'll know we set him up.
after: Sam, you know this is the way they do things. Different teams have different jobs, for operational security.
ru: Ну, мы можем оставаться вне поля зрения и быть готовыми прикрыть тебя.

quote: If we let him out of our sight, you will never see him again.
before: You don't fall for this again! This is just more of his, eh, lies.
after: So come with me. He's the only one who knows where the alchemist's orb is.
ru: Если мы выпустим его из виду, то не увидим его уже никогда.

quote: Why, if you had your target in your sights, would you fire so wildly, hmm?
before: The murderer pursues the dead man to this outcropping; he tries to hide, it does him little good, and yet there are shotgun pellets on either side of his hiding place.
after: Maybe the killer was running? Have you ever tried to fire a shotgun while sprinting?
ru: Зачем, если твоя цель находится в поле зрения, так палить?

quote: You see, my clock only focuses on sight, and a little bit of touch.
before: Now in the middle of all this five senses work, I suddenly remembered the solar-powered clocks project from my youth. And I realized this theory also explains why Chris's clock is so much better than mine.
after: Here's Chris's clock. It's the first clock ever that uses smell to tell the time.
ru: Мои часы сосредоточены только на зрении и в меньшей степени на осязании.

quote: This truly is a scandal of epic proportions hidden in plain sight.
before: We secretly filmed some of the family of the former chief minister and a lawyer as they told our undercover investigator exactly how these dubious deals are done using such companies. And the awful thing is, there are so many other examples out there from all walks of life.
after: Whether it's the ruthless Mexican drugs cartel, the Zetas, who use anonymous companies to launder profits while their drugs-related violence is tearing communities apart across the Americas. Or the anonymous company, which bought up Americans' tax debts, piled on the legal fees and then gave homeowners a choice: Pay up or lose your home.
ru: Это воистину невероятных масштабов скандал, скрытый у всех на виду.

quote: All of these things and far more are linked in your brain to your sight.
before: Here's where it gets interesting. To create the experience of sight, your brain references your conceptual understanding of the world, other knowledge, your memories, opinions, emotions, mental attention.
after: These linkages work both ways, and usually occur subconsciously. So for example, what you see impacts how you feel, and the way you feel can literally change what you see.
ru: Все эти вещи и многие другие в мозге напрямую связаны со зрением.

quote: He said ferry services have improved "out of sight" over the past year.
before: Manager of Sydney Ferries, Geoff Smith defended the safety record of his services.

quote: Well, it's a good sign that she made it through the night.
before: Same old. I just wish I could make Tix better.
after: So I... I don't get where I am. I tried to do something stupid.
ru: Очень хороший знак, что она пережила эту ночь.

quote: But the sign say y'all close at 10:00.
before: Sure. Sorry, we're closed.
after: Look, I'm hungry. My boss, he's making me close up for the night.
ru: Но на табличке написано, вы закрываетесь в 10:00.

quote: Someone is out to get me, and all signs point to you.
before: You ought not to have come today. I look forward to seeing you.
after: You're the only one who knew it all. it has to be you. Six or seven days passed, and archer heard nothing from madam olenska.
ru: Кто-то пытается меня достать, и все знаки указывают на тебя.

quote: All Christian worship is drama, full of sign and symbol.
before: The way people communicate is not only through words, but through gestures, through the way, you know, the person is expressing himself through his body, or voice, tune or whatever. Now this is very different from how Western spirituality has developed, which was always through philosophy, so you always have theologians who are philosophers, but in the East, you always have theologians who are either poets, or maybe icon drawers or whatever.
after: But what Father Fady is claiming is that Eastern Christianity has made a priority of passing down gestures, which take you right back to the beginnings of the Church. When the priest lifts the communion bread for example, it symbolizes Jesus rising from the dead.
ru: Всё в христианском богослужении - драма, полная знаков и символов.

quote: As you can see, he's holding a sign, and his sign says he wants a job.
before: I get to be the mayor of a great American city, Albuquerque, New Mexico. I was at lunch on July 17, 2015, in my great American city, and on my way back to city hall, I saw this gentleman standing on a corner.
after: But if you look closer at the picture, you'll see he's standing underneath a blue sign, and that sign says, if you need help, if you need food or shelter or you'd like to donate, please call 311, our community service number. So why is this guy standing underneath my sign with his sign?
ru: Как вы можете заметить, он держит табличку, и эта табличка гласит, что ему нужна работа.

quote: There are Cornish language signs, ice-cream commercials, Wikipedia, and even memes.
before: From there, they organized weekly or monthly events where they could gather and speak in public. Today, some schools teach Cornish.
after: (Laughter) (Laughter) And with their language once again intact, the people of Cornwall have secured recognition as a Celtic nation alongside Ireland, Scotland and Wales. They stared down centuries of forced assimilation and said, " We're not a county in England.
ru: На корнском теперь есть знаки и вывески, реклама мороженого, Wikipedia и даже мемы.

quote: So, it's hard to create a new meaning for the existing sign.
before: That means that if there are five cars waiting, you have to wait till they all go, then you go. It lacks the notion of alternating, or taking turns, and it's always on the minor road, allowing the major one to have primacy.
after: You couldn't suddenly tell everyone, " OK, remember what you used to do at yield signs? Now do something different. "
ru: Тяжело создать новое значение существующему знаку.

quote: Is this a sign of things to come for the Vikeslandic Department of Aeronautics and Space?
before: Will Vikesland's flag be displayed in outer space again in the near future?

quote: But for whatever reason, Ray's signature isn't on any of the documents.
before: Utility bills are in Alice's name. You know, maybe she was the one with all the dough.
after: I was thinking we should get in touch with that FBI handwriting analyst down in Denver. Nah, not worth the hassle of involving the FBI just yet.
ru: Но по какой-то причине подписи Рэя нет ни на одном документе.

quote: I used a forensic laser on the incident report to bring up the missing signature.
before: He went in, got blood on himself trying to revive him. Charlie, what do you got?
after: The first name is definitely "George" but the last name did not start with "P," as we originally thought.
ru: Я использовал криминалистический лазер на донесении об инциденте, чтобы восстановить утраченную подпись.

quote: All I need is both your signatures where it says tenant.
before: Well, great. Let's set you up here.
after: Um, there's a problem. Oh right, I'm-I'm sorry, my mistake,
ru: Мне нужно, чтобы вы оба подписали там, где написано "арендатор".

quote: For someone so practised at forging signatures, it wouldn't be difficult to forge Esther's handwriting.
before: Can you do them beforehand? Tell the guests I'm not well.
after: I'm sure it would've been easy enough to lay your hands on a copy of Esther's signature. And then, all you had to do was slip the faked suicide note into her handbag -- after you'd killed her.
ru: Для столь опытного в подделывания подписей человека было бы несложно подделать почерк Эстер.

quote: I started working on my mother's signature, because my father's is absolutely impossible to forge.
before: I was in high school and got a bad grade, a rare event for me, so I decided to hide it from my parents. In order to do that, I set out to forge their signature.
after: So, I got working. I took some sheets of paper and started practicing, practicing, practicing, until I reached what I thought was a steady hand, and went into action.
ru: Я начала работать над подписью мамы, потому что подпись отца подделать абсолютно невозможно.

quote: She uses her thumbprints instead of a signature to keep a record of her earnings.
before: I went through that book, and what caught my eyes were her thumbprints on each page. My mother has never been to school.
after: On that day, for some reason, I wanted to teach her how to hold a pen and write her name. She was reluctant at first.
ru: Она использовала отпечаток пальца вместо подписи под записями о доходах.

quote: We broadcast a chemical signature of our emotions.
before: And we can see it in our breath. Suspense, fear, joy all show up as reproducible, visually identifiable moments.
after: It is the end of the poker face. Our spaces, our technology will know what we're feeling.
ru: Мы передаём химическую подпись наших эмоций.

quote: Grimsley and Rydze were reported to be customers of Signature Pharmacy.
before: P. David Soares, Albany County prosecutor, indicated in filings from his office that Signature is believed to be a "producer" of anabolic steroids.
after: Holyfield, Matthews, and Canseco were allegedly on customer lists from Applied Pharmacy Services in Mobile, Alabama. Both pharmacies and their owners are implicated in the steroid ring.

quote: It's a list of names, numbers and it must have some significance.
before: - Lt's the last page I was curious about. - As was I.
after: All local phone numbers. The first belonged to a woman, Margot whose mother was Magda, who denied knowing Harriet.
ru: Это список имён, числа, которые должны иметь какое-то значение.

quote: I'm attempting to crack into a secure cache of orbital dominant images with high global significance.
before: Once you've settled into which site you want to hack into, start launching your XRF programs. What's your target, son?
after: You're hacking into celebrity surgical records. - Yes I am.
ru: Я пытаюсь взломать секретное хранилище самых важных фотографий с орбиты, имеющих глобальное значение.

quote: I know what it means, obviously. What I don't understand is its significance.
before: I don't know what that means. Well, it's...
after: Bookbinding. How could a book cut through the muscle tissue and sever a major artery?
ru: Я знаю, что это такое, просто не понимаю важности этого открытия.

quote: This is an event of some significance, Miss Price.
before: You've never lifted a hoof to dance in your life. Until this evening, I'd not had the honour of being acquainted with Miss Price.
after: Quite unprecedented. He regards forms of sudden locomotion as emblematic of ill breeding.
ru: Это событие большой важности, мисс Прайс.

quote: They were just there, but they had no significance.
before: Some of it is controlled, like music or theater, but most of it is chaotic and incoherent, which some of us refer to as noise. There was a time when I considered wild soundscapes to be a worthless artifact.
after: Well, I was wrong. What I learned from these encounters was that careful listening gives us incredibly valuable tools by which to evaluate the health of a habitat across the entire spectrum of life.
ru: Она существовала, но не имела никакого значения.

quote: How would you characterize the historical significance of what's happened?
before: (Applause) Chris Anderson: I just have a couple of questions for you. Thank you for coming here.
after: Is this a story-of-the-year, a story-of-the-decade or something more? Wadah Khanfar: Actually, this may be the biggest story that we have ever covered.
ru: Как бы вы охарактеризовали историческое значение происходящего?

quote: And the thing there is, we define significance.
before: My goal is to ensure that whoever controls this land understands the boiling river's uniqueness and significance. Because that's the question, one of significance.
after: It's us. We have that power.
ru: И дело тут в том, что именно мы определяем важность.

quote: Republicans have seen significance in Mr Howard's comments.
after: Ted O'Brien, Chair of the Australian Republican Movement said Mr Howard has provided some recognition for a possible Australian head of state.

quote: The defendant had a significant amount of cocaine in his system.
before: I have a car. It's possession, Your Honor.
after: Let me get this straight. You want a second felony count for what the kid ate?
ru: У обвиняемого в крови было значительное количество кокаина.

quote: Harrow made significant contributions to a number of philanthropic organizations.
before: I've been going through Charles Harrow's books. It's a bit like falling down the rabbit hole, but I think I've found where the body might be buried.
after: - How significant? - Six zeroes significant.
ru: Харроу делал значительные пожертвования в ряд филантропических организаций.

quote: Raven, it appears that you have significant damage to the nerves in your left leg.

before: (Applause) Chromosome one — top left, bottom right — are the sex chromosomes. Women have two copies of that big X chromosome; men have the X and, of course, that small copy of the Y.
after: So if you zoom in on this genome, then what you see, of course, is this double-helix structure — the code of life spelled out with these four biochemical letters, or we call them bases: A, C, G and T. How many are there in the human genome?
ru: Парни, извините, но всего лишь очень маленькая штучка делает вас другими.

quote: Sorry. I can't spend more than 10 million dollars.
before: Five years. Cost of development — 300 million dollars.
after: Looks absolutely audacious. Looks absolutely ridiculous.
ru: Извините. Я не могут потратить больше 10 миллионов долларов.

quote: W-what sort of website would want a video of you cycling?
before: No. Of course I wouldn't.
after: Oh, I can think of a lot. Quite an unusual fetish.
ru: Это какому же сайту понадобится видео как ты катаешься?

quote: So I could, sort of, change the kind of stability with a little control there on the dial, and I can sort of watch it flip around.
before: And then I thought, what if I added this feature, where I can say, this point, you can fly like a bird. You're free, kind of thing.
after: And this is in 1993. And when my professors saw this, they were very upset at me.
ru: Вы свободны. Я мог изменить вид стабильности немного покрутив там на циферблате, и я могу наблюдать перевороты.

quote: Making it sort of a continuous preview of what's to come for RHEL.
before: About 1 year ago, Stream was introduced, as a way to make the work around RHEL more public, allowing the users to contribute.
after: That doesn't imply anything about it being of lower quality by definition, or some continuous beta like some people call it. Many of the packages that are built for stream, reach the next version of RHEL unmodified.

quote: One flesh, one heart, one soul, now and forever.
before: Thank you. Your Grace, Your Grace, my lords, my ladies, we stand here in the sight of gods and men to witness the union of man and wife.
after: Have you ever seen one like it? I've never seen anything like any of this.
ru: Одна плоть, одно сердце, одна душа, отныне и вовеки.

quote: Grabbing a few souls -- that's got to be below his pay grade.
before: Apparently, he swung through town 10 years ago, to the day. So, what -- do you think tea and crumpets made these deals and now he's collecting? Or he just sent his dog -- told it to go fetch.
after: I guess. Any idea who signed the dotted line? I have no clue.
ru: Чувак - король ада. Ходить за душами - ниже его достоинства. Ясно.

quote: They say in that moment, the soul tells all of its secrets.
before: Did you escape, or did you kill him? Because if you did, you need to tell us all of the details, including what his eyes looked like when he took his last breath.
after: No, they don¡¯t, no one says that. - Yeah, they do.
ru: Говорят, в этот момент душа открывает все тайны.

quote: Gerard had a soul and we're saving it.
before: For God's sake! This is warped.
after: I should be fucking furious... but d'you know what? I'm not.
ru: У Жерара была душа и мы спасаем её.

quote: It belongs to the soul, and the soul is not a part of the physical world.
before: One feature is the tradition of religious dualism: Consciousness is not a part of the physical world. It's a part of the spiritual world.
after: That's the tradition of God, the soul and immortality. There's another tradition that thinks it's opposed to this but accepts the worst assumption.
ru: Сознание принадлежит душе, а душа не часть физического мира.

quote: Because there's a soul in this whole thing.
before: It's true. It's true.
after: We need to have a new instinct for the 21st century. We need to combine all this stuff.
ru: Потому что во всем этом есть душа.

quote: And what the soul does is it yearns for righteousness.
before: Slavery is wrong because it's an obliteration of another soul. Rape is not just an attack on a bunch of physical molecules, it's an attempt to insult another person's soul.
after: The heart yearns for fusion with another, the soul yearns for righteousness. And that led to my third realization, which I borrowed from Einstein: " The problem you have is not going to be solved at the level of consciousness on which you created it.
ru: И каждая душа стремится к добродетели.

quote: Moseley's Mostly Jazz Funk and Soul Festival evacuated, and organisers described the weather as "biblical".
before: Parts of the Birmingham, England area flooded on Saturday amid heavy downpours, following a Met Office yellow weather warning for its region.

quote: Prepare yourself to be wowed by a Wall of Sound.
before: Attention Mr. and Mrs. Whatever-your-last-name-is. Why do they need a rehearsal?
after: Sound, sound. What was that?
ru: Приготовьтесь быть снесенными стеной звука.

quote: I don't think I'll ever forget that sound.
before: It's all about exclusivity. Just being invited means you're a somebody.
after: The screaming. Abigail,did you see anybody near the cab of the truck?
ru: Я никогда не забуду этот звук.

quote: I don't speak their lingo, But I recognize the sound. Have you met one?
before: Angels... they really exist? Unfortunately, yes.
after: Let's just table the angel talk, luv. It's the preacher we need to focus on here.
ru: Не понимаю их жаргона, но этот звук я где угодно узнаю.

quote: Prairie, my dear, toward the sound my voice.
before: All right, everybody, relax. Looking good.
after: Prairie? Prairie, toward the sound of my voice, honey.
ru: Прейри, дорогуша, в сторону звука моего голоса.

quote: And I'll never forget the comforting sound of water trickling down a stream.
before: I'll never forget the sound of laughing with my friends. I'll never forget the sound of my mother's voice right before I fell asleep.
after: Imagine my fear, pure fear, when, at the age of 10, I was told I was going to lose my hearing. And over the next five years, it progressed until I was classified as profoundly deaf.
ru: И я никогда не забуду умиротворяющий звук воды, журчащей в ручье.

quote: (Beeps) Somehow these sounds represent the word and the concept.
before: They represent the word " mathematics, " and these symbols also represent that word and this we can listen to. It sounds like this.
after: How does this happen? There's something amazing going on about representing stuff.
ru: (Звук) Эти звуки характеризуют это слово и идею.

quote: This can sometimes create a sound, but doesn't necessarily have to always.
before: This is because our small intestine is actually a huge neat freak, and it takes the time in between digestion to clean everything up, resulting in those eight meters of gut — really, seven of them — being very clean and hardly smelling like anything. It will, to achieve this, create a strong muscular wave that moves everything forward that's been leftover after digestion.
after: So what we're embarrassed of is really a sign of something keeping our insides fine and tidy. Or this weird, crooked shape of our stomach — a bit Quasimodo-ish.
ru: Иногда это сопровождается звуками, но не обязательно всегда.

quote: For programming we need capable gameplay, AI, sound and graphics programmers, proficient in C++ and/or JavaScript.
before: For other tasks, we do require some prior knowledge in fields such as software development, 3d animation etc. Our main personnel needs are in three fields: Programmers, artists and sound people. We have many applicants for sound contributors but need a manager to oversee them.
after: Finally, in the art department, we could use some more texture artists, 3D artists, animators, and illustrators to draw 2d icons for the game's user interface.

quote: Well, if she's the source, we may have a lead.
before: And that's because they weren't seeing her. They were seeing their fears.
after: Guess who was witness to Bob's attack on his wife. Bigfoot.
ru: Ну что ж, если она источник, то у нас возможно есть зацепка.

quote: The point is have we overlooked something, some source of revenue previously untapped?
before: Even Lloyd George can't want that. I'm not sure he's a good example.
after: If only we had some coal, or gravel, or tin. I can think of someone who's got plenty of tin.
ru: Суть в том, что может мы что-то упускаем из виду, какой-нибудь источник дохода, незамеченный ранее?

quote: We need to find the source of this cold-front before it freezes all of Motorcity!
before: Uhm, uhm, I'm working on it! Let's set out guys.
after: Oh, Claire, uuh, looks like I can't drive you home right now, you gonna be alright hanging around here for a while? Okay, like, exactly, how long do you mean by "a while"?
ru: Нужно найти источник этого холодного фронта, прежде чем он заморозит весь Моторсити!

quote: Megatron said that there was another Energon source here.
before: That I was obsessed! Me, can you imagine that?
after: - On Earth? On another source?
ru: Мегатрон сказал что есть еще один источник Энергона на Земле

quote: What we did was we found what were the locally available sources of biomass.
before: So we wanted to see if we could introduce this charcoal-making technology there. Well, unfortunately, they didn't have sugarcane and they didn't have cassava, but that didn't stop us.
after: And there was wheat straw and there was rice straw in this area. And what we could use as a binder was actually small amounts of cow manure, which they used ordinarily for their fuel.
ru: Что нам оставалось делать, так это найти местный доступный источник биомассы.

quote: These are potential sources for high-speed data transmission.
before: Look at your smart phone. It has a flashlight, an LED flashlight.
after: And then there's security. You would agree with me that light doesn't penetrate through walls.
ru: Это потенциальные источники высокоскоростной передачи данных.

quote: Well, one obvious source is dead sharks -- dead sharks, washed up.
before: They didn't get enough samples to really explore the genetics in enough detail. So, where do you get samples from for your genetic analysis?
after: We might get two or three dead sharks washed up in Ireland a year, if we're kind of lucky. Another source would be fisheries' bycatch.
ru: Мёртвые акулы — один из таких источников. Их выносит на берег. В Ирландии их может быть 2-3 в год,

quote: Official sources claimed four such hideouts were demolished.
before: In a separate incident, eleven suspected insurgents died when security forces, along with jets and helicopters, raided their hideouts.

quote: The storm might re-intensify once it moves over open waters of the South China Sea.
This is detective Robin Griffin with the Southern Lakes police.
before: Have you got a mobile? It's up with my shirt.
after: I have a body, male, middle-aged. 5'10". Brown hair.

quote: They just disembarked at the Western edge of the reserve, Southern bank, still in radio range.
before: - You're staying here. Got it.
after: Hey, uh, Doc, you got a... fella? Last I heard, he was in Beijing, but that was months ago now.
ru: Они только что высадились На западном краю заповедника, южный берег, еще в радиодиапозоне.

quote: Your father, he set me up- you know, I've never seen the Southern cross.
before: - Go. - Just so you know, I never meant to take off without saying anything.
after: Have you? - The constellation?
ru: Твой отец, он подставил все. Знаешь, я никогда не видела Южный Крест.

quote: I rode my horse after drinking wine and raced the horse at the Southern Gate.
before: Say it! Yes...
after: When I saw a girl standing in the middle of the street I wanted to jump over her but the consequence..... I was so scared and then ran away.
ru: Я был пьян, когда пустился вскачь и погнал коня к южным воротам.

quote: From Alaska to Florida and from Maine to the most southern parts of California.
before: Also, the CODIS results that we have have tentacles to crime scenes, have linkages in 40 states in the United States. Forty of the 50 states have tentacles to our crime testing of these rape kits.
after: A sea to shining sea, string of CODIS hits. Natasha is now 36 years old.
ru: От Аляски о Флориды и от штата Мэн до самых южных частей Калифорнии.

quote: It's just one year of data, but you can see how dynamic the Southern Ocean is.
before: This beautiful animation of the Southern Ocean I'm just going to use illustrate how we're using these corals to get at some of the ancient ocean feedbacks. You can see the density of the surface water in this animation by Ryan Abernathey.
after: The intense mixing, particularly the Drake Passage, which is shown by the box, is really one of the strongest currents in the world coming through here, flowing from west to east. It's very turbulently mixed, because it's moving over those great big undersea mountains, and this allows CO2 and heat to exchange with the atmosphere in and out.
ru: Здесь данные всего за один год, но вы видите, как изменчив Южный океан.

quote: They're building a trade corridor stretching from Northeast India through Myanmar and Bangladesh to Southern China.
before: You guessed it: China. China and India have fought a major war and have three outstanding border disputes, but today India is the second largest shareholder in the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank.
after: Their trade volume has grown from 20 billion dollars a decade ago to 80 billion dollars today. Nuclear-armed India and Pakistan have fought three wars and continue to dispute Kashmir, but they're also negotiating a most-favored-nation trade agreement and want to complete a pipeline stretching from Iran through Pakistan to India.
ru: Они создают торговый коридор, простирающийся от северо-востока Индии через Мьянму и Бангладеш в южный Китай.

quote: An earthquake has hit the sea near the Southern Sumatra.
after: The earthquake, which had a magnitude of 5.1, was 160km away from Bengkulu and 725 km away from Jakarta, the capital of Indonesia. It struck at approximately 0600 local time today.

quote: That has got to be the closest thing to going into space that you can do.
before: Built like a spacecraft, it's designed to explore the deepest depths of the ocean. And I'm lucky enough to have hitched a ride down to the sea floor, two kilometres beneath the surface.
after: And, given that I'm not going to go into space any time soon, I think it's the next best thing. See you in eight hours.
ru: Совершая подобное погружение, вы как бы отправляетесь в космос, оставаясь при этом на Земле.

quote: Understanding the nature of wormholes is gonna lead to new forms of space travel.
before: A little nervous. I know I can't use the bridge to go back, but there's something poetic about using a relic from the past to explore the future.
after: This ia first step. Here's to innovation.
ru: Понимание природы червоточин приведет к новым формам космических путешествий.

after: Tell it to my car. You know where to find it.
ru: Место на парковке было моим, и ты об этом знаешь.

before: I am the master of time and space. Well, I was.
after: Oh, is that my brain scan? - No.
ru: Потом, время и пространство стало управлять мной

quote: I'm not talking about space travel, merely about humanity's metaphorical journey into the future.
before: (Laughter) And there was total disagreement about what the role of humans should be, even at the most basic level, so let's take a closer look at possible futures that we might choose to steer toward, alright? So don't get me wrong here.
after: So one option that some of my AI colleagues like is to build superintelligence and keep it under human control, like an enslaved god, disconnected from the internet and used to create unimaginable technology and wealth for whoever controls it. But Lord Acton warned us that power corrupts, and absolute power corrupts absolutely, so you might worry that maybe we humans just aren't smart enough, or wise enough rather, to handle this much power.
ru: Я не говорю о космическом путешествии, не просто о метафорическом путешествии человечества в будущее.

quote: We created a space called the Young Girls Transformative Project.
before: Several years ago, a few friends of mine decided we needed to bridge the disconnect between our generation and the generation of young women. It's not enough to say you have two Nobel laureates from the Republic of Liberia when your girls' kids are totally out there and no hope, or seemingly no hope.
after: We go into rural communities and all we do, like has been done in this room, is create the space. When these girls sit, you unlock intelligence, you unlock passion, you unlock commitment, you unlock focus, you unlock great leaders.
ru: Мы создали место под названием «Преобразования для молодых девушек».

quote: I mean, a bird needs space to fly.
before: So I said, now it's okay. The room is too small.
after: It will go perfectly on the day of the walk. Now comes the day of the walk.
ru: Птице же нужно место, чтобы летать.

quote: Kopra's injury comes amidst technical troubles with Space Shuttle Discoverys external fuel tank.
after: While technicians work to solve the problems with the fuel tank, the rest of the STS-133 crew continue to train for their mission at the Johnson Space Center in Houston, Texas.

quote: Well, you don't have four spare tires, Staszek.
before: No, thanks, I have a spare. I can manage on my own.
after: Plus, you want to keep your hands clean. There is enough room for us all.
ru: Четырёх запасных шин у тебя не наберется, Сташек.

quote: No one has a spare ventilator for a patient who's DNR?
before: It's official. No hospital in the five boroughs will take Dennis.
after: Nope. They don't want to get sued when he wakes up.
ru: Ни у одной нет свободного аппарата для пациента с отказом?

quote: I'm pretty sure you have a spare room up in here.
before: There's always a record of misdeed somewhere... And someone's always looking for it. Humphrey, what are you doing here?
after: I was wondering if I could crash. You made it pretty clear you were done with me.
ru: Я уверен, что у тебя есть свободная комната.

quote: That would leave me a lot of spare time.
before: I should reign it in. Don't beat yourself up.
after: See you next time, Barry. Get home safe, Jay.
ru: Возможно, у меня будет больше свободного времени.

quote: She already has all the spare parts, because the problems were diagnosed in advanced.
before: But this is not just about data, so let me switch gears and tell you how this is impacting already the jobs we do every day, because this new wave of innovation is bringing about new tools and applications that will allow us to collaborate in a smarter and faster way, making our jobs not just more efficient but more rewarding. Imagine a field engineer arriving at the wind farm with a handheld device telling her which turbines need servicing.
after: And if she faces an unexpected issue, the same handheld device will allow her to communicate with colleagues at the service center, let them see what she sees, transmit data that they can run through diagnostics, and they can stream videos that will guide her, step by step, through whatever complex procedure is needed to get the machines back up and running. And their interaction gets documented and stored in a searchable database.
ru: Запасные части уже имеются в наличии, потому что проблемы были диагностированы заранее.

quote: In her spare time O’Connor drew cartoons, and her writing is also brimming with caricature.
before: From her farm in rural Georgia, surrounded by a flock of pet birds, Flannery O’ Connor scribbled tales of outcasts, intruders and misfits staged in the world she knew best: the American South. She published two novels, but is perhaps best known for her short stories, which explored small-town life with stinging language, offbeat humor, and delightfully unsavory scenarios.
after: In her stories, a mother has a face “as broad and innocent as a cabbage,” a man has as much drive as a “floor mop,” and one woman’ s body is shaped like “a funeral urn.” The names of her characters are equally sly.
ru: В свободное время О'Коннор увлекалась рисованием карикатур, сатирой также наполнены её произведения.

quote: At this level of the labor market, what you need is a marketplace for spare hours.
before: And it's not just caterers, it's hoteliers, it's retailers, it's anyone who provides services to the public or businesses. There's all sorts of organizations that can use these pools of very flexible people, possibly already once they've been inducted.
after: They do exist. Here's how they work.
ru: На этом уровне рынка труда вам нужна особая площадка для торговли свободными часами.

quote: The plane was being dismantled for spare parts and there were no injuries.
before: An airliner has suffered an explosion and caught fire at Soekarno-Hatta Airport in Tangerang, Banten, Indonesia.

quote: Let us remember that the teachers were not Hebrew speakers.
before: Because the Hebrew you speak, which you call Israeli, which seems a sensible idea, presumably was not the same as the one that was being developed? They were taught in the best Hebrew, which was available for their teachers.
after: Wasn't their first language. It was not their first language. They were not native Hebrew speakers.
ru: Нельзя забывать, их учителя не были носителями этого языка.

quote: And as your keynote speaker, I have prepared a few words.
before: Rogelio: Okay, stop it, stop it, it's not cheesy. And I think Rafael is right to want to mark this extraordinary occasion of Jane's graduation.
after: (Clears throat) Jane, it is an honor and a privilege for me to be here today. It's a moment that I've waited for the two-and-a-half months I've known you.
ru: И как главный оратор, я подготвил пару слов.

quote: Like when your cell phone rings and it makes your speakers buzz.
before: - Interference? - Yeah.
after: It's usually caused by poorly set-up equipment, so when I heard it for the first time a few weeks ago I just made a note to myself to talk to the station technicians, but then I realized something. Listen.
ru: Как когда звонит мобильник и колонки начинают фонить.

quote: Hotter than the pair of speakers I bought today off the back of a truck.
before: Behold, your fondue. But please, wait 30 minutes before eating, for it is far too hot for human consumption.
after: Hotter than three rats fornicating in a wool sock. Hotter than the burning flesh of Shel Silverstein in hell.
ru: С пылу, с жару, как те ворованные колонки, которые я сегодня приобрёл у наркоманов.

quote: And yet, performance anxiety also haunts public speakers, contestants in spelling bees, and even world-famous musicians.
before: That competitor just experienced the phenomenon known as " choking, " where despite months, even years, of practice, a person fails right when it matters most. Choking is common in sports, where performance often occurs under intense pressure and depends on key moments.
after: Most people intuitively blame it on their nerves, but why does being nervous undermine expert performance? There are two sets of theories, which both say that primarily, choking under pressure boils down to focus.
ru: Однако страх сцены также присущ ораторам, участникам различных викторин и даже всемирно известным музыкантам.

quote: So here are three speakers of the English language.
before: In his way, he speaks English as well. (Laughter) And here is Ms. Kardashian, and she is an English speaker, too.
after: What worldview do those three people have in common? What worldview is shaped through the English language that unites them?
ru: Итак, перед нами три носителя английского языка.

quote: However, this new generation of Cornish speakers was scattered across Cornwall and unable to use the language freely.
before: In the 1900s, Cornish activists fought for their culture. The language had been dormant for over 100 years, but they used old books and plays to teach it to their children.
after: By the 1990s, Cornish had reawakened, but it wasn't thriving. Then, in the early 2000s, Cornish speakers found one another online and leveraged digital spaces to speak on a daily basis.
ru: Однако это поколение носителей корнского языка было разбросано по Корнуоллу и не могло свободно использовать язык.

after: Kenna, Greer, I found you! Look at this necklace Julien just gave me.
ru: Попытайся быть менее печальной в такой особенный день для Лолы.
