before: Red... Devil! _
after: I'm Zayday Williams, president, and this is my vice president, Grace Gardner. We would also like to thank Dean Munsch for allowing us to have a winter semester rush this year.
ru: Добро пожаловать на этот особенный вечер нового и улучшенного Каппа Каппа Тау.

quote: I'll be turning this briefing over to Lieutenant Lao of the special operations division of IA.
before: Any questions? Good.
after: What we discuss here must remain absolutely confidential. - Go ahead.
ru: Я передам этот инструктаж лейтенанту Лао из отдела специальных операций ОВР.

quote: This is my partner, Special Agent Tim McGee.
before: Hi. Uh, I'm Very Special Agent Anthony DiNozzo.
after: We're looking for... Me.
ru: Это мой напарник - специальный агент Тим МакГи.

quote: What is so special about the human brain?
after: Why is it that we study other animals instead of them studying us? What does a human brain have or do that no other brain does?
ru: Что же такого особенного в человеческом мозге?

quote: In the case of artwork, the history is special indeed.
before: That's not because, or it's not simply because, I'm a snob and want to boast about having an original. Rather, it's because I want something that has a specific history.
after: The philosopher Denis Dutton in his wonderful book " The Art Instinct " makes the case that, " The value of an artwork is rooted in assumptions about the human performance underlying its creation. " And that could explain the difference between an original and a forgery.
ru: С произведением искусства, история действительно особенная.

quote: So did we have a special tool? No.
before: Everyone was trying to figure out how this was possible. I thought it was luck, but after each new discovery, that became less and less likely.
after: Did we have a killer application that no one else had? No.
ru: Был ли у нас какой-то специальный инструмент?

quote: Rowling was released today to hundreds of special midnight parties at bookstores.
before: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince by J.K.
after: The book is expected to sell tens of thousands of copies in the first hour, and the waves of fans just keep on coming. As midnight spreads across the Atlantic and the North American continent, more and more stores will start selling.

quote: This species of Monitor lizard is common to West and Central Africa.
before: The 10-year-old, 4.5 feet (1.4 m) long lizard named Nice, came from the African nation of Ghana as a hatchling. It is currently housed in a reptile zoo in Kilkenny, Ireland.

quote: Doctor's too busy covering his ass to say anything more specific.
before: Was that it? Well, I think so.
after: Listen, Kate, I really appreciate you keeping me company on the way. Oh, sure, sure, I was more than happy to do that.
ru: Доктор слишком занят, чтобы сказать, что-то более конкретное.

quote: This is very broad, and it's not truly specific to exactly what you had done.
before: If they don't make money, why do you bring them in? Here is some literature just on the procedure you had.
after: You want to make sure you continue to eat well, but things to look out for that you would need to call your doctor is if you notice any separation. So it sometimes takes a little while for the body to process all that you've received.
ru: Они очень общие, не совсем конкретно о том, что у вас.

quote: Did he mention a specific area within the airport?
before: In the meantime, I want to review your encounter with Aziz. Whatever you need.
after: I think I would've said, Saul. Any indication the weapon might be arriving on an incoming flight?
ru: Он называл конкретное место в аэропорту?

quote: You're gonna have to be a bit more specific.
before: Killed him? I've killed lots of people.
after: What the hell happened to you? I really don't know.
ru: Тебе следует выражаться конкретнее.

quote: In math and science, symmetry has a different, and very specific, meaning.
before: If you are artistically inclined, you might think of the subtle modulations of a Mozart concerto, or the effortless poise of a prima ballerina. When used in every day life, the word symmetry represents vague notions of beauty, harmony and balance.
after: In this technical sense, a symmetry is the property of an object. Pretty much any type of object can have symmetry, from tangible things like butterflies, to abstract entities like geometric shapes.
ru: В математике и естественных науках, симметрия имеет другое, очень конкретное значение.

quote: But why do these gases absorb specific colors of light?
before: Before reaching our eyes, different gases absorbed those specific parts of the spectrum. For example, oxygen gas snatched up some of the dark red light, and sodium grabbed two bands of yellow.
after: This is where we enter the quantum realm. Every atom and molecule has a set number of possible energy levels for its electrons.
ru: Но почему же эти газы поглощают свет определённого цвета?

quote: He was convinced that each organ had a specific function.
before: Eventually, he would leave the arena to become the personal physician to four Roman Emperors. While his peers debated symptoms and their origins, Galen obsessively studied anatomy.
after: Since the Roman government largely prohibited working with human cadavers, Galen conducted countless dissections of animals instead. Even with this constraint, his exhaustive investigations yielded some remarkably accurate conclusions.
ru: По его убеждению, каждый орган отвечал за определённую функцию.

quote: In the evening, votes are counted by volunteers under heavy supervision, following specific procedures.
before: Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters. Candidates can send representatives to witness every part of the process.

quote: He must have designed it specifically for you.
before: Or at least it was. This one's long since dead.
after: What's it used for? Well, it's meant to collect and make sense of the scrambled plan that September put in your mind.
ru: Должно быть, он создал его специально для тебя.

quote: Were you tasked specifically to track the operations of Terry McCandless?
before: Detective Cruz, were you assigned to work undercover for the Charleston police department and report on illegal activities among your fellow officers? Yes.
after: Yes. And after an exhaustive investigation... I found no illicit activity.
ru: Было ли вам специально поручено отслеживать действия Терри Маккенделса?

quote: Jessica, it's like they've been specifically instructed to leave my name off.
before: It's not harassment, God damn it! Louis!
after: Now you're just being paranoid. I am not paranoid.
ru: Джессика, им словно специально приказали не называть мое имя.

quote: Last week you very specifically said, "Keep tongue out."
before: Yeah, I think if you keep your... You need to keep your tongue inside your mouth for this to work.
after: - No. - You did say that, Claire.
ru: На той неделе ты специально попросила показать язык.

quote: This is a knee that's been designed specifically for poor people.
before: But at 1,400 dollars, it's still too expensive for people like Kamal. And lastly, here you see a low-end knee.
after: And while you have affordability, you've lost on functionality. The mechanism here is a single axis, and a single axis is like a door hinge.
ru: Он разработан специально для людей с низким доходом.

quote: It's for that reason that many activists specifically avoid using the telephone.
before: One prominent Bahraini activist, who was arrested and tortured by his government, has said that the interrogators showed him transcripts of his telephone calls and text messages. Of course, it's no secret that governments are able to intercept telephone calls and text messages.
after: Instead, they use tools like Skype, which they think are immune to interception. They're wrong.
ru: Именно по этой причине многие активисты специально стараются не пользоваться телефоном.

quote: Like many of our viruses, it came out of Africa, specifically the Zika forest in Uganda.
before: So where did it come from, and how did it get here? And it is here.
after: Researchers at the nearby Yellow Fever Research Institute identified an unknown virus in a monkey in the Zika forest which is how it got its name. The first human cases of Zika fever surfaced a few years later in Uganda-Tanzania.
ru: Как и многие вирусы, он пришёл из Африки, а именно из леса Зика в Уганде.

quote: The letter was not addressed to anyone specifically, being addressed to just the courthouse itself.
That comes later, when Theo's brother gives his speech.
before: Is that some kind of joke? This isn't a time for humor, Francine.
after: "...the-the only two words you need to know as a husband are: 'Yes, dear.'" I'm not joking, Stan!
ru: Оно придет позже, когда брат Тео будет произносить речь.

quote: He wants to sit down with you before he gives his speech.
before: No, don't take it from me. Talk to the Vice-President yourself.
after: Now? I suggested that you might have some policy ideas for him.
ru: Он хочет встретиться с тобой до того, как произнесет речь.

quote: She said you gave a nice speech, though.
before: Oh, that's right. You haven't talked to her since the funeral.
after: Yeah. Nice speech.
ru: Она сказала, вы произнесли хорошую речь.

quote: The cameras are all trained on the plaza outside where the president's giving his speech.
before: Plaza team, what's your status? Plaza's clear.
after: Whatever's going down, that's where it'll happen. That's where we need to be.
ru: Все камеры обращены на площадь. снаружи здания, где президент выступает с речью.

quote: Until today, writing always had a much more restricted and private use than speech.
before: Institutions have always been the ones to establish the rules and propose changes. Why do I say this is a particularly appropriate moment?
after: But in our time, the age of social networks, this is going through a revolutionary change. Never before have people written so much; never before have people written for so many others to see.
ru: До настоящего времени письменная речь всегда подчинялась более строгим правилам, чем устная.

quote: And this is an interactive installation which presents the fiction that speech casts visible shadows.
before: So it occurred to me, what happens if we could run these backwards? And thus was born the project called Remark, which is a collaboration with Zachary Lieberman and the Ars Electronica Futurelab.
after: So the idea is you step into a kind of a magic light. And as you do, you see the shadows of your own speech.
ru: Этa интерактивная установка создаёт ощущение, будто речь производит видимые тени.

quote: It was such a great speech that the Athenian law courts let him off.
before: They won enumerable victories, but no one remembers what they are because they were all fought for selfish ends. The one battle that the Spartans fought that everybody remembers is the the battle of Thermopylae where they were butchered to a man, but fought for the freedom of Greece. "
after: He lived for another 10 years, then the Macedonian faction caught up with him. They cut out his tongue in mockery of his oratory, and no one knows what they did with his body.
ru: Эта речь так потрясла Афинский суд, что Гиперид был освобождён.

quote: Jimmy Wales gave a speech titled Freedom of speech, human rights, and free culture.
after: In his speech he made a comparison between the Freedom House rating with the size of the Wikipedia in that language. He found a link between the two in the cases he examined.

quote: I've always been taught to favor accuracy over speed.
before: Your conviction is admirable. But you can't possibly think you're faster than me.
after: Bull's-eye. Air supply terminated.
ru: Меня всегда учили ценить точность превыше скорости.

quote: Instead, let's say it gets close, just shy of that ultimate speed.
before: To approach the speed of light means circling the Earth pretty fast. Seven times a second. But no matter how much power the train has, it can never quite reach the speed of light, since the laws of physics forbid it.
after: Now something extraordinary happens. Time starts flowing slowly on board, relative to the rest of the world.
ru: Вместо этого, положим, что скорость поезда стала почти равна скорости света.

quote: He's gotta keep the train at top speed so they can't get off.
before: Okay that's it, we're stopping. - Frank, this is George, we gotta... - Give me that!
after: So tell him to keep it floored. I will do no such thing. Okay then here, hold this?
ru: Дай сюда! Ему нужно держать предельную скорость, чтобы они не смогли слезьть.

quote: Donald Campbell's heroic attempt at the speed record on Coniston Water ended in tragedy.
before: We are also of a view that further investigation into other, extraneous, matters would not be in the national interest. To which end, all investigative materials relating to Blenheim Vale Boy's Home are to be sealed for 50 years.
after: Upstairs. All change.
ru: Героическая попытка Дональда Кэмпбелла установить рекорд скорости на Конистон Вотер, закончилась трагедией.

quote: It can run the same speed without even that segment.
before: Without a foot, here's what it does. It doesn't even slow down.
after: No problem for the cockroach — they can grow them back, if you care. How do they do it?
ru: Он может бежать с той же скоростью и без сегмента лапы.

quote: That's the speed of the destruction that we are having.
before: That was when we shifted from deforestation of temperate forests to deforestation of tropical forests. So think of this: In 100 years, we lost the same amount of forest in the tropics that we lost in 2,000 years in temperate forests.
after: Now, Brazil is an important piece of this puzzle. We have the second largest forest in the world, just after Russia.
ru: Такова скорость уничтожения в наши дни.

quote: Because this only affects the surface, the waves are limited in size and speed.
before: The difference is in where this energy comes from. For normal ocean waves, it comes from wind.
after: But tsunamis are caused by energy originating underwater, from a volcanic eruption, a submarine landslide, or most commonly, an earthquake on the ocean floor caused when the tectonic plates of the Earth's surface slip, releasing a massive amount of energy into the water. This energy travels up to the surface, displacing water and raising it above the normal sea level, but gravity pulls it back down, which makes the energy ripple outwards horizontally.
ru: Так как он влияет только на поверхность, волны ограничены в размерах и скорости.

quote: At speed Ribéry rounded Iker Casillas to slot home.
before: Though the French were offside eight times the crucial equaliser came from a Franck Ribéry run on to a Patrick Viera pass that beat the line of Spaniards close to half time.

quote: I'll give you evens on Spirit of Sahara.
before: We wouldn't go and see him. Not unless he said we could.
after: That's as far as I go. You know what I think?
ru: - Я поставлю один к одному на Дух Сахары.

quote: He's been carrying Grandfather's spirit this whole time!
before: - We need to go there now. Frederick is in on it!
after: No, you don't understand. What is there to understand? !
ru: Он все это время носил в себе дедушкин дух!

quote: Because, for the first time ever, I am full of Christmas spirit.
before: Big, big, big, and sappy! "Why?"
after: I believe in the goodness of my fellow man. I mean, it's been a fantastic year.
ru: Потому что впервые в моей жизни я преисполнена духом Рождества.

quote: Not exactly keeping with the ancient chumash spirit.
before: - Think you can handle that? - Blackmail,huh?
after: Fine. I'll make the tea tomorrow night,we'll drink it together.
ru: Не слишком сочетается с древним духом Чумашей.

quote: I think we should be more ambitious -- in the spirit of TED.
before: Come on, if we build technology that makes all humans obsolete, what could possibly go wrong? " (Laughter) But I think that would be embarrassingly lame.
after: Let's envision a truly inspiring high-tech future and try to steer towards it. This brings us to the second part of our rocket metaphor: the steering.
ru: Я думаю, что мы должны быть более амбициозными, в духе TED.

quote: An entrepreneurial spirit, an independent streak and a dedication to his parents.
before: But Troy's mannerisms — they reveal the patterns of someone who is scared, troubled and unsure of the future. Now Troy also embodies the many positive qualities his generation is known for.
after: He believes in hard work and has tried gigs in both the licit and underground economies, but he hasn't had any luck and is just trying to find his way and still dances between both worlds. When I met Troy a few years ago, he had been employed as a golf caddy at a local country club, carrying bags for rich men and women who often never even acknowledged his existence.
ru: Дух предпринимательства, независимость, преданность родителям.

quote: So in the spirit of TED, they're doing things together because it makes a difference.
before: What I hope you think is that bacteria can talk to each other, they use chemicals as their words, they have an incredibly complicated chemical lexicon that we're just now starting to learn about. Of course, what that allows bacteria to do is to be multicellular.
after: What happens is that bacteria have these collective behaviors, and they can carry out tasks that they could never accomplish if they simply acted as individuals. What I would hope that I could further argue to you is that this is the invention of multicellularity.
ru: В духе TED они все делают вместе, потому что это дает желаемый результат.

quote: Spirit of the Land by Tower Voices of New Zealand won the best classical album.
They're dropping you as their spokesman.
before: I just got off the phone with the people From horny goat weed.
after: But John Edwards and I were supposed to ride On their cinco de mayo float. Yet another black superstar Taken down by his personal life.
ru: Они не хотят, чтобы ты был их официальным представителем.

quote: According to a spokesman for the Home Office, new elections.. ..will be held as soon as the situation is normal.
before: The provisional President has authorised.. ..a caretaker government with former Minister Li Masi.. ..as Premierwho has promised emergency measures.. Members of subversive organizations have been arrested.. ..in accordance with the new police law.
after: The secretary of the Rightist Union, deputy Mazzante,.. ..has given his party's unqualified support.. ..to the caretaker government. At the first meeting of the new Cabinet.. ..approval was given to a bill.. ..of the new Employment Minister Antonino Irnerio Steiner,..
ru: Официальные представители заявили, что новые выборы состоятся, как только ситуация нормализуется.

quote: Colonel Stanley Owlen, spokesman for CENTCOM in Afghanistan.
before: You want to let me do some good? Just be right.
after: - Thank you for joining us. - Pleasure.
ru: Полковник Стэнли Овлен, официальный представитель Центрального Командования ВС США в Афганистане.

quote: "The early matinees are very strong and extremely encouraging," said Steve Elzer, a spokesman for Columbia.
before: The film, directed by Ron Howard, is an adaptation of the novel of the same name by Dan Brown, which has sold over 60 million copies worldwide. Officials at Sony-owned Columbia Pictures, which distributed the film, expect the film to gross US$50 million to US$80 million during its first weekend in the United States, based on figures from early matinees on Friday.

quote: I shall need a man on the spot to oversee the money operations.
before: Why, what does it surprise you? The wheels will be turning fast from now on.
after: On the spot in Mexico? Where else?
ru: Мне понадобится человек, который будет следить за разработкой месторождения на месте.

quote: Get some paper towels and some spot remover.
before: When did that happen? No, don't use that.
after: Whoa, how'd it get bigger? It likes water.
ru: Возьми больше бумажных полотенец и пятновыводитель.

quote: We're going to hang out with you while we stake our spot.
before: What are you guys doing here? Why didn't you tell us the new parade route goes right in front of your building?
after: For two whole days? You know, this place is great.
ru: Мы собираемся тусоваться с тобой, пока не застолбим наши места.

quote: This gray spot here looks like an abscess caused by the bacteria from your STI.
before: Hmm, Dr. Lin, could you slide the wand back over the left Fallopian tube? What is it?
after: Does that mean I can't have babies? No, no, it's just a blockage right now.
ru: Серое пятно похоже на абсцесс, вызванный бактерией из-за вашей ППП инфекции.

quote: They've got those black sinister eyes and those spots on their body.
before: Leopard seals, since the time of Shackleton, have had a bad reputation. They've got that wryly smile on their mouth.
after: They look positively prehistoric and a bit scary. And tragically in [2003], a scientist was taken down and drowned, and she was being consumed by a leopard seal.
ru: У них чёрные зловещие глаза и пятна по всему телу.

quote: That horn-shaped region is what we call the sweet spot.
before: So as you move vertically away from this surface, the heat falls off. As you move side to side, it moves off.
after: That's the place where the heat is even to within 10 percent. So that's the place where you really want to cook.
ru: Вот эта область в форме горна — самое лучшее место.

quote: And that can be done by raising the density in very specific spots a whole lot.
before: Increasingly, we're realizing that we don't even need to densify an entire city. What we need instead is an average density that rises to a level where we don't drive as much and so on.
after: So you can think of it as tent poles that actually raise the density of the entire city. And we find that when we do that, we can, in fact, have a few places that are really hyper-dense within a wider fabric of places that are perhaps a little more comfortable and achieve the same results.
ru: Этого можно добиться, сильно увеличив плотность в отдельных местах.

quote: If confirmed, Khvichava would take the top spot with an eight year lead.
before: Reportedly born in 1880, documents state that Khvichava picked corn and tea for a living in 1965, at the age of 85. Prior to Khvichava, the record holder for the oldest known person to have lived on the planet was Jeanne Calment of France, who lived to be 122 years old.
after: The Justice Ministry in Georgia backs up her claim, but it was not independently verified by the Gerontology Research Group and her birth certificate was lost.

quote: Her last post on Serena was in the spring, the day she moved out.
before: Still nothing from Gossip Girl? I checked.
after: Well, yeah, just because she hasn't written about Serena doesn't mean she doesn't know anything about her. You do have a personal correspondence with our poison pen pal.
ru: Ее последний пост про Серену был весной В день, когда она уехала

quote: In the spring, it's gonna be full of purple flowers.
before: Did you... scatter Bixby's ashes? In the garden under a jacaranda tree.
after: I thought she was gonna make it through. Yeah, we all did.
ru: Весной, оно расцветет и будет всё фиолетовое.

quote: The course where you covered the D.C. sectional high school golf championships last spring?
before: I loved Vivian. I-I could never... Dump her body in the pond of the 13th hole at Washington Hills?
after: Listen to me. I... I promise you, I did not want Vivian dead.
ru: Там, где вы освещали чемпионат по гольфу местной школьной команды, прошлой весной.

quote: Brain cells are growing like winter wheat and spring has sprung.
before: Oy, first shift back you're gonna treat me like that? Mail-order B12 shots.
after: - What? - (CELL PHONE VIBRATES) Hey, did you guys hear that old McGill at 22 retired?
ru: Клетки мозга растут, как озимая пшеница с приходом весны.

quote: You must have all seen the Arab Spring, which began in Tunis and in Egypt.
before: And thanks to that, Turkey has been able to reasonably create a success story in which Islam and the most pious understandings of Islam have become part of the democratic game, and even contributes to the democratic and economic advance of the country. And this has been an inspiring example right now for some of the Islamic movements or some of the countries in the Arab world.
after: Arab masses just revolted against their dictators. They were asking for democracy; they were asking for freedom.
ru: Должно быть вы все наблюдали за Арабской Весной, которая началась в Тунисе и Египте.

quote: Their remains, along with Scott’s diary, would not be found until spring.
before: On the way back towards the camp, two of the five men succumbed to frostbite starvation, and exhaustion. The remaining explorers hoped for a prearranged rendezvous with a team sent from their base, but due to a series of mishaps, misjudgements and miscommunications, their rescue never arrived.
after: Today, scientists from various countries live and work at Antarctic research stations. But the journeys of these early explorers are not forgotten.
ru: Их останки обнаружат только весной вместе с дневником Скотта.

quote: What comes the day after the Arab Spring?
before: We soon will have 10 billion people, many of whom will lack basic resources. So complain as we might, what actually can replace what we have today?
after: Well, one attractive alternative that obviously presents itself to us is that of networks. Right?
ru: Что будет после «арабской весны»?

quote: Q: Celtic Spring has performed across both North America and Europe.
after: Where have audiences been the most responsive?

quote: Whole squad of munchers livin' up there like pigeons.
before: What, did the Mafia- Excuse me. The Sanitation Department... forget to do their trash pickup this week? I was on a roof in Mott Haven yesterday.
after: Yeah, I saw 'em pouring out of a sewer in Morningside Heights. Hundreds.
ru: Я был на крыше в Мотт Хевене вчера, целый отряд грызунов там живёт, будто голуби.

quote: I've been carrying this squad for two years, and my back's getting tired.
before: For what, Detective Santiago? For you to give me a promotion and a 40% raise.
after: Excuse me, Captain. Hey, Amy, can I talk to you for one second?
ru: Я тащила эту команду два года, и моя спина уже устала.

quote: Captain Patterson will be taking over Squad 3, effective immediately.
before: Severide, we're stripping you of your rank. What?
after: We're sticking to the plan, right? Definitely.
ru: Капитан Паттерсон примет на себя командование Спасателем 3. Он приступает незамедлительно.

quote: The cheerios' photo's tomorrow, and I want back on that squad.
before: (school bell ringing) Coach sylvester, we need to talk. Oh, I got nothing to say to you, prego.
after: Oh, is that what you want? Well, what I wanted was a head cheerleader who wasn't going
ru: Завтра фотографируют группу поддержки, и я хочу обратно в команду.

quote: The firing squad aimed, fired -- the general was dead.
before: It was a dimly lit shack. There was a beaten up black and white television flickering in the background, and a former head of state and general was being blindfolded and tied to the pole.
after: Now this was being broadcast live. And shortly after, we left the country, and we returned to Switzerland.
ru: Расстрельная команда прицелилась, выстрелила, - и генерал был убит.

quote: I'm expecting the release of a chapter book called "Platypus Police Squad: The Frog Who Croaked."
before: " Punk Farm, " " Baghead, " " Ollie the Purple Elephant. " I just finished the ninth book in the " Lunch Lady " series, which is a graphic novel series about a lunch lady who fights crime.
after: And I travel the country visiting countless schools, letting lots of kids know that they draw great cats. And I meet Bagheads.
ru: Я ожидаю выхода в свет книги для младших школьников под названием «Полицейский отряд Утконос: Лягушка, которая квакала».

quote: Pink's squad and another squad spent their entire day outside the wire.
before: But the thing that I know you all have heard a lot of times, American soldiers saying, " Why don't they talk about the good stuff that we do? " OK, this is a perfect example.
after: They didn't have to go outside the wire. There were not Americans hurt out there.
ru: Отряд Пинка и еще один отряд провели весь день по ту сторону забора.

before: One of his most notable roles came in 1988 when he played Lt.
after: He also appeared in the The Naked Gun 2 ½: The Smell of Fear in 1991 and The Naked Gun 33 1/3: The Final Insult in 1994.

quote: "Face the circle in the square, you'll see me, I'll show you where."

after: Interesting. Interesting, interesting.
ru: К кругу на площади встаньте лицом, там укажу я как быть гордецом.

quote: I think I'm the only black man in Red Square right now!
before: '.. Russian pride is at an all-time high.' But there's a darker side to Russian nationalism - much darker.
after: I've gained unique access to some of Russia's most high-profile ultra-nationalists to discover what some young people think it means to be a true Russian... This one... is a masterpiece.
ru: Мне кажется, я сейчас единственный черный на Красной площади!

quote: St. Peter's Square is empty, dreary, and abandoned.
before: Our non-relations with other religions are tense and dangerous. We've become few in number, alone, against the rest of the world.
after: Michael, we have the duty to take steps. How?
ru: Площадь Святого Петра опустела, стала унылой и заброшенной.

quote: He helped us carry him out of the Square.

ru: Он помог нам унести его с площади.

quote: For 18 days, our cameras were broadcasting, live, the voices of the people in Tahrir Square.

For those who have disabilities — the paraplegic, there's the brain-computer interface, or BCI, where chips have been put on the motor cortex of completely quadriplegic patients, and they can control a cursor or a wheelchair or, potentially, a robotic arm.
ru: Это хирургия по системе NOTES, она становится реальностью: бесшрамовая хирургия, возможная благодаря роботизированной хирургии.

quote: Many survivors have waited many months to undergo surgery to heal their blinding cataracts.
before: In theory, Liberia's public health services are free of charge. In practice, our health system lacks the funding and capacity to expand care to all at the point of need.
after: Few had to relive the traumatic experience, when their blood was retested for Ebola at the point of admission. Some survivors experienced delayed or deferred admission due to limited bed capacity.
ru: Многие пережившие Эболу вынуждены месяцами ждать операции на глазах, чтобы восстановить зрение после развившейся катаракты.

quote: It looks very different from what you're expecting surgery to look like.
before: Some of the tools for this had been around for a hundred years, but it had only been used as a diagnostic technique until the 1980s, when there was changes in camera technologies and things like that, that allowed this to be done for real operations. So what you see — this is now the first surgical image — as we're coming down the tube, this is a new entry into the body.
after: We bring instruments in, from two separate cuts in the side, and then you can start manipulating tissue. Within 10 years of the first gallbladder surgeries being done laparoscopically, a majority of gallbladder surgeries were being done laparoscopically — truly a pretty big revolution.
ru: Это выглядит совсем иначе, чем ожидаешь от операции.

quote: However, Higgins was considered to be too unhealthy to have the surgery in Marbella, Spain.
before: Recently, Higgins lost all his teeth as the result of having treatment for his cancer. In May 2010, a charity dinner took place in Manchester, England that raised approximately £20,000 (US$30,997, €23,859, A$34,363, C$31,961) so as to allow surgery for new teeth for him to occur.

quote: An all-out coordinated breach has its advantages -- maximum force, the element of surprise.
before: Their discipline makes them hard to escape but easy to predict. Sorry we keep meeting like this, Alexi.
after: But there are drawbacks, too. If everyone goes in at once, you can find yourself locked inside before you realize your target has already left.
ru: Скоординированное одновременное нападение имеет свои преимущества - удар сразу всей силой, элемент неожиданности.

quote: To my great surprise, your fingerprints weren't in AFIS.
before: Cassie is fine. Sorry I missed your arrest and booking, but I've been coordinating the effort to identify you.
after: Of course they aren't. I've never committed any crimes.
ru: К моему удивлению, твоих пальчиков не оказалось в АДИС.

quote: He flirts a little and then, what a surprise, you run into him again.
before: That is there because this klutz crashed into me when I was standing in line at the Shake Shack. It seems random, casual.
after: I could not believe it when I saw him a few days later at that café in Georgetown. I didn't let him get away that time.
ru: Флиртует с тобой немного, а затем, ты сталкиваешься с ним опять, вот неожиданность.

quote: You can understand my surprise when I found out who he really was.
before: I represent your ex-husband, John. In the event of his death, I was instructed to contact you.
after: John left something for you. If you're watching this, Jill, I'm long gone from this world.
ru: Каково же было мое удивление, когда я узнал, кем он был на самом деле.

quote: And much to his surprise, I said, "Well actually, we do."
before: The drug you give to your patients that stops the cancer cells multiplying also stops the newborn neurons being generated in their brain. " And then Robert looked at me like I was crazy and said, " But Sandrine, these are adult patients — adults do not grow new nerve cells. "
after: And this is a phenomenon that we call neurogenesis. [Neurogenesis] Now Robert is not a neuroscientist, and when he went to medical school he was not taught what we know now — that the adult brain can generate new nerve cells.
ru: И, к его удивлению, я ответила: «На самом деле, образуются».

quote: Then, to my surprise, my teacher said that the monitor had to be a boy.
before: I very much wanted to be the class monitor. And I got the highest score on the test.
after: She had forgotten to make that clear earlier because she assumed it was... obvious. (Laughter) A boy had the second highest score on the test, and he would be monitor.
ru: Потом, к моему удивлению, нам сказали, что старостой должен быть мальчик.

quote: But to his surprise, the composite portrait that he produces is beautiful.
before: This technique could be used to characterize different types of people. Galton thinks that if he combines photographs of violent criminals, he will discover the face of criminality.
after: Galton's surprising finding raises deep questions: What is beauty? Why do certain configurations of line and color and form excite us so?
ru: Но, к его большому удивлению, человек на составном портрете получается красивым.

quote: The biggest surprise pick for the squad was Newcastle United's Scott Parker.
after: Bayern Munich midfielder Owen Hargreaves will make his England return after a broken leg kept him out of competition. Other central midfielders in the squad will include Steven Gerrard, Frank Lampard and Michael Carrick.

quote: That prime rib was surprisingly good, but it's 10:30 in the morning.
before: Coming up on the main stage, give it up for Esther! Oh. Oh. Hey, Barney.
after: I don't need to see a lady get naked and dance. Oh, Esther gets naked.
ru: Этот стейк был удивительно хорош, но сейчас 10:30 утра.

quote: Although One Fish, Two Fish, Red Fish, Blue Fish might be surprisingly applicable.
before: So the topic at hand is sexual fidelity. Probably won't be relying on Seuss here.
after: Go on. Well... they say at the end of your life, you regret the stuff you didn't do more than the stuff that you did, and I'm pretty sure Alice is the stuff I want to do.
ru: Хотя "Раз рыбка, два рыбка, Красная рыбка, синяя рыка" неожиданным образом могло бы подойти.

quote: Surprisingly heavy for a man with so few brains.
before: I knew the Great Lakes were big, but I never imagined they would be this big. It's like a sea.
after: So, Steve... Are you a man capable of honoring your commitments?
ru: Удивительно сильно сказано для человека с небольшими мозгами.

quote: She has a surprisingly high tolerance to a lot of the benzodiazepines.
before: 'And as the skin started to blister and crack 'and the smell of it filled her nostrils... '..she knew it was the other life that was the dream.' Dosing Janet correctly has been a challenge.
after: That's why we're keen to get her started on ECT. You can't just fry her brain.
ru: Она обладает удивительно высокой толерантности для многих бензодиазепинов.

quote: And then, in a surprisingly quiet voice, he began to sing their favorite lullaby.
before: From his pocket, he took a screwed-up piece of paper and quietly began to read the words which he'd written as a message for his two little ones. His hands were shaking.
after: You see, there wasn't much that he could do from behind bars to show his children that he missed and loved them. But he could do this.
ru: А потом он удивительно тихим голосом стал петь их любимую колыбельную.

quote: Surprisingly, CRISPR is actually a natural process that’s long functioned as a bacterial immune system.
before: How does it work? And what can it do?
after: Originally found defending single-celled bacteria and archaea against invading viruses, naturally occurring CRISPR uses two main components. The first are short snippets of repetitive DNA sequences called “clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats,” or simply, CRISPRs.
ru: Удивительно, но CRISPR на самом деле является естественным процессом, служащим бактериям в качестве иммунной системы.

quote: And I'd commit to doing it later, and not surprisingly, later never came.
before: Imagine your last hamburger. (Laughter) So my common sense, my good intentions, were in conflict with my taste buds.
after: Sound familiar? So I wondered, might there be a third solution?
ru: Я обещал себе обязательно сделать это попозже. Не удивительно, что это «попозже» никогда не наступало.

quote: Surprisingly, it was one of the better 11 hour flights I have had.
before: In the seat to my left was another infant in a baby seat, and to his left was his mother holding yet a third baby in her lap. When I woke two of the babies were suspended from the wall in what looked like airplane baby crib trampolines.
after: All three babies slept through the entire trip and when I woke from one nap I found myself lying against what felt like memory foam, but turned out to be the obese woman, whose largess had spilled over our hapless arm rest and into my seat. It was...not unpleasant.

quote: And all their survey metrics around intent to purchase are off the charts.
before: Define "care." Their brand health is excellent, okay?
after: They're on the charts, and skin care is a red ocean, Martin. We just need to demonstrate that their current management structure-- with, you know, a little assistance from K and A-- can convert their brand to rock star status.
ru: И заинтересованных покупателей судя по опросам всегда выше крыши.

quote: Dr. Naylor created the survey to collect our common responses to heinous crimes.
before: Obviously, this is not a coincidence, even though Tetch thought it was. What do you think is going on?
after: But it occurred to me, if one were to invert the arrangement of data, turn it upside down, one could instead identify outlier respondents-- people who don't share polite society's judgments about torture and murder. People who lack empathy.
ru: Доктор Нэйлор создала опрос чтобы собрать обычные реакции на ужасные преступления

quote: Do you disagree with the notion that they committed heinous acts before they were identified by the survey?
before: You can't frame him for the fire. Maybe if we were not limiting ourselves to crimes we think were committed by the DANTE psychos...
after: Of course not, I just accused Chapel of arson. We now know that four of these people are dead, and two of them are already in prison.
ru: Ты думаешь, что они не совершали преступлений до того, как их выявили опросом?

quote: You've been selected to take a short survey.
before: We're just friends. Okay, well, congratulations.
after: "How sexually desirable do you find Teddy on a scale from one to ten?" Teddy, I don't have time for this.
ru: Ты была выбрана участником короткого опроса.

quote: Well, you remember that World Values Survey that I mentioned earlier?
before: (Laughter) Or maybe the heartless, greedy Wall Street type, right? Or maybe people like me, with multiple origins, living in a big, cosmopolitan metropolis.
after: It showed another fascinating finding: 71 percent of the world population agreed with the statement, " I am a citizen of the world. " Do you know what it means?
ru: Помните Всемирный обзор ценностей, который я упоминал ранее?

quote: Independent analysis from anonymous employees on their surveys.
before: And you can say, " Well how do you know they're happy? " Well we did win, every year that we entered, one of the rankings for best employer for small business.
after: It does, and it can, work in Bulgaria. There's nothing holding us back, except our own mentality about play.
ru: В независимом анализе анонимных сотрудников, по их опросам.

quote: From this dataset you actually learn that retired European families are extremely patient with survey takers.
before: One way to imagine that is I gather large datasets from around the world. So for example, there is the Survey of Health, [Aging] and Retirement in Europe.
after: (Laughter) So imagine that you're a retired household in Belgium and someone comes to your front door. " Excuse me, would you mind if I peruse your stock portfolio?
ru: По нему вы видите, что европейские семьи пенсионного возраста чрезвычайно терпеливо относятся к тем, кто проводит опрос.

quote: Other surveys have found that underage drinkers account for 20% of alcohol consumption.
before: Alcohol use by the youth has been a matter of public concern, as it has been linked with lowered educational performance, risky sexual activity, motor accidents and addiction.
after: Alcohol advertising is not subject to federal legislation, the industry follows a voluntary code of conduct.

quote: Dinosaurs were incredibly adaptable, with an astonishing capacity for survival.
before: Ironically, it's the very thing that make dinosaurs so iconic that condemns them to extinction. The finds and discoveries of recent years have painted a staggering picture.
after: Enduring the break-up of continents, sea-level rises and countless changes in climate, they continued to diversify and thrive. On land, in water, among the trees and even in the skies.
ru: Динозавры невероятно легко приспосабливались с поразительной способностью к выживанию.

quote: Humanity has one last hope for survival, and part of it rests on your shoulders.
before: Why am I so important? You have a destiny.
after: What does that even mean? You're going to help save the world.
ru: У человечества осталась последняя надежда на выживание, и часть её покоится на твоих плечах.

quote: Fetal survival rate is 50 percent at best?
before: He has to. I'm saying laparoscopic surgery comes with inherent risks.
after: Which is 40 percent better than doing nothing at all. We should push them. Wait, you can't push a couple to go against their beliefs.
ru: Вероятность выживания плода - 50%, в лучшем случае?

quote: I need you to come to leadbetter beach and bring me a 36-hour survival basket.
before: Look at you crushing on Vampira. Who is this?
after: Look, dad, I'm a little tied up right now. This is a challenge that involves a former nemesis and something I deserve.
ru: Мне нужно, чтобы ты приехал на Ледбиттер-пляж и привез мне корзину для выживания на 36 часов.

quote: Genes that result in a greater variety of immunities may give offspring a major survival advantage.
before: When a study asked women to smell T-shirts that had been worn by different men, they preferred the odors of those whose MHC molecules differed from theirs. This makes sense.
after: Our ears also determine attraction. Men prefer females with high-pitched, breathy voices, and wide formant spacing, correlated with smaller body size.
ru: Гены, влияющие на выработку иммунитета к большему количеству болезней, могут дать потомкам большое преимущество выживания.

quote: For most of human history, survival depended on making quick decisions with limited information.
before: So, if heuristics lead to all these wrong decisions, why do we even have them? Well, because they can be quite effective.
after: When there's no time to logically analyze all the possibilities, heuristics can sometimes save our lives. But today's environment requires far more complex decision-making, and these decisions are more biased by unconscious factors than we think, affecting everything from health and education to finance and criminal justice.
ru: Бо́льшую часть истории человечества выживание означало принятие быстрых решений при недостатке информации.

quote: Maddened by survival, I gravitated inwards towards books, poems and my brother's hand-me-down Walkman.
before: We built a movement and it traveled around the world and to Palestine, in 2015. AM: I was born to a single mother in the Pink House projects of Brooklyn, New York.
after: I saw train-station theater, subwoofing streets and hood murals. In high school, I found a community of metaphor magicians and truth-telling poets in an organization called Urban Word NYC.
ru: Я обезумела от выживания, меня затягивали книги, стихи и допотопный плеер моего брата.

quote: Daniel has only a five percent chance of survival without cancer chemotherapy treatments.
after: Previous testimony revealed that Hodgkin's lymphoma which was diagnosed January has a 90 to 95% success rate for survival with chemotherapy.

quote: Instead of looking for survivors, They start hauling these huge bags out of the wreck.
before: Yeah. And the guys that repelled out of them were like commandoes.
after: The bags were packed with cocaine. It was like the whole plane was packed with coke
ru: Вместо того, чтобы искать выживших, они начали увозить эти огромные сумки с места крушения.

quote: And I will never say that to another survivor again.
before: Now I hear it... and it doesn't do anything to ease the pain. Not one bit.
after: Yeah, right! You crazy? !
ru: И я ни разу не скажу так больше выжившим.

quote: All survivors, abandon all weapons and exit the ship.
before: This is a warning. Surrender your vessel immediately.
after: Silence will be interpreted as defiance. We will not hesitate to open fire! I gave my life to Harlock.
ru: Всем выжившим немедленно сложить оружие и покинуть корабль.

quote: Cornelia: 12 attempts at the same surgery with no survivors would drive any good man mad.
before: The whole event is just completely tragic and quite shocking. Who would have guessed Dr. Christiansen was so hopelessly lost?
after: Of course. His anguish is over, but hers is just beginning.
ru: 12 попыток одной и той же операции без выживших кого угодно сведут с ума.

quote: I am another image and vision of another survivor of war.
before: This is my story. I was that girl.
after: I am that refugee, and I am that girl. You see, I grew up in war-torn Iraq, and I believe that there are two sides of wars and we've only seen one side of it.
ru: Я - другое изображение другого выжившего в войне.

quote: But there were witnesses, survivors in the dark.
before: Extinction can come slowly, but sometimes it arrives fast. An asteroid hits, and the world went down in flames.
after: When the skies cleared, a new world was born. A world fit for mammals.
ru: Но были очевидцы, выжившие в темноте.

quote: But for the survivors, for the victims, for the marginalized communities, their stories, their truths, matter.
before: There are no easy solutions for human rights abuse. And there's not a single piece of technology that can ever stop the perpetrators.
after: And that is where justice begins. Thank you.
ru: Но для выживших, для жертв, для маргинальных сообществ эти истории, эти истины очень важны.

quote: Late Saturday evening, aviation officials confirmed the crash had no survivors.
after: So far, 120 victims have been identified through DNA analysis. Identification and bank cards were also being recovered by crews sifting through the wreckage.

quote: The celebrity sweat from celebrity bums in this seat.
before: But it's certainly got some memories. Think of the real fear and exhilaration experienced by real-life celebrities in this car.
after: What a life it's been. But now, it's at the end of its useful life, and because it's been such a hard life, we're not allowed to sell it.
ru: Звёдный пот от звёздных задов на этих креслах.

quote: And all the time I've got my gun on him, sweat running off me.
before: Not a tooth in his head. Then he sits on the sofa, lights up, you know, like winding me up.
after: In my eyes, down the back of my neck. And all the time he's just looking at me.
ru: А мое оружие все это время нацелено на него. По мне пот течет.

quote: And you and I at home, careless of God, abed in our sweat.
before: These, er, places, will ever make me think of you. The bells clanging, the faithful falling to their knees.
after: I would have those Sundays back. Well, we live in different times now.
ru: А мы с тобой дома, не волнуясь о боге, потные, в постели.

quote: Chips are earned through blood, sweat, and tears.
before: - Need something from you. - What?
after: When you've earned them, you'll get 'em back. Fair enough.
ru: Фишки зарабатываются кровью, потом и слезами.

quote: And the heat came on to add to the sweat.
before: And the shouts of response to the call of the prayer went up higher even still. And the organ rolled on in to add the dirge.
after: And my hand gripped firmer, so I wouldn't be the one left in the field. My eyes clenched tighter so I wouldn't see the wheat being separated from the chaff.
ru: Жара усиливалась, и по лицам бежал пот.

quote: And I pick him up, and I wipe sweat and cheap perfume off his forehead.
before: (Beat) And the good-for-nothings become good-for-disappearing into whatever toxic waste, chemical sludge shithole they crawled out of. And it's just me and janitor man.
after: And he begs me not to hurt him and I grab him tight by his janitor-man shirt collar, and I pull him to my face and he's taller than me but the cape helps, so he listens when I look him straight in the eyes. And I say two words to him: " Go home. "
ru: Я поднимаю его, вытираю пот и дешёвый парфюм с его лба.

quote: When they came out of the shaft, they were soaking wet from their own sweat.
before: Mercury is used in the extraction process. These miners are enslaved in a mine shaft in another part of Ghana.
after: I remember looking into their tired, bloodshot eyes, for many of them had been underground for 72 hours. The shafts are up to 300 feet deep, and they carry out heavy bags of stone that later will be transported to another area, where the stone will be pounded so that they can extract the gold.
ru: Когда они вышли из шахты, то были насквозь мокрыми от собственного пота.

quote: The survey also found that 39% of both sexes wear sweats while working from home.
before: A gender gap also exists for showering on work-at-home days, with 44% of women showering, while only 30% of men did.

quote: You didn't think it was sweet when I was jealous of you and Jenny.
before: I'm not smiling because it's funny. I'm smiling because it's sweet.
after: You and I weren't together then, but we are now. Right.
ru: Когда я ревновала тебя к Дженни, это тебе милым не казалось.

quote: I must admit Executive Manager Hiruma's manju (sweet bun) is always delicious!
before: You shouldn't be doing this. I certainly hope you like it.
after: They were special ordered, after all. We love 'em!
ru: что сладкие булочки от Директора Хирумы всегда восхитительны!

quote: Okay, go double on the peppered prawns and-and the sweet potato tarts.
before: Yes. Yes!
after: Yeah, all right, thank you, thank you. Oh, there he is! Ha.
ru: Ладно, удвойте креветки с перцем и ватрушки из сладкого картофеля.

quote: Frankie has told me so much about your sweet potato booth.
before: - Grace, meet my friend, Jacob. - Hey.
after: That's odd, seeing as how I'm a yam man. - Aren't they the same thing?
ru: Фрэнки столько рассказывала о вашем сладком картофеле.

quote: Sweet, sensitive, creative Tyler was secretly webcammed by his roommate while being intimate with another man.
before: The consequences for some have become dire, very dire. I was on the phone with my mom in September of 2010, and we were talking about the news of a young college freshman from Rutgers University, named Tyler Clementi.
after: When the online world learned of this incident, the ridicule and cyberbullying ignited. A few days later, Tyler jumped from the George Washington Bridge to his death.
ru: Милый, чувствительный, творчески одарённый Тайлер был тайком заснят на веб-камеру его соседом по комнате во время близости с другим мужчиной.

quote: Do you get less sweet porridge if you invest in shade-grown coffee instead of drinking it?
before: But here was the weird thing: 54 percent of the people still said if they put their money in those kinds of stocks, they thought that they would make less money. So is it true?
after: Well, you know, the investors in companies like Burt's Bees or Ben & amp; Jerry's wouldn't say so. Right?
ru: Вы полýчите меньше сладкой каши, если будете вкладывать в экологичный кофе, а не пить его?

quote: Well, it's certainly not because vanilla actually tastes sweet.
before: Even trained food assessors, and that's people who have been explicitly taught to disentangle the sense of smell and the sense of taste, may still be biased to evaluate products sweeter if they contain vanilla. Why?
after: It's because even these professionals are human, and have eaten lot of desserts, like us, and have therefore learned to associate sweetness and vanilla. So taste and smell and other sensory information is inextricably entangled in our conscious mind.
ru: Разумеется, не потому, что у ванили действительно сладкий вкус,

quote: Today the chicken is served across the US as fried chicken in a sweet, sticky sauce.
before: Peng conceived the famed dish, which is unknown in China, as unfried. Garlic and soy sauce provided flavour, as did chillies.
after: The chillies remain, with broccoli also appearing. Peng named it after Zuo Zongtang from his native Hunan Province; Zongtang assisted in suppressing the 19th-century Taiping Rebellion.

quote: Please, have the decency not to pretend that you feel any sympathy for me.
before: My sympathies. Sir, you are prosecuting me. I'm sitting in a courtroom, being charged with murder, primarily at your doing.
after: Fair enough. Let's agree to be honest with each other.
ru: Пожалуйста, хотя бы не притворяйтесь, что вы мне сочувствуете.

quote: So you showed your sympathy by shagging Mrs Fleming behind her back.
before: Yes. That's an awful thing for a woman of Frances' age.
after: After six months, I knew it had to end. But Sally beat me to the punch by telling me her husband had found out.
ru: И вы продемонстрировали ей своё сочувствие, трахая миссис Флеминг за её спиной.

quote: That won't stop Jean Loring from using them as props to drum up sympathy.
before: It's not fair. They're not the ones on trial.
after: You don't seem overly concerned. She confessed to being an accomplice on live television.
ru: Джина Лоринг с лёгкостью использует их, чтобы вызвать сочувствие.

quote: Well, you have my genuine sympathy, Mr. Brunelle, but I'm sorry, you can't have my help.
before: I need your talents. Connor needs your talents.
after: Mr. Brunelle, I admire your persistence, but I'm afraid human nature hasn't changed since your last visit. We remain awash with murder.
ru: Я вам искренне сочувствую Мистер Брунелл, но, к сожалению, не могу предложить вам свою помощь.

quote: And then if we're motivated to act on sympathy, I call that compassion.
before: Then there's something that I call sympathy, a little more removed: " I'm sorry to hear that your grandmother has just passed away. I don't feel that same grief, but I get it; I know what you feel and it concerns me. "
after: Far from being the thing that makes us human, human empathy is far from perfect. We round up empathic creatures, we kill them and we eat them.
ru: Если сочувствие мотивирует нас на какие-либо действия, я называю это состраданием.

quote: But when people learned what her son was accused of, she didn't get that sympathy.
before: I knew I would find her someday, or we would find each other. Because, when people heard that my son was a victim, I got immediate sympathy.
after: But her suffering is equal to mine. So we met in November 2002, and Aicha will now tell you how that came about.
ru: Когда же же люди узнавали, в чем обвиняют ее сына, она этого сочувствия не получала.

quote: We are deepened with the capacity for sympathy, for pity, imagination, compassion, commiseration.
before: We are endowed with the power to combine ideas recursively, to have thoughts about our thoughts. We have an instinct for language, allowing us to share the fruits of our ingenuity and experience.
after: These endowments have found ways to magnify their own power. The scope of language has been augmented by the written, printed and electronic word.

" (Laughter) Every day, we allow our coworkers, who are otherwise very, very nice people, to steal from us.

It wasn't until the American Civil War that canines actually accompanied soldiers into battle.

ru: Сатурн сопровождается очень большой и разнообразной коллекцией лун.

quote: We were expecting new particles and new phenomena accompanying the Higgs boson.
before: The Higgs boson does not share the beauty, the symmetry, the elegance, of the rest of the elementary particle world. For this reason, the majority of theoretical physicists believe that the Higgs boson could not be the full story.
after: Instead, so far, the measurements coming from the LHC show no signs of new particles or unexpected phenomena. Of course, the verdict is not definitive.
ru: Мы ожидаем открытия новых частиц и новых явлений, сопровождающих открытие бозона Хиггса.

quote: Stories accompany me, keeping my pieces and memories together, like an existential glue.
before: And since my husband is in Istanbul, I started commuting between Arizona and Istanbul — the two places on the surface of earth that couldn't be more different. I guess one part of me has always been a nomad, physically and spiritually.
after: Yet as much as I love stories, recently, I've also begun to think that they lose their magic if and when a story is seen as more than a story. And this is a subject that I would love to think about together.
ru: Истории сопровождают меня, соединяя мои произведения и воспоминания, как экзистенциальный клей.

ru: Теперь, только представь добро которое ты сможешь осуществить если ты используешь эту силу для создания будущее.

ru: За следующие тридцать дней необходимо выполнить объем работ, на который нужно втрое больше.

quote: They are getting a visual feedback in 2D, but the task they have to accomplish is 3D.

quote: You have a group of people trying to accomplish a mission greater than themselves; it's not about you.
before: I saw my friends battling these circumstances, and I watched the anxiety it produced in them and me, not being able to express our feelings about it. The military and theater communities are actually very similar.
after: You have a role, you have to know your role within that team. Every team has a leader or director; sometimes they're smart, sometimes they're not.
ru: У вас есть группа людей, пытающихся выполнить миссию, которая важнее, чем они сами, это не ради себя.

quote: So hopefully, you can accomplish your dreams as well, with this outlook.
before: (Video) ♫ Spider-Man theme song ♫ (Applause) Thank you. All right, all right, so — That was pretty cool, and so I was able to accomplish my dream of playing snare drum with the marching band, as I believe I can do for all of my dreams.
after: The next aspect to my philosophy is that I surround myself with people I want to be with, people of high quality. I’ m extremely lucky to have an amazing family, who have always supported me throughout my entire life.
ru: Итак, надеюсь, что вы также сможете осуществить свою мечту, с такой установкой.

quote: Working with local partners would be an option to accomplish this, according to Coonen.

ru: Желает ли обвиняемый предоставить суду смягчающие обстоятельства?

ru: Не обвиняй меня в убийстве на глазах у моих людей.

after: Two brothers are found guilty of massacring their parents. And the government tells us that almost 16% of the murders committed in this country are perpetrated by one family member against another.
ru: Всемирно известный футболист обвиняется в казни своей жены.

quote: I've been accused of running a brothel, accused of being a spy.
before: Now, with my job, there's above-average amount of risks that are involved. I've been temporarily detained.
after: I've had a grenade thrown at my office. It didn't go off, though.
ru: обвиняли в содержании притона, обвиняли в шпионаже.

quote: When my friends on Twitter stopped accusing and started asking questions, I almost automatically mirrored them.
before: That's important because we can't present effective arguments if we don't understand where the other side is actually coming from and because it gives them an opportunity to point out flaws in our positions. But asking questions serves another purpose; it signals to someone that they're being heard.
after: Their questions gave me room to speak, but they also gave me permission to ask them questions and to truly hear their responses. It fundamentally changed the dynamic of our conversation.
ru: Когда мои друзья в Twitter прекратили обвинять и начали задавать вопросы, я почти на автомате начала отвечать им тем же.

before: You drive 19 long hours back home. And when you get there, the police are waiting on you.
after: You tell anybody and everybody who will listen, " I didn't do it! I couldn't have done it!
ru: Они обвиняют вас в преступлении, которое было совершено, пока вы были во Флориде.

quote: Achieving goals, mastering skills, the opponent isn't the other team, it's really just yourself.

after: And if you've worked hard, and done the absolute best that you can, then no matter what the scoreboard says, you are the winner in the game of life. You can hold your head high...
ru: Достигайте целей, улучшайте свои навыки, ваш настоящий противник - это не не другая команда, а вы сами.

ru: Моё руководство интересуют результаты, но они не меньше озабочены тем, как я их достигаю.

quote: Let's discuss your best outcome here and how I can help you achieve it.
before: It's impossible. So let's talk about what you really want.
after: You talk this much in bed? You this... chatty on your hands and knees?
ru: Давай обсудим твою выгоду в этом деле, и то, чем я могу помочь, чтобы ее добиться.

quote: These problems still seem very daunting and very intractable, and any solutions we're achieving are small solutions.

after: We're making incremental progress. What's the fundamental problem we have in dealing with these social problems?
ru: Эти проблемы всё ещё кажутся очень устрашающими и очень неподатливыми, и любые решения, которых мы достигаем — это малые решения.

quote: That can only be achieved through debate, critical conversation and insisting on dialogue that doesn't demonize people.

Yes, the girl falls, absurd to fall, even the earth with its compulsion to take unto itself all that falls must know that falling is absurd, yet the girl falling isn't myself, or she is myself, but a self I took of my own volition unto myself.

ru: Признаваться в своих грехах - страшно.

ru: Потому что ты едва признавал меня в мой последний рабочий день.

ru: Мы не хотим даже признавать существование женщин, которые занимаются сексом с женщинами или не хотят иметь детей.

ru: И требуйте от своих учителей, чтобы они их признавали и славили.

after: Their goal wasn't to make Fiona as normal as possible; their goal was simply to help her be as independent as possible so that she could fulfill her potential, however that looked for her. But the culture at large does not take this open attitude about disabilities.
ru: Они признавали её ограничения, но видели и сильные стороны, и принимали её такой, какая она есть.

ru: Но вы приобретали собственность государства через подставные фирмы, не так ли?

after: One of them probably just sold that day. Well, I mean, that's what I thought, but... look.
ru: Сильвер и Брен продают и приобретают недвижимость постоянно.

after: Yes. It belonged to the Navy.
ru: Приобретающий её должен обладать весьма специфичными навыками.

before: Language evolved to solve the crisis of visual theft. Language is a piece of social technology for enhancing the benefits of cooperation — for reaching agreements, for striking deals and for coordinating our activities.
after: Just as wings open up this sphere of air for birds to exploit, language opened up the sphere of cooperation for humans to exploit. And we take this utterly for granted, because we're a species that is so at home with language, but you have to realize that even the simplest acts of exchange that we engage in are utterly dependent upon language.
ru: И можно видеть, как в развивающемся обществе, только начинающем приобретать язык, не иметь язык -- это всё равно что птице не иметь крыльев.

quote: Values are acquired; doctrine and dogma are imposed -- the two opposing mechanisms.
before: Remoteness affects the quality of education. Educational technology should be introduced into remote areas first, and other areas later.
after: And learning is most likely a self-organizing system. If you put all the four together, then it gives — according to me — it gives us a goal, a vision, for educational technology.
ru: Ценности приобретаются, доктрины и догмы навязывают, это два противоположных механизма.

ru: Вы приобретаете отношения с компанией.

after: Oracle has offices in more than 145 countries, and employs over 50,000 people. This acquisition will make Oracle the largest customer relationship management (CRM) applications company in the world.

after: Rush is right. We have to take them down, and we have to do it right now.
ru: И это еще одна причина, чтобы действовать немедленно.

ru: Было бы понятно, если бы вы действовали исключительно по просьбе начальства.

after: We should wait until her intentions become clear. She intends to destroy us.
ru: Если мы будем действовать в спешке, то рискуем разоблачить себя.

ru: Быть не может, чтобы Акоста действовал в одиночку.

quote: It can be frightening to act, but sometimes, not acting is worse.
before: To combat it, we spray pesticides that do grave damage to other species, including amphibians and birds. So when you hear about gene drives in the coming months, and trust me, you will be hearing about them, remember that.
after: (Applause)
ru: Действовать бывает страшно, но бездействие порой гораздо хуже.

quote: B: You have to act socio-centrically, not egocentrically.
before: The key to heroism is two things. You have to act when other people are passive.
after: And I want to end with a known story about Wesley Autrey, New York subway hero. Fifty-year-old African-American construction worker standing on a subway.
ru: Б: действовать надо ради общего блага, а не собственного.

quote: If you give people responsibility, they act responsibly.
before: The fool can't even separate his recycling. " But the perhaps surprising but overwhelming and compelling evidence from all these modern examples is that it does work.
after: Don't get me wrong — it's not a panacea. The question is not: Would this be perfect?
ru: Дайте человеку ответственность, и он будет действовать ответственно.

quote: Police believe Loibl acted alone and, since he is deceased, they closed their case on Wednesday.
before: Investigators were unable to crack the encryption on Loibl's phone, and it appeared he had destroyed his computer's hard drive.
after: They offered no motive for the shooting.

quote: We have to adapt to the situations and worlds we find ourselves in.
before: Now, if a cobra decides to sit in the middle of that path, do I walk on and get bitten? Or do I take the other path and live?
after: The alternative... Is you'll get your arse bitten by a snake. Yes.
ru: Мы должны приспосабливаться к ситуациям и миру в котором мы находимся.

quote: Some find it harder to adapt than others.
before: You'd think the only shovel he'd ever handled was a teaspoon. It probably was.
after: Well, he gets on my nerves. It takes all sorts to make a world, Pet.
ru: Некоторым труднее приспосабливаться.

quote: You have to realize that these are dangerous times, and we have to adapt.
before: But whatever decision I come to, it stands. Those men show up every morning for you because I tell them to.
after: It's not like when we was driving. No. No, it's not.
ru: Ты должен понять, мы живем в опасное время. Придется приспосабливаться.

quote: And if we can't adapt, we die.
before: And you need to respect the chain of command. Things change.
after: I did my research. What was wrong with the old design?
ru: Если мы не приспосабливаемся, мы умираем.

quote: Evolution is all about passing on the genome to the next generation, adapting and surviving through generation after generation.
before: I wanted to restore health from disease. I wanted us to live long and healthy lives.
after: From an evolutionary point of view, you and I are like the booster rockets designed to send the genetic payload into the next level of orbit and then drop off into the sea. I think we would all understand the sentiment that Woody Allen expressed when he said, " I don't want to achieve immortality through my work.
ru: Для эволюции же главное – передать геном следующему поколению, приспосабливаясь и выживая от поколения к поколению.

quote: The resulting cycle of damage and repair eventually makes muscles bigger and stronger as they adapt to progressively greater demands.
before: This is when the muscle-building magic happens. The greater the damage to the muscle tissue, the more your body will need to repair itself.
after: Since our bodies have already adapted to most everyday activities, those generally don't produce enough stress to stimulate new muscle growth. So, to build new muscle, a process called hypertrophy, our cells need to be exposed to higher workloads than they are used to.
ru: В результате циклов таких повреждений и восстановлений мышцы становятся больше и сильнее, поскольку соответственно приспосабливаются к бо́льшим потребностям.

quote: I also loved looking at how animals have adapted to the African landscape.

And I — you know, there's a number of people I met — I met this guy who runs a conservation site at a party, and he said, " You know, I wasn't making any money.

after: This is only a few weeks ago. You can see the stability and control is really quite nice, and I'd like to think this somewhat validates that starting hypothesis, that the human mind and body, if properly augmented in that way, can achieve some pretty cool stuff.
ru: Со временем шум от реактивного двигателя начинает раздражать.

quote: Eu is annoyed that public is unable to ask questions during the debate.

quote: Mr. Nordquist, I must compel you to answer.

after: Lockhart/Gardner brings costly nuisance suits against us. Ah... so this isn't about handicapped children.
ru: Мистер Нордквист, я должен заставить вас отвечать.

after: This one question will define your professional success more than any other, because how you show up and treat people means everything. Either you lift people up by respecting them, making them feel valued, appreciated and heard, or you hold people down by making them feel small, insulted, disregarded or excluded.
ru: Это простой вопрос, и вы — осознанно или нет — ежедневно отвечаете на него с помощью действий.

quote: To conclude, we've got a lot of questions to ask, and like I said, we'll ask questions here, not answer them.
before: You have heightened brain activity when you're doing a comparable task, when that one task is creative and the other task is memorized. It's very preliminary, but I think it's kind of cool.
after: But we want to get at the root of what is creative genius neurologically, and I think, with these methods, we're getting close. And I think, hopefully in the next 10, 20 years, you'll see real, meaningful studies that say science has to catch up to art, and maybe we're starting now to get there.
ru: У нас много вопросов, и, как я уже сказал, здесь я задаю вопросы, а не отвечаю на них.

quote: The local SPCA and some animal rescues were under tents answering questions from visitors.

after: - So hard your friend? - Yes, my dead friend.

ru: По сравнению с жизнью, Хэнк, стрельба по тарелкам дает нам возможность предвидеть цели.

ru: Порою, я должна уметь предвидеть, быть гибкой и двигаться так быстро, как только могу.

quote: But something interesting happened, something I didn't anticipate.
before: Just my palms sweating and the robot's new servos heating up. (Laughs) Clearly, we were not built for this.
after: See, D.O.U.G., in its primitive form, wasn't tracking my line perfectly. While in the simulation that happened onscreen it was pixel-perfect, in physical reality, it was a different story.
ru: Но кое-что интересное случилось в тот день, чего я не могла предвидеть.

quote: It anticipated change, even though those changes were not known.
before: And what they were saying on this occasion was that our competitors had to build new buildings for the new technology. We were fortunate, because in a way our building was future-proofed.
after: Round about that design period leading up to this building, I did a sketch, which we pulled out of the archive recently. And I was saying, and I wrote, " But we don't have the time, and we really don't have the immediate expertise at a technical level. "
ru: Оно предвидело перемены, хоть они были неизвестны.

ru: Это он должен звонить и извиняться.

quote: You don't have to apologize, but you should probably go.

ru: Тебе не нужно извиняться. Но тебе лучше уйти, пожалуйста.

ru: Во-первых, я хочу искренне извиниться за всё что сказал о Кимберли.

ru: Посмотрите, как я сама смогла извиниться перед своей жертвой.

You want to appear worse than you are.

after: Take your enemy's expectations and turn them against him. To make a good-sized fireball without a lot of ordnance, you need a powder with a high surface-area-to-mass ratio.
ru: Когда противник превосходит и числом и вооружением, ключ в том, чтобы казаться многочисленнее и сильнее, чем есть на самом деле.

after: Speech patterns that deviated from the written rules were considered corruptions, or signs of low social status, and many people who had grown up speaking in these ways were forced to adopt the standardized form. More recently, however, linguists have understood that speech is a separate phenomenon from writing with its own regularities and patterns.

ru: И хотя я ценила их заботу, мне всё равно нужны были дедлайны.

Well, I use my drum to tell my story and my people's stories.
