before: But what Sergio was talking about is, let's calibrate our relationship to the threat. Let's not hype the threat; let's actually see it clearly.
after: We have reason to be afraid that we haven't secured loose nuclear material in the former Soviet Union. Let's focus on what are the legitimate challenges and threats, but not lunge into bad decisions because of a panic, of a fear.
ru: У нас есть основания бояться таяния ледников.

quote: It was as if they knew they should be afraid, and yet they weren't.
before: And this is really interesting. Even though people who were given Propranolol while the memory was in edit mode were no longer afraid of that frightening trigger cue, they could still describe the relationship between the cue and the frightening outcome.
after: This suggests that Propranolol can selectively target the non-declarative emotional memory but leave the declarative event memory intact. But critically, Propranolol can only have any effect on the memory if it's in edit mode.
ru: Как будто они знали, что должны бояться, но им не было страшно.

quote: Roban took the case away because he was fed up with your selfishness!
before: Your wisdom does you credit. In the future put it to good use.
after: And you keep capitalising on the tips for your own benefit! What's in your head?
ru: Робан передал это дело потому, что был сыт по горло твоим эгоизмом!

quote: But if you're fed up with me, I'd understand.
before: I got ready and... and then I just bottled it. I felt terrible, and that's why I went for a drink.
after: I never said that. It's ok.
ru: Если ты сыта мной по горло, так и скажи, я понимаю.

quote: I'm fed up with this sanctimonious nonsense from saint bloody Peter.
before: Oh, fuck off. Stop telling me what to do.
after: I disappoint you, do I? Good.
ru: Я сыт по горло этой ханжеской ахинеей от новоявленного Святого Петра.

quote: I'm fed up with you, your behaviour.
before: Are you drinking? !
after: I'm fed up with it! You spoil everything, you come late to rehearsals, you forget your lines.
ru: Мне надоело ваше поведение.

quote: I'm fed up with the power that a few exert over the many through gender, income, race, and class.
before: Women and children, especially the poor, are at the bottom. Even the most destitute of men have someone they can abuse — a woman or a child.
after: I think that the time is ripe to make fundamental changes in our civilization. But for real change, we need feminine energy in the management of the world.
ru: Я сыта по горло властью, которой пользуется кучка людей для дискриминации по половому, имущественному, расовому или классовому признаку.

quote: He was fed up with it.
before: And it came to a head when I met this young man in front of the sports center. And he told me that he had voted to leave, because the European Union had done nothing for him.
after: And all around town, people told me the same thing. They said that they wanted to take back control, which was one of the slogans in the campaign.
ru: Ему это надоело.

quote: In 1948, Spanish ophthalmologist Jose Ignacio Barraquer Moner was fed up with glasses.
after: He wanted a solution for blurry vision that fixed the eye itself, without relying on external aids. But the surgery he eventually devised was not for the faint of heart.
ru: В 1948 году испанскому офтальмологу Хосе Игнасио Барракеру-Монеру ужасно надоели очки.

quote: Some of the emails I've had are simply appalling and I'm fed up with it."
before: Some MPs have said negative emails from opponents have prompted them to support the Bill. An anonymous MP told The Independent: "Quite a few of us who were considering abstaining will vote in favour of gay marriage because of the unreasonable nature of the emails we have been receiving.
ru: Некоторые письма просто ужасны, и я сыт этим по горло.

quote: He was very keen on games and the good of the country.
before: He was dressed in a long frock coat. He looked like a military man; his moustache was waxed, his gray hair was short and neat, he held himself upright, he talked in a breezy way, he lived at Enfield.
after: He was an officer in the Hertfordshire Yeomanry and chairman of the Conservative Association. When he was told that a local magnate had said no one would take him for a City man, he felt that he had not lived in vain.
ru: Он очень увлекался играми и благом страны.

quote: I know you're not keen on a Dan deja vu.
before: And when I find out what secret you've been keeping and why, you will pay. Hey, thanks for covering for me.
after: Well, it's a sacrifice that I can handle. It's yours that I'm worried about, though.
ru: Я знаю, ты не в восторге от всего этого "дежа вю" с Дэном.

quote: I told you, they're very keen on the rocket ship thing with the astronaut anecdotes.
before: I want to go over where we are on Chevrolet again and devote our final days to overdoing it on the artwork for the top three campaigns. I cannot look at these again.
after: You told them about the astronauts? I had to.
ru: Я говорил тебе, им очень нравится идея с ракетой и с анекдотами об астронавтах.

quote: That man is so keen on hunting rebels, but all he does is create new ones.
before: I thought this Townsend already refused you. He changed his mind after Simcoe and his Rangers torched his father's stables.
after: Well, he may live to regret this one. Let's see what Culper Jr. Has to say.
ru: Этот чудак так жаждет найти всех мятежников, но благодаря ему их количество только растет.

quote: So this is why you've been so keen on finishing Project Looking Glass.
before: - I thought that was impossible. - As did I.
after: The people from that world want to destroy what we've built. I was only trying to protect you.
ru: Так поэтому ты так стремилась закончить проект "Взирающее Стекло".

quote: They were keen on reading it and knowing more and more about periods on their own.
before: While making the book, we took great care that none of the illustrations were objectionable in any way and that it is culturally sensitive. During our prototype testing, we found that the girls loved the book.
after: Parents and teachers were comfortable in talking about periods to young girls using the book, and sometimes even boys were interested in reading it. (Laughter) (Applause) The comic book helped in creating an environment where menstruation ceased to be a taboo.
ru: Они были увлечены, узнавая больше и больше о месячных самостоятельно.

quote: The good NGOs, like Oxfam, are very keen on this idea.
before: Another is, you can make NGOs accountable. You can use yardstick competition, so they have to compete against each other for the resources.
after: They want to have the discipline and accountability. So that's a way to get basic services scaled up.
ru: Достойные НПО, как например Oxfam, с энтузиазмом поддерживают эту идею.

quote: Australians have never been keen on the idea of a national identity card.
after: The idea for a national identity card first appeared in 1985 with a proposal for the Australia Card but was eventually given up upon, since then the idea has resurfaced on numerous occasions, most recently in 2002 after the London bombings. Mr Howard said his government had looked into a national identity card but the disadvantages outweighed the advantages.
ru: Австралийцы никогда не горели желанием вводить национальное удостоверение личности.

quote: So I guess the wedding is on hold?
before: You never know. I know.
after: There's not going to be a wedding, there already was a wedding and that's the only wedding I'm paying for. Maybe Anne will want to pay for it all by herself.
ru: - Я так понимаю свадьба приостановлена?

quote: E-everything's been on hold because of what happened.
before: On the machine. The information I gave you in Alexandria.
after: It can't be on hold. The plant where they're grinding the propellers is moving.
ru: Всё было приостановлено из-за случившегося.

quote: Maybe your dreams are on hold right now.
before: And I help my dad with business stuff. Accountant.
after: No? That's a nice way of putting it.
ru: Может, твои мечты просто взяли паузу.

quote: Your business is on hold until we let you know.
before: No,I can't stay put. I got business all over the world,I'm sorry.
after: Fine. Oh,hey,you are one smoking lady.
ru: Бизнес приостановлен до тех пор, пока мы не сообщим.

word: to be on the safe side
quote: I'd like to just run him around your vehicle, just to be on the safe side.
before: He's 17 years old, being questioned by a police officer. - You're probably right, but, if you don't mind, I have my K-9 in my car here.
after: Officer, are we being profiled here? - I... - Well, I was asleep in the backseat, and you saw two kids driving at 8:00 in the morning.

before: Oh, but that shouldn't matter to you, 'cause you're innocent, right? Yeah, that is right, actually, but you know what?
after: Dr. Hodgins. Everything all right?
ru: Просто на всякий случай я хочу проконсультироваться с адвокатом.

word: to be on the safe side
quote: We'll arrange some bloods to be on the safe side.
before: Now, Sally, find something pretty for Mavis. That's nice, I like that one.
after: But I can't find anything wrong with you a proper rest won't cure. I wouldn't say no to a day in bed and that's not like me.

word: to be on the safe side

before: But we know where we belong, don't we? - Are you coming with us?
after: But you don't need me -- you've got him. You really have -- and he knows how to take care of his family.
ru: - Да, я поеду прямо за вами, просто для подстраховки.

before: I don't think she's a bad person. She was my friend.
after: Oh, that girl's... babe, behind you. Hello.
ru: Просто... Мы должны все быть на одной волне

word: to be on the same page
quote: There's never a time when everyone will be on the same page, share the same lens, or know the same history.
before: And if we truly listen to one another, we will hear things that demand that we shift our own perceptions. There is no perfect time and there is no perfect place to start a difficult conversation.
after: So, let's talk about listening and how to be a good listener. There's lots of ways to be a good listener and I'm going to give you just a couple.
ru: Никогда не настанет момент, когда все на одной волне, разделяют одни взгляды и знают одну и ту же историю.

quote: I know, but I think we're on track.
before: I understand. Well, we have a lot of work to do before the benefit, don't we?
after: We're doing quite well. It's so good.
ru: Я знаю, нo, пo-мoему, мы успеваем.

before: No. No, Will.
after: It's important to all of us. We've heard a lot about the Pinn project, doctor Caster.
ru: Они просто хотят знать как продвигается работа.

quote: I run this place, I look after these men, I make sure the work is on track.
before: There's only one and I hold it. And I'm asking for it.
after: I've earned this position. Making amends with your brother doesn't give you the right to challenge my authority.
ru: Я тут главный, я отвечаю за людей, руковожу работами на стройке.

quote: So, as the president now reassures us, we are on track to achieve our goals.
before: The story that we're told is that there was a " light footprint " initially — in other words, that we ended up in a situation where we didn't have enough troops, we didn't have enough resources, that Afghans were frustrated — they felt there wasn't enough progress and economic development and security, and therefore the Taliban came back — that we responded in 2005 and 2006 with troop deployments, but we still didn't put enough troops on the ground. And that it wasn't until 2009, when President Obama signed off on a surge, that we finally had, in the words of Secretary Clinton, " the strategy, the leadership and the resources. "
after: All of this is wrong. Every one of those statements is wrong.
ru: итак , как президент заверяет нас, мы на пути достижения наших целей.

before: I was completely wrong. I entered the sphere a week before the scheduled air date.
after: Two days before my big breath-hold attempt, for the record, the producers of my television special thought that just watching somebody holding their breath, and almost drowning, is too boring for television. (Laughter) So, I had to add handcuffs, while holding my breath, to escape from.
ru: И я думал, что всё идёт по плану.

quote: According to the launch director, Pete Nickolenko, "We're on track and ready to go for Monday."
before: On Saturday, mission managers unanimously voted to proceed with the mission after engineers ruled out any safety concerns with the shuttle's booster rockets. During off-site testing, two problems with the boosters appeared, though both were determined to have no impact if they were to occur during lift-off.
after: The launch is expected to occur at 0621 local time (1121 UTC) Monday morning, about an hour before sunrise, and will be the 131st space shuttle mission.

ru: Я по уши в деле Кэтрин Нолан.

after: Where's Chloe? I thought she was gonna be with you all day?
ru: Я завалена работой, помогая Эшу с мальчишником.

quote: Because you just said that you were swamped with work.

before: Yeah, okay. All right. Maybe we'll just drive a bit.
after: Look at this entrance. No one's going home to their significant other, because I no longer have one.
ru: Что ж, сучечки, надеюсь, вы готовы, нажраться сегодня?

before: That is the past. This, right here... this is the future, and the flamingo is only the start, the first seed of what will be a mighty forest.
after: And guess where they're gonna bring it... right here! I need to count on you to make Meyer understand.
ru: Огромное количество людей готово играть на деньги.

after: I owe you one, so why don't we just grab some dinner first? My treat.
ru: Подумала, что ты не будешь против пойти на Курта Рассела.

before: She didn't even come down for supper. Well, our D.A. wanted us to reach out.

quote: Well, that will be up to her.

after: What are you gonnae do? Brodie?

quote: Well, I guess that'll be up to you.

ru: Ну, наверное, это тебе решать.

ru: Вот я и не могу понять, стоит ли пытаться развиваться самой?

after: Like a job? I don't know.
ru: Ну что, все еще думаешь, что твоё молчание чего-то стоит?

ru: Такой катер новым стоит один миллион евро.

quote: And decided that it was worth taking the time to write this down as a law.
before: Someone must have seen a black person and a white person playing checkers with someone in some town square. after: This caste system was so arcane that in courtrooms throughout the South there was actually a black Bible and an altogether separate white Bible to swear to tell the truth on in court. The very word of God was segregated in the caste system of the Jim Crow South.

quote: And that, I think, is an idea worth spreading.

after: (Applause)

quote: We can find a way to beat them.

quote: You don't beat it once and it's gone forever.

after: It's something you live with. It's something you live in.
ru: У вас не получится победить её раз и навсегда.

ru: Чтобы ударить тебя, мне пришлось бы стать тобой, а я выше этого.

quote: It's like you're trapped indoors, breathing this hospital air.
before: So it's a beautiful day out, huh? I wish people had told me how much I was gonna miss being outside before I checked in.
after: Never feeling the wind or... smelling the rain or anything. It's just sad.
ru: Быть запертым в этих больничных стенах, дышать этим воздухом,

quote: That means, once it's removed, you will not be able to breathe on your own.
before: I want to make sure you understand what this means. The ventilator is breathing for you.
after: Now, if you can't breathe... you will die. It might take a few hours... probably less.
ru: Это значит, что как только мы отключим его, вы не сможете самостоятельно дышать.

quote: He appeared to have been stabbed and was not breathing.
before: When Detective Liem and I interviewed Ms. Aubrey, she informed us she hikes daily at Huckleberry Regional Preserve and usually arrives around 2:00 P.M. She was on her usual trail about a mile from the parking lot when she discovered Mr. Schorr.
after: First theory... The killers went to the home sometime after midnight to either deliver or collect various types and amounts of narcotics, that an argument ensued either over the money or the possibility of bad drugs, and the suspect, or suspects, "armed with a knife and gun, proceeded..."
ru: Похоже, он был зарезан, и уже не дышал.

quote: He fell to the ground. He stopped breathing.
before: Jini's younger brother Kimong has autism. And when he was seven, he had his first grand mal seizure at Disneyland.
after: Jini's parents are Korean immigrants. They came to the country with limited resources speaking little English, so it was up to Jini to enroll her family in Medicaid.
ru: Он упал на землю, перестал дышать.

quote: Learning how to breathe better is learning how to live better.
before: We breathe with our first breath at birth, up until our last one. Breathing gives rhythm to our lives.
after: Holding your breath in the sea, not necessarily at 100 meters, but maybe at two or three, putting on your goggles, a pair of flippers, means you can go see another world, another universe, completely magical. You can see little fish, seaweed, the flora and fauna, you can watch it all discreetly, sliding underwater, looking around, and coming back to the surface, leaving no trace.
ru: Учиться, как лучше дышать, значит учиться, как лучше жить.

quote: It's about eight times heavier than the air we're used to breathing.
before: And this future air has some very sensual qualities. It's very heavy.
after: It's so heavy, in fact, that when you breathe it in, whatever words you speak are kind of literally heavy as well, so they dribble down your chin and drop to the floor and soak into the cracks. It's an air that operates quite a lot like a liquid.
ru: Он примерно в восемь раз тяжелее, чем воздух, которым мы привыкли дышать.

quote: The one thing that breathed life into this meme was Mr. Beck's reaction to it.
before: Had Mr. Beck simply ignored this meme, it likely would have died out. Most internet memes die quickly.

quote: And we keep breeding you not to chase foxes, but to be cute.
before: You think you're you when you wanna chase the foxes, but other people planted that in you years ago. And now, somewhat arbitrarily, you're considered very cute by us humans.
after: And we put you in television shows and movies, and you're chasing tennis balls because they're as close to a fox as you're gonna get. - Hey, Liz.
ru: И продолжаем разводить вас уже не для охоты на лис, а потому что вы милые и забавные.

quote: They're using human bodies to breed them
before: What did you see? This is a nursery for parasites!
after: So the parasites in the Imperial Tribute tea were bred in human bodies! This is the true face of Huo Yi's master plan
ru: Они используют человеческие тела... чтобы разводить их.

quote: But, darling, Prescott is just waiting for you to retire so he can breed you like one.
before: A serval in an emerald collar. I'm not an animal.
after: I'm sorry. Prescott is... none of my business.
ru: - Но, милая, Прескотт просто ждет, когда ты уйдешь со сцены, чтобы заставить тебя размножаться, как скотину.

quote: He said he bred horses in England, and that's all I can recall, unfortunately.
before: No-one directed me, Mr Crown. I met Mr Green without the 'e' at a party in Marrakesh.
after: But there is a vase, with an 'e', is there not? I've got a photo of it here in my bundle.
ru: Он сказал, что разводит лошадей в Англии, и это всё, что я могу вспомнить, к сожалению.

quote: You name it, I bred it, and I sold them to pet shops.
before: One was a passion for rodents. I had all kinds of rats, mice, hamsters, gerbils, squirrels.
after: (Laughter) I also had a passion for Africa. Growing up in a multicultural environment, we had African students in the house, and I learned about their stories, so different backgrounds, dependency on imported know-how, goods, services, exuberant cultural diversity.
ru: Назовите любой вид - я точно его разводил и продавал в магазины.

quote: They're looking for somewhere to breed. If it rains here they'll breed.
before: And the dragonflies you can see today outside here, on the campus, are the young of this generation. They hatched out in India.
after: But most of them are going to carry on. And next stop, perhaps only four or five days away is going to be East Africa.
ru: Они ищут место для размножения. Если здесь пойдут дожди, они будут размножаться.

quote: Conservation group gets together, tries to figure out how to breed an animal that's almost extinct.
before: And you can do strange things with this stuff. This is a baby gaur.
after: They can't do it naturally, so what they do with this thing is they take a spoon, take some cells out of an adult gaur's mouth, code, take the cells from that and insert it into a fertilized cow's egg, reprogram cow's egg — different gene code. When you do that, the cow gives birth to a gaur.
ru: Это детеныш щуки Группа по сохранению вымирающих видов собирается вместе и пытается придумать, как заставить размножаться животное, которое находится под угрозой исчезновения.

quote: Scientists say the shark only breeds off the S.
before: According to Dr. Quattro, "if South Carolina's waters are the primary nursery grounds for the cryptic species and females gather here to reproduce, these areas should be conservation priorities."
after: Carolina coast and that it is at a risk for extinction. "Management plans are needed to ensure that these sharks are not adversely impacted so that we can learn more," added Dr. Quattro.

quote: And he recognized you as someone who brought a package to the post office that day.
before: A postal worker identified me as the person who brought him that envelope? No. I showed him photos of ASAs.
after: That is an air-tight case. He said you would have received a receipt just like this.
ru: И он узнал тебя, как человека, который приносил сверток на почту в тот день.

quote: Well, believe it or not, my parents used to bring us here when we were kids.
before: Something you two want to tell us? Where did you find this place?
after: Your parents? They brought you here?
ru: Веришь или нет, мои родители привозили меня сюда в детстве.

quote: So you were the one who brought all the prostitutes?
before: They called me "the Coho King." Pretty much single-handedly organized those things myself.
after: Uh... Whoa, whoa, whoa. Can we slow down? Why?
ru: Так значит это вы привозили туда всех этих проституток?

quote: I would make it and bring it to her in bed.
before: Okay. Um... for as long as I can remember, I've woken up at 6:30 every day to make Shelly coffee, splash of milk, two sugars.
after: She says that her day doesn't even start until she's got caffeine in her veins. And then one day, woke up, 6:30... like always, and I made myself one.
ru: Я делал это и приносил ей в постель.

quote: It's what brings that lightning.
before: And those are the two critical elements of a music city, a city whose leaders recognize the importance of music for our development as individuals, our connection as a community and our viability as a vibrant place to live. See, smart cities, music cities, know that thriving nightlife, a creative class, culture is what attracts young, talented people to cities.
after: And no, we can't predict the next egg that will hatch, but we can create a city that acts like an incubator. To do that, first, we've got to know what we've got.
ru: Это то, что приносит ту самую удачу.

quote: The bomb caused a 15-foot wide crater, and brought down the west wing of the hotel.
after: An injured guest, Jawad Chaudhry, said, "The floor under my feet shook. I thought the roof was falling on me.

quote: It was grandfather who brought about a reconciliation with the Shimerdas.
after: One morning he told us that the small grain was coming on so well, he thought he would begin to cut his wheat on the first of July. He would need more men, and if it were agreeable to everyone he would engage Ambrosch for the reaping and threshing, as the Shimerdas had no small grain of their own.
ru: Это дедушка добился примирения с Шимердами.

quote: He hated himself and he hated the fate that had brought about his humiliation.
before: George heard the man and woman making their way through the bushes. As he crept down the hillside his heart was sick within him.
after: When his mind went back to the hour alone in the alleyway he was puzzled and stopping in the darkness listened, hoping to hear again the voice outside himself that had so short a time before put new courage into his heart. When his way homeward led him again into the street of frame houses he could not bear the sight and began to run, wanting to get quickly out of the neighborhood that now seemed to him utterly squalid and commonplace.
ru: Он ненавидел себя и судьбу, которая довела его до унижения.

quote: It took a lot of work to bring about our reunion.
before: Oh, my. I wouldn't undersell it.
after: Reunion? Have we met before?
ru: На наше воссоединение ушло немало сил.

quote: And their descendents, the Minoans, brought about the end of their civilization trying to reclaim it.
before: I find this notion romantic but um... ..unlikely. No, I believe it was transcribed by the elders of an ancient civilization in Crete... 9,000 years before Christ, in a place that later became the legendary lost City of Atlantis.
after: And that sounds more likely? Whoever lays their hands on the Book of Leaves will rule all of Italy... if not the world.
ru: А их потомки, минойцы, привели свою цивилизацию к гибели, пытаясь вернуть книгу.

quote: Look, like I've told you, we're doing everything we possibly can to see what brought about that lion attack.
before: Really? I came to ask you a few questions-- the last thing I expected to find was you having a party one day after three people died on your watch.
after: Well, then would you care to comment on information we have in regards to the zoo's choice of food suppliers being adjusted due to budgetary restrictions? Information culled from where, Ms. Campbell? Our previous vendors?
ru: Я уже вам говорил, мы делаем всё возможное в расследовании причины этих нападений.

quote: Anger has a long history of bringing about positive change; but, in addition to being angry, I'm also hopeful.
before: Gender as it functions today is a grave injustice. We should all be angry.
after: Because I believe deeply in the ability of human beings to make and remake themselves for the better. Gender matters everywhere in the world, but I want to focus on Nigeria and on Africa in general, because it is where I know, and because it is where my heart is.
ru: Гнев издавна приводил к позитивным переменам; но я не только злюсь — я ещё и надеюсь.
source_ru: Благодаря подобной ярости произошло много хороших перемен; но, помимо ярости, я полна надежды.

quote: And then Barack Obama, hopeful that he, too, may bring about change.
before: Then, as segregation raged in much of the country, young black people helped spearhead civil rights campaigns in the 1950s and 1960s. After that, some people embraced black power and then became Black Panthers and then the next generation, they turned to hip-hop to make sure their voices were heard.
after: And when that failed, when we realized we were still brutalized and battered, we had to let the world know that our lives still mattered. Now, when technology allows more video of our pain and struggle to be broadcast to the world, we wonder, like, what is next?
ru: Затем появился Барак Обама, и мы надеялись, что вместе с ним придут перемены.

quote: And that largely helped bring about an end to the official policy.
before: And I know there are good people out there. I saw thousands of you in the streets, protesting family separation.
after: But we know that the government is still separating children. And things are actually getting worse.
ru: Это очень помогло положить конец такой политике.

quote: The Real Irish Republican Army a paramilitary group that aims to bring about a united Ireland, has claimed responsibility.
before: A bomb exploded early on Tuesday morning in Londonderry, Northern Ireland, injuring two police officers. Investigations into the identity of the bombers and their motive are continuing.
ru: Ответственность взяла на себя «Подлинная ИРА» — военизированная группировка, которая добивается объединения Ирландии.

word: to bring sb up to speed
quote: Captain wants you brought up to speed by morning.
before: Well, at least your cover doesn't come with a partner. All the open homicides in our docket.
after: Welcome aboard, Detective Riley. I make no promises, John.
ru: Капитан попросил ввести тебя в курс дела к утру.

quote: And is that how you're going to bring him up?
before: I didn't kill your husband. But it's what you represent that did.
after: With Jonah on one side and us on the other? He'll know right from wrong, yes.
ru: И в таком духе вы его и собираетесь воспитывать?

quote: Look, I didn't bring it up because I didn't want to ask you to appear at the hearing.
before: You didn't say anything about it when we...reconnected. Yeah.
after: You didn't trust what I would say? No.
ru: Послушай, я не поднимал эту тему, потому что не хотел просить тебя идти на слушанье.

quote: The master deserves some happiness... after all this time... bringing up the child on his own.
before: I get a mother and sisters all in one day. Yes, it's gonna be very exciting around here... what with a baroness and all. Oh, hold still!
after: Oh, she must be lovely. I hope she likes me.
ru: Хозяин заслужил немного счастья: столько лет - и всё сам, один воспитывая ребёнка.

quote: I hate to bring this up, I really do.
before: I said I'm fine. Dean.
after: But don't you think maybe it's time we bury Sam? No.
ru: Жаль поднимать эту тему. Правда.

quote: Basically, I was brought up to be a good Samaritan, and I am.
before: I have to tell you about my childhood. I went to this very proper Christian school taught by nuns, fathers, brothers, sisters.
after: And I'd go at the end of the day to a traditional Hindu house, which was probably the only Hindu house in a predominantly Islamic neighborhood. Basically, I celebrated every religious function.
ru: Вообще, меня воспитывали, чтобы я стал добрым самаритянином. Я и стал.

quote: How do we bring up boys? What does it mean to be a boy?
before: And then let's remember that we've been taught the exact opposite by the powers that be, that compassion clouds your thinking, that it gets in the way, that vulnerability is weakness, that emotions are not to be trusted, and you're not supposed to take things personally, which is one of my favorites. I think the whole world has essentially been brought up not to be a girl.
after: To be a boy really means not to be a girl. To be a man means not to be a girl.
ru: Как мы воспитываем мальчиков? Что означает - быть мальчиком?

quote: The Maasais, the boys are brought up to be warriors.
before: And you know what's cool? I'm actually one of them.
after: The girls are brought up to be mothers. When I was five years old, I found out that I was engaged to be married as soon as I reached puberty.
ru: Масаи из мальчиков воспитывают воинов.

quote: And do your superpowers extend to knowing when it was broadcast?
before: I just can. It's polyester.
after: Useless. Rosie Clark, I'm arresting you on suspicion of assault.
ru: Я просто могу. Это полиэстер. - А твоя суперсила может сказать, когда это транслировали?

quote: You perform parlor tricks for humans, you allow them to record our antics and broadcast them across the globe.
before: No! No, please.
after: - Do you think that's wise? - I, um...
ru: Ты показываешь людям дешевые фокусы, позволяешь им записывать твои выходки и транслировать их по всему миру.

quote: They retain a certain amount of data before broadcasting it.
before: Cassandra's managed to link into some satellites that are above the ionosphere, so out of the effect of the ley lines. - Ah. - They can't send or receive signals, but new satellites with live broadcasts, they have a video buffer.
after: So we can see the news from right before it got cut out. - Good Intel. - [Typing] MAN:
ru: Они сохраняют определенное количество данных, перед тем как транслировать их.

quote: You only need a camera and a laptop nowadays to broadcast online.
before: I agree. The scale seems too small for the prize.
after: I'm sure they'll take care of it. Since there isn't much to do how about a round of intro?
ru: В наше время нужна лишь камера и ноутбук... и можно транслировать в интернет.

quote: For 18 days, our cameras were broadcasting, live, the voices of the people in Tahrir Square.
before: We were banned from Egypt, and our correspondents, some of them were arrested. But most of our camera people and our journalists, they went underground in Egypt — voluntarily — to report what happened in Tahrir Square.
after: I remember one night when someone phoned me on my cellphone — ordinary person who I don't know — from Tahrir Square. He told me, " We appeal to you not to switch off the cameras.
ru: 18 дней наши камеры в прямом эфире передавали события на площади Тахрир.

quote: Couldn't we just give people more incentives to engage in conversations, rather than just broadcasting opinions all the time?
before: But what if we put more focus on quality? What is more important: the total number of readers of a post you write, or who are the people who have impact that read what you write?
after: Or reward people for reading and responding to views that they disagree with? And also, make it socially acceptable that we change our minds, or probably even reward that?
ru: Может, нам нужно просто дать людям больше стимулов к вступлению в разговор, вместо того чтобы просто всё время транслировать мнения?

quote: Then, with my cell phone, I flipped the internet against itself and began to broadcast these live conversations to my online followers.
before: And so what we did was just organize what was already going on. And so what I started doing was mining these alternative viewpoints from these alternative digital universes, dissecting them, breaking them down into controversial talking points.
after: This made them want to leave the safety of their laptops and meet us in person to have real conversations with real people in real life. And we did this.
ru: Затем с помощью телефона я обернул интернет против себя самого и начал транслировать эти живые разговоры моим подписчикам.

quote: Following the Queen's address, Dutch prime minister Mark Rutte's response was broadcast.
before: Prior to the Queen's announcement, local media suggested she would abdicate.

quote: And then that's how NASCAR was born, people racing the cars they'd built for...
before: So the idea was, you put the big engines to outrun the police? Exactly. That was the idea.
after: They built the little dirt track down there in 1947. And this was for bootleggers to just see who had the fastest car? See who had the fastest car.
ru: И вот так появился NASCAR, люди гонялись на машинах, которые строили для...

quote: Much rather spend me time painting landscapes, or building a wall.
before: These commies ain't seen the last of Billy Fiske! I can't be doing with all these politics of war and suchlike.
after: Nice cul-de-sac for our retirement, eh, Pinkypoo? - Just three more days till me pension.
ru: Лучше на природе рисовать пейзажи, или строить укрепление.

quote: I-I spoke with the structural engineers who built it.
before: That's what caused the collapse. No, that wouldn't be enough to cause such a catastrophic failure.
after: They think that it was a combination of the heavy rains and the additional stories that the developer added to building 3. So, maybe vibrations from the heavy equipment and the additional pilings compromised building 1?
ru: Я-я разговаривал с инженерами-конструкторами, которые строили его.

quote: The head of the company that's building the new plant.
before: And I got a call that one of you visited, Gio Vecoli?
after: He was a bit ruffled, but it sounded like you decided he wasn't a murderer. We did.
ru: Руководитель компании, которая строит станцию.

quote: And then we built larger and larger accelerators, because we were curious about the nature of the universe.
before: We'd actually learned how to control these particles. We'd learned how to interact with our world on a scale that's too small for humans to see or touch or even sense that it's there.
after: As we went deeper and deeper, new particles started popping up. Eventually, we got to huge ring-like machines that take two beams of particles in opposite directions, squeeze them down to less than the width of a hair and smash them together.
ru: Потом мы начали строить всё более крупные ускорители, потому что мы хотели узнать сущность Вселенной.

quote: You can also start to change what you build.
before: Once you do those things, you can start making all sorts of investments. You can start doing things like, you know, transit systems that actually work to transport people, in effective and reasonably comfortable manners.
after: This is the Beddington Zero Energy Development in London, which is one of the greenest buildings in the world. It's a fabulous place.
ru: Не правда ли? Также вы сможете изменить строительство.

quote: And we know how to build properly.
before: The failure points were the same: walls and slabs not tied properly into columns — that's a roof slab hanging off the building — cantilevered structures, or structures that were asymmetric, that shook violently and came down, poor building materials, not enough concrete, not enough compression in the blocks, rebar that was smooth, rebar that was exposed to the weather and had rusted away. Now there's a solution to all these problems.
after: The proof of this came in Chile, almost a month later, when 8.8 magnitude earthquake hit Chile. That is 500 times the power of the 7.0 that hit Port-au-Prince — 500 times the power, yet only under a thousand casualties.
ru: Мы знаем, как строить правильно.

quote: It will also involve France (where the ATR planes were built) and Tunisia.
before: The Italian ANSV (Agenzia nazionale sicurezza al volo, or National Agency for Flight Safety) opened an investigation into the crash.

quote: Well, if that's a sin, we'll all burn in hell.
before: You look like you need to confess. I've been an ass and an idiot.
after: What about? Aliena, the roof, everything that is important in my life.
ru: Если бы это было грехом, мы бы все горели в аду.

quote: You all deserve to burn in hell.
before: No! God!
after: Anna. Get away from me.
ru: Вы все должны гореть в аду.

quote: If I'm going to burn in hell, you're going to burn with me.
before: Escape. Escape.
after: I wouldn't do that if I were you, Herman Mudgett. I'm not like the other women.
ru: Если мне суждено гореть в аду, я заберу тебя с собой.

quote: You'll be burning in the fires of Hell anyway.
before: ! Are you a friend of Noir? ! Confess to all your sins.
after: Is that card so precious to you? ! Well? !
ru: В любом случае, ты будешь гореть в аду...

quote: Candles can't burn in a vacuum, therefore, probably sparklers wouldn't either.
before: You say, anytime you have a vacuum state, you will discover that one wheel will not turn another one, if the only connection between them is whatever was there before the vacuum. That kind of thing.
after: It's not clear; actually sparklers will, but they didn't know that. They didn't have sparklers.
ru: Свечи не горят в вакууме, поэтому, вероятно, не будут гореть и бенгальские огни.

quote: Many of the fires burned throughout Saturday night.
after: In the central part of the state, various rural areas and small towns were evacuated; officers went door to door in some locales to notify residents of the impending dangers. A spokesperson for the American Red Cross reported approximately 50 people stayed overnight in an emergency shelter set up in the town of Cushing, just outside of Oklahoma City.

quote: They must burst by themselves.
before: Tie her down. She mustn't scratch the boils.
after: - Why can't we just cut them out? - The roots are too deep.
ru: Они должны лопаться сами по себе.

quote: That my stays are so tight they'll burst?
before: I can scarce breathe. What's there to fear?
after: I'm surprised Captain Poldark allows such riffraff in his house. But perhaps he's been obliged to lower his standards of late.
ru: Что мой остается так туго они будут лопаться?

quote: One report suggested that a wave had hit the resort, causing boats to burst into flames.
before: A spokesperson for a surfing resort on the coast of North Pagai said that they had “experienced a level of devastation that has rendered the resort inoperable”. Witnesses suggested that villas at the resort had been “wiped out” by the tsunami.
after: “There was a lot of debris floating in the water, including bar stools and other pieces of furniture from Macaronis Resort,” a member of staff said. Reports suggested that water had reached rooftops in North Pagai.

quote: This town just can't stop burying teenagers.
before: I'll talk to him. Take it easy, Dad.
after: How can it still hurt this much? It was so long ago.
ru: Этот город всё время хоронит подростков.

quote: This is where they buried the workhouse inmates.
before: Was there many put in 'ere? Yes.
after: I had too many. And they're all here.
ru: Здесь хоронили обитателей работного дома.

quote: Whoever buried Cooper wanted to make sure he couldn't be examined if he was dug up.
before: Look, without clean bones, Dr. Brennan and I are lost. And without the adipocere, I can't do a proper tox screen.
after: What do you think? You kept all these.
ru: Кто бы ни хоронил Купера, он позаботился, что труп нельзя будет изучить, даже если его выкопают.

quote: Listen, I know Purgatory's country and all, but is that legal to bury your husband in the garden?
before: Greece, when I heard. ♪ We'll make love, baby ♪
after: [Wynonna chuckling] Only thing Curtis loved more than me was his tomatoes. Who am I to separate soulmates?
ru: Я знаю, что Пёргатори деревня, но разве законно хоронить мужа в саду?

quote: In the old Roman custom, the dead were never buried within the walls.
before: And he finally gets enough strength together to climb up the ladder onto the roof, and all the pigeons, a la Red Balloon, are there waiting for him and they carry him off over the walls of the city. And I forgot to mention this: whenever he lost a pigeon, he would take that pigeon out beyond the walls of the city.
after: And I thought that's a really cheery story. (Laughter).
ru: Согласно старой римской традиции, мертвых никогда не хоронили в пределах городских стен.

quote: You can't bury your dead the way that you would.
before: And he explained that Ebola threatened everything that made us human. Ebola means you can't hold your children the way you would in this situation.
after: You have to trust these people in these space suits to do that for you. And ladies and gentlemen, what happened then was rather extraordinary: The community and the health workers, Peter, they sat down together and they put together a new plan for controlling Ebola in Lofa County.
ru: Вы не можете достойно хоронить близких.

quote: But now a new group of leaders has come into power and is burying the hatchet.
before: (Applause) But the real promise of connectivity is in the postcolonial world. All of those regions where borders have historically been the most arbitrary and where generations of leaders have had hostile relations with each other.
after: Let's take Southeast Asia, where high-speed rail networks are planned to connect Bangkok to Singapore and trade corridors from Vietnam to Myanmar. Now this region of 600 million people coordinates its agricultural resources and its industrial output.
ru: Сейчас к власти пришло новое поколение лидеров, и они закапывают топор войны.

quote: Only former Presidents are buried at the cemetery.
before: Chiluba was buried beside his successor Levy Mwanawasa, who died in 2008.
after: Chiluba's final years were spent at home on the grounds of ill-health; he was already unable to leave the country owing to the confiscation of his passport.

quote: I was at my mother's when she bought it.
before: Thank you. I only wanted to know.
after: Across the city. - It's all fine.
ru: Я была у мамы, когда она купила его.

quote: Excuse me, but he bought it fair and square.
before: Perhaps I can help you. Give me my car back now.
after: I saw the title. He bought it from my wife.
ru: Простите, но он купил её честно и законно.

quote: Hey, Pop. Why don't you buy a TV?
before: Your first chore is to help me with this fence on Saturday. Everything else come after that. Now, get that saw, we gonna cut these boards.
after: What I want with a TV? What I want one of them for? Everybody got one.
ru: Пап, почему ты не купишь телевизор?

quote: We wanted to buy one for Ricky Falcone, but it was sold out!
before: Redman the Robot! We tried to buy it in the store and the guy said it was all sold out!
after: I got the last one. I bought the last one!
ru: Мы хотели купить робота для Рики Фалькон, но роботов не было!

quote: So Obiang junior, well, he buys himself a $30 million mansion in Malibu, California.
before: So his daddy is president for life of Equatorial Guinea, a West African nation that has exported billions of dollars of oil since the 1990s and yet has a truly appalling human rights record. The vast majority of its people are living in really miserable poverty despite an income per capita that's on a par with that of Portugal.
after: I've been up to its front gates. I can tell you it's a magnificent spread.
ru: А тем временем Обианг младший покупает себе особняк в Малибу, Калифорния, за 30 миллионов долларов.

quote: I got a letter of recommendation that would let me buy medical marijuana.
before: So I decided to find out. I went to a seedy clinic in Venice Beach in California and got a recommendation that would allow me to be a medical marijuana patient.
after: I got that recommendation illegally, because I'm not a resident of California — I should note that. I should also note, for the record, that I never used that letter of recommendation to make a purchase, and to all of you DEA agents out there — (Laughter) love the work that you're doing, keep it up.
ru: Я получил рецепт, по которому мог купить медицинскую марихуану.

quote: Also around this time, at home, this was the computer that people were buying.
before: But our school at that time got a grant from the government, and they got an incredible computer — the research machine 3DZ — and they left the programming manuals lying around. And so students like myself with nothing to do, we would learn how to program it.
after: It was called the Sinclair ZX80. This was a 1K computer, and you'd buy your programs on cassette tape.
ru: И приблизительно в то же время, дома у меня был такой компьютер, какой все покупали.

quote: Eimskip, a shipping company in Iceland, recently bought the shipping division of Mearsk.
before: Icelandic companies have been investing heavily in Denmark for the last few years. Recently the Fons Investment ehf. bought the Danish airlines Sterling Air and Mearsk Air.
after: I-Holdings have been investing heavily in the Denish retailer market.

quote: I definitely didn't miss those days, 'cause Matty and I were fully evolved, so much so, that we didn't even bypass the era of being...
before: I will, my tiny-tiger! ...and all the sorts of baby-talk.
after: - Jealous? - Of what?
ru: Я определенно не скучала за теми днями, потому что мы с Мэтти на столько эволюционировали, что даже не обходили эру бытия...

quote: So saying "Yes, and" bypasses our inner critic.
before: Let's grab it by its tail. It's pulling us to the moon! "
after: We all have an inner critic that kind of guards what we say, so people don't think that we're obscene or crazy or unoriginal, and science is full of the fear of appearing unoriginal. Saying " Yes, and " bypasses the critic and unlocks hidden voices of creativity you didn't even know that you had, and they often carry the answer about the cloud.
ru: Выражение «Да, и» обходит нашего внутреннего критика.

quote: We've observed that the process of art therapy bypasses the speech-language issue with the brain.
before: The results have been nothing short of spectacular. Vivid, symbolic artwork is being created by our servicemen and women, and every work of art tells a story.
after: Art-making accesses the same sensory areas of the brain that encode trauma. Service members can use the art-making to work through their experiences in a nonthreatening way.
ru: Мы наблюдали, как процесс арт-терапии обходит проблемы с речью в мозге.

quote: These are the bits, the pleasure centers, and maybe what I'm seeing and sensing and feeling is bypassing my thinking.
before: We're not feeling it. We're thinking beauty is in the limbic system — if that's not an outmoded idea.
after: The wiring from your sensory apparatus to those bits is shorter than the bits that have to pass through the thinky bit, the cortex. They arrive first.
ru: Это отделы, центры удовольствия, и, возможно, то, что я вижу, воспринимаю и чувствую, обходит мои мысли.

quote: We can't get it wrong, we cannot bypass this opportunity.
before: Dick Hubbard, Mayor of Auckland, said: "In the past Auckland had missed too many opportunities.
after: Controversy is a good sign, a healthy sign – all the major projects around the world have had controversy. Today it's not about rugby, it is about boldness and vision against caution."

quote: Like right now, you're calculating how much time you've been away from work... and you're wondering what I'm doing here.
before: How do you know that I wasn't trying to be mysterious? Because you're one of the most transparent people I know.
after: I-I read an article where you, um, dedicated the wall of remembrance to the first responder families of 9/11. That was a nice thing you did.
ru: Как и сейчас, ты подсчитываешь, как много времени ты провел не на работе... и ты удивляешься: что я здесь делаю.

quote: While I'm faced with a decision, my program calculates the variables and I take action.
before: I guess every situation is a little different. For me, it's rather simple.
after: For example, what could be simpler then a triage situation in Sick Bay? Two patients, for example, both injured, for example, both in imminent danger of dying.
ru: Когда я сталкиваюсь с ситуацией принятия решения, моя программа подсчитывает вероятности, и я приступаю к действию.

quote: Are you calculating my age?
before: I was born in the Year of the Tiger. So I'm destined to eat lamb.
after: No, I'm not. I know you were.
ru: Подсчитываешь, сколько мне лет?

quote: Oh, hey, I was just calculating pi to relax.
before: Easy as pie. 3.1415926--
after: I'm not dangerous. I could go to Vegas.
ru: О, эй, я просто вычисляю число Пи, чтобы успокоиться.

quote: Our models have hundreds of thousands of grid boxes calculating hundreds of variables each, on minute timescales.
before: But still, we look at the pieces. We run enormous models on supercomputers; this is what I happen to do.
after: It takes weeks to perform our integrations, and we perform dozens of integrations in order to understand what's happening. We also fly all over the world looking for this thing.
ru: У наших моделей сотни тысяч сетевых графов, каждый вычисляющий сотни переменных в каждое мгновенье.

quote: Many articles calculate: How long would it take for this worker to work in order to earn enough money to buy what he's making?
before: What a factory makes is never the point, and the workers could not care less who buys their products. Journalistic coverage of Chinese factories, on the other hand, plays up this relationship between the workers and the products they make.
after: For example, an entry-level-line assembly line worker in China in an iPhone plant would have to shell out two and a half months' wages for an iPhone. But how meaningful is this calculation, really?
ru: Во многих статьях подсчитывают: Сколько времени это займёт для этого рабочего, чтобы заработать достаточно денег, чтобы купить то, что он производит?

quote: On several occasions, the U.S. has been told that its calculating methods were not valid.
before: This is the latest of a string of failed U.S. attempts, to show before NAFTA and WTO tribunals, that the Canadian government has been subsidizing lumber.
after: A NAFTA report of August 13, 2003 said the U.S. made a mistake in calculating its duties based on U.S. prices, and by not taking Canadian market conditions into consideration, and ordered Washington to recalculate them. NAFTA decisions are legally binding and must be put into effect within 60 days.

quote: This volcano is called Erta Ale by the local Afar people. It means "smoking mountain".
before: It's one of the rarest geological phenomena on our planet. A volcano with a lake of molten lava. As the Sun goes down, the lava lake comes to life.
after: For many, this place is a vision of hell. Yet it holds the key to understanding Io, a world over half a billion kilometers away.
ru: Местные жители называют этот вулкан "эрта але", что означает "Курящая гора".

quote: The number he called you from, write it down.
before: Dante called me about a month ago asking for help getting a false identity. I assumed he wanted to give it to a mule to move contraband.
after: He's got, like, a dozen phones, rotates 'em around. He's not an idiot.
ru: Номер, с которого он звонил, напиши.

quote: Otherwise don't bother calling, you know what I think.
before: - Some help you are ! - At least I'm trying to help.
after: - What a pain ! Bye. - Bye...
ru: В противном случае не надо мне звонить, ты знаешь мое мнение.

quote: They didn't want it to be called Monty Python's Flying Circus.
before: "lt's a lot bloody better without John." I know that the BBC were wary of doing it without John.
after: "Call it Monty Python," they said. And, I don't think they were ready to commission 13.
ru: Они не хотели, чтобы оно называлось "Летающий цирк Монти Пайтона".

quote: So I call this FreeSpeech, and I was playing with this for many, many months.
before: The second thing is, if I wasn't an English speaker, if I was speaking in some other language, this map would actually hold true in any language. So long as the questions are standardized, the map is actually independent of language.
after: I was trying out so many different combinations of this. And then I noticed something very interesting about FreeSpeech.
ru: Я называю её ФриСпич (FreeSpeech) и я пробовал её на протяжении многих-многих месяцев.

quote: The configuration on the left is called CIS, which you've probably never heard of.
before: Now the hydrogens and carbons are on opposite sides of the double bond. Now, even though both of these molecules are made up of exactly the same building blocks, they are two completely different substances, and they behave completely differently inside of us.
after: The one of the right is called TRANS, and you probably have heard of trans fats before. They don't go rancid, they're more stable during deep frying, and they can change the texture of foods in ways that other fats just can't.
ru: Конфигурация слева называется «цис-». Вряд ли вы слыхали о такой.

quote: There's a growing group of investors, call them "conscious investors."
before: We need hipsters, and we need companies like Adidas, and what we need most is for investors to convince other companies to behave like Adidas. And herein lies the challenge.
after: Conscious investors care about ESG issues. And they talk a lot about engaging management on ESG issues.
ru: Существует быстро растущая группа так называемых «сознательных инвесторов».

quote: The clash took place near the Al-Aqsa Mosque, the site Jews call the Temple Mount.
before: Israeli police, including paramilitary and mounted units, stormed into a crowd to disperse about 150 Palestinians who were throwing stones and bottles in Jerusalem's Old City.
after: It is the holiest place in Judaism, and third holiest in Islam.

quote: The light turns on, you can call it a day.
before: Here, read this. Then fix this.
after: That goes for all of you newts. Read, fix the lamp, go away.
ru: Когда зажжется свет - закончишь рабочий день.

quote: I think we should officially call it a day.
before: OK. Right, well, it's getting on.
after: Some of us have a stag do to organise. Good call, Chief.
ru: Думаю, формально сегодня можно закончить работу.

quote: Well, I suggest we follow the Carrington Institute's lead and call it a day ourselves.
before: I'll try again in the morning. Er, yes, good, good.
after: I need to get to the airport. Going to meet your girlfriend, eh, Chief?
ru: Думаю, мы займёмся зацепкой с институтом Кэррингтон а на сегодня хватит.

quote: All right, let's call it a day.
before: - Well, he would say that. - I didn't hear any contact either.
after: - We're conceding. Well done, Clive.
ru: Ладно, на сегодня хватит.

quote: Mom called off the attack, although I don't see how it's her.
before: Bender's saved. Cease fire.
after: Someone said Howitzer! Yay!
ru: Мамочка отменила атаку, хотя я не вижу гада убийцу.

quote: Then we should call off today with the rain and all.
before: The bridge has been cut off due to the flood. All roads heading downtown are blocked as well.
after: Tomorrow will be better. Yes... that might be better.
ru: Тогда из-за дождя отменим сегодняшнюю встречу.

quote: Well, Peter speculated the robbers may have seen us and called off the job.
before: I know what I heard. And whoever said it lives close to us.
after: That's exactly what I said. You know, we can check in with these store owners, take a look at the security cams. Yeah. Okay.
ru: Питер предположил, что грабители увидели нас и отменили все. - Да, именно так я и сказал.

quote: I think that you might have some rewrites to do once he calls off this wedding.
before: - Daniel's relationship with Emily. - Hmm.
after: Are you still in denial about how your transparent shower stunt backfired? Oh, come on.
ru: Я думаю , у тебя есть некоторые переписи Однажды он уже отменил свадьбу

quote: With the rise of jihadist violence, they began to receive threats to call off their events, which they refused to heed.
before: So now let me introduce you to four people whose stories I had the great honor of telling. Faizan Peerzada and the Rafi Peer Theatre workshop named for his father have for years promoted the performing arts in Pakistan.
after: And so a bomber struck their 2008 eighth world performing arts festival in Lahore, producing rain of glass that fell into the venue injuring nine people, and later that same night, the Peerzadas made a very difficult decision: they announced that their festival would continue as planned the next day. As Faizan said at the time, if we bow down to the Islamists, we'll just be sitting in a dark corner.
ru: С ростом насилия боевиков они стали получать угрозы с требованием отменить свои представления. К этим угрозам они не прислушались.

quote: Do not cancel anything that does not directly require the President's signature, smile, or person.
before: Spoon the ambassador onto the speaker. I'm sure he'll understand.
after: It's imperative that the public knows that this government can run while he's down. - How is he?
ru: Нет, не отменяйте ничего, что не требует президентской подписи, позволения или персоны.

quote: Not just because Chelsea died, but because I knew that they were gonna cancel that ceremony.
before: What does a loser like you have to gain by seeing all the kids that he hated so much? I came this close to flushing two years of sobriety down the toilet tonight.
after: See, tomorrow night I was gonna tell people what I did. And I knew that I would be arrested as an accomplice. I knew it, but...
ru: Не только из-за смерти Челси, но и из-за того, что знал, что церемонию отменят.

quote: I'll put $25 on the wedding being canceled by lunchtime tomorrow.
before: Yep, let's go. See you all back at the lab.
after: Yeah. 50 bucks says it's canceled before the sun goes down. Worst friends ever. The victim is female, mid-30s.
ru: Ставлю 25 баксов, что завтра свадьбу отменят ещё до полудня. Я ставлю 50 - что её отменят ещё до захода солнца.

quote: And no one has to cancel their Christmas plans.
before: - You see? Easy. We talk to this guy and wrap this thing up nice and quick.
after: We arrest a wacko homeless guy, and happy holidays. - Where's Massey's laptop?
ru: И никому не надо будет отменять свои планы на Рождество.

quote: And so she went outside and she stood there in the rain, talking to Keith Jarrett, begging him not to cancel the concert.
before: He went and sat outside in his car, leaving Vera Brandes to get on the phone to try to find a replacement piano. Now she got a piano tuner, but she couldn't get a new piano.
after: And he looked out of his car at this bedraggled, rain-drenched German teenager, took pity on her, and said, " Never forget... only for you. " And so a few hours later, Jarrett did indeed step out onto the stage of the opera house, he sat down at the unplayable piano and began.
ru: Она вышла на улицу и, стоя под дождём, разговаривала с Китом Джарреттом, умоляя его не отменять концерт.

quote: In fact, in one study I read, 25 percent of technology projects are canceled or deliver things that are never used.
before: This scenario is not an exaggeration. In my job as a technology advisor, I've seen so many companies make the well-meaning decisions to put huge investments into technology, only to have the benefits fail to live up to the expectation.
after: That's like billions of dollars just being wasted each year. So why is this?
ru: В одном исследовании я прочла, что 25 процентов технологических проектов отменяются или же их продукты никогда не используются.

quote: Businesses shut down, airlines started canceling routes.
before: And it wasn't until three months later that the world recognized this as Ebola. When every minute counted, we had already lost months, and by then the virus had spread like wildfire all across West Africa, and eventually to other parts of the world.
after: At the height of the crisis, when we were told that 1.4 million people could be infected, when we were told that most of them would die, when we had nearly lost all hope, I remember standing with a group of health workers in the rainforest where an outbreak had just happened. We were helping train and equip them to put on the masks, the gloves and the gowns that they needed to keep themselves safe from the virus while they were serving their patients.
ru: Разрушился бизнес, авиакомпании начали отменять маршруты.

quote: The tsunami warnings were canceled later in the day.
before: A powerful magnitude 7 earthquake rocked Japan's southwestern island of Kyushu at 10:53 am local time today (0153 UTC), prompting the Japanese Meteorological Agency to issue tsunami warnings for the area.

quote: I want my family photo to capture this moment.
before: Oh, that's all right. Um... just let it ring.
after: That's my Lily. Okay, say "cheese."
ru: Я хочу запечатлеть этот момент на семейном портрете.

quote: I just want to capture this look of disappointment and revulsion.
before: What if the fire just goes out? I need a camera.
after: You're using the wrong words. No, words are my business, Delsanto.
ru: Я хочу запечатлеть этот взгляд разочарования и отвращения.

quote: It was captured on film by a camera crew making the upcoming Fox special... In Search of Bigfoot.
before: Springfield's beloved Plow King... is trapped. - Barney Gumble, shown here donating... $50,000 to the Shelbyville Dance Theater... was caught in a sudden avalanche on Widow's Peak earlier today.
after: Hold it, Bob. We can see your wristwatch.
ru: На пленку это событие запечатлела съемочная группа "Фокс", готовящаяся к работе над фильмом "В поисках йети".

quote: Even though Japanese are easily captured by this pure mountain- there aren't many Fuji paintings.
before: Because I want to save number 100. I think it's very hard to see Fuji as a piece of art.
after: The more famous artists are, the less they want to paint Fuji. Instead they paint incredibly abstract mountains- but concerning Fuji's beauty there's also a different feeling.
ru: Хотя даже японцев легко захватывает эта прекрасная гора, Живописных работ, изображающих ее, очень мало.

quote: But the real power of the CAO is its ability to capture the actual building blocks of ecosystems.
before: Here's an image of the Golden Gate Bridge in San Francisco, not far from where I live. Although we flew straight over this bridge, we imaged it in 3D, captured its color in just a few seconds.
after: This is a small town in the Amazon, imaged with the CAO. We can slice through our data and see, for example, the 3D structure of the vegetation and the buildings, or we can use the chemical information to actually figure out how fast the plants are growing as we fly over them.
ru: Однако настоящая сила ВОКа заключается в её способности запечатлевать существующие структурные элементы экосистем.

quote: Neutrons have no repelling electric charge so they're easily captured by the iron group elements.
before: The outer layers collapse into the center, and bouncing back from this sudden injection of energy, the star explodes forming a supernova. The extreme pressure of a collapsing star is so high, that subatomic protons and electrons are forced together in the core, forming neutrons.
after: Multiple neutron captures enable the formation of heavier elements that a star under normal circumstances can't form, from silver to gold, past lead and on to uranium. In extreme contrast to the million year transformation of hydrogen to helium, the creation of the heaviest elements in a supernova takes place in only seconds.
ru: Нейтроны не имеют электрического заряда, поэтому их легко захватывают элементы из группы железа.

quote: Lobster relatives ate other animals, capturing them using their grasping arms.
before: These were soon replaced by the ancestors of modern animals. The Cambrian explosion.
after: Armored wriggling clam worms crawled across the seafloor and into it, creating new ecosystems. Our tadpole-like ancestors flitted along ancient coastlines, while their eel-like relatives with gnashing throat teeth swam above the ice-cream cone corals of the first reefs, dodging school-bus-sized krakens and hungry sea scorpions.
ru: Родственники омаров поедали других животных, захватывая их своими щупальцами.

quote: His party captured a slim majority of seats in the election.
before: John James Charest, PC MNA, is a Canadian lawyer and politician from the province of Quebec and a former leader of the federal Progressive Conservative Party (1993–1998), the current leader of the Quebec Liberal Party, and the 29th and current Premier of Quebec. In November 5, 2008, seeing a chance to win a majority, Charest called a snap election for December 8.

quote: It's my job to care as your wife.
before: You're shrinking me? No, as... As your wife.
after: Look, I know this is difficult, but-- but he's your family. We're strangers, violet.
ru: Должна заботиться о тебе как жена.

quote: But I can't make you care about things.
before: Of course you can stay. Of course.
after: I can't even make myself care about things right now. I'm sorry to hear that.
ru: Но я не могу, заставить тебя заботиться о чем-то.

quote: He's built schools to teach children to care for the forest.
before: Benki came back to his village full of ideas — new technologies, new research, new ways of understanding what was going on. Since that time, he's continued to work with his people, and not only the Ashaninka Nation, but all the peoples of the Amazon and beyond.
after: Together, he's led the reforestation of over 25 percent of the land that had been destroyed by the loggers. He's created a cooperative to help people diversify their livelihoods.
ru: Он строит школы, чтобы учить детей заботиться о лесе.

quote: And when you look at this image, you might find yourself going, "Why would I conceivably care about this?"
before: And AfriGadget is a blog that looks at technology in an Africa context. And specifically, it's looking at a blacksmith in Kibera in Nairobi, who is turning the shaft of a Landrover into a cold chisel.
after: And the truth is, this guy can probably explain this to you. This is Erik Hersman.
ru: Когда вы посмотрите на эту фотографию, вы возможно подумаете, "С какой стати меня это должно волновать?"

quote: (Raven quipped that he did not care for Wilson's tie, the extent of their disagreement for the evening.)
before: The event was billed as a debate between the two scientists, but they found little to disagree about.
after: Raven pointed to unsustainably high levels of consumption, especially in the United States, that will lead to ecological disaster if left unchecked. Levels of consumption have to be cut drastically, he argued.

quote: In my case, the obstacle is you-- my lackluster teammates who refuse to carry their own weight.
before: I'll kick things off. Okay. I have chosen Miley Cyrus' "The Climb," because it's about overcoming obstacles and beating the odds.
after: ♪ I can almost see it ♪ ♪ That dream I'm dreaming ♪
ru: В моем случае, препятствие это вы - мои друзья без огонька, что отказываются нести свою ношу.

quote: "Life's heaviest burden is to have nothing to carry."
before: -Yes. Isn't it heavy to carry around?
after: Yes. That's so true. Are you working?
ru: "Самое тяжёлое бремя в жизни несёт тот, кому нечего нести".

quote: I was caught somewhere I shouldn't have been caught carrying something I shouldn't have been carrying.
before: What about you? They don't lock up Tories unless it's serious.
after: Please tell me you're some kind of Nathan Hale. Sticking it to the enemy behind their lines.
ru: Меня схватили там, где не должны были, за то, что я нес то, что не должен был нести.

quote: You don't need to carry all that weight.
before: Do you feel the straps cutting into your shoulders? All those negotiations and arguments, and secrets and compromises.
after: Why don't you set that bag down? Some animals were meant to carry each other, to live symbiotically for a lifetime - star-crossed lovers, monogamous swans.

ru: Как и другие цветы, орхидеи должны привлекать насекомых, чтобы те собирали с них пыльцу и переносили её на другие растения.

In fact, he moved to Hawaii not to retire, but to carry on with his work.
