before: Oh. Honey, that's amazing. Do you think it's legit?
after: Yeah? What do you think, like, money huge?
ru: Ну, мой адвокат сейчас проверяет предложение, но, если все удастся, это будет грандиозно, Энджи.

quote: And make sure that people are constantly checking to say, "Are we good people doing good work?"
before: And so there was a lot that we had to do to sort of — We'd gone from a very small company — I mean if you go literally two and a half years ago, our company was 400 people, and today it's 6,500. And so when you go through that growth, you have to sort of cement your cultural values and talk about them all of the time.
after: And if you check those boxes, the next part of that is making sure you're telling your story. And I think we learned a lot of lessons but I think at the end of it we came out stronger.
ru: Убеждаться, что люди всё время проверяют: «Мы хорошие люди, которые делают хорошую работу?»

quote: They inspect it, they check it for cracks, for drill damage, for spalls, for chips.
before: At the peak of activity earlier this year, the researchers lowered the drill an extra hundred feet deeper into the ice every day and another 365 years deeper into the past. Periodically, they remove a cylinder of ice, like gamekeepers popping a spent shotgun shell from the barrel of a drill.
after: More importantly, they prepare it for inspection and analysis by 27 independent laboratories in the United States and Europe, who will examine it for 40 different trace chemicals related to climate, some in parts per quadrillion. Yes, I said that with a Q, quadrillion.
ru: Они осматривают его, проверяют на трещины, на повреждения от бура, на осколки и зазубрины.

quote: How many of you are checking it right now?
before: How many of you have checked your email today? Come on, raise your hands.
after: (Laughter) And how about finances? Anybody check that today?
ru: Кто из вас проверяет её прямо сейчас?

quote: How would you like to check what exactly happens?
before: How do you plan to investigate the chemistry of the phenomenon?

quote: I'm gonna check in and drink at the gate.
before: I'm going. But, so-- how long are you--
after: So how... long are you going for?
ru: Пойду зарегистрируюсь и выпью у ворот. Ладно.

quote: Front desk says she checked in yesterday afternoon alone.
before: She's a Philly girl. How long was she here for?
after: She wasn't alone. She brought 4,000 of her closest friends.
ru: На стойке регистрации сказали, что она заселилась вчера днем, одна.

quote: Can you maybe check in with them on Friday and tell them?
before: - Okay, look, I can't commit to Friday. Maybe... I won't know until I see how the session's going.
after: Give 'em like 80%? - All right.
ru: Можешь связаться с ними в пятницу и тогда сказать точно?

quote: He checked in three days ago as Frank Babcock.
before: Have you seen this guy? Gil Bellamy.
after: With a fake I.D. Expired credit card last time.
ru: Он заселился 3 дня назад как Фрэнк Бэбкок.

quote: Yes, hi, has a Marc Faison checked in yet?
before: You know what, maybe he thought we were meeting there. I'm calling the restaurant to see...
after: He has not. What about now?
ru: Да, здравствуйте, а Марк Фэйсон уже зарегистрировался?

quote: Why'd you check in under an alias?
before: According to the hotel's register, that is "John Mason." He bares a striking resemblance to you, Mr. Elspeth.
after: I suppose you have me dead to rights, so... I confess.
ru: Почему Вы зарегистрировались под псевдонимом?

quote: Anyway, she wants us to go to the house and check in on Stuart because he might be "lonely."
before: Mmm, she loves it. She finally found a place where everyone talks about how sweaty they are.
after: She's just being nice. Well, I'm her son, how come she doesn't send someone to check on me if I'm lonely?
ru: Как бы то ни было, она хочет, чтобы мы съездили туда и проведали Стюарта, потому что ему может быть «одиноко».
source_ru: В любом случае, она хочет, чтобы мы поехали в дом и проверили Стюарта, потому что ему может быть "одиноко"

quote: To check in with us and remind us that we are a link.
before: Isn't that what we all need? Somebody to reach out and make sure that we're OK.
after: Every now and then, we all just need a little help holding the stapler. Thank you.
ru: Кто поинтересуется, как у нас дела, и напомнит нам, что мы — звено цепочки.

quote: Sometimes to get your needs met, you need to choose an unsavory partner.
before: Gossip Girl didn't offer to help? Yeah, but only if I help her, whatever that means.
after: You know, that might work for you at 3:00 in the morning in the lower east side, but it's Gossip Girl. It's been pretty nice not having her record our every move.
ru: Иногда, чтобы добиться желаемого, приходится выбирать сомнительных партнеров.

quote: Sweetheart, why do you think I chose my side of the bed?
before: Uh, dad, it's totally the left. I mean, look at it.
after: Okay! Okay.
ru: Дорогая, как ты думаешь я выбирал, с какой стороны кровати спать?

quote: I give her a home, somewhere from which she may choose what to make of herself.
before: Rose, this woman would make a penniless drudge of you. I would not.
after: Rose? Is it your wish that you remain here a while longer yet?
ru: Я дала ей кров, место, где она может выбрать, чем заниматься.

quote: I think now we're just choosing what our future's gonna be.
before: Are we trying to fix things between us or not? I don't know the answers yet.
after: We've kept this secret a long time. You had an affair with her, right?
ru: Я думаю, сейчас мы выбираем каким будет наше будущее.

quote: We can choose to change our environment to have more bees.
before: We can make individual changes, but we can make social changes. We can choose to have more wolves.
after: We can choose to have different rating agencies. We can choose to control corporations instead of allowing corporations to control us.
ru: Можно выбрать изменить окружающую среду, чтобы стало больше пчёл.

quote: A single electron isn't choosing to go left or right but left and right simultaneously.
before: Block one of the slits and the stripes go away. This shows that the pattern is a result of each electron going through both slits at the same time.
after: This superposition of states also leads to modern technology. An electron near the nucleus of an atom exists in a spread out, wave-like orbit.
ru: Электрон не выбирает, куда идти, а идёт сразу и направо, и налево.

quote: I chose Sub-Saharan Africa because this is a huge delivery territory.
before: Let me show you how possible this is. This is a map of Sub-Saharan Africa, with a map of the United States for scale.
after: It's very challenging. But we analyzed every 50-mile by 50-mile block on the continent, and we found that half of farmers live in just these shaded regions.
ru: Я выбрал Южно-Африканский регион, так как это огромная территория доставки.

quote: Why did you choose to run in this constituency?
before: Why have you chosen to involve yourself in the political process?

quote: I was just citing your axial chemistry study.
before: Good that you came, Niels. Better that you made it out of Europe.
after: So this is the famous Skinny Man? No, this is...
ru: Я как раз цитировал твою работу по аксиальной химии.

quote: I'm not lying. In one year, the same student could cite 400-year-old poetry with ease at graduation.
before: - Hi, Richard! - Welcome.
after: So infinite in her skills. So like a god in her form and her actions.
ru: Я не вру: через год этот ученик мог с лёгкостью цитировать 400-летнюю поэзию на выпускном.

quote: Many federal agencies refused citing National Security.
before: The front pages of newspapers across Canada carried the story. The Judicial Watch Foundation submitted Freedom of Information Act Requests - to obtain the full agenda and minutes of the secret assembly.
after: The foundation finally succeeded and did receive thousands of pages of documents. The documents, marked 'Unclassified', are the blueprints of a - shadow government ruling by bureaucratic and Executive fiat.
ru: Множество федеральных агентств отказались ссылаться на национальную Безопасность.

quote: When i talk about people being evil, I could cite quotes or dig up statistics, But those are just words and numbers.
before: - for my own selfish purposes. The fact is, as hot as you look, And it is quite hot, I wouldn't have said anything.
after: I think we could have a little more fun If i express myself in song. * evil woman *
ru: Когда я говорю о людях, являющихся злом, я могу приводить цитаты или ссылаться на статистику, но это все лишь слова и цифры.

quote: I decided to use their defense as my offense, and I began to cite and highlight Islamic scripture as well.
before: I thought that would lead to cultural and social change. It turns out, it does a little, but not a lot.
after: In 2012 and 2013, my organization led the single largest and most widespread campaign in Libya. We entered homes and schools and universities, even mosques.
ru: И тогда я решила превратить их защиту в своё наступление, я тоже начала цитировать и акцентировать внимание на исламском священном писании.

quote: In his study, Darwin actually cited a French neurologist, Guillaume Duchenne, who sent electric jolts to facial muscles to induce and stimulate smiles.
before: (Laughter) In addition to theorizing on evolution in " The Origin of Species, " Charles Darwin also wrote the facial feedback response theory. His theory states that the act of smiling itself actually makes us feel better, rather than smiling being merely a result of feeling good.
after: Please, don't try this at home. (Laughter) In a related German study, researchers used fMRI imaging to measure brain activity before and after injecting Botox to suppress smiling muscles.
ru: В своем исследовании Дарвин цитировал французского невролога Гийома Дюшена, применявшего электрические импульсы, чтобы вызвать и стимулировать улыбку.

quote: Secondly, it's imperative that you do not cite The New York Times.
before: I'll give you three examples. First of all, I must, as a speaker, provide a service to the audience and talk about what I will give you, instead of saying what I can't have.
after: (Laughter) And finally, it's okay for the speaker — that's the good news — to fake intellectual capacity. If I don't understand something, I can just say, " etc., etc. "
ru: Второй. Ни в коем случае не цитировать «Нью-Йорк Таймс».

quote: Reuters reports that Israel, citing a member of Carter's delegation, denied the visit.
before: Carter told reporters that he wanted to go to the Gaza Strip, but was not allowed.

quote: Slow down. You claim it was the last time you saw Puss?
before: Action, Motherfuckers! It takes about 30 minutes online to find Zooey Wigner.
after: Yeah. Really? So, it would surprise you to learn that.. when Schrodinger's warehouse was open the next morning, Puss was still there.
ru: Погоди, ты заявляешь, что тогда видел этого Киску в последний раз?

quote: It did claim to be Napoleon and Karl Marx.
before: And on top of all that my superego keeps popping up. You were right, by the way.
after: And the Pope. And something else.
ru: Оно требовало быть Наполеоном и Карлом Марксом.

quote: He claims your man kidnapped and assaulted him.
before: Sid Rothman assaulted one of my officers. That's got to count for something.
after: He's ready to press charges. Let me guess.
ru: Но он утверждает, что ваш человек похитил его.

quote: Yeah, uh, the limo company claims that the car she arrived in was ordered by you.
before: Well, I mean, we're trying to figure out how she got there, and your mom said that she wasn't scheduled to work yesterday. So...
after: I've never drunk dialed a limo before. But...
ru: Да, и в прокате лимузинов утверждают, что машину, на которой она приехала, заказали вы.

quote: Just yesterday, I was attacked by a guy who claimed that I was filming him.
before: You hear about, actually, a drone pilot, a hobbyist, was attacked two weeks ago because he was flying near a beach. Here's some personal input I didn't expect.
after: I was checking my email right here — easy way to get input for your talk. But I think there are better solutions.
ru: Буквально вчера на меня напал парень, утверждавший, что я его снимаю.

quote: But I never claimed things I didn't understand, I talked about my personal experiences.
before: That's what I asked constantly, because, again, I am not an expert, I am a normal kid, and now I'm talking to CNN and Fox News about a scientific discussion that really, should I be facilitating, should I be commenting on? And a lot of people questioned that, and for good reason.
after: And even at the Senate hearing, I just talked about how misinformation is dangerous. My mom got a lot of her beliefs from social media, from Facebook and from organizations that were allowing their platforms to push lies that were very dangerous.
ru: Но я никогда не заявлял того, чего не понимал, я говорил о личном опыте.

quote: Critics also claim that harm reduction gives the wrong message to our children about drug users.
before: We know that if recovery is ever going to happen we must keep people alive. Offering someone a clean needle or a safe place to inject is the first step to treatment and recovery.
after: The last time I looked, these drug users are our children. The message of harm reduction is that while drugs can hurt you, we still must reach out to people who are addicted.
ru: Критики также заявляют, что программа снижения вреда создаёт у наших детей неправильное представление о наркопотребителях.

quote: Whitton claims the creature was walking "parallel" to them as they hauled out the corpse.
before: The single photo shown at the conference portrays a blurred black figure in the distance.
after: Another photo on Whitton's website www.searchingforbigfoot.com shows what is allegedly the corpse, decapitated and stuffed into a freezer.

quote: Clarify your ideas by putting them in words; the talker gains as much from his conversation as the listener.
before: Proper friendships form one of the best means for the formation of ideas and ideals, for they enable one to practise in giving expression to thought. The speaker who would speak fluently before an audience should learn to speak fluently and entertainingly with a friend.
after: You sometimes begin to converse on a subject thinking you have very little to say, but one idea gives birth to another, and you are surprised to learn that the more you give the more you have to give. This give-and-take of friendly conversation develops mentality, and fluency in expression.
ru: Проясняйте свои мысли, облекая их в слова: говорящий получает от беседы не меньше, чем слушатель.

quote: There's just one thing you need to clarify for me.
before: Provided you still want it. That's a generous offer, sir.
after: Of course. Frost may have been carrying some vital Intel.
ru: Только сначала проясните для меня одну вещь.

quote: I called him this morning just to clarify a few things.
before: You did? Yeah.
after: You may have noticed I wasn't exactly paying attention when we were in his office. Well, you were surprised.
ru: Я звонил ему утром, что бы разъяснить несколько вещей.

quote: Oh, thank you for clarifying. I feel much better now.
before: And I sat in hundreds of police meetings just like yesterday's, but suddenly I'm disinvited. Uninvited. "Disinvited" implies you were invited in the first place.
after: Cut it out. It was a purely technical huddle.
ru: Спасибо за объяснение, мне стало намного легче.

quote: Just to clarify: copy editors don't choose what goes into the magazine.
before: I'm a copy editor. I work at The New Yorker, and copyediting for The New Yorker is like playing shortstop for a Major League Baseball team: every little movement gets picked over by the critics — God forbid you should commit an error.
after: We work at the level of the sentence, maybe the paragraph, the words, the punctuation. Our business is in the details.
ru: Следует пояснить, что редактор-корректор не выбирает, что печатать.

quote: But before I do, I just want to clarify which numbers I'm talking about here.
before: But you should also be able to tell which numbers are reliable and which ones aren't. So today I want to try to give you some tools to be able to do that.
after: I'm not talking about claims like, " 9 out of 10 women recommend this anti-aging cream. " I think a lot of us always roll our eyes at numbers like that.
ru: Но сначала хочу просто пояснить, о каких цифрах я веду речь.

quote: He went on to clarify that he believed Japan could provide data about missiles to the United States without violating Japan's constitution.
before: Koizumi pointed out that the angle and altitude of a missile in flight could be used to determine the target of the missile.
ru: Затем он уточнил, что, по его мнению, Япония может передавать США данные о ракетах, не нарушая японскую конституцию.

quote: The one who cleans his ears with his car keys?
before: - Where'd you get the booze, huh? - [sighs] Was it that Greyson kid?
after: Why do you have to get to the bottom of everything? - Because this is serious.
ru: Который чистит уши ключами от машины?

quote: Your main duty will be cleaning my crown.
before: Oh, and one last thing. I want you to be my new handmaiden.
after: That is not your crown. That is the official crown of the Queen of Valencia, and my mother is its rightful owner.
ru: Ты будешь все время чистить мою корону.

quote: I cleaned a metro station for two months.
before: I was a nurse. But my papers are no good here.
after: Two months, and that was it. I'd need three jobs anyway to bring my family here.
ru: Я два месяца убирал станции метро.

quote: So from now on, we're going to be cleaning the house my way.
before: Mr. Stilson usually just has us start in the kitchen. Mr. Stilson is no longer with us.
after: The Monk way. Who's Monk?
ru: И, начиная с этого момента, мы будем убирать дом по моему.

quote: They'd rotate who'd cleaned and who'd watch the kids.
before: They plastered neighborhoods with flyers and handed business cards out to their families and friends, and soon, they had clients calling. Two of them would clean the office or house and one of them would watch the kids.
after: (Laughs) It's awesome, right? (Laughter) And they split the money three ways.
ru: Они убирались и смотрели за детьми по очереди.

quote: And first-class morality is, don't bomb Mexico -- they clean my house.
before: Economy class morality is, we want to bomb you back to the Stone Age. Business class morality is, don't bomb Japan — they built my car.
after: (Laughter) Yes, it is politically incorrect. All right, now I want to do a little bit of a thing for you...
ru: И мораль первого класса: «Не бомбите Мексику — они убирают у меня в доме».

quote: And there are no international laws in space to enforce us to clean up after ourselves.
before: This is the paradigm of the satellite industry. Satellites that are no longer working are often left to deorbit over many, many years, or only moved out of the way as a temporary solution.
after: So the world's first satellite, Sputnik I, was launched in 1957, and in that year, there were only a total of three launch attempts. Decades later and dozens of countries from all around the world have launched thousands of more satellites into orbit, and the frequency of launches is only going to increase in the future, especially if you consider things like the possibility of 900-plus satellite constellations being launched.
ru: Нет никаких международных законов о космическом пространстве, принуждающих убирать за собой мусор.

quote: County officials closed the schools to clean them.
before: In Moneta, Virginia, a high school senior died from an infection that spread to his kidney, liver, lungs and heart. In Bedford County, where Moneta is located, school officials have reported five cases of the Methicillin-resistant strain of the Staph bacteria.

quote: You just click the top, it packs 200,000 volts.
before: Am I supposed to write for help? It's not a pen, it's a stun gun.
after: You know I'm armed, right? Oh, yeah.
ru: Нажимаешь, и она выдаёт 200 000 вольт.

quote: When you click the button on your mouse, it sends a message to the computer with information about its position.
before: You might have an optical mouse that makes these measurements with lights and sensors, but older ones did this with a hard rubber ball and some plastic wheels. Same concept.
after: When your mouse click is received, it's handled by the basic input / output subsystem. This subsystem acts like the eyes and ears and mouth and hands of the computer.
ru: Когда вы нажимаете кнопку вашей мыши, она отправляет сообщение на компьютер с информацией о своей позиции.

quote: (Clicking) Now these two cylinders start to rotate.
before: And similar to the listeners before the story starts, these metronomes are going to click, but they're going to click out of phase. (Clicking) Now see what will happen when I connect them together by placing them on these two cylinders.
after: This rotation vibration is going through the wood and is going to couple all the metronomes together. And now listen to the click.
ru: (Метрономы щёлкают) Цилиндры начинают кататься.

quote: She clicks on a teller that's a five-star teller, who's seven minutes away.
before: It went directly to her mom's mobile device without going through an intermediary. And then her mom looked at her mobile device — it's kind of like an Uber interface, there's Abra " tellers " moving around.
after: The guy shows up at the door, gives her Filipino pesos, she puts them in her wallet. The whole thing took minutes, and it cost her two percent.
ru: Она нажимает на служащего с высоким рейтингом в семи минутах от неё.

quote: The installer app will not require rooting the device, instead installing by simply clicking a button.
before: The firm's first announced step is to improve the process of installing the software on owner's devices, which Kondik described as "hideous". A new installer app is planned to be released "in the coming weeks" on Google Play.

quote: But when he takes us to gym, we're supposed to climb the rope.
before: Playing catch in class? That, for most kids, is what's called fun.
after: He fails to pick up on my reluctance. He's not a good fit for me.
ru: А когда мы идем в спортзал мы должны подниматься по канату.

quote: It's still a great pleasure to climb with such a beautiful woman!
before: He doesn't like talking about the past, but here he has to. You were barely out of nappies the last time Lothar was here.
after: Come on, granddad, get your axes in properly. The terrible trio are back!
ru: Это по-прежнему большое удовольствие - подниматься с такой прекрасной женщиной!

quote: Take a second to imagine how ridiculous it feels to climb 1,500 feet up a wall just to fill a backpack full of rocks.
before: We spent the day climbing together to a specific crack in the middle of the wall that was choked with loose rocks that made that section difficult and potentially dangerous, because any missed step might knock a rock to the ground and kill a passing climber or hiker. So we carefully removed the rocks, loaded them into the pack and rappelled back down.
after: (Laughter) It's never that easy to carry a pack full of rocks around. It's even harder on the side of a cliff.
ru: Представьте себе, как глупо это звучит: подниматься по стене 500 метров, чтобы набрать полный рюкзак камней.

quote: Now, the first time we climb the trust stack, it feels weird, even risky, but we get to a point where these ideas seem totally normal.
before: The second level is about having confidence in the platform, that BlaBlaCar will help you if something goes wrong. And the third level is about using little bits of information to decide whether the other person is trustworthy.
after: Our behaviors transform, often relatively quickly. In other words, trust enables change and innovation.
ru: В первый раз подниматься по лестнице доверия непривычно и даже страшно, но в итоге это становится совершенно естественным.

quote: When I was a kid, I learned to swim in this lake and I climbed mountains every day after school.
before: And this picture shows the city that I come from, Beijing, China. And old Beijing is like a very beautiful garden, you can see a lot of nature.
after: But after getting older, we built more and more modern buildings. And they all look the same.
ru: В детстве я учился плавать в местном озере и лазил по горам каждый день после школы.

quote: Rescuers said the hikers were climbing very late in the day.
after: Two survivors were air lifted to a hospital in Bolzano. Reports say recent snow drifts did not bond with the under ice, creating the sliding.

quote: Every time I close my eyes, I see that sweet little monkey's face.
before: I got blood on my hands, Hank. Seriously, I don't know if I'm gonna sleep tonight.
after: Marcy? You want to come in?
ru: Каждый раз, когда я закрываю глаза, я вижу милую мордочку этой обезьянки.

quote: You know, if I close my eyes, I can still see you holding Fish's umbrella.
before: Dude! Color me impressed.
after: "Yes, Ms. Mooney. "No, Ms. Mooney.
ru: Знаешь, я закрываю глаза и всё ещё вижу, как ты держишь зонтик Фиш.

quote: Apparently he's drunk so much he's always got one eye closed so he could see straight.
before: The landlord had threatened to evict him. One Eye'd Pete?
after: And why's he coming forward suddenly? He's homeless and it's cold outside.
ru: Похоже, что так сильно напивался, что постоянно закрывал один глаз, чтобы хоть что-то видеть.

quote: If I close my eyes,I can still feel her mustache on my cheek.
before: I can't do it again. The hot towels,the cold compresses.
after: Stop it,matthew! everything is fine here,okay?
ru: Закрывая глаза, я до сих пор ощущаю, как ее усы щекочут мне щеки.

quote: Prisoners harden up, they shut down, they close in ...
before: Indeed, many associated education with humiliation and failure. I can tell you firsthand that prison is dehumanizing.
after: just to survive. And this can be devastating for families.
ru: Заключённые становятся чёрствыми, нелюдимыми, закрываются в себе,

quote: As the polls were closing and it became clear that Trump was going to be our new president, I was devastated.
before: But remember, the goal isn't to win, the goal is to listen and to understand and to be open to learning something new. LA: So let's go back to election night.
after: I was sad, I was confused, and I'll be honest — I was angry. And then just before midnight, I received this text message from Caitlin.
ru: Так как избирательные участки закрывались и становилось ясно, что Трамп станет нашим новым президентом, я почувствовала пустоту.

after: Disagreements seeped into the convention as well when Cruz gave a speech in which he did not endorse Trump. When his refusal became evident, a chorus of boos erupted from the delegates, continuing until he left the stage.

quote: There was great speculation about why William Bourne should suddenly disappear from London society.
before: It appears that he vanished without trace around the same time that Mr Reppington arrived here in Candleford. I've been looking at newspapers from the time.
after: I expect he might have grown weary of it. Society can be very tiring.
ru: Долго строили домыслы, зачем Уильяму Боурну внезапно исчезать из лондонского общества.

quote: You disappear, Mel, all the time.
before: Paris Hilton? You're comparing me with Paris Hilton?
after: You fucking disappear. Dinners, lunches.
ru: Ты исчезаешь, Мел, все время.

quote: Cristina, please don't disappear on me again.
before: I, uh, just wanted to let you know that, uh, my fellowship is, uh, almost done, and, uh... well, I got an offer from Lebackes pediatric surgery clinic, Oliver Lebackes' practice, and, uh... well, I gave it some serious consideration, and I've decided to take it. So, I guess this is my notice.
after: Where are you? Please, just... call me.
ru: Кристина, пожалуйста, не исчезай.

quote: And then he disappears before you even have a chance to question him?
before: Think about it, Captain... we were closing in on Keller, right? Then, all of a sudden, a murder witness magically pops up and identifies me, of all people?
after: I mean, come on! So, what, you're suggesting Vincent Keller is behind all this?
ru: А потом исчезает до того, как вы смогли его допросить?

quote: They're like soap bubbles that disappear when we touch them.
before: Time-warping technology challenges our deepest core, because we are able to archive the past and some of it becomes hard to forget, even as the current moment is increasingly unmemorable. We want to clutch, and we are left instead clutching at a series of static moments.
after: By archiving everything, we think that we can store it, but time is not data. It cannot be stored.
ru: И словно мыльные пузыри, они исчезают при прикосновении.

quote: But phantom limb sensations don’t necessarily disappear on their own.
before: The cortical map is also most likely responsible for the feeling of body parts that are no longer there, because they still have representation in the brain. Over time, this representation may shrink and the phantom limb may shrink with it.
after: Treatment for phantom pain usually requires a combination of physical therapy, medications for pain management, prosthetics, and time. A technique called mirror box therapy can be very helpful in developing the range of motion and reducing pain in the phantom limb.
ru: Однако ощущения фантомных конечностей не всегда исчезают сами по себе.

quote: And then notice that a great many of these problems disappear.
before: Anyway, the question I think people should talk about — and it's absolutely taboo — is, how many people should there be? And I think it should be about 100 million or maybe 500 million.
after: If you had 100 million people properly spread out, then if there's some garbage, you throw it away, preferably where you can't see it, and it will rot. Or you throw it into the ocean and some fish will benefit from it.
ru: Обратите внимание: большинство проблем тогда исчезает сама собой.

quote: Mr Holt was swimming at the beach, known for its dangerous currents, when he disappeared.
before: Victorian State Coroner Graeme Johnstone has ruled that former Australian Prime Minister Harold Holt drowned in the surf at Cheviot Beach on December 17, 1967.
after: Numerous theories have circulated since to explain the disappearance, including one that believed he was abducted by a Chinese submarine.

quote: And, you know, I'd really hate to disappoint her.
before: Well, I can't go. Jen and I have movie night tonight.
after: Hey, I've been married for 14 years. Trust me, getting them used to being disappointed
ru: Я очень не люблю её разочаровывать.

quote: Well, I'm so sorry to disappoint you, my dear, but I'm innocent on all counts.
before: Well, by the same bastard who hid the camera in Lydia's apartment. I still have a hard time believing that you didn't install that camera.
after: And I suggest you start backing me up, because if I end up getting framed for this, I'm gonna see to it that everything you cherish so dearly is ripped from those greedy little claws of yours. Careful, Conrad.
ru: Что ж, мне жаль тебя разочаровывать, дорогая, но я невиновен по всем пунктам.

quote: Why do you Musketeers insist on disappointing me?
before: At least I have one loyal soldier. First, you take me to that tavern, put my life in danger and now this.
after: Bruno was a thug. The King made a deal and betrayed it.
ru: Мушкетеры только и делают, что разочаровывают меня.

quote: I don't want to disappoint you or make another mistake.
before: Axl needed to be told to close his mouth when he takes a shower. But you gave up everything for me.
after: Tell me what you want me to do. You have to.
ru: Я не хочу разочаровывать вас или делать другие ошибки.

quote: It's what I wanted every single day, and every single day I was disappointed.
before: I wouldn't have to buy stuff that was' Bedazzled', when I was trying to be like the cool kids. " I would wish, and pray, and hope, and do whatever I could so I would wake up in the morning and be different, and I wouldn't have to deal with these struggles.
after: I have an amazing support system around me, who never pity me, who are there to pick me up if I'm sad, who are there to laugh with me during the good times, and they taught me that, even though I have this syndrome, even though things are hard, I can't let that define me. My life was put into my hands, just like your lives are put into yours.
ru: Я мечтала об этом каждый день и каждый новый день разочаровывалась.

quote: When they disappoint us, we gleefully knock them from the very pedestal we put them on.
before: We have this tendency to put visible feminists on a pedestal. We expect them to pose perfectly.
after: Like I said, I am a mess — consider me knocked off that pedestal before you ever try to put me up there. (Laughter) Too many women, particularly groundbreaking women and industry leaders, are afraid to be labeled as feminists.
ru: Они разочаровывают нас, и мы, ликуя, сбрасываем их с пьедестала, на который сами их поместили.

quote: I said, "Did Jefferson ever disappoint you?"
before: So, he was very satisfied with the kind of relationship they had over 50 years. And I asked him one question.
after: And here is this man who had given his whole life to uncovering Jefferson and connecting with him, and he said, " Well... " — I'm going to do a bad southern accent. Dumas Malone was from Mississippi originally.
ru: Я спросил, "Джефферсон когда-нибудь вас разочаровывал?"

quote: A spokesman for the foreign office said: "We are disappointed with the judgement."
after: They have not yet decided whether to appeal.

quote: If Regina's already discovered this, I apologise for the repetition.
before: Well, I'm sure you'll make of it whatever your social skills will allow. I will.
after: My husband was well connected in Parisian literary circles. Gide and Malraux were our friends.
ru: Если Реджина уже это обнаружила, простите за повторение.

quote: Diane, I made a couple of calls and discovered a possible suitor.
before: I would tend to agree. Well, when you argued so passionately about a merger,
after: Don't you want to know who? Hello.
ru: Даян, я сделал несколько звонков и обнаружил подходящий вариант.

quote: Agent Carter, how did you come to discover the stolen items?
before: I can't bloody well leave them here for someone else to find. - I'm certainly not turning them over to you to be stolen the next time you feel sleepy.
after: Leet Brannis, uh, told me where they were. And how did you come into contact with Mr. Brannis?
ru: Агент Картер, как вам удалось обнаружить украденное?

quote: We discovered cyanide in Mr Batch's stomach contents.
before: Have you come to be healed? You're not a healer, you're a murderer.
after: I didn't poison anyone. Mrs Batch saw you the night before her husband was murdered.
ru: Мы обнаружиил цианид в желудке мистера БАча

quote: And in addition, we discovered a Pinocchio effect.
before: And using this technology, we can now reveal the hidden emotions associated with lying, and therefore detect people's lies. We can do so noninvasively, remotely, inexpensively, with an accuracy at about 85 percent, which is far better than chance level.
after: No, not this Pinocchio effect. (Laughter) This is the real Pinocchio effect.
ru: Вдобавок мы открыли эффект Пиноккио.

quote: In some of these brains, scientists discovered something surprising.
before: In the Nun Study, 678 nuns, all over the age of 75 when the study began, were followed for more than two decades. They were regularly given physical checkups and cognitive tests, and when they died, their brains were all donated for autopsy.
after: Despite the presence of plaques and tangles and brain shrinkage — what appeared to be unquestionable Alzheimer's — the nuns who had belonged to these brains showed no signs of having the disease while they were alive. How can this be?
ru: В мозге некоторых из них учёные обнаружили нечто удивительное.

quote: I discovered that Twitter was a microblogging site.
before: This is Twitter; you've heard a lot about it today. Essentially, for me, when I began investigating this case, I was completely new to this; I'd signed up two days earlier.
after: It enabled me to send out short, 140-character messages. Also, an amazing search facility.
ru: Я обнаружил, что Twitter — это сайт микроблогов.

quote: Scientists hope to discover new meaning to the beginning of our solar system.
Not only do I not have a say, she doesn't even want to discuss it.
before: - That's nice. - Yeah.
after: They want to hold all the cards. I want you to imagine for a minute what it's like trying to negotiate with two women.
ru: Нужно ли говорить, что она даже не хотела обсуждать это.

quote: You know, some things are not meant to be discussed, Didi.
before: - What does that mean? - Well...
after: - You had anal sex? - Yeah, for like 10 minutes.
ru: Знаешь, некоторые вещи не стоит обсуждать, Диди.

quote: It's an online forum discussing a troubled 4-year-old girl.
before: Backtracking now... Oh, no.
after: Any identifying information on who she's talking to? Give me a minute. Give me a minute.
ru: Это онлайн-форум, обсуждающий проблемных 4-х летних девочек.

quote: I didn't feel the need to discuss it with him.
before: - It was a fling. End of the day, she chose me, and he knew that.
after: Is that why you got married earlier? Lay it all to rest?
ru: Я не видел нужды обсуждать это с ним.

quote: They said these are pathological curves, and we don't have to discuss them.
before: And since they went through the iterations an infinite number of times, as the ruler shrinks down to infinity, the length goes to infinity. This made no sense at all, so they consigned these curves to the back of the math books.
after: (Laughter) And that worked for a hundred years. And then in 1977, Benoit Mandelbrot, a French mathematician, realized that if you do computer graphics and used these shapes he called fractals, you get the shapes of nature.
ru: Они сказали, что эти кривые патологические, и мы не собираемся их обсуждать.

quote: And they had discussed things of great national importance.
before: It was the date of the Super Bowl. And the reason that this date was so momentous is that what my colleagues, John King and Halee Fischer-Wright, and I noticed as we began to debrief various Super Bowl parties, is that it seemed to us that across the United States, if you will, tribal councils had convened.
after: Like, " Do we like the Budweiser commercial? " and, " Do we like the nachos? " and, " Who is going to win? "
ru: И они обсуждали вещи общенационального значения.

quote: My parents would come home looking sad and drained, but they didn't discuss it with us.
before: But most of us don't want to acknowledge death, we don't want to plan for it, and we don't want to discuss it with the most important people in our lives. I grew up in an Australian community where people got old or sick and passed away, and only the adults attended the funeral.
after: So I was ignorant to death and of the grieving process. At 15, I got my invitation.
ru: Мои родители приходили домой грустные и выжатые, но они не обсуждали с нами эту тему.

quote: Hospital spokesman Bill McShane delined to discuss Swoboda's injuries.
before: The two wounded are a Suburban Journals reporter and Mayor Mike Swoboda. Swoboda underwent emergency surgery to treat a gunshot wound to the head Thursday night at St. John's Mercy Hospital in Creve Coeur.
after: He did note that another Suburban Journals reporter Todd Smith was in satisfactory condition. Smith was shot in the hand.

quote: For exampIe, when a manager dismissed a worker for misconduct or generating losses, etc.,
before: I'm a laughing stock. Even when someone made a wrong decision, even slightly wrong, they'd get someone to back them up so that they wouIn't lose authority.
after: and the organization would veto it only because the person was in the youth organization. That was completely wrong and we're still dealing with the consequences.
ru: Например, начальник увольняет рабочего за неподобающее поведение, неаккуратную работу или за что-либо ещё,

quote: I'm not dismissing the charges.
before: - Wait, guys, this isn't Crossfire. I'm gonna free Mr. Bishop on $100,000 bond.
after: We're gonna go to trial. But I'm gonna tell you something, guys: you can't do this.
ru: Я не отклоняю обвинение.

quote: We get dismissed or demeaned or even ostracized.
before: And this range of acceptable behaviors — when we stay within our range, we're rewarded. When we step outside that range, we get punished in a variety of ways.
after: Or we lose that raise or that promotion or that deal. Now, the first thing we need to know is: What is my range?
ru: Нас увольняют, дискредитируют, даже отстраняют от общества.

quote: Yusuf Pathan was the first to fall, dismissed by Mohammad Asif for 15 runs.
before: Gautam Gambhir scored 75 runs as India were limited to 157-5 after twenty overs. The other Indian batsmen fell cheaply, with Rohit Sharma the second highest scorer, reaching 30 not out.
after: Robin Uthappa fell for just eight runs while Yuvraj Singh made 14 before being caught and bowled by Umar Gul, who was Pakistan's best performing bowler, taking 3-28. Gul also bowled Mahendra Singh Dhoni, who made six runs.

quote: We're just worried that the eccentricities he's been displaying lately will get out to the financial press or worse.
before: Press discovered sexual harassment charges were filed against the founder and C.E.O. The stock was offered at 70, end of the week... Between 4 and 5 bucks.
after: He could show up on the trading floor and make a scene. You want us to help you get through the I.P.O. and take the company public without incident.
ru: Мы просто волнуемся, что странности, которые он показывал в последнее время, станут известны финансовой прессе или хуже.

quote: It doesn't only display a lack of respect for me, it shows a lack of respect for yourselves.
before: - (all) Yes, sir. - (teacher) "Yes sir."
after: I mean it! You're wasting my time and your time.
ru: Вы тем самым не только показываете неуважение ко мне, но еще и к самим себе.

quote: This is about the poor judgment you have been displaying In this department for months now!
before: Do you have any idea how pathetic that sounds? This is not about Dexter !
after: You want to work out? No.
ru: Это из-за твоей недальновидности, которую ты показывал в этом отделе, в течение многих месяцев!

quote: They're displaying the world's most exotic pink diamond.
before: Well,hopefully,it has nothing to do with the promotion. What promotion?
after: That might have something to do with it. Well,this is something you don't see every day,except maybe if you're you.
ru: Они выставляют самый экзотичный розовый алмаз.

quote: Voice 16: All channels in Italy were displaying the same thing.
before: My business partner told me to turn on the television. Voice 15: So I switched on the television.
after: Voice 17: The Twin Towers. Voice 18: The Twin Towers.
ru: Голос 16: Все каналы Италии показывали только это.

quote: They were displayed first at Stux Gallery in 1983.
before: It was kind of a mixture of found object, product design and advertising. And I called them relics.
after: This is the clown skull. Is a remnant of a race of — a very evolved race of entertainers.
ru: И они выставлялись в галереи Stux Gallery в 1983 году.

quote: By displaying despair, helplessness and hopelessness, the media is telling the truth about Africa, and nothing but the truth.
before: But I want to say that there are two things we need to connect. How the media covers Africa in the West, and the consequences of that.
after: However, the media is not telling us the whole truth. Because despair, civil war, hunger and famine, although they're part and parcel of our African reality, they are not the only reality.
ru: Показывая отчаяние, беспомощность и безнадежность, СМИ говорят тем самым правду об Африке, и ничего кроме правды.

quote: Setup for the relics display can take about four hours depending on the venue.
before: Wikinews reporter Richard Kinne spent three days with the relics when the North American tour came to Ithaca, NY a few weeks ago. The relics travel with two caretakers, one of whom is always in close proximity to the relics.
after: Taking it down takes a bit under two hours.

quote: The hair color concept intrigues me because it's how I distinguish you anyway.
before: Britta. I guess my--my hands are tied.
after: But what if we arrange by age, so that way the young people can work while the old people sleep and vice versa. Um, I-I was just wondering who you considered old, because I'd like to remind you again that I'm just about the same age as Jeff.
ru: Концепция с цветом волос меня заинтриговала, потому что теперь я вас все равно различаю именно так.

quote: He's used computer analysis and they are able to distinguish between different types of predator.
before: - Yes. Is that one of the words?
after: Humans, badgers, various other animals. Not only that, different geometric shapes.
ru: Он использует компьютерный анализ. Они различают несколько видов хищников.

quote: He also has difficulty distinguishing the faces of people he knows.
before: Bill is asked to describe a series of photographs. He's able to put words to many of these objects but is very confused by some of the others.
after: All of these people really just look the same, and though he can recognize his ex-girlfriend because of her long hair, he can't remember her name. He tells the doctor he has a fish living inside of his head, possibly a trout.
ru: Еще он с трудом отличает друг от друга знакомых людей.

quote: Without compassion, what is there to distinguish men from beasts?
before: Father will be most pleased. And, um, the Prince?
after: What was your student doing beyond the walls? Sleep escaped me.
ru: Без состраданий. К чему различать человека от животного?

quote: Okay, but what distinguishes it from an offensive unit?
before: So military technologies can influence the course of the world, can make or break world peace — and there lies the issue with cyber weapons. The first issue: Imagine a potential enemy announcing they're building a cyberwar unit, but only for their country's defense.
after: It gets even more complicated when the doctrines of use become ambiguous. Just 3 years ago, both the U.S. and France were saying they were investing militarily in cyberspace, strictly to defend their IT systems.
ru: Хорошо, однако, что отличает его от подразделения для нападения?

quote: They have eyes, they can distinguish between light and dark, but they mostly work by smell.
before: And once they belong to the ants that work outside, they never go back down. Now ants — most ants, including these, don't see very well.
after: So just to reinforce that what you might have thought about ant queens isn't true — you know, even if the queen did have the intelligence to send chemical messages through this whole network of chambers to tell the ants outside what to do, there is no way that such messages could make it in time to see the shifts in the allocation of workers that we actually see outside the nest. So that's one way that we know the queen isn't directing the behavior of the colony.
ru: У них есть глаза, они могут различать темноту и свет, но в основном они работают, ориентируясь на запах.

quote: Knowing, that's what distinguishes us from the apes.
before: But that's terrible. We are homo sapiens.
after: But look at it this way. It took nature 100 million years to make the ape stand up and become Homo sapiens.
ru: Знания, вот что отличает нас от обезьян.

quote: The employee had been tutored on how to distinguish predators.
before: Sorenson, now aged 63, was discovered to be downloading child pornography by an employee of his parish at the St. John Fisher Church in Churchill, Allegheny County in December 2011.
after: Police investigating the case found some 5,000 child pornography images in Sorenson's church office.

quote: Peter Mill distributes his surplus pecan crop as food for livestock through a local co-op.
before: What are you doing? I'm watching a live feed.
after: For sheep, pigs and... and ostrich? Good God, man, did you go to college?
ru: Питер Милл распределяет излишки культуры пекана через местную компанию в качестве корма для скота.

quote: The good sisters have made linen ones which Sister Mair will distribute.
before: Many of our citizens are afraid to leave their houses, which is understandable, but we ask that you go to them and bring them word of our new rules concerning the disease. First of all, everyone must wear masks.
after: Please take them to your neighbours and leave them on their doorsteps. Also, we need volunteers to bury the dead.
ru: Сестры сделали льняные маски, которые будет распределять сестра Мейр.

quote: What line were we in when they were distributing testicles?
before: Indiana State Penitentiary is this way. Kiss my ass.
after: You know I have to go, right? I love you.
ru: А все-таки, где мы были, когда всем раздавали яйца?

quote: I told him we would bring water down to distribute from the mosque.
before: So what did he say? Well, he says he welcomes the Americans as long as they don't expose the Iraqi people to any corrupting influences.
after: Also I asked him for help with the crowd so that they don't go crazy. He says that the Americans should hit them if they come too close.
ru: Я сказал, что мы можем доставить воду и раздавать около мечети.

quote: We figured out that it would be too expensive and impractical to distribute 30 million tags.
before: So we started to look for technologies that would help us get these three things. Can we distribute radio-frequency tokens to identify people?
after: Can you use CCTV cameras with image-processing techniques? Again, too expensive for that scale, along with the disadvantages of being non-portable and being completely useless in the case of rain, which is a common thing to happen in Kumbh Mela.
ru: Мы поняли, что это было бы слишком дорого и непрактично — раздавать 30 миллионов передатчиков.

quote: Let's see how it would play out if the hats were distributed like this.
before: There are more than two possible values, but what does have two possible values is that number's parity, that is whether it's odd or even. So the solution is to agree that whoever goes first will, for example, say " black " if he sees an odd number of black hats and " white " if he sees an even number of black hats.
after: The tallest captive sees three black hats in front of him, so he says " black, " telling everyone else he sees an odd number of black hats. He gets his own hat color wrong, but that's okay since you're collectively allowed to have one wrong answer.
ru: Посмотрим, что получится, если шапки распределятся вот так.

quote: At issue is not the amount of that allocation but to whom it's distributed.
before: With approximately four million babies born each year in the US, if the average endowment of a baby trust is set at 25,000 dollars, the program would crudely cost about 100 billion dollars a year. This would constitute only about two percent of current federal expenditures and be far less than the 500-plus billion dollars that's already being spent by the federal government on asset promotion through tax credits and subsidies.
after: Currently, the top one percent of households, those earning above 100 million dollars, receive only about one third of this entire allocation, while the bottom 60 percent receive only five percent. If the federal asset-promoting budget were allocated in a more progressive manner, federal policies could be transformative for all Americans.
ru: В сущности, речь не об объёме выделяемых средств, а о том, как их распределять.

quote: Australian baggage handlers had been caught using passenger's luggage to distribute illegal drugs.
Uh, you peering at me through the window is disturbing.
before: What you doing? I didn't want to disturb you.
after: Uh, Christine's not here. Oh, I'm, I-I'm, I'm not here about Christine. No, no, I, um, I-I came over to see you about some, some office business.
ru: Твоё наблюдение через дверное стекло очень даже меня беспокоит. - Кристин нет.

quote: He'll be annoyed if I disturb him during his prayer.
before: Bless him. Oh, Jesus, who said, "If anyone wishes to come after me, he must deny himself, and take up his cross and follow me."
after: Given what I have to tell him, he'll have good reason to be annoyed. Join me in prayer, Albert.
ru: Его преосвященство не любит, когда ему мешают молиться.

quote: How could you come here and disturb what little peace I have left?
before: And we thought maybe you could help us. How could you?
after: Have you been messing about in that little room with that box? Now, you listen to me.
ru: Как вы можете приходить сюда и беспокоить меня после всего, что я пережила?

quote: You don't disturb a ha-ha ho when she's taking a selfie with the mic stand, John.
before: By the way, Jane, thanks for leaving last night without saying good-bye to Kristen. She bought you a Gimlet Godfrey.
after: It's like waking a sleepwalker. I like that she's interested in my career.
ru: Нельзя беспокоить "а ха-ха хо", пока она делает селфи с микрофонной стойкой, Джон.

quote: He built an underground room where he could practice without interruptions and not disturb other people.
before: To get rid of an odd habit he had of involuntarily lifting his shoulder, he practiced his speeches in front of a mirror, and he suspended a sword from the ceiling so that if he raised his shoulder, it would hurt. (Laughter) To speak more clearly despite a lisp, he went through his speeches with stones in his mouth.
after: And since courts at the time were very noisy, he also practiced by the ocean, projecting his voice above the roar of the waves. His activities in the learning zone were very different from his activities in court, his performance zone.
ru: Он вырыл подвал, чтобы практиковать без перерывов и не беспокоить других людей.

quote: With another patient of mine who also had some vision, the visions she had could be disturbing.
before: And you start to see things. The things you see can be very complicated indeed.
after: On one occasion, she said she saw a man in a striped shirt in a restaurant. And he turned round, and then he divided into six figures in striped shirts, who started walking towards her.
ru: У моего другой пациентки, [как и у Шарля Люллена] случались видения, и эти видения ее иногда беспокоили.

after: Guided by the refractive error and the shape of the cornea, the excimer laser robotically sculpts the exposed corneal bed into the correct shape. This process usually takes less than 30 seconds for each eye.

I'm expressing myself badly if you think it is not serious.

ru: Мы создаем инструменты, такие как марсоход, чтобы расширить наше видение и увеличить наш горизонт.

after: Whatever the disposal or cleanup options we come up with, it's clearly not just a technical problem. There's also complex space laws and politics that we have to sort out.
ru: Ремонт и техническое обслуживание сможет продлить жизнь сотням спутников, вращающихся вокруг Земли.

ru: Предположи, что что-то живёт в нашем Wi-Fi собирает человеческие умы, извлекает их.

quote: Instead, their visual systems have evolved to extract only the information that is necessary.

quote: I devised a procedure which extracted dormant Inhuman DNA from subjects pre-Terrigenesis.

quote: And if the whole planet would run on fusion, we could extract the fuel from the ocean.
before: Now, the fuel from fusion comes from the ocean. In the ocean, you can extract the fuel for about one thousandth of a cent per kilowatt-hour, so that's very, very cheap.
after: It would run for billions and billions of years. Now, if fusion is so great, why don't we have it?

Another group of ingredients in smartphones comes with similar environmental risks: these are metals such as copper, silver, palladium, aluminum, platinum, tungsten, tin, lead, and gold.
