quote: ‘Mrs. Harling,’ I said presently, ‘I wish I could find out exactly how Ántonia’s marriage fell through.’
ru: «Миссис Харлинг, — сказал я вскоре, — хотелось бы мне точно узнать, почему расстроилась свадьба Антонии».

quote: Your rehearsal dinner place just fell through.
before: Because that's what could happen. Um, Cate? Hmm?
after: I don't know- something about septic tanks and knee-deep water. I tuned out before I started gagging.
ru: Место для вашего предсвадебного ужина отменилось.
source_ru: Репетиция свадебного ужина в том месте сорвалась.

quote: One of the bookings fell through, so we're going to knock a quarter off the price.
before: And stay the hell away from Bobby Martin. Appreciate you coming.
after: No, we're not. There were four dates.
ru: Один из заказов сорвался, поэтому мы сбавим четверть цены.

quote: So many people fall through the cracks, and they lead miserable, wretched lives.
before: How someone like you, who's dedicated his life to the mentally ill... Could end up hating us so much that you'd want to kill us. No one knows better than you how... how terribly overwhelmed the mental-healthcare system is in this country, how little money is devoted to clinical research.
after: Some even turn violent. One could make the argument that these so-called victims are better off.
ru: Как много людей оказываются за бортом и ведут ничтожную, жалкую жизнь.

quote: Well, I had a place lined up when I first came out of training, but it fell through.
before: JP? !
after: And I found somewhere else, sir, but it needs a deposit and, with my family being on the other end of the island... ~ You've been sleeping here? ~ Until I get my first pay slip, yes.
ru: Я договаривался в одном месте сразу после учёбы, но там всё сорвалось.

quote: If what I'm gonna try falls through, if Reddington interferes, then maybe you're right.
before: It's just gonna take me some time to get it going. I do have some say in whether or not we put our child up for adoption.
after: Maybe I'll be okay with it, but I'm not... right now. I'll be back tomorrow.
ru: И если мой план провалится, если Реддингтон помешает, тогда, возможно, ты права.

quote: And when that happens, things slow down, fall through the cracks and inefficiencies flourish.
before: And when people feel stuck and helpless, they stop seeing their role in a bigger system. They start to think the work they do doesn't matter in driving change.
after: Now imagine with me, if you had a process you had to go through — had no other alternative — and this process was inefficient, complex and very, very slow. What would you do?
ru: И когда такое происходит, работа замедляется, дела остаются без внимания и процветает неэффективность.
source_ru: И когда такое происходит, дела замедляются, пропадают в трещины и неэффективность процветает.

quote: However, due to problems with insurance and liability indemnification, the deal fell through, according to Casey.
before: While SEPTA awaits new Silverliner V trains from Hyundai Rotem, which begin arriving in 2009, it had hoped to lease eight rail cars from New Jersey Transit, at an agreed-upon rate of US$10,000 per month.
ru: Однако из-за проблем со страховкой и освобождением от ответственности сделка сорвалась, сообщил Кейси.

quote: And he sees a lot of veterans that are falling through the cracks, and he's very concerned about that.
before: He knows that he's where he's at because people helped him when he came back, you know.
after: And then, there are other people that are falling through the cracks. And so, law enforcement, you know, law enforcement needs.
ru: И он видит много ветеранов, которые остаются без внимания, и его это очень беспокоит.

quote: I love the engine, but what fascinates me about old cars like this is why people feel compelled to get into period costume before driving them.
before: They'd love it, actually, because it does 0.18 miles to the gallon. You're kidding?
after: I mean, you live in a 1970s house. Do you feel the need to wear a shirt from the 19...
ru: Я люблю двигатели, но то, что очаровывает меня, так это старые машины, как эта поэтому люди чувствуют необходимость одеть костюм из той эпохи, прежде чем сесть за руль.

quote: Kinetic energy, for example, has always fascinated me.
before: But then you can imagine anything. At an early age, I was mechanically inclined.
after: And my friend, let's call her "B," always came up with the ideas. Playing frogs was one of B's classics.
ru: Кинетическая энергия, к примеру, всегда очаровывала меня.

quote: Fascinating, but you've never worked in this dive, now, have you?
before: No offense, but you do know I've worked in a restaurant before. I've seen them built, burn down-- Not that I had anything to do with that.
after: Come on, then, have a go at table three. I would think long and hard before sending an e-mail like that to a guy I just slept with.
ru: Захватывающе, но ты никогда не работала в подобной пивнушке, не так ли?

quote: Suddenly I was becoming sort of acceptable, which I found also fascinating.
before: Then suddenly, it started to get on front pages. I was being asked and paid to do front covers.
after: How one moment — it was disgusting — journalists would lie to me to get a story or a photograph of me, saying my work was wonderful, and the next minute there were terrible headlines about me. But then this changed suddenly.
ru: Неожиданно я стала желанной, что тоже было захватывающе для меня.

quote: Viewing solar transits are fascinating, but only if done safely.
after: People must never look directly at the Sun at any time! The safest way of viewing a transit is to project the image of the Sun as seen through a telescope onto a screen.

quote: She was feeding ice cream to your son.
before: Guess who I just met. The fucking cat lady from downstairs.
after: So... I don't know where the fuck you are or why you think you can fucking run away from the FBI, but you better get back here... [Beep] Fuck!
ru: Она кормила мороженым твоего сына.

quote: It's nice that Lydia is brest feeding him.
before: Figure what out? He never said.
after: So much healthier. Plus, it's obvious why he likes it so much.
ru: Славно, что Лидия кормит его грудью.

quote: I've been feeding him for years. It's not personal.
before: What? Any low grade technician could do his job.
after: Don't give me that bullshit, Steve. Of course it's personal.
ru: Я кормил его несколько лет Ничего личного.

quote: You gotta feed him every now and again.
before: But I'm just getting used to this kid right now, and, you know, he's getting better every day but he's gonna take a while. He's hungry.
after: You know that. Thanks. I appreciate it, chef. We'll be okay. Thanks.
ru: Нужно время от времени, кормить его.

quote: OK. A farm that doesn't feed its fish, a farm that measures its success by the success of its predators.
before: It evolved to soak up impurities. " And then he added, " But our water has no impurities. "
after: And then I realized when he says, " A farm that has no impurities, " he made a big understatement, because the water that flows through that farm comes in from the Guadalquivir River. It's a river that carries with it all the things that rivers tend to carry these days: chemical contaminants, pesticide runoff.
ru: Хорошо, ферма, которая не кормит свою рыбу. Ферма, которая измеряет свой успех успехом своих «хищников».

quote: Instead, we want to feed them more vegetable proteins.
before: In fact, what you're seeing here are soybean fields. These soybeans are being shipped to Europe and to China as animal feed, especially after the mad cow disease scare about a decade ago, where we don't want to feed animals animal protein anymore, because that can transmit disease.
after: So soybeans have really exploded, showing how trade and globalization are really responsible for the connections to rainforests and the Amazon — an incredibly strange and interconnected world that we have today. Well, again and again, what we find as we look around the world in our little tour of the world is that landscape after landscape after landscape have been cleared and altered for growing food and other crops.
ru: Вместо этого, мы предпочитаем кормить их растительными белками.

quote: She fed love to a generation of people with purple hull peas and greens.
before: My mother cooked with the colors and textures of her garden. She baked yams and squash and heirloom tomatoes and carrots.
after: It seems that during my childhood, the blooms from my mother's gardens have healed all the way from her halo to the roots on the soles of our feet. In our last conversation before her death, she encouraged me to go anywhere in the world that would make me happy.
ru: Она кормила любовью целое поколение с помощью фиолетовой фасоли и зелени.

quote: The captors locked the crew inside the vessel and they were not fed well.
before: Somali pirates seized the Bahamas-flagged vessel on September 21 near the Horn of Africa, as the bulk carrier, was cruising in the Gulf of Aden en route and transporting coal to Europe.
after: The vessel is now headed to Italy and will sail from there to Greece, to meet the ship owners.

quote: I really did feel like an Ayn Rand hero. I was one.
before: But above all, they saw themselves as Randian heroes. I really felt like an Ayn Rand hero!
after: I didn't just feel like one, I was one! I was building the products.
ru: Я на самом деле чувствовал себя героем Айн Рэнд.

quote: I think the only unconditional love I ever felt was from Lee Iacocca.
before: Oh, that is just wrong. Well, I come from a long line of cold, detached people.
after: - My box turtle. - Oh.
ru: Думаю, то безусловную любовь, которую я когда-либо чувствовал, была от Ли Якокка.

quote: Most of the time, I just want to feel normal.
before: I mean, he's going through enough right now. As a sick person, I wouldn't want someone to give up on me because of that.
after: - I don't even know what to say. - Just be honest.
ru: Большинство времени я просто хочу чувствовать себя нормальной.

quote: I felt like I was climbing kilimanjaro with you.
before: - No, I'm fine. - Oh... Crack the sky was a big deal for me.
after: Gave me a huge writing boner. Come on.
ru: С тобой я чувствовал себя, как будто забираюсь на Килиманджаро

quote: But it turns out we can feel like we're in two places at once.
before: And it doesn't really matter where you're from or what age you are — it's really evocative. Now, don't get me wrong — I'm not saying that when you're in a piece you forget that you're here.
after: We can have what I call this duality of presence, and I think that's what allows me to tap into these feelings of empathy. Right?
ru: Но мы можем чувствовать себя, как будто находимся сразу в двух местах.

quote: You can feel just fine while high blood pressure ravages your most vital organs.
before: So it's no wonder that some men don't want to be bothered and skip going to the doctor altogether, especially if they feel fine. But herein lies the problem.
after: This is Denny Moe, owner of Denny Moe's Superstar Barbershop in Harlem. I've been lucky enough to have Denny as my barber for the last eight years.
ru: Можно чувствовать себя нормально, пока высокое давление разрушает жизненно важные органы.

quote: Without decisions you cannot see, you cannot think, you cannot feel.
before: And what that illustrates is that decisions are the key things that support our perceptual bubble. It keeps it alive.
after: And you may think that anesthetics work by sending you into some deep sleep, or by blocking your receptors so that you don't feel pain, but in fact most anesthetics don't work that way. What they do is they introduce a noise into the brain so that the neurons cannot understand each other.
ru: Без принятия решений человек не может видеть, не может думать, не может чувствовать.

quote: Q: Which council decision do you feel the city/your ward should be most proud of?
after: Which was the least desirable?

quote: I'm not here to fight with you or trade insults.
before: What the hell are you doing here? Don't tell me we're fucking neighbors now.
after: That's a good thing, 'cause you probably wouldn't last one round. Uh, I came here to talk to you about Dexter.
ru: Я здесь не для того, чтобы драться или обмениваться оскорблениями.

quote: Why would they be fighting about Hannah?
before: He had a right ding-dong with him about it last week. I thought it was about our Hannah, but... maybe it was about this.
after: My dad never liked them going together. Nearly ten years between them.
ru: Зачем им драться из-за Ханны?

quote: The woman who exists to fight the Troubles.
before: I'm already ruined. I kidnapped Audrey Parker.
after: They won't forgive that. They'll execute me.
ru: Женщину, чьё предназначение бороться с Бедами.

quote: My advice for you is to never cross Ubba and never, never fight him.
before: ...and saw my father killed. My uncle took my lands and pledged his allegiance to the Danes.
after: Stolen by the invaders along with a Saxon girl, Brida, I became first a slave and then a son to Earl Ragnar.
ru: Советую никогда не переходить дорогу Уббе. И никогда с ним не драться.

quote: We need to partner with international partners, developed countries, to fight this together.
before: Corruption is an issue that we have not yet gotten a good enough handle on, and we have to fight tooth and nail, that and increased transparency in the way we manage our economies and the way we manage our finances. We also need to be wary of new conflicts, new types of conflicts, such as we have with Boko Haram in my country, Nigeria, and with Al-Shabaab in Kenya.
after: Otherwise, we create a new reality which is not the type we want for a rising Africa. And finally, the issue of education.
ru: Мы должны сотрудничать с международными партнёрами, развитыми странами, и бороться с этим вместе.

quote: Because governments and businesses will fight over this power game, but where are we?
before: So I suggested we create a new oath, like the Hippocratic Oath, so that every student entering an engineering program takes a technocratic oath or a wisdom oath or some oath of commitment to the rest of us. That's my best hope, that we all rise.
after: And unless we play into that power table, I think we'll end up in a bad place. My biggest fear?
ru: Потому что правительства и компании будут бороться за власть, а где будем мы?

quote: You have to realize that you can't fight and control this.
before: And then we look at what companies can do. This is all the opportunity about being a community organizer.
after: You actually need to organize it. You need to harness it.
ru: Нужно иметь в виду, что нельзя бороться с кем-то или пытаться контролировать.

quote: The US team vowed to fight on in the individual competition.
before: The US team, who had come first in the qualifying round, came fifth in the finals which led to tears from John Orozco.
after: Steve Penny from USA Gymnastics told reporters: "Our guys know that they're better than fifth place, and they're going to try to show that off through the rest of the competition."

quote: We're all just trying to figure out who we are.
before: We all have our insecurities. Yes, we do.
after: I guess what I'm trying to say is don't stop... believin' Get this party started. That's so cute.
ru: Мы все просто пытаемся понять кто мы есть.

quote: You figured out what Ben was up to -- you made sure he had an alibi.
before: His friends were throwing him a going-away party. I can prove it.
after: Because you knew he wouldn't stop until he killed his father. And that's why you were gonna do it for him.
ru: Вы выяснили, что собирался делать Бен - вы удостоверились, что у него было алиби.

quote: You have to figure out what you can give him that nobody else can.
before: Booth loves you, Brennan, not me. It doesn't matter what anybody else would do.
after: Oh, great. 387 packages were shipped on the day he went missing.
ru: Ты должна понять, что ты можешь ему дать, чего никто другой не может.

quote: You asked me to figure out who e-mailed you that photo of Sarah's dead body.
before: Uh, sure. What's up?
after: We need to find the sender. I'd like to bring in someone who works here, someone I trust. Okay.
ru: Что такое? Ты просила меня выяснить, кто отправил тебе то фото трупа Сары.

quote: If you're trying to figure out what to say instead, try this.
before: People are still saying all the time to victims of privacy violations, " What were you thinking? You should have never sent that image. "
after: Imagine you've run into your friend who broke their leg skiing. They took a risk to do something fun, and it didn't end well.
ru: Если вы пытаетесь понять, что сказать вместо этого, попробуйте сделать так.

quote: She's still figuring out that journey to her authentic self.
before: Where does she belong? She has no idea.
after: But all she knows is that she does not want to be limited by the labels imposed upon her. So really, Kamala Khan's story is everyone's.
ru: Она по-прежнему пытается понять свою сущность.

quote: I can't figure out how Gomorrah got dragged into this.
before: And the angels shout, " Escape to the mountain. Whatever you do, don't look back, " just as God starts raining down fire on Sodom and Gomorrah.
after: But Lot and his folks are running, fleeing all that destruction, kicking up dust while the Lord rains down death, and then, for some reason, Lot's wife looks back. God turns her into a pillar of salt.
ru: Я никак не могу понять, за что досталось Гоморре.

quote: Get in the kitchen and start filling sippy cups.
before: Do you know what goes on around here when you're not here? Huan Ying. You can stay until the baby's born, but you're helping with the day care.
after: No English. Start filling cups with apple juice, or I'll have you and your commie fetus deported faster than you can say "Saigon." Okay, guys, I'm going upstairs to my office.
ru: Иди на кухню и начинай наполнять чашки-непроливайки (для детей).

quote: All right, so now let's start filling up some other places.
before: Okay, you think you can fit anything else in your mouth? Mm-mm.
after: Peter, I've had a long day at work, and right now, sex is the last thing I want to think about. You never want to do it no more.
ru: Хорошо, тогда начнём заполнять другие места.

quote: The puke that's in my hair is running down my body and filling my shoes.
before: Oh, okay. Will you excuse me?
after: What is happening to me right now? What?
ru: Рвота на моих волосах стекает вниз по телу и наполняет мои ботинки.

quote: I find Rayna Cruz, they fill in the blanks.
before: Look, the best way you can help Stefan is to keep your mouth shut and stop making things worse. So this faceless so-called Armory claims to know where you come from?
after: And if you have to lie or hurt your friends or screw anyone over in the process, so be it, right? I was sent to a workhouse at the age of four, with a concept of family so limited that I actually convinced myself that an Italian line cook was my father.
ru: Я нахожу Рейну Круз, а они заполняют пропуски.

quote: We don't have to fill it with ums and ahs.
before: I can get very excited by saying something really quickly, or I can slow right down to emphasize, and at the end of that, of course, is our old friend silence. There's nothing wrong with a bit of silence in a talk, is there?
after: It can be very powerful. Of course, pitch often goes along with pace to indicate arousal, but you can do it just with pitch.
ru: Не стоит заполнять её паразитами вроде «э-э-э» и «хм-м-м».

quote: We have filled the void with something wonderful, but it is not enough.
before: And with the right kind of help, maybe one day I could get better. I came together with patients around the world, and we started to fight.
after: I still don't know if I will ever be able to run again, or walk at any distance, or do any of those kinetic things that I now only get to do in my dreams. But I am so grateful for how far I have come.
ru: Мы заполняем существующие пробелы своими исследованиями, но этого не достаточно.

quote: And then even better is we take a video, a video of someone filling it up.
before: So now we have the real deal. How long will it take it to fill it up?
after: And it's filling up slowly, agonizingly slowly. It's tedious.
ru: А ещё лучше — снять на видео, как бак наполняется водой, медленно,

quote: It took 10 seconds to fill the oven.
before: "We have an oven full.
after: The ground moved," said Phoenix co-investigator Bill Boynton, a researcher at the University of Arizona located in Tucson, Arizona.

quote: Well, why don't you fill in the form for Newbury's?
before: I'd like to marry Amy. Especially now. I just can't afford an engagement ring.
after: I have. Cos I don't want to work for 'em. But you've got your new baby to think of now.
ru: - Почему ты не заполнил анкету для Ньюбери? Я заполнила.

quote: Man, this story is filling in a lot of gaps.
before: Well, then I'll be a spokesman for my people, like Ralph Abernathy. Ralph, I like that name.
after: But I want to know about Dad and his broken heart. Your father lost a lot in his life-- his hair, his mother, more games of Monopoly than any man ought.
ru: Человек, эта история заполняется в много пробелов.

quote: We need to fill in the gaps and find these kids.
before: Listen up, everyone, it's confirmed. Driver has a record, Major Crimes has their suspect.
after: What about the boy with the police? Says he can't remember anything.
ru: Мы должны заполнить пробелы и найти этих подростков.

quote: For me, having you here fills in the biggest blank.
before: But to actually do it, after 30 years? I just have a lot of blanks to fill in.
after: "Played out." You're kidding. That place was great.
ru: Для меня одно твоё присутствие заполняет самую большую пустоту.

quote: There's porn to fill in the gaps -- and it will fill in the gaps.
before: So as parents, one of the things that we do is we teach our children about sex. We have books to help us, we have sex ed at school for the basics.
after: (Laughter) We teach our children " the talk " about biology and mechanics, about pregnancy and safe sex, and that's what our kids grow up thinking that sex is pretty much all about. But we can do better than that.
ru: А чтобы заполнить пробелы, есть порнография — и какие только пробелы она не заполняет!

quote: And boy are we willing to fill in those gaps in our lives with lies.
before: We wish we were better husbands, better wives, smarter, more powerful, taller, richer — the list goes on. Lying is an attempt to bridge that gap, to connect our wishes and our fantasies about who we wish we were, how we wish we could be, with what we're really like.
after: On a given day, studies show that you may be lied to anywhere from 10 to 200 times. Now granted, many of those are white lies.
ru: И к сожалению, мы готовы заполнить такие пробелы в нашей жизни ложью.

quote: But maybe Mission Blue can fill in that ocean that we can't see.
before: And now with Google's Oceans, we can actually put a white shark in that ocean. And when we do and it swims, we see this magnificent bathymetry that the shark knows is there on its path as it goes from California to Hawaii.
after: We've got the capacity, NASA has the ocean. We just need to put it together.
ru: Но, возможно, миссия "Голубая планета" поможет заполнить пробелы в знаниях об океане.

quote: I--I'm trying to find the Jennifer Williams I knew 23 years ago.
before: Cyrus Harry? You used to call my Cy if it's-- if it's really you.
after: We spent a long weekend at the Jersey Shore? She was visiting a friend...
ru: Я--я пытаюсь найти ту Дженнифер Уильямс, с которой был знаком 23 года назад.

quote: My mother could find the cloud in every silver lining.
before: It's gettin' ugly out there. You okay?
after: That's cute. Mine smiles all the time, like some ghoul.
ru: Моя мать могла найти каплю дёгтя в любой бочке мёда.

quote: Good help is so hard to find these days.
before: John Amos? Tea and cookies at once!
after: Is there something wrong with your face? Bart, that's rude.
ru: В эти дни трудно найти хороших работников.

quote: We need to find Euron Greyjoy's fleet and sink it.
before: And careful of the paper mites. They like flesh as well.
after: Your Grace, he's already destroyed a good portion of our fleet. To send our remaining ships after him...
ru: Мы должны найти флот Эурона Грейджоя и потопить его.

quote: Perhaps part of this journey is about me trying to find out where I belonged.
before: I had no idea. So I hope there aren't too many psychologists in this audience.
after: So whilst going, and don't worry, I didn't when I arrived with these tribes, I didn't paint myself yellow and run around with these spears and loincloths. But what I did find were people that belonged themselves, and they inspired me, some extraordinary people, and I'd like to introduce you to some heroes of mine.
ru: Возможно, целью путешествия было найти своё место в этом мире.

quote: I bought a book on simplicity to try to find answers.
before: It was a disaster. I felt completely trapped.
after: And I did find a quote that made a big difference in my life, which was, " We suffer more often in imagination than in reality, " by Seneca the Younger, who was a famous Stoic writer. That took me to his letters, which took me to the exercise, " premeditatio malorum, " which means the pre-meditation of evils.
ru: В попытке найти решение я купил книгу о простоте.

quote: We have to really find a way of supporting those countries in a better way.
before: These red are the countries that doesn't do it, and the policy has to be improved. Not simplistic extrapolation.
after: We have to respect the middle income countries on what they are doing. And we have to fact-base the whole way we look at the world.
ru: Мы должны по-настоящему найти путь для поддержания тех стран лучшим способом.

quote: Police noted a blood trail was found outside the business.
before: It is unclear if the suspects left with any property, but early reports indicate one suspect was injured during the robbery.
after: Police said the men may have arrived at the business driving a light blue or silver Ford Mustang.

quote: If Dr. Bishop finds out, we'd love to learn anything we can about it.
before: So how is it activated? I'm not sure.
after: Olivia, if I had any inclination of what Peter was doing... I know.
ru: Если доктор Бишоп выяснит, мы будем рады узнать больше об этом устройстве.

quote: I found out about that Bible-thumping idiot trying to shaft me.
before: ~ Is it? Look, all right...
after: I wanted revenge. But shooting him?

ru: Я хочу, чтобы они могли просить о том, чего они хотят в постели, и получать это.

quote: They had a leader board where, if you recommended the best stories, you would get points.
before: Digg is a communal dynamic to try to find and source the best news, the most interesting stories. And they made this into a game, initially.
after: And that really motivated people to find the best stories. But it became so powerful, there was actually a cabal, a group of people, the top seven on the leader board, who would work together to make sure they maintained that position, recommending people's stories.
ru: У них есть таблица лидеров, где вы, если находите лучшие истории, получаете очки.

quote: Oh, but you got along with him okay?
before: Oh, well, it wasn't my own trailer. That director kid had the big trailer.
after: Well, yeah, I mean, you know, we had to-- I tell you, Millie, the kid is like-- he looked like an alien.
ru: Но ты с ним нормально ладил?

quote: Why do you have to get along with everyone you work with?
before: - You do? - Yeah.
after: We didn't get along when we first started working together. Yeah, and I hated that.
ru: Почему тебе хочется ладить со всеми коллегами?

quote: I didn't always get along with my teammates.
before: Well, this is sort of funny. It reminds me of the old days, when I played football.
after: But on Sunday we put all that bullshit aside and played together. I don't get it.
ru: Я не всегда ладил с членами команды.

quote: It's the only people he gets along with anyway.
before: Who wants to tell the patient? Fine, I'll get some kid to go talk to him.
after: Are we still fired? He works with abandoned kids.
ru: Он всё равно только с ними и ладит.

quote: We can't get along with other people, even in our own families.
before: Why do we have these wars in every generation, and in every part of the world? And revolutions?
after: We find ourselves in the paralyzing grip of self-destructive habits we can't break. Racism and injustice and violence sweep our world, bringing a tragic harvest of heartache and death.
ru: Мы не умеем ладить с другими людми, даже в наших собственных семьях.

quote: Because I don't think they should get away with it.
before: No, I'm not. Someone threw a man off a bridge and I want to know who did it and why.
after: Because that is my job and I'm sick of people trying to stop me from doing it. GROANS IN PAIN Oh, my God.
ru: Потому что я не считаю, что это должно сойти им с рук.

quote: It's just me telling him he can get away with anything.
before: Which means it's too late for me to back down. It's no longer my choice.
after: I have to send him to prison. Your job is to keep this machine running.
ru: Как будто я говорю ему, что ему может сойти с рук что угодно.

quote: Then you know why he can't get away with it.
before: But victim or perpetrator, if your number's up, we'll find you. We know about Quinn and what he did to Cal.
after: Where are we taking him? Fed building downtown.
ru: Тогда вы знаете, почему это не может сойти ему с рук.

quote: She doesn't just get to get away with this!
before: And does that make you feel important? Are you enjoying this? !
after: I'm sick of that bitch! I'm sick of you!
ru: Ей не должно это просто так сойти с рук!

quote: I just wanted to get back to you on that message about Chesapeake Bay.
before: The larvae he swallowed in the bay had grown into a full-sized parasite in eight hours from the toxic soup. Hi, this is Steve Slattery over at Homeland Security.
after: Yeah? And? Yeah, uh... turns out we did hear something a few weeks back about a couple divers' bodies being found in the water.
ru: Я хотел ответить вам на то сообщение о Чесапикском заливе.

quote: I'll get back to you as soon as I know anything.
before: Consider it done. I'll just, I'll drop Nadia off and then I'm all yours.
after: Thanks. Well, if it is drugs these kids are not gonna narc to a teacher.
ru: Я вернусь к вам как только узнаю что нибудь.

quote: We'll get back to you as soon as we have something.
before: Damn strange business. First his car blows up, and then somebody tries to kill him.
after: Dougie, you can take the rest of the day off. Well, that's great, because I can take him to the doctor.
ru: Мы свяжемся с вами, как только что-то узнаем.

quote: I told them that I was doing a project, had some questions and at some point may possibly get back to them.
before: AS: I did video recorded interviews with several Scientologists – they didn't know what the interviews were for.
after: I asked them questions about themselves, their skills, where they stood on Scientology training and counseling, etc. I then weeded out the ones that I didn't think would be appropriate for the personal staff of Tom Cruise and for those who seemed promising, I compiled their video with contact information and sent it to Shelly Miscavige. She would forward to Andrea (TC's Assistant at the time) any she thought were good.
ru: Я сказал им, что делаю проект, что у меня есть вопросы и что когда-нибудь, возможно, я с ними свяжусь.

quote: Meaning that your firm, it pays its employees the minimum, just enough to get by and remain a permanent underclass.
before: I think what Allen is implying is that there are wage slaves. Meaning what?
after: Are you accusing me of exploitation? Are you ever coming in here?
ru: То есть твоя фирма платит сотрудникам минимум — ровно столько, чтобы сводить концы с концами, — и они навсегда остаются низшим классом.
source_ru: Это то, что твоя фирма платит сотрудникам минимум, ровно столько, сколько нужно, чтобы оставаться низшим классом.

quote: I never thought I'd be the guy who just got by.
before: You'll cram and you'll survive. All my life, I was who I was because I was the smartest.
after: You know what I don't get, is if you're having so much trouble, how is everybody else getting through this? But polarity reverses in a sub-quantum flux.
ru: Никогда не думал, что стану тем, кто просто кое-как перебивается.
source_ru: Я не думал, что буду тем парнем, который прорвется.

quote: You're gonna be okay, John. A lot of people get by with nine toes.
before: You owe me a toe, Bartowski. There.
after: - I'm getting by fine with eight. - How much is a toe worth to Casey?
ru: Всё будет хорошо, Джон. Многие прекрасно обходятся девятью пальцами на ногах.
source_ru: Множество людей ходит с девятью пальцами на ноге.

quote: And the rest of us, the vast majority of us, struggle to get by.
before: And I asked myself the question: How is it possible that we could be so poor here in the United States, because coal is such a wealthy resource; it's so much money? And I realize: because the Chinese ingratiated themselves with a small ruling class here in the United States, who stole all of that money and all of that wealth for themselves.
after: And the Chinese gave this small ruling elite loads of military weapons and sophisticated technology in order to ensure that people like me would not speak out against this relationship. Does this sound familiar?
ru: А остальные, подавляющее большинство из нас, еле сводят концы с концами.
source_ru: А что до остальных, мы - подавляющее большинство вынуждены прозябать в нищете.

quote: Other people do all sorts of jobs to get by.
before: Under our apartment, there is a carpenter, sweetshops, a butcher, a printing house, workshops, among many more. I have started teaching part-time, and with my husband, who juggles several jobs, we've opened a small bookshop.
after: When I look at my destroyed city, of course, I ask myself: What has led to this senseless war? Syria was largely a place of tolerance, historically accustomed to variety, accommodating a wide range of beliefs, origins, customs, goods, food.
ru: Другие люди берутся за любую работу, чтобы выжить.

quote: Give us enough to get by but not enough to provide for ourselves.
before: Oho! Oh, it all makes sense.
after: Keep us psychologically feeble so we lose our purpose in the process. Stop thieving our aspirations out of our sleep.
ru: Дайте нам достаточно, чтобы кое-как обходиться, но недостаточно, чтобы обеспечивать себя.
source_ru: О, всё это очень продуманно. Дайте нам вдоволь, чтобы едва держаться на плаву, но не больше.

quote: Oh don't worry about me; get on with the tunnel.
before: Ah... you're lucky. I think it's only temporary paralysis.
after: Thanks to you and Jamie it's nearly finished. Doctor, I think the Dominators have finished drilling too.
ru: О, не беспокойтесь обо мне; продолжайте туннель.

quote: Just get on with it, Inspector.
before: Oh, no, we're not. Eddie, do shut up.
after: Thank you. Ms Viviani, Mr Grace - good afternoon.
ru: - Продолжайте, инспектор.

quote: Would everybody please get on with their tasks?
before: So, how old are you? None of your business how old I am.
after: Morning. Thank you.
ru: Пожалуйста, все продолжайте свою работу.

quote: Just get on with it.
before: A hamster with a blunt penknife would do it quicker! You ordered me to make no noise, master.
after: Cheer up. It'll all be over soon.
ru: Просто продолжай.

quote: Quinn's preggo and feels that she's totally alone... and Sue won't leave Will alone... as the poor guy's trying to get over... divorcing his terrible wife Terri.
before: - I think I kinda like her. I don't want her to get hurt.
after: I mean, she's not terrible. - She's just kinda, you know, terrible. - Sorry.
ru: Квинн беременна и чувствует себя совершенно одинокой. И Сью все никак не оставит Уилла в покое, в то время как бедняга пытается пережить развод со своей ужасной женой Терри.

quote: The poor kid can't get over it.
before: - What about Isabelle? He dropped her.
after: Emilie surprised me. She seemed like a nice girl.
ru: Бедный ребенок не может прийти в себя.

quote: Or maybe I just need to get over it.
before: I actually convinced myself that he was in some remote mountain region and couldn't accept my calls. Or maybe he just doesn't want to bother you with every half-lead that goes nowhere.
after: Thanks for the books. Elena on phone:
ru: Или может быть, мне просто нужно пережить это.

quote: We all have to get over it. Okay.
before: Yes. I won't see Vivienne again, you won't see Vivienne again and he won't see Vivienne again.
after: Now, bounce me up. I'm not moving until you play with me.
ru: Нам всем нужно это пережить Ясно?

quote: And maybe if you come back to a close, cohesive, tribal society, you can get over trauma pretty quickly.
before: When their warriors came back from fighting the US military or fighting each other, I bet they pretty much just slipped right back into tribal life. And maybe what determines the rate of long-term PTSD isn't what happened out there, but the kind of society you come back to.
after: And if you come back to an alienating, modern society, you might remain traumatized your entire life. In other words, maybe the problem isn't them, the vets; maybe the problem is us.
ru: Может, вернувшись в сплочённое, закрытое общество, можно быстро оправиться от травмы.

quote: That is something that I did not get over.
before: A camp counselor fortunately came over and separated us. From that point onward I was terrified of swimming.
after: My inability to swim has been one of my greatest humiliations and embarrassments. That is when I realized that I was not the Incredible Hulk.
ru: Это был страх, от которого я не смог оправиться.

quote: One of the most off-putting things you can say is, "Just get over it."
before: It's not hard science, but I worked with a lot people I know who've lived with depression to refine these suggestions. First up, some things you might want to avoid — some " don'ts. "
after: Great idea — love it, it's just we already thought of that. (Laughter) The absence of the ability to just get over it is depression.
ru: Одна из самых отталкивающих фраз, которую вы можете сказать: «Просто переживи это».

quote: That eager to get rid of me, huh?
before: Also for two. You can't believe these forms.
after: Hey, you know those, uh, little berets you guys wear? You got any extra?
ru: Так хочешь от меня избавиться?

quote: To elaborate, I want your wife, the teacher, to help get rid of Lisa's substitute.
before: Don't want to hit you. I want your wife.
after: Edna? You know how you said you could help me with any desire, and nothing was forbidden?
ru: В смысле, мне нужна твоя жена-училка, чтобы помочь Лизе избавиться от учительницы на замену.

quote: But I became disenchanted, so I had to get rid of her.
before: I-I thought you already were married. Yes, I was.
after: Through divorce. Where's your sense of humor?
ru: Но я разочаровался, так что пришлось от нее избавиться.

quote: Why do I feel like you're trying to get rid of me?
before: You might want to beat traffic, so... I thought you'd be happy that I was here.
after: I have no idea. It's not because you're a jinx.
ru: Почему у меня такое чувство, что ты пытаешься избавиться от меня?

quote: Even if you don't want them, you can't get rid of them.
before: Those are the ones that you can't delete if you're an iPhone person. You press on them and they don't jiggle and they don't have x's.
after: (Laughter) Those are like the core genes of Prochlorococcus. They're the essence of the phone.
ru: Даже если они вам не нужны, вам от них не избавиться.

quote: First is, everybody says we're going to get rid of a lot of cars.
before: What are your concerns or issues about them? Peter Calthorpe: Well, I think there's almost too much hype here.
after: What they don't say is you're going to get a lot more vehicle miles. You're going to get a lot more cars moving on streets.
ru: Во-первых, говорят, что мы сможем избавиться от большого количества машин,

quote: People burn trash to get rid of the garbage, and they dig their own sewer channels.
before: People steal electrical power — this is Rio. People tap in and they have thieves who are called " grillos " or " crickets, " and they steal the electrical power and wire the neighborhood.
after: Talk about more plastic bags than plankton. And sometimes they have natural trash-disposal.
ru: Чтобы избавиться от мусора, его сжигают. И они сами себе роют каналы канализации.

quote: So the killer got stuck in, threw a few punches.
before: Hang on. Heavy bruising, upper torso.
after: Here. Partially fractured spine.
ru: Ну убийца застрял, ударил несколько раз.

quote: The wheel got stuck in a open manhole.
before: Oh, brother. Uh-huh. I made it seven blocks before I smashed into the construction barricade.
after: And when Frank found out...? It was not pretty.
ru: Колесо застряло в открытом люке.

quote: I mean, what if we got stuck out there?
before: Yes, there is. We-- we have to go back and... get all our supplies.
after: We will go to your camp. It is on the way to where we will take you.
ru: Вдруг мы здесь застрянем надолго?

quote: Who knows what they wanted me for before you got stuck with me?
before: Look, it's pretty simple, ok? If we make it to the base and it's still up and running I might not make it out alive.
after: Hell if I know. It's gotta be a cure though, right?
ru: Кто знает, чего от меня хотели, пока ты со мной не застрял?

quote: I got stuck and I made it through.
before: This is an amazing feeling of calmness, being the only person in the world who knows a new law of nature. And I started the second project in my Ph.D, and it happened again.
after: And I started thinking, maybe there's a pattern here. I asked the other graduate students, and they said, " Yeah, that's exactly what happened to us, except nobody told us about it. "
ru: Я застрял, и прошёл через это испытание.

quote: And the third: a mysterious stranger has gotten stuck squeezing through the bars on her window.
before: The first: a prison cell. The second: complete amnesia.
after: His name is Hedge, and he has come to help Ethic save the world. But first they have to break out of jail.
ru: Третий — странный незнакомец застрял, пытаясь протиснуться сквозь решётку на окне.

quote: (Robot buzzes) (Singing) Oh no, it got stuck.
before: So, we're all good. OK.
after: Isn't it comforting that even robots sometimes get stage fright? It just gets stuck a little bit.
ru: (Жужжание робота) (Пение) О, нет, он застрял.

quote: I'm sure you could get the hang of it pretty quick.
before: I'm available whenever. We're not splitting the atom, okay?
after: But if you can't deal with customers Or you get bored and quit on me, Then we're gonna be short-staffed And I'm gonna have to go through all this again.
ru: Я уверена, вы освоитесь довольно быстро.

quote: It's not too bad when you get the hang of it.
before: Delicious. How do you like your school, Elliott?
after: That's wonderful. How do you think Greta will go?
ru: Не так плохо, если приноровиться.

quote: I doubt he'll ever get the hang of it.
before: I say just be yourself and stop trying so hard. "Be interested..." Ha.
after: Robert didn't rebel. He didn't ask questions.
ru: Сомневаюсь, что он когда-нибудь с этим освоится.

quote: It takes a little time to get the hang of it at first.
before: DAPHNE [ON RECORDER]: I was lying in bed wearing a whipped-cream teddy. But did he care?
after: My God, you should've heard my audition tape. - I was so inept it was incredible.
ru: Потребуется какое-то время, чтобы приноровиться.

quote: I got to get up to this floor more often, huh?
before: Wow. That's some good skinny.
after: They're joking. They're here on official police business.
ru: Мне стоит подниматься на этот этаж почаще, а?

quote: Now, if you passed the test, go ahead and get up and exit the classroom.
before: Everyone could see that they had chemistry together, but it wasn't until Donny Richter's algebra class that the real bonding began. Okay, I don't want to embarrass anyone, so, everyone, close your eyes, close 'em.
after: Does that include the crew? No, the "Babies Having Babies" crew... - 38.
ru: Теперь, если вы закончили с тестом, вставайте и выходите из класса.

quote: You didn't get up to see why the baby wasn't crying.
before: The old Dan Logan charm. The baby didn't cry.
after: The phone didn't ring. Your neighbor didn't stop by and borrow some sugar--
ru: - Ты не вставала проверить, почему малышка не плачет.

quote: I just have to get up early tomorrow to grind out a piece before Friday.
before: Oh, come on, Chris, I was just kidding around. No, it's fine.
after: Goodnight, Mom. Oh!
ru: Мне завтра рано вставать, чтобы со всем управиться до пятницы.

quote: (Video) Roy Neary: Get up, get up! I'm not kidding. Ronnie Neary: Is there an accident?
before: Stu Pickles: Because I've lost control of my life. (Laughter) Rives: And then there was the lone TEDster who was disgruntled I had overlooked what he considers to be a classic.
after: Roy: No, it's not an accident. You wanted to get out of the house anyway, right?
ru: (Видео) Рой Нери: Вставай! Я не шучу. Ронни Нери: Что-то случилось?

quote: If you sit a lot, get up and move around on occassion, and be sure to exercise.
before: Keep anything you're carrying close to your body. Backpacks should be in contact with your back carried symetrically.
after: Using your muscles will keep them strong enough to support you effectively, on top of all the other benefits to your joints, bones, brain and heart. And if you're really worried, check with a physical therapist, because yes, you really should stand up straight.
ru: Если вы много сидите, вставайте и двигайтесь при любом удобном случае. И обязательно делайте упражнения.

quote: You're both getting up. Here we go. Good, now? Them.
before: And... bam, bake... (clicks metronome) Great. Okay, from there, you're both getting up.
after: (Applause) So from there, from there, we're both getting up, we're both getting up, going in this direction, going underneath. Whoa, whoa, underneath.
ru: Вы вдвоём, вставайте. Вот и мы. Хорошо.

quote: She owns a small business, and she loves to give, not as much as she loves to receive.
before: I'll find someone else with a business. What about Sophie?
after: I'm not so sure Sophie's cleaning business is totally, well, legal. I mean, when we worked for her, on the memo line of our paycheck, she wrote "colonoscopy."
ru: У нее есть маленький бизнес, и она любит давать, конечно не так сильно, как она любит получать.

quote: And I've really missed giving it.
before: Yeah. I have really missed your advice, Ms. Grant.
after: Now, shoo. Up, up and away. No time to lose.
ru: А я скучала по даванию советов.

quote: You gave me the world's finest jewels, but no wedding ring.
before: I've never wanted to be free. When I met you at the jewelry shop, I thought I'd get 29 years straight.
after: Who said: "Never wed your mistress, "for marriage is love's perfect murder."? You have more like that?
ru: Ты дарил мне самые прекрасные в мире украшения. Но ни разу - обручального кольца.

quote: Let me give you some examples of my work.
before: We all can contribute towards change. Like I said, I'm a designer and I would like to change things through design.
after: I'm collaborating with Swarovski, the crystal company. And if you cut crystals in a certain way, you are able to bend and direct the light onto a certain place.
ru: Давайте я приведу несколько примеров своих работ.

quote: And the final one is that most anti-economic of activities, but give.
before: It can be learning to cook a new dish, picking up an instrument you forgot as a child. Keep learning.
after: Our generosity, our altruism, our compassion, are all hardwired to the reward mechanism in our brain. We feel good if we give.
ru: И последний поступок самый анти-экономический из всех. Дарите.

quote: America gave them weapons, gave them money, gave them support, encouragement.
before: And we forget this now, but back then the Mujahideen were celebrated in this country, in America. We thought of them as holy warriors who were taking the good fight to the ungodly communists.
after: But within that group, a tiny, smaller group, a minority within a minority within a minority, were coming up with a new and dangerous conception of jihad, and in time this group would come to be led by Osama bin Laden, and he refined the idea. His idea of jihad was a global war of terror, primarily targeted at the far enemy, at the crusaders from the West, against America.
ru: Америка давала им оружие, деньги, оказывала поддержку, поощряла.

quote: Mohammadi was given a sentence of 14 years, with a minimum non-parole period of seven years.
before: Maio, changed his plea to guilty during the trial, and was sentenced to 12-and-a-half years in jail, with a non-parole period of six years. Judge Kerry Cullinane sentenced Labanon to six years jail, He was ordered to serve at least three years before being eligible for parole.

quote: We should never give in to these vile pagans, to these brutes.
before: - There is, alas, no other way. - Father, I beg you, ignore this counsel of despair.
after: Otherwise we will have failed, and that is how we would be judged. - Your Highness, I think you must...
ru: Мы не должны поддаваться этим мерзким язычникам, этим скотам.

quote: But despite the bitterness of loss, you can not give in to anger.
before: I understand how you hard. We have all lost loved ones and friends.
after: You can not. People have been waiting for thousands of years... contact.
ru: Но несмотря на горечь утраты, нельзя поддаваться гневу.

quote: But you had to give up a successful career of your own.
before: When Rick had a passion, there was no stopping him. I loved that about him.
after: High-end sales type of business. Following someone else's dream must be, uh...
ru: Но вам пришлось бросить успешную карьеру.

quote: I paid for you to go to rehab. I gave up Abby for you.
before: That it is ours. What's wrong?
after: Now you want me to buy you a business? It never ends.
ru: Я заплатил за твою реабилитацию, я бросил ради тебя Эбби.

quote: Who gave up the woman he loved for zombies.
before: A human who you told about us. A human who risked his life for zombies.
after: Yeah. That guy.
ru: Тот, кто бросил любимую женщину ради зомби.

quote: I'm not ready to give up on this just yet.
before: If I stay with the Tok'ra, I can at least try to mend some fences. Are you sure?
after: Don't worry, I'll be back eventually. I'll miss you.
ru: Я пока не готов сдаваться относительно этого.

quote: The three things I did sort of blurt out when we got there, was first: Never, ever give up.
before: And we'll never forget it. It'll always be part of us.
after: I live it. What's the phrase from today from Socrates?
ru: Я брякнула какие-то три вещи, когда мы добрались до берега. Во-первых, «Никогда, никогда не сдаваться».

quote: It takes time, it takes a tolerance for failure, it takes individual people choosing every day not to give up.
before: But those discoveries come with a cost. It took thousands of people and 44 years to get the Hubble Space Telescope from an idea into orbit.
after: I know how hard that choice is because I live it. The reality of my job is that I fail almost all the time and still keep going, because that's how telescopes get built.
ru: и запустить его на орбиту. Для этого нужно время, нужно уметь мириться с неудачами, нужны люди, которые каждый день принимают решение не сдаваться.

quote: On some days, it means not giving up, continuing to swim in freezing water and setting a world record.
before: Even today, when I can't find motivation or joy in what I'm doing, all I ask myself is, " Is this the best I can do right now? " And the meaning of my " best " changes.
after: But on many other days, it means getting over my depressing thoughts, stepping out of the house and being able to do the daily chores. What does not change is that voice within.

quote: I use a lot of tricks, which means that sometimes I have to lie to you.
before: A magician promises to deceive you — and he does. MT: I like to think of myself as an honest magician.
after: Now I feel bad about that. But people lie every day.
ru: Я пользуюсь большим количеством трюков, что означает, что время от времени мне приходится лгать вам.

quote: If you're an average married couple, you're going to lie to your spouse in one out of every 10 interactions.
before: Men lie eight times more about themselves than they do other people. Women lie more to protect other people.
after: Now, you may think that's bad. If you're unmarried, that number drops to three.
ru: Если вы — среднестатистическая супружеская пара, вы будете лгать друг другу один раз из десяти.

quote: Elias and the other two men were stabbed in the back while lying on the ground.
And so we hide, and we hide behind what we like to call the floodgate of intimacy.
before: (Laughter) The floodgates in our mind open much like the streets of Shanghai. (Applause) So many pieces of information to process, so many ideas, concepts, feelings and, of course, vulnerabilities that we don't often wish to share.
after: (Laughter) And what might that floodgate be holding? What is the dike upon which it is built?
ru: И поэтому мы скрываем, и скрываем за тем, что мы любим называть «воротами близости».

quote: Is there anything else you would like to say to people reading this article?
I listened to the Qur'an on the radio yesterday.
before: What are you thinking, Wadjda? This competition is very difficult for me.
after: "If the learning of the Qur'an is difficult for you, God will reward you twice." Good.
ru: Я вчера целый день слушала Коран по радио.

quote: This is going to be quick and it's not going to be repeated, so listen up.
before: Oh, mate! Ready to order.
after: I'll have a bowl of won ton soup, the Singapore vermicelli noodles, half a Peking duck with pancakes har gow, char siu and the wasabi chicken dim sum. OK. And for you?
ru: Говорю я быстро, повторять не буду, так что слушай внимательно.

quote: We must attract a suitable bride, even if he won't listen to a word I say.
before: Master Phineus, master of the paintbrush, patiently awaits. Make him look marriageable, Master Phineus.
after: I shall endeavor to please, Your Majesty. But I can't work miracles.
ru: Мы должны подыскать подходящую невесту, даже если он меня совсем не слушает.

quote: Don't you want a lot of people to listen to your songs?
before: Yes, but only a small number. Let me ask you this.
after: The melody, it is really very good and you are very good at it, and I have the same idea that you have. To bring in new kinds of sounds to the music industry.
ru: Ты хочешь, чтобы много-много людей слушали твои песни?

quote: So listening to this brought something to the ear besides the obvious burst.
before: (Digital beeping sounds) This is scientific data converted into sound, and it's mapped in pitch. The process is called sonification.
after: When I examine the very strong low-frequency regions, or bass line — I'm zooming into the bass line now. We noted resonances characteristic of electrically charged gasses like the solar wind.
ru: Слушая гамма-всплеск, я поняла, что кроме него здесь есть что-то другое.

quote: No one's quite listening hard enough, but I very much believe it's true.
before: They're sucked in from other people; chiefly, if you're a man, your father, and if you're a woman, your mother. Psychoanalysis has been drumming home this message for about 80 years.
after: And we also suck in messages from everything from the television, to advertising, to marketing, etc. These are hugely powerful forces that define what we want and how we view ourselves.
ru: Никто их не слушает. Я же уверен, что именно так и есть.

quote: We may be the first people in the United States listening to this.
before: Can I hear? " And before long, they think, " Jeez, this is kind of historic.
after: We should record it. " So they bring in this big, clunky analog tape recorder and start recording these little bleep, bleeps.
ru: Может быть, мы первые люди в США, начавшие слушать его.

quote: I don’t listen to many a capella bands, though.
before: We are playing melodic metal, so my inspiration as a composer can be found in Blind Guardian and Nightwish. Metallica has always been a great influence for me, too.
after: There’s a German a capella band called the Wise Guys which I like, but it’s pop and doesn’t have to do much with our style of singing or performing. Combining the metal style with the performing style a capella is the original part of the idea.

quote: No, you should let one of them live.
before: I know it is, whoa, whoa. But you need to take care of this for them. We should let niki die?
after: You should give the cord blood to niki because she's weak And she needs it.
ru: - Нет, вы должны дать одной из них жить.

quote: I think I don't want to live in an Easter basket.
before: If you look closely, that's blue, that's green, that's yellow... to take the edge off all the chrome and concrete. What do you think?
after: I know. You really want to live in the batcave.
ru: Я думаю, что я не хочу жить в Пасхальной корзинке.

quote: I'll be living my dream in Iowa for eight weeks.
before: Wait a minute. Are you actually good at this writing thing?
after: How are you gonna ruin that, Peggy? Eight weeks?
ru: Я буду жить своей мечтой в Айове целых восемь недель.

quote: My family will live in a house down the hill.
before: The soccer field will be over here. Here, I want to have a little doll house for Manuela, and downstairs, a bar with a Jacuzzi for the guys.
after: I'm going to install a telescope so I can look at them whenever I want. Yeah, right.
ru: Моя семья будет жить в доме на склоне.

quote: I hope that you will find it as fascinating to read about traditional societies as I found it to live in those societies.
before: Features of the modern lifestyle predispose us to those diseases, and features of the traditional lifestyle protect us against them. Those are just some examples of what we can learn from traditional societies.
after: Thank you. (Applause)
ru: Я надеюсь, что вам будет так же интересно прочесть книгу о традиционных обществах, как и мне было интересно жить в таких обществах.

quote: These organisms can be totally desiccated; they can live in a vacuum.
before: Twelve to 24 hours later, it put it back together exactly as it was before. We have thousands of organisms that can do this.
after: I am absolutely certain that life can exist in outer space, move around, find a new aqueous environment. In fact, NASA has shown a lot of this is out there.
ru: Эти организмы можно полностью обезводить, они могут жить в вакууме.

quote: But it's also wrong about plants, because plants are not just able to live; they are able to sense.
before: But it's something completely wrong. You know very well about professors.
after: They are much more sophisticated in sensing than animals. Just to give you an example, every single root apex is able to detect and to monitor concurrently and continuously at least 15 different chemical and physical parameters.
ru: Также это -- ошибочно в отношениии растений, потому что они не просто способны жить; они способны чувствовать.

quote: Dannie Abse is an esteemed Jewish writer who lives in Glamorgan, South Wales.
after: Joan Abse, his wife, was an art historian and writer. Dannie Abse is well-known for being a poet and a medical doctor.

quote: No, I locate and retrieve children Who are abducted by non-custodial parents.
before: Recover? Don't you mean kidnap?
after: Which nicholas is not. He lives with his biological father, Who's the sole legal guardian.
ru: Нет, я находил и возвращал детей, которых похищали, несвязанно с лишением родительских прав.

quote: This club and the steel factory in which its located are all assets of Queen Consolidated.
before: My condolences, and to give you this. It's a notice to vacate the premises.
after: No, you--you can't do this. It's already done.
ru: Этот клуб и сталелитейный завод, в котором он располагается, являются имуществом Куин Консолидейтед.

quote: This cell is located in the Ryloth system.
before: A rebel cell has reported an Imperial carrier over their world. If we can steal that ship, we can use it to house all our fighters.
after: Ryloth? I know the cell you're talking about.
ru: Эти повстанцы находится в системе Рилот.

quote: Can you tell me where you're located?
before: How may I help you? Yes, I'd like to open up a new account.
after: I'm sorry, sir. We're not accepting new accounts at this time.
ru: Не подскажете, где вы располагаетесь?

quote: The ground stations are located on safe locations on the ground.
before: So they use GPS and other sensors on board to navigate between ground stations. Every vehicle is equipped with an automatic payload and battery exchange mechanism, so these vehicles navigate to those ground stations, they dock, swap a battery automatically, and go out again.
after: They secure the most vulnerable part of the mission, which is the landing. They are at known locations on the ground, so the paths between them are also known, which is very important from a reliability perspective from the whole network.
ru: Наземные станции располагаются в безопасных местах на земле.

quote: This was taken under the Montparnasse Cemetery where most of the ossuaries are located.
before: So the bones were moved from the cemeteries into the quarries, making them into the catacombs. The remains of over six million people are housed in there, some over 1,300 years old.
after: There are also phone cables that were used in the' 50s and many bunkers from the World War II era. This is a German bunker.
ru: Этот снимок был сделан под кладбищем Монпарнас, где находится большинство склепов.

quote: B is located on the edge of the network.
before: (Audience: B.) Nicholas Christakis: B, it's obvious.
after: Now, who would you rather be if a juicy piece of gossip were spreading through the network? A. And you have an immediate appreciation that A is going to be more likely to get the thing that's spreading and to get it sooner by virtue of their structural location within the network.
ru: Узел Б находится на краю сети.

quote: Q: Why should businesses be attracted to locating in Mississauga?
Murdoch's defence lawyer, Grant Algie, indicated an appeal would be lodged against the conviction.
before: Telling jurors that he "entirely agreed" with their verdict, Chief Justice Brian Martin sentenced Murdoch to a mandatory life sentence.
after: "Obviously we are disappointed with the result," he said.

quote: And I was looking at your things.
before: I was looking for a broom. And then I saw the box.
after: Well, don't. I just...
ru: И я смотрела на ваши вещи.

quote: I wasn't even gonna look at him.
before: I didn't think I would care. You know, I had a plan.
after: And when I realized he wasn't coming at all, I just got this awful feeling in the pit of my stomach. He doesn't even want to see me.
ru: Я не собиралась даже смотреть на него.

quote: Your father sent a carrier pigeon through the skylight when the guards weren't looking.
before: Cousin Harry's coming? But... how?
after: Your cousin will save us, and then you will marry him, as planned. I don't want to marry my cousin.
ru: Твой отец послал почтового голубя через окошко, пока стражники смотрели в другую сторону.

quote: Is that how she looked when you saw her on the bed in your uncle Steven's bedroom?
before: I don't understand. Is that your-- Is that your description?
after: I didn't see it. You just made that up?
ru: Так она выглядела, когда вы увидели её на кровати в спальне вашего дяди Стивена?

quote: That star I looked to night after night was called Vega.
before: And almost a sense of vertigo, like I was going to fall into space. And when this happened — I know this sounds kind of ridiculous, but I would simultaneously feel unfathomably insignificant and also kind of weirdly important.
after: Vega is the brightest star in the constellation Lyra, which is not coincidentally the name of one of my dogs. (Laughter) But this experience is being lost.
ru: Звезда, на которую я смотрела ночами, называется Вега.

quote: Early journalists looked at these spills, and they said, "This is a filthy industry."
before: The oil industry is like a huge, gigantic octopus of engineering and finance and everything else, but we actually see it in very moral terms. This is an early-on photograph — you can see, we had these gushers.
after: But they also saw in it that people were getting rich for doing nothing. They weren't farmers, they were just getting rich for stuff coming out of the ground.
ru: Первые журналисты смотрели на эти лужи нефти и говорили: "Это грязная индустрия".

quote: I look out at what's happening on college campuses, and I see the anger.
before: The tide of resistance, in fact, was so intense, that my college president rescinded the invitation. I was deeply disappointed by this because, as I saw it, there would be nothing that any of my peers or I could do to silence someone who agreed with him in the office environment of our future employers.
after: And I get it. But what I wish I could tell people is that it's worth the discomfort, it's worth listening, and that we're stronger, not weaker, because of it.
ru: Я смотрел на происходящее в кампусе колледжа и видел ярость.

quote: It also suggested that the Council should look at setting up a monitoring force in Lebanon.
before: The summit declaration called on the UN Security Council to draw up plans for implementing its resolutions UNSCR 1559 and 1680, which call for extending the Lebanese government's authority over all of Lebanon and the disarming of militias such as Hezbollah.

quote: Well, somebody's got to look after you, and that somebody turned out to be me.
before: - All right, everybody in. - We're not tired.
after: It's my sacred duty. That's what your mama said.
ru: Кто-то должен присматривать за вами, и этим кем-то оказался я.

quote: We have to be big enough to look after this baby.
before: What do you mean? Well, we have to blend in, don't we?
after: So, gather around, ladies. Get ready.
ru: Нужно быть весьма большими, чтобы заботиться о ней.

quote: I've looked after the new boy, sir, and shown him round the dormitory.
before: Obviously, you're a new boy. You've not been here before. - Never. - You, of course, have.
after: Have you? Cos last time you came, you were super-quick. Yeah, but the worst thing about the last time I came was my reaction when you told me how well I did.
ru: Ты у нас, конечно, был. Я присматривал за новичком и показал ему студию.

quote: I'm not staying, and I'm not gonna be stuck here looking after kids.
before: It's good that you're back, kid, you know, for... Stella and that.
after: - But I should? - They're your kids!
ru: Я не останусь и я не собираюсь застрять тут, чтобы присматривать за детьми.

quote: Okoloma lived on my street and looked after me like a big brother.
before: So I would like to start by telling you about one of my greatest friends, Okoloma Maduewesi.
after: If I liked a boy, I would ask Okoloma's opinion. Okoloma died in the notorious Sosoliso plane crash in Nigeria in December of 2005.
ru: Мы с Околомой жили на одной улице, он присматривал за мной как старший брат.

quote: If the city looks after the country, the country will look after the city.
before: It's about the relationship between the city and the countryside. And I think the message of this is very clear.
after: And I want us to ask now, what would Ambrogio Lorenzetti paint if he painted this image today? What would an allegory of good government look like today?
ru: Если город заботится о деревне, деревня будет заботиться о городе.

quote: I grew up herding, looking after our livestock -- goats, sheep and cattle.
before: A Himba is one of the 29 ethnic groups in Namibia. We live a very traditional lifestyle.
after: And one day, my father actually took me into the bush. He said, " John, I want you to become a good herder.
ru: В детстве я был пастухом, присматривал за животными — овцами, козами и крупным рогатым скотом.

quote: I will not let anyone look down on us and Prof. In.
before: I borrowed from the janitor. It's a bit light, but it'll do.
after: Everyone, I'm asking for 100% from you today. There...
ru: Никому не позволю смотреть на нас с учительницей Ин свысока.

quote: After experiencing the United States, she looks down on our country's traditional marriage arrangements.
before: Looking at the atmosphere, it would be impolite to hide this. She is still young and likes to make up stories.
after: You said that because you were afraid I'd arrange your marriage, right? No, Dad.
ru: Пожив за границей, моя дочь стала смотреть свысока на наши традиции касательно заключения браков.

quote: They look down on us, and we risk our lives for them.
before: SURVIVAL KIT "These whites, these dirty whites.
after: They're a bunch of nouveaux riches, pretentious, arrogant, ignorant. They don't deserve this beautiful land.
ru: Они нас презирают. а мы рискуем ради них своей шкурой.

quote: How dare you look down on me? I never looked down on you!
before: Now look at me. I passed with the highest marks. You're just another student. You jerk, Takuma!
after: You jerk! You have no idea how I felt!
ru: Как только смел смотреть на меня свысока!

quote: I looked down on my reality.
before: I struggled to reconcile my reality with the formal education I received in school, in the schools I attended. I had identity crises.
after: I looked at my ancestry, I looked at my lineage with disrespect. I had very little patience for what my life had to offer around me.
ru: Я презирала окружавшую меня жизнь.

quote: I was looking for dad's "Playboys" in the guest house.
before: Toby, unless you want dad to find out about whatever's going on in there, you better tell me everything you know. Okay, a long time ago,
after: Nice. And I ran across... a bunch of legal stuff about your birth mom.
ru: Я искал папины "Playboy" в домике для гостей.

quote: Let's start looking for anagrams of Sidney Falco and Sweet Smell of Success.
before: - There aren't. And you don't want to start looking for anagrams--
after: Okay. I got your text.
ru: Начинаем искать анаграммы Сиднея Фалько и "Сладкого запаха успеха"

quote: The petition you've been looking for backing Selah Strong to the New York Congress.
before: Major, Captain. What have you for us, Mr. Paine?
after: I confess my name is on it, a foolish mistake in a moment of drunken weakness. But I suspect there are others who will prove of more interest to you.
ru: Петиция, которую вы искали, в поддержку Силаха Стронга как кандидата в Конгресс.

quote: You were looking for Tatiana, were you not?
before: - Thank you. Why are you here?
after: I considered it an invitation to bring her to dinner. It was very smart, but I warned you.
ru: - Ты же искал Татьяну, разве нет?

quote: And I was always looking for a better canvas to tie these all together.
before: In one, I used NASA supercomputers to design next-generation spacecraft, and in the other I was a data scientist looking for potential smugglers of sensitive nuclear technologies. As a data scientist, I did a lot of analyses, mostly of facilities, industrial facilities around the world.
after: And one day, I was thinking about how all data has a location, and I realized that the answer had been staring me in the face. Although I was a satellite engineer, I hadn't thought about using satellite imagery in my work.
ru: И я всегда искал канву, которая лучше подходит для того, чтобы связать их все вместе.

quote: So we switched our models, and now we began to look for skeletal stem cells.
before: And two, that maybe that, the degeneration or dysfunction of this stem cell is what's causing osteochondral arthritis, a very common ailment. So really the question was, were we looking for a pill when we should have really been looking for a cell.
after: And to cut again a long story short, about five years ago, we found these cells. They live inside the skeleton.
ru: Поэтому мы поменяли наши модели и начали искать скелетные стволовые клетки.

quote: And I was looking for caves: caves because caves are the original prime real estate.
before: There was actually a few other academics out there. But sadly, due to political instability, they moved out, and so I moved in.
after: But also because if you're looking for fossils in that kind of heat, your best bet for fossil preservation is always going to be caves. But then, Yemen took a really sad turn for the worse, and just a few days before I was due to fly out to Yemen, the civil war escalated into a regional conflict, the capital's airport was bombed and Yemen became a no-fly zone.
ru: И я начала искать пещеры: искать пещеры, потому что пещеры это первичный вид недвижимости.

quote: I look forward to it.
before: That's... Fantastic.
after: We liked you when you came in here. We like you more now. Well, thank you so much for taking the time.
ru: Буду с нетерпением ждать.

quote: I look forward to your trial.
before: - It's time. - Good. I'm glad Na'Toth didn't succeed.
after: Are you really that naive? Do you imagine Earth Alliance will permit this charade?
ru: С нетерпением буду ждать суда.

quote: Right, I'll look forward to that.
before: I could borrow it if you like. Yeah.
after: You're going to be late. It's 11:30.
ru: Конечно, буду ждать с нетерпением.

quote: Although, I gotta say, I'm looking forward to getting rid of this thing one day.
before: Are you feeling more like yourself? Well, according to my DNA, I'm 100% John Sheppard.
after: Doc says it'll clear up eventually. So listen.
ru: Хотя, должен сказать, я с нетерпением буду ждать, когда однажды смогу избавиться от этого.

quote: I hope you're looking forward to that. Thank you very much.
before: But I think in this context and with the idea of taking something fake and making it into something real, I'm just going to leave it there, and walk off the stage. (Laughter) I will be seeing you several times over the next few days.
after: (Laughter) (Applause)
ru: Надеюсь, вы будете с нетерпением ждать следующей встречи.

quote: Because if we do, I can look forward to the conversation I'm going to have with my daughter in 20 years.
before: I can't wait to see what we TEDsters do about this crisis. And I really, really hope that we multiply all of our energy, all of our talent and all of our influence to solve this problem.
after: (Applause)
ru: Потому что, если мы сделаем это, я буду с нетерпением ждать разговора, который у меня состоится с моей дочерю через 20 лет.

quote: They were trying to get me to look up your S.A.T. score.
before: What are you guys doing? I'm officially not a part of this.
after: - What? - What are you, a narc?
ru: Они пытались заставить меня посмотреть твои оценки.

quote: I-I-I looked her up and saw that she was playing in Vegas.
before: Is that why you showed up 18 years later and killed her? I-I, I didn't kill her.
after: I didn't come here to kill her. I came here to, to talk to her, explain my side of the story.
ru: Я искал её и увидел, что она играет в Вегасе.

quote: Who's on the other end looking it up?
before: It's like sending a letter. There's a box, you type in a question, and the answer comes up.
after: Nobody. It's in the wires.
ru: А кто на другом конце будет его искать?

quote: She was looking up places to buy the morning-after pill.
before: Mr. Kennish, I swear... Please don't play dumb with me. I saw her computer.
after: I don't know if that's the reason that you broke up, but I do know I do not want her with someone who would put her in that position. You know, honestly, I expected more from you.
ru: Она искала места ,чтобы купить Таблетку после не защищенного секса

quote: As we walked to the center of the room, I looked up at the heavens through the oculus.
before: Dad explained that this wasn't a big open hole, but it was called the oculus, an eye to the heavens. And there was something about this place, I didn't know why, that just felt special.
after: This was the first church that I'd been to that provided an unrestricted view between God and man. But I wondered, what about when it rained?
ru: Когда мы двинулись к центру помещения, я посмотрел на небо через окулус.

quote: So I put on my best "Yeah, I totally understand" face, and went home to look up what Décimas were.
before: I was getting up to leave and go home to write, when Joaquín stopped me and said, " Hang on, hang on, " and presented me with this challenge: " Write the stanzas for this song in Décimas. " Now, at this point in my life, I still wasn't completely sure what Décimas were, but I was too embarrassed to tell my teacher I didn't know.
after: I learned that a Décima is a type of verse that only exists in Spanish, and that it has 10 lines. It's very, very complex — perhaps the most complex style of stanza that we have in Spanish.
ru: Поэтому я сделал вид, что всё понял, пошёл домой и посмотрел, что такое децимы.

quote: We look up and to the left and see vultures circling round and round.
before: Instead, we hear them say, " Oh, look. Something must be dead. "
after: It occurred to me at this very moment that if these ladies at the derby are aware of vulture's connection to death, then why aren't we talking more about these birds at crime scenes? People know that vultures are connected to death.
ru: Посмотрев вверх, мы увидели кружащих в небе грифов.

quote: A boy needs to look up to his father.
before: She told him... I slept around, that I brought diseases home, that I fathered other children, that I never cared about them. What part of that is not true?
after: You poisoned him about me. yourself feel better, to control him.
ru: Мальчик должен уважать отца.

quote: But we all looked up to her, in many ways.
before: She was head and shoulders above the others. She didn't see eye to eye with everyone.
after: Now, one moment, please. There we are.
ru: Но мы все её уважали во многих отношениях.

quote: He is not the big football star we all used to look up to, Dale.
before: It looked like he needed a gig. That's all this is -- a-a jump-start.
after: You seriously want me to kick him out of the band? If you want that poster in the window.
