before: LB: I think fear, political incompetence, interference, not taking it seriously soon enough — it's pretty human. I think throughout history, pretty much every pandemic is first viewed with denial and doubt.
after: We've had two months that we've lost. We've given a virus that moves exponentially a two-month head start.
ru: Но страны, действовавшие быстро, и даже те, кто начал медленно, как Южная Корея, смогли наверстать упущенное, у них получилось.

quote: Jim Chutney, SVP of B.A., and Saul Weinberg, managing director of operations, were arrested in broad daylight at the E Corp offices.
before: This... it's just a road paved with your dead friends and family. You need that game a lot more than I thought.
after: Both men... Guys like this, they work in long games.
ru: Джим Чатни, старший вице президент по бизнес аналитике И Сол Вайнберг, руководитель управления операциями, были взяты под арест посреди бела дня в офисе E Corp.

quote: My great-grandfather was a drunk in Detroit, who sometimes managed to hold down a factory job.
before: How should we live? All of us, whether we realize it or not, seek answers to these questions, with our ancestors kind of whispering in our ears.
after: He had, as unbelievable as it might sound, 21 children, with one woman, my great-grandmother, who died at 47 years old of ovarian cancer. Now, I'm pregnant with my second child, and I cannot even fathom what she must have gone through.
ru: Мой прадед, любитель выпить, жил в Детройте. Иногда ему удавалось справляться с работой на заводе.

quote: And even now, I manage the C-staff who manage the departments who manage the people who manage the people picking and packing.
before: But during that time, my role started to change, too. So, yes, I was the CEO in the garage; I was picking and packing, doing all the work, but then I graduated to actually managing the people who picked and packed, and then pretty soon I managed the people who managed the people picking and packing.
after: And it is at that point in time, I lost control. So I thought, OK, we were delighting all of these customers with these notes.
ru: И даже сейчас я управляю руководителями отделов, которые управляют теми, кто управляет упаковщиками.

quote: Seattle (2-0-1) managed to get through on percentage only over New York (2-0-1).
before: Denver (3-0-0 12pts) knocked off Golden Gate (2-0-1 8pts) for a spot in the final by defeating reigning champions Vancouver by 52 points in the last game of the group stage.

quote: But, it's fascinating that they can manifest themselves in so many different ways across the solar system.
before: Now, the laws of physics are simple and they're universal. What applies here, applies everywhere else up there.
after: In this programme, I'm going to look at how the universal forces of nature that created all this can also wreak devastation across the solar system. How they can be the death of a planet and how they can keep other worlds alive.
ru: но примечательно то, что они могут проявляться столь различными способами во всей Солнечной системе.

quote: Psychological conditions can manifest themselves in physical problems.
before: Are you trying to trap me into saying... Do you love her enough to admit that you slept with her?
after: Sometimes these can be extreme enough to kill. There are treatments, but only if there is a diagnosis.
ru: Психологическое состояние может проявлять себя через физические проблемы.

quote: That a photon can manifest as a wave and a particle coincided with my deepest intuitions that people are good and bad, ideas are right and wrong.
before: (Laughter) Wave-particle duality: the idea that one thing can manifest as two things... you know?
after: Freud was right about penis envy and he was wrong about who has it. (Laughter) (Applause) Thank you.
ru: Тот факт, что фотон может проявляться и как волна, и как частица, подтвердил моё внутреннее чутьё о том, что люди одновременно и хорошие, и плохие, а идеи — одновременно правильные и ложные.

quote: The cancer is incurable, and can manifest over 40 years after the initial exposure to asbestos.
before: Blue asbestos fibers are very narrow and thus easily inhaled, and are a major cause of mesothelioma. Mesothelioma is a form of cancer which can develop in the lining of the lungs and chest cavity, the lining of the abdominal cavity, or the pericardium sac surrounding the heart.

quote: And this is the antidepressant drug manufactured by the defendant?
before: I promise, next time, I'll bring something good. Elvatyl is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor.
after: It controls depression by stopping the brain from reabsorbing serotonin. I see.
ru: И это антидепрессантное медицинское средство производится обвиняемым?

quote: We need to find out who is manufacturing this drug and seize it.
before: You are criminal by association. By the mere fact that you attended school at St. Angelus.
after: We need to find out who else has it. If we open the lockers, how many parents will pull their kids from St. Angelus?
ru: Нам нужно отыскать производителя наркотиков и задержать его.

quote: This is too elaborate just to manufacture meth.
before: Check this out. Well, somebody trashed the place.
after: An industrial fridge. Don't usually see that in a meth lab.
ru: Это слишком сложное оборудование, чтобы просто производить мет.

quote: Mr. Openshaw ran the company which manufactured them.
before: The Pipz, aka "the beads." They're from a toy which was implicated in the deaths of a number of children last year.
after: Mr. Fordham was his criminal defense attorney. Some of the Pipz, you see, were poison.
ru: Мистер Опеншоу владел компанией-производителем.

quote: We even put satellites in space just to test the satellites, and we've learned to manufacture our satellites at scale.
before: And we take a different risk approach. We take them outside and test them.
after: We've used modern production techniques so we can build large numbers of them, I think for the first time. We call it agile aerospace, and that's what's enabled us to put so much capability into this little box.
ru: Мы даже запустили спутники в космос, просто чтобы их опробовать. И мы всерьёз научились производить их.

quote: Indeed, today we can manufacture gold on Earth thanks to modern inventions that those medieval alchemists missed by a few centuries.
before: They wanted to transform lowly lead into gleaming gold. History portrays these people as aged eccentrics, but if only they'd known that their dreams were actually achievable.
after: But to understand how this precious metal became embedded in our planet to start with, we have to gaze upwards at the stars. Gold is extraterrestrial.
ru: И правда: ведь сегодня мы можем производить золото. И всё благодаря достижениям науки, до которых средневековые алхимики не дожили каких-то несколько веков.

quote: He cofounded a company called Deaftronics, which now manufactures the Solar Ear, which is a hearing aid powered by his invention.
before: Now, he noticed that these hearing aids needed batteries that needed replacement, very often at a cost that was not affordable for most of the users that he knew. In response, and being an engineer, Tendekayi invented a solar-powered battery charger with rechargeable batteries, that could be used in these hearing aids.
after: My colleague, Sudesh Sivarasu, invented a smart glove for people who have suffered from leprosy. Even though their disease may have been cured, the resulting nerve damage will have left many of them without a sense of touch in their hands.
ru: Он стал соучредителем компании Deaftronics, которая на основе его изобретения производит слуховой аппарат под названием «Solar Ear» (Солнечное ухо).

quote: How frequently did the Neanderthals used bones to manufacture tools?
I promised to marry her as soon as she left her husband.
before: But the sight of you drove me crazy. Made me reckless.
after: - And she has left her husband now. - I left my husband, too.
ru: Я обещал жениться на ней, как только она бросит своего мужа.

quote: You don't have to be married to understand that.
before: You just have clients. I know what it feels like to care deeply about someone, okay?
after: Let me ask you a question. What does it feel like for you now to be the other guy?
ru: И не обязательно жениться, чтобы это понять.

quote: With such connections they can have very little chance of marrying well, Bingley.
before: Perhaps we should call, when we are next in town. They would be just as agreeable to me, had they uncles enough to fill all Cheapside!
after: That is the material point. Miss Bennet, how does your sister do?
ru: Да, с такими связями им будет очень сложно удачно выйти замуж, Бингли.

quote: You think I'd let my son marry a WASP?
before: This girl is shit to him. Look at her, she's a WASP.
after: It's not gonna happen. Is it true?
ru: Ты думаешь, что я бы позволил своему сыну жениться не на католичке?

quote: My uncle, my aunt, my brother or sister, cannot force me to marry.
before: My mother can't force me to marry. My father cannot force me to marry.
after: No one in the world can force me to marry. I'll marry when I want.
ru: Мой дядя, моя тётя, мои брат или сестра не смогут заставить меня выйти замуж.

quote: My son, he says he is not ready to get married.
before: But when they got older, when the time comes for them to start think about getting married, that's when we expect them to realize, a little bit more, their own culture. But that's where we had some problems.
after: And he has a sweetheart, but she is American woman, not Chinese. It's not that it's bad, but I told him, " What's wrong with a Chinese woman? "
ru: Мой сын говорит, он не готов к женитьбе.

quote: Any boys and girls caught flirting would get married off immediately, okay.
before: And the first one was about a group called The Party of God, who wanted to ban Valentine's Day. Red was made illegal.
after: The second one was about a woman complaining because three minivans with six bearded men pulled up and started interrogating her on the spot for talking to a man who wasn't related to her. And I asked the students in Kuwait where they thought these incidents took place.
ru: Запретить красный цвет. А если будет замечено, что юноша и девушка флиртуют друг с другом, их следует немедленно женить.

quote: McGuiness also said that "gays are not prohibited to marry in California."
It matches the outline on the wall in Zalman's workshop.
before: Looks like he's doing his preflight. Look at that.
after: He was painting a decal. Zoom in on that guy.
ru: Это совпадает с контуром стены в мастерской Залмана.

quote: The pattern on the carpet matches the blood on his shirt.
before: That's the way the maid said she found him. Well, this body's been rolled.
after: That could have been the killer. There's no wallet, nothing in his pockets.
ru: Отпечаток на ковре совпадает с кровью на рубашке.

quote: The bullet found in Agent Booth's body matches one fired from your gun.
before: They've arrested me, and they won't even tell me why. Well, how about for what we believe to be the most devastating terrorist attack on American soil since 9/11?
after: So add that to the list of all the other lives you took today. Liam, you know me.
ru: Пуля, найденная в теле агента Бута, совпадает с пулями, выпущенными из твоего пистолета.

quote: If someone else was here, that matches the M.O. of the Son of Sam murders.
before: But it rained last night. It compromised the scene.
after: Berkowitz's first victims were two girls he shot in a car. Yes, but one of them was only hit in the leg and survived.
ru: Если был кто-то ещё, это совпадает с почерком убийств Сына Сэма.

quote: Random genetic mutations in orchids may result in a trait– like a scent or a shape– that, by chance, matches the needs of a single insect species.
before: Other orchids look and smell just like the fungi on which certain insects lay their eggs. Where do all these bizarre adaptations come from?
after: The huge diversity within the insect world also increases the likelihood that an orchid will find a unique audience. Able to make more seeds and offspring with the help of its dedicated pollinators, the orchid successfully reproduces in isolation, and becomes a new species.
ru: Случайные генетические мутации могут привести к появлению у орхидей свойств, например запаха или формы, удачно совпадающих с потребностями отдельных видов насекомых.

quote: Remember that "cisgendered" means that your gender identity does match the gender you were assigned at birth.
before: In our original diagram, rich white men were at the top, but if we restricted our attention to non-men, we would see that they are here, and now the rich, white non-men are at the top. So we could move to a whole context of women, and our three types of privilege could now be rich, white and cisgendered.
after: So now we see that rich, white cis women occupy the analogous situation that rich white men did in broader society. And this has helped me understand why there is so much anger towards rich white women, especially in some parts of the feminist movement at the moment, because perhaps they're prone to seeing themselves as underprivileged relative to white men, and they forget how overprivileged they are relative to nonwhite women.
ru: Помните, цисгендер означает, что тот, кем вы себя ощущаете, совпадает с тем, какой пол у вас определили при рождении.

quote: Then after we harvest a coral, we measure this ratio, and now you can see, those curves match perfectly.
before: Their ratio tells us the water temperature. In this example here, we had monitored this reef in Galapagos with temperature recorders, so we know the temperature of the water the coral's growing in.
after: In this case, at these islands, you know, corals are instrumental-quality recorders of change in the water. And of course, our thermometers only take us back 50 years or so here.
ru: Вырастив коралл, мы определили содержание изотопов кислорода. Как видите, две кривые идеально совпадают.

quote: This means we're next, and I care about us.
before: TROY: Please, Pierce. Please, don't die slightly before your time.
after: Where--? Gotcha!
ru: - Это значит, мы следующие, а я беспокоюсь о нас.

quote: It doesn't mean we won't continue with our sex life, which is very important to me.
before: At the moment, I don't seem to satisfy you in the way that I'd like to. Don't get upset, Joe.
after: Very important to me. When you buy a tiger, right, you also have to feed it.
ru: Это не значит, что мы поставим крест на нашей сексуальной жизни, которая очень важна для меня.

quote: What do you mean The Library is cut off from the outside world?
before: Flynn, what happens when the bell stops? Charlene, no!
after: Get out! Grab what you can and get out!
ru: Что значит, Библиотека отрезана от внешнего мира?

quote: Which could mean he doesn't feel very important in his everyday life.
before: Well, it makes him easier to control. He prolongs the torture because the more he does, the more powerful he feels.
after: Kate: Maybe he has low self-worth. Like attracts like.
ru: Это может говорить о том, что он не чувствует себя значимым в повседневной жизни.

quote: But that doesn't mean we voters can't demand courage from our political leaders.
before: Making big changes involves taking big risks, and taking big risks is scary. Overcoming that fear requires guts, and as you all know, gutsy politicians are painfully rare.
after: I mean, that's why we put them in office in the first place. And given the state of the world today, there's really no other option.
ru: Но это не значит, что мы, избиратели, не можем требовать от политических лидеров храбрости.

quote: Meaning that fat could be this new sixth basic taste.
before: Which we know surprisingly little about. For example, we know that there are those five basic tastes, but we strongly suspect that there are more, and in fact, using our EEG setup, we found evidence that fat, besides being sensed by its texture and smell, is also tasted.
after: And if we figure out how our brain recognizes fat and sugar, and I'm just dreaming here, but could we then one day create a milkshake with zero calories that tastes just like the real deal? Or maybe we figure out that we can't, because we subconsciously detect calories via our receptors in our gastrointestinal tract.
ru: Это значит, что жир может стать шестым основным вкусом.

quote: It means, for example, that the smallest male in a group can be the alpha male.
before: He has only trouble with the combination of the two. And so the coalition formation that goes on in chimpanzee society makes it much more complex than you think.
after: You don't need to be the biggest and strongest male. The smallest male, if he has the right friends and keeps them happy, or he has female support, he can be the alpha male.
ru: Это значит, например, что самый маленький самец в стае может быть альфа-самцом.

quote: Blow crap up they will, but this time, Instead of trying to visualize the shock wave, They'll measure it.
before: A good day to blow some crap up, huh? You bet.
after: Adam: This plumbing equipment here is a matrix For holding together our key piece Of detection equipment in this myth, And that is this -- an oseco rupture disk, Basically a calibrated piece of aluminum foil.
ru: Они будут взрывать, но на этот раз вместо попыток визуализировать ударную волну они будут измерять ее.

quote: Park's tiger mom and dad were so insufferable, she has to measure their affection in hours.
before: - Thank you. Makes sense.
after: Chase's careerist dad and alcoholic mom were so indifferent, he has to believe it's a wash. Your turn.
ru: Суровые родители Парк были настолько невыносимы, что она должна измерять их любовь в часах.

quote: You once told me how much you hated that your father measured his happiness by the night's receipts.
before: To be honest, I don't think I realized how much this place being closed put me in a funk, but I swear, it's like I'm starting to feel alive again. Careful.
after: Yeah, but that's because it's all he had. Declan and I were always butting heads with him, his marriage was crap.
ru: Однажды ты сказал мне, как ненавидел, что твой отец измерял свое счастье выручкой за вечер.

quote: They run water temperature tests to measure the greenhouse effects.
before: You own a boat, Mr. Grant? The fund owns one.
after: But you didn't bring me in here to talk about a boat, now, did you? Sarah Rhodes and Adam Lewis.
ru: Они измеряют температуру воды, чтобы определить парниковый эффект.

quote: It's coming into some tricky things then when we are measuring MDGs.
before: So what I'm telling you is that we know the child mortality. We have a decent trend.
after: And the reason here for Africa is especially important, because' 90s was a bad decade, not only in Kenya, but across Africa. The HIV epidemic peaked.
ru: Но затем начинаются всякие неоднозначные моменты, когда мы измеряем результаты достижения ЦРТ.

quote: You know, it looks at economic power measured by GDP.
before: And that the Chinese won't catch up or pass the Americans until somewhere in the latter part, after 2050, of this century. The other point that's worth noticing is how one-dimensional this projection is.
after: Doesn't tell you much about military power, doesn't tell you very much about soft power. It's all very one-dimensional.
ru: Видите ли, он учитывает экономическую мощь, измеряемую в ВВП.

quote: Rezero keeps his balance by constantly measuring his pitch angle with a sensor.
before: Now we'll explain that in a second. Let me first explain how Rezero actually keeps his balance.
after: He then counteracts and avoids toppling over by turning the motors appropriately. This happens 160 times per second, and if anything fails in this process, Rezero would immediately fall to the ground.
ru: Резеро балансирует, постоянно измеряя угол наклона с помощью сенсора.

quote: Strong aftershocks followed the initial earthquake, with at least one measuring a magnitude 5.6.
after: Tsunami alerts were issued for the entire South Pacific region but were later canceled. Survivors fled to high ground and stayed there for hours. __NOTOC__

quote: Before you were taken, you met with a man.
before: You're-you're doing really good. I have just one more question.
after: At a coffee house. Yeah, I remember.
ru: До того, как тебя похитили, ты встречалась с мужчиной.

quote: Do you kiss the wife of every president you meet?
before: Well, dignity's a bit overrated for a mistress, don't you think? Ah... you know, a woman like your wife, for example, would certainly make it worthwhile.
after: Oh. Not every president's wife looks like yours.
ru: Ты поцелуй жены каждый президент, вы встречаетесь?

quote: How could I have imagined someone I've never met before?
before: Job done, right? She's alive!
after: That's her, exactly. Same dress, same everything... except for the tattoo.
ru: Как мне мог привидеться человек, с которым я ранее не встречался?

quote: Maybe he met with a person there, huh?
before: No, I guess he can't. Unless we find out where he was staying.
after: - I'll look into it. - No, I'll do it. You go home.
ru: Может, они там встречались?

quote: So I want to introduce you to this framework: Old power, meet new power.
before: How can we describe it and give it a framework that makes it more useful? Because we realized that many of the lessons that we were discovering in movements actually applied all over the world in many sectors of our society.
after: And I want to talk to you about what new power is today. New power is the deployment of mass participation and peer coordination — these are the two key elements — to create change and shift outcomes.
ru: Я хочу ознакомить вас с этой основой: старая власть встречает новую власть.

quote: And you meet someone you really like, you get to know her.
before: And when I tell people about this, they tend to think of maybe an 80 or 90 year-old person who looks really good for being 90 or 80. But it's really more like this: let's say you're a 30 year-old guy — or in your 30s — and you're a bachelor and you're dating people.
after: And you're in a restaurant, and you say, " Well how old are you? " She says, " I'm 60. "
ru: Вы встречаете кого-то, кто вам очень нравится, вы с ней знакомитесь.

quote: Number two -- my favorite -- we meet a rogue black hole.
before: Now, there is money in the federal budget, next year, to build up the public health service. But I don't think to any extent that it really needs to be done.
after: You know, 10 years ago, or 15 years ago, really, you walk into an astronomy convention, and you say, " You know, there's probably a black hole at the center of every galaxy, " and they're going to hoot you off the stage. And now, if you went into one of those conventions and you said, " Well, I don't think black holes are out there, " they'd hoot you off the stage.
ru: Номер два — моё любимое: мы встречаем злобную чёрную дыру.

quote: High schools had to meet a passing grade of 55 percent or face large scale reform.
before: In March, Wake County Superior Court Judge Howard Manning threatened to close state high schools that did not meet his expectations.

quote: Let me guess, someone's making it difficult for you to meet your deadline.
before: Still got the ink stains on my fingers. The contract stipulates that if I don't finish phase one of the build within six months, Playa Verde takes full control of the property.
after: Workplace accidents, stolen materials, nothing went right since they came onboard. Playa Verde sent a security consultant to keep an eye out.
ru: Дайте-ка я угадаю, кто-то начал усложнять вам задачу уложиться в срок.

quote: And if we do not meet this deadline-- we'll meet the deadline.
before: Look, if you just want me to kill him, I can do it in his sleep. But if the point is to make it look like somebody else did it-- the point is we are running out of time.
after: Want to take it down to the truck? Yeah, hold on.
ru: И если мы не управимся в срок... Мы управимся.

quote: Gina, if they meet my deadline, I win.
before: They're pissed off they didn't get him, that's all. Please.
after: If they don't, they give me licence to go after them twice as hard. Thank you.
ru: Джина, если они уложатся в мой дедлайн, я выиграю.

quote: We just need to meet our deadline.
before: If I rake in all our receivables and hold back some pay checks we can pay one single fine. I got the money.
after: - Just how did you do that? - I took out a second mortgage.
ru: Мы просто должны укладываться в сроки.

quote: Yeah, it was easy enough to finish the transfer in time to meet the deadline.
before: Well, once I figured out where the mistake was, you know, they took the money from your account, put it into their account, but never sent it on to "Heat" magazine's account before they left for the weekend... Assholes.
after: It was genius. Sheer genius.
ru: Да; было уже довольно легко закончить перевод вовремя, чтобы успеть к сроку.

quote: I didn't think you'd meet the deadline.
before: I wanted to be sure that it would get done. It wasn't due for two more days.
after: - Based on what? - Based on past performance.
ru: Я думала, что ты не уложишься в срок.

quote: Reduced to melting evil old Decepticons down.
before: I'm out there digging for it. There's just not much left to find. So that's how badly you boys need more?
after: No. That's an Autobot there. The ones who fought for us.
ru: Раз уж вы старых десептиконов плавите.

quote: To this place of safety, and we will melt him with acid.
before: The doctor is still missing, but he will always come looking for his box. By bringing it here, he will be lured from the dangers of london
after: Ok, that last part? And we will not melt him with acid.
ru: Для этого в безопасное место, и мы будет таять его кислотой.

quote: Nuclear reactors inside power plants that survived the bombs are melting down.
before: The reason Alie created the city of light. Why?
after: Radiation levels are already rising. If we can't figure out a way to fix it, all of us will be dead in 6 months.
ru: Атомные энергоблоки на АЭС, не пострадавшие при бомбардировке, начали плавиться.

quote: I prefer to let it melt slowly on my tongue.
before: What's so nice about chocolate? The substance itself or the crunch of your teeth on it?
after: You're right. Changing the way you bite into it... makes it something new.
ru: Я предпочитаю позволять ему медленно таять на моем языке.

quote: For some magicians or mentalists, sometimes the spoon will bend or melt, sometimes it will not.
before: She's not taking any chances. (Laughter) You see, psychokinesis is the paranormal influence of the mind on physical events and processes.
after: Sometimes the object will slide across the table, sometimes it will not. It depends on how much energy you have that day, so on and so forth.
ru: Иногда у некоторых магов и менталистов ложка сгибается или плавится, а иногда нет.

quote: In early spring, these frozen pools begin to melt, supplying villagers with irrigation for their fields.
before: Horizontal glaciers are formed when farmers redirect glacier meltwater into channels and pipes, then carefully siphon it off into a series of basins made from stones and earth. Villagers minutely control the release of water into these reservoirs, waiting for each new layer to freeze before filling the basin with another wave.
after: Local people make vertical glaciers using the meltwater from already-existing glaciers high above their villages. The meltwater enters channels that run downhill, flowing until it reaches a crop site where it bursts forth from a pipe pointing straight into the air.
ru: Ранней весной эти замёрзшие озёра начинают таять, снабжая фермеров водой для полива.

quote: It's a wax-like substance with a melting point of human body temperature, 37 degrees Celsius.
before: But the magic is in this pouch of wax. This is a phase-change material.
after: You can melt this simply using hot water and then when it melts it's able to maintain one constant temperature for four to six hours at a time, after which you simply reheat the pouch. So, you then place it into this little pocket back here, and it creates a warm micro-environment for the baby.
ru: Это воскоподобный материал, который плавится при температуре человеческого тела в 37 градусов по Цельсию.

quote: They hope to find shocked quartz, melted rock and glass.
before: Researchers plan to look at rock samples that will be retrieved during a drilling mission surrounding the impact area.
after: The element known as iridium is also expected to be found in elevated levels.

quote: My contact in Boston may have mentioned that Meredith said their program's her first choice.
before: Not without Yang anyway. Cristina has options.
after: You're building a house. Harvard has an excellent neurosurgery department.
ru: Мой человек в Бостоне упоминал, что Мередит сказала что их программа для нее на первом месте.

quote: Now we mustn't mention him to Daddy, else it'll spoil the surprise.
before: An old friend. Of the family.
after: And there'll be special sweets for boys who can keep secrets. I wanted to thank you... for what you did the other day with my father.
ru: Мы не должны упоминать о нем папе, иначе мы испортим сюрприз.

quote: And when you mentioned it on our date, I remembered it instantly.
before: God, I really hate that band. I was at the first show.
after: It was you. Did I mention I'm a terrible person?
ru: Когда ты упомянул его на нашем свидании, я сразу же вспомнила.

quote: Dr. Naylor ever mention the name Morland Holmes?
before: Maybe a family member who thought he belonged in a mental health facility, took it out on Dr. Naylor. What are the chances that the same family member wanted Emil Kurtz dead?
after: Sorry, no. Calendars and contacts.
ru: Доктор Нейлор упоминала имя Морланда Холмса?

quote: Well, you remember that World Values Survey that I mentioned earlier?
before: (Laughter) Or maybe the heartless, greedy Wall Street type, right? Or maybe people like me, with multiple origins, living in a big, cosmopolitan metropolis.
after: It showed another fascinating finding: 71 percent of the world population agreed with the statement, " I am a citizen of the world. " Do you know what it means?
ru: Помните Всемирный обзор ценностей, который я упоминал ранее?

quote: Joseph Jeune also never mentioned that he was not cost-effective.
before: And we were seeing patients like this. Joseph Jeune.
after: A few months of medicines, and this is what he looked like. (Applause) We call that the Lazarus Effect of HIV treatment.
ru: Джозеф Джён тоже никогда не упоминал о нерентабельности своего лечения.

quote: Carolyn Porco mentioned another one called Enceladus the other day.
before: It was that gadget that serendipitously opened a door to another unexplored world. This is Europa.
after: This is one of the places where planetary scientists believe there is a highest probability of the detection of the first life off earth in the ocean that exists below there. For those who have never seen this story, Jim Cameron produced a really wonderful IMAX movie couple of years ago, called " Aliens of the Deep. "
ru: Кэролин Порко уже упомянула Энцелад здесь недавно.

quote: The budget report mentioned a increase in fuel duty.
after: The budget report said that "the planned fuel duty increase of 2 pence per litre in April 2008 will now be postponed until October 1, 2008. Main road fuel duty rates will rise by 1.84 pence per litre on 1 April 2009, and will increase by 0.5 pence per litre above inflation on 1 April 2010".

quote: But I really did miss you, and you know how much I care about you.
before: I just want to wait and see how things go. All right, we can wait.
after: And you know how much I care about you, but I'm still not doing it. What if I decide to go to the same school that Jack is going to?
ru: Но я действительно скучал по тебе, и ты знаешь, что ты мне небезразлична.

quote: My boss had a tee time that he didn't want to miss.
before: You want them to have your back. Because at the end of the day, it wasn't about proving my mettle.
after: I wasn't there long. Could I ask why we are here?
ru: Мой босс не хотел пропустить игру в гольф.

quote: Now, there's a heart-warming tableau that Norman Rockwell somehow missed.
before: All right, come on. And I'm gonna take you now to show you your first lady butt.
after: Hello, ladies. Earl!
ru: Вот это греющая сердце картина, которую Норман Роквелл каким-то образом пропустил.

quote: I hate the feeling that I missed out on everything.
before: I-I don't know when this thing became about proving something. It just did.
after: You--you have your stories. I've heard all of them--
ru: Я ненавижу чувство, что я все пропустила.

quote: What he missed was connection to the other men he was with.
before: I think what he missed is brotherhood. He missed, in some ways, the opposite of killing.
after: Now, brotherhood is different from friendship. Friendship happens in society, obviously.
ru: Он скучал по связи с другими мужчинами, которая у него была.

quote: I also missed the sense of clarity I'd felt at my sickest.
before: Like me, everyone in there was broken. But out here, among the living, I felt like an impostor, overwhelmed and unable to function.
after: Staring your mortality straight in the eye has a way of simplifying things, of rerouting your focus to what really matters. And when I was sick, I vowed that if I survived, it had to be for something.
ru: Ещё я скучала по ясности, которую чувствовала, когда болела.

quote: They want to be missed when they're gone.
before: They want to be missed. They want to be missed the day they don't show up.
after: And tribe leaders can do that. It's fascinating, because all tribe leaders have charisma, but you don't need charisma to become a leader.
ru: Они хотят, чтобы по ним скучали, когда они уходят.

quote: Heat-seeking devices and helicopters are being used by rescue workers to search for missing persons.
before: Four people are reportedly still missing.

quote: You both donate, they mix it up, fertilize the egg.
before: But that's the beauty of the swirl. The swirl?
after: You never know who the father is. Ooh. That's Stefan.
ru: Вы оба сдаете сперму, ее смешивают, и оплодотворяют яйцеклетку.

quote: Mixing these elements, we irrevocably bind ourselves to one another, creating a new Crescent pack.
before: I'll explain later. Oh. Your timing is perfect.
after: I ask each one of you, do you renounce your alpha status? Well, where is he?
ru: Смешивая эти элементы, мы навсегда связываем друг друга, создавая новую стаю Полумесяца.

quote: I know you usually mix it, I couldn't quite bring myself to do it, but...
before: Gene? Um, I brought you a beer and some ice cream.
after: A... are you there? Anyway, I just wanted to apologize for earlier at dinner, and, uh... That's it, really.
ru: Знаю ты обычно их смешиваешь, не думаю, что я бы решилась...

quote: If they have to tell you how to mix it, it's all the better.
before: Oh, that's perfect. The only reason people order exotic drinks is to show how sophisticated they are.
after: It makes them feel like experts. Plus Larry and I are gonna have our hands full.
ru: Им придётся объяснить, что надо смешивать. Даже лучше.

quote: I think it's great we're all hugging here, as we mix our vowels, and we make the saddle.
before: I speak a little bit — you don't understand, but I speak a little bit and I'm sure you are my friend. You are my friend, You are my friend, You are my friend, You are my — I love people.
after: I appreciate less the consonants of those we haven't sounded. I'm pressing the buzzer; I am interpassionate.
ru: Я думаю, это хорошо, когда мы обнимаемся, когда мы смешиваем наши гласные, мы помогаем друг другу.

quote: And the blue former developing countries are mixing up with the former industrialized western world.
before: And it is the DHS that makes it possible to know this. And we had an increase in income.
after: We have a continuum. But we still have, of course, Congo, up there.
ru: И синие, ранее «развивающиеся» страны, смешиваются с бывшим индустриальным «западным» миром.

quote: We freely mix R's and L's, English and vernacular versions of their names.
before: And if they lose their booklets, their records can still be pulled by searching with their names. Now, the way we pronounce and spell names varies tremendously.
after: Even soundex, a standard method for grouping words by how similar they sound, was not good enough. So we had to modify it to help us link and match existing records.
ru: Мы свободно смешиваем «Р» и «Л», английские и народные версии имён.

quote: The company's performance this year compared to last year has been mixed.
before: The total complaints against Sallie Mae for September of this year is 2 fewer than the same time last year.
after: March and June numbers were down over 150 complaints from the same month a year before. April, May, July and August all saw increases of 17–43.

quote: The latest version of my serum modified the organisms in my test subjects in quite an unexpected way.
before: So, my dear Gustave, is my serum ready? Your Majesty, I must admit the results of my research aren't what I anticipated.
after: You'll see, it's extraordinary! Rodrigue!
ru: Последняя версия моей сыворотки изменяет организмы моих испытуемых совершенно неожиданным образом.

quote: "Don't struggle to get what you want, but modify your wanting."
before: The Noble Truths should be your guide as you plan for the future. Let me remind you that one of those truths is
after: I wish you a safe trip home to your country. I'm sorry, Mr. President.
ru: "Не вступайте в борьбу ради своих желаний, просто изменяйте их."

quote: It could also modify them, or create new ones.
before: When you run a program, your operating system allocates area within the short-term memory for performing those instructions. For example, when you press a key in a word processor, the CPU will access one of these locations to retrieve bits of data.
after: The time this takes is known as the memory's latency. And because program instructions must be processed quickly and continuously, all locations within the short-term memory can be accessed in any order, hence the name random access memory.
ru: Он также может изменять их или создавать новые.

quote: But humans did not learn to fly by modifying birds.
before: Because of this complexity, humans have only been able to harness the power of proteins by making very small changes to the amino acid sequences of the proteins we've found in nature. This is similar to the process that our Stone Age ancestors used to make tools and other implements from the sticks and stones that we found in the world around us.
after: (Laughter) Instead, scientists, inspired by birds, uncovered the principles of aerodynamics. Engineers then used those principles to design custom flying machines.
ru: Но люди не научились летать, видоизменяя птиц.

quote: That's when we're going to begin to use this knowledge to modify ourselves.
before: To deny that that's the case is not a very good start on that. A generation or so away there are going to be even more profound things that are going to happen.
after: Now I don't mean extra gills or something — something we care about, like aging. What if we could unravel aging and understand it — begin to retard the process or even reverse it?
ru: Это когда мы начнем использовать эти знания чтобы видоизменять самих себя.

quote: The organizers are planning to modify the Queen's Baton Relay to remove Gambia.
after: The relay traditionally involves the baton travelling to all participating countries.

quote: It's possible his daughter's abduction was motivated by revenge.
before: Mr. El-Masri admitted he had close ties with the previous regime in Egypt. As a result, he made some very powerful enemies.
after: Okay, where does that leave my daughter? I mean, if... If she wasn't the one they were after and she's just in the way--
ru: Возможно, что похищение его дочери было мотивировано местью.

quote: You know, we can speculate what, in their mind, motivated them.
before: It was more of an R D program. It wasn't really until the mid-'90s that it started to take off when they made the decision to build the nuclear weapons program.
after: I think it was the U.S. invasion of Iraq after Kuwait. You know, there was an eight-year war between Iraq and Iran, we had wiped out Saddam's forces in a matter of weeks.
ru: Знаете, можно спорить на тему, что их могло мотивировать.

quote: What's not wise is peddling unverified and politically motivated horseshit to the press.
before: And that's exactly what I intend to tell them in there. If you think it's wise to tie the President's hands so publicly...
after: And if you can't find me the "career officers" responsible, I'll get someone who can. Surprise!
ru: Что уж точно неразумно — предоставлять прессе непроверенную и политически мотивированную ерунду.

quote: Our society's major concern is mental development and to motivate each person to their highest potential.
before: They're not given the tools, homogenly or whithin their own field, of how to do critical thinking. In a resource based economy, the education would be very different.
after: Because our philosophy is the smarter people are the richer the world because everybody becomes a contributor. The smarter your kids are, the better my life will be.
ru: Главная забота нашего общества это умственное развитие и мотивирование каждого человека к достижению своего максимального потенциала.

quote: We had to get people motivated, involved, and get them to understand this.
before: There's plenty of money. (Laughter) But we realized it's more than just money that's required.
after: And we started thinking about all the different things that could go wrong. What are all the challenges that might get in the way?
ru: Нам нужно было мотивировать людей, задействовать их, и люди должны были это понять.

quote: I think it's people's curiosity that motivates them to come into the projects.
before: During that time, you haven't thought about what you're going to eat tomorrow. This is art. "
after: And then it becomes more. It becomes a desire, a need, an armor.
ru: Я считаю, что любопытство побуждает людей заниматься проектами.

quote: We have stiff competition and we need to motivate and it's all being done.
before: But I will let a kid with no license take over control of my vehicle system. (Applause) Because we want to create — we want to create the classroom of tomorrow.
after: You win or lose an engineer or a scientist by eighth grade. The game is not over — it's over by the eighth grade, it's not beginning.
ru: У нас жёсткая конкуренция и мы должны мотивировать и мы уже начали.

quote: Jackson said the act was motivated with intent to kill a "black man".
before: James Harris Jackson was charged on Monday with murder as an act of terrorism, after allegedly fatally stabbing Timothy Caughman in Manhattan last week.

quote: Luckily, we didn't have to mount a camera on our head and wait for many years.
before: So instead of focusing solely on better and better algorithms, my insight was to give the algorithms the kind of training data that a child was given through experiences in both quantity and quality. Once we know this, we knew we needed to collect a data set that has far more images than we have ever had before, perhaps thousands of times more, and together with Professor Kai Li at Princeton University, we launched the ImageNet project in 2007.
after: We went to the Internet, the biggest treasure trove of pictures that humans have ever created. We downloaded nearly a billion images and used crowdsourcing technology like the Amazon Mechanical Turk platform to help us to label these images.
ru: К счастью, нам не пришлось устанавливать камеру себе на голову и ждать много лет.

quote: At times, the Romans would also mount siphons onto the ramparts, and launch clay pots full of Greek fire from catapults at an invading army.
before: Squads of Roman defenders would carry portable flame throwers, spraying anyone trying to climb out of the moat. The terrified victims would leap back, only to find that they still burned underwater.
after: The front lines would turn into an inferno, making it appear as if the earth itself was on fire. If, by some miracle, the outer wall was compromised, attackers would be faced with the final defense: the great inner wall.
ru: Иногда римляне устанавливали сифоны на крепостной вал и, с помощью катапульт, метали во вражескую армию кувшины с греческим огнём.

quote: State television reported the rescue as the "largest international marine rescue operation ever mounted by China."
before: Survivors were found on 22 Vietnamese ships near the Pratas Islands, off the southern coast of Guangdong province.

quote: Helen was beaten last night, and then she was pushed from a moving vehicle.
before: And we weren't supposed to trust calls or e-mails from each other because they could've been a trap. And we could have ended up hurt or... or dead.
after: Do you think that The Wolf killed her? How do I get a hold of him?
ru: Хелен избили прошлой ночью, а затем ее вышвырнули из двигающегося автомобиля.

quote: I am effectively quitting Shulman Associates and moving to Texas.
before: It's actually... Guys, I've got some incredibly major news.
after: And I want to thank the one person that convinced me to keep Austin weird and follow my heart, Mindy Lahiri.
ru: Я покидаю "Шульман и парнеры" и переезжаю в Техас.

quote: Jason would want us to move on with our lives.
before: So I speak with the confidence only a twin could have... Jason wouldn't want us to spend the year mourning.
after: Which is why I've asked the School Board not to cancel the Back-to-School semiformal. But rather, to let us use it as a way to heal, collectively, and celebrate my brother's too, too short life on this mortal coil.
ru: Джейсон хотел бы, чтобы мы двигались дальше.

quote: His fiancée was just murdered,and he's already moving on.
before: He's blind. That's too literal,Bones.
after: Well,she's gone. He has accepted it.
ru: Его невеста была убита и он двигается дальше

quote: But I think with the vision to do that, we can move forward.
before: We have 30 students a year go out into the field and try to implement this and move it forward. The other thing is you have to do things with a long time frame, as, you know, you can't expect to get something done in a year or two years; you have to be looking five or 10 years ahead.
ru: Но я думаю, что, имея представление об этом, мы можем двигаться дальше.

quote: The bubbles will move to the target areas.
before: It can also play a role in medicines, for instance, as a method for noninvasive delivery systems for drugs and genes to a specific part of the body. Imagine a microbubble filled with a mixture of drugs and magnetic agents being injected into our bloodstream.
after: But how do they know where to go? Because we placed a magnet there.
ru: Пузырьки будут двигаться к цели.

quote: It's a pool of water, and the protocell starts moving itself around in the system.
before: In this protocell model, it's just an oil droplet, but a chemical metabolism inside that allows this protocell to use energy to do something, to actually become dynamic, as we'll see here. You add the droplet to the system.
after: Okay? Oil droplet forms through self-assembly, has a chemical metabolism inside so it can use energy, and it uses that energy to move itself around in its environment.
ru: Это вода, и протоклетка начинает двигаться по этой системе.

quote: "We aimed our weapons at him and told him to move away from us" (Ynet).
before: "The boy pulled out a matchbox, held up a pipe bomb, and attempted to detonate it," said Muli.

quote: Jack, we need to get you off this boat.
before: Hey, bud. They say the best way to a fisherman's heart is through his fly.
after: Yeah, Jill didn't care for that one, either. I'm fine.
ru: Джек, нужно забрать тебя отсюда.
