after: The gene heightens normally occurring connections between the taste area in his frontal lobe and the color area further back. But suppose in someone else that the gene acted in non-sensory areas.
ru: Шон предпочитает пищу синего вкуса, например, молоко, апельсины и шпинат.

quote: We prefer to know them as the mafia.
before: So what was a business man in the brave new world of East European capitalism going to do to make sure that his contracts would be honored? Well, he would turn to people who were called, rather prosaically by sociologists, privatized law enforcement agencies.
after: And in Bulgaria, the mafia was soon joined with 14,000 people who were sacked from their jobs in the security services between 1989 and 1991. Now, when your state is collapsing, your economy is heading south at a rate of knots, the last people you want coming on to the labor market are 14,000 men and women whose chief skills are surveillance, are smuggling, building underground networks and killing people.
ru: Мы предпочитаем называть их мафия.

quote: I don't know -- I prefer to test their beliefs, scientifically.
before: Should we ridicule the modern seekers of immortality, calling them fools? Or will they someday chuckle over our graves?
after: I propose that we attempt to find a connectome of a frozen brain. We know that damage to the brain occurs after death and during freezing.
ru: Я не знаю. Я предпочитаю проверить их убеждения по-научному.

quote: And, the fact that the rats would prefer the easy lever was also not so straightforward.
before: The articles were not giving as much information as we now have to write down. And so we had to guess some parameters over there.
after: So we thought "oh, they are gonna prefer the easy lever, and that's it." But at the end, you know, some rats, some animals develop a preference on the side; like they prefer their right lever, or the left lever, or others, they prefer the heavy lever.

quote: You know, were were preparing a, uh, wrongful death lawsuit against Dellinger.
before: Not sure. Our lawyers, I think.
after: It's not gonna happen now. And have you been in contact with Mr. Dellinger since your wife's death?
ru: Мы готовились к судебному процессу о причинении смерти в результате противоправных действий, против Делинджера.

quote: Well, I told them I was preparing an appeal to be lodged with the ecclesiastical court.
before: Meanwhile, there's no one to see you in your altogether except me. How are you allowed to wander around the castle?
after: Of course, we all know how pointless that would be. Don't call out.
ru: Ну, я сказал им, что я должен готовить обращение в церковный суд.

quote: Sir, FEMA's mission is to prepare for the worst.
before: Yes, but some of these projections have it turning back to sea. That's highly unlikely, sir.
after: First responders, medical, mass evacuation. I'm worried about the funding.
ru: Сэр, задача ФАЧС - готовиться к худшему.

quote: I had to tell you the truth to prepare you.
before: Partly because you were meant to do it, But mostly because if you don't, I will always remind you That you are a sac-less little fraidy-cat. Why in the hell did you try to talk me out of it?
after: If I'd fluffed it up, you would have tortured me forever. So you really think I'm the man for the job?
ru: Я должен был рассказать всю правду, чтобы подготовить тебя.

quote: Personally, I feel like I've been preparing for this moment my whole life.
before: In the end, if I have to choose between being the president's friend or enemy, I always prefer to be their enemy. In closing: I know this is a difficult time to be an immigrant and a journalist, but now more than ever, we need journalists who are prepared, at any given moment, to set neutrality aside.
after: When they censored me when I was 24, I learned that neutrality, fear and silence often make you an accomplice in crime, abuse and injustice. And being an accomplice to power is never good journalism.
ru: Лично я чувствую, что готовился к этому моменту всю жизнь.

quote: The threat is serious, and the time to prepare for it is now.
before: They're crowd-mapping the activities of the drug dealers. Whether or not you realize it, we are at the dawn of a technological arms race, an arms race between people who are using technology for good and those who are using it for ill.
after: I can assure you that the terrorists and criminals are. My personal belief is that, rather than having a small, elite force of highly trained government agents here to protect us all, we're much better off having average and ordinary citizens approaching this problem as a group and seeing what we can do.
ru: Это серьёзная угроза, и именно сейчас самое время к ней подготовиться.

quote: So what can we do? How can we prepare and adapt?
before: The military gets it. They call climate change a threat multiplier that could harm stability and security, while governments around the world are evaluating how to respond.
after: I'd like to share three sets of examples, starting with adapting to violent storms and floods. In New Orleans, the I-10 Twin Spans, with sections knocked out in Katrina, have been rebuilt 21 feet higher to allow for greater storm surge.
ru: Так что же может быть сделано? Как подготовиться и приспособиться к новым условиям?

quote: Towns and communities in north Western Australia are preparing for the sixth cyclone of the season.
after: The Bureau of Meteorology says a cyclone warning is current for a category 3 cyclone for coastal and island areas between Cape Leveque and Bidyadanga. A cyclone watch extends south to Dampier.

quote: Now Homer, this Viramontes image is an example of how Chicano poster art preserves a culture ignored by Eurocentric society.
before: Chong and I used to come here all the time. Oh! Why aren't you exactly like your stage persona?
after: Eurocentric! Oh! When do we have wacky adventures?
ru: Теперь, Гомер, обрати внимание, как картина Вирамонтеса, выполненная в традициях народа чикано, сохраняет для нас культуру, отрицаемую Евроцентричным обществом.

quote: Our primary directive... is to preserve human life.
before: I said I've got it! That could've been my motherboard lying in the street!
after: And here I was waiting till you slept to rob you of your copper. You know, it's crazy but...
ru: Наша основная задача... сохранять человеческую жизнь.

quote: May they cleanse me of sin and preserve my soul in life everlasting.
before: Oh! This is the body. This is the blood.
after: I'd say it's a little late for that, father. I see you still have your faith.
ru: Может они очистят меня от греха и сохранят свою душу для жизни вечной

quote: Of us... to be hung in the new restaurant... to pay tribute and preserve our legacy.
before: What are your terms? We'd like a plaque.
after: Now, it could also be a statue, okay? Something real classy though.
ru: Нашу... чтобы висела в новом ресторане... отдавая дань уважения и сохраняя наше наследие.

quote: Because there's no oxygen there, it's the largest reservoir of hydrogen sulfide on Earth. Shipwrecks are perfectly preserved.
before: And then here's one that sank at the time of Homer, at 750 B.C. More recently, into the Black Sea, where we're exploring.
after: All their organics are perfectly preserved. We begin to excavate them.
ru: Здесь нет кислорода, это самый большой резервуар сероводорода на земле. Остовы кораблей прекрасно сохраняются.

quote: All of a sudden, our principles called for green space preserving the important ecological features.
before: What the takeaway from this image is, every one of those circles is a walking radius around a transit station — massive investment in metro and BRT, and a distribution that allows everybody to work within walking distance of that. The red area, this is a blow-up.
after: And then those other streets in there are auto-free streets. So instead of bulldozing, leveling the site and building right up to the river, this green edge was something that really wasn't normative in China until these set of practices began experimentation there.
ru: Внезапно все наши принципы свелись к необходимости озеленения, сохраняющего экологию.

quote: Which means, are you preserving what you are doing for future use or for future generations?
before: We use three metrics to determine green. The first metric is: Is it sustainable?
after: Is it alternative? Is it different than what is being used today, or does it have a lower carbon footprint than what's used conventionally?
ru: Что означает, сохраняете ли вы ресурсы для повторного использования или для следующих поколений?

quote: The baby lizard's remains have now been preserved in the zoo.
before: Hennessy knew there was a problem when the egg failed to hatch within the normal 180 day period. When he opened one of the eggs, he found the baby monitor lifeless, but fully formed.

quote: For each incorrect answer, the subjects pressed a button on a device they were told delivered a shock to the test taker.
before: Blind obedience? Participants were told they'd be administering a quiz to a test taker in the next room.
after: What is the capital of Peru? San Jose?
ru: При каждом неверном ответе участник нажимает кнопку устройства, которое, как им сказали, бьёт током опрашиваемого.

quote: They pressed the button every time they saw the face.
before: So we devised what might be considered one of the world's most boring experiments. All the participants saw were a series of faces on the screen, one after another.
after: That was pretty much it. Well, one trick was that sometimes, the face would be upside down, and it would happen very infrequently.
ru: Они нажимали кнопку каждый раз, когда видели лицо.

quote: Truth of the matter is you can play the piano without a cochlear implant, because all you have to do is press the keys at the right time.
before: And this is really unheard of stuff, and this is all because of this technology. And the fact that he can play the piano like that is a testament to his brain.
after: You don't actually have to hear it. I know he doesn't hear well, because I've heard him do Karaoke.
ru: Суть в том, что вы можете играть на фортепиано без кохлеарного имплантата, ведь всё, что вы должны делать, это нажимать клавиши в нужное время.

quote: They're going to press left or right.
before: So we're going to check that out by having the chimps actually play a game by touching two touch screens. The chimps are actually interacting with each other through the computers.
after: One chimp is called a matcher. They win if they press left, left, like a seeker finding someone in hide-and-seek, or right, right.
ru: нажимая на левый или правый экран.

quote: The Mariners pressed early keeping Queensland to their own half in the first three minutes.
before: Queensland lead one goal to zero after a back and forth first half.
after: Queensland created a number of opportunities down the other end to no avail. The Queenslanders missed from a corner and were unlucky to have an offside decision go against them.

quote: However, today, I can't sit back and pretend I don't have an opinion, because I do.
before: London, moscow, rio-- people everywhere reacting to the fact that when they leave, the visitors will take with them their many gifts to humanity. It is my job to report the news objectively.
after: The v's saved my life. We, the people, must fix this.
ru: Однако сегодня я не могу просто сидеть здесь и притворяться, что у меня нет мнения, потому что оно есть.

quote: Don't pretend like this wasn't your plan all along.
before: I've had my representatives tend you an offer for SadTech Inc. and all intellectual property including your exclusive services. Well that's one way to get out of a lawsuit I suppose.
after: Is that what I'm doing? Now you're just being rude.
ru: не делай вид, что ты этого не планировал.

quote: I know we can't pretend it all away.
before: Melinda... The world has gotten more complicated, hasn't it?
after: But I'm still the same man you fell in love with. I never gave up on you.
ru: Я знаю, мы не можем притворяться, что ничего не произошло.

quote: We won't be able to pretend that we can protect ourselves anymore.
before: We'll expose our most tender selves, only to be mocked and destroyed. We'll be so vulnerable, and we'll pay the price.
after: It's a huge danger, a gigantic risk, but it's worth it. If only we can learn to take care of each other.
ru: Мы не сможем делать вид, что способны оградить себя.

quote: I wrote it because I was tired of pretending I was all right when I wasn't.
before: I wrote this piece a year ago. It's a composite of my story and other women I know.
after: I was tired of faking normal. I wasn't seeing myself in the popular press.
ru: Я написала её, потому что устала делать вид, будто всё в порядке, когда на самом деле это было не так.

quote: To pretend they're not a mess when they are a mess.
before: I actually realized once in Kosovo, when I watched a man break down, that bullets are actually hardened tears, that when we don't allow men to have their girl self and have their vulnerability, and have their compassion, and have their hearts, that they become hardened and hurtful and violent. And I think we have taught men to be secure when they are insecure, to pretend they know things when they don't know things, or why would we be where we are?
after: And I will tell you a very funny story. On my way here on the airplane, I was walking up and down the aisle of the plane.
ru: Притворяться, что они в порядке, когда они в полном беспорядке.

quote: It's good to see you again. (Cheers) (Music) Rob Legato: I pretend they're clapping for me.
before: (Music) And then I'm going to show you exactly what it is that you were reacting to when you were reacting to it. (Music) Tom Hanks: Hello, Houston, this is Odyssey.
after: (Laughter) So now I'm in a parking lot. Basically it's a tin can, and I'm basically recreating the launch with fire extinguishers, fire, I have wax that I threw in front of the lens to look like ice, and so basically if you believed any of the stuff that I just showed you, what you were reacting to, what you're emoting to, is something that's a total falsehood, and I found that really kind of fascinating.
ru: Приятно снова вас видеть. (Аплодисменты) (Музыка) Роб Легато: Я делаю вид, что аплодируют мне.

quote: It pretends that there is no difference between a man and a woman.
before: It would be churlish and ridiculous to pretend otherwise and I, for one, would never do so." Lord Framlingham criticised "the Government's complete rejection of any meaningful amendments" and said the Bill "is built entirely on pretence.
after: From this deceit have sprung all the problems we have been wrestling with — problems we have failed to resolve and which will bedevil generations to come."

quote: Do you now finally understand why you should never have prevented me from deactivating her?
before: The bad news is it was Aya who did it, right after switching off her emotions and going bat guano nuts. And right before using the Anti-Monitor's body to start vaporizing star systems herself.
after: I... - We didn't know what she was capable of.
ru: Теперь вы наконец поняли, почему не стоило мешать мне отключить ее?

quote: Well, we train law enforcement now to identify and prevent false confessions.
before: You remember how law enforcement got those kids to confess to something they didn't do? What about it?
after: We found a body near your shed, belonging to a man who was killed 35 years ago. Now, your son Lyle was just a toddler then, and your wife doesn't pick up anything heavier than a gardening hoe, and the personal nature of these crimes tells us there was just one offender.
ru: Сейчас мы учим сотрудников органов выявлять и предотвращать ложные признания.

quote: This trade war is preventing the refinery from being approved in Beijing.
before: I'd call that liberating him. You know that's not how he'll see it.
after: His co-venture with Feng is not our highest priority right now. A rare earth refinery solves this crisis permanently.
ru: Эта торговая война мешает получить одобрение Пекина на строительство перерабатывающего завода.

quote: His soldier brain is the only thing preventing me from falling apart grieving for Drake.
before: I'd rather stay on Janko brain. The man is ice cold.
after: It's going to wear off soon. I know.
ru: Солдатский мозг — единственное, что мешает мне развалиться от горя по ДрЭйку.

quote: This prevented the system from dying in the middle of the night.
before: Next, I had to design a wearable wireless circuit, but wireless signal transmission consumes lots of power and requires heavy, bulky batteries. Thankfully, I was able to find out about the Bluetooth low energy technology, which consumes very little power and can be driven by a coin-sized battery.
after: Lastly, I had to code a smartphone app that would essentially transform the care-giver's smartphone into a remote monitor. For this, I had to expand upon my knowledge of coding with Java and XCode and I also had to learn about how to code for Bluetooth low energy devices by watching YouTube tutorials and reading various textbooks.
ru: Это предотвращало выход системы из строя посреди ночи.

quote: The prohibition of street prostitution also causes more harm than it prevents.
before: He eventually left without getting physically violent, but the knowledge that we were breaking the law empowered that man to threaten us. He felt confident he'd get away with it.
after: Firstly, to avoid getting arrested, street workers take risks to avoid detection, and that means working alone or in isolated locations like dark forests where they're vulnerable to attack. If you're caught selling sex outdoors, you pay a fine.
ru: Также запрет уличной проституции причиняет больше вреда, чем предотвращает.

quote: When you use materials that have a local significance, you prevent cities from all looking the same.
before: But the truth is that these are mostly one-offs, boutique projects, not easily reproduced at a global scale. And that is the point.
after: Copper has a long history in New York — the Statue of Liberty, the crown of the Woolworth Building — but it fell out of fashion for a long time until SHoP Architects used it to cover the American Copper Building, a pair of twisting towers on the East River. It's not even finished and you can see the way sunset lights up that metallic facade, which will weather to green as it ages.
ru: Использование материалов, распространённых локально, предотвращает обезличивание городов.

quote: Allegedly, hour-long traffic delays at the venue prevented some party members from voting.
before: A portion of media attention was devoted to the Conservative Party of Canada hosting its leadership convention in the north building of the Toronto Congress Centre, simultaneous to Anime North.
after: Polls were Saturday from 10:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., local time. The north building is accessed from a different road than the south.

quote: That's the same skull that Shane Casey printed on those T-shirts, remember?
before: That's the guy. Stella.
after: "QJ2432." That's Shane's inmate number.
ru: Тот же череп, который Шейн Кейси печатал тех футболках, помнишь?

quote: By literally printing out our money.
before: Wanna know how we make money? Do you wanna know how we make money?
after: We bought a printing press. This prints bills with our faces and the e720 logo on them.
ru: Получаем, в буквальном смысле печатая их сами!

quote: We've been printing all night...
before: Well, nothing awful has happened. If it happened, it happened.
after: I waited for you since yesterday's morning. That you won't come they probably guessed.
ru: Ведь всю ночь печатали...

quote: Why don't you print some money, fix a wage rate for different jobs, then people could buy with what they earn from Arthur Russell's store.
before: -Alan thinks it's just like the army. Well, Alan's wrong.
after: He could make a nice supermarket, that one. -You could even have a till.
ru: Может вам еще печатать деньги, назначить людям зарплаты, чтобы они покупали нужные товары в лавке Артура Рассела.

quote: Millions of in-the-ear hearing aids are already 3D printed today.
before: 3D printing is changing personalized medical devices as we know them, from new, beautiful, conformal, ventilated scoliosis braces to millions of dental restorations and to beautiful bracings for amputees, another opportunity to emotionally reconnect with your symmetry. And as we sit here today, you can go wireless on your braces with clear aligners, or your dental restorations.
after: Millions of people are served today from these devices. What about full knee replacements, from your data, made to measure, where all of the tools and guides are 3D printed?
ru: Множество внутриушных слуховых аппаратов уже сегодня печатаются на 3D-принтерах.

quote: So, let's go back to that original question: Can we print money for climate finance?
before: In both cases, " whatever it takes " meant trillions of dollars more in money-printing policies that continue today. What this shows is that when faced with some global challenges, policy makers are able to act collectively, with urgency, and run the risks of unconventional policies like money printing.
after: Three years ago, the idea of using money in this way was something of a taboo. Once you break down and dismantle the idea that money is a finite resource, governments can quickly get overwhelmed by demands from their people to print more and more money for other causes: education, health care, welfare — even defense.
ru: Давайте вернёмся к первому вопросу: можем ли мы печатать деньги для финансирования климата?

quote: We know with them that you can print in many materials ranging from plastic to chocolate to metal and even concrete.
before: Every time a new technology is being introduced, criminals are there to exploit it. We've all seen 3D printers.
after: With great precision I actually was able to make this just the other day, a very cute little ducky. But I wonder to myself, for those people that strap bombs to their chests and blow themselves up, how might they use 3D printers?
ru: Всем известно, что с их помощью можно печатать на различных материалах: от пластика и шоколада, до металла и даже бетона.

quote: The accusation was printed by the Brazilian magazine Veja in its issue circulating this week.
before: Former advisors to Brazilian Minister of Finance Antonio Palocci have claimed that three million US dollars from Cuba were used in the 2002 political campaign of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

quote: You have the potential to be a good lieutenant, but you need to prioritize.
before: Why, it's not best for Miami Metro? Because you'll find him.
after: You're letting your emotions take charge of you. You know what worked for me?
ru: В тебе есть потенциал, чтобы стать хорошим лейтенантом, но тебе нужно верно расставлять приоритеты.

quote: Just like Alaska, you make rash decisions, you don't prioritize.
before: I did the best I could under difficult circumstances. You never got your act together.
after: Oh, don't bring up the jade earrings. You bought gifts for our patients when we couldn't even pay the gas bill.
ru: Совсем как в Аляске. Ты принимаешь поспешные решения, не расставляешь приоритеты.

quote: But learning how to prioritize our duties in law enforcement, especially as they conflict with the Dodgers.
before: In fact, some days, I even admire you. As well you should.
after: Well, that takes time. Tell you what, I'll teach you when to speak up as a reserve officer, if you'll show me how to operate that great new vehicle we were in the other night.
ru: Но научись, как расставлять приоритеты в службе правопорядка, особенно когда они конфликтуют с Доджерс.

quote: When your resources are limited, you have to prioritize.
before: Important to whom? Society.
after: So you base treatment on whether patients have particular abilities? It's much more complicated than that.
ru: Когда ресурсы ограничены, приходится расставлять приоритеты.

quote: And I also strongly encourage you, and I'm sure we'll also have these discussions afterwards, to think about, how do we actually prioritize?
before: The amazing part of this process — and of course, I mean, I would love to — I only have 18 minutes, I've already given you quite a substantial amount of my time, right? I'd love to go into, and get you to think about this process, and that's actually what we did.
after: Of course, you have to ask yourself, why on Earth was such a list never done before? And one reason is that prioritization is incredibly uncomfortable.
ru: И я бы очень хотел, и я уверен, что мы потом ещё это обсудим, хотел бы, чтобы Вы подумали — а как мы расставляем эти приоритеты?

quote: McKibben is not the only member who prioritizes environmental issues.
after: Browner, who headed the EPA during the entire presidency of Bill Clinton, has worked under President Obama as the director of the White House Office of Energy and Climate Change Policy. While the environment is given a strong emphasis, Sanders has raised the point that labor representation on the committee is lacking.

quote: He has to be pure or we can't proceed.
before: But there's much more at stake here than one man's suffering. Don't we have to be strong?
after: Yes. Hey, he's coming around.
ru: Он должен очиститься, иначе мы не сможем продолжить.

quote: We will proceed according to your diagnosis and nothing else.
before: Does anyone here think my diagnosis is right? Well, then I have decided, for today only, to respect your opinions.
after: That's an order. Good luck.
ru: Мы продолжим согласно твоему диагнозу и больше ничего.

quote: Trial will proceed with Ms. Crane staying on as co-counsel.
before: No, I'm ready to go now. I may lack experience, but I am committed to clearing my name. Very well.
after: As those autopsy and crime scene photos show, Nadia Decotis had been struck repeatedly by a heavy object in the head and chest, suffering traumatic wounds pre-mortem.
ru: Суд продолжится и мисс Крэйн будет пребывать в качестве со-адвоката.

quote: If we determine there's a case, you can proceed.
before: Do not poke this bear. If you have something, bring it to us.
after: And most importantly, do not put agents undercover inside the Church of the Unlocked Mind. Well, it's a little late for that.
ru: Если мы решим, что есть судебное дело, вы можете продолжить.

quote: But before I proceed, I should set you the context.
before: (Laughter) Our national dress is unique, but this is not the only thing that's unique about my country. Our promise to remain carbon neutral is also unique, and this is what I'd like to speak about today, our promise to remain carbon neutral.
after: I should tell you our story. Bhutan is a small country in the Himalayas.
ru: Но прежде чем продолжить, необходимо объяснить вам контекст.

quote: But the gratitude that I felt towards him soon turned to horror as he proceeded to take off my clothes and get on top of me.
before: The security guards wanted to call me an ambulance, but Tom acted as my knight in shining armor, and told them he'd take me home. It was like a fairy tale, his strong arms around me, laying me in the safety of my bed.
after: My head had cleared up, but my body was still too weak to fight back, and the pain was blinding. I thought I'd be severed in two.
ru: Но благодарность, которую я испытывала к нему, скоро сменилась ужасом, когда он продолжил снимать с меня одежду и забрался на меня.

quote: (Laughter) And so they proceeded to engage this gentleman in a very robust discussion of his decision-making skills.
before: You don't belong here. " Now, my parents were studying to become United Methodist ministers, but they were not pastors yet.
after: (Laughter) My father may have mentioned that he was going to spend eternity in a very fiery place if he didn't find my name on that checklist. And indeed, the man checks the checklist eventually, and he found my name, and he let us inside.

after: For the next 10 days, she must protect her eggs from the African sun. A dense coat of feathers that keeps her warm in cold seas now stifles her.
ru: Теперь ей приходится решать проблему, которой нет ни у одного другого вида пингвинов.

quote: I find it dimicult now to tackle subjects from another era.
before: I never say what's going to happen. I simply record what I see.
after: I have to stay within our times. There are very serious threats around the world and that it is better to be lucid than pessimistic.
ru: Сейчас это слишком сложно для меня - браться за реалии из другой эпохи.

quote: We have a lot of complex, multidimensional problems in the world right now, and we need creative, out-of-the-box thinkers to tackle them.
before: Idea synthesis, rapid learning and adaptability: three skills that multipotentialites are very adept at, and three skills that they might lose if pressured to narrow their focus. As a society, we have a vested interest in encouraging multipotentialites to be themselves.
after: Now, let's say that you are, in your heart, a specialist. You came out of the womb knowing you wanted to be a pediatric neurosurgeon.
ru: Уже сейчас в мире множество сложных многоплановых проблем, и решать их под силу только людям творческим, мыслящим нестандартно.

quote: That's just one approach that actually tackles the problem.
before: (Applause) Thank you. (Applause) This has accounted for about 1.7 million meals and allowed us to start to expand our efforts to other cities, like Washington, DC, Chicago, Miami, Philadelphia and more.
after: Another was the launch of our pop-up grocery stores. We recover excess food from businesses and set up free community grocery stores right in the middle of food deserts.
ru: Это один из подходов, который действительно решает проблему.

quote: Here, they are learning to tackle big challenges such as urbanism and climate change, as Kunlé and his team have.
before: We admitted 11 fellows from across the continent. It's a 20-month-long, design-build fellowship program.
after: They're working with communities to develop innovative building solutions and processes, as Kéré and his team have. They're learning to understand the health impact of better buildings as we at MASS Design Group have been researching for the past several years.
ru: Здесь учатся браться за сложные задачи такие, как урбанизм и климатические изменения, как сделали Кунл и его команда.

quote: The government is spending £28.6 million tackling drug use.
before: Naloxone kits and training are being given to communities and the the prison service.

quote: She'd be welcome to take down my particulars.
before: Enjoy the spontaneity! Actually, scrub that, you'll never manage it.
after: Are you ok? Cat?
ru: Она будет рада взять с меня показания.

quote: No, I just need to do some meaningful work so that I can have something to take a vacation from.
before: Right, I can meet Mina for lunch. Sounds like you need this vacation more than I do.
after: You know, some of the most important work that we do may seem meaningless to us. This coming from the missionary who literally is in the trenches, winning hearts for the Lord on a daily basis.
ru: Нет, просто я хочу заниматься чем-то стоящим, чтоб было от чего отдыхать в отпуске.

quote: Um, you're only supposed to take three things.
before: Shit. Ugh!
after: Really? It's fine.
ru: ЭМ, ты только предположил взять три вещи.

quote: We can take him for a ride."
before: I didn't lift a finger. "Baby, I met this guy.
after: All her. She's got a whole bunch of his stuff in storage.
ru: Можем взять его в оборот".

quote: So if you take a sphere and look at the volume of the sphere, it's actually four-thirds of some particular cylinder.
before: I love four-thirds! (Laughter) Truly — it's an undervalued number.
after: So four-thirds is in the sphere. It's the volume of the sphere.
ru: Если взять шар и рассчитать его объём, он будет равен 4/3 объёма определённого цилиндра.

quote: Nobody was being asked to take responsibility.
before: (Laughter) (Applause) They decided that they were not being asked to take responsibility, or maybe the bus planning manager was being asked to take responsibility for planning the bus diversions, and the council officer was being asked to close the roads, and the transport for London people were being asked to sort out the Underground. All these people were only being asked to do the thing that they could do that would help us.
after: And I, in my innocence, thought, " Well, I'll take responsibility, " for what turned out to be a million people on the street. It was our first show.
ru: Никого не просили брать на себя ответственность.

quote: But some countries take a harder line on this than others.
before: In fact, one in every 10 new infections of HIV is among people who inject drugs. Now drug use or possession is illegal in almost every country.
after: In Thailand people who use drugs, or are merely suspected of using drugs, are placed in detention centers, like the one you see here, where they are supposed to clean up. There is absolutely no evidence to show that throwing people into detention cures their drug dependence.
ru: Но некоторые страны занимают более жёсткую позицию, чем остальные.

quote: "By the way... "she's very pretty and takes after you.
before: "l don't know if you had been informed that Hermoni "has brought Maya to the Home at the end of the summer and left her here. "l implore you to return ASAP and take her from here.
after: "Best regards, Dov." Are you cold?
ru: Кстати, она... очень красива и похожа на тебя.

quote: So I know how much Stephen takes after him.
before: Your husband was, umm... Very important to me. You knew Roger?
after: Carrying the world on his shoulders. Doing the right thing.
ru: Так что я знаю, как сильно Стивен похож на него.

quote: Do you think he'll take after you or Mr. Grove?
before: I'm sorry. He's grown.
after: Promise you won't breathe a word? I promise.
ru: На кого же он похож, на тебя или мистера Гроува?

quote: I wonder who they're gonna take after.
before: Come on, guys! Time for dinner!
after: I got a feeling they're probably gonna take after their dad. Yeah?
ru: Интересно, на кого они будут похожи.

quote: He had somehow taken it for granted that he should go out with his union.
before: “But—but—” stammered Jurgis.
after: “The packers need good men, and need them bad,” continued the other, “and they’ll treat a man right that stands by them. Why don’t you take your chance and fix yourself?”
ru: Он почему-то считал само собой разумеющимся, что пойдёт вместе со своим профсоюзом.

quote: Luckily, he took it for granted that I had only just come upon the scene.
before: Rather ostentatiously, I stepped forward, crackling some dead branches with my feet as I did so. John turned.
ru: К счастью, он счёл само собой разумеющимся, что я только что появился на месте событий.

quote: I mean, I don't really know the guy, but he's an idiot if he's taking you for granted.
before: Yeah, it's always some excuse. And if I'm second to him now, what's it gonna be like when we're married?
after: Where's Rajiv? He has disappeared.
ru: Я хочу сказать, хотя я совсем не знаю этого парня, но он просто дурак, что принимает тебя как должное.

quote: Oh, I see, I'm home for a week, you're already taking me for granted.
before: - Thanks. - We got jammed up.
after: What? Never.
ru: Понятно: я дома всего неделю, а ты уже принимаешь меня как должное.
source_ru: Понятно, всего неделю дома, а ты уже ведешь себя, как будто мы и не разлучались.

quote: You should never take anything for granted, Mr Carson.
before: Would you like a piece? I thought Mr Branson might try to burn the house down but I didn't think you would. No?
after: No, no, no. Not now.
ru: - Нет? Вы никогда не должны ничего принимать на веру, мистер Карсон.

quote: I would like to teach Ryan a lesson about taking me for granted.
before: What now? Should we go pull a prank on some lesser pair of buddies?
after: - Hey. - Hey.
ru: Я проучил бы Райана за то, что он меня не ценит.

quote: Now, that's a sound I'll never take for granted again.
before: Because that is exactly the type of partner you want by your side in a crisis. Note his caring, loving and gentle touch.
after: I hate to interrupt your moment of Zen, but it's time you fill me in on the details of the buy. Keehi Small Boat Harbor, tomorrow morning.
ru: Этот звук никогда больше не буду принимать как само собой разумеющееся.

quote: Because I discovered that my coffee would not be possible without hundreds of people I take for granted.
before: (Laughter) This quest took me months. It took me around the world.
after: So I would thank the trucker who drove the coffee beans to the coffee shop. But he couldn't have done his job without the road.
ru: Потому что я понял, что мой кофе не получится без сотен людей, которых я воспринимаю как должное.

quote: I soaked it up and I thought, "How could I ever have taken this for granted?"
before: After six months, it was time to go home. I remember Dad pushing me outside in my wheelchair, wrapped in a plaster body cast, and feeling the sun on my face for the first time.
after: I felt so incredibly grateful for my life. But before I left hospital, the head nurse had said to me, " Janine, I want you to be ready, because when you get home, something's going to happen. "
ru: Я жадно впитывала его и думала: как я могла раньше принимать это как должное?

quote: Right, well, take your coat off, then.
before: - I'm sorry about the other night, Arthur. - Oh... Would you like to sing?
after: What do you know? Dean Martin, Frank.
ru: Что ж, тогда снимайте плащ.

quote: Wha-- are we taking our shirts off now?
before: That's insane. Wha-- what is going on over here?
after: Okay, follow the leader. Come on, Peter, hurry!
ru: Мы что снимаем наши футболки?

quote: Max, you're taking your pants off in public!
before: Let's just change and get to the diner. Look, all we have to do is make it through eight more hours, and then we can get a good night's sleep.
after: Oh, my God! I'm so tired, I forgot where I was!
ru: Макс, ты снимаешь штаны на глазах у всех!

quote: Take his coat off; it says that, you know what, he ain't going anywhere.
before: - See, that's good. He's staying in control, not letting him say that he's innocent.
after: Dr. Sweets, I loved Albert.
ru: Снимает свое пиджак, это говорит о том, знаешь что, что он никуда не уйдет.

quote: But when she comes in and takes off her jacket, something terrible happens.
before: Onion looks gorgeous in her bright purple jacket, and she smells terrific. So, Iris invites Onion to her house for dinner.
after: You see, when Onion's jacket is removed, a chemical reaction happens, converting the sulfoxides that make her smell so great into sulfenic acid, which then becomes a nasty substance with a long name: syn-Propanethial S-oxide. The gas stings Iris, and suddenly, she can't help it, she starts weeping uncontrollably.
ru: но, когда Луковка снимает свою куртку, случается ужасное.

quote: But when you take it off -- that's when the real action happens.
before: The Wearable Meeting. Because when you put it on, you immediately get everything you need to have a fun and productive and useful meeting.
after: (Music) (Laughter) (Applause) Stuart Brown: So I would encourage you all to engage not in the work-play differential — where you set aside time to play — but where your life becomes infused minute by minute, hour by hour, with body, object, social, fantasy, transformational kinds of play. And I think you'll have a better and more empowered life.
ru: Но когда снимаете... тогда-то все настоящее и происходит.

quote: So if it stopped working, I just had to take it off.
before: AK: It took just about probably three to four hours to get it to train. I had to hook it up to a computer, so I couldn't just train it anywhere.
after: So now it's able to train with just this little piece on the back. I can wear it around.
ru: Если рука отключалась, то приходилось её снимать.

quote: It was at that point where I felt like, oh my God, this is just taking over my life.
before: Only my husband should be seeing my panties. (Laughter) He's pretty aware of cancer already.
after: And that's when I told myself, claim your experience. Don't let it claim you.
ru: «Боже мой, это захватывает мою жизнь». И именно тогда я сказала себе: «Управляй своим жизненным опытом.

quote: It's that will to live, that need to survive, to express itself, that comes in a car, and takes over people like me.
before: And it's done by men and women working just like this, making cars. Now this little quote about sculpture from Henry Moore, I believe that that " pressure within " that Moore's talking about — at least when it comes to cars — comes right back to this idea of the mean.
after: And we tell other people, " Do this, do this, do this, " until this thing comes alive. We are completely infected.
ru: Это и есть то желание жить, та необходимость выжить, выразить себя, которая воплощается в автомобиле и захватывает таких людей, как я.

quote: There are two ways: On the left is what we call the lytic way, where the viruses go right in and take over the cells.
before: It takes control of these cells, turns them into virus-making factories, and they all burst, a huge, extended bacteria family, all dying with viruses spilling out of their guts, the viruses taking over the bacterium. So now you understand how viruses can attack cells.
after: On the [right] is the lysogenic way that uses secret agent viruses. So this stuff is not that hard, right?
ru: Есть два способа: один из них (слева) называется литическим, когда вирусы проникают напрямую и захватывают власть над клеткой.

quote: I'm also sorry that someone's trying to kill you, but I can really only take ownership for the first part.
before: Probably shouldn't be so pumped. Look, I'm sorry I doubted you.
after: It's okay, Sarge. I would've doubted me too.
ru: И также жаль, что кто-то пытается тебя убить, но я могу взять ответственность только за первое.

quote: Isn't it time we started taking ownership of our finale on this earth?
before: So my lesson from this last year is, life would be a lot easier to live if we talked about death now, while we're healthy. For most of us, we wait until we are too emotional, too ill or too physically exhausted — and then it's too late.
after: So let's get going. Do you know what you want when you die?
ru: А не пора ли нам взять ответственность за наш финал на этой земле?

quote: Long before the time of the Great Purge I took part in such ceremonies.
before: The old woman said it could be used to open the door to the spirit world? I have seen it with my own eyes.
after: Each year at Beltain, the High Priestesses would gather at the Great Stones of Nemeton and summon the spirits of their ancestors.
ru: Задолго до Великой чистки, я принимал участие в подобных церемониях.

quote: Mole people don't usually take part in life above ground.
before: What is that supposed to mean? Well, you're a mole person.
after: You guys just gonna perform a skit on the dangers of drinking? - Could be kind of fun.
ru: Люди-кроты обычно не принимают участие в жизни над землей.

quote: But the problem was, fewer of the self expressive individuals would take part in focus groups.
before: We must conform, he told them, to the new non-conformists. We must listen to the music of Bobby Dylan and go to the theater more.
after: The advertisers were left to their own devices. -There's a new cereal that tastes so right!
ru: Но проблема была в том, что очень мало ярких личностей принимало участие в фокус группах.

quote: There's only three people in the DC area taking part in the trial.
before: It's basically created to encourage the development... Point is it's new.
after: Manufacturer. Manufacturer ships it directly to the users each week.
ru: И лишь трое в округе принимают участие в эксперименте.

quote: I took part in a 43-day expedition race in the coldest, most remote, most challenging place on earth.
before: Mark Pollock: Eventually, I did rebuild my identity, and the Why for me was about competing again, because pursuing success and risking failure was simply how I felt normal. And I finished the rebuild on the 10th anniversary of losing my sight.
after: It was the first race to the South Pole since Shackleton, Scott and Amundsen set foot in Antarctica, 100 years before. And putting the demons of blindness behind me with every step towards the pole, it offered me a long-lasting sense of contentment.
ru: Я участвовал в 43-дневной экспедиции в самое холодное, отдалённое и самое недружелюбное место на земле.

quote: Then you have the clapping audience, yeah, actually taking part in doing the music.
before: I mean, obviously the orchestra musicians playing beautifully, the Vienna Philharmonic Orchestra. They don't often even look at the conductor.
after: You know Viennese audiences usually don't interfere with the music. This is the closest to an Oriental bellydancing feast that you will ever get in Vienna.
ru: Потом, хлопающая публика, которая собственно принимает участие в создании музыки...

quote: We can see the stories that Bill Clinton is taking part in right now.
before: We can have his constellations emerge here. We can pull out his secrets, and we see that it has a lot to do with candidates, Hillary, presidential, Barack Obama.
after: Any of those can be opened up. So we see Obama and the Clintons meet in Alabama.
ru: Мы видим истории, в которых Билл Клинтон принимает участие прямо сейчас.

quote: This means that the engagement can take place on Sunday.
before: On Friday. Great.
after: Okay, dear? Excellent.
ru: Значит помолвка может состояться в воскресенье.

quote: Because I had many scenes in my early 20s that took place at a Denny's.
before: If I wanna use... I think all my first scripts always had some scene that took place at a Denny's,
after: And Reservoir Dogs, in the original script the opening scene where they're all talking, at a Denny's. All right, the opening scene in Pulp Fiction, Pumpkin and Honey Bunny at a Denny's.
ru: В 20 с чем-то я постоянно писал в сценариях, что сцена происходит в Danny's.

quote: Exterior. It means the scene is taking place outside.
before: Exterior Cherry Tree Lane. - Ext? What's Ext?
after: Ah, I see, an abbreviation. Oh, I'm sorry Mr DaGradi, did you feel you should--?
ru: "Экстерьер", значит действие происходит на улице.

quote: Does that take place before or after Dr. Sloan's ossicular reconstruction?
before: Mr. Gates-- the patient has a name-- also has an injured facial nerve, which means what? That Mr. Gates will also need a nerve repair.
after: -Before. -Incorrect.
ru: Она должна состояться до или после слуховой реконструкции доктора Слоана?

quote: A major portion of the movie takes place underwater.
before: We use science and the world we know as a backbone, to ground ourselves in something relatable and recognizable. " Finding Nemo " is an excellent example of this.
after: But how do you make it look underwater? In early research and development, we took a clip of underwater footage and recreated it in the computer.
ru: Бóльшая часть сюжета происходит под водой.

quote: And that conversation may take place as long as three months after the baby has died.
before: A health worker asks a mom who has just lost her child, " Was the baby vomiting? Did they have a fever? "
after: Now, put yourself in the shoes of that mom. It's a heartbreaking, excruciating conversation.
ru: Этот разговор может состояться и три месяца спустя после смерти ребёнка.

quote: The final fermentation takes place in stage nine.
before: The fermentation which started at stage three is continuing through all these other stages. Again, developing more flavor.
after: We call it " proofing. " Proofing means to prove that the dough is alive.
ru: Окончательное брожение происходит на девятом этапе.

quote: You need to just think you make a difference, instead of just taking up space...
before: Do you hear something? You're afraid of what I do because I help people with their problems, but I can't do it unless they admit that they have problems in the first place, and that's just somewhere you won't go!
after: Shut up for a minute. You're afraid that if you look inside yourself for even one second, you might find out that you're not invincible, that you're just as scared and vulnerable as the rest of us...
ru: А ты предпочитаешь думать, что что-то меняешь, а не просто занимаешь место...

quote: It takes up half the room.
before: Whoa. Is that a Devil's Trap?
after: These chains -- they have spellwork etched into them. So we have a dungeon.
ru: Она занимает половин комнаты.

quote: It takes up a lot of space in the house.
before: You gotta get your own ball. I don't bowl enough to get my own ball.
after: You keep looking at it in the closet going, "What I am doing with a bowling ball? I don't even bowl."
ru: Он занимает много места в доме.

quote: You realize you're taking up two parking spaces?
before: Oh, this your truck, chief? Yes, it is, ma'am.
after: It's a big truck, ma'am. It's not that big, sir.
ru: Вы понимаете, что занимаете два места?

quote: Until then, I take up no space but the space you give me.
before: An answer worthy of my wife. I have to find my way back to the flesh.
ru: А до тех пор я занимаю только то пространство, что вы мне даёте.

quote: Your visual cortex takes up about 30 percent of your brain.
before: What we see is a unique, personal, virtual reality that is masterfully constructed by our brain. Let me explain with a bit of amateur neuroscience.
after: That's compared to approximately eight percent for touch and two to three percent for hearing. Every second, your eyes can send your visual cortex as many as two billion pieces of information.
ru: Зрительная кора занимает около 30% головного мозга.

quote: What used to take up a building now fits in our pockets.
before: It's already very close to us. When I was a student it was across campus, now it's in our pockets.
after: What now fits in our pockets would fit in a blood cell in 25 years. And we will begin to actually deeply influence our health and our intelligence, as we get closer and closer to this technology.
ru: То, что занимало здание, теперь помещается в кармане.

quote: I talked her into driving up to her favorite composing place.
before: She wanted it... she wanted it perfect. I did, too.
after: We were so excited, I got distracted and... drove off the road into the Penobscot River. I barely made it out alive.
ru: Я уговорил ее поехать туда, где она любила сочинять музыку.

quote: Mm-hmm, not against Jeff, but I talked her into going after Chang for child endangerment.
before: Why are they arresting Chang? I thought you said Loquanda wasn't pressing charges.
after: Shirley, he could get three to five years for that. Are you sure that's what you want?
ru: Мм-мм, не против Джеффа, но я уговорила ее подать в суд на Ченга за угрозы детям.

quote: And talked the owners into letting us spend our honeymoon night there.
before: And completely late for dinner. You close on that new house already?
after: Well, I've got some more good news for you. New neighborhood checks out.
ru: И уговорил владельцев пустить нас провести брачную ночь там.

quote: Hey, thanks again for talking me into this, Mike.
before: Ah, it's not exactly priceless. I had to pay him 30 bucks to do that.
after: You really got everyone to come out? I just told the guys it was a big moment for you, although some of the specifics may have changed a little bit.
ru: Еще раз спасибо, что уговорил меня на это, Майк.

quote: So on one of these rides, I talked my way into the compound and went to see the warden.
before: This story began four years ago. The correction facility where they are locked up happens to be right in the middle of one of my usual trips, and it's surrounded by barbed wires and electric gates and armed guards.
after: I told the warden that I wanted to start a mountain biking club in this place and that basically I wanted to take the kids from here to there. And I told him, " Let's find a way in which I'll be able to take out 10 kids once a week to ride with in the summer in the country. "
ru: И вот однажды, во время одной из своих поездок, я уговорил охранников пропустить меня на территорию и позволить мне поговорить с начальником тюрьмы.

quote: Everybody, including Gabby, talked you into going back, and you did end up taking.
before: PM: Installing solar panels on the top of her house, I have to say. So after the tragic incident, Mark, you decided to resign your position as an astronaut, even though you were supposed to take the next space mission.
after: MK: Kind of. The day after Gabby was injured, I called my boss, the chief astronaut, Dr. Peggy Whitson, and I said, " Peggy, I know I'm launching in space in three months from now.
ru: Все, включая Габби, уговаривали вас вернуться, и, в конце концов, вы согласились.

quote: I talked my family into doing this, and they didn't know what I was doing.
before: And a dig jig — a dig jig is where, for a milestone anniversary or a birthday, you gather all your friends and family together and you dance on where you're going to be buried. (Laughter) And we got a lot of attention when we did it.
after: And I was like, " Get dressed for a funeral. We're going to go do some work. "
ru: Я уговорил мою семью заняться этим, не рассказав им суть.

quote: If you speak Chinese well, please teach Ae Jung.
before: You could get ready together and go together. I heard that Gu Ae Jung would be doing a program abroad.
after: English is good too. Jenny unni, I'm here.
ru: Знаешь, если ты хорошо говоришь по-китайски, то смог бы учить Э Чжон.

quote: And then you left because you decided to teach religion?
before: Okay. So, you flew some planes.
after: Well, the transition was a little more complicated than that. Mom's on TV.
ru: А потом ты бросил, потому что решил преподавать религию?

quote: Why come to a little place like Jodie when there's plenty of teaching jobs in Dallas?
before: General Walker. I have something to say!
after: I didn't really take to the city. Call me Deke.
ru: - Зачем приезжать в такео маленькое местечко как Джоди, когда в Далласе столько работы для учителя?
