ru: Я напечатала этого чёрно-белого персонажа на принтере, и когда диск поворачивается, это сводит пару в таких различных обличиях.

quote: Psiphon is supposed to be able to effectively turn anyone's personal computer into a proxy server.
after: The censored user may then connect to the computer running Psiphon and accesses banned content from there, all out of the view of censors. Psiphon data is also encrypted and moves globally on a network reserved for secure financial transactions, so the Censor wouldn't be able to tell a Psiphon request from a MasterCard purchase.

quote: They have turned down your request to test genetronics on humanoids three times already.
before: You're using the desperation of an injured man as an excuse to try a procedure that you couldn't do under normal circumstances. I checked with Starfleet Medical.
after: Are you really going to hide behind the rules of some bureaucracy? Beverly, your patient's life is at stake here.
ru: Они уже трижды отклоняли вашу просьбу о проведении генотронного лечения.

quote: I turned down TV interviews, and I said no to every request for photos of the two us.
before: So my first impulse in the face of all of this attention was to become very protective of my own relationship. I said no to every request for the two of us to do a media appearance together.
after: I think I was afraid that we would become inadvertent icons for the process of falling in love, a position I did not at all feel qualified for. And I get it: people didn't just want to know if the study worked, they wanted to know if it really worked: that is, if it was capable of producing love that would last, not just a fling, but real love, sustainable love.
ru: я отклоняла интервью на телевидении, говорила «нет» всем, кто хотел получить нашу совместную фотографию.

quote: I turned off the grill about a half an hour ago.
before: Toys? ! Hey, I'm just closing up.
after: Oh, we, uh... No, we're not here to eat, Blaine.
ru: Я выключил гриль где-то полчаса назад.

quote: But what I don't understand is why you turned off the scoreboard.
before: - You understand, right? - I do.
after: No, no, no, I turned off the microphone. No.
ru: Чего я не понял, так это зачем вы выключили табло со счетом.

quote: Turn off your bomb, we'll talk about it.
before: You want to tell your boy here to ease up on his trigger finger? Soon as you and your people leave this ship.
after: I already told you, it's not our bomb. Then whose is it?
ru: Выключи свою бомбу, и мы поговорим об этом.

quote: Will you set the timer, turn off the oven in 35 minutes?
before: Hey, sorry. I'm going out.
after: I'm using the timer for a meeting, hon... Angela.
ru: Установи себе таймер, выключить духовку через 35 минут.

quote: Turn off those mobile phones. Turn off those computers.
before: We stand in a massively lit bathroom, looking into the mirror cleaning our teeth. It's the worst thing we can possibly do before we go to sleep.
after: Turn off all of those things that are also going to excite the brain. Try not to drink caffeine too late in the day, ideally not after lunch.
ru: Отключите мобильные. Выключите компьютеры.

quote: It's not something we can turn off.
before: Now, working memory is that part of our consciousness that we are aware of at any given time of day. You're going it right now.
after: If you turn it off, that's called a coma, okay? So right now, you're doing just fine.
ru: Вы не можете просто выключить её.

quote: Right this minute, we can turn off TV, log off the Internet, get up and start to do something.
before: Yes, that's right. Right now, we need to start our own art.
after: Where I teach students in drama school, there's a course called Dramatics. In this course, all students must put on a play.
ru: Прямо сейчас — начать самим творить. Вот в эту самую минуту — выключить телевизор, выйти из интернета

quote: Mr. Beale, would you turn on the news channel?
before: The next step is to trace the delivery chain from the cyanide factory to the plating plant. Something had to have happened along the way.
after: ...San Fernando Valley, where a freak series of heart attacks has kept paramedics on their toes in this Chatsworth neighborhood. The 911 calls came within five minutes of each other from three different homes.
ru: Мистер Бил, включите канал новостей.

quote: Ed was dead before the oven was turned on.
before: He was found in his apartment with the gas turned on, right? I mean, how is that not a suicide?
after: Oh, no, no. No, no, no, no, no, no, no, no.
ru: Эд был мёртв до того, как включили духовку.

quote: Turns on the TV, leaving it on while he assaults her.
before: He goes into the victim's bedroom. Chloroforms her.
after: Actually, Amy already had her television on, so he just left it playing. What if it wasn't a coincidence?
ru: Включает телевизор, оставляет его включенным когда насилует ее.

quote: And now, in the immortal words of Saint Nick, turn on the compressor.
before: Obviously not. Behold, the greatest inflatable tree that 'murica has to offer.
after: You hear that? It's the sound of Christmas.
ru: И теперь, говоря бессмертными словами Святого Николая: "включить компрессор".

quote: Every time I turned on the faucet, I was overwhelmed.
before: When I was in Africa some years ago and then came back, I noticed water. In Africa where I was, I didn't have drinkable water.
after: Every time I clicked on the light, I was so grateful. It made me so happy.
ru: Каждый раз, когда я включал кран, я был поражён.

quote: I knew when you turned on your TV and how long you watched it for.
before: KH: Uh, I think you just outed them to, like, a lot of people here. SM: Don't be embarrassed, it's just metadata.
after: Fun fact about the Hill household: they don't watch a lot of television, but when they do, it's usually in binge mode. Favorite shows include " Difficult People " and " Party Down. "
ru: Я узнал, когда ты включаешь телевизор и как долго ты его смотришь.

quote: I turn on the flashing lights to indicate compliance.
before: (Laughter) She's had some drinks, so I drive us in her parents' car, and we get pulled over by the police. I'm scared.
after: I pull over slowly under the brightest streetlight I can find in case I need witnesses or dashcam footage. We get out my identification, the car registration, lay it out in the open, roll down the windows, my hands are placed on the steering wheel, all before the officer exits the vehicle.
ru: Я включил аварийные огни, чтобы показать, что я подчиняюсь.

quote: I mean, any kind of profound, new change in the world could turn out to be a black ball.
before: NB: That looks plausible under current conditions. It's not just synthetic biology, either.
after: CA: Let's look at another possible response. NB: This also, I think, has only limited potential.
ru: Чёрным шаром могут оказаться абсолютно любые новые серьезные изменения в мире.

quote: We've got to tweak it a little.
before: - I wrote it. - Oh. Well, it's got some good bits.
after: Yes, yes, she's got to get off the stage fast too. Well, stick her in a cannon.
ru: Нужно только немного подправить.

quote: I had to tweak the image a little bit, but it's under control now.
before: See you. Everything on schedule?
after: Foley's up there. Get him!
ru: Пришлось немного подправить картинку, но теперь все под контролем.

quote: Many weapons programs were tweaked but no major weapon system was cut.
after: Funding for unmanned aircraft will be increased.

quote: It's funny how things have a way of getting twisted and exaggerated over time.
before: Is everything all right? There are those somewhat less enlightened among our people who believe he is a demon who rips souls from human bodies and takes them to hell where they suffer for all eternity.
after: While others don't. He's not that bad.
ru: Забавно, как одни вещи со временем искажаются и преувеличиваются.

quote: Why do you twist my words?
before: - Why do I what? Nat.
after: You make everything seem as if it's my fault. Why can't you just be normal?
ru: Почему ты искажаешь сказанное мной?

quote: The information they get gets filtered through somebody who either twists that information, or colors that information, does something with it.
before: According to relevant researchers, 83 percent of the population of this planet lives in the societies without independent press. Think about that number: 83 percent of the population on the whole planet does not really know what is going on in their countries.
after: So they're deprived of understanding their reality. That is just to understand how big and important this problem is.
ru: Информацию, которую они получают, кто-то фильтрует, кто-то её или искажает, или придаёт ей какой-то оттенок, что-то с ней делает.

quote: A's player Daric Barton reportedly twisted his right knee.
after: This happened after Matsui's hit. Barton tripped on grass attempting to catch Matsui's hit ball.

quote: Mhmm, just don't underestimate how difficult that is.
before: Problem is they're wired to keep the rest of the world out. So all I have to do is find a way into this boy's world.
after: I never do. Right.
ru: Ммм, только не недооценивай насколько тяжело это будет.

quote: Hey, never underestimate the power of a desperate woman-- In love.
before: "Woo"? Your big plan is to "woo"?
after: ♪ Alright, watch your step--
ru: Эй, никогда недооценивай силу влюбленной, отчаянной женщины.

quote: Four older brothers. Stop underestimating me and fix this.
before: But that was also 2007, and he's been sliding ever since. What?
after: - You screwed me, Ben. - I didn't screw you.
ru: Хватит меня недооценивать и уладь это дело.

quote: Never underestimate the collective human ability to overlook the inexplicable.
before: I don't understand. How could it not have been headline news?
after: Also, the Frost Fair involved a lot of day drinking. May I?
ru: Нельзя недооценивать коллективную человеческую способность игнорировать необъяснимое.

quote: Thankfully, criminals underestimate the power of fingerprints, too.
before: And even this evening, have you paid any attention to sit without touching anything? Well, you're not alone.
after: And I'm not just talking about the twisted parting of lines that make our fingerprint unique. I'm talking about an entire world of information hiding in a small, often invisible thing.
ru: К счастью, преступники тоже недооценивают силу отпечатков пальцев.

quote: So never, ever underestimate the power of a simple human connection.
before: So that's Pam. And she answered the call to me when I was that 14-year-old in the phone box, over 30 years ago.
after: Because it can be and so often is the power to save a life. Thank you.
ru: Не недооценивайте силу простого человеческого общения.

quote: Do not underestimate the transformative power of truly modern markets.
before: Does that sound improbable to you? That's what a lot of people said about turbo trading in financial exchanges 20 years ago.
after: Thank you. (Applause)
ru: Не стоит недооценивать преобразующую силу современных рынков.

quote: Lead Paul Sun-Hyung Lee talked about how the series has been underestimated "up 'til now."
after: During the premiere, "I felt like Cinderella at the ball [...] I'm a jobber, I've been working as an actor for like, close to 25 years, lots of small roles. Expositionary characters, never asked to carry anything, to be a lead, to actually have a background story.

quote: I did not want to undergo chemotherapy, which I had a new name for, "kill 'em therapy".
before: What the classical conventional medicine had to do for me was there-nothing. For me, the next thing was the minister.
after: Or any type of radiation, I was extremely lucky that I found Dr. Burzynski.
ru: Я не хотел проходить химиотерапию, которую я называю "убей-их-терапия".

quote: I prayed for him every day when he was about to undergo the heart surgery.
before: I still cannot believe that they are getting married... This is a crazy pairing.
after: I think Gu Ae Jeong and Dok Go Jin look quite well together. What do you mean?
ru: Я каждый день молилась за него, пока он проходил лечение.

quote: Did you undergo any special treatments, any special vitamins or drugs?
before: Considered stripping. Had the body for it, but turns out, you can get a lot more for your eggs than for your boobs.
after: Not that I know of. Why are you here?
ru: Вы проходили какие-нибудь специальные процедуры, принимали какие-либо особенные витамины или препараты?

quote: Camino has come to say goodbye because she's going to Pamplona to undergo a long treatment.
before: Honey, what's given you that idea? It'd be a shame to die now, when everything's beginning to turn out right.
after: She wants to tell you she misses you all and promises to be back before the school year is over. Isn't that right, dearie?
ru: Камино приехала попрощаться с вами потому что она уезжает надолго в Памплону, проходить курс долгого лечения и хочет сказать, что будет очень по вам скучать

quote: It can undergo complex reactions, some of which are happily architectural.
before: It is able to move around its environment. It can follow chemical gradients.
after: So here we are. These are protocells, patterning their environment.
ru: Он может подвергаться сложным реакциям, и часть их них, к счастью, имеет отношение к архитектуре.

quote: However, he advised that Ayala should undergo a series of precautionary follow-up tests.
before: Tests were done on the finger to determine this. Dr. Martin Fenstersheib, Santa Clara County's health officer, said that even if the finger was still raw when Ayala bit into it, the risk was low that she would have become infected with anything.

quote: Underlying this was a profound shift.
before: What began to rise up in the 1970s was the idea that we, and everything else on the planet, are connected together in complex webs and networks. Out of that were now going to come epic visions of connectivity, like the Gaia theory, and utopian ideas about the worldwide web and the global economic system.
after: What was beginning to disappear was the enlightenment idea, that human beings are separate from the rest of nature and masters of their own destiny. Instead, we began see ourselves as components, cogs in a system, and our duty was to help that system maintain its natural balance.
ru: В основе этого лежал глубокий сдвиг.

quote: In terms of treatment, obviously, there is significant psychological trauma underlying the physical symptoms.
before: No more individual meetings. We see her together, in the office, in a controlled environment.
after: Neither of us is equipped to be delving into this woman's psychology. I know that.
ru: - Что касается лечения, налицо значительная психологическая травма, лежащая в основе физических симптомов.

quote: Unless we figure out the underlying disease, this guy's lied to his last constituent.
before: - Why are we doing this here? So Cuddy can't find us.
after: - False negative on the P.C.R. AIDS test? - Ran it twice.
ru: Либо мы найдем лежащее в основе этого заболевание, либо он солгал своему последнему избирателю.

quote: And we chose a conservative approach, which underlies the entire project.
before: Now, before going into some details of specific solutions, you may be wondering how we came to these calculations. Well, first of all, we collected a lot of data, and we used statistical analysis to create ranges that allow us to choose reasonable choices for every input used throughout the models.
after: All that data is entered in the model, ambitiously but plausibly projected into the future, and compared against what we would have to do anyway. The 84 gigatons reduced from onshore wind turbines, for example, results from the electricity generated from wind farms that would otherwise be produced from coal or gas-fired plants.
ru: Мы выбрали умеренный подход, лежащий в основе всего проекта.

quote: And although these walls look very different, Galois has produced a language to say that in fact the symmetries underlying these are exactly the same.
before: A third of a turn where the Z pieces meet. And the half a turn is halfway between the six pointed stars.
after: And it's a symmetry we call 6-3-2. Here is another example in the Alhambra.
ru: И, хотя стены выглядят совсем по-разному, Галуа изобрел язык, который позволяет утверждать, что, на самом деле, симметрии лежащие в основе этих этих двух узоров - идентичны.

quote: Now, put it this way: What ways of thinking about justice and morality underlie the arguments we have over marriage?
before: How many here favor the first policy: the state should recognize traditional marriage only? And how many favor the second, same-sex marriage?
after: The opponents of same-sex marriage say that the purpose of marriage, fundamentally, is procreation, and that's what's worthy of honoring and recognizing and encouraging. And the defenders of same-sex marriage say no, procreation is not the only purpose of marriage; what about a lifelong, mutual, loving commitment?
ru: Тогда поставим вопрос так: какие точки зрения на справедливость и мораль лежат в основе наших дискуссий о бракосочетании?

quote: How well does a criminal trial capture the history of the events underlying the crimes?
before: WN: You have suggested in your book, The Memory of Judgment, that the Holocaust trials have a pedagogical value - they document events and serve as a historical record, in addition to serving the cause of justice.

quote: Well, I don't understand why they'd say that.
before: You know what they said happened. They said that I advised that girl to have an abortion.
after: I mean, that doesn't make sense. Well, I know it doesn't make sense.
ru: Ну, я не понимаю, почему они так сказали.

quote: You have to understand what this baby is.
before: But, when you're looking for the baby I see only the motions. It has to be more real for you.
after: To understand what a missing baby is, you must understand what it is to have a baby. It comes from the body, not from the mind.
ru: Ты должна начинать понимать, что значит этот младенец для тебя.

quote: If you don't want to go through with this, I totally understand.
before: Noma! What?
after: I've come this far. You think I'm giving up now?
ru: Если ты этого не хочешь, я полностью понимаю.

quote: He just terminated my employment, and I don't understand why.
before: You seem upset. I've been the head of his security detail for 20 years.
after: If it's about the other night, I-I was following orders. He told you to shoot that man?
ru: А он только что отказался от моих услуг, и я не понимаю, почему.

quote: Something inside of me was changing that I just didn't understand.
before: He was very intimidating, and there was absolutely no doubt in his guilt. But regardless of his guilt, as the days passed, I began to see this monster as a human being.
after: I was beginning to question myself as to whether or not I wanted to give this man the death penalty. Jury deliberations began, and the judge gave us jury instructions and it was to be used as a tool in how to reach a verdict.
ru: Внутри меня что-то менялось, а я не понимала, что.

quote: And of course, I'd smile as if I understood everything.
before: Now, dealing with an unfamiliar language was at times very frustrating and uncomfortable. I found myself several times at parties clutching my glass of wine, without understanding a single word of what was being said around me.
after: I felt limited in my ability to say what I thought, what I felt, what I believed. Not only did I not understand the conversations, but the streets were full of signs and text that I couldn't read.
ru: Разумеется, с улыбкой на лице, как будто всё понимала.

quote: And we don't understand why they won't let us in. Right?
before: This is the modus operandi that we have today. We roll 120-foot Spartan, i.e. our vision, up to our clients' gates of Troy.
after: Well, how about instead of doing that, we roll up to the gates something they want. Now this is a little bit of a dangerous metaphor, because of course we all know that inside of the Trojan Horse were a bunch of people with spears.
ru: И мы не понимаем, почему они не хотят нас пускать внутрь?

quote: And if you want to do essential business, okay, I understand!
after: Some people [don't] have a car, some people—like for example, do you know many nurses live in Long Island, they have to drive their car? A lot, a lot!

quote: Well, I believe we have apprehended the responsible party undertaking all necessary steps to ensure that the sensitive information is contained.
before: Going somewhere? So you believe your stewardship of MI6 during the recent crisis has been up to scratch?
after: Ugh! Such a job well done.
ru: Я полагаю, что мы задержали ответственного за эти события. И предпринимаем все необходимые меры, чтобы обеспечить сохранность конфиденциальных сведений.

quote: My firm is making it a priority to identify a number of city youths... who are in crisis, and to undertake efforts to reorder their lives.
before: -but two attorneys from your firm, Mr. Levy? -This is pro bono, Your Honor.
after: Excuse me, I can't help but notice that your client is under a delinquent petition... for the sale of narcotics, and further, for assault on a police officer. Beyond that, he walked away from a JSA facility.
ru: Моя фирма считает своей приоритетной задачей замечать молодых горожан... которые попали в трудное положение, и предпринимать усилия для приведения их жизни в порядок.

quote: North Korea has conducted missile test launches and undertaken a nuclear test.
before: "The situation has changed since the last six-party talks in September last year.
after: Talks shouldn't re-open without careful consideration," added Nakagawa. North Korea successfully tested a nuclear missile on October 9, 2006.

quote: Said of a being that unites the characteristics of both sexes.
before: From 'Hermaphrodite'... Mythological.
after: The leech is a hermaphrodite. In zoology, what one calls the creatures that have a male genital gland and a female genital gland (leech), the creatures that..."
ru: Существо, которое объединяет в себе отличительные черты обоих полов

quote: A captured wildling swears their tribes are uniting in some secret stronghold, to what ends the Gods only know.
before: Beyond the Wall, the rangers are reporting whole villages abandoned. At night they see fires blazing in the mountains from dusk until dawn.
after: Outside Eastwatch Cotter Pyke's men discovered four blue-eyed corpses. Unlike us, they were wise enough to burn them.
ru: Пленные одичалые клянутся, что их племена объединяются в какой-то секретной крепости, только Боги знают, ради чего.

quote: All the new Watchdogs, they're recruiting in prison, uniting against us.
before: I see it, too. It's how they're organizing.
after: Man: Hey, you seeing this? It's S.H.I.E.L.D.
ru: Все новые Сторожевые, они рекрутинг в тюрьме, объединяются против нас.

quote: The Alpha Quadrant will unite. A new, stronger Federation will rule for thousands of years.
before: It'll spread. Within another generation they'll conquer the Dominion.
after: But since we can't win this war, why not save as many lives as we can? I know it's difficult to accept.
ru: Миры Альфа-квадранта объединятся в новую, единую Федерацию, которая просуществует тысячи лет.

quote: The Roman Catholic Church urges "fruitfulness" on the faithful?
before: Um, well... ..i-in Germany, the expression is to go in peace, loving God and...be fruitful. Fruitful?
after: What cultish gibberings is he spreading in the Lord's house? By night, he revels in... unholy affections... by day he mocks the creed.
ru: Римско-католическая церковь призывает верующих быть плодовитыми?

quote: If you're concealing anything, I urge you to reveal it now.
before: With all due respect, Father, you are not the police. No, but I believe the key to these murders lies within the walls of St Bridget's.
after: I lied to hide my sin. The worst sin of all.
ru: Если вы что-то скрываете, я призываю это открыть.

quote: Others have urged me to do just that.
before: Child, I could kill you 100 ways. I will not lie.
after: And I am fully prepared to cut your candle short. What do you want?
ru: Меня призывают сделать именно это.

quote: I'd urge you to think about your future.
before: You're not gonna answer for your crimes. The past is past, Mr. Holmes.
after: Are you okay? Uh, yeah.
ru: Я призываю вас подумать о будущем.

quote: In dance, the great choreographer, George Balanchine, used to urge his dancers, "Don't think, just do."
before: In basketball, the term " unconscious " is used to describe a shooter who can't miss. And San Antonio Spurs star Tim Duncan has said, " When you have to stop and think, that's when you mess up. "
after: When the pressure's on, when we want to put our best foot forward, somewhat ironically, we often try and control what we're doing in a way that leads to worse performance. So what do we do?
ru: В танцах, великий хореограф Джордж Баланчин убеждал своих танцоров: «Не думай, делай».

quote: I urge you to take five minutes and look at those films.
before: We've had over 30 million views. Most of these discussions are still happening online.
after: I come from Mali, one of the world's poorest countries. I grew up in a family where every dinner conversation was around social justice.
ru: Я призываю вас потратить пять минут и посмотреть эти фильмы.

quote: So I urge you all to do what you can.
before: We are sleepwalking into the future. We're not ready for what's coming at us.
after: Life in the mid-21st century is going to be about living locally. Be prepared to be good neighbors.
ru: Поэтому я призываю вас всех сделать всё, что в ваших силах.

quote: Opposition politicians have urged the French government to take preventative measures.
before: In his announcement, Castex said, "the situation is getting worse and so we have decided to suspend all flights between Brazil and France until further notice". While a report from RT TV said the data from March 16 indicates Lineage P.1 represents 0.5% of all COVID-19 cases in France.
after: Member of the Socialist Party Boris Vallaud said this suspension was "necessary and a very good decision".

quote: And he didn't use bleach Because that would cause discoloration And leave an odor.
before: I'm thinking peroxide. Hansen must have used it To clean all the blood evidence.
after: And makes it obvious That a cleanup had taken place. He also left the alarm clock on the windowsill, exposing it To direct sunlight.
ru: Он не использовал отбеливатель, это бы оставило пятна и запах,

before: You are now under arrested. You have the right to remain silence.
after: I just got out. Right.
ru: Все, что вы скажете, может и будет использовано против вас в суде.

before: And in writing one of the scenes, it happened in that third valley. For some reason I wrote about cairns — stacks of rocks — that a man was building.
after: I got stuck, and a friend, when she asked if I would go for a walk with her dogs, that I said, sure. And about 45 minutes later, walking along the beach, I came across this.
ru: Я не знаю почему этот образ пришел ко мне, но он был очень ярким.

quote: Now, stories are powerful, they're vivid, they bring it to life.
before: The biggest problem is not that we live in a post-truth world; it's that we live in a post-data world. We prefer a single story to tons of data.
after: They tell you to start every talk with a story. I did.
ru: Да, истории сильны, они ярки, они придают себе жизнь.

quote: He said that is a vivid display of freedom of speech in Egypt.
before: Mr. Bush's visit prompted some demonstrations and angry editorials in various newspapers.
after: But he made clear more reforms are needed.

quote: Have I ever told you how-how wonderful your voice is?
before: I won't keep you waiting, trust me. Hey, hey.
after: It's like hot tea and-and honey. Any child who has a father with a voice like yours is just...
ru: Я когда-нибудь говорила, какой у тебя замечательный голос?

quote: I knew boys' voices changed, but this is weird.
before: I sound awesome. Sound awesome.
after: Weird and bad. Mabel, this is the best thing that ever happened to me.
ru: Я знала, что голоса парней меняются, но это странно.

quote: I'm kinda busy right now, but it's really good to hear your voice.
before: Hi, Todd. Honey.
after: What's going on? It's Todd.
ru: Я типа занят сейчас, но очень здорово слышать твой голос.

quote: How many cigarettes do you smoke a day to get your voice to sound like this?
before: I mean, arrivederci. I got it when i was 12, but i don't know why you need to know.
after: I don't smoke, and my voice doesn't sound like that. How many guys did you sleep with in high school?
ru: Сколько сигарет ты куришь в день, чтобы твой голос так звучал?

quote: Our stories are still misunderstood, our bodies are still taken advantage of, and our voices?
before: Like, that's insane, right? And most people still don't really understand the full picture, right?
after: Our voices are silenced in a world that still shows little concern for our everyday struggles. So our stories need to be told in a multitude of ways by a range of voices talking about diverse and nuanced topics, and they really need to be listened to.
ru: Нас по-прежнему не понимают, из нас пытаются извлечь пользу, а наши голоса?

quote: So there is a lot to learn from listening to voices.
before: Meaning, how you decide to place your voice when you talk to someone. And you vocal posture, when you talk to your spouse, can help predict not only if, but also when you will divorce.
after: And I believe this has to start with understanding that we have more than one voice. So, I'm going to talk about three voices that most of us posses, in a model of what I call the mask.
ru: Итак, можно многое узнать, прислушиваясь к голосам.

quote: So, we're inviting into our lives the voices of people who are not present with us.
before: The first really big health issue is a word that Murray Schafer coined: " schizophonia. " It's a dislocation between what you see and what you hear.
after: I think there's something deeply unhealthy about living all the time in schizophonia. The second problem that comes with headphone abuse is compression.
ru: Таким образом, мы вызываем в нашу жизнь голоса людей, которых нет с нами.

quote: Text-to-speech software is getting better every year, with an increasing focus on "natural" voices.
before: Besides human readers, there's also the fully automated approach of turning text into sound.

quote: The younger one's probably looking for a father figure, trying to fill some emotional void.
before: We should consider a father and son team, brothers, or possibly an Uncle and nephew. But even if there is no biological connection, this relationship has all the hallmarks of their kind of bond.
after: No fuss, no muss. You have your fun and Johnny law's none the wiser.
ru: Младший, скорее всего, ищет фигуру отца, пытаясь заполнить внутреннюю пустоту.

quote: It talks about "other worlds beyond ours, places on the other side of the void."
before: The book doesn't say who they are? No, just where they're from.
after: they have to have been born in another world, like I was. Jennifer, just because you can hear the barn and read the book... and was left here by agent Howard.
ru: Она говорит о "Другие миры за пределами нашего, места на другой стороне пустоты."

quote: The only answer to the void is time.
before: And losing someone the way that you did, it creates this void. And sometimes when you work closely with somebody else, it feels like an answer to this void, but it's not.
after: So do yourself and your album... and me... a favor, and just stay friends. Okay?
ru: Эту пустоту залечит лишь время.

quote: He can't fix that void, if he doesn't take responsibility for creating it.
before: Yeah, everything about him is still capable of it. It just doesn't make a difference if he's given up.
after: I-I-I can't make him change unless he wants to. And if he never wants to?
ru: Он не сможет заполнить эту пустоту, пока не возьмёт ответственность, что он сам её создал.

quote: There are moments when we have to face the void, and fear can paralyze us.
before: These are fragile ecosystems. And it's between these spheres that we build nets that connect us.
after: One of the most beautiful things about this exhibit is the sense of solidarity generated when we face these new " aero-graphs. " Finally, let me tell you one last story.
ru: которые нас соединяют. Бывает, что мы оказываемся над пустотой и парализованы страхом.

quote: And you'll see there are all these filaments and structures and voids.
before: Notice this pattern and pay attention to this pattern. We're going to zoom in and zoom in.
after: And when a number of filaments come together in a knot, that makes a supercluster of galaxies. This one we're zooming in on is somewhere between 100,000 and a million galaxies in that small region.
ru: Вам станут видны все волокна, конструкции и пустоты.

quote: But I actually found a comfort in speaking out to the void.
before: Now, for many people, the internet can feel like a lonely place. It can feel like this, a big, endless, expansive void where you can constantly call out to it but no one's ever listening.
after: I found, in sharing my feelings with the void, eventually the void started to speak back. And it turns out that the void isn't this endless lonely expanse at all, but instead it's full of all sorts of other people, also staring out into it and also wanting to be heard.
ru: Но я понял, что мне нравится выговариваться в эту пустоту.

quote: Computer simulations showed that these voids contained dark matter.
before: One such phenomenon is the universal structure of galaxies. Galaxies tend to clump themselves together, with voids in between.
after: It had been theorized that this occurred because there was an extra force in dark matter clumping it together. Kesden mentions that these structures may be caused by other forces that affect only regular matter, like electricity and magnetism, but not dark matter.

quote: Slowly, on purpose, with their stinking music on full volume.
before: - Yes? - Last night they passed by again.
after: I was this close to beating them up. They started talking to each other in Arabic and laughed in my face.
ru: Специально едут помедленней, со своей вонючей музыкой на полной громкости.

quote: I'm open to trumpets, but easy on the volume.
before: Let's talk silhouettes. Focus on A-lines and sheaths.
after: Less dress, more bride. - Exactly.
ru: Пусть будет узким и в то же самое время немного объемным.

quote: What formula would you use to find the volume,hmm?
before: Sounds good.I take it you're familiar with all the equipment in the media lab? You have no idea how familiar I am with that equipment.
after: Mr.Court.So glad you've decided to join us. Would you like to tell us what formula you would use to find the volume of a triangular prism?
ru: Какую формулу вы будете использовать, чтобы найти объем, а?

quote: The guitar is at the max volume, no matter who plays it.
before: He said: "Take my place as guitarist". I thought it could work that way.
after: This is practically all. Many times you add a spring to the audio arm, right?
ru: Когда громкость гитары выкручиваешь на максимум, не важно кто на ней играет.

quote: My lungs reach residual volume, below which they're not supposed to be compressed, in theory.
before: And so I slowly continue sliding to the bottom. 40 meters down, 50 meters down, and between 50 and 60 meters, a second physiological response kicks in.
after: And this second response is called blood shift, or " pulmonary erection " in French. I prefer " blood shift. "
ru: Воздух в лёгких достигает уровня остаточного объёма, ниже которого в теории сжатие лёгких недопустимо.

quote: And we've been able to achieve 10 cents a page if we run things in volume.
before: So you basically do a beautiful, respectful job. This is not a fax, this is — the idea is to do a beautiful job as you're going through these libraries.
after: This is what it looks like at the University of Toronto. And actually, it turns out to, you know, pay a living wage.
ru: И мы смогли достигнуть стоимости в 10 центов за страницу, когда мы сканировали большие объёмы.

quote: It's basically one big volume of air that just oozes out in every direction.
before: It was dubbed " the bubble " by the press. That was the lounge.
after: The membrane is translucent. It's made of silcon-coated glass fiber.
ru: По сути это большой объём воздуха, который просто сочится в разных направлениях.

quote: Rounding out the bottom five states by volume of complaints, Mississippi had 11.
before: Wyoming had 8. Puerto Rico and Alaska had 9 each.

quote: As for obstruction of justice, we again make the argument that your actions weren't entirely voluntary.
before: I think the best plan would be to let the judge's wrath cool down. You could be out from the contempt thing this week.
after: We're not done. Don't despair.
ru: Что касается помехи правосудию, мы ещё раз постараемся доказать, что ваш поступок был не совсем добровольным.

quote: The Chinese have a cultural taboo that restricts voluntary donation.
before: We don't even know if he's transplanting them within the US. He could be exporting them to China.
after: You gotta die with all your parts or you dishonor mommy and daddy. I mean, you could still kill a guy for parts. That doesn't break that taboo.
ru: В Китае, по традиции, существует запрет на добровольную пересадку.

quote: It was a voluntary refresher course on police codes.
before: What is going on here? Teddy and I met at code camp.
after: Some long nights of intense memorizing. It was pretty dope. Sounds dope.
ru: Это был добровольный курс о полицейских кодах.

quote: A voluntary resignation's slightly more elegant than a bullet in the brain.
before: It seemed to achieve its goal. I understand Claude Denizet will resign today.
after: Without the threat of one, we would never have achieved the other. - It's the Middle East way.
ru: Добровольная отставка все же лучше, чем пуля в голову.

quote: But this depends on choosing a voluntary simplicity, growing qualitatively, not quantitatively.
before: And within those boundaries, they can carry a number of factors. We can still prosper, humanity can still prosper for 150,000 years if we keep the same stability of climate as in the Holocene for the last 10,000 years.
after: So in 1900, as you can see, we were well within the limits of safety. Now, in 1950 came the great acceleration.
ru: Однако это зависит от того, выбираем ли мы добровольную простоту и качественный, а не количественный, рост.

quote: International organizations, non-governmental organizations, private voluntary organizations, contractors.
before: (Laughter) Including us, I would remind you. The rest — wider array of partners.
after: You're not going to get away from that. Leviathan Force, it's all about joint operations between the military services.
ru: Международные организации, неправительственные организации, частные добровольные организации, подрядчики.

quote: It's based on more voluntary deference and even elements of love, at times.
before: Here you see submissive gestures from two members of very closely related species. But authority in humans is not so closely based on power and brutality as it is in other primates.
after: The fifth foundation is purity / sanctity. This painting is called " The Allegory Of Chastity, " but purity is not just about suppressing female sexuality.
ru: Она основана на более добровольном уважении и, иногда, даже элементах любви.

quote: Mandatory and voluntary evacuations, he says, are currently underway.
before: He also says that this category 2 hurricane will affect southern Florida, including Lake Okeechobee. Georgia, Texas, Mississippi, and New York are helping Florida prepare.

quote: "We're looking for subjects, volunteer subjects for some unusual research."
before: "I better get involved in this and make sure that somebody doesn't get hurt and and at least there be some sensitivity towards what this stuff is really about." I met Rick's research nurse at a party and she heard me talking about that I had used peyote, ceremonially and she took me aside and said "There's something that you might be interested in"
after: I was a little concerned that the study participants might be a litte obnoxious maybe that's not the right word but, you know, people that were just seeking to do a lot of drugs they were very professional people. They were varying degrees as to how much hallucinogen use they had been through.
ru: "Мы ищем добровольцев для не совсем обычного исследования."

quote: Were you secretly hoping that he'd pick you out of the audience as a volunteer?
before: Allison, were you a fan of August West before you went to watch him perform? Yes.
after: Yes. Yeah, you looked pretty excited on that video.
ru: Вы втайне надеялись что он выберет вас из публики в качестве добровольца?

quote: The volunteer will receive Mrs. Felix's $25 bonus.
before: A task force, if you will. You can't even buy a bag of wee... ee...
after: $25? Oh, screw it.
ru: Доброволец получит от миссис Феликс бонус 25$.

quote: We are looking for volunteers for the T-shirts committee.
before: Do we have volunteers to sell shirts? Put down your hands please in the back.
after: We volunteer, Milton. 10 days.
ru: Мы пытаемся увидеть, есть ли добровольцы в комитет по майкам.

quote: So the servers are managed by a ragtag band of volunteers.
before: We have exactly one employee, and that employee is our lead software developer. And he's only been our employee since January 2005, all the other growth before that...
after: All the editing is done by volunteers. And the way that we're organized is not like any traditional organization you can imagine.
ru: За серверами следит разношерстная толпа добровольцев,

quote: We have thousands of oiled penguins and thousands of willing but completely inexperienced volunteers.
before: And with that call, my life would change forever. It was Estelle van Der Merwe calling from SANCCOB, saying, " Please come help.
after: And we need penguin experts to come train and supervise them. " So two days later, I was on a plane headed for Cape Town with a team of penguin specialists.
ru: У нас тысячи облитых нефтью птиц и тысячи готовых помочь, но совершенно неопытных добровольцев.

quote: Every town that has a volunteer fire department understands this way of thinking.
before: The point is that you can find Ukrainian folk dancers and connect with them, because you want to be connected. That people on the fringes can find each other, connect and go somewhere.
after: (Laughter) Now it turns out this is a legitimate non-photoshopped photo. People I know who are firemen told me that this is not uncommon.
ru: В каждом городе есть отряд пожарных-добровольцев. Которые понимают такой подход.

quote: The crews themselves are also quite international in character, with volunteers from 50 different countries.
before: The OM website claims that, since 1970, the two ships have together reached 30 million people in 140 countries, in 435 ports around the world.
after: Powell gives credit to their shared Christian background for their ability to get along with each other despite their differences. The names of their ships also have Christian meaning: doulos means "servant" and logos means "word", as in holy scripture.

quote: "Representative Bookman greets young voters at Warwick mall."
before: Okay, let's cut. Sir, look at this Bookman photo op.
after: She's courting the youth vote. That means she's desperate.
ru: "Депутат Букман встречается с молодыми избирателями в Уорвик-молл."

quote: Transparency is the key to regaining the voter trust.
before: The people of Alaska believed in him, and... hopefully, I can get them to believe in me too. Well, you have me sold.
after: - Hmm. - Speaking of which, I was going through Bernard's briefcase, and I stumbled upon something. I don't even think I was supposed to see it.
ru: Открытость - ключ к восстановлению доверия избирателей.

quote: The overnight polls show women voters are loving it, as I predicted.
before: It's all over the news. Thanks to you.
after: Their husbands all cheat, so they're with you. But it's still important we show a united front tonight.
ru: Вечерние опросы показали, что женщинам-избирателям это нравится, как я и предсказывала.

quote: Four years from now, I think an outsider's what the voter will be looking for.
before: - Okay, Alex. - It's a good move.
after: Yeah, third-party candidate is the future, and always will be. Why did Garrett Walker change his mind?
ru: Думаю, через четыре года избиратель поставит на аутсайдера.

quote: In France, voter turnout hit a record low.
before: Voter turnout around the world peaked in the late' 80s, and it has been declining at a pace that we have never seen before, and if those numbers are bad at the national level, at the level of our cities, they are just dismal. In the last two years, two of the world's most consolidated, oldest democracies, the U.S. and France, held nationwide municipal elections.
after: Almost 40 percent of voters decided not to show up. In the U.S., the numbers were even scarier.
ru: Во Франции явка избирателей опустилась до самой низкой отметки.

quote: And when reaching young voters proved to be challenging, I became a Snapchatter.
before: I ran live Facebook sessions where I took questions from voters on anything and responded on the spot. And we put all the questions I got and all the answers on an open Facebook because we thought transparency is important if you want to establish trust.
after: I got young people to teach me how to do that, and I used every filter on Snapchat during the last part of the campaign. And I actually had to use a lot of humor and humility, as I was very bad at it.
ru: А когда оказалось, что привлечь молодых избирателей сложно, я перешла и в Snapchat.

quote: These girls banded together and formed a group and launched a campaign for voter registration.
before: And this was at the beginning of elections. This is one place where women were never — even the older ones barely sat in the circle with the men.
after: This is a real rural village. And the theme they used was: " Even pretty girls vote. "
ru: Эти девушки сплотились, создали группу и начали кампанию по регистрации избирателей.

quote: Typically, fewer than 40% of registered voters go to the polls during non-presidential election years.
before: Predictions of an unusually high level of voter turnout seem to be coming to fruition as voters throughout the country report longer than expected lines. One voter from Kansas City, Missouri reported a 90-minute wait, while voters in southwest Michigan reported that they had to park several blocks from the polls because of the crowds.
after: The highest midterm voter turnout on record occurred in 1970, when 47% of registered voters went to the polls.

quote: Union Pacific offers free rail passage and a week's wages on arrival.
before: My newspaper has reported Irish labor bosses conscripting them out here for a fee. How is that any different from indentured servitude?
after: We got more applicants than we got work. Really?
ru: Юнион Пасифик предлагает бесплатный проезд по железной дороге и заработная плата за неделю по прибытию.

quote: Now, what do you think the average wage was per year?
before: And so she thought, to raise money, she'd try and get those who could afford it to buy lottery tickets and the prize would be enormous. And the money raised would be enormous.
after: - It can't have been much, can it? - No, it wasn't much.
ru: Как вы думаете, какова была средняя заработная плата за год?

quote: I believe that's the new minimum wage.
before: What were your demands? Yeah, five thirty-five an hour, and that's what they're paying now.
after: And now you know who to thank for that. -All right, I gotta go.
ru: По-моему, это новая минимальная заработная плата.

quote: I've been making less than minimum wage for two years.
before: Which is against army regs. I need the money.
after: A lot less. We all have.
ru: Два года я получала меньше минимальной заработной платы.

quote: No movement in the wage gap for women in the United States.
before: Since I gave my TED Talk and published my book, another year of data came out from the U.S. Census. And you know what we found?
after: Seventy-seven cents to the dollar. If you are a black woman, 64 cents.
ru: Изменений в разрыве заработной платы женщин в Соединённых Штатах не произошло.

quote: That can lead to a vicious cycle as cost cuts eventually lower wages, leading to even lower demand.
before: Fear of a recession can become a self-fulfilling prophecy if it causes people to pull back investing and spending. In response, producers might cut operating costs to help weather the expected decline in demand.
after: Even policy designed to help prevent recessions can contribute. When times are tough, governments and central banks may print money, increase spending, and lower central bank interest rates.
ru: Всё это превращается в порочный круг, поскольку при снижении затрат также снижаются заработные платы, из-за чего спрос ещё больше падает.

quote: As wages increase that also lifts the burden on the poor and the working class.
before: Number two: a declining population means scarce labor. Scarce labor drives wages.
after: Now I'm not talking about a radical drop in population like we saw in the Black Death. But look what happened in Europe after the plague: rising wages, land reform, technological innovation, birth of the middle class; and after that, forward-looking social movements like the Renaissance, and later the Enlightenment.
ru: Когда заработная плата растет, это также снимает бремя с бедноты и рабочего класса.

quote: The current state mandated minimum hourly wage rate is $6.50 for an Illinois employee.
Did you come about the crack in my wall?
before: Why? Did you call a policeman?
after: What cra...? Agh! Are you all right, mister?
ru: - Вы пришли из-за трещины в моей стене?

quote: No, it's safer if we climb over the curtain wall.
before: Wait, wait! Stairs! No, we sneak out through the courtyard.
after: Trust me, hiding from royals is my life. No, the courtyard is clear now, but it won't be for much longer.
ru: Нет, мы выскользнем через двор. Нет, безопаснее будет перебраться через стену.

quote: The Wall is not just ice and stone.
before: This is where I leave you. You're not coming with us?
after: Ancient spells were carved into its foundations. Strong magic to protect men from what lies beyond.
ru: Стена — не просто лед и камень.

quote: He pissed me off, I punched the wall.
before: I was... I was thinking. And this?
after: - I do everything by the book. - I know you do --
ru: Он разозлил меня, я саданул по стене.

quote: We walked the Great Wall of China to say goodbye.
before: And as every relationship comes to an end, ours went too. We didn't make phone calls like normal human beings do and say, you know, " This is over. "
after: I started at the Yellow Sea, and he started from the Gobi Desert. We walked, each of us, three months, two and a half thousand kilometers.
ru: Мы прошли Великую Китайскую стену, чтобы попрощаться.

quote: I saw the writing on the wall and I sold it.
before: Except it wasn't always such a surprise. For example, my Manhattan apartment nearly doubled in value in less than four years.
after: (Laughter) (Applause) So, a lot of other people also saw the warning, spoke out publicly and they were ignored. So we didn't know exactly what the crisis was going to look like, not the exact parameters, but we could all tell that the thing coming at us was as dangerous, visible and predictable as a giant gray rhino charging right at us.
ru: Я увидела надпись на стене, и я её продала.

quote: Now, on the wall, we saw two eyes.
before: What you can see is a photo of a wall of a tomb in Northern Sudan. A colleague and I were traveling in a very remote village, and we asked an old man to take us down into a little tomb.
after: One is crying, and you can see there are tweezers next to it. Simon said to me, " My God, do you think that's trachoma? "
ru: Там на стене мы увидели два глаза.

quote: The gunman allegedly spray painted the letter 'V' on the meeting room wall.
before: Witness have said that shots were heard, however there are reports circulating that the gunman shot blanks instead of live rounds. A reporter who was in the room at the time thinks the weapon may have been a "cap gun", but police say that the weapon was a pistol loaded with live rounds.
after: The 'V' is the same symbol used in the movie V for Vendetta.

quote: And, and you don't have a monopoly on the war, Mr Carne.
before: She's appalling, I don't even know why you're considering her. Because she was the only candidate who had a notion of what the future might look like.
after: I don't claim to Mr Astell. Glad to hear it.
ru: И у вас нет монополии на войну, мистер Кaрн.

quote: Our marriage was a war, our divorce a cold war.
before: I was planning on it. So was Ron.
after: We were each taking positions, building arsenals. And that's why you created the fake profile?
ru: Наш брак был войной, наш развод был бы холодной войной.

quote: This is going to be a long war.
before: I'm a little old for Macho optimism, Mr. President. Here's the truth.
after: Every war is longer than you think it's going to be. You'll be strongest on your first day, And every day after that, you'll get weaker And they'll get stronger.
ru: Все войны длятся дольше, чем мы предполагаем.

quote: War is coming to man, Michael, whether you wish it or not.
before: And if you defy him you'll anger him for the last time. Only if I fail.
after: The dogs of heaven will be unleashed. Sandra.
ru: Грядёт война Михаил, хочешь ты того или нет.

quote: The war came when I was still a baby.
before: There is no hatred allowed in my class. My story is like that of so many other refugees.
after: And my father, who had been absent in most of my early childhood, was doing what other men were doing: fighting for the country. He had two wives and many children.
ru: Когда началась война, я была ребёнком.

ru: Он отличался не только мудростью, но и восхитительным чувством юмора.
